0001_grand-illusion.jpg.People: Two painted men: a large half-body portrait of a blond man glancing upward and to the side, and a smaller bust of a uniformed man in a peaked cap and monocle at lower left. They do not look at each other; one looks away anxiously, the other stares out.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Composition: Tall vertical portrait boxed in a thick black frame with a top band. The big head sits upper right, the small officer lower left, forming a diagonal; the title arcs between them along the curve of the dark cloak.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or tempera illustration with soft modelled skin and visible brush texture, on a flat orange ground. A small signature is painted at the right edge.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Typography: Rounded geometric sans, title in large cream letters curving down the right in a quarter-circle, with credits in pastel blue, pink, yellow, green and tan following the same arc. Lettering overlaps the dark cloak and reads as part of the picture.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red-orange background, black clothing, warm tan skin; flat even light.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Story it suggests: A wary man in a dark coat is watched over by a stiff, aloof officer, suggesting captivity, rank and distrust.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Visual idea: Two faces of different class and attitude are paired, with the cast names bending in an arc as if the type itself were a curved wall around them.
0001_grand-illusion.jpg.Feels like: 1930s-40s European illustrated cinema poster, with a late-1990s DVD frame.

0002_seven-samurai.jpg.People: None; no figures, only abstract marks.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical stack on black: a grid of six rings in two columns of three at top, the title in the middle, byline below, one large brush glyph at the bottom. Strong bilateral order with a lot of empty black space.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Medium: Ink and brush on paper, with ragged, bleeding edges and uneven ink density; looks scanned and reversed out of black.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Typography: Hand-brushed lowercase-and-capital script, title at moderate size across the middle in white, with an irregular baseline. A small ring forms the O-like shape between words; the byline is a smaller brush hand. A big dark gray Japanese character sits at the bottom, with a gray side strip and logo outside the artwork.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with charcoal-gray ink rings and white ink lettering; no light source, purely graphic.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Story it suggests: A group counted out in ring marks before a single decisive word, implying a band assembled for one task.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Visual idea: Six rings plus the one in the title make seven, so the number in the title is drawn as marks, like brush stamps.
0002_seven-samurai.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary arthouse reissue with calligraphic Japanese ink aesthetic.

0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.People: One woman's face, huge, translucent and faded into the background so only eyes, nose and mouth show; no other people visible, the train is the only other subject.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Composition: Vertical, with the ghosted face top right, the title stacked in two enormous lines down the center-left, and a locomotive rushing diagonally from lower right toward the viewer. Sweeping music-staff ribbon of smoke runs across the middle.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Medium: Gouache-like illustration overlaid with a photographic face tint; stippled halftone sparkle around the train and steam.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Typography: Giant extruded art-deco condensed display letters filling most of the poster, stacked 'the / Lady / Vanishes', in orange gradient with deep maroon-black block shadow; the bottom has yellow bold slab caps for the director's name and a yellow script 'a film by'. The title dominates and drips into the face.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange and red with black silhouette, lit by two glowing white headlamps and orange sparkling steam.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman dissolves into the haze while a train barrels forward, implying a disappearance during a journey.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Visual idea: The face fading into the background literally enacts the title, while the train's smoke trails as music notation.
0003_the-lady-vanishes.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Art Deco travel poster blended with golden-age thriller.

0004_amarcord.jpg.People: Five painted figures in medium to full body: a woman in a hatch at upper left, a dark-haired teen in a gray cape, a smaller red-haired child, a blond youth in a cap, and a large smiling woman in red coat and fur collar at right with hand on hip. They crowd toward the front and mostly smile at the viewer.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Composition: Central dark title box splits the sky and sea from the street scene; figures arranged in a diagonal from lower left up to the big woman at right, with a ship floating on the horizon above and a building and tiled plaza as stage-like background.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Medium: Flat, naive gouache-style painting with outlined shapes, dry brush hatching and slightly distorted caricatured faces; matte paper look.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Typography: Title in a tall, thin art-nouveau sans in white caps with an interlocking 'OR', inside a navy rectangle with a thin white border; small spaced credit line beneath. Placed centered in the upper third, overlapping nothing in the picture.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Color and light: Candy pastels, sea blue, terracotta roofs, pops of red; bright, even sunlight.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Story it suggests: A seaside town's eccentric locals pose for a group portrait, as if remembered with exaggeration.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Visual idea: A memory rendered as a stage set, with caricatured townsfolk and a ship in the background.
0004_amarcord.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century Italian folk illustration, nostalgic and comic.

0005_the-400-blows.jpg.People: One person, a young face in tight close-up, one eye visible, with fingers of one hand gripping the wire at left. The face is seen through a diagonal wire mesh.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Composition: Full-bleed photo with a diagonal lattice crossing the whole frame; the face is slightly right of center and the big title sits stacked at lower right, balancing the hand at left.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with fine grain; the wire texture is rough and tactile.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Typography: Very large lowercase bold grotesque in white, stacked 'the / 400 / blows', right-aligned, filling the bottom right third; a small spaced-out lowercase credit line below. Clean and typeset, sitting over dark mesh shadow.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray with deep black; hard side light carving the face.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Story it suggests: A child looks out from behind a barrier, confined and watchful.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Visual idea: The mesh fragments the face into diamonds, a visual cage.
0005_the-400-blows.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave black-and-white cinema, in modern minimalist reissue design.

0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.People: Two figures, full-body: a tall beast-faced man in dark ornate costume at left and a woman in a long pale gown leaning against him. She gazes up at him; he looks away.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Composition: Figures cluster left of center in a diagonal; a dark balustrade with statues and antlers recedes at right; stone steps in the foreground and cloudy sky above. Title sits in the open dark area right of the woman.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with grain and soft focus, heavy tonal contrast.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Typography: Hand-written white script, 'Jean Cocteau' small above, 'Beauty and the Beast' larger in loose cursive with an asterisk-like mark between words; set right of the figures in the dark space, medium size.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome with luminous gown and dramatic dusky clouds; theatrical backlight.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Story it suggests: A frightening creature and a delicate woman share a fragile, tender moment at a garden terrace.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Visual idea: Contrast of dark fur and light satin, rough and soft, in one embrace.
0006_beauty-and-the-beast.jpg.Feels like: 1940s poetic fantasy film, dreamlike and theatrical.

0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.People: A crowd of small silhouetted figures packed in lifeboats at the bottom, seen from behind or in profile; some faces are blurred. Many more are implied in other boats.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal: a large lit ocean liner tilting steeply from top right to center left, with lifeboats gathered in the lower right. Title is anchored at the very bottom.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Medium: Painted in oil with visible brushstrokes and canvas texture, rendered in grayscale; shimmering dabs for lights.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Typography: Very large tall condensed white caps in a single line across the bottom; a small tracked credit line above it. Hugs the lower edge, cut by the left sidebar.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white; bright rows of lights against deep dark night water.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Story it suggests: People in small boats watch a huge ship tilt and sink in the dark.
0007_a-night-to-remember.jpg.Visual idea: The tilted ship dwarfs the humans; its row of lights forms a cascading diagonal.

0008_the-killer.jpg.People: One man, half body, at left in a gray suit and tie, arm outstretched with a handgun pointing out of the right of frame; his head is cut-out and pasted over the splatter background, looking sideways with a hard stare.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Composition: Diagonal arm from left to the pistol at lower right, with a thin crosshair circle behind him and the title bar across the top. Splatter fills the right and bottom.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Medium: Cut-out photographic image on flat graphics: sharp white background, red splatter and brushed ink; the figure looks like a cropped photo pasted onto a layout.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Typography: Heavy black slab-serif caps, very wide and big, spanning the full width under a smaller 'JOHN WOO'S'; letters overlap the man's head and crosshair lines.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Color and light: White, red and black with the man's beige-gray suit; flat bright lighting.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Story it suggests: An armed man takes aim in a violent encounter marked by blood.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Visual idea: The crosshair circle and blood spray turn the page into a target.
0008_the-killer.jpg.Feels like: 1990s action film video cover, loud and graphic.

0009_hard-boiled.jpg.People: One man, large, shown from head to waist and thighs, tilted and falling backward toward the viewer while firing a pistol in each hand. His face is half-turned and squinting; both guns and fists are blurred in the foreground.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal: the body slants from upper right to lower left, with the left-hand gun pointing to the bottom-left corner and the other gun at mid-right. Title block stacked on the upper left balances the figure on the right; a black band caps the top.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with visible film grain, motion and focus blur on the hands, and a softly out-of-focus red background with bokeh blobs.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Typography: Two-line stacked title, very large, taking about a third of the poster width and height, in tall condensed sans capitals with a black drop shadow; the first line is white, the second yellow-orange. A small yellow possessive credit sits above, and wide-spaced white caps run across the black top band. The title sits left of the figure without covering his face.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Color and light: Deep red background, cream shirt, white and yellow lettering; hot, theatrical, saturated light.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is caught mid-fall in a violent shootout, firing in two directions at once.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Visual idea: Frozen action: the blur and tilt turn a single instant of gunfire into the whole poster.
0009_hard-boiled.jpg.Feels like: Late 1980s to early 1990s action thriller home-video cover.

0010_walkabout.jpg.People: One tiny silhouetted figure standing on one leg like a heron on the roof of a wrecked car, holding a long spear. Seen in full body in side profile, very small against the sky.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Composition: Large empty sky with a crescent moon at top center; the car and figure sit low, slightly right of center, with smoke billowing at left and a flat horizon of desert below. Everything sits inside a beveled gray frame that looks like a window.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Medium: Photographic composite with heavy film grain and a vignette; the frame has a rough concrete or noise-textured bevel.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized white outline-inline sans caps, 'WALKABOUT', set right of center in the sky with a small handwritten-style credit line tilted beneath. Floats in empty sky without touching the image.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Color and light: Dusk gradient from deep navy-violet to pink and pale yellow at the horizon; fire gives a small orange glow.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone figure surveys a burning wreck in a vast desert, implying survival and clash between nature and machine.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Visual idea: The tiny silhouette is balanced against a huge moon and sky, and the wrecked car is a relic in an empty land.
0010_walkabout.jpg.Feels like: 1970s desert odyssey, reimagined in modern moody poster style.

0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.People: One man, head and shoulders, in extreme close-up, head bowed so we see the top of the head, brow and nose; eyes are cast down. He emerges from total darkness.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Composition: Centered face on black, in the upper two-thirds; large empty dark space around; title and credit centered below with wide gaps.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white film still with fine grain; no visible texture beyond photo.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Typography: Small widely tracked serif capitals in pale gray, centered; title is modest, with a smaller credit line below. Calm and classical, separate from the image.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Color and light: Near monochrome, a single hard light picking out the pale hair and forehead against black.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stares inward in grim reflection or dread.
0011_the-seventh-seal.jpg.Visual idea: The face sinks into darkness as if emerging from or disappearing into the void.

0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.People: Three men's heads and shoulders, painted large, fill the lower half as a triangle: a dark-haired bearded man at left, a pale blond man in front-center, a brown-haired man at right. They stare out at the viewer with serious, flat expressions, packed close together.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Composition: Centered and roughly symmetrical: a huge arched title block across the top two fifths, black void in the middle, and the three faces forming an upward-pointing triangle below. Heavy empty black space separates lettering from faces.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Medium: Smooth airbrushed or digitally painted portraits with soft gradients on a flat black ground. The lettering has a glossy chrome, brushed-metal sheen with beveled edges.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Typography: Enormous spiky heavy-metal style logotype spanning nearly the full width, arched and jagged, in lilac-silver chrome with 3D bevels and a small umlaut-like mark above; a small widely spaced white sans 'THIS IS' sits above it. It is typeset or custom drawn and sits like a banner over the heads.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Color and light: Black background with violet, blue and pale lilac lighting on the faces and logo, like stage spotlights from below and the side.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Story it suggests: A trio of long-haired rockers glare out of the dark, projecting menace and swagger under a monumental band logo.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Visual idea: A band album cover or tour-poster: the logo is the monument and the faces are the trio standing under it.
0012_this-is-spinal-tap.jpg.Feels like: 1980s hard rock and heavy metal album art, airbrushed fantasy-poster style.

0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.People: No visible person; an ambiguous symmetrical inkblot with a skull- or face-like center and wing-like arms. It can be read as a moth or a skull but nothing clearly human.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Composition: Perfect left-right mirror symmetry around a central vertical axis; the blot occupies the upper two-thirds with title stacked in the lower third on white space.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Medium: Ink, blood-like paint and watery blots on white paper with glossy wet texture; looks like a real Rorschach print, with splatter drops.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Typography: Thin elegant light serif capitals in black, stacked 'THE / SILENCE / OF THE / LAMBS' with a larger last line, centered below the blot. A small red and black credit line at top. Spatters of red dots land around the letters.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Color and light: Stark white, with deep red and black ink; flat, clinical light.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Story it suggests: A mind or crime is read through a psychological test, with something violent hidden inside.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Visual idea: The Rorschach blot doubles as a moth and a skull, turning an image of a test into a threat.
0013_the-silence-of-the-lambs.jpg.Feels like: 1990s psychological thriller in a modern art-print style.

0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.People: One man, three-quarter body, gripping a long sword with both hands raised above his head, scowling and glaring sideways. He is a drawing, not a photo.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Composition: Large white circle behind him on a red field, the sword rising diagonally out of the top edge. Figure fills center and bleeds off the bottom; the title box sits at lower right.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Medium: Ink-brush drawing with dry-brush black strokes and pale pink flesh wash on textured paper, with a small red seal stamp near the right.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Typography: White caps on a black box at lower right, bold condensed sans with a small rotated 'SAMURAI' and big 'I'; a smaller line below with serif italic 'A film by' and the trilogy label. The box overlaps the figure's robe and is block-like and typeset.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Color and light: Flat vermilion red, white disc, black ink; no real light, graphic.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Story it suggests: A warrior prepares to strike, tense and fierce.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Visual idea: The white disc behind the raised sword reads as a rising sun, a red-and-white flag evoking a nation.
0014_samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto.jpg.Feels like: Modern ukiyo-e and manga-inspired illustration for a period martial-arts epic.

0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..People: One central swordsman in a crouched stance holding two swords, framed by a white disc; surrounding him are many gray, half-cropped attackers seen from behind or the side, with only heads, shoulders and feet showing. A crowd of about eight attackers, all drawn.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Composition: Radial and encircling: the hero sits upper center in a white circle, and long curved blades from all sides point inward, with the gray men crowding the lower right and corners. Title box at lower right.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Medium: Ink drawing with red-dot halftone shading on the gray crowd, hand-inked lines, and a small red seal stamp; textured paper.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Typography: Bold condensed white caps in a black box at lower right, with a small rotated 'SAMURAI' beside the numeral 'II', and a second box line below with serif italic credit. Typeset and block-like, overlapping the crowd.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Color and light: Flat vermilion red with black ink and gray halftone figures; no light source.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Story it suggests: A lone fighter is surrounded by a mob of blades and has to fight his way out.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Visual idea: Swords converge like spokes toward the hero, as the red disc becomes a target.
0015_samurai-ii-duel-at-ichijoji-temple..Feels like: Modern ink-and-manga take on a classic samurai epic.

0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.People: One man, three-quarter body, standing waist-deep in surf holding a long wooden oar like a weapon, headband streaming, scowling sideways. A single drawn figure.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Composition: Red sky with large white disc at upper left of center, a white sea horizon cutting the lower half, and a great curling wave at left; the figure is diagonal with the oar pointing down-left. Title box at lower right.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Medium: Ink and brush on textured paper, woodblock-like wave patterns in fine black lines, halftone-dot shading on the oar, red seal stamp.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Typography: White condensed caps in a black box at lower right with a small rotated 'SAMURAI' and numeral 'III', plus a lower line with a serif italic credit; sits over the waves and the figure's robe.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Color and light: Vermilion, black and white with pinkish flesh tones; flat graphic light.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Story it suggests: A warrior stands in the sea and prepares for a final confrontation.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Visual idea: The wave echoes classic woodblock prints, and the white disc is both sun and moon over a red sky.
0016_samurai-iii-duel-at-ganryu-island.j.Feels like: Contemporary homage to ukiyo-e and martial-arts epics.

0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.People: One nude figure with pale hair, seen in profile, kneeling and hunched forward with a hand pressed to the face; the figure fills most of the poster height and is out of focus. No second person.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Composition: The figure is a large curled shape sitting right of centre, facing left, against a dark empty room. A strict 4x5 grid of white tally-mark clusters is laid over the whole poster, ignoring the figure.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus, grainy photographic still with shallow depth of field; the tally marks are crisp flat white vector lines on top.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Typography: Title 'SALO' is in large, thin, widely spaced white sans capitals at mid-left; smaller spaced lines for the director's name and subtitle sit among the tally rows. The letters align to the grid rows and sit over the body without a backing.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Color and light: Muted skin tones and pale grey hair against deep brown-black; dim, diffuse indoor light.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Story it suggests: A person curls up in shame or grief while something is being counted off around her.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Visual idea: A clean tally grid imposed on a blurred, vulnerable body, as if the image is being tallied or ruled like a ledger.
0017_salo-or-the-120-days-of-sodom.jpg.Feels like: Austere arthouse Blu-ray design, contemporary, clinical and bleak.

0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.People: Two drawn figures: an upper close-up of a bald woman with a startled, wary stare turned over her shoulder, and below, a woman in a pink suit seen from behind carrying a suitcase and coat. Portraits of other women hang on the upper wall, also drawn.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Composition: Split in two horizontal bands: gray bookshelf scene above, bright yellow street scene below; title letters tower on the left and the walking woman is small at right facing a block of buildings.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Medium: Clean flat-color comic-style ink line art with spot colors and hatching, as in a graphic novel.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-drawn purple wobbly lowercase-and-capital letters, stacked 'The / Naked / Kiss', filling the left two-thirds of the lower half, with some letters bouncing and tilting; the upper credit is chunky white hand-lettered caps stacked on the right. Lettering is part of the drawing.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Color and light: Gray in the upper band, canary yellow, lavender and salmon pink below; flat, bright.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman arrives in a new place, carrying her bag, while a hard stare hints at a past she is leaving.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Visual idea: Two panels contrast the woman's inner stare with her outer arrival, a before and after.
0018_the-naked-kiss.jpg.Feels like: 1960s pulp drama translated into modern alternative comics.

0019_shock-corridor.jpg.People: One large man's head seen from the forehead down, eyes closed and brow furrowed. A tiny woman in underwear holding a feather boa floats on his forehead, like a thought; she is a drawing within the drawing.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Composition: Symmetric, centered face in the upper two-thirds, cropped at the nose, with a pink block below showing a long corridor in perspective; the title sits across the corridor.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Medium: Flat-color comic ink drawing with bold black outlines, hatching and speed lines.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Typography: Huge yellow hand-drawn block capitals with black drop shadow, stacked 'SHOCK / CORRIDOR', filling the pink lower third; credit in similar yellow caps across the black hair at top. Lettering is cartoonish and part of the drawing.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Color and light: Gray, pink and yellow with black; flat light.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Story it suggests: A man with his eyes shut is haunted by a thought, at the end of a long hallway.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Visual idea: The head is a room, the tiny figure is a thought, and the corridor is below him, showing inside and outside at once.
0019_shock-corridor.jpg.Feels like: Alternative comic-book reinterpretation of a 1960s exploitation film.

0020_sid-nancy.jpg.People: None; no figures. Two padlocks hanging from a chain suggest a pair.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Composition: Centered and symmetric: a chain forms a U-shape from the top corners, a wide black title band crosses its middle, and two interlocked padlocks hang below on blank cream space.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic with a slightly worn, high-contrast photographic look on the chain and rusty padlocks; the rest is flat ink.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Typography: Bold sans caps in yellow on a black band that cuts across the full width and is threaded by the chain; yellow underline; credit below spaced out to the width of the band. Small italic script engraved on the locks reads 'Love' and 'Kills'.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Color and light: Off-white ground, black, mustard yellow and metallic silver; flat light.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people bound together by a lock and chain, and the engraved words warn that love is dangerous.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Visual idea: A necklace-like chain with two locks stands in for a couple, so the pair is an object, not people.
0020_sid-nancy.jpg.Feels like: 1980s punk-era graphic design, raw and slogan-like.

0021_dead-ringers.jpg.People: One face, or possibly two merged: huge, blurry, close-up with a pair of eyes and eyebrows, a faint nose, and mouths and nostrils repeated at the left and right edges like a mirror doubling. Ambiguous whether it is one person with ghost doubles.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Composition: Bilateral symmetry; the face fills the poster below a title band, with the doubled features tiled outward from the center axis.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Medium: Soft airbrushed grayscale photograph, blurred as if a double exposure or photocopy, with a smooth gradient.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Typography: Elegant red classical serif caps with highlights, centered; a smaller spaced line above and the title larger between thin red rules. Clean and typeset, sitting above the eyes and not touching the image.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Color and light: Cool silver-gray with deep black features and red text; soft diffuse light.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Story it suggests: One identity splitting into copies, an unsettling mirrored double.
0021_dead-ringers.jpg.Visual idea: Facial features repeated and offset to show doubling and loss of identity.

0022_summertime.jpg.People: One main woman, half body, smiling and facing the viewer, holding a small blue book or ticket at a cafe table; smaller sketched people in the background, including a man reading a newspaper and a couple at left.
0022_summertime.jpg.Composition: The woman sits centered, with a loose arcade of arches behind her and a tabletop tray in front that holds a drink and a film camera; title scrawled across the lower area.
0022_summertime.jpg.Medium: Loose ink-brush sketch and gouache blobs with black dry-brush line, spot-color wash that is deliberately offset from the lines, paper white left showing.
0022_summertime.jpg.Typography: Large red hand-lettered brush script 'Summertime' spanning the bottom, with a smaller blue handwritten credit at the top right; both feel hand-painted and spontaneous, overlapping the color blobs.
0022_summertime.jpg.Color and light: Bright primary yellow, sky blue and coral red on white; sunny and cheerful.
0022_summertime.jpg.Story it suggests: A traveler sits at a cafe in a sunny foreign city, taking in the scene.
0022_summertime.jpg.Visual idea: Misregistered color blobs behind sketch lines give the feel of a travel sketchbook.

0023_robocop.jpg.People: None; no figures or faces, only the title carved in metal.
0023_robocop.jpg.Composition: Entire poster is a brushed steel plate with a raised border; the embossed title sits dead center, with a large empty field above and below.
0023_robocop.jpg.Medium: Photographic rendering of scratched, brushed metal with beveled, embossed lettering and subtle stains and rivet-like border.
0023_robocop.jpg.Typography: Blocky angular title in the plate, chamfered and with an inner outline, medium width across the poster, same color as the metal so it reads through shadows only. The top band carries small engraved wide-tracked letters in the same metal.
0023_robocop.jpg.Color and light: Cool gunmetal gray with soft top light and a warm sheen near the title.
0023_robocop.jpg.Story it suggests: A machine and its armor, sealed and impersonal.
0023_robocop.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is the object itself, a steel plate engraved with the name.

0024_high-and-low.jpg.People: Two figures in tight, cropped close-ups: a man at left in profile with dark hair, a hand holding a phone receiver to his ear, and a woman at right with a worried, wide-eyed face and a hand raised near her chest. They are side by side but each is cut off by the frame; the faces look tense and focused away from one another.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Composition: A big concentric-semicircle target or radio-wave motif sits at the center, built from thin cream lines over a crosshair of one vertical and one horizontal line that divide the poster into four panels. The giant letters HIGH and LOW are cropped at the top and right edges, with AND rotated sideways at left.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Medium: Coarse black-and-white film grain, a halftone newsprint texture, and a photocopy look; a Japanese newspaper page is visible behind the letters. Thin flat cream vector lines are laid over the grainy photography.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Typography: Gigantic black block capitals bleeding off the top and right edges so they are partly cut off; HIGH is stacked above LOW, with AND turned 90 degrees at the left. Overprinted on newspaper columns, with a small cream label strip reading 'A FILM BY ...' crossing the center of the lettering.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Color and light: Almost monochrome gray, black and white with cream accents, flat grainy daylight like press film.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense phone call, with a man listening intently and a woman anxiously watching, under the headlines of a crime in the news.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Visual idea: The phone receiver is the bullseye of a target or signal ring, linking the call, surveillance and a newspaper story, with the crosshair splitting the image into above and below.
0024_high-and-low.jpg.Feels like: 1960s black-and-white crime thriller, reworked in a modern Swiss-style graphic design.

0025_alphaville.jpg.People: Two faces dissolved into coarse halftone dots, barely legible: one in the upper red half, one in the lower purple half, upside down relative to the first. Ambiguous, abstracted near to unrecognizable.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Composition: Rotational symmetry: the lower half repeats the upper half turned 180 degrees, with title and name tags and the top and bottom bands mirrored. Crossing olive, brown and teal bars form a loose grid over the halftone field.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Medium: Giant coarse halftone dots, flat color blocks and strips, like screenprint or collage; no photographic detail.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Typography: Small tilted label-like boxes: lowercase bold sans title on a lime tag, and the director's name in a spaced serif on a mauve tag, each repeated upside down in the lower half. Letters are modest in size and look pasted on.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, black, purple, lime and olive; flat and artificial, no real light.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Story it suggests: A face seen as signal or data, doubled and inverted, in a world that treats people as patterns.
0025_alphaville.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is flipped upside down halfway to show a world mirrored and disoriented.

0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.People: One man's face in large close-up, tilted, with a cigar or cigarette at the lower mouth; his head fills most of the poster.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Composition: Face is huge, central and bleeds off the top and right; a torn union-flag-like shape of white and blue stripes runs diagonally from left. Title is turned 90 degrees, running down the right edge.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Medium: Two-ink screenprint look with red-orange and dark maroon, rough speckle, halftone grain and splatter, as if photocopied.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Typography: Tall cream distressed sans caps rotated to read top-to-bottom along the right edge, rough and chipped; small white bold credit lines at upper right and lower right. Hand-stamped feel.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, deep maroon, cream and a little teal-blue; harsh flat light.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard-faced man chews on a cigar, menacing and in command.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Visual idea: A flag and a face fused into one screenprint suggest national identity and crime.
0026_the-long-good-friday.jpg.Feels like: 1970s British crime film in a modern gritty print style.

0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.People: Several people shown in fragments: a bare torso with a stitched scar, a man with bound raised wrists and a sideways stare, a man licking at a wound-like seam, a man's large face in close-up, and a woman's face looking sideways. Five or six cropped photo shards.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Composition: Shattered photo collage on black: angular shards arranged vertically down the center like a broken column, with the title sweeping at left across the pieces.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Medium: Color photographic stills cut into jagged shards pasted on black; glossy, saturated film look.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn thin pinkish-red art-nouveau style lettering, with 'FLESH' large, small 'for', 'FRANKENSTEIN' very large and extending into the photo shards; a smaller credit line in the same hand. Tall, loose, elegant letters that cross the pieces.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Color and light: Black ground, skin tones, hot magenta-red lettering; glossy studio light.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Story it suggests: A body assembled from pieces, and people caught in a strange operation.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Visual idea: The poster itself is stitched together from fragments, like the body implied by the scar.
0027_flesh-for-frankenstein.jpg.Feels like: 1970s horror exploitation with arty pop sensibility.

0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.People: One man's face in large close-up, tilted, pale and unwell-looking with intense wide eyes, half in shadow.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Composition: Face fills the frame diagonally from upper left to lower right, with the title and credits stacked over the top of the head and forehead.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photograph tinted in magenta duotone, with grain and blown-out highlights.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Typography: Thin condensed art-deco caps in white, large 'BLOOD For DRACVLA' across the width, with a smaller 'ANDY WARHOL presents' above and a credit line below; sits directly on the forehead without a box.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Color and light: Deep crimson-magenta and black, with a spotlit pink glow on the left cheek; theatrical light.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Story it suggests: A weak, hungry man stares from the dark, suggesting a thirst that is also illness.
0028_blood-for-dracula.jpg.Visual idea: The duotone makes the whole face look bloodstained or blood-lit.

0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.People: About eight young women in white Edwardian-style dresses scattered across a sunlit clearing: one lying under an orange parasol holding a magnifying glass (foreground), one in a straw boater at right, others reading, standing or sitting in soft focus up the slope. Mostly calm, with little interaction.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Composition: Layered depth from foreground grass and a twisted branch, to the central parasol, to girls climbing a hazy dark rock face; the title is stacked in the upper middle over the hazy rock.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color film still, warm and grainy, with a hazy, vintage emulsion look.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Typography: Large stacked cream bold grotesque 'Picnic / at / Hanging / Rock', tight leading and uneven sizes, set in the upper center, with a small credit line below. Overlaps the rock and the mist, clearly typeset.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Color and light: Golden amber and creamy white with hazy backlit sunlight; dreamy and overexposed.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Story it suggests: A leisurely outing in white dresses in a strange, hazy landscape that hints at something unseen.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Visual idea: The sleepy, glowing mist against the looming dark rock hides a sense of unease behind beauty.
0029_picnic-at-hanging-rock.jpg.Feels like: 1970s pastoral period drama with a dreamy, uncanny mood.

0030_m.jpg.People: Two men in profile-ish view, large and half-body, framed tight; one in the foreground is mostly a dark silhouette under a wide hat, the other behind him looks over his shoulder with wide, wary eyes. They overlap closely, one stalking or shadowing the other.
0030_m.jpg.Composition: Portrait layout with a diagonal stack of faces from lower left to right; the foreground hat mass fills the left and top as a dark void, the lit face sits right of center, and a blurred building glows in the upper background. Lettering sits at the vertical middle between the two figures.
0030_m.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with deep contrast, soft grain and glow; photographic realism.
0030_m.jpg.Typography: Small, widely letterspaced serif caps on one line ('A FILM BY', a large rough white M, then the director's name), centered at mid-height; the M is scratchy and chalk-like, glowing as if marked on the dark coat. A vertical band at left carries the year and collection name.
0030_m.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays and near-black; low-key, hard window light picking out faces.
0030_m.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is being watched or marked by someone close behind him in a dark city street.
0030_m.jpg.Visual idea: The glowing letter M chalked on the coat works as a brand of guilt, placed exactly between the pursuer and the pursued.

0031_great-expectations.jpg.People: One small boy in silhouette, standing in profile, small in the mid-ground between two gravestones; no one else visible.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Composition: Church tower at left, gravestones flanking the boy at center, bare tree branches arching across the upper half; the title sweeps diagonally across the top over the branches.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still tinted green, high contrast, with visible grain.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Typography: Large ornate white copperplate script with flourishes, 'Great Expectations', running diagonally across the top, with smaller light-blue script above. The curling swashes weave among the branches.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Color and light: Murky green monochrome, with cold moonlit sky and dark foreground.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Story it suggests: A lonely child stands in a graveyard, frightened and small.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Visual idea: The ornate script tangles with the bare branches, as if the lettering were also part of the haunted setting.
0031_great-expectations.jpg.Feels like: Gothic 1940s literary adaptation, cold and eerie.

0032_oliver-twist.jpg.People: Four figures: a thin boy at lower right holding an empty bowl and looking up, and three adults at left, two of them hunched older men and one tall man in a ruffled coat cut off at the head, facing down toward the child. The adults look away or down.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Composition: Child at lower right is dwarfed by adults towering at left; the huge title stacks down the middle and right; the picture has a ragged torn black border.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Medium: Gritty black-and-white film still with rough printed edges, slightly blurred focus, a worn woodblock texture on the type.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Typography: Big rough woodcut-style salmon-pink lowercase 'oliver. twist' stacked, letters distressed and chipped, with 'David Lean's' in orange serif at top right. The letters overlap the men's heads and are dominant.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Color and light: Gray-black with a muted terracotta-pink title; dim, low-key light.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Story it suggests: A hungry boy asks the men in power for more and gets cold looks.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Visual idea: Small child, huge figures, huge letters, which makes the scale of the poor against power.
0032_oliver-twist.jpg.Feels like: 1940s social-realist literary film, rough and worn.

0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.People: One figure in a fur parka and white fur trousers, full body, twisting to throw or thrust a long harpoon with a coiled line in the other hand; face turned in profile.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Composition: Dynamic diagonal of the harpoon across the upper body; figure fills the left two-thirds, the title block sits at the upper right, with open snow around.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Medium: Grainy vintage black-and-white photograph with soft, bleached tones.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed red serif caps 'NANOOK' and 'NORTH' with a smaller red italic 'of the', set between dotted rules at the right, with a small spaced credit above. Typeset in a Victorian or Western woodtype flavor, slightly overlapping the arm.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale snow white with deep burgundy lettering; flat, bright, overcast light.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Story it suggests: A hunter in the snow braces to strike with a harpoon.
0033_nanook-of-the-north.jpg.Visual idea: The twisting body and diagonal spear freeze action and effort against empty white.

0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.People: One bearded man in a long dark cloak, full body, standing in profile and looking sideways, with a golden disc behind his head like a halo.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Composition: Tall central vertical figure inside a torn gray brush-stroke shape, with branches overlaid; the poster is mostly empty white. Title crosses the middle at figure height.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Medium: Gray photographic cut-out layered with rough painted edge, paper texture and a gold flat disc; double-exposure with bare tree branches.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Typography: Thin, widely spaced art-deco style serif capitals 'ANDREI RUBLEV' across the middle, with letters partly fading where they cross the cloak; tiny split credit line at the bottom. Light and delicate, overlapping the figure.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Color and light: White and gray with a single mustard-gold circle; soft and foggy.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary figure walks through a bare, wintry world, solemn like a saint.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Visual idea: The gold disc turns the man into an icon, a holy figure in a faded landscape.
0034_andrei-rublev.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary arthouse reissue with Orthodox icon reference.

0035_diabolique.jpg.People: One head only, a stylized face with long hair and closed eyes half submerged in water, grabbed by a huge red hand coming from above. Hand and head are cut-out shapes.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Composition: Diagonal: a gray triangular tiled wall at upper left, the red hand diving from the top into a head in a black bathtub of water; the title is slanted and curves with the ripples along the bottom.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Medium: Rough linocut or woodblock print look, with speckled flat ink, chipped edges and white-on-black ripple lines.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Typography: Cream chunky caps 'DIABOLIQUE', slanted and wave-distorted so letters break and tilt with the water ripples; a small credit line follows the same curve. Integrated into the water drawing.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Color and light: Black, cream, gray and a single spot of vivid red on the hand; stark graphic light.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Story it suggests: A person is held and pushed under water by an unseen attacker.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Visual idea: The red hand is the only color, so violence is the one bright thing; the title ripples like the water.
0035_diabolique.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French thriller, in a modern block-print horror style.

0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.People: One tiny figure clinging to the cab of a truck, a small speck against the vast cliff and sky; no faces visible. Scale makes the person nearly an afterthought.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from upper left to lower right: a truck hangs off a wooden trestle jutting from a steep rock slope, with a small crate falling in the lower left. Subject sits upper-center, tilted frame, black border around the image and a text block below.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Medium: Hand-illustrated look with flat layered ink tones, rough dry-brush edges and slight grain, like a screenprint in a limited tonal range.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Typography: Title at the bottom in large tan, bold condensed capitals, 'of' set smaller; director credit stacked small to its left; typeset, flat, sits on a black band under the image.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays and blacks with warm cream highlights and a tan title; dramatic overcast light with a bright patch of cloud low left.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Story it suggests: A vehicle is about to tumble off a collapsing ledge and a man hangs on, with cargo already falling away.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Visual idea: Vertigo made literal by tilting the whole world so gravity pulls the eye down the slope.
0036_the-wages-for-fear.jpg.Feels like: Tense adventure thriller illustration, modern limited-edition screenprint homage to mid-century suspense.

0037_time-bandits.jpg.People: Tiny figures barely visible on the rigging of a ship; the ship rests on a giant human head emerging from the water, which is a drawn face, not a person.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Composition: Ship on the left and a tall dark tower island on the right, both rising from a low horizon; thin perspective lines and horizontal bars radiate across the sky; a black slanted block holds the title at upper right.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Medium: Detailed pen-and-ink illustration with watercolor-like colored fills and a smooth airbrushed gradient sky, crisp and glossy like a 1980s painted poster.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Typography: Huge two-line title at upper right, tall serif capitals in cream with blue drop shadow and a metallic gloss, set on a black parallelogram that cuts the sky; the 'TIME' is cropped at the top edge. Small script and serif credit at bottom right.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Color and light: Saturated cyan-blue sky shifting to orange at the horizon, deep blue sea, cream sails; clear, dreamlike daylight-to-sunset glow.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Story it suggests: A fantastical voyage across an impossible sea toward a looming fortress, with time and space bent out of joint.
0037_time-bandits.jpg.Visual idea: Perspective grid lines and floating black slabs suggest warped space, as if the world is a slipping drawing board.

0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.People: One man's face in extreme close-up, eyes hidden behind dark sunglasses, lips visible; face fills the frame, partly covered by white butterfly shapes. Photographic person, not a drawing.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Composition: Face centered and cropped tight; white butterfly cutouts scatter diagonally over it, a large one over the nose and mouth and a big white curved shape top right that holds the title. Thin black frame and white margin.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic halftone-like image overlaid with flat solid white vector butterfly shapes and flat pink ink.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Typography: Title upper right in big bold sans-serif capitals, 'BRANDED TO' in hot pink and 'KILL' in black, small black credit above; sits on a white cut-out shape and overlaps the image edge, typeset and flat.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and hot pink; harsh flat studio-like light on the face.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard-faced man with hidden eyes is hunted or marked, as delicate insects swarm over him.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Visual idea: Delicate white butterflies masking a cold face contrast softness with menace and obscure features like censored patches.
0038_branded-to-kill.jpg.Feels like: 1960s crime film graphic design, pop-art modern reissue.

0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.People: One man repeated nine times in a 3x3 grid of poses, shown full or three-quarter body from behind and side, in a yellow jacket and dark trousers, white gloves, firing a pistol or moving; the repetition reads like a motion study.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Composition: Three rows of three figures against black, forming a loose grid with staggered poses; title runs vertically down the right edge, with the circled 'O' at the bottom.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Medium: Film-still photographic quality with motion blur and glowing pink muzzle flashes; looks like saturated color film frames on a black ground.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Typography: Title letters T-O-K-Y-O stacked vertically along right edge in thin hot-pink geometric capitals, the final 'O' a big ring containing small light blue 'DRIFTER'; tall, elegant and airy, feels typeset and stretched.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Color and light: Black ground, mustard-yellow jackets, hot pink flashes and lettering, pale blue accents; theatrical stage lighting.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone gunman moves and fires in staccato bursts through a dark void.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Visual idea: The sequence of frames turns one body into a chronophotograph, stretching a fight into rhythm.
0039_tokyo-drifter.jpg.Feels like: 1960s stylized Japanese pop crime movie, retro-modern reissue.

0040_armageddon.jpg.Composition: Almost entirely empty black field with a thin glowing arc of a planet's horizon sweeping across the lower third; title sits on the arc just below center. Huge negative space above.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Medium: Digital rendering: a fine orange rim light line and a rendered fire effect on the lettering, on flat black.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Typography: Title in small-to-medium serif capitals with a fiery orange flame effect along its top edge, nestled on the curve of the arc; the Criterion collection line in spaced thin gray serif capitals across the top.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Color and light: Pure black with a burning orange-yellow glow along one edge, like sunrise on the limb of a planet.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Story it suggests: Something burns at the edge of the world, with a vast darkness around it.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Visual idea: The title itself is the sun cresting the planet's horizon.
0040_armageddon.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s blockbuster DVD sleeve, minimalist and ominous.

0041_henry-v.jpg.People: One small man's face in helmet and a red-trimmed cap inside one frame of a film strip; shown as a close-up portrait photograph; tiny compared with the poster.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Composition: Large diagonal black film strip slants from upper left to lower center, forming a V; black rectangles and bars cut into a white field; title runs rotated up the right side of the strip; the portrait is small in the middle.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic design, solid black and red inks on white with a small color photograph of a face; the film strip has matte black plates with gray sprocket holes.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Typography: Huge sans-serif capitals in red on black, 'LAURENCE OLIVIER' top left, a big 'V' formed by the strip, and 'HENRY' rotated along the diagonal; credit 'BY WILLIAM SHAKESPEARE' bottom right in black bold; letters cropped or clipped by black blocks and rotated heavily.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and strong red; flat graphic with a muted-color portrait.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary man in armor is framed as a hero, a single frame of a larger story.
0041_henry-v.jpg.Visual idea: The roman numeral V is built from a film strip, merging title and cinema.

0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.People: Two men in a small wooden boat, one in a straw hat smiling and rowing, the other in a white hat seen from behind; three circular insets show faces and figures: a man in sunglasses and cap, a man in a conical hat, and a person in a dark coat by a shore. Real people in photographs.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Composition: A river scene filling the poster, boat lower right, fallen log left; title across the top; an oval gold badge with a fish drawing in the middle; circular portraits stack on the lower left.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Medium: Slightly oversaturated color photographs with a digital collage look: beveled chrome title, glossy gold badge, circular framed insets.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Typography: Huge two-line title across the top in beveled metallic gray capitals with drop shadows and glossy highlights, nearly edge to edge; it overlaps the foliage and water, clearly a computer effect.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Color and light: Deep green water and foliage, beige stones, golden yellow badge; sunny daylight.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men set out on a river, as other odd characters watch from side windows.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Visual idea: Collage of circles like fishing floats and a medal makes the cover a kitschy trophy.
0042_fishing-with-john.jpg.Feels like: 1990s home-video travelogue cover, a bit tacky and playful.

0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.People: One painted figure, a young person shown from chest up, face filling the center; a cloth band around the head with feathers or leaves, eyes staring, white-and-black paint streaked over the nose and mouth. It is a drawing or painting, not a photo.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Composition: Face centered and vertical, running nearly the full height; title letters spread widely in three tiers (LORD / OF THE / FLIES) around the head, with the face poking through the gaps; a bow-like white shape sits at the chest.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Medium: Mixed-media paint on stained paper: watercolor washes, charcoal and pencil lines, thick white gouache, visible paper stains and pink sketch lines.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Typography: Title letters are hand-drawn in rough dark charcoal strokes, very widely spaced, some letters replaced by diamonds or plus signs, stretched across the full width and layered over the face; credit at the bottom is in similar scrawl.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Color and light: Muted ochre, olive and gray on cream paper with white highlights and touches of pink; soft, dirty, diffuse light.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Story it suggests: A child gone feral, masked and wild-eyed, stares out as civilization frays.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Visual idea: Letters carved or scribbled like primitive marks, with the face painted as a tribal mask, turn the cover into a crude artifact.
0043_lord-of-the-flies.jpg.Feels like: Raw expressionist illustration, a handmade 'found notebook' look, contemporary art-house.

0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.People: One woman's face in huge close-up, wide blue eyes, dramatic eye makeup, red lips, sweat beads on her forehead, one hand pressing against her head at left, with a mass of red-orange hair. Real photograph of a person.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Composition: Face fills the poster, slightly right of center, with the hand and flame-like hair on the left; the title crosses horizontally under the eyes; credit across the top.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Medium: Film still: soft focus, fine film grain, saturated Technicolor-like color photographic realism.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Typography: Title mid-left in medium-large elegant serif capitals, white with 'RED' in red, set across the face and hand below the eyes; credit across top in small white serif; typeset, clean, sharp over a blurred background.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Color and light: Burning reds and oranges, pale skin, bright blue eyes; warm theatrical stage light.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks out in a trance of fear or ecstasy, possessed by something.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Visual idea: The red hair and the 'RED' in the title tie the image to a single obsessive color.
0044_the-red-shoes.jpg.Feels like: Classic 1940s Technicolor melodrama, glamorous and feverish.

0045_taste-of-cherry.jpg.People: One man, roughly life-size from head to thigh, half body, dissolved into a dust-like haze; his raised open hand is the clearest detail and the figure reads partly as a silhouette.
0045_taste-of-cherry.jpg.Composition: Single vertical figure slightly right of center, head near the top, body fading toward the bottom; title sits across the lower torso. Empty haze fills the sides.
0045_taste-of-cherry.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with heavy grain, soft focus and a monochrome amber wash, like film seen through dust or smoke.

0046_the-most-dangerous-game.jpg.Typography: Title in three tiers: THE MOST and GAME in small widely spaced olive capitals with chiseled cut edges, DANGEROUS in large dark maroon bold condensed capitals on a white strip; all right-aligned, typeset, spaced out.

0047_insomnia.jpg.People: One blurry face in extreme close-up, only part visible, with a bright white blob where an eye would be; faintly ambiguous, more like an out-of-focus presence.

0047_insomnia.jpg.Typography: Title in widely spaced blue sans-serif capitals, ghosted with doubled offset copies, broken by the white circle covering the 'O'; credit is small gray serif at lower right; the letters blur like vision.

0048_black-orpheus.jpg.People: Two people: a man carrying a woman in his arms, he smiling down at her, she looking up; full-length painted figures, central and large; they are an illustration.

0048_black-orpheus.jpg.Medium: Painted gouache-like illustration with visible brushstrokes, saturated opaque colors against black, and flat round dots like paper confetti.
0048_black-orpheus.jpg.Typography: Title at the bottom in large cream serif capitals, nearly edge to edge, cut off slightly at the sides; credit above in small gray-cream capitals; typeset and solid, sitting below the figures.

0048_black-orpheus.jpg.Feels like: 1950s painted film poster, romantic and festive.

0050_and-the-ship-sails-on.jpg.People: One man, head and shoulders, hair swept up, with a sly sideways grin and dark-ringed eyes, wearing a black suit with a big red bow; a cutout photograph, placed in a circle.

0052_yojimbo.jpg.Composition: Centered stack: a small crest at the top, a credit, then a large trefoil family-crest emblem with two crossed revolvers and six dots, with the title running across it; a repeating pattern of the small crest fills the lower half.

0053_sanjuro.jpg.People: None. A drawn family-crest-like emblem is the only figure-like element, and no human or animal appears.

0053_sanjuro.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary arthouse reissue evoking old Japanese woodblock and heraldic print.

0054_for-all-mankind.jpg.People: One tiny figure in a bulky spacesuit running or striding on the lunar surface, seen from behind and the side, in the left-center of the image; dwarfed by the landscape.

0054_for-all-mankind.jpg.Visual idea: The enormous title versus the tiny person shows scale of ambition against emptiness.

0055_the-unbearable-lightness-of-being.j.People: Three people in two panels: left, a woman's face tilted and lit in blue, wearing a black bowler hat, eyes half open, lying back; right, a man and woman embracing, faces nuzzling in warm light. Real photographs of people.

0055_the-unbearable-lightness-of-being.j.Typography: Title in thin tall condensed lowercase white letters, split into 'the lightness being' on the left and 'unbearable of' on the right, in words alternating across the divider with underline rules, a staggered lower half; typeset and lightweight.

0055_the-unbearable-lightness-of-being.j.Visual idea: The title alternates across the divide, so 'lightness' and 'unbearable' sit on opposing sides.

0056_the-39-steps.jpg.People: One man seen from behind in a long overcoat, large in lower center, running across a ridge; behind him tiny figures at left (one aiming a stick or rifle) and two small figures at right; small helicopter-like aircraft above. Silhouette-like and photographic.

0056_the-39-steps.jpg.Typography: Title stacked and tilted in dark teal bold slanted capitals with oversized '39' and smaller 'STEPS' angled upward; credit above in olive italic capitals; typeset, flat, sits in the sky and interacts with the cloud.
0056_the-39-steps.jpg.Color and light: Gray-white clouds, black ground, teal title, olive credit; flat overcast light.

0057_charade.jpg.People: Two people, a woman in a red coat and a man in a yellow jacket with a gun, running side by side in full body at the center of the poster; small relative to the swirling arrows; drawn/painted figures.

0057_charade.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people flee together through a confusing loop.
0057_charade.jpg.Visual idea: A spiral of arrows suggests confusion, misdirection and a game of tracing.

0059_the-night-porter.jpg.People: Two people in tight close-up: a person with short hair in a dark cap with a blue mask resting their head sideways against a bare chest, while a black-gloved hand presses on skin; the faces are cropped, the figures merge into one embrace. Real photograph.

0060_autumn-sonata.jpg.People: Two girls in white shirts and shorts: one seen from behind standing in a room, the other a mirror reflection; painted, faceless, small figures at left.

0061_monty-python-s-life-of-brian.jpg.People: No human figures except tiny silhouettes of three riders on camels at the bottom and two small cherubs holding a ribbon at the top.
0061_monty-python-s-life-of-brian.jpg.Composition: Giant three-dimensional title block slants diagonally from upper left to lower right across the whole poster; a small ship flies at left shooting beams; camels tiny along the bottom horizon; star-filled space around.

0061_monty-python-s-life-of-brian.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s space-opera parody, painted airbrush epic.

0062_the-passion-of-joan-of-arc.jpg.People: One person in tight close-up, a tear-streaked face tilted up with eyes looking skyward, wearing a coiled straw crown; an arrow with feathers at lower left. Real black-and-white photograph.

0067_the-blood-of-a-poet.jpg.Visual idea: The title splits across the image so the photograph is framed like a film still bracketed by words.

0068_orpheus.jpg.People: One man, tightly framed from the shoulders up, filling most of the poster. Smoky, rippling tendrils and a ghostly hand overlap his face and chest, so part of the figure reads as a double exposure or reflection.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Composition: The face sits just right of center, with a swirling spiral of rings and smoke around it that pulls the eye inward. A second hand rises at lower right and a dark mass of curling shapes at upper left; the title block sits across the bottom.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic image with visible film grain, soft blur and layered double exposure; the lettering is flat white ink on top.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Typography: Large white hand-drawn title across the bottom third with ball-ended, wobbly letterforms, and a smaller matching line above it. It sits on top of the image with no distortion, and a small vertical label strip runs down the left edge.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale only, deep blacks with silvery midtones, dim moody light with a glow around the face.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Story it suggests: A man looks out through a wavering barrier, as if caught between this world and another that is reaching toward him.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Visual idea: Water-like ripples and smoke act as a mirror or portal, turning the image into a passage between two realms.
0068_orpheus.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century European art-house fantasy with a surreal, dreamlike mood.

0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.People: A man in a light suit stands full-length in the center of a framed photo; behind him a pale white winged figure, statue-like or costumed, rises over a wall, so it is ambiguous whether it is a person, a mask or a sculpture. He stares wide-eyed toward the viewer.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Composition: A horizontal photo band is framed between huge title words above and below, like a frame within a frame, with white margins. The man is just left of center and the wings spread diagonally outward behind him.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with visible grain, set on clean white paper; the title is crisp solid black ink and the signature is hand-drawn.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Typography: Very large black high-contrast serif italic, with 'Testament' across the top and 'of Orpheus' across the bottom, both cropped slightly at the edges and bleeding off the photo band. A small handwritten signature overlaps the top word, and a black band at the very top carries the collection name in spaced capitals.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray, harsh daylight with a bright white figure against dark hillside.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Story it suggests: A startled man is followed by a strange winged apparition in an empty rocky landscape.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Visual idea: The photo is sandwiched between two halves of the title, so the picture itself becomes the gap between the words.
0069_testament-of-orpheus.jpg.Feels like: Elegant, stylish European art-cinema design, 1960s fashion-magazine editorial.

0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.People: One man in extreme close-up, head tilted down in profile and filling the right two-thirds of the poster. He wears a crown of thorns, and blood and sweat run down his face.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Composition: Diagonal flow from the thorny crown at top left down across the face to the beard at bottom right; the left side is open clear sky. The title is stacked at upper right over the crown.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Medium: Glossy photographic realism, a film still with fine grain and wet highlights on skin.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Typography: Stacked three-line title in bold white serif capitals with swashy details, at upper right, medium-large and overlapping the thorns. A small credit line with thin rule sits above it, and a vertical strip label runs down the left.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Color and light: Saturated blue sky against warm orange-brown skin and deep red blood, hard direct sunlight with sharp shadows from the thorns.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Story it suggests: A man suffers under a hot, empty sky, lost in painful thought.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Visual idea: The crown of thorns casts its own shadow onto the face, so pain is shown as light and shadow.
0070_the-last-temptation-of-christ.jpg.Feels like: 1980s serious Hollywood drama, intense and religious.

0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.People: Two large faces in profile face each other at the center, a man and a woman. Small costumed animal figures (boar, wolf, rabbit, bear) peek out at the sides and a jester's hat and back appear at the bottom, as if watching from the audience.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical theater stage: curtains at top, scenery panels left and right, chandeliers in matching positions, a moon behind the title and floorboards in front. The two profiles frame the title in the middle.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with gouache or textured-paper feel, visible brush and stipple texture, layered cut-paper-like scenery panels.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Typography: Large, tall red calligraphic script title running down the center between the two faces, with small spaced capitals above and below. It is hand-lettered, elegant, and sits in the open sky area without overlapping the faces.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Color and light: Warm ochre, teal, lavender, rust red and blue, soft glowing storybook light with candle flames on the chandeliers.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers face each other on a fairy-tale stage while strange creatures watch.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is a toy theater, a stage seen from the audience, with the title as the central spectacle.
0071_the-magic-flute.jpg.Feels like: Storybook fantasy, a baroque theater and folk-art illustration, a modern retro painted look.

0072_le-million.jpg.People: A man in a black tuxedo and a woman in a white dress sit together, drawn small and full-body, leaning toward each other. They are illustrated figures, in the center of the poster and tiny against the flowers.
0072_le-million.jpg.Composition: A big brown circle sits at the bottom center and holds the figures on top, with a dark blue tree-branch shape and flowers arranged in an arch around them. The title crosses the circle horizontally.
0072_le-million.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink poster illustration in the style of old lithograph prints, with soft stippled edges on the flowers and visible aged paper tone.
0072_le-million.jpg.Typography: Bold blocky black capitals, 'LE MILLION', across the lower middle, overlapping and partly cut by the brown disc, with a spaced numeral line above in white. Small credit lines sit below inside the circle, and a tiny signature is at the right.
0072_le-million.jpg.Color and light: Cream background with navy blue, pink, yellow, olive green and chocolate brown; flat, even, decorative color.
0072_le-million.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful couple sits on a coin-like disc under blossoms, in a light romantic comedy mood.
0072_le-million.jpg.Visual idea: The brown circle is a giant coin, which the numeral and title make a pun on a fortune.
0072_le-million.jpg.Feels like: 1930s French Art Deco poster, playful romantic comedy.

0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.People: One woman's face in extreme close-up, cropped so only an eye, nose and mouth are visible, filling the whole poster. A bright white patch at lower left may be a reflection or light flare, with a darker shape behind it.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Composition: The eye sits at upper center and the lips at bottom right, creating a diagonal running down across the face. The handwritten title runs across the cheek, with a thin white border around the image.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph, soft and high contrast, with the lettering as thin white handwriting.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Typography: Thin, loose white handwriting in several lines, mid-large, slanting upward across the cheek and nose and overlapping the face. It feels like a note written directly on the picture, and a small vertical strip label sits at the left.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome with a blown-out white highlight, soft diffused light.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks out with an uneasy, searching gaze, as if waiting for something.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Visual idea: The face is cropped like a mirror reflection or fragment, and the handwriting turns the title into a personal scrawl.
0073_cleo-from-5-to-7.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave black-and-white intimacy, early 1960s.

0074_vagabond.jpg.People: One young woman at waist-up, facing the camera with a stern, tired look, hair blown by wind. She grips a bag strap with one hand and wears a worn jacket and a bright scarf.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Composition: The figure sits right of center against a flat horizon of an empty field, with the horizon line about halfway down. Large sky above holds the title, which crowds the top edge.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Medium: Photographic film-still look, natural grain with muted, slightly faded color; the title is thin white marker-like handwriting.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Typography: Large hand-scrawled white capitals 'VAGABOND' at the top, cut off by the top edge, with smaller handwritten lines below that curve toward the figure's head. The letters are uneven and loosely drawn, overlapping the sky and the top of her hair.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Color and light: Pale yellow-gray sky, earthy brown soil, dull green jacket and one vivid red scarf; flat, overcast light.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone, weathered young woman stands in a bare, cold countryside, apparently on the move and owing no one.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Visual idea: The red scarf is the single warm accent against a bleak landscape, and the scribbled title echoes the character's rough independence.
0074_vagabond.jpg.Feels like: 1980s European realist drama, gritty and documentary.

0075_chasing-amy.jpg.People: Five people: one woman's giant face fills the upper two-thirds, and four men are lined up smaller in a staggered row below, three in caps or hats. The woman looks down at the viewer; the men glance sideways or smile at the camera, so the group relates as a crowd gathered around her.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Composition: Two scales stacked vertically: an enormous face dissolving into white above, and a diagonal row of faces rising left to right below. The title sits in the left middle, between the two layers.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic collage with soft high-key fading into white; looks like a glossy 1990s promotional photo.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized title at left with a lowercase black serif 'chasing' and a bold red wide capitals 'AMY' tucked beneath it, overlapping the woman's chin and the men's heads. A thin rule and spaced collection title run along the top.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Color and light: Mostly white and gray with a single red accent in the title; bright, blown-out, soft studio light.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of guys orbit around a woman who looms over them, all attention directed at her.
0075_chasing-amy.jpg.Visual idea: Scale contrast: the woman is huge and ghostly while the men are small and solid, so she is the pull everyone is looking toward.

0076_brief-encounter.jpg.People: A man and a woman face each other in profile, close, at the side of a train carriage window; she leans out from the left in a thick coat, he stands at the right in a cap. Their hands nearly touch at the center bottom.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Composition: Diagonal and mirrored: her body slants in from the upper left and his head sits at the right edge, with a vertical door frame dividing the two. A paper ticket in the lower right holds the title, floating over a bank of smoke.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white film still with fine grain and soft fog; the ticket is a realistic paper object with printed type.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Typography: Title is printed in heavy black condensed sans on a cream railway ticket, with small serif lines above and below and a tiny number repeated at both ends. It sits in the lower right, tilted slightly, overlapping the smoke.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Color and light: Rich black and white with silvery greys, strong side lighting on faces, murky gray fog at the bottom.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Story it suggests: Two strangers look at each other across a gap at a station, with a charged moment before they part.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Visual idea: The title is a ticket, so a travel document stands in for the whole story of a chance meeting.
0076_brief-encounter.jpg.Feels like: 1940s British romantic melodrama, black-and-white and restrained.

0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.People: A woman with long flowing hair is shown head-back, shoulders bare, and three men's faces loom darkly in the upper left, staring at her. All are painted figures, from shoulders up, and the woman is much larger and brighter than the men.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Composition: A framed rounded rectangle on a black page; inside, the woman sweeps diagonally from upper right down to lower left, with the men crowded in the upper left. The strong diagonal and the sweep of hair fill nearly the whole frame.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache-style illustration with smooth blended shading and flowing brush-drawn hair strands, in a slightly glossy printed finish.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Typography: Small mixed-case lettering: a gold-and-white credit line at upper left and a plain bold serif title at the lower right, both on the black border outside the picture, so they do not touch the painting.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Color and light: Hot oranges and reds with cream skin tones against black; warm glowing studio light.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman draws the desire and attention of several men, who watch her with suspicion and hunger.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Visual idea: Color temperature separates the roles: the men are deep red and shadowy, while she is golden and luminous.
0077_and-god-created-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European sensual drama, a vintage painted movie-poster look.

0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.People: Two black-and-white photographs of one stout man: at upper left he bends forward on all fours, cut out of the white, and at the very bottom he peeks out holding a telephone to his ear. Both are small and cropped by the edges.
