0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Composition: A grid of hot-pink and white rectangles with huge vertical title letters crossing them; the man at the upper left and the second man at the bottom form a diagonal. The pink block at the right edge anchors the page.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink graphic design in pink, navy and black with halftone-like photographic cutouts; clean, crisp and modernist.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Typography: Gigantic condensed title letters fill the page, with 'THE bank' running horizontally and 'DICK' rotated ninety degrees and stacked down the right side. Letters are black with some in navy, cut off at the top edge, overlapping the photos and the pink blocks, with a smaller 'W.C. FIELDS' bar at the lower left.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Color and light: Hot magenta, navy, black and white; flat, bright, no real lighting.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Story it suggests: A comic, scheming little man scrambles around and ducks behind a phone.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Visual idea: The title is the architecture: tall letters become walls, and the little man appears to scramble among them.
0078_the-bank-dick.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century Swiss graphic design applied to a classic comedy, playful and bold.

0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.People: Two extreme close-up crops of an older man's face in black-and-white: the top shows a nose and chin in profile, and the bottom shows an ear and cap brim. No full figure is visible, and the person is fragmented.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Composition: Three horizontal bands: a photo strip at top, a plain white band in the middle, and a second photo strip at the bottom. The giant red numeral and the title letters straddle all three bands.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Medium: Gritty black-and-white photograph crops with grain, combined with flat solid-ink type in the style of a graphic design poster.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Typography: Huge red numeral '6' at left, large stacked heavy black condensed 'W.C.' at right, thin outlined white lowercase 'fields' across the bottom, and a small spaced serif 'SHORT FILMS'. The sizes and weights contrast strongly, and the letters overlap the photo and the band edges.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Color and light: Gray photos with white and black, plus a single bright red numeral; flat and graphic.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Story it suggests: A funny face is observed up close in pieces, as if the camera is nosing in on someone's mugging.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Visual idea: Cropping the face into pieces and letting the typography fill the gaps makes the face a texture behind the words.
0079_w-c-fields-six-short-films.jpg.Feels like: Playful 1990s graphic design for a classic-comedy compilation, Swiss modernist with a pop streak.

0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.People: No clear person is visible. A scrawled red drawing near the center suggests a box or sketch, but no figure appears.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Composition: A hazy glowing orange field in the upper half melts into a lower half of dark ground streaked with vertical red lines. A bright light burst sits at the left edge, and the title block sits right of center.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Medium: Heavily textured, scratched and blurred photographic surface, like a damaged film emulsion or smeared glass, with grain, streaks and bokeh specks like rain.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Typography: Medium-large distressed pale yellow-beige capitals, stacked 'THE ELEMENT / OF CRIME', in a worn stencil-like sans on the right middle, with a small credit line above and a hand-drawn red scribble overlapping the credit. The letter texture looks scuffed, matching the surface.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, ochre, brown and dark red; hazy, glowing, as if looking at a setting sun through rain.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Story it suggests: A murky, rain-soaked, feverish world, with something unsettling hidden in the haze.
0080_the-element-of-crime.jpg.Visual idea: The picture reads as a degraded memory or fever dream, the image itself corroded like old film.

0081_variety-lights.jpg.People: One woman, head and shoulders in a round portrait, looking at the viewer over her shoulder with red lips and a white feather ornament in dark curled hair. Her skin is painted green, a deliberately artificial look.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical, framed layout: a large circle with the portrait is centered on the black page, a smaller circle with the title sits below and overlaps it, like a figure-eight, and ornamental borders surround both.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Medium: Painted, slightly retouched look with a matte, tinted-photo finish, set inside printed ornamental borders and filigree in gray on black, like a vintage printed label.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn looping red script title in a small red circle at the bottom center, with a spaced wide dark-lettered banner at the top. The letters are thin, casual and playful, within a decorative frame.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Color and light: Black, vivid vermilion red, acid green and cream; flat, theatrical light like stage footlights.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous performer glances back at us from a stage-like portrait, showing off.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Visual idea: The circular portrait works like a theater marquee or a vintage playbill medallion.
0081_variety-lights.jpg.Feels like: Retro vaudeville and variety-show theater, a vintage playbill style revived in a modern way.

0082_hamlet.jpg.People: One man in extreme close-up, eyes lowered, cheek pressed against a human skull he holds beside his face. The face fills the left two-thirds; the skull is a second face-like shape at right.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Composition: A diagonal pairing of face and skull rising from lower right to upper left, with the face cropped at the top and the title stacked across the bottom. Smoky blank background at upper right.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with soft, slightly flattened tonal range, like an enlarged film still.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Typography: Large, heavy, rounded white capitals 'HAMLET' across the bottom, wide and bold, with a smaller gray line above that overlaps the skull's teeth and chin. The letters overlay the image directly and are slightly hand-cut in feel.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome, soft side light on the face and deep black eye sockets on the skull.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in grief or doubt contemplates death, pressing a skull close as if it were another face.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Visual idea: Face and skull are paired like twins, so the living and the dead share the same frame.
0082_hamlet.jpg.Feels like: Classic mid-century stage-to-screen tragedy, solemn and literary.

0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.People: A tall man in sunglasses, spotted shirt, striped pants and a beret aims a pistol in each hand, drawn large and full-body at left. A second man in a blue shirt with a star badge stands at the right holding a microphone, and a small rider on a motorcycle appears at the bottom.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Composition: Arched title curves over the heads like a rainbow, with the main figure striding diagonally down to the lower left, over a car, shacks and a high-rise. Busy collage with characters at several scales.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn, marker-and-ink illustration with flat color fills and slight texture, bright and cartoon-like, like a 1970s poster printed on cream paper.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Typography: Large 3D bubble lettering curved in an arch, blue with peach and cream gradient fill and outlines, with a script name above and a yellow speech-bubble tag for the credit. Hand-drawn, playful, and above the figures, with the letters drawn with perspective depth.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Color and light: Bright blue, orange-peach, lavender, black-and-white stripes; flat, cheerful, even light.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Story it suggests: A swaggering gunman is surrounded by a lawman, a crowd and a street, in a bold urban crime story.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Visual idea: Everything is stacked in one tilted scene, with the stripes giving the main figure a rhythmic, almost musical energy.
0083_the-harder-they-come.jpg.Feels like: 1970s blaxploitation and reggae-era comic poster, loud and colorful.

0084_good-morning.jpg.People: Two boys, drawn standing in a doorway: a taller one in a striped white sweater holding a book, and a smaller one in front, making an OK sign with one hand. Both look stiff and serious, shown from the waist up.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Composition: Layered interior with a teal doorway in the center, a window on the left, an umbrella at right, and a table with bowls in the foreground. The figures sit right of center, with the title in the open upper part.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Medium: Gouache or watercolor-style painted illustration with visible paper texture, dry-brush edges and slightly misregistered shapes, like a print.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Typography: Lowercase thin sans-serif title in cream, medium-large at the top center-left, with a smaller line below. It sits in the empty teal door panel without overlapping the figures; clean and typeset.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Color and light: Muted teal, olive, cream and coral-pink, with soft diffused morning light from the left.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Story it suggests: Two sulking boys stand quietly at home, somewhat stubborn and a little mischievous.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Visual idea: The pink stripes on the sweaters and the red bowl echo each other, joining the figures to the room as a quiet domestic still life.
0084_good-morning.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century Japanese domestic comedy, rendered in warm modern storybook illustration.

0085_pygmalion.jpg.People: A man and a woman in profile, both facing right, one behind the other and overlapping. They are shown head and shoulders in close-up; she wears a tiara and pearl necklaces, and he a white cravat.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Composition: The two faces form a stepped diagonal, with the man in the foreground at left and the woman behind and to the right, in front of a big abstract flower shape. The title crosses the lower third.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph combined with flat tan, beige and white graphic petal shapes, giving a collage look; the title is in ink-like script.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Typography: Large black flowing script title 'Pygmalion', at the bottom, slightly slanted and overlapping the man's chin and the pearl necklace. It is hand-lettered, connected and calligraphic.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Color and light: Warm grays and beige tones with black hair and a bright white petal; soft studio portrait light.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Story it suggests: Two elegant people look off in the same direction, one following the other, in a refined social setting.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Visual idea: The big flower shape behind them is a bloom or halo, hinting at a person being cultivated or refined.
0085_pygmalion.jpg.Feels like: 1930s British drawing-room comedy, polished and fashionable.

0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.People: One bearded man in extreme close-up, glaring sideways with a shadowed nose, filling most of the poster. The photo is tinted, so the man looks fierce and almost sculpted.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Composition: The face fills the center right, a tall red vertical banner stands at the left, and a black-and-red block at the bottom holds the title text. Strong vertical and horizontal division like a constructivist layout.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph tinted blue-gray, in a flat graphic layout with solid red and black panels.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Typography: Very large white capitals 'EISENSTEIN' rotated or stacked down the red banner letter by letter, plus smaller bold white title lines at lower right and a bottom bar with 'THE SOUND YEARS'. A thin red rule underlines one line; mixed weights, all sans-serif and crisp.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Color and light: Slate blue-gray, strong red and black with white lettering; dramatic, hard side light on the face.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Story it suggests: A fierce, brooding man glares past us, as if watching someone approach.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Visual idea: The vertical red banner and block layout recall a political poster, making the face feel like propaganda.
0086_eisenstein-the-sound-years.jpg.Feels like: Soviet-constructivist-inspired design for a historical epic collection.

0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.People: One man in a fur hat with a goatee and long hair, shown close-up from the chest up and looking off to the side with a calm, serious expression. Blurred figures are barely visible behind him.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Composition: The head is placed centrally with the hat touching the top, and a dark red block in the lower right holds the title. A red-underlined credit line hangs from the upper left.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Medium: Coarse, high-contrast black-and-white photograph with visible grain, in a flat layout with a translucent dark red panel.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Typography: Large, bold white sans-serif capitals 'ALEXANDER NEVSKY' in two stacked lines in the red box at lower right, with 'NEVSKY' bigger, and a smaller credit line with a red underline at upper left. The text sits on a block that overlaps the man's costume.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Color and light: Gray photograph with a deep crimson panel and white lettering; flat, dim lighting.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Story it suggests: A solemn leader stands watching, apparently preparing for something serious.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Visual idea: The red box reads as a banner or seal, giving the historical portrait a political-poster feel.
0087_alexander-nevsky.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Soviet historical epic, shown through a modern 1990s design.

0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.People: One bearded man with long hair and a fur hat, in extreme close-up and glaring sideways, filling most of the poster. A harsh shadow of his nose falls across his face.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Composition: The face fills the frame, cropped by the top, with a black strip down the left edge and a dark red title block at the bottom right. A credit line at upper left is underlined with a red bar.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film photograph with dramatic shadow, framed in flat graphic panels with a red texture in the title block.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Typography: Big bold white sans-serif capitals 'IVAN THE TERRIBLE' in two lines in the dark red box at bottom right, and a smaller credit line at upper left with a red underline. The block overlaps the beard and the lettering is crisp and typeset.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Color and light: Cold gray with black and dark red; hard, theatrical lighting from the side.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense, menacing man looks sideways at a threat or a rival.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Visual idea: The nose shadow acts like a mask, splitting the face into light and dark halves, with the title block as a heavy weight.
0088_ivan-the-terrible-part-i.jpg.Feels like: 1940s Soviet historical epic, presented with severe, bold design.

0089_sisters.jpg.People: Two young women's faces in extreme close-up, cropped at the sides so only an eye, brow and cheek of each show. They face each other in mirror image, and their dark hair merges into a central column, so they may be one face reflected.
0089_sisters.jpg.Composition: Strict left-right mirror symmetry along a central vertical axis, with the joined hair forming a kaleidoscopic shape down the middle. The title sits across the center, bridging the two halves.
0089_sisters.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with coarse grain, mirrored digitally, with flat red ink for the lettering.
0089_sisters.jpg.Typography: Large chunky red title 'Sisters' across the center, in a rounded, blobby display face, with a horizontal crack or slice running through the letters and splitting them. It overlaps both faces and the hair, with a small credit line below in black and white.
0089_sisters.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray with a single saturated red; flat, harsh light.
0089_sisters.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women who look alike stare out as if they are two halves of one person, with something fractured between them.
0089_sisters.jpg.Visual idea: Mirror doubling, with a crack through the title echoing the split between the two halves.

0090_kwaidan.jpg.People: No people are visible. Swirling ink smoke could suggest a ghostly form, but nothing figurative is clear.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Composition: A tall column of billowing red smoke runs down the center against pure black, with the huge title stretched across the middle and its letters melting downward. Large empty black margins surround it.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Medium: Photographic ink-in-water or smoke image with soft translucent edges, combined with flat white type that has dripping, brush-streaked ends.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Typography: Very large, tall, condensed white capitals 'KWAIDAN' span almost the full width at the center; the bottoms of the letters drip or streak downward like wet paint or running ink, cut by the smoke. The type is crisp at top and distorted at the bottom, and it overlaps the red cloud.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Color and light: Vivid red-orange against black, glowing, backlit like ink dropped in water.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Story it suggests: Something blood-like and ghostly seeps and drips through a dark void.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Visual idea: The letters dissolve like melting into the smoke, so the title itself appears to be bleeding.
0090_kwaidan.jpg.Feels like: Modern horror-art design with a haunting, elegant mood.

0091_the-blob.jpg.People: A young man in a gray jacket in the foreground at left holds a phone to his ear and points straight out at the viewer with a ringed hand, wide-eyed in alarm. At the lower right a crowd of teenagers and a policeman huddle by cars; at the top right a woman's hand reaches out of the red mass.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Composition: A giant dark red blob looms across the top and hangs over everything, with the title drawn on it. The man at left and the yellow convertible at the bottom right form a diagonal, with the crowd between them and the monster above.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted oil or gouache illustration with visible brush strokes and glossy highlights, in the style of pulp-era movie posters.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Typography: Giant chunky, rounded, drippy letters 'BLOB' in dusky red-brown, set into the red mass at the top, with a small 'THE' tucked in the middle and an upright serif credit line above. Three slogan tags in cream on teal bars are staggered below, overlapping the blob and the man.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Color and light: Deep red and teal sky, with warm skin tones and a yellow car; dramatic, theatrical light as if from the glowing creature.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Story it suggests: An alarmed young man tries to warn everyone as a huge red mass swallows the night over a crowd of teens.
0091_the-blob.jpg.Visual idea: The monster is made of the same stuff as the title, so lettering and creature merge into one looming shape.

0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.People: A figure at upper left in a rolled-up sleeve or short-sleeved top appears to hold something or a rifle, rendered in coarse dots; the shapes are hard to read, and at right a tangled organic mass with tendrils may be a creature or a brain. The figures are ambiguous halftone shapes.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Composition: The picture is cut by color: red at the left, magenta at the right, with black shapes between, and a diagonal slash through the middle. The title is stacked in three giant lines in the lower left, crowding the bottom.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone dots, as if a newsprint photo was enlarged, printed in two flat inks with rough, uneven edges.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Typography: Very large chunky white hand-cut capitals in three stacked lines, 'FIEND / WITHOUT / A FACE', filling most of the lower two-thirds and running off the left edge. The letters are rough and ragged, as if torn paper or stencil, and overlap the dots with strong contrast.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Color and light: Hot red, magenta and black with white lettering; flat, loud, screaming color.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Story it suggests: Something monstrous, formless and tangled is attacking, and people are caught in a panic.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Visual idea: The enlarged halftone dots break the picture into pieces, so the monster seems to dissolve into the print itself.
0092_fiend-without-a-face.jpg.Feels like: 1950s B-movie horror, redone as a loud punk pop-art screenprint.

0093_black-narcissus.jpg.People: A single tiny figure in a pale habit or robe pulls a rope to ring a large green bell, seen from directly above or sideways. It is small against the stone and shown as a figure on a ledge.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Composition: The photo is rotated or shot from a steep top-down angle, so stone ledges and walls run diagonally from upper left to lower right, with a green valley at the bottom. The figure and bell sit upper right of center, and the title spans the lower middle.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Medium: Color film photograph with a painterly, rich, slightly saturated look; the stone is textured and grainy.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Typography: Large, elegant high-contrast serif capitals, with 'BLACK' in black on the left and 'NARCISSUS' in white on the right, split into two colors across the stone. It is wide, centered at lower middle, and overlays the image cleanly, with a small credit line at the very bottom in spaced capitals.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Color and light: Gray stone, deep green bell and valley, pale lilac robe; cool, hazy daylight.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone person works at a high, isolated, stony place, dwarfed by the architecture.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Visual idea: The tilted view makes the building into an abstract geometry that swallows the human figure.
0093_black-narcissus.jpg.Feels like: 1940s technicolor British drama, remote and austere.

0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.People: One woman in profile, shown from chest up, wearing a collared jacket, looking to the right with a determined expression. She sits large in the center against a stormy sea.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Composition: Centered figure in profile facing right, with a wave horizon running through her head and shoulders and the title slanting up diagonally across her coat in the lower half. The sky fills the top and the credit sits at the bottom.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white image that looks like charcoal or graphite drawing over a photograph, with soft smudged texture and heavy grain.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Typography: Large, bold, white brush-script title in italic, slanted upward, with a darker offset shadow beneath each letter, set over the lower half of the coat. Casual, hand-lettered, sign-painter style, with a small serif credit line at the bottom.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray, with a dramatic gray sea and sky and a bright white wave crest; soft overcast light.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Story it suggests: A determined woman faces the open sea, as if heading toward something she cannot be talked out of.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Visual idea: Her profile merges with the waves, so the sea becomes her inner state.
0094_i-know-where-i-m-going.jpg.Feels like: 1940s British romance, with a hand-drawn nostalgic look.

0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.People: A man and a woman, shown from the chest up. The man at left in a red plaid shirt looks down at her, his hand touching her shoulder; the woman at right in a tan coat looks away to the side with a guarded, unhappy expression.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Composition: The two figures sit in the lower half in a diagonal, with a large title stacked over the upper part. A wall of birch trees with autumn leaves fills the background and a house is faintly visible behind them.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with visible oil-like brush strokes and canvas texture, giving a hand-painted, saturated look.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Typography: Large, slanted, white brush-script title in three lines, 'All / That Heaven / Allows', filling the upper two-thirds and overlapping the leaves, with a small credit line at top right. The letters are glossy cream and hand-lettered.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Color and light: Autumn oranges, yellows and reds against a turquoise sky, plus the red plaid; warm, bright afternoon light.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Story it suggests: A man gently tries to hold a woman who looks away, uncertain, in a charged quiet moment.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Visual idea: The autumn foliage works as a color mood for passion and the passing of time, flaming behind the couple.
0095_all-that-heaven-allows.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Technicolor melodrama, rendered as a painted romance poster.

0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.People: Three painted portraits at large scale: a dark-haired man at upper left looks sideways, a second man in a bow tie at upper right looks sternly aside, and a blonde woman in a pink jacket in the center-right looks away. A smaller woman lounges at the lower left, and a tiny figure drives a yellow roadster at the bottom.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Composition: Triangular grouping of three heads, with the woman anchoring the bottom of the triangle and looking off toward the left, and the lounging woman and car forming a second, smaller tier below. The title curves across the bottom.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache and airbrush illustration with swept, visible brush strokes in the background, slick shading and glossy faces.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Typography: Big italic slanted yellow-and-cream script title 'Written on the Wind' with dark outline and shadow, across the lower third, with 'on the' smaller; the car passes under it. Below it, four names in blocky blue capitals in a row, plus a small credit line at right.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Color and light: Blue sky background with warm skin tones, rose pink, and a bright yellow car; bright, glossy, theatrical light.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Story it suggests: A love triangle and a family under strain, with each person looking away from another, and a fast car for reckless living.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Visual idea: Each face looks in a different direction, so the layout itself shows who is avoiding whom.
0096_written-on-the-wind.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Hollywood melodrama poster, painterly and glamorous.

0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.People: None; no figures appear, only a painted wall.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Composition: A single tall column of stacked words runs down the center-right, flanked by rows of small triangles above and diamonds between lines and below. The rest is an empty brick wall with an off-center vertical emphasis and a lot of margin on the left.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Medium: A photographed red-painted brick wall with visible mortar lines, bumps and paint drips, with the lettering and ornament hand-painted on top in thick opaque paint. It looks like a mural, with a thin yellow hand-lettered credit line at the top.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Typography: Very large hand-painted yellow capitals stacked on three lines (DO THE / RIGHT / THING), irregular and blocky with angular, wedge-like letterforms, some letters (T, H) deliberately wonky. The paint sits on the brick texture so the mortar shows through. The credit line at top is thin, hand-drawn and widely spaced.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Color and light: Saturated brick red with bright lemon yellow, plus small green, blue, orange and maroon accents; bright flat daylight.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Story it suggests: A neighborhood wall speaks in plain, loud paint, a statement or a slogan written on the street.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is the wall itself, a street mural or hand-painted sign, with the patterned borders suggesting folk or textile decoration.
0097_do-the-right-thing.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s urban, community street art; vibrant, hand-made and graphic.

0098_l-avventura.jpg.People: One woman in profile from behind, looking down to the left, her hair blown by wind. Her upper body and collar are cropped by the bottom edge.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Composition: The woman sits in the lower center-left, with a big empty cloudy sky taking the upper two-thirds and the title centered in the sky above her. Her head forms a rounded mass against the clouds.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Medium: Duotone blue-tinted photograph with heavy film grain, soft and misty.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Typography: Medium-large white sans-serif capitals 'L'AVVENTURA', centered at the top third, with a smaller pale blue credit line below in sentence case. It sits cleanly in the empty sky and does not overlap the figure.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome steel blue and pale gray, overcast, diffused light.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stands alone under a heavy sky, turned away and lost in thought or searching.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Visual idea: The wind-tossed hair and wide empty sky express restless uncertainty and emptiness around her.
0098_l-avventura.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian art-house drama, cool and melancholic.

0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.People: One enormous face fills the poster, but it is a hard-threshold image: only the lit parts survive as lavender patches, and inside them smaller faces of a crowd are visible. A hand and a camera appear in the lower patches, so the face is partly a container for many people.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Composition: Central vertical portrait, symmetric-ish and cropped tightly, rising from the middle to the lower right with a rectangular patch breaking the contour at bottom right. Title block stacks above and below the face with black empty space around.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Medium: Photographic image crushed to two tones with ragged, eroded edges like high-contrast photocopy or stencil threshold, flat solid ink.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Typography: Band name in huge white bold condensed caps across the top, title in even larger red condensed caps across the bottom, both full-width and tightly tracked; a thin light credit line sits at the base. Flat typeset, sits in the black margins without touching the face.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Color and light: Black ground, lavender-blue highlights, saturated red title and white top text; harsh, flat, spotlight-like contrast.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Story it suggests: A single charged face seems to be built out of the crowd around it, suggesting a performer and an audience that merge.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Visual idea: The portrait is made out of the crowd: face as mosaic of many faces, individual dissolving into mass.
0099_gimme-shelter.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s/70s rock documentary, underground concert poster, photocopy-and-screenprint look.

0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.People: Three mustached men in 1970s clothes fill the middle: one in profile holding a walkie-talkie, two facing front in aviator sunglasses. Many tiny figures (mariachi trio, a fencer, a jester, riders on mopeds, a couple in a parachute, a boat driver) are scattered around, plus a purple octopus-like monster and a robot.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Composition: Dense pyramid collage: three big heads in a tilted row at the top, vehicles and creatures in a band below, huge block title as a base along the bottom. A white zigzag signal line runs horizontally across the middle linking left and right.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Medium: Gouache or pastel painting with visible brush and chalky pencil strokes, slightly rough edges, hand-illustrated paper feel.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Typography: Giant stone-like block letters spelling the band name, cracked and shaded in 3D, spanning almost the full width at the bottom with tiny figures standing on and riding in front of them; handpainted, part of the scene, not a separate overlay. Only a small vertical spine text elsewhere.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange background with warm tan, olive, red and a few cool blues and purples; flat even lighting like a 1970s paperback.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Story it suggests: Cop-show style agents are swamped by absurd, escalating chaos: monsters, robots, chases and a parachute all colliding.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Visual idea: A mock 1970s action-cop-show poster that crams every genre trope in one frame, with the title as a monument.
0100_beastie-boys-video-anthology.jpg.Feels like: 1970s crime TV and B-movie paperback illustration, parody.

0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.People: One woman's face, large close-up, fills most of the poster, tilted slightly, wearing a headband. Half the face is lit, the other half is swallowed in shadow; her eyes look out at the viewer.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical portrait with the face rising from the middle, title letters running across the top and the lower caption below; nearly symmetric but lit from the left. Large black negative space on the right.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Medium: Duotone photographic grain, a film still reduced to red on black, soft grain and no sharp line work.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Typography: The first word in giant red serif capitals runs the full width at the top, nearly touching the edges and overlapping the logo; the remaining title line is in smaller spaced red serif capitals at the bottom, with a white spaced credit line above it. Elegant typeset, high-contrast didone style.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Color and light: Deep blood red and black only, with one white caption; a single side light like a candle in a dark room.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman sits alone in the dark, silently suffering, half of her inner life hidden.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Visual idea: A single colour, red, as the emotional temperature, with a face split between light and dark.
0101_cries-and-whispers.jpg.Feels like: Art-house European psychological drama, 1970s, austere and sacred.

0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.People: A single figure made of parts: bowler hat, giant lips for a torso and head, and two stockinged legs. It is a drawn collage, not a real person, and it is ambiguous whether it is meant as a woman or a man.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Composition: Centred vertical stack on a blank off-white field: hat on top, lips in the middle, legs below, with large empty space on both sides. Near-symmetrical, with the title block anchored at the bottom.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Medium: Cut-paper collage and old engraving look: a halftone/engraved hat tinted green, watercolor-like pink lips, blue speckled stocking texture, on paper-textured cream stock.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Typography: Title in big black serif (high-contrast, typeset) in two centred lines across the lower fifth; the top of the 'C' brushes the figure's shoe. Small caps credit line below. Calm and conventional.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Color and light: Cream background with hot pink, blue and olive green accents; flat, even light.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Story it suggests: A respectable gentleman's outfit has been taken over by a mouth, hinting at appetite hidden under propriety.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Visual idea: A body reassembled from mismatched parts, where the face is replaced by lips: manners with a mouth inside.
0102_the-discreet-charm-of-the-bourgeois.Feels like: 1970s European satirical poster art, witty and surreal.

0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.People: A man and a woman in caricature, cheek to cheek: she leans in with closed eyes and red lips, he looks sideways with an anxious expression, his hand raised behind his head. Both are drawn at roughly half-body, filling the lower two thirds.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Composition: Large red apple shape behind the couple with a bite taken out of the upper right; the couple sits diagonal across the centre, the title stacked tall on the upper left. Plenty of white space.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Medium: Ink and gray wash illustration, loose black brushwork and pencil hatching, flat red spot colour, glossy highlight on the apple, off-white paper.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-brushed script title across the upper half, tilted upward, black, partly overlapping the apple and the woman; cast names in handwritten script plus condensed caps stacked at right; director credit at bottom with script plus caps. Hand-drawn and lively.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white with a single hot red; clean, flat, bright paper-like light.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Story it suggests: A seductive woman draws a flustered man into her scheme, with temptation in the air.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Visual idea: The red apple of temptation as stage behind the couple, spot colour on a monochrome caricature.
0103_the-lady-eve.jpg.Feels like: 1940s screwball comedy, magazine caricature illustration, retro.

0104_double-suicide.jpg.People: Two figures in kimono lie on a woven straw mat, photographed from above: a man on the left, a woman at the lower right upside down relative to him, their hands almost touching in the middle. Their faces are small; only the man's face and the woman's inverted face are visible.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Composition: Top-down view, the two bodies laid out in rotational symmetry, mirrored head to foot along a diagonal. A white margin at the right, black bar at top, with the title letters running down both halves.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with strong grain and fine texture of the straw mat and fabric patterns, spot red print.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Typography: Title split into two giant white sans-serif letter columns, 'DOUBLE' on the left running down, 'SUICIDE' on the right running down, set over the image with one letter (O, I) replaced by a red circle or bar; two red vertical bars with white stacked name letters on the right. Geometric, modernist, the letters sit on top and interact with the bodies.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with sharp red accents; flat, even daylight.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers lie side by side in a final, staged stillness, fatefully paired.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Visual idea: The red O circles the man's face like a target or a sun, while the letters spell out a doubling; bodies mirror the two-part title.
0104_double-suicide.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese New Wave, graphic modernist design.

0105_spartacus.jpg.People: A single raised arm gripping a short sword, seen as a black silhouette, with a second rough shape (a kneeling or helmeted figure) at the base; ambiguous, drawn as a stylised woodcut figure rather than a photo.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Composition: Strong central vertical column of black on a flat red field, with a large circular seal in the upper right and empty red space left and below; main subject centered slightly left.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink: rough black cut-paper or woodcut shapes on saturated red with slight uneven texture, a faint ghosted drawing underneath, a handwritten signature line.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely tracked white sans capitals across the middle, crossing the black arm; a circular badge with text around the rim at the upper right; a small cursive signature with dotted line at the bottom. Typeset and delicate against the heavy mark.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Color and light: Pure saturated red and black with white; flat graphic light.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Story it suggests: A defiant arm raises a blade in an act of revolt.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Visual idea: The gesture reduced to a single black emblem, like a stamp or flag, and a rubber-stamp seal.
0105_spartacus.jpg.Feels like: Cold war and 1960s graphic poster, constructivist propaganda.

0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.People: A young woman with curled blond hair sits in a white slip, holding a revolver across her lap; behind her looms a huge shadow of a man in a hat. Tiny silhouettes of a few people stand around a fire at the right in the distance.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Composition: Central woman in the lower middle in front of an enormous hat-and-profile silhouette that fills the centre and the top; a flat savannah horizon with acacia trees breaks across the lower third and the title overlaps the head of the silhouette.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with gouache or oil brushstrokes, mottled paper-like sky, dabs of colour and sprayed warm spots; layered, collage-like.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Typography: Title in huge cut-off condensed slab serif caps stacked in two lines, orange and cream with a cream shadow, running across the top half and overlapping the shadow figure; credit in script and condensed caps at lower left. Heavy, vintage, letterpress-style.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange, ochre and olive green with brown shadows and a pink-grey sky; hazy tropical sunset glow.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman with a gun sits in the shadow of a looming man, in a hot, remote colonial place where something violent is about to happen.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Visual idea: The man exists only as a shadow shape behind the woman, a menace made of absence.
0106_coup-de-torchon.jpg.Feels like: Late 1970s/1980s French crime drama with a retro paperback illustration look.

0107_mona-lisa.jpg.People: A man and a woman, close, filling the upper two thirds: the man on the left faces right, turned toward the woman, who leans over his shoulder and looks at him. Both are painted in mid-to-close half-body crop.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Composition: Two heads placed on the diagonal upper half, with a rainy night street and two cars with taillights at the lower middle; the title block is stacked right of centre in the lower half.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Medium: Loose digital or oil painting with visible bold brush marks, streaks and smears; textured, expressive rather than photographic.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Typography: Title in huge yellow serif capitals stacked in two lines on the right side, filling the lower half; small yellow script credits above and below, starring names in yellow bold serif; all typeset and set against the painted darkness.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Color and light: Neon reds, blues and magentas on deep black-blue, with a vivid yellow title; wet-night city light with glowing reflections.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense, intimate exchange between two people in a car at night, with desire and distrust.
0107_mona-lisa.jpg.Visual idea: The painted brush strokes themselves feel like city lights and rain, with the yellow title acting as a neon sign.

0108_the-rock.jpg.Composition: Vast empty black field; title block floats in the upper middle and a tiny island with a prison-like building and tower sits at the lower right edge, creating a diagonal tension between big text and small object.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Medium: Flat black ground with a rough cracked-stone texture on the lettering and a metallic, slightly embossed night photo of the island.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Typography: Big, heavy slab-block title in the upper middle (about half the width), 'THE' small and inset above; cracked gray concrete or rock texture, typeset, with chunky notched letters. A thin white rule and spaced-out collection name run across the top.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Color and light: Black with gray stone texture and small warm orange lights on the island; night, isolation.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Story it suggests: A fortress on an island in the dark, remote and inescapable.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Visual idea: Title carved like rock, tiny island in a black void, so the emptiness stands for sea and isolation.
0108_the-rock.jpg.Feels like: 1990s action thriller home-video cover, dark minimalist.

0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.People: One woman, close-up of the face and shoulders, wearing a big dark fur hat and wrapped in a fur collar; only her pale face and lips are lit, her eyes half-lidded and gazing out.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Composition: Centered portrait in the upper two thirds, face slightly right of center, with the title block stacked in the lower left. Large black negative space around.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with glossy, velvety tonal range and soft glow, like a vintage glamour still.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Typography: Title in tall, condensed Art Deco capitals in copper-bronze, stacked in three lines at lower center-left, with a small 'directed by' credit below in mixed type; typeset, understated, sits in the dark fur area without overlapping the face.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Color and light: Black and silver-white with a single metallic bronze tone; a single soft spotlight from the front, like a portrait studio.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Story it suggests: A cool, composed woman emerges from darkness wrapped in luxury, hinting at power and seduction.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Visual idea: Face as the only light in a sea of black fur, glamour as mask.
0109_the-scarlet-empress.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood glamour portrait, Art Deco, studio noir.

0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.People: One figure drawn in profile, a thin man in a cap with a pipe sticking out and a striped sweater, facing right toward the sea, standing tall in the lower center. Far smaller shapes: none, though the seaside house is a shape.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Composition: Calm, spare layout: figure centered in the lower two thirds, a grey seaside hotel and rocks at left and right, white wave line cutting diagonally across the beach, large empty paper. Blue stripes beneath him echo a reflection.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Medium: Pencil outline with soft graphite hatching, flat grey ink shapes and loose blue crayon, on tan textured paper; a crisp gouache or screenprint feel.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Typography: Title in tall, thin hand-drawn blue capitals in three stacked lines at the top, slightly irregular and crooked; small hand-lettered director credit in black at the lower right. Light, childlike, chalky.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Color and light: Pale beige paper, soft grey and a bright cyan blue; flat, calm daylight.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone, awkward man stands on the shore on holiday, gently out of place.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Visual idea: Pipe smoke becomes grey puffs rising in a line, and the figure's stripes echo as a reflection in blue below, a gentle visual pun.
0110_monsieur-hulot-s-holiday.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French sketchbook illustration, light comedy, mid-century poster art.

0111_mon-oncle.jpg.People: One man in hat, coat and pipe drawn in loose pencil, striding left and gripping the end of a red line that wraps around him.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Composition: Figure placed center-right, with a mass of red loops filling the left and bottom and winding across the entire page like a tangle; title at top right, empty paper on the right.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Medium: Gray pencil shading on a cream paper-textured background, with bold flat red ink lines; handmade, crisp print.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Typography: Title in black, thin hand-drawn capitals stacked in two lines at the top right, uneven and slightly wobbly; small hand-lettered credit at mid-right. Light, delicate, does not touch the red lines.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper with saturated vermilion red and gray; flat, even.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is caught up in a tangle of loops and wires he cannot get out of, in a comic struggle with a confusing world.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Visual idea: A single continuous red line meanders like a leash, hose or tangled thread, pulling the figure through the composition.
0111_mon-oncle.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French graphic illustration, mid-century modern, whimsical comedy.

0112_playtime.jpg.People: Many tiny pictogram-like people (couples, families, children, a man in a hat with an umbrella, a crawling baby) scattered along the bottom and floating in windows of a huge grid structure; a large, ambiguous skyscraper drawn as scaffolding.
0112_playtime.jpg.Composition: A vertical, tall lattice or glass tower fills the whole poster, with tiny people at the base for scale and large two-word title overlapping it diagonally. Perspective lines converge upward.
0112_playtime.jpg.Medium: Gray ink linework with a hand-printed, lithographic and brushy texture, with small flat dabs of colour; paper-white background and drippy hand-lettering.
0112_playtime.jpg.Typography: Title broken into two parts: 'Play' in large black-navy hand-painted letters running vertically in a sloping, uneven way, and 'Time' in red, with a T that stretches downward; credit in heavy sans caps tilted at upper right. Brushy, dripping edges, huge, interacts with the building.
0112_playtime.jpg.Color and light: White paper with grey structure, with small colored confetti-like dots in red, blue, green, yellow; clean, bright.
0112_playtime.jpg.Story it suggests: Little people wander through a gigantic, cold glass-and-steel city that dwarfs and tangles them.
0112_playtime.jpg.Visual idea: The architecture as grid and the people as tiny colourful marks, a playful vs. rigid contrast; the title letters become part of the structure.
0112_playtime.jpg.Feels like: 1960s modernist graphic design, mid-century comic illustration.

0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.People: Four loosely drawn caricature heads of two men and one woman and one more man, lined along the bottom, each with an expressive wide-eyed look; a hat, a scarf and a bob hairstyle. Names handwritten under each.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Composition: Heads arranged in a staggered row across the lower third, with a large white skewed rectangle holding the title in the upper half. A thin border frame around the poster.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Medium: Sketchy pen and crayon line drawing with flat tan skin patches and a flat yellow ground; loose, spontaneous, hand-inked.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Typography: Huge title set in heavy blocky slab capitals in navy and dark red, in four stacked lines, spanning the full width and overlapping the white shape and the drawn heads; a black brush-script credit above, cursive red names beneath heads. Bold, loud, typeset and colliding with the drawings.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Color and light: Bright mustard yellow, dark red, navy blue and a white panel; flat, bright, sunny.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of misfits is gathered, shifty and anxious, as if planning something that probably won't go right.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Visual idea: Cast as quick caricature sketches on a poster-board layout, treating the poster like a hurried notebook of a gang.
0113_big-deal-on-madonna-street.jpg.Feels like: 1950s-60s Italian comedy, retro poster, comic-sketch caper.

0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.People: One man, a butler in formal tails and a bow tie with a thin mustache and a droopy-eyed expression, drawn at half-body scale, holding a tray with five wine glasses.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Composition: Central figure in the lower two thirds with tall, narrow torso, diagonal bands of green hill behind; many tiny houses tilt at different angles on the hillside, and a big bridge arch curves at the top left. Title stacked at top center.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in a limited palette: stylised, geometric screenprint or linocut look, no gradients.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Typography: Title in white, tall condensed rounded sans-serif capitals stacked in two lines at the top center with an underline; credit in white bold caps at right. Clean, geometric, art-deco-like and sits in the open dark space.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Color and light: Teal-green, pale grey-green, black and white; flat graphic light, nocturne-like.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Story it suggests: A polished servant carries drinks above a crooked town, suggesting class distance and a comic world.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Visual idea: Wobbly houses and tilted hills make the world look off-balance around a perfectly balanced butler.
0114_my-man-godfrey.jpg.Feels like: 1930s-inspired Art Deco and mid-century modern illustration, light comedy.

0115_rififi.jpg.People: One tiny black silhouette of a man hanging from a rope at the top; a huge black gloved hand in the lower half is a second, oversized human fragment (hand only).
0115_rififi.jpg.Composition: Strong vertical axis: a white light shaft from the top edge runs down into the cuff of the giant hand, which pinches a diamond; the title block fills the bottom. The tiny man and the hand create a scale contrast.
0115_rififi.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink, vector-like shapes with crisp edges; only the diamond has light gradient facets.
0115_rififi.jpg.Typography: Enormous bold sans-serif capitals 'RIFIFI' spanning the full width at the bottom in yellow-orange, slightly cropped by the poster edge, with a smaller 'JULES DASSIN'S' above in the same color; typeset and heavy, locked to the image above.
0115_rififi.jpg.Color and light: Saturated cobalt blue ground, pure black and white, one warm yellow accent; flat graphic light, with the white beam as the only light.
0115_rififi.jpg.Story it suggests: A man lowers himself through a shaft toward a jewel held in a giant grasping hand, a heist in miniature.
0115_rififi.jpg.Visual idea: The man as a puppet on a string above a hand that holds the prize, scale used to show greed and danger.
0115_rififi.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century modernist poster, crime caper, 1950s graphic design in a contemporary reissue.

0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.People: One young woman, half-body, with arms raised overhead holding a long staff or pole; she looks straight ahead with a faint smile, framed by billowing clouds.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Composition: Central figure with arms making a V shape upward, surrounded by an oval cloud mass that frames her; crescent moon at upper right; title at the bottom center.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Medium: Fine pen and ink with stippling, cross-hatching and dotted shading, like an engraving or woodcut on cream parchment-colored paper in sepia.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Typography: Title in black, tall angular and chiseled capitals ('THE' tiny and spaced above) at the bottom, nearly full width; small credit in spaced caps below; typeset with sharp cuts in letters, set clear of the drawing.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown ink on cream, soft and even.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Story it suggests: A resolute woman raises her staff like a banner against a stormy sky, determined and defiant.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Visual idea: The clouds swirl as a halo, framing the heroine like a legendary figure on a scroll.
0116_the-hidden-fortress.jpg.Feels like: Classic Japanese period adventure, woodblock or engraving-style illustration.

0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.People: One woman in a maid's frilled cap and collar, painted large from the shoulders up, her eyes glancing sideways with a serious, wary look.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Composition: Central, tightly cropped portrait filling the poster, head in the upper middle, split background of blue at left and orange at right; title spills across the lower third over her chest.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Medium: Expressive acrylic or oil painting with visible loose brushstrokes, thick dabs and a canvas weave; flat, graphic fills, bright green outlines.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Typography: Title in large, looping handwritten cursive in deep purple across the lower third, crossing her torso and spilling slightly off both edges; small sans caps credit above it. Hand-drawn, casual and legible, overlaps the picture.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Color and light: Acid green, lavender-white, sky blue and fiery orange; unrealistic poster-paint colours, no real light source.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Story it suggests: A servant stares aside with suspicion, her calm face covering some private scheming.
0117_diary-of-a-chambermaid.jpg.Visual idea: Face rendered in unnatural green and violet like a Pop or Fauvist portrait, divided by two colour fields.

0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.People: A tall man in a worn suit and hat, hat in hand, stands with his arm around a glamorous blonde woman in a pale gown. Smaller caricatured figures: a megaphone man, a flailing man, and clusters of men in hats walking at the bottom edge.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Composition: Couple on the right-of-centre standing high like monuments on a hilltop, with a big yellow circular spotlight arc behind them and small vehicles (bus, cars, a birthday cake car) swirling along its edge; crowds at the foot. Title curls at top left.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Medium: Ink and gray wash brush drawing with pencil hatching on white, with light yellow and orange spot colour; hand-drawn caricature feel.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Typography: Title in cream-yellow ornate swash caps in two stacked lines at top left, tilted and curling, the C overlapped by the logo; cast and director in black decorative serif caps below. Hand-lettered and whimsical.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Color and light: Greys with pale yellow and orange accents; a glowing yellow halo behind the couple, like a spotlight.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Story it suggests: A man and woman stand above a busy world of travelers and workers, hinting at a road journey with comic complications.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Visual idea: A circular beam of light turns a hilltop into a stage and the vehicles into a parade of episodes.
0118_sullivan-s-travels.jpg.Feels like: 1940s screwball comedy, newspaper cartoon, vintage illustration.

0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.People: Two figures in a squalid room: a gangly bespectacled man stands at the upper left, rigid with hands tucked into his sleeves; in the foreground a wild-haired man lies slumped on a pile of plates, mouth open and tongue out, eyes rolled. A caricature, exaggerated, grotesque.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Composition: Messy, cluttered diagonal: the sprawling man runs from lower left to the right across the bottom half, the standing man in the upper left, the title sprayed across the upper right. Room clutter fills the middle: dartboard, dishes, bottles.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Medium: Scratchy pen-and-ink with watercolour wash and ink splatters, heavy cross-hatching and spatter, on a yellowed paper texture, with a handwritten signature at the bottom.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Typography: Title in splashy red brush-script, tall and ragged, running across the top right, with blood-like drips and spatter, the 'I' stretched into a huge vertical; small black serif credit above. Violent, hand-brushed, large.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Color and light: Sickly mustard yellow, brown and beige with sharp blood red; murky, nicotine-stained room light.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Story it suggests: Two down-and-out roommates live in a squalid, chaotic room where one has collapsed.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Visual idea: A grotesque, satirical cartoon in which squalor itself is an actor; the red title looks like spattered blood or wine.
0119_withnail-and-i.jpg.Feels like: 1980s British satirical illustration, gritty dark comedy.

0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.People: One man holds a cardboard box over his head so that his smiling, wide-eyed face fills the box opening; his hands grip the sides, one with a cigarette, and a tiny second face with hair sits on his neck below the box. Somewhat disturbing.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Composition: Strong vertical, centered: huge stacked title at the top, then the box as a frame within a frame in the lower half. A second tiny face at the neck offsets the main head, empty white space on both sides.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Medium: Photorealistic painting (hyperreal, smooth oil or airbrush) of skin, cardboard and cloth, set on a plain off-white page.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Typography: Title in huge, heavy black rounded sans-serif in three stacked lines at the top, with one word in red; smaller serif credit under it. Clean typeset, tightly spaced, sits above the picture without touching it.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Color and light: Off-white, deep brown shadow and flesh tones, with navy and red type; clinical, spot-lit light.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Story it suggests: A man presents a grinning, manic face from inside a box while a second face is growing from his body, a sign of an identity splitting.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Visual idea: The box works as a TV or product package, packaging a face as a commodity, with a second head as a sinister punchline.
0120_how-to-get-ahead-in-advertising.jpg.Feels like: 1980s British satirical comedy, product-ad parody with a surreal touch.

0121_billy-liar.jpg.People: A man's face in the lower left, drawn from below with a dreamy upward gaze and hand on chin; in the upper right a pair of legs in a corset made of many small military-style heads (generals, soldiers, in hats) in a lace pattern.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Composition: Split diagonal: blue field on the left with the portrait and title, white field on the right with the pink legs sweeping down; corset shape pinned in the upper right. Title block at the left mid-height.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Medium: Flat screenprint look with black brush line drawing, flat spot colours in blue and pink, and lace-like dotted ink texture.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Typography: Title in huge, chunky white slab-serif caps with a purple outline in two stacked lines on the left, overlapping the white-blue boundary; small black serif director line above. Bold, retro, typeset.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue, pale pink, white and black with a magenta-purple top bar; flat, bright, clean.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Story it suggests: A dreamer's imagination is full of uniformed fantasies, mixing daydream and desire.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Visual idea: The corset is literally made of his daydream crowd: fantasy figures stuffed into the shape of a woman's body.
0121_billy-liar.jpg.Feels like: 1960s British New Wave pop design, mod graphic.

0122_salesman.jpg.People: One figure carrying a suitcase in each hand, standing in a long dark coat with a halo ring drawn above the head; the face is pale, solemn, a figure in silhouette like a monk or messenger.
0122_salesman.jpg.Composition: Strongly centered vertical, the figure on the vertical axis with a thin horizontal line like a ground, large white space around; title at the bottom.
0122_salesman.jpg.Medium: Flat black ink, high-contrast woodcut or brush-and-ink style on bare white paper, with ragged edges and a handwritten signature at the right.
0122_salesman.jpg.Typography: Title in huge black stencil-like block capitals across the bottom, all caps, tightly set, with condensed credit line below; typeset, heavy, sits well below the figure.
0122_salesman.jpg.Color and light: Black and white only; stark, no light source.
0122_salesman.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man walks onward with his sample cases, elevated into a saint by the halo, a quiet irony.
0122_salesman.jpg.Visual idea: A halo turns a door-to-door seller into a saint or pilgrim, with suitcases as burdens.
0122_salesman.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s American political-underground woodcut poster, documentary.

0123_grey-gardens.jpg.People: One older woman stands in the foreground wearing a dark head wrap with a lace trim and red ribbon, a thick fur coat and red belt, looking sideways with a stern look, hands in her coat. Behind her is a decaying large house.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Composition: Subject centered, looking sideways, in front of a rundown house; overgrown dry brush fills the foreground and the sky is blue at the upper right. Text block on a semi-transparent dark band at the bottom, repeating the house.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Medium: Full-colour photograph with warm film grain, slightly faded 1970s documentary colour; a mirrored, darkened copy of the house under the title band.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Typography: Title in large distressed, stencil-like grey-black capitals in a wide band at the lower third, with white text above and below, and small boxes between names; looks like worn print on a transparent bar. Set over the lower part of the photograph.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Color and light: Dry gold-brown grass, grey shingles, fur brown, and a few strong reds; overcast flat daylight with blue sky.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Story it suggests: A faded grande dame stands defiantly in front of her crumbling house, as if holding her ground against decay.
0123_grey-gardens.jpg.Visual idea: Grandeur and ruin side by side: fur coat and dilapidated mansion, with the house echoed in the title band.

0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.People: A large pale, ghosted face of an older man fills the right half, cropped at the eye and cheek, looking toward the viewer. Over it a vertical film strip holds five frames: an old person screaming, a bearded man in profile, and a couple kissing, between blank frames.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Composition: Vertical split: white left side with text block, giant faded face on the right, and a black film strip running down the center like a spine, slightly tilted, with two lines of sprocket holes. Frames within frames.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photography: a washed-out halftone enlargement behind crisp small high-contrast film stills; clean graphic design.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Typography: Name set in large, heavy condensed black capitals with a lighter thin line of first names above and grey smaller title lines below, left aligned on the white area at mid-height; a small 'plus' line below. Typeset, tidy, beside the film strip.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Color and light: Greys, black and white only; flat, soft grey like a ghost image.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Story it suggests: A watchful face looks over a strip of dramatic moments, suggesting one mind behind several stories.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Visual idea: A film strip as a spine of frames in front of a giant portrait, the maker behind his work.
0124_carl-theodor-dreyer.jpg.Feels like: Classic art-cinema box set from the 2000s, monochrome and restrained.

0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.People: One old person, seen from low angle, strains upward with mouth open in a scream or shout, fists clenched at the chest, bound with a thick rope around the waist and tied to a wooden beam, face blown out white. Ambiguous whether in pain or rage.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Composition: Dynamic, tilted diagonal: head at top left, body slanting to the lower right, the wooden beam crossing diagonally at the top right. Title crammed at the bottom right, a thin line slicing through the title.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white film still with deep grain, glowing overexposed highlights on the face and rough wool texture.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Typography: Title in huge thin white sans-serif capitals across the bottom third in two lines, 'DAY OF' cut off at the right edge, a hairline slicing between lines; small light director line to the left. Clean, large, overprinted on the photograph.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and blown-out white; hard, harsh daylight against dark foliage.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Story it suggests: A person is bound and screaming in an act of public punishment, a moment of terror.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Visual idea: The giant thin title cut off at the edge echoes the scream that can't be contained.
0125_day-of-wrath.jpg.Feels like: 1940s European art film, severe religious drama, austere modernist typography.

0126_ordet.jpg.People: Two people in tight close-up, a woman at left with her head thrown back, eyes closed and mouth slightly open, and an older man at right pressing his cheek to hers, mouth open as if speaking. They fill the entire frame; his hands grip her shoulders and a hand is visible at bottom. The relation reads as intimate, grief or anguish.
0126_ordet.jpg.Composition: Two faces interlock diagonally, cropped on all sides, with the woman's face lower left and the man's upper right. Thin white horizontal rules mark the top band and run under the title; the title occupies the lower right.
0126_ordet.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph, soft gray tones, fine grain, smooth skin highlights.
0126_ordet.jpg.Typography: Huge thin geometric sans title in white capitals across the lower right, about 70 percent of the width, with a small director credit in matching sans above its left edge, overlapping the woman's clothing. Wide-spaced small caps at top. Text sits directly on the photo, with hairline rules.
0126_ordet.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray, with soft, even, high-key light and deep black in the man's jacket.
0126_ordet.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple in raw emotional extremity, possibly mourning or desperate devotion.
0126_ordet.jpg.Visual idea: Two faces pressed together so tightly they become a single shape.
0126_ordet.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European art-house drama, classic modernist Criterion layout.

0127_gertrud.jpg.People: Two people: a woman faces the viewer, large, in the lower right, with a stern, sad stare; a man behind her at the upper left looks away in profile, head cropped by the frame. They are turned away from each other.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Composition: Two overlapping portraits in a diagonal: the man high at the left, the woman lower right in the centre; dark empty space between. Title across the bottom.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with soft grain and gentle gradations, glossy, like a studio portrait.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Typography: Title in huge thin white sans-serif capitals across the bottom, nearly the full width, with a thin line under; smaller director credit above at left. Elegant and light, overlaid on the dark clothing.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white; low-key lighting from the front, shadows.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people stand side by side but emotionally apart, a woman resolute while the man looks away.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Visual idea: Facing opposite directions: gaze versus profile, two people as an unresolved pair.
0127_gertrud.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art house drama, restrained and formal.

0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.People: One older man's face fills the whole poster, cropped at the forehead and chin, eyes looking sideways with a stern, serious look; the portrait is huge and uncomfortably close.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Composition: Extreme close-up, head slightly tilted, centered and cropped by all sides, two hairline rules crossing horizontally; title in the lower right overlaps his chin and neck.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic portrait, grainy, matte grey tonal range, slightly soft.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Typography: A short bold name line in white caps with a dash, followed by the giant thin white 'MY / METIER' in two stacked lines at the lower right, cut off at the right edge and sliced by a rule; overlaid on the face. Light, sparse, modernist.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Color and light: Grey and white with black; flat, even light.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Story it suggests: A man watches the viewer closely, as if explaining his own craft.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Visual idea: The face as a monumental landscape with the title reading as a signature.
0128_carl-th-dreyer-my-metier.jpg.Feels like: Classic documentary portrait, mid-century art-film monograph.

0129_le-trou.jpg.People: Two men's faces in the left half, one above the other, stern and sombre, drawn like charcoal portraits; at lower right, tiny black silhouettes of figures standing by a doorway or cell on stairs.
0129_le-trou.jpg.Composition: Heavy, dark mass of black in the center and right, the two faces anchored at the left edge, and a staircase-like structure of blocks at the lower right; title bottom-center. Diagonal black bands across the top.
0129_le-trou.jpg.Medium: Charcoal and ink smears with a washed-out blue duotone, rough brush strokes and splatter, like a photocopy layered with gouache.
0129_le-trou.jpg.Typography: Title as rough, big, ink-stamped capitals 'LE TROU' with distressed edges in off-white, at the bottom, 'LE' smaller, 'TROU' much larger; director in light blue-grey rounded lowercase above. Chunky, grungy, hand-printed.
0129_le-trou.jpg.Color and light: Slate blue, purple-grey and black; cold, dim light like a prison cell.
0129_le-trou.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men stare out of a bleak confinement, with guards in the background, trapped in a dark hole.

0174_band-of-outsiders.jpg.People: Three people in a film still, from waist or chest up: two men on the left, one with a hat and a cigarette, and a young woman at the right bending in from the lower edge. They gather in a tight huddle around something in their hands.

0175_fear-and-loathing-in-las-vegas.jpg.People: Two grotesque cartoon men in an open convertible at the center-bottom, screaming with mouths wide open, one in a bucket hat and sunglasses, the other with spiky hair and a patterned shirt. 0175_fear-and-loathing-in-las-vegas.jpg.Feels like: Late 1990s cult comedy, rooted in 1970s underground and gonzo illustration.

0176_the-killers.jpg.People: Two parts: at the top, two men in suits seen only from the neck down, each pointing a handgun toward us; at the bottom right, one man's face and shoulder tilted back with his mouth open and head resting against a pillow. The two sections show different people and films.

0180_i-am-curious-yellow.jpg.People: One girl's face, enormous close-up filling the whole poster, looking straight at the viewer with a serious expression under a straight fringe.

0181_i-am-curious-blue.jpg.People: One girl's face, enormous close-up filling the whole poster, looking straight at the viewer with a serious expression under a straight fringe.

0182_straw-dogs.jpg.People: One man's face, extreme close-up cropped at the forehead and mouth, filling the poster. He wears thick-rimmed glasses with one lens shattered, and stares blankly forward.

0182_straw-dogs.jpg.Visual idea: The cracked lens stands for a fractured mind or damaged perception, showing the violence on the face only.
0182_straw-dogs.jpg.Feels like: Gritty early 1970s violent thriller, redone as a painterly modern cover.

0183_les-dames-du-bois-de-boulogne.jpg.People: Two scenes stacked in one image: a dark-haired woman in black, upper body, glaring down at us from the top right, and a couple at the lower right where a man in a dark suit kisses the hand of a woman lying down in light fabric. 0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.People: One man's face, large, shown in angled three-quarter profile from the upper left, with a topknot hairstyle, a goatee and a fierce side glance; ambiguity: it's a stylized flat illustration, not a photo.
