0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-style illustration with a grainy, speckled texture and splattered ink dots, in solid shapes with little shading.
0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Typography: Large cream-white sans capitals in two lines, 'THRONE' and 'OF BLOOD', across the top and overlapping the head, with a smaller credit line above. The text sits over both red and black and is thin and clean.
0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Color and light: Blood red, black, white and light gray; stark and graphic, with no real light source.
0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Story it suggests: A warrior stares down with ruthless intent, already marked with blood.
0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Visual idea: Red splatter spread across the face and a flag-like red field turn the portrait into a symbol of violence and power.
0190_throne-of-blood.jpg.Feels like: Modern graphic-poster treatment of a feudal Japanese tragedy.

0191_jubilee.jpg.People: One face, extreme close-up, cropped so that only the eyes, forehead and cheeks show. The eye makeup is heavy and dark, and a strong stare is directed sideways.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Composition: The face fills the whole poster, with a bold title bar at the top, a strip of tape holding the credit line diagonally across the forehead, and a red scribbled ellipse looping across the face.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Medium: Xerox-like high-contrast photocopy halftone in black and white with rough grain, plus red marker scribbles and a piece of masking tape with handwritten ink.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Typography: Huge black blocky capitals across the top for the title with a rough, photocopied edge, the last letter partly broken off. A hand-written marker credit on a strip of tape tilted slightly.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with one hot red marker color; harsh flash-like contrast.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Story it suggests: A defiant, wide-eyed stare from someone scrawled over and defaced, as if rebellion had been scribbled on the face.
0191_jubilee.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is a cut-and-paste punk flyer, with graffiti over a face and tape holding the information on.

0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.People: Two people in separate halves: a woman in the upper half with a bob haircut seen from the side with her face mostly in shadow, and a man in the lower half with an intense, half-lit face. Each leans a hand on a dark paneled wall, mirroring the other.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Composition: Split horizontally with the title band across the middle; the halves mirror each other with a diagonal lean and a wall of vertical panels. The woman is upper right, the man lower center-right, in a point-symmetric arrangement.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Medium: High-contrast grainy black-and-white film stills, with a flat solid light-blue bar.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Typography: Large black heavy sans title on a pale blue band across the middle, cropped at the top and bottom edges so the letters are sliced. A bold white credit line beneath on the left, with a thin series strip at the top.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with one pale sky-blue band; deep shadows and sharp light.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people stand on opposite sides of a divide, each turning away or pressing against the wall, caught in a standoff.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Visual idea: The title bar slices two mirrored figures as if cutting them apart, the blue stripe being a cool wound between them.
0192_coup-de-grace.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European art film, austere and tense, with a modernist graphic design.

0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.People: A man at the lower left, with only the top half of his face visible: eyes, brows and a round hat, staring sideways. At the upper right, a woman in a frilled costume with flowers in her hair, seen from behind, and a small group of onlookers behind her.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Composition: A layered collage with the big eyes at the left center, the stage scene at the upper right, and a torn strip of paper with old script along the bottom. The hat's diagonal brim cuts across the middle.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photos tinted in cold blue, overlapped in a collage, with a torn paper edge and handwritten script paper at the bottom; grainy halftone look.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Typography: Big heavy black sans capitals at the bottom, set in two lines across nearly the full width, with the director line the same size, on a pale paper strip. A thin series line at the top.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Color and light: Cold blue and steel gray with white highlights, black type; moody theatrical light.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Story it suggests: A watchful man peers from the edge of a backstage world of costumes and crowds, as if suspicious of something hidden.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Visual idea: A mix of an eye staring and a stage performance, with a torn paper edge hinting at a letter or evidence.
0193_quai-des-orfevres.jpg.Feels like: 1940s French crime thriller, atmospheric and theatrical, in a DVD-era collage.

0194_il-posto.jpg.People: A young man with dark curly hair sits at a desk, looking up with a wide, wary stare, small in the mid-right. In the foreground, the out-of-focus shapes of two other people loom: a dark head at upper left and a hand and blurred sleeve at bottom.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Composition: Over-the-shoulder, frame-within-frame view: dark blurred foreground masses frame the small seated figure; the desk's diagonal edge cuts across the bottom. The image sits inside an inset border on a stained cream paper margin.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with film grain, on a yellowed, stained paper mount with thin rule lines.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed bold sans: 'ERMANNO OLMI'S' in white and 'IL POSTO' in yellow, crammed to the left and cropped by the frame so the first letters are cut off. The type sits right across the image and the man's head sits just under it. A spaced-caps banner is at top.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Color and light: Greyscale with a single mustard-yellow word; flat office light.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Story it suggests: A newcomer sits under the scrutiny of larger figures who press in on him.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Visual idea: The hulking, out-of-focus foreground makes the boy look small and examined.
0194_il-posto.jpg.Feels like: 1960s black-and-white realist drama, packaged in a late-1990s DVD style.

0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.People: Six people in a row, mostly young women in dark dresses, dancing in a line with arms linked and heads turned in different directions, seen full body or three-quarter. A man in a suit stands on the left in the background.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Composition: A diagonal line of dancers moves from the upper left to the lower right, filling the frame, with the title crossing horizontally at the middle. The image sits in a cream paper border with a stain at the upper left.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph printed like a vintage photo with a cream border, yellowed edges and stains, like an old snapshot.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Typography: Large condensed sans capitals across the middle, with the director's name in off-white and the title in lime green, cropped on the left so the first letters are cut off and the line runs beyond the edge. Sits over the figures.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome sepia-gray with one lime green accent; flat, even indoor light.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of young people moving together in a lively but awkward social dance.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Visual idea: The title is cropped like a snapshot slipped out of frame, a worn photo with one fresh green stroke.
0195_i-fidanzati.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian social realism, with a nostalgic photo-album look.

0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.People: No clear figure; the image is a dense close-up of what looks like skin or a palm with fingerprint ridges and a web of cracks and creases. Ambiguous: it might be a hand or the texture of a landscape.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Composition: A full-bleed texture with branching dark lines radiating from the lower center, crossed by two thin white circles, one large arc at the center and a smaller circle at the lower right. The title sits near the middle, running off the right edge.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white macro photograph with a grainy, printed look, with fine ridge patterns and thin vector circle lines on top.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Typography: Yellow-green thin capitals for the title, mid-size and cropped at the right edge, with a smaller white credit line above. The title crosses the lines and circles like a caption.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray with one acid yellow-green accent; harsh, flat light.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Story it suggests: Scarred, branching lines on a surface suggest a body or ground marked by memory.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Visual idea: The ridges of skin read like a map or tree of damage, with circles like a target or a lens focusing on it.
0196_hiroshima-mon-amour.jpg.Feels like: Late 1950s European modernist art film, abstract and graphic.

0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Composition: A huge black field with rows of barbed wire stretched horizontally across the lower half, the title centered above the wire, and empty black space across the whole top half. The wire sags and bunches toward the bottom right.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink vector illustration of barbed wire in tan on near-black, matte and plain.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Typography: Thin, light sans capitals for the title in muted tan, centered and medium-small, with a smaller spaced credit above. Quiet and understated, placed right above the wire.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Color and light: Matte black with muted tan-gold lines; dim and flat.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Story it suggests: An empty, dark place fenced by wire, where something is absent and left unspoken.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Visual idea: A bare minimum of barbed wire against a void stands for confinement and silence.
0197_night-and-fog.jpg.Feels like: Austere post-war documentary, a restrained modern minimal design.

0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.People: A few people, all small and heavily blurred: a man in a gray jacket stands at right behind a counter, and two dark-haired heads in the lower right foreground are seen from behind, cropped by the frame. They are out of focus, so their relationship is unreadable.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Composition: A pale rectangular doorway or panel sits upright in the center-left, with the title centered on it; the people cluster in the bottom right corner. Large soft blobs of red and yellow fill the rest, and a red vertical band runs down the left edge.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Medium: A photograph shot deliberately out of focus, with heavy film grain, bloom and smeared color; it reads like a defocused color film still.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Typography: Small to medium centered serif capitals in off-white, set in the middle of the poster over the blurred panel, with a thin red rule beneath and a small script line above the credit. The letters are slightly soft, as if sharing the blur, and sit on top of the image rather than interacting with it.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Color and light: Deep maroon, blood red, and murky yellow with a glowing cream center; dim, artificial, bar-like interior light.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is seen from a distance, half-hidden in a crowded, dim public room, as if observed by outsiders.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Visual idea: Defocus as a metaphor for unclear perception or social distance: the scene is present but cannot be brought into focus.
0198_ali-fear-eats-the-soul.jpg.Feels like: A moody 1970s art-house drama, blurred color photography.

0199_schizopolis.jpg.People: One man, half body, large in the lower right, grinning at the viewer with one arm thrust up and out of frame. He wears a brown suit and tie with a price sticker on the lapel.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Composition: A stacked horizontal layout of banners: black strip, red title band, a big central picture panel, red strip, black strip with a barcode. The man fills the right of the picture panel on a diagonal, balanced by a starburst at left.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink bands and heavy halftone dots in the picture panel, with a cut-out photographic figure; it imitates cheap mass-market packaging or comic-book printing.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Typography: Huge, bold, italic white sans capitals fill the red band edge to edge, with a smaller hand-lettered line above. Everywhere else is loud supermarket-style copy in many faces (condensed, slab, brush, italic), inside black and red boxes, sticker-like burst text, and a barcode.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, black, white and yellow, flat and bright like retail packaging.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful man is sold like a product, shouting reassurance that hides something unsettled.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Visual idea: The poster parodies a consumer product package, with price tag and 'factory tested' claims, turning the person into merchandise.
0199_schizopolis.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s ironic pop-culture parody of packaging and tabloid ads.

0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.People: Several small drawn or photographed figures inside ads: a kissing couple in a heart-lined box, a nurse's head, a hand with a rope, a pistol, and a badge. They are tiny, illustrative and clipped, with no real interaction.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Composition: A full-page grid of vintage classified ads in two columns, boxes cut off at the right edge. A thick hand-drawn red heart is drawn over the upper left ad containing the title, framing it as the focal point.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Medium: Black ink letterpress-style newspaper or pulp-magazine print on cream paper, with halftone photos and line engravings; the red heart looks like a marker or crayon scrawl.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Typography: The title is set inside one ad in black block capitals, stacked on three lines, with a small credit and teaser copy below in spaced typewriter-like type. Surrounding ads add a dozen other faces, cropped at the page edge; the title is a normal-sized ad among others, distinguished only by the red heart.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Color and light: Black on yellowed cream paper with a single vivid red accent; flat, no lighting.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Story it suggests: A romance is smuggled into a column of sleazy mail-order promises about money, guns and marriage, hinting at a dangerous love.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Visual idea: The title is camouflaged as a classified ad, and a lovers' heart is scrawled over it, mixing romance with fraud and violence.
0200_the-honeymoon-killers.jpg.Feels like: 1950s-60s pulp magazine back-page ads, low-budget exploitation.

0201_umberto-d.jpg.People: One elderly man in a bowler-style hat and dark coat, large, from the thighs up, crouching and hugging a small dog to his face. Two small dark figures stand far in the background at right.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Composition: The man and dog form a big central triangle filling the frame, with the dog at the center. Doorways and walls in the background create a few vertical rectangles, and the title sits at the bottom.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Medium: Photographic black-and-white with fine grain, soft contrast and natural gray tones.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Typography: A large, elegant cream-colored serif title in capitals sits across the bottom, overlapping the man's coat, with a small sans-serif credit beneath. Typeset and clean, it is set in the dark area for contrast.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with a warm cream title; soft, bright daylight outdoors.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Story it suggests: A lonely older man clings to his small dog as if it were all he had.
0201_umberto-d.jpg.Visual idea: An intimate embrace that makes the dog the emotional center of the image.

0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.People: A giant cropped woman's face (nose, red lips, teeth) fills the top two-thirds; a tiny embracing couple kissing sits at the lower right. Scale contrast between huge mouth and small lovers.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Composition: Face is huge and off the top-left edge, mouth center-left; the small couple at lower right sits on a horizon line with a low building. Title stacked at the bottom.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Medium: Coarse high-contrast photographic grain with a spray or halftone feel, ink-wash style couple, only the lips tinted in color.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Typography: Heavy bold serif caps stacked in three left-aligned lines at the bottom, covering the lower fifth: blue for the first title, gray ampersand, magenta for the second title; small black director credit above. Letters fill the full width.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Color and light: Black, white and gray with isolated magenta lips and blue/magenta type; harsh, glowing white light.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Story it suggests: A woman's anxious or passionate moment dwarfs a small, brief romance at a station.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Visual idea: A huge mouth over a tiny couple turns desire into landscape, with color used only on lips and title.
0202_indiscretion-of-an-american-wife.jp.Feels like: 1950s melodrama reimagined in a 1990s DVD design.

0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.People: A cropped, fragmentary body: a torso, a raised arm and a leg in a garter and stocking, shown in coarse halftone. It is hard to say who it is; it reads as one reclining or twisting figure, faceless.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Giant red letters at top ('BRD') and bottom ('TRILOGY'), cropped by the frame, enclose a central diagonal figure. A white border frames the whole panel, and a small centered block of text sits in the middle.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Gritty photocopied or newsprint halftone with heavy noise, a warm gray paper cast and flat red ink overlaid; it reads as a rough screenprint.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Very large red sans-serif capitals, bleeding off the edges and cropped, take up about a third of the poster at top and a quarter at bottom. The central title list is small white sans capitals centered, with a script credit above. The red letters overprint the image translucently.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Gray-brown, deep red and white; flat, harsh printed contrast.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A body fragmented and exposed under a heavy stamped label, hinting at desire and constraint.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: Oversized cropped letters act as a wall over a fragmented figure, like a blown-up newspaper or poster scrap.
0203_the-brd-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: 1970s-80s German art-house, raw photocopy graphic design.

0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.People: One woman's face in extreme close-up, cropped from forehead to lips, with both eyes looking out and a veil mesh over it. A small white flower sits on her forehead at upper left.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Composition: The face fills the whole frame symmetrically, eyes at the upper third and nose at center, lips at the bottom edge. A white border surrounds the picture, and a title block sits at the middle of the face.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Medium: Photographic color film still with visible grain and warm tones; a fine dark netted veil acts as a grid over the skin.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Typography: Small white script credit above a medium white sans-serif capital title, centered across the nose, with wide letter spacing. It is typeset and lies directly over the skin and veil, with no effects.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Color and light: Warm peach, rose and brown, with bright red lips; soft, direct light.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks out from behind a veil, composed and watchful, hiding emotion behind a mesh of convention.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Visual idea: The net veil forms a grid across the face, a screen between viewer and person.
0204_the-marriage-of-maria-braun.jpg.Feels like: A 1970s European melodrama, intimate color film portrait.

0205_veronika-voss.jpg.People: One woman's face in extreme close-up, eyes and nose and the top of the lips visible, cropped at the forehead and chin, with a dotted veil pattern across it.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Composition: The face fills the frame with two wide-open eyes at the upper third, nose near center, and lips cut off at the bottom. A white border surrounds the picture, and the title sits at the middle.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with a faint warm gray tint, soft focus and a fine lace dot pattern.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Typography: Small white script credit above a medium white sans-serif title in spaced capitals, centered over the cheek and nose. It is typeset, clean, and sits directly on the image.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Color and light: Soft taupe gray with black shadows; diffuse, glowing light that bleaches the skin.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stares wide-eyed, perhaps frightened or entranced, behind a delicate veil.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Visual idea: A face as a faded, dotted surface, identity half dissolved into the veil's pattern.
0205_veronika-voss.jpg.Feels like: A 1980s black-and-white European art film, vintage glamour portrait.

0206_lola.jpg.People: One face in extreme close-up, cropped to eyes, nose and mouth, filling the whole frame. Details of the figure beyond the face are absent; a sliver of dark hair appears at the top right.
0206_lola.jpg.Composition: The face is centered and symmetric, with the eyes at the upper third, nostrils at the center and lips at the bottom edge. A white border frames the picture, and the title sits at the midline over the nose.
0206_lola.jpg.Medium: Grainy color film still, with soft focus and a strong monochrome-like color cast; it looks like a blown-up frame.
0206_lola.jpg.Typography: Small white script credit above a short, medium white sans-serif title in spaced capitals, centered over the nose. Typeset and clean, with no effect.
0206_lola.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange, mustard yellow and rust red, hot and glowing, as if lit by colored gel light.
0206_lola.jpg.Story it suggests: An intense, almost abstract stare at a woman's face in feverish light, suggesting desire or unease.
0206_lola.jpg.Visual idea: A face enlarged until it becomes landscape-like, with the nostrils and lips as dark shapes, in one hot color.

0207_the-pornographers.jpg.People: A man's face in tight close-up, grimacing with one eye squeezed shut, with a rope across it; also fragments of a woman's face and hair at upper right, and a bright blue disembodied hand at upper left. They do not obviously relate; the faces are cropped into separate panels.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Composition: A black field is cut into a loose grid of rectangular windows, big at the left center and narrow at the right, each holding a crop of face, camera or hand. The title sits across the middle, with the large grimacing face below and the blue hand above on a vertical strip.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic halftone panels on flat black, with one flat cyan-tinted hand and a green box holding a line drawing.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Typography: Large, condensed, heavy white sans-serif capitals, tightly spaced, span the left two-thirds, with a cyan bold credit beneath. It is typeset, with the title tucked against the green drawing box, and interlocks with the grid like a panel.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray with cyan and lime green accents; harsh, flash-like contrast.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is watched, surveilled or tormented through cameras and fragmented glimpses of bodies.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Visual idea: The grid evokes a contact sheet or viewfinder windows, with cameras and body parts cropped into voyeuristic fragments.
0207_the-pornographers.jpg.Feels like: A 1960s Japanese New Wave art film, modernist graphic design with a 1990s DVD-era edge.

0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.People: None; a large spider is the only subject, a creature close-up, with no human figure.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Composition: Asymmetric: the spider spreads diagonally from lower left to right across the lower two thirds, while the stacked title block sits upper right; large white margin at top left.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph, nearly sketch-like with fine hair texture and grain, like a pencil or ink study on white paper.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Typography: Large light serif title lines, 'Through a Glass Darkly / Winter Light / The Silence', right-aligned and stacked in black above the spider, with a small letterspaced serif line above; typeset, calm and book-like, legs of the spider reaching toward the text.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Color and light: Almost pure white with grey and black, soft bright diffuse light.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Story it suggests: A single predatory insect sits in a blank, silent space, an unease with no one around.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Visual idea: The spider as a symbol of dread and a watching presence in a bare, white world.
0208_a-film-trilogy-by-ingmar-bergman.jp.Feels like: Austere European art-house, 1960s, rendered in a clean modern minimalist cover.

0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.People: Two people, large and tightly cropped: a man seen from behind with his head turned away, and a woman with wet hair resting her face and a raised hand against his back, eyes closed. They are in an intimate embrace.
0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Composition: The two figures fill the picture panel diagonally, with the woman's face at the right center and the man's broad back on the left. Wooden slats frame the upper corners, and a white band at the bottom holds the title.
0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with fine grain and rich midtones.
0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Typography: Small, spaced capitals in dark serif, left-aligned in the white band at the bottom, with a smaller italic credit beneath. Quiet and typeset, entirely separated from the image.

0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman seeks comfort in a man's back, overwhelmed or fearful, while he turns away.
0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Visual idea: A hand and face pressed against a shoulder, closeness without eye contact.
0209_through-a-glass-darkly.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house drama, classic black-and-white photography.

0210_winter-light.jpg.People: One man in a dark overcoat and scarf, seated, shown from the thighs up with head bowed and hands clasped on his lap. His shadow falls on the wall behind him.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Composition: The figure is centered and slightly right, forming a dark triangle against a lighter textured wall, with a white block of light at left and a shadow at right. A white band at the bottom holds the title.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with fine grain and strong contrast.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Typography: Small spaced serif capitals centered in the white band, with a small italic credit beneath. Typeset and calm, with no interaction with the image.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome with a deep black coat; harsh side light casting hard shadows.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary man sits in somber thought, burdened or doubting.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Visual idea: The man is held in stillness against a bare wall, his shadow doubling his isolation.
0210_winter-light.jpg.Feels like: A 1960s Scandinavian art-house drama, austere black-and-white portrait.

0211_the-silence.jpg.People: Two women: one large in the left foreground in profile, bare-shouldered with dark curled hair, hand pressed on a door; the second, smaller, peers out from the narrow gap of a door beyond her, only half her face visible. They are separated by the door edge, so one looks like she is watching the other.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Composition: A tall paneled door with a circular relief fills the right half, a vertical slit of space divides the two women, and the left woman fills the lower left. The picture sits above a white band with the title at lower right.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with fine film grain and soft gray tones.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Typography: Small spaced serif capitals, right-aligned in the white band at the bottom, with a small italic credit below. Typeset and quiet, separated from the image.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray with bright highlights on the woman's shoulder and a soft, window-like daylight.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stands at a door while another secretly watches her through the crack, suggesting suspicion and distance.
0211_the-silence.jpg.Visual idea: A door gap becomes a divider; the circle on the door echoes an eye or target.

0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.People: One person in solid black silhouette, shown from chest up in profile, holding binoculars or a viewfinder to his eyes. All facial and clothing detail is lost.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Composition: The black silhouette fills the center and left on a pure white background, with its arm raised to the right. The title sits in the lower black area, and a thin rule runs under a top header.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Medium: Pure high-contrast black-and-white, like a stencil or a blown-out photograph, with slight grain on the edges.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Typography: Very large white serif title in two left-aligned lines at the bottom, set into the black body and cut off nowhere. It is typeset, uses upper and lowercase, and reads as a reverse-out of the silhouette.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Color and light: Only black and white; flat backlight that erases all detail.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Story it suggests: A man looks intently through an instrument, observing something outside the frame.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Visual idea: The silhouette as a viewer, turning the person into a lens for looking.
0212_ingmar-bergman-makes-a-movie.jpg.Feels like: A 1960s-70s documentary or making-of, minimal modernist design.

0213_richard-iii.jpg.People: One figure drawn in profile at bottom left: a grotesque man with a wide-open eye and a long flowing beard or hair. A crown sits above him. Tiny armored figures and horsemen appear in the purple arch, as part of the pattern.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Composition: A large rounded arch of purple holds a white crown in its center. Below, a horizontal band splits black and white, and the profile head with its streaming hair fills the lower half. The layout is stacked and nearly symmetrical, with the crown on the axis.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Medium: Rough woodcut or linocut look: chunky flat black and purple ink, with speckled white gaps and cutting marks, hand-cut edges.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Typography: The title is at the top in purple, with a swashy blackletter 'R' with decorative calligraphic flourishes and a bold sans 'ichard III'; a small sans credit sits above it. A plain white sans credit runs across the bottom. The ornate R looks hand-drawn, and the rest typeset.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Color and light: Violet, black and white, flat and graphic; no light effect.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Story it suggests: A crowned, wary man with wild hair, surrounded by a medieval world of knights and battles.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Visual idea: A heraldic woodcut in which crown, arch and a distorted face compress power and menace into emblem form.
0213_richard-iii.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century stage or film poster, medieval-woodcut revival.

0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.People: One grinning man with a cigarette in his mouth and a hat, shown from the waist up, holding a box of coins; a dark rounded shape, possibly a second figure's head or shadow, sits at right in a white scratchy glow. The man is drawn, not photographed.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Composition: The man sits in the lower left, with his grin facing the viewer, and the box of coins in the lower center. A white hatched glow occupies the right, and the title stacks on four lines above, tilted slightly to the right.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Medium: Scratchboard or white-on-black engraving: dense fine hatching lines in white on a deep black ground.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Typography: Large, ornate, old-style serif title in off-white, stacked in several lines with varied sizes ('MONEY' in wide capitals) and floral flourishes at line ends. Hand-drawn, antique, and echoing the engraving texture; smaller credits run beneath in italic and spaced capitals.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Color and light: Black and chalk-white with a faint gray cast; a spooky glow behind, like a flickering fire.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Story it suggests: A sinister smiling man offers a box of coins, a tempting bargain with something sinister behind it.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Visual idea: Scratchboard hatching makes the light look scraped out of darkness, suited to a devilish bargain.
0214_all-that-money-can-buy-a-k-a-the-de.Feels like: Folk horror or Americana fable, storybook engraving.

0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.People: One man's face, partly shadowed and seen in torn fragments within the left sail shape; it is an ambiguous, half-hidden face pressed into a graphic shape.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Composition: Torn black paper shapes assemble into a sailboat: a large triangle (sail) holding the face, a smaller triangle, and two horizontal hull pieces with a gap that suggests a blade. The boat sits in the lower-left two-thirds of a large white field.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Medium: Cut or torn paper collage in solid black with ragged edges, plus a halftone photograph for the face; the hull has a speckled, dry-brush edge.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Typography: Large, light, thin sans-serif capitals for the title run across the top right, with a wide-spaced credit line above-left. Typeset and clean, placed in white space and not touching the image.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Color and light: Strict black and white, high contrast, with only a gray gradient on the face.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Story it suggests: A man brooding inside a boat, with something sharp cutting the scene in two.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Visual idea: A boat and a knife blade are one silhouette: the hull doubles as a blade, the sail as a hiding place for a face.
0215_knife-in-the-water.jpg.Feels like: A 1960s Eastern European film poster, modernist cut-paper design.

0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.People: None; the poster has no figures.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Composition: A tall central panel with a decorative beaded border holds the title in huge stacked letters, flanked on both sides by a checkerboard diamond pattern. The design is strictly symmetric and vertical.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Medium: Distressed printed texture: speckled dark ink, worn paper grain, subtle vignette and fold-like wear. It looks like an old pressed print or playing card.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Typography: Enormous tall, narrow art-deco letters with inline hatching and thin outlines fill nearly the entire height of the panel: 'RULES' and 'GAME' huge, with 'THE' and 'OF THE' small, framed by flourishes and arrows. Hand-drawn, decorative, and sets the whole mood; the credit is in smaller deco capitals at the bottom.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Color and light: Deep plum-black with pale lavender lettering and sepia diamond checks; dim, aged, antique tone.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Story it suggests: A formal, ritualized world of games and etiquette, in which everyone follows patterns.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Visual idea: The title as the whole picture, where the checkerboard hints at a game board and strict rules.
0216_the-rules-of-the-game.jpg.Feels like: 1930s art deco playbill or theater card, antique-print revival.

0217_tokyo-story.jpg.People: An elderly couple seen from behind, seated side by side in matching plaid robes, looking out over water and hills; at the bottom a lone woman stands in profile in a skirt and blouse, with her hands behind her back. The couple is large and the woman is small.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Composition: The poster is divided horizontally: a large photo on top, a cream title band in the middle, and three panels along the bottom (rooftops and railway, a cloud pattern with vertical kanji, and the woman standing). The couple sits right of center with their backs to us.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic prints with film grain, assembled like a layout of contact prints on cream paper.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Typography: The English title is medium-sized black serif on the cream band at right, with a lighter gray credit to its left, and kanji title set vertically in the middle bottom panel. Typeset, understated, and aligned to the grid of panels.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Color and light: Soft grays and cream with a pale blue-gray tint; hazy, even daylight.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Story it suggests: An old couple sit quietly and look out at a distant place while a lone younger woman stands apart.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Visual idea: A sequence of quiet frames, like a page from an album, tied by horizontal and vertical lines.
0217_tokyo-story.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese family drama, calm and understated album-page design.

0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.People: One large male figure from the waist up, pointing a gun straight at the viewer with both arms extended; his face is hidden behind the gun. Three tiny figures stand inside the red circle at the center.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Composition: The man is centered and symmetric, with the gun muzzle as a red circle at the exact top-center, framed by title words on either side. The black field leaves empty space around him.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone dots in one cyan ink on solid black, with a red halftone ring; it looks like a silkscreen or newspaper print.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Typography: Large, condensed white bold sans-serif title in two words split by the red circle, with a small cyan translation under the left half; a credit above in white and a director credit at the bottom. Typeset, and the circle replaces the letter space between the words.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Color and light: Electric cyan and black with one red accent; flat, graphic, with the light implied by halftone dots.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Story it suggests: A gunman aims directly at us, and a tiny group is trapped inside the gun's muzzle.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Visual idea: The title's red circle is literally the gun barrel, with three small people inside.
0218_le-cercle-rouge.jpg.Feels like: A late-1960s/70s crime thriller, pop-art silkscreen.

0219_la-strada.jpg.People: Two drawn figures: a huge shirtless strongman in a studded belt with a chain across his chest, face in shadow, arm bent upward; and a small clown-faced woman in a bowler hat and striped shirt at lower right, beating a drum. The size difference is extreme; she seems dwarfed by him.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Composition: The strongman's torso fills the entire left and center, cropped at the head and at the top by the frame, with his arm sweeping to the top right. The small clown figure sits at the lower right with the drum, balancing the mass. The title sits top right.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn pen-and-ink hatching and flat black ink on a tan craft-paper ground, with cream highlights and a tiny red nose accent; it looks like a screenprint.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Typography: Chunky cream rounded sans-serif title in two stacked lines at top right, large and bold, in the same cream as the figure's skin. A handwritten 'Fellini' signature in a circle on the drum.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Color and light: Tan, black and cream with a single red dot; flat, matte, no light source.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Story it suggests: A brute performer and a small clown companion are bound together by a chain and a drum.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Visual idea: The chain on his chest and the drum around her make them circus acts yoked together, with scale as hierarchy.
0219_la-strada.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European illustrated film poster, circus-show screenprint.

0220_naked-lunch.jpg.People: One man in a dark suit and fedora, seen from the waist up, with a portable typewriter in place of his head; his hands hold it, fingers splayed. Two cockroaches crawl on the outer page.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Composition: A framed photo sits in the center of a vintage book-cover page with a double-line border, with the title below and a credit above. Cockroaches sit on the upper left and lower right corners, diagonally opposite.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Medium: A photographic portrait mounted on a mock aged book page, with paper texture, worn red cloth edges and photographic cockroaches.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Typography: A medium-sized red old-style serif title centered below the photo, with a gray serif tagline beneath and a small italic credit above. Typeset to resemble an old book, sitting on the paper with no distortion.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Color and light: Faded yellow-green paper, deep red and black; soft, flat studio light inside the photo.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Story it suggests: A man whose identity has been replaced by his writing machine, in a world infested with vermin.
0220_naked-lunch.jpg.Visual idea: A typewriter as a head, with insects, mixes writer, machine and bug into a bizarre vintage book cover.

0221_ikiru.jpg.People: One older man in a hat and heavy coat, centered and small, sitting on a swing with both hands gripping the chains, looking upward. Snow covers his shoulders.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Composition: The swing frame and the man sit at center, with a picket fence behind him and a dark wall of trees and falling snow above. The title is huge at top, with the credit centered below it. The composition is symmetric and vertical.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with heavy grain, falling snow and strong contrast, as if from a nighttime photograph.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Typography: Very large, wide-spaced white sans-serif capitals for the title across the upper third, with a smaller spaced credit below. Typeset and clean, sitting over the dark trees and snow.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome black and white; dim night light with a glow on the snow and his face.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man sits on a swing in a snowy night park, wistful and still.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Visual idea: A swing as a symbol of quiet reflection, a small figure under a vast dark.
0221_ikiru.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese humanist drama, classic black-and-white film still.

0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.People: None; the image shows only an object (an inkwell) and its spilled stain.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Composition: A tipped glass ink bottle at upper right pours into a large dark pool that spreads across the center and lower left. The pool fades into white on the left and bottom, and the title sits at the bottom below it.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Medium: Photographic close-up with a soft vignette that dissolves into paper white; the ink looks like a wash with grainy brown tone.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Typography: Large black serif title in a single line near the bottom, with 'Priest' fading to gray, a thin brown rule beneath and a small italic credit line. Typeset, bridging dark and light areas; the top header reads faintly over the bottle.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown, black and white; soft glow with glass highlights on the bottle.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Story it suggests: Ink has spilled, a writing instrument undone: something personal is poured out onto the page.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Visual idea: A spilled ink stain stands in for a diary and its confession, with the writing itself the subject.
0222_diary-of-a-country-priest.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European religious or literary drama, sepia still-life design from the 2000s.

0223_maitresse.jpg.People: Two people, cropped: a woman in black corset, gloves and leather, seen from the lips down, standing over a person in red satin shown only from the back of the head and shoulders at the very bottom. She holds a leash or strap. One is dominant and large, the other small and bent.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Composition: The dark figure fills the left and center, leaning diagonally, with the white empty space at upper right. The red figure is wedged at the bottom, with the title across the lower third.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Medium: Slightly soft color photograph with a glossy, high-key look; the figure is cut out against pure white.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Typography: Large outlined white capitals with a thin black stroke, stretched across the full width near the bottom, overlapping both figures; a script credit sits below. The letters are hollow so the image shows through.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Color and light: Black and teal leather against white, with a vivid red satin accent and red lips; bright flash-like light.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Story it suggests: One person holds power over another through a leash, a relationship of control.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Visual idea: The face of the dominant figure is cut out so only the lips and body remain, making the pose and leash the whole story.
0223_maitresse.jpg.Feels like: A 1970s-80s erotic drama, early-2000s DVD design.

0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.People: Two people cropped at the edges and facing away from each other: a woman at left in a white dress and jacket, looking up and to the side, and a man at right in a dark coat and hat, looking down, with a newspaper tucked on his chest. A hand in the middle reaches into something at the bottom.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Composition: A V-shaped yellow wedge splits the poster between the two cut-out figures, with the title running down inside it. The figures bleed off the left and right edges, and the hand at the center bottom ties them together.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Medium: Cut-out black-and-white photographs with white outlines over flat mustard-yellow ink, with a paper-print grain; newspaper text on the man's chest is legible as a texture.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Typography: Huge white brush-script 'Pickup' tilted upward in the center, with 'ON SOUTH STREET' in bold white condensed sans below, and a small director credit on top. The script is the largest element, hand-lettered and cutting between the two figures.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, black and white; flat, graphic, high-contrast.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Story it suggests: Two strangers are drawn together, each looking elsewhere, while a hand slips into a bag.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Visual idea: The yellow wedge splits two figures, and the central hand joins them; the title script splits them like a blade.
0224_pickup-on-south-street.jpg.Feels like: A 1950s film noir, with a contemporary cut-out collage look.

0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.People: A giant painted face of a man with a mustache, large and cropped at the right, plus a smaller scene of four figures inside a tilted frame: a man in a kilt seen from behind with a raised fist, two seated people, and one standing man behind. The big face looks down toward the scene.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Composition: A large face on the right is overlapped by a tilted painted panel at the center, with the title running diagonally across the top left. A tilted frame and a torn-edge boundary create a collage-like dynamic.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Medium: Gouache or airbrush-style painted illustration with visible brush strokes and color blocks, on cream paper.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Typography: Huge red condensed old-style serif title in two stacked lines, tilted upward at about 15 degrees, covering the upper half. Credits in black and olive condensed type are stacked on the left, with names larger than labels. Hand-lettered look, strongly integrated with the tilt of the image.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Color and light: Orange, red, olive, mustard and cream; warm, stagey light.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Story it suggests: A powerful man looms over a tense scene of confrontation among soldiers and a woman.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Visual idea: A giant face looms over the drama as an overseer, with the small scene as his memory or domain.
0225_tunes-of-glory.jpg.Feels like: A British 1960s film poster, painted illustration.

0226_onibaba.jpg.People: One figure, ambiguous: a pale demon mask with two white horns, wide-open eyes and a fanged grimace, set in a dark mass of black hair or fur. It is a mask, so whether a person wears it is unclear. Slashes of black cut across the face.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Composition: Strictly central and symmetric: the mask in the upper middle, a huge black shape below it like a robe or mound, and the title at the bottom. Black tall reeds or grass strokes fan out across the gray background. A gray vertical strip with year and collection name runs at the lower left.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with matte gouache-like flat shapes, subtle blue highlights in the hair, textured paper grain and layered cut-paper look.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Typography: Large cream serif capitals in a heavy slab-like face across the bottom, about 85 percent of the width, with a small credit line above. Clean, not distorted, sitting on black; collection text sideways in the left strip.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Color and light: Black, charcoal, mauve-gray and cream, a muted, moonlit, nocturnal palette.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Story it suggests: A terrifying masked presence emerging from dark reeds, someone hiding behind a demon face.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Visual idea: The mask peeks out of black like a creature in the grass, with black strokes slicing it like blades.
0226_onibaba.jpg.Feels like: Modern horror illustration with folk-theatre ghost-story feel.

0227_le-corbeau.jpg.People: No human figure. A drawn black bird, a crow-like shape, with outspread wings and a long dark trail extending down to a town. Ambiguous whether the trail is a tail, a shadow or a stream.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Composition: A diagonal sweep runs from the bird at upper left down to a cluster of rooftops at the bottom, making an S-shaped black mass. Large hand-lettered text lies across the middle, and white space fills the margins.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Medium: Rough brush and ink, linocut or stamp-like printed black on white with ragged, dry-brush edges and flecks; flat single black ink.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn, wobbly, uneven capitals; the director's name is medium size across the middle, and the title 'Le Corbeau' is huge, filling the lower half, with letters of different sizes and heights. The black letters merge into the black shape behind them.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Color and light: Pure black on white; no light, only high-contrast ink.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Story it suggests: A dark presence hangs over a small town, and the whole place sits under its shadow.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Visual idea: The bird's body becomes a poison trail that spills into the village, and the title letters are part of the same ink.
0227_le-corbeau.jpg.Feels like: 1940s European graphic poster, expressionist woodcut feel.

0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.People: One man lying face down, cropped to head and shoulder, shown in grainy gray; his face is turned toward the viewer's left and pressed against the red ground. A pistol appears at the lower right. The man looks dead.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Composition: The man's head fills the upper half diagonally. A red flood of paint-like shape spreads across the lower half and swallows the left edge, with the pistol in the bottom right and the title at lower right.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Medium: Coarse photocopied photograph in gray halftone, overprinted with rough red ink, splatters and torn masking; it feels like a screenprint or stencil.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Typography: Rough hand-cut, brush-like white capitals in two stacked, tilted lines at the center right, with jagged edges like stencil or cut paper. A small spaced sans credit sits below.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Color and light: Blood red, gray and cream; harsh, flat daylight.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Story it suggests: A man lies dead on the ground in blood, with a gun beside him.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Visual idea: The red ink is blood: the stain is spreading over the photograph and the title, as if the poster itself were bleeding.
0228_salvatore-giuliano.jpg.Feels like: A 1960s Italian political crime film, raw photo-and-ink design.

0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.People: Two people, half body, side by side in bed: a bearded man with thick glasses in dark pajamas, reading a book and glancing sideways, and a woman with long hair and glasses, raising an open hand as if explaining or asking. They are close but not touching, and their attention does not meet.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Composition: Both sit in the bottom fifth of the frame against a vast blank gray wall, with the title floating in the empty middle-top. A brass bed rail runs horizontally across them; a white duvet fills the foreground.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Medium: Slightly faded color film photograph with fine grain and soft contrast.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Typography: Large, light sans-serif capitals in two colors (white for the director's name, gray for the title), interleaved in two lines in the upper center. Typeset and neat; the interleaving makes the credit and title read as one block.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Color and light: Muted beige, gray, cream and navy; flat, even indoor light.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple in bed talks past each other, one reading and one gesturing, with a gulf of empty wall above them.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Visual idea: Huge empty space above two small figures expresses the weight of a conversation they cannot resolve.
0229_scenes-from-a-marriage.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European domestic drama, understated color realism.

0230_3-women.jpg.People: Two women in the right half: a dark-haired woman in heavy eye makeup lying behind and embracing a younger, blonde girl who looks at the viewer, huddled close. A third presence is suggested only by the title and by the wall pattern. They look intimate and slightly uneasy.
0230_3-women.jpg.Composition: The pair sits on the right edge, leaning into a low diagonal that runs to the left, where a bare foot extends. A straw hat lies at the bottom right, and a pale painted wall with pink coiled shapes fills the left. The title sits left of center.
0230_3-women.jpg.Medium: Washed-out color film photograph with heavy grain and bleached, overexposed highlights, with a soft white fade at the bottom.
0230_3-women.jpg.Typography: Medium black serif title, '3 Women', with a small blue caps credit above, left of center over the pale wall. Typeset, quiet, and in no way distorted.
0230_3-women.jpg.Color and light: Pale lavender, powder blue and pink, nearly bleached out; hazy, overexposed light.
0230_3-women.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women cling to each other in a dreamy, faded space, with a sense of strange kinship or unease.
0230_3-women.jpg.Visual idea: The overexposed palette and swirling wall creatures make the scene feel like a dream or a mural coming to life.
0230_3-women.jpg.Feels like: A 1970s American art-house dream film, pastel and faded.

0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.People: One face in extreme close-up, enlarged until the features are abstract: two huge concentric-circle eyes, a nose and a mouth cut into brown blocks. The face is split down the middle between orange and blue.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Composition: A symmetric frontal face fills the entire poster, with the two spiral eyes at the upper third and the title between them above. The vertical split gives left-right color halves, and an orange stripe runs along the bottom.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Medium: Coarse two-color halftone screenprint, with misregistered orange and blue dots over a brown ink layer; dots are very large and visible.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Typography: Tall, condensed heavy black sans-serif capitals for the name 'DR. MABUSE' in the top center, with 'THE TESTAMENT OF' in smaller slab capitals above it. A small white credit on the bottom stripe. Typeset and set between the eyes like a forehead label.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Color and light: Orange, sky blue, brown and pale gray; flat poster-ink color with no real light.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Story it suggests: A hypnotic, staring face fixes the viewer with spiral eyes, suggesting mind control.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Visual idea: The eyes are hypnotic spirals, and the split color halves make a divided, unstable mind.
0231_the-testament-of-dr-mabuse.jpg.Feels like: A 1930s thriller reimagined as a 1960s pop-art screenprint.

0232_floating-weeds.jpg.People: Four large figures drawn in a theatrical print style fill the right two thirds: a man in a tall black hat at top right, a man with a raised stick at center, a woman with floral hair ornaments at right, and a scowling man at the bottom. All are cropped to head and shoulders and glare sideways at one another; they are drawings, not photographs.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Composition: Figures are stacked in a tight diagonal cascade from upper right to lower left, overlapping patterned robes with no empty space. A white vertical title banner with a roof-like peak sits on the left, with a black spine strip at the lower left edge.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Medium: Woodblock-print look with flat inks, heavy black outlines, visible cloth or paper weave texture, scratches, and worn fibers across a mustard ground.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Typography: A tall white label with huge black brush-style characters, then smaller stacked English and Japanese credit lines, all set vertically on the left. The label is crisp and flat and sits on top of the illustration like a pasted sign; the title characters are very large.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, teal, maroon, and red with black, lit flatly like an aged print.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of rivals or lovers exchange hostile looks in a charged, theatrical standoff.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is built as an old stage-print or woodcut scene, with the label as a signboard hung on it.
0232_floating-weeds.jpg.Feels like: Vintage Japanese theatrical woodblock print, historical drama.

0233_stray-dog.jpg.People: A man in a pale suit and cap stands upright at center-right, half to three-quarter body, looking off to the side while holding a small notebook. A young woman in a striped swimsuit crouches at his feet, head bowed, cropped from a photograph. Large black pistol silhouettes at top, with a pair of eyes inside the left one, add ambiguous figures.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Composition: Two photo figures are stacked vertically in a dark irregular silhouette shape on the right. A red-outlined box holds the title at left, and gun silhouettes cross the top edge pointing toward each other. Large empty beige field on the left.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Medium: Hand-tinted black-and-white photo cutouts over a flat paper-textured beige ground, with solid black shapes and a smoky gray gradient behind the figures.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Typography: Huge stacked red condensed English letters read vertically, with smaller credit text beside it; huge white brush-stroke kanji sit next to them in the same box. The red letters are tall, bold, and rotated 90 degrees, and the white characters are rough and hand-painted.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Color and light: Beige and gray with red accents and black; flat graphic light with tinted skin and cream clothing.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Story it suggests: A man watching for something while a vulnerable woman sits close by under the threat of a weapon.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Visual idea: Gun silhouettes form a frame that links the eyes, the box, and the figures, so the title block hangs from the weapon.
0233_stray-dog.jpg.Feels like: Postwar crime noir, mid-century graphic design reissue.

0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.People: One large ambiguous figure: a huge white boxy body with a face on top and a drum as its belly, standing on two thin legs in boots. Small faces peek out below, with a bearded saint-like figure, an inverted figure, and a skull at the right. All are drawings.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Composition: Strongly centered and symmetrical vertical shape that fills most of the poster. Smaller figures crowd the edges in a dense black field, with radiating lines behind them.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Medium: Rough woodcut or linocut with chunky carved marks, white ink on black, gold-tan ink details, and one red accent.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Typography: The title is stacked in blocky hand-carved capitals in black on the white body, set mid-upper, with a smaller credit line on a black band. The letters look chiseled and uneven, and the title sits inside the figure.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, and metallic gold-tan with a bright red band of triangles; flat, high-contrast printing with no real light.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange monstrous child-like figure beats a drum amid a world of faces and death.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Visual idea: The drum is turned into a body with teeth, mixing toy, monster, and creature.
0234_the-tin-drum.jpg.Feels like: Folk-art woodcut horror and grotesque fable, 1970s-flavored.

0235_the-leopard.jpg.People: One man shown from the chest up in profile at center, graying hair and mustache, dark coat and white cravat, looking right. A blurred figure-less room is behind him.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Composition: Large half-body portrait slightly right of center, with an ornate gold wall on the left and a big patterned vase blurred at right. Title overlays his head and shoulders.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus photographic frame, shallow depth of field, slight film softness and warm saturated color.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Typography: Spaced white serif capitals, with a small line above and 'THE LEOPARD' in large letters across the chest. Thin white decorative flourishes loop over his face. The type is light and elegant and sits directly on the photo.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy, gold, and porcelain blue and red; warm, soft interior light.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Story it suggests: A weary aristocrat sits quietly in a lavish room, lost in thought.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Visual idea: The ornate swirls echo the gilded room so the title merges with the decor.
0235_the-leopard.jpg.Feels like: Period costume drama, 1960s European art cinema.

0236_mamma-roma.jpg.People: One woman's face, shown twice in a split image: a close-up of a tired woman with a big dark fringe of hair and heavy-lidded eyes, shifted along a diagonal so the two halves are mismatched. Expression is weary and still.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Composition: A square photo block sits upper center on a yellow field, cut by a diagonal that offsets the two halves. A column of repeated title text runs down the left edge, with space below and a boxed number at bottom center.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Medium: Duotone sepia-gold photograph, grainy and matte, on flat solid-colored paper.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Typography: The title is repeated like a ruled column at small size, and the same title also appears as a large, thin handwritten white script crossing the face at center. Small bracketed year at right and rotated name at lower right. Script is hairline, the column is small and gray.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Color and light: Mustard gold and brown with a white script line; flat monochrome light.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Story it suggests: A worn woman is split between two states, gazing coldly.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Visual idea: The split-and-offset image doubles her face while the repeated title echoes an inescapable name.
0236_mamma-roma.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary art-house reissue of 1960s neorealist cinema.

0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.People: Two figures at lower half, full to three-quarter body: a blonde woman in a long dress on the left with one hand on her hip and the other at her head, mouth open in a cry; and a man seen from the back with arms thrown out wide at right. They stand in a field in a staged, dramatic pose.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Composition: The pair occupies the bottom half against an open sky with a field horizon. The title is in the sky above, with yellow flourishes swirling overhead.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with soft contrast; yellow line-art ornaments drawn on top like ink.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Typography: Large tan serif title in mixed upper and lower case with a smaller italic 'of a', spread across the top half, with a small credit line in the same tan. The swirling yellow ribbon lines weave through and around the letters.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, and gray with yellow and tan accents; bright overcast daylight.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Story it suggests: A comic outburst or romantic confusion between two people in a summer meadow.
0237_smiles-of-a-summer-night.jpg.Visual idea: Ornamental curls suggest frolic and floral decoration above the stark photo.

0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.People: Faces and bodies appear only inside small circles: couples kissing, a woman's face in close-up several times, a man's face, a pair beside a bicycle, a dance. About a dozen tiny cropped figures, all fragmentary.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Composition: Strict 4 by 5 grid of equal circles on white, each circle holding either a photo crop or a word. Even margins with a ruled header and a credit line at bottom.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Medium: Duotone and color-tinted photographs in flat saturated inks, as in screenprinting, on clean white.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Typography: The title is spread word by word across the circles, one word per dot, in white lowercase rounded sans type, repeated in English and French. A credit line below uses color-coded words. Small, evenly spaced, and set into the grid like a game board.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, orange, cyan, pink, black on white; flat graphic light.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A playful romance told in fragments, kissing, flirting, and teasing.
0238_a-woman-is-a-woman.jpg.Visual idea: The poster turns a sentence into a grid of dots where text and image trade places like a puzzle.

0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.People: Four people in two halves: top, a man with a worried look in the center with a woman clinging to him at left and another woman at right with her mouth open and a hand at her ear; bottom, a man and a woman in close-up faces. All are tightly cropped half-body or face shots from photographs.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Composition: The poster is split into two horizontal halves by a dark title band across the middle, with faces and bodies in each half and no empty space. Ghosted giant names sit behind the credit lines at the split.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Medium: Gritty photographic halftone or heavy grain with scratches and specks, one half sepia and one half gray black-and-white; a worn, photocopied surface.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Typography: The title is a bold sans in white across a brown band at center, with weights mixed within the word (bold, light, bold) and no spaces. Widely letter-spaced credit lines above and below, and huge translucent surnames behind them that are partly cut off by the image.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown on top and cool gray-black below; dim, harsh light.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Story it suggests: Desperate people huddle together in distress, in two parallel versions of the same story.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Visual idea: The poster mirrors itself in two halves with the title as the seam, suggesting twin versions.
0239_the-lower-depths.jpg.Feels like: Two-part 1950s-1930s drama double bill, dingy social realism.

0240_early-summer.jpg.People: Seven people posed in a formal family portrait: an older man and woman seated at the center, two women standing behind, a man standing at the left, and two boys in caps kneeling at the sides. They look straight at the viewer with calm, still faces, framed from knees up.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Composition: The group fills the top 60 percent in an even horizontal row, and the bottom 40 percent is a large empty cream field. The title sits on the dividing edge between photo and blank space.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Medium: Aged black-and-white photograph with sepia toning and speckled paper grain; the lower field is a cream paper texture and the title looks like typewriter or letterpress ink.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Typography: Large red slab-serif capitals, widely spaced, spanning the poster width at the join of photo and blank area, with a smaller gray credit line below on the right. The ink is rough and uneven like a stamp, with the top of the letters partly touching the photo.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Color and light: Sepia gray and cream with one red title; soft, flat, even light.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Story it suggests: A family gathered stiffly for a portrait, hinting at quiet tension under the polite surface.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Visual idea: The poster reads like a family snapshot album page, with the blank space left for a caption.
0240_early-summer.jpg.Feels like: Warm 1950s domestic drama, old family photograph.

0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Composition: Large yellow rectangular signboard centered with a thin white and black border, set inside a field of diamond harlequin pattern. Text lines stack from top to bottom, with floral ornaments at the bottom.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Medium: Flat printed inks with a chalky, hand-painted paint-wash texture and slight brush marks on both the yellow board and diamonds.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Typography: Giant blue capitals spelling a name in two lines with a white outline and black edge, filling most of the signboard width; above it a curved red display line and smaller lines; below it a red rule and three red condensed lines of text with floral flourishes. Mix of circus-poster lettering styles.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Color and light: Primary yellow, blue, red, and green; bright, even, theatrical coloring.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Story it suggests: A collection of showbiz entertainments is being announced like a variety show.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Visual idea: The poster is a harlequin curtain and a billboard, announcing a stage act.
0241_stage-and-spectacle-three-films-by-.Feels like: Circus and music-hall billboard, vintage theatrical.

0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.People: One woman, nearly full body, seated and holding a lute-like mandolin, head turned in profile to the left, wearing a harlequin diamond-pattern dress.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Composition: A large pale circle centered in a yellow rectangular panel, the figure leaning through it; frame within frame: white border, then a red-and-navy diamond pattern border. Title arcs over the head.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with flat colors, white outlines and rough brush edges, like a stage or theatre poster.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Typography: Large red outlined caps with white stroke and black shadow, arched upward on a curve and tilted across the top, overlapping the head slightly; small red serif credit between thin red rules above.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Color and light: Warm yellow, red, green and blue on cream circle; flat bright stage light.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful performer in a harlequin costume turns away as if playing to a stage audience.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Visual idea: The dress's diamond pattern repeats in the border, making costume and frame one theatrical motif.
0242_the-golden-coach.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European theatrical or commedia dell'arte poster.

0243_french-cancan.jpg.People: One illustrated woman dancer, full body, bent forward with a feather hat, green gloves, and white ruffled skirt, smiling to the side. She is a drawn pin-up style figure.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Composition: A big white circle in the middle of a yellow panel holds the figure, with the curved title above her in an arc. A white and black border frames the panel over a green and navy diamond pattern.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or watercolor illustration with loose, visible brush strokes, with flat poster inks in the frame.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Typography: Large red condensed capitals with a white outline, set on an upward-curving arc across the upper middle, with a smaller line of red text above between thin rules. The letters are chunky and slightly tilted, like show-bill type.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Color and light: Yellow, white, red, and green; bright, flat stage-lit color.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheeky dancer is mid-kick in a lively cabaret number.
0243_french-cancan.jpg.Visual idea: The circle works as a spotlight that makes her the show's star.

0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.People: One elegant woman in profile, drawn from the waist up with a feather hat and fur-trimmed dress, one gloved hand raised holding a flower. Below her dangle three tiny male figures (a soldier, a man in a tailcoat, and a man in a top hat) hanging on strings like puppets.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Composition: The woman is centered inside a white circle on yellow, her glove pointing up toward the title, with the three tiny men hanging at the bottom. The title bows around her top; a blue diamond border surrounds the panel.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with dry-brush strokes, flat inks, and a hand-drawn scratchy look.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Typography: Red condensed display capitals with a white outline, curved along a rising arc through the upper area with the flower touching the first letter. A smaller credit line above with rules. The letters overlap her hat plume slightly.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Color and light: Yellow, white, deep purple, and red, with blue border; flat, spotlight-like clarity.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman holds the strings of several men who hang on her every move.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Visual idea: The men as marionettes on her fingers literalizes control.
0244_elena-and-her-men.jpg.Feels like: Playful vintage French comic illustration, 1950s romantic comedy.

0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.People: Two tiny figures embracing at the right edge of a dock, drawn as silhouettes, with a very small boat at lower left. They are small relative to the scene.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Composition: Diagonal composition: a huge black dock wall slants up from lower left to right, with cranes leaning up to the left and a big smoke cloud rising behind them. The title sits in the white sky top right, while the figures are small at the right.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Medium: Charcoal or graphite drawing with soft smudged shading and a grainy paper surface, like a lithograph.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Typography: Bold blue hand-cut sans capitals, broad and chunky, stacked in the upper right; the small word 'OF' is tiny between two big words. Slightly rough edges as if printed or stenciled, with a thin blue credit line above.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, and gray with powder blue title; foggy, hazy, dim light.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers hold each other on a lonely, smoky quay as a ship waits.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Visual idea: The enormous smoke and cranes dwarf the lovers, and the blue title is the single note of color.
0245_port-of-shadows.jpg.Feels like: Poetic realist romance, 1930s French film noir.

0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.People: One man portrait, head and shoulders, centered in a yellow circle, slicked-back black hair, dark coat, white shirt and tie; his face is painted blue, with a serious gaze toward the viewer.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Composition: Strongly centered symmetrical layout: a yellow circle inside a thick circular frame, with a smaller yellow circle containing the title below. Ornamental flourishes and borders fill the corners.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Medium: Painted or digitally painted illustration with brushy texture on the yellow disc, flat solid blue skin, over a black plate with engraved-looking ornament.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Typography: Title in thin decorative art-nouveau style black letters inside a small yellow circle at the bottom, small to medium sized. A widely spaced, carved-looking series name at top, small. The lettering is curvy and ornamental.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Color and light: Black, mustard yellow, and cobalt blue; flat, graphic, spotlighted.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man looks out, self-assured and cool, hinting at a portrait of a local character.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Visual idea: The blue face on yellow, held in a medallion, makes him an icon or a saint on a stamp or old playing card.
0246_i-vitelloni.jpg.Feels like: Retro ornamental book or tarot-card look, mid-century Italian comedy.

0247_slacker.jpg.People: One figure, ambiguous: a black-and-white photocopy of a young person in sunglasses with a halo of radiating lines, printed on a flyer stapled to a pole. It is a picture of a picture, shown from the chest up.
0247_slacker.jpg.Composition: Vertical utility pole and a crumpled flyer fill the lower two thirds, offset to the center-right, with a yellow metal sign bar across the top holding the title. Sky and green leaves peek in at the left.
0247_slacker.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism of a real wooden pole, with nails, staples, and pink and yellow tape; the flyer is a crumpled photocopy with halftone grain and hand-drawn ray lines.
0247_slacker.jpg.Typography: Large title cut out of the yellow sign as stencil letters through which the background shows (blue sky, wood, metal), spanning nearly the full width at the top. Above it, a small hand-printed black marker credit line. The letters are rough and cut by hand.
0247_slacker.jpg.Color and light: Bright school-bus yellow, brown wood, blue sky, green leaves, with a black-and-white flyer; daylight.
0247_slacker.jpg.Story it suggests: A stranger's face is posted on a street pole, a local oddball whose notice is ignored.
0247_slacker.jpg.Visual idea: The flyer on a pole is a found object, and the stenciled title is cut right out of the street sign.
0247_slacker.jpg.Feels like: 1990s indie zine and DIY street-flyer culture.
