0248_videodrome.jpg.People: One person seen from behind and above, bent over, reaching one hand toward a glowing screen. His head and hand are dark silhouettes; a giant pair of lips appears on the screen.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal: the figure leans in from the left toward a tilted TV set at right, with the screen as the brightest region. The title floats at the top on a dark field.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with heavy black shadows, grain, and a slight scan-line texture at top; the screen glows with a blue noise-like texture.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Typography: Big white condensed all-caps title with squared, chiseled letters across the top center, with a smaller spaced credit line above. The title is crisp and flat and stands apart from the photo on the dark band.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with electric blue-white glow from the screen; strong single-source light.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Story it suggests: A person is drawn into a screen that seems to touch back.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Visual idea: The TV as a mouth or skin the hand presses on, merging body and machine.
0248_videodrome.jpg.Feels like: Early-1980s body horror and sci-fi, VHS era.

0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.People: Two red fists/arms reaching toward each other, one from the top and one from the bottom, with a crowd of small faces at the bottom edge. Fists and crowd are photographic cutouts printed in one ink.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: arms reach from top and bottom toward the middle where a red crescent and star sit. The crowd runs along the bottom, and the title takes the top third.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Medium: Screenprint or stencil look: red halftone grain, rough paint-like edges and speckle on a tan, kraft-paper ground.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Typography: Large rough hand-painted black capitals stacked on the upper left half, slightly uneven, running off the left edge and top, with 'OF' small and slanted. A hand-lettered credit line at lower right, slightly tilted. The letters are loose and brushed, overlapping the red arm.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Color and light: Red and tan with black text; flat printing light with grainy texture.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Story it suggests: A collective rises up, two hands grasping to complete a symbol.
0249_the-battle-of-algiers.jpg.Visual idea: The fists complete the crescent like a mouth or handle, and the star sits in the center.

0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.People: One man's face, huge, tilted sideways and cropped at the top, seen in grainy profile with open mouth and hair falling forward; another person's shoulder in the foreground at lower right.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Composition: The title takes the top third in two layers (white box, then black below), and the huge cropped face fills the rest at an angle sloping down to the bottom right. A thin strip of five colors runs along the bottom edge.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Medium: Coarse grain, high-contrast photographic halftone in a flat blue-gray tint; very rough and smudgy.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Typography: Huge black heavy sans capitals, cut off at the top edge, stacked in three lines ('J', 'CASSAVETES') across the full width, then white heavy serif capitals below on the dark photo. The letters are enormous and crowd the edges.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Color and light: Blue-gray, black, and white; harsh and flat.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Story it suggests: A person caught in raw emotion, laughing or crying, up close.
0250_john-cassavettes-five-films.jpg.Visual idea: The enormous face and type fight for the same space, a loud close-up.

0251_shadows.jpg.People: Two faces in extreme close-up, rotated sideways, heads touching or lying together; they are cropped and partly lost in shadow, reading as a couple.
0251_shadows.jpg.Composition: Horizontal split: a white top third holding the title, a dark photographic block below with the two heads tilted diagonally; the faces run corner to corner.
0251_shadows.jpg.Medium: Coarse grainy black-and-white photograph tinted olive green, with crushed blacks and heavy noise like a blown-up film frame.
0251_shadows.jpg.Typography: Huge ultra-bold black sans-serif 'SHADOWS' stretching the whole width at the top, nearly touching the photo, with a smaller serif credit above right; typeset, heavy, sits on the white band like a header.
0251_shadows.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with olive-grey green tint; harsh low-key light with deep shadows.
0251_shadows.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people lie close together in the dark, intimate and half-hidden.
0251_shadows.jpg.Visual idea: The word 'shadows' set in solid black over images made of shadow, the title as the heaviest mass.
0251_shadows.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s American independent, raw, documentary-style black-and-white.

0252_faces.jpg.People: Two faces in extreme close-up, one at left with a closed eye and a tilted head, and one at right with a furrowed brow and a sideways glance, both overlapping and cropped. They are grainy and blurred.
0252_faces.jpg.Composition: Title fills the top 40 percent on white, and a blurry photo block occupies the bottom with the faces side by side. There is a small credit above the title.
0252_faces.jpg.Medium: Extreme grain, halftone, smudgy and over-enlarged photograph in a flat tan tone.
0252_faces.jpg.Typography: Huge solid black grotesque capitals spanning the whole width, with the F cut by the logo mark, and a small serif credit line above. The title is flat, heavy, and dominates over the image.
0252_faces.jpg.Color and light: Tan sepia and black on white; soft diffuse light.
0252_faces.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people face each other with tense, strained feelings.
0252_faces.jpg.Visual idea: The word 'faces' sits over close-up faces, literal and blunt.

0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.People: One woman lying down, seen from the head and shoulders, arms raised over her head with hands on her forehead, looking upward. Soft, cropped, and slightly blurred.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Composition: Title takes the top half in white space, with a dark band dividing it from a photo below; the photo's arms form a diagonal across the middle.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Medium: Duotone photograph in dusty rose tint with fine grain, on a smooth white upper area.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Typography: Huge black heavy sans 'A WOMAN' across the full width, directly above a smaller white serif line on a dark band ('UNDER THE INFLUENCE'). A small serif credit above right. The type is flat, large, and sits in blocks above the image.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Color and light: Dusty rose, black, and white; soft, diffuse light.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman lies exhausted or overwhelmed, hiding behind her arms.
0253_a-woman-under-the-influence.jpg.Visual idea: The arms form a barrier or frame around her face, echoing the stacked title.

0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.People: Two people in a dim scene: a dark silhouette in profile at right and a smoke-covered figure at left. Cropped and ambiguous, and one is nearly pure black shape.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Composition: Title across the top third, with a huge 'KILLING' beside a vertical 'THE'; photo below with a big black silhouette at right and glow at left.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Medium: Grainy, high-contrast photo in violet duotone with smoky haze.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Typography: Huge black heavy sans 'KILLING' across most of the width, with 'THE' rotated 90 degrees on its left side; below it, a white serif line on a dark band. Small credit in black serif at top right. The big letters crowd each other and the poster edge.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Color and light: Violet, black, and white; dim, smoky low light.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone sits in a smoky room, silent, as something menacing hangs over.
0254_the-killing-of-a-chinese-bookie.jpg.Visual idea: The black silhouette is a hole that reads as menace.

0255_opening-night.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up and profile, wearing large dark sunglasses, with tousled hair framing her face, lips closed. She is cropped at the top and sides.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Composition: The face fills the upper two thirds on a slight diagonal, and the title stacks in two big lines across the bottom third. The second line is on a white band and is cut off at the left and bottom.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Medium: Duotone photograph in plum purple with soft film grain and a hazy glow.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Typography: Giant white serif 'OPENING' across the width on the photo, then enormous black heavy sans 'NIGHT' on white, cut off by the left edge. A small credit above in white serif. Big, flat, and crowding the edges.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Color and light: Plum purple and black on white; soft, dim, hazy light.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman hides behind dark glasses, guarded and distant.
0255_opening-night.jpg.Visual idea: The sunglasses are a mask, hiding her eyes while the title shouts.

0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.People: One man appears repeatedly in a contact sheet: eighteen small frames of the same bearded face looking down or to the side, cropped head and shoulders.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Composition: Top half is empty black, with the title block at the left center, and three rows of contact-sheet frames fill the bottom. Strong horizontal bands.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Medium: Photographic contact sheet in a blue-lavender tint, with film edge numbers and the word 'KODAK' printed along the sprocket margins.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Typography: Left-aligned stack: small white credit, then a bigger lavender serif line, then a big bold white condensed word 'FORGE', then a smaller serif subtitle. Hard-edged and flat, aligned with the left edge and cut slightly at the margin.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Color and light: Black with lavender-gray tint; flat, dim.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is studied frame by frame, almost obsessively, as if being examined.
0256_a-constant-forge.jpg.Visual idea: The repeating frames suggest picking one image out of many, as editors do.

0257_secret-honor.jpg.People: One man seated and bowed over a microphone at a table, wearing a red-brown jacket, head down; behind him a framed portrait of another man looks down from the wall. The foreground man is blurry.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: the portrait frame on top, the slumped man in the middle, and the microphone and a glass of whiskey in the front. Title text sits at the top over the frame.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Medium: Soft, hazy photographic print that looks creased and worn, with torn edges, cracks, and white flecks in a warm sepia-orange tone.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Typography: Small spaced white capitals with curly brackets, plus an italic white 'a film by' and a larger italic 'Robert Altman'. Light and delicate, set over the portrait. Thin and quiet, interacting with the paneling.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber, orange, and brown, lit by a glowing lamp.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Story it suggests: A man alone under a watching portrait, confessing into a microphone and drinking.
0257_secret-honor.jpg.Visual idea: The portrait behind him sets up a second watcher, an authority overseeing the confession.

0258_tanner-88.jpg.Composition: Three horizontal bands like a flag: red top band with title, white middle band with the large year, blue lower block with credits. A torn paper corner sits at the bottom right. Text is right-aligned in the blue block, and content is stacked.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink with crisp vector shapes; only the torn-paper scrap at lower right has a photographic paper texture with shadow.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Typography: Gigantic bold grotesque title in white caps cropped at both edges, filling the red band, then a huge blue apostrophe-and-number below. Credits in widely spaced white sans caps, right-aligned. A typewriter-style tagline with a red underline on the torn scrap. Heavy, loud, campaign-sign style.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, white and blue, flat, no light or shadow.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Story it suggests: A political campaign presented as a sign, with the torn scrap hinting at something real beneath.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is itself a campaign sign, a flag reduced to type.
0258_tanner-88.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American political campaign graphics, a home-video cover.

0259_fat-girl.jpg.People: One girl in extreme close-up, her face half covered by a hand of splayed fingers. One eye looks out between them. A second arm or body crosses at right, ambiguous.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Composition: The face is cropped tight, tilted, and filling the poster, with the hand forming a diagonal across the middle. Title words are scattered over the lower right.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Medium: Grainy color photograph, soft and noisy, in muted greens, teals, and pinks.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Typography: The word 'FAT' is bold white sans in the middle right, with 'GIRL' separated below as spaced letters; both have ghosted double images and blurred edges as if vibrating. A small script 'a film by Catherine Breillat' with echo shadows above. Text sits across her face and fingers.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Color and light: Teal green, deep black hair, and flushed pink skin; dim, intimate, cool light.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl hides her face from someone, ashamed or wary.
0259_fat-girl.jpg.Visual idea: The fingers form a mask over her face, with doubled letters like a stutter.

0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.People: One figure with a pale blank oval mask on a black head and shoulders; two eyes peer out of eye holes. It is a mask on a person, ambiguous.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Composition: Strongly centered symmetric portrait: the white mask is in the middle of a black mass of hair and clothing, and the title is written on the mask's lower half.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Medium: High-contrast posterized photocopy with pink and black halftone grain; a rough stencil-like print.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered black cursive script, tilted and overlapping, in several lines that are tangled together across the mask's lower half, medium size, written like handwriting on the blank face. The strokes are scratchy and the lines collide.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Color and light: Pink, black, and white with gray grain; flat, harsh.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Story it suggests: A figure hides her face behind a blank mask, with only watchful eyes visible.
0260_eyes-without-a-face.jpg.Visual idea: The title is written where the face should be, so the lettering stands in for the face.

0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.People: Three children's faces piled together, lying on pillows: a blonde girl in the foreground, a dark-haired boy behind her, and another older child at the top. All are looking in different directions with wide, wary eyes.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Composition: Faces overlap in a diagonal stack from top to bottom right, filling the poster. A white band at the bottom holds the title, with the large script title cut off by it.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Medium: Soft color photograph with fine film grain and warm skin tones.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Typography: Large looping script title in black cut off at the bottom by a white band, and below it a widely spaced red serif capital title with a golden ampersand. A small spaced credit at right. The script is cropped, with only the tops of the letters showing.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Color and light: Cream, white, warm skin tones, and honey blonde; soft window light.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Story it suggests: Children lie hidden together, anxious and listening to something nearby.
0261_fanny-and-alexander.jpg.Visual idea: The overlapping faces as a huddle, with script half-submerged.

0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.People: One boy's face in huge close-up at right, half cropped by the edge: dark hair, a wide dark eye, and red parted lips, looking out. A blurry shape ghosts on the left.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Composition: The face fills the right half on a diagonal tilt against an empty yellow field on the left. The title band sits at the bottom.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Medium: Soft-focus color film photograph with fine grain; the background is blurred.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Typography: Large, flowing black script title cropped by the band at the bottom, then a spaced red serif title with a gold ampersand and a smaller spaced gold subtitle line. The script is cut by the white bar and a small credit sits above at right.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Color and light: Saturated mustard yellow, dark brown hair, and red lips; warm and soft.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Story it suggests: A boy stares out, startled or watchful, with something unseen behind.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Visual idea: The pushed-aside face against a flat color field feels like a mask or a portrait peeking in.
0262_fanny-and-alexander-theatrical-vers.Feels like: Intimate period family drama, 1980s European art film.

0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.People: Two figures facing each other in a room: a boy in a dark sweater at left, standing full length, and a bent elderly figure in a heavy dark fur coat and hat at right, pointing a finger at him. Silhouetted and stiff.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Composition: The two stand at the center and right, framed by a doorway with a red curtain and a table with a bowl of apples between them. Symmetrical room with title bands below.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Medium: Color film still, grainy, dark and richly saturated.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Typography: Large script title cropped at the bottom by a white band, then a red spaced serif title with a gold ampersand, plus a smaller gold subtitle. Delicate, widely spaced, with credit text at right.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Color and light: Deep red walls, black clothing, and glowing white window; low warm light.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Story it suggests: An old authority scolds a child who stands rigid in a red room.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Visual idea: The red room and tiny doorway frame like a stage, with the pointing finger as the central gesture.
0263_fanny-and-alexander-television-vers.Feels like: Period gothic family drama, 1980s European cinema.

0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.People: One older man standing at a staircase, in a beige jacket and plaid shirt, with both fists raised to his forehead and eyes closed, glasses hanging on his chest. He seems tense or deep in thought, in a behind-the-scenes pose.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Composition: He stands right of center, with a pale wooden staircase and banister dominating the left. The poster has the title band at the bottom.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Medium: Natural color photograph, soft film grain, pale and slightly overexposed.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Typography: Cropped script title on a white band at the bottom, with a gold spaced 'THE MAKING OF' above a red spaced serif title and gold ampersand. The script is cut off by the band, and a small credit sits at right.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Color and light: Pale cream, beige, and soft brown; flat daylight.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Story it suggests: A man is caught clenching his fists in frustration or concentration at work.
0264_the-making-of-fanny-and-alexander.j.Visual idea: A behind-the-scenes snapshot where the central figure's raised fists make a frame.

0265_short-cuts.jpg.People: None; only a tiny fly at the top left corner. The red heart is a symbol, not a figure.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Composition: Broken red heart at lower right, sliced by long white diagonal lines that radiate from the left and converge near the heart, with a white light-beam wedge from the left. A vertical column of handwritten names runs down the upper right; large empty cream space elsewhere. Title in a dark square sits at the heart's center.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Medium: Stained, aged cream paper texture with water-stain blotches, flat solid red and black ink shapes, a speckled grey-blue wash band at upper left, a realistic illustrated fly.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Typography: Title SHORT CUTS stacked in a condensed cream block face inside a black square, sliced through by the white lines. Cast names in small hand-written script, centered column; credit lines in green small caps on a rising diagonal following the beam.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream and beige with saturated red, black and a little olive green; flat, even, no real light source.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Story it suggests: Many lives are cut apart and fractured by small breaks, with love or the heart at the center of the damage.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Visual idea: A shattered heart whose cracks double as the film's cuts and crossing lines; the fly adds a note of unease.
0265_short-cuts.jpg.Feels like: Literary indie drama poster, 1990s, with a modern graphic-design reinterpretation.

0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.People: One robed figure seen as a white silhouette from behind-three-quarter, head turned up to the left, arms spread wide with open palms, ringed by a radiating halo. Small, simple, symbolic; no face detail.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Composition: Figure stands right of centre and runs the full height from top to bottom edge; title on the left wraps around it, with the 'of' and 'KINGS' overlapping its robe. Large pink empty field at left top.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-style silhouette with a soft radial gradient of light behind it; letters with distressed, worn-ink edges.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Typography: Heavy black Victorian slab/wood-type capitals: a big 'KING' with curled tails, small 'of', big 'KINGS', stacked at the lower left over the robe. Name credit at top left in condensed black type. Spaced caps banner at top with a rule.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Color and light: Dusty mauve-pink with a pale glow near the head; white figure, black type; soft glowing light.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Story it suggests: A radiant figure opens his arms to the viewer.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Visual idea: Reducing the figure to a white cut-out with a halo, so he reads as pure icon.
0266_the-king-of-kings.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century biblical epic poster, softened by a 1990s-2000s DVD treatment.

0267_kagemusha.jpg.People: Two large mounted figures in black silhouette, left and right, facing each other; hard to tell riders from horses. Further shapes at the corners are ambiguous.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Composition: Two dark masses frame a white V-shaped gap in the center, symmetrical and facing inward. Title sits in the white space at upper center, tilted lines of weapons cross at bottom center.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black and white cutout, rough ink-like edges with speckle, a red brush-smear patch on the right figure.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Typography: KAGEMUSHA in a red serif, upper center, about a third of the width, set in white space and not touching the figures. Credit in a grey brushstroke strip with handwritten script below it.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with a single dab of blood red; no light gradient, flat graphic.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Story it suggests: Two armed forces or two men confront each other in a standoff, with violence already marked in red.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Visual idea: Silhouettes carve out the white space between them, a stand-in for a shadow or double.
0267_kagemusha.jpg.Feels like: Epic samurai drama, 1980s, woodcut-like graphic style.

0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.People: One man in a long coat, full body, aiming a shotgun upward to the left; a flat black silhouette with only a bit of face detail.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Composition: Figure fills the right half from top to bottom on a diagonal stance; title stacked at left center overlapping behind him. Large empty white space at left and below.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Medium: Flat solid black ink on stark white, photographic cutout thresholded into a silhouette; sharp clean edges.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy sans-serif black YOUTH OF THE BEAST stacked in three lines, with OF THE small and tucked beside; spans most of the width, the T and BEAST are clipped or cut by the figure. Small director line above.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Color and light: Black and white only, hard contrast, no mid-tones.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone armed man closes in on someone, an act of violence is imminent.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Visual idea: Type and the silhouette share the same black, so the lettering becomes part of the figure's mass.
0268_youth-of-the-beast.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese gangster film, modern minimalist graphic poster.

0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.People: A young man in a cap and uniform shown large, in close half-body, with a young woman pressed against his shoulder, both looking tense; a brawling crowd of small figures in the middle band; a tiny figure on a bell tower at the top.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Composition: Layered collage: giant title at top, cutout couple at lower right with a thick black outline, melee scene across the middle, a pagoda-like building at lower left, a ladder tower rising to the bell figure through the title.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Medium: Black and white photographs cut out and collaged, black halo outlines around the pasted couple, halftone-like grain.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Typography: Gigantic black condensed sans FIGHTING ELEGY spanning the full width in two lines, cut off at the edges and interrupted by the ladder and the figure's head; small director line at upper left.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale, strong white background with flat daylight.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Story it suggests: A hot-headed young man is caught between fights and a tender, anxious love.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Visual idea: A paper cutout mash-up where the type is overlapped by the pictures, putting brawling and romance in one stack.
0269_fighting-elegy.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese youth film, retro cut-and-paste layout.

0270_casque-d-or.jpg.People: One woman in a huge close-up face, three-quarters turn, glancing sideways, ruffled collar and sparkling earring visible; fills the left two thirds.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Composition: Face on the left, black empty field on the right, title in an ornamental label at lower right, thin gold rule across the top.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Medium: Black and white film still with soft grain, glossy studio lighting, photographic realism.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Typography: CASQUE D'OR in cream letters on a gold-framed plate with curly ends, lower right, small compared with the face; classic Victorian-style serif, subtitle below in gold sans caps.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with gold accents; soft high-key light on the face against a dark background.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman with a knowing, wary look who draws desire and danger.
0270_casque-d-or.jpg.Visual idea: Star portrait, glamour glow, the dark side hinting at secrecy.

0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.People: One man, huge close-up of the face tilted to the side and cropped at the top, shirt collar and striped tie at the bottom left.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Composition: Face fills the frame on a diagonal tilt, title band along the bottom, black header at the top with a rule.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Medium: Grainy black and white photograph, strong chiaroscuro with rim light, noisy film grain.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Typography: Large white condensed TOUCHEZ PAS AU with the last word GRISBI in muted gold, across the full width near the bottom, over a translucent band; small credit line above.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with gold; hard side-light carving the face from darkness.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Story it suggests: A tired, wary man holds a secret, danger waits in the dark.
0271_touchez-pas-au-grisbi.jpg.Visual idea: A close, slanted view that suggests sleeplessness and menace.

0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.People: None; a scythe and two wing-like shapes drawn in line; ambiguous, they could be wings or sweeping brush marks.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Composition: Two large scribbled wings spread diagonally left and right with a thin orange scythe standing between them; title stacked at lower right, small credit above at upper right.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Medium: Hand-scribbled white chalk or ink lines with spatter on a textured, mottled red surface; flat orange scythe shape.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Typography: LA COMMARE SECCA in tall white condensed sans, stacked in three lines at lower right, about a third of the width; small subtitle in braces. Credit in dark serif caps.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red with white and orange; flat with a worn texture.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Story it suggests: Death arrives, with wings and scythe, over the dry or the doomed.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Visual idea: A sketched reaper, line-drawn wings for the hurry of death.
0272_la-commare-secca.jpg.Feels like: Italian art-house film, 1960s, expressive hand-drawn poster.

0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Composition: A winding road runs from the horizon to the lower right, with dark hills on both sides; scattered apples sit on the road in the foreground, growing larger toward the bottom. Title spans the upper area above a large empty band of sky.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Medium: Rough one-color ink print on brown kraft or cardboard paper with flecks, spatter and uneven edges, like a woodcut or xerox threshold.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Typography: Bold black THIEVES' HIGHWAY slightly crooked and wobbly, across nearly the whole width near the top, with a smaller typeset credit overlapping it; looks stamped and ink-bled.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Color and light: Tan and brown paper with black only; flat, a warm vignette at the edges.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Story it suggests: Spilled apples on a lonely road suggest a cargo lost or a journey gone wrong.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Visual idea: Fruit spilled across the asphalt as clues of a crash or heist, in a poster printed like a crate label.
0273_thieves-highway.jpg.Feels like: 1940s American crime drama, with a handmade print look.

0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.People: Five: three men in the foreground as big half-body faces (a man in a fedora in profile at left, a blond man looking sideways at center, a bald man in a suit and red tie at right), and two wrestlers locked together in the middle background; a fist at lower left.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Composition: Boxing ring ropes cross diagonally behind the three men, who form a tight cluster at the bottom; wrestlers rise above them, and the title cuts diagonally through the middle.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Medium: Detailed oil painting with visible brushwork, glossy highlights, painterly background.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Typography: Big slanted yellow block letters NIGHT AND THE CITY with a red drop shadow, stacked over the wrestlers and ropes, filling most of the poster; hand-lettered, strongly tilted, overlapped by the ropes.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Color and light: Olive green and smoky yellow background, warm flesh tones, a red tie and red lettering shadow; spotlight-like glare.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Story it suggests: A hustler caught in a sleazy ring world, watched by suspicious men.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Visual idea: The wrestlers' hold is a metaphor for tangled schemes, with the ring ropes as a trap.
0274_night-and-the-city.jpg.Feels like: 1940s American film noir, with pulp paperback cover painting.

0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.People: Two: a seated man in a grey sweater whose head is hidden behind a pinned paper note, and a woman at the right edge with dark hair reaching toward him.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Composition: Horizontal photo strip across the middle, cream paper bands above and below; a white square note pinned at center-left covers the man's head. Handwritten credit fills the lower band.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Medium: Faded color film still with a reddish cast, warm paper texture, red paint splatter, a glimpse of film strip at the top.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Typography: TOUT VA B!EN in a heavy black condensed sans, stacked in three lines on the pinned note; credit in a loose hand-written pencil or pen script across the lower band; the I is replaced by an exclamation mark.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Color and light: Pinkish-red and cream, with a few red blood-like drops; soft indoor light.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Story it suggests: An office scene with a faceless man and flying red drops hints at things not going as well as the title says.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Visual idea: The pinned notice replaces the man's head, as if a slogan stands in for the person.
0275_tout-va-bien.jpg.Feels like: 1970s political French New Wave, collage and notice board.

0276_the-river.jpg.People: One woman, huge extreme close-up of half her face, in a white headdress and a veil, with dotted ornament painted on her forehead and cheek.
0276_the-river.jpg.Composition: Face cropped on the left edge, eye near the left third, the headdress curving up; a smooth deep red field at right with small blue-grey dots.
0276_the-river.jpg.Medium: Soft, slightly faded old color film still with hazy focus and mild grain; chalky hand-drawn lettering.
0276_the-river.jpg.Typography: The River in white chalk-like swashy script across the middle right, about half the width, slightly rough as if drawn with crayon; credit line in a plain serif below.
0276_the-river.jpg.Color and light: Warm reds, rust and cream; soft diffuse light.
0276_the-river.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman in ceremonial dress gazes quietly, as if on the edge of coming-of-age.
0276_the-river.jpg.Visual idea: A cropped face as portrait icon, with painted dots as a motif echoed by the dots on the red field.
0276_the-river.jpg.Feels like: Dreamy color melodrama, 1950s Technicolor look, ethnographic and poetic.

0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.People: Two young men, tight half-body close-up: one in a leather jacket at left looking off to the side, one wearing sunglasses behind him at right, both cropped by the frame.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Composition: The two faces side by side, one in front and one further back; title centered across the lower middle; a faint pink spiral ornament at right.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Medium: Color photo made to look like a worn, creased paper cover, with white crack lines at the top left and torn paper edges; ornate woodcut-style letterforms.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Typography: MY OWN in thin white serif caps, PRIVATE in widely spaced caps, and IDAHO in huge ornamental block letters, each letter filled with engraved flowers and cherubs; credit in thin italics and caps.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Color and light: Muted browns, tan, grey and leather black with pink accents; natural overcast daylight.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Story it suggests: Two drifters look away, each lost in his own world.
0277_my-own-private-idaho.jpg.Visual idea: A battered scrapbook cover crossed with Renaissance printer's ornament for a story of a road and wandering.

0278_l-eclisse.jpg.People: Two: a woman reclining with her head tilted back, and a man in a dark suit kissing her cheek, in a tight close-up with a fist pressing between them.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Composition: A diagonal clinch, the woman's bare shoulder as a bright sweep at left, the man's dark suit forming a heavy mass at right and bottom; title box at lower right.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Medium: Black and white film photograph with soft grain and rich tonal range, silky highlights.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Typography: L'ECLISSE in thin, wide, light-weight sans caps with a metallic-gradient look inside a thin ruled box at lower right, about a third of the width; director line above in small caps.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with soft studio light on skin, dark suit absorbing the light.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate kiss in which the woman's glance stays distant and unmoved.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Visual idea: Light skin against dark fabric as the contrast of closeness and detachment.
0278_l-eclisse.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house romance, modernist and fashionable.

0279_young-torless.jpg.People: One boy's face partly visible at lower right, cropped, with his eyes looking upward; tiny silhouetted figures in dark coats stand in front of a large building.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Composition: A huge black ink spiral or vortex forms a circular frame in the center, with a pale green view of a large castle-like building inside; title stacked at the top within the circle and the boy at the bottom right edge.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Medium: Rough black brush or ink swirls over a duotone, faded photograph; speckled and blurred type.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Typography: YOUNG TÖRLESS in tall, narrow, rounded black letters with a soft blurred edge, stacked in two lines inside the ring, about two thirds of the width; the umlaut dots sit beside the credit line.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Color and light: Black and a washed pale grey-green; overcast, dim light.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy watches a grim institution from within a closing circle, as if trapped in or peering through a hole.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Visual idea: A keyhole or lens-like vortex that frames the institution and a watching boy.
0279_young-torless.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European school drama, stark, oppressive and moody.

0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.People: One small figure in kimono seen from behind, full body, holding a sword at his side, standing at the center; several bodies lie in the foreground, partly dark shapes.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Composition: Figure at the end of a path in the vertical center, in a misty forest with tall trunks; corpses in the lower half form a dark foreground and the title box sits low on the page; a strong central vanishing point.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Medium: Grainy monochrome film still tinted with a single orange duotone, rough and gritty texture.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Typography: THE SWORD OF DOOM in thick, chunky off-white block letters inside a double-ruled stamped frame, about two thirds of the width, low on the poster; the director line in small orange caps above.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange fog with near-black foreground; hazy diffuse backlight.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone swordsman stands unmoved amid the dead he has left behind him.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Visual idea: A silhouette walking away from carnage, set against a hazy glow, like a vision of fate.
0280_the-sword-of-doom.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese samurai chanbara, grim and fatalistic.

0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.People: One man's face, only eyes, nose, mustache and mouth drawn, large and centered, with no outline; no other people.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Composition: Facial features floating on empty cream paper, vertical stack from eyes to mouth with title below; symmetrical and centered.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Medium: Loose brush and ink drawing, black strokes and sepia wash on cream paper; one of the eyes carries a white gouache highlight.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Typography: Hand-brushed script Jules and Jim in terracotta-red watercolor, large (about three quarters of the width), at the lower center, tilted and flowing; credit in small typeset caps beneath.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Color and light: Cream, black and brownish red; flat, soft.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's quizzical, wary expression suggests a puzzled or yearning observer.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Visual idea: A face reduced to a few gestural marks, with the mustache as the main character mark.
0281_jules-and-jim.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave illustration, elegant and sketch-like.

0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.People: None; two white sheets hung on a clothesline, one stained with red.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Composition: Two big white rectangles hang from a diagonal clothesline against black, with the left one's lower half filled with red; text at top and a three-line list at bottom left.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink graphic of black, white and red, with a rough, splattered edge on the red.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Typography: ANDRZEJ WAJDA in white serif caps at upper right, THREE WAR FILMS in a rough hand-lettered red directly under it, overlapping slightly; a list of three titles in white wide-spaced serif caps at bottom left.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and a deep blood red; flat, no light.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Story it suggests: Everyday laundry stained with blood hints at war intruding into ordinary life.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Visual idea: Blood-stained sheets as a domestic image of loss.
0282_andrzej-wajda-three-war-films.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Eastern European drama, a minimalist modern graphic cover.

0283_a-generation.jpg.People: Several small ambiguous figures drawn in black on a spiral staircase seen from below, one near the right with a head and arms visible, others at the top left blurred into a black mass.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Composition: A huge spiral stairwell viewed from above or below, concentric loops centered in the page and leading the eye inward; title near the bottom on the curve.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Medium: Rough hand-drawn black ink lines and blotches on flat saturated red, like a woodcut or linocut.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Typography: A GENERATION in hand-cut, wobbly white letters with mixed uppercase and lowercase, spanning nearly the full width near the bottom, partly crossing the stair rails; credit in a small serif.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red and black; flat graphic, no gradation.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Story it suggests: People moving along a winding, threatening staircase, chased or climbing out of danger.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Visual idea: The spiral stair as a dizzying descent or ascent, with people reduced to specks.
0283_a-generation.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Eastern European drama, handmade protest poster aesthetic.

0284_kanal.jpg.People: Only a hand, partly drawn in red outline, reaching up toward a hanging cylindrical object; no body is visible.
0284_kanal.jpg.Composition: Red barbed wire sprawls diagonally across a black field; a small canister hangs in the center, and the hand reaches from the bottom center; title at the bottom left.
0284_kanal.jpg.Medium: Flat red linework and fills on near-black, like cut-paper or screen-print; mirror-reversed text on the cylinder.
0284_kanal.jpg.Typography: KANAL in rough white hand-cut capitals at the bottom left, about a quarter of the width, directly beside a small credit line; reversed lettering appears on the object.
0284_kanal.jpg.Color and light: Deep red on black; harsh, high contrast, no light source.
0284_kanal.jpg.Story it suggests: A hand reaches for a dangerous device while trapped among barbed wire.
0284_kanal.jpg.Visual idea: Wire, bomb-like canister and hand compress war and entrapment into three symbols.
0284_kanal.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Eastern European war drama, stark political poster.

0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.People: A small figure in silhouette standing at lower right, full body, looking up; a larger upside-down figure on a cross hangs above, with spiky rays radiating from its head; ambiguous, partly a crucifix.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Composition: A large black cross extends from the top and a hanging inverted figure dominates the upper-center; the small standing man is bottom-right, a horizon bar at the bottom; title overlaps the cross.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Medium: Rough brush and spray-ink graphic, black with scratchy texture on a flat orange field, like a screenprint.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Typography: ASHES + DIAMONDS in large, uneven white hand-cut letters, tilted, about two thirds of the width at the top, overlapping the cross; credit in smaller matching hand lettering.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange-red and black with white text; flat, graphic.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands beneath an inverted crucifix, facing a reckoning.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Visual idea: An upside-down cross over a lone figure compresses guilt, faith and death into one image.
0285_ashes-and-diamonds.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Polish film, expressive 1950s-60s poster style revived in a modern brush-and-ink look.

0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.People: A man with a mustache and cigarette in a circle (the O of the title), plus eight small panels showing hands, a woman, and several tiny figures in comic-like vignettes; a face in a rocket and a woman in water.
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Composition: A 3x3 grid of rounded square panels; the center row is occupied by the big title with the man's face as the O; four panels above and below hold separate gag scenes (knife, rocket, revolver, window, woman with sausages, bottle over glasses, drowning woman, cauldron with feet, woman shot at window).
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Medium: Flat solid color with black outline drawings, comic-strip inking, slight misregistration of panel edges.
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Typography: DIVORCE in chunky, curvy custom black letters spanning the full width in the middle band, the O replaced by the face; ITALIAN STYLE in wide spaced caps between rules; small credit at upper left.
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Color and light: Greens and yellow-greens with orange accent and black lines on white; flat, cheerful.
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Story it suggests: A smug man imagines nine absurd ways of getting rid of his wife.
0286_divorce-italian-style.jpg.Visual idea: A comic-strip grid of murder fantasies orbiting a single face in the title letter.

0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.People: One man with a mustache, half-body, front-facing, large at lower right, and a second dark figure partly hidden behind him; tiny birds at the upper left.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Composition: Man occupies the lower right, a large steamship tilted on a hillside rises diagonally behind him at left; title across the top with a swirl of abstract washes behind.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Medium: Digital collage of halftone-dotted photo cutouts, watercolor-like washes and thin scratchy ink lines; layered translucent paper effect.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Typography: BURDEN OF DREAMS in a rustic slab-serif-like face in orange and red at the top, about two thirds of the width, with the small OF in white tucked between the lines; credit in a bold sans and small serif under it.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Color and light: Pale sage green, olive and rust orange with maroon; soft, hazy daylight.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's obsessive project of hauling a huge ship over land in the jungle.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Visual idea: A ship on a mountain as a stand-in for an impossible dream, with the man's face carrying the weight.
0287_burden-of-dreams.jpg.Feels like: 1980s documentary about a jungle expedition, rendered in a modern painterly collage.

0288_f-for-fake.jpg.People: One bearded man in a black hat, large close-up, his face partly covered by a blue-gloved hand in the left foreground.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Composition: Face fills the frame diagonally, the blurred glove in the left foreground obscures one eye; title in the center on a glowing smoke wisp.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color film still with heavy grain and a hazy glow, smoke effect.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Typography: F for FAKE in small, glowing white sans-serif capitals at the center over the face, about a quarter of the width, bleeding light; italic director credit above it.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Color and light: Deep black, warm skin tones, and cold blue gloves with soft white glow.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Story it suggests: A man hides half his face behind a gesture, hinting at trickery and concealment.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Visual idea: A hand and smoke veil the eye, making the face itself a possible fake.
0288_f-for-fake.jpg.Feels like: 1970s essay-style film, moody, with a magician's or conjuror's mystique.

0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.People: None; an empty red jersey hangs on a rod in the center.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Composition: Jersey hung centered and filling most of the frame vertically, with the gym rafters blurred behind; credit line at the very bottom.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism, glossy satin fabric with sparkle highlights, shallow depth of field.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Typography: HOOP DREAMS in black collegiate block letters outlined in white, printed on the jersey as if sports lettering, curved slightly with the fabric folds, across about half the width; credits in small white sans below.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red and white against dark brown; spotlit, shimmering highlights.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Story it suggests: A jersey waiting to be filled, a dream hanging in an empty gym.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Visual idea: The title is literally the jersey lettering, the garment as stand-in for the player.
0289_hoop-dreams.jpg.Feels like: 1990s sports documentary, a straightforward product photo look.

0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.People: A surreal composite body: a pink arm holding a green torch, a crown of spikes, and a huge pink backside on blue bird-like legs; no face. Ambiguous, a mock statue made from body parts.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure on a wide white field, the arm and torch rising to the left of the title, big pink round form in the middle, legs spread to the bottom; title top right.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Medium: Cut-paper collage with halftone and flat color on off-white paper, with a visible signature.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Typography: The Phantom of Liberty in an elegant large black serif, three stacked lines at upper right, about half the width; small caps credit at the bottom center.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink, olive green and blue-grey on a warm off-white; flat, even.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Story it suggests: A mocking joke on a national monument, an absurd body replacing the statue.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Visual idea: A monument of liberty turned into a body-part pun, mixing pomp with silliness.
0290_the-phantom-of-liberty.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European satire, a surreal pop-collage poster.

0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.People: Seven: a man in a tuxedo and a woman in a ruffled collar pressed cheek to cheek in the foreground, and five women dressed as angels in white gowns, with halos and wings, in the background.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Composition: Couple in the lower left; five angels in a row behind, evenly spaced, framed by red curtains at the top corners and sides; title at upper right.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Medium: Gouache or acrylic painting with visible brushwork, a bit naive and stylized, flat decorative shapes.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Typography: Heaven Can Wait in a tall, elegant red high-contrast serif, stacked on three lines at upper right, about a third of the width; italic director credit smaller below.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue, deep red curtains, cream and orange accents; stage-lit, flat.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Story it suggests: A suave man's romance is watched by a heavenly chorus.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Visual idea: A theatrical stage with angels as a chorus line, tying romance to the afterlife.
0291_heaven-can-wait.jpg.Feels like: 1940s Hollywood romantic comedy, a retro hand-painted illustration.

0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.People: Two close-up faces, a woman and a man cheek to cheek, large; a small trio of faint figures in the upper left corner (two men and a woman).
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Composition: Faces overlap diagonally in the center, framed in a rounded irregular white frame; musical notation overlays curve across the corners and notes scatter below.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Medium: Hand-tinted vintage studio photograph with soft glow, overlaid with white music staves and black notes; paint-like torn edge at the bottom.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Typography: Unfaithfully Yours in a chunky brown slab-serif at the bottom, almost full width, with a bouncy baseline; the credit in a smaller olive version beneath.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia and cream, red lips, pale blue-grey eyes; soft glow.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate couple wrapped in music, with a hint of a watching scene behind.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Visual idea: Music notes act as a thread, making romance feel like a symphony.
0292_unfaithfully-yours.jpg.Feels like: 1940s romantic comedy with a classical-music motif.

0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.People: One man in a monk's robe, full body from a low angle, arms crossed, looking off to the side in profile.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Composition: A standing figure in the center on a rolling hill under a wide cloudy sky; title in the top third, large empty sky.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Medium: Black and white film photograph with fine grain, soft clouds.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Typography: THE FLOWERS OF ST. FRANCIS in grey classic serif capitals on two lines at the top center, about half the width; the director's name above in gold blackletter-style script.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Color and light: Grey tones with gold accent; soft overcast daylight.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Story it suggests: A solemn monk stands alone on a hill, proud and unmoved.
0293_the-flowers-of-st-francis.jpg.Visual idea: A low-angle view makes the humble figure monumental against the sky.

0294_the-browning-version.jpg.People: A man in glasses, tweed vest and tie, big half-body, in profile looking off to the right; a second man's face half cut off at the right edge; a chalk-drawn face at the left on a blackboard.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Composition: Main figure on the right two-thirds, with a blackboard of scribbles and Greek letters behind at left; a torn paper strip across the bottom holds the title.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned black and white photograph, with chalk drawings and a paper-strip texture overlaid.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Typography: The Browning Version in a dark brown serif on a torn, brush-edged manila paper strip across the lower part, about the whole width; smaller caps credit below.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Color and light: Sepia, brown and cream; dim, low-key light.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Story it suggests: A stern schoolmaster stands apart from the others, watched and judged.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Visual idea: A chalkboard ghost sketch of a face echoing the man, like a student's caricature.
0294_the-browning-version.jpg.Feels like: 1950s British school drama, vintage and academic.

0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.People: Three: a young woman in the center, bare-shouldered, glancing back at the viewer; a young man at the right looking aside; another person at the left edge, partly cropped.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Composition: Close-up of a woman's head and shoulder tilted diagonally; the men flank her; the bottom third is a wide title band with ghosted reflections.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Medium: High-key black and white photograph with a washed-out, bleached look; the title duplicated as a faded echo.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Typography: CRAZED FRUIT in pale grey wide sans capitals across the full width at the bottom, repeated below as a lighter mirrored echo; Japanese characters in black vertically in the middle; credit with the name in red and gold.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with little red and yellow; bright overexposed light.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman is the center of a charged triangle of glances.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Visual idea: A repeated title and a flattened tilted pose suggest heat, glare and unease.
0295_crazed-fruit.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese youth film, with a cool modern design.

0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.People: Two people. A man's face and shoulders fill the right half in large close-up, eyes cast down; a much smaller woman in a long coat stands in a separate inset at upper left, seen from behind or side, hand on a railing.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Composition: The large head sits upper right, tilted down toward the lower center, while the small night-street scene is a skewed inset cropped into the upper left like a slanted panel. A white strip runs down the left edge and the lower third is empty black holding the title.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic film stills with visible grain and high contrast, composited as overlapping panels with a hard-edged skewed inset.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Typography: The title LE NOTTI BIANCHE is huge white serif capitals in two stacked lines across the bottom, the first letter and the final E cropped by the edges; a small italic credit sits above and three large white dots float at right. The type sits on the solid black field rather than over the image.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Color and light: Near-pure black and white, with deep shadow and a hard bright patch of light on the man's face and a single street lamp glowing in the inset.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary man lost in thought while a woman waits alone in a night street he is not looking at.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Visual idea: Two scales of the same story: the near, brooding face versus the distant figure, split into mismatched frames; the three dots read as an ellipsis of waiting.
0296_le-notti-bianche.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century European art-house drama, a restrained 1950s noir-tinged romance.

0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.People: Two beings: a young woman in close-up, eyes lowered, cheek pressed against the head of a dark donkey that fills the lower and right portions; her hand clutches its fur. They are intimate, protective.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Composition: Diagonal embrace running from upper right face down to lower left hand and the animal's muzzle at bottom. Face is slightly right of center; black negative space above and left; title block upper left over dark ground.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus black-and-white photography with heavy film grain and blurred edges, glowing highlights on skin against inky shadow.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Typography: Title is mixed-case sans serif, 'au hasard' in grey and 'Balthazar' in larger white, stacked at upper left of medium size, with a small pale credit above. Typeset, clean, sits on the dark background beside the face.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome, extreme contrast, pale face and hand emerging from black as if lit by a single soft source.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Story it suggests: A tender bond between a girl and an animal in a dark, uncaring world.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Visual idea: The girl and the animal merge into one shape through touch, tenderness against darkness.
0297_au-hasard-balthazar.jpg.Feels like: Quiet 1960s European art cinema, humanist and sorrowful.

0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.People: Two people in a cropped rectangular photo at center: a man with a glistening, sweaty face at left and a young woman in a red ribbon at right, both staring intently. They are close and overlapping, tense.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Composition: Dense layered collage: a huge faint sunburst circle behind everything, vertical columns of dots and red bars at top, a long black rule at left, a horizontal photo band at center-lower, and giant title across the middle.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Medium: Aged cream paper with halftone dot patterns, punched-card style dots, ghosted calligraphy, a translucent sunburst and a color film still, printed in flat red and black like constructivist graphic design.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Typography: Oversize red condensed block letters GATE OF FLESH span nearly the full width, cut and tightly packed, with white SEIJUN SUZUKI'S above in heavy sans. A smaller vertical SEIJUN SUZUKI runs up the left side. The type overlaps the circle and dots, loud and poster-like.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige and tan with strong red and black accents, flat even graphic light apart from the photo's sweaty highlights.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people locked in a hot, confrontational standoff inside a chaotic, noisy world.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Visual idea: Constructivist typographic collage where the human faces are a small calm block inside a storm of data-like marks and a rising-sun circle.
0298_gate-of-flesh.jpg.Feels like: Japanese 1960s pop-modernist graphic design, a retro punk-ish exploitation feel.

0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.People: Two people entangled at lower right: a woman leaning far back with open laughing mouth and a soldier-like man in a cap burying his face in her chest; one raised arm and hand come in from upper left. Medium framing, intimate and violent.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Composition: Diagonal arch from raised hand at upper left to the man's head at lower center, with the woman's face at right center. Title blocks stack across the top half over a mottled wall texture; a framed rectangle with margins surrounds it all.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned photograph over a rough stained plaster texture, with grain, scratches and a faint grey branch; looks like an aged print with a printed border and a red brush-style character.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Typography: Large bold condensed sans in dark brown-black, with SEIJUN SUZUKI'S small above and STORY OF A / PROSTITUTE very large stacked, spanning the width and overlaid on the photo with the image showing through the letters. A vertical red Japanese brush character sits at upper right.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome sepia and grey with one touch of vermilion red in the calligraphy; dim flat light.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Story it suggests: A desperate, half-ecstatic embrace between a woman and a man in uniform amid hardship.
0299_story-of-a-prostitute.jpg.Visual idea: Type and photograph fused through overprint, with a weathered wall as the surface for both.

0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..People: One bearded man in a red cap and diving suit, chest-deep in water at lower center, holding a spear gun upright; small, drawn figure with a solemn face.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Composition: Strong horizontal split: pale blue sky with a small ship and tethered balloon above a horizon line, then a huge field of repeating green waves below. The man sits low and centered, with the title stacked in the empty water above him.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Medium: Hand-drawn illustration with watercolor washes and fine ink outlines, visible paper-grain texture, flat naive rendering.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Typography: Title THE LIFE AQUATIC is large yellow outlined hand-lettered caps stacked on three lines centered in the water, with small 'with STEVE ZISSOU' at the bottom in the same style. The letters look inked and watercolored, sitting like floating text on the waves.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Color and light: Soft turquoise green and light sky blue with a red cap and yellow lettering as accents; flat, bright, gentle daylight.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Story it suggests: A lone explorer bobbing in a vast sea, armed and deadpan, far from his ship.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Visual idea: The tiny figure and tiny ship are dwarfed by repeated waves, a storybook-style map of the ocean.
0300_the-life-aquatic-with-steve-zissou..Feels like: Whimsical modern storybook illustration, 2000s indie comedy.

0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.People: One child, full body, centered at lower center, walking toward the viewer on a gravel road, red-orange frizzy hair, dark coat; small relative to the sky.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Composition: Strong central one-point perspective: a road converges to the figure, with hills on both sides, a huge sky above and a white-bordered title box centered in the upper third. Symmetrical and vertical.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Medium: Hand-tinted photographic color with soft saturated gradients in the sky and grass; a faint overlay of typewriter text covers the sky.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Typography: The title AN ANGEL AT MY TABLE is white bold sans caps inside a white-outlined rectangle at center-top, with an italic credit below. Behind it, ghostly typewritten lines of text fill the sky, partly legible and layered.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Color and light: Bright blue sky, white clouds and vivid green fields, with a warm orange tone on the figure; clear open daylight.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary child walks out of a wide rural landscape toward an uncertain life.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Visual idea: Words become sky: the typed text floats above the child like thoughts or writing.
0301_an-angel-at-my-table.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s art film, gentle coming-of-age portrait.

0302_harikari.jpg.People: No people shown, though the letters might be read as figures; no faces.
0302_harikari.jpg.Composition: Large red four-pointed star shape formed by cracks at center-right, with vertical and horizontal ragged lines reaching nearly the edges, a red dot top right, and a lot of white empty space.
0302_harikari.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in red and black on white; the red has rough torn edges like a brush or cut paper.
0302_harikari.jpg.Typography: The title HARAKIRI is broken into four chunks arranged around the star: HA RA / KI RI. Each letter is blocky, taped-together black and cut off, tilted at angles, with the red shape slicing between them. A small thin credit 'A FILM BY MASAKI KOBAYASHI' sits at upper left, much smaller.
0302_harikari.jpg.Color and light: Pure white ground, a vivid red and black, no light effects, graphic and sharp.
0302_harikari.jpg.Story it suggests: A violent cut or wound that splits the world and the name apart.
0302_harikari.jpg.Visual idea: The word is literally cut by a red slash that becomes a sunburst, echoing a flag's red disc.
0302_harikari.jpg.Feels like: Japanese 1960s graphic design, stark and bold.

0303_bad-timing.jpg.People: One young woman with long tousled blond hair, half body, seated on a couch in a black slip, hand with a cigarette at her mouth, eyes heavy and unfocused. Faint ghost shapes of other figures or a face are washed into the upper background.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Composition: Her figure sits lower right, leaning forward on a diagonal; the upper left is a faded double-exposure of pale abstract shapes, and a framed picture hangs top right. Title runs across the middle, cropped off the right edge.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Medium: Overexposed, washed-out color photograph with grain, ghosted double-exposure overlays and a translucent pale veil over the left half; scratchy paint-like marks and a faint grid pattern in the lettering.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Typography: BAD TIMING in wide-spaced bold brown capitals, medium-large, across the middle and cropped at the right edge by the G; it is semi-transparent with chipped speckles of gold where the background shows through. The credit in small spaced serif capitals at left is cut off at the edge.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Color and light: Bleached cream, pale grey-blue and beige with a warm orange-brown title; hazy, bright, overexposed light.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman lost in a numb, smoky moment after something has gone wrong in a private room.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Visual idea: Memory and trace: faded overlaid images suggest a past intruding on a quiet present.
0303_bad-timing.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European art-house drama, faded and moody.

0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.People: One person, an extreme close-up of a young man's face, cropped from hair to chin, one eye in shadow and one eye looking at us, red-orange hair, with a pale collar at the bottom.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Composition: The face fills the center and the title is stacked over it in three lines, with 'WHO FELL' crossing his eyes and nose. A small credit is at the bottom, centered, all aligned along the vertical axis.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Medium: Photographic color with soft grain, the face emerging from a pure black ground with a vignette fade at the edges.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Typography: THE MAN / WHO FELL / TO EARTH in heavy white blocky sans capitals, large, centered and stacked in decreasing sizes; the words cross the face and the line 'WHO FELL' covers the eyes. Crisp typeset white over the image.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with warm orange hair and peach skin, a pale green-white collar; a dramatic side light from the left that cuts the face in half.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange, cold stare from someone who seems not to belong here.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Visual idea: Title as a mask: the letters sit on the face and half-blind the figure, and the three-step sizing hints at falling.
0304_the-man-who-fell-to-earth.jpg.Feels like: 1970s science-fiction art film, cool and alien.

0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.People: One huge bearded man's face, drawn, occupying most of the poster with a heavy scowl and orange skin; a tiny yellow silhouette of a figure stands at left, pointing, much smaller.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Composition: The big head sits right of center with the scowl slanting toward the upper left, and the little silhouette at lower left makes a large-small contrast. Title blocks sit across the top and bottom in a framed rectangle on cream paper.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or lithograph illustration with airbrushed highlights and visible smooth gradients on a cream paper border, vintage print look.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Typography: BOUDU in huge black bubbly letters with a cream outline across the top, slanted and uneven. Below, SAVED FROM DROWNING in smaller art deco outlined caps, and JEAN RENOIR in a cream deco face at the bottom. All lettering is hand-drawn with an outline and sits directly over the painting.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Color and light: Teal and blue-green sea behind with hot orange-red skin and hair, yellow-green accent, vivid flat light.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Story it suggests: A grumpy giant who overwhelms everything around him, including the little person watching.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Visual idea: Caricature and scale: the huge face is wave and landscape in one, the small pointing figure a witness.
0305_boudu-saved-from-drowning.jpg.Feels like: 1930s French illustrated poster, comic art deco.

0306_le-samourai.jpg.People: One man, half body, in a trench coat and brimmed hat, face half in shadow and gazing at us straight on, lit from one side.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Composition: The figure is in the upper middle, set in a black void with the title block in the lower third, left aligned. A lot of empty black space frames him.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Medium: Photographic color still with fine grain and a black field around it, a soft glow fading into the coat at the bottom.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Typography: LE SAMOURAI in tall condensed pale blue sans capitals, large, spanning most of the width at the bottom, with a diaeresis over the I; 'ALAIN DELON IN' and 'A FILM BY' in small white, and JEAN-PIERRE MELVILLE in a bolder blue. Clean typeset with two dots at the right.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Color and light: Black with steel blue-grey, a beige trench, and the cool light that throws half the face into darkness.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Story it suggests: A cold, solitary man ready for something and watching us.
0306_le-samourai.jpg.Visual idea: Silhouette and half-light: the hat and shadow conceal the face, turning the man into a symbol.

0307_naked.jpg.People: One man, half body, front-facing, grimacing with eyes squeezed shut and teeth clenched, holding a cigarette in one hand and a mug in the other, in a black sweater.
0307_naked.jpg.Composition: Centered figure on an empty tan field with the title above him, a big gap between them, a very simple vertical symmetrical layout.
0307_naked.jpg.Medium: Duotone black-and-brown print, grainy photograph cut out against a flat solid tan background.
0307_naked.jpg.Typography: NAKED in bold black condensed sans capitals, centered above, with a smaller 'A FILM BY MIKE LEIGH' beneath it. Typeset, plain, not touching the figure.
0307_naked.jpg.Color and light: Sandy tan and black, flat even light.
0307_naked.jpg.Story it suggests: A scruffy man pulling a pained face while he fidgets with smoke and tea.
0307_naked.jpg.Visual idea: The silly grimace in the vacant space makes a portrait of discomfort.
0307_naked.jpg.Feels like: 1990s British indie realism, bare and dry.

0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.People: One young woman, close-up of her head and shoulders, black bob with bangs, a slight smile and sideways glance, a striped scarf at the bottom.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Composition: Her head fills the lower two-thirds, centered; the title lettering is stacked above and touching the top of her hair. Symmetrical, with a light grey backdrop.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with fine grain against a pale background; the lettering is flat color ink.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Typography: masculin / féminin in huge red fat-face serif lowercase, two stacked lines across the top, the first line cropped by the top edge. 'a film by Jean-Luc Godard' below in italic pink and orange bold serif, each word a different color. Playful typeset mixing sizes and colors.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Color and light: Grey-white photograph with hot red, pink and orange type; soft even light.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Story it suggests: A relaxed, amused young woman looks at someone off to the side.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Visual idea: The cool monochrome face is set against loud pop-color letters, a contrast of black and white with color.
0308_masculin-feminin.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave, pop and playful.

0309_ugetsu.jpg.People: Two faces, a man at left and woman at upper right, both blurred, heads tilted toward each other as a ghostly double exposure; a tiny figure walks in the field at far left below.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Composition: The big overlapping faces fill the upper two-thirds on a diagonal, with a pair of bare trees and a horizon below, and a dark band with the title at the bottom. Faces are more dreamlike than real.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus black-and-white film still with heavy grain and sepia tint, double exposure and paper-like texture, dark vignette at the bottom.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Typography: UGETSU in large widely spaced pale serif capitals on the dark band at the bottom, centered; a small italic credit under it. Thin, elegant, typeset.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Color and light: Warm greys and sepia, pale glowing light on the faces, dark at the base.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple haunted by each other, with a lonely landscape behind them.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Visual idea: Faces floating over a landscape like a memory or spirit above the ground.
0309_ugetsu.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese ghost-story classic, misty and elegiac.

0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.People: One man, half body, lunging toward us with a long sword blade rising at left; his face is bloodied, scowling, hair coming loose, robe stained.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Composition: Large tilted title band across the top third, then a diagonal figure at lower right, with the long blade forming a near-vertical line on the left. Misty hills and empty tan sky fill the left middle.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Medium: Duotone brown-tan halftone-like photograph with grain, white speckle and scratches on the ink band, like a worn two-color print.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Typography: SAMURAI in smaller and REBELLION in huge, heavy condensed white-and-brown capitals stacked at the top; the letters are cut off at the left and right edges and torn by white scratches. The shape of the band is angled, with a credit on a white wedge below.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Color and light: Mustard brown and sandy tan with white, flat and dusty daylight.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Story it suggests: A wounded fighter bears down, grim and unbroken, in an open field.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Visual idea: Typographic band as a slash plus the blade as a line, aggression in angle.
0310_samurai-rebellion.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese swordplay drama, worn grindhouse print.

0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.People: One man, three-quarter body, in a dark kimono holding a sword at his hip, looking aside warily in a wild mountain forest.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Composition: Title band across the top, then the figure at lower center in a misty valley that funnels toward the middle; angled white strips under the title carry the credit.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Medium: Olive green and cream duotone printed halftone photograph with grain, white scratch marks and flecks over the ink.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Typography: SWORD in huge white heavy capitals cropped at the left, OF THE BEAST in smaller stacked pieces beneath, BEAST huge and cropped on the right edge. The letters overlap the photo, white on both the green band and the mist; credit on a torn white wedge.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Color and light: Olive green and pale khaki, misty and diffuse daylight.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone swordsman alert in a hostile wilderness, being hunted or hunting.
0311_sword-of-the-beast.jpg.Visual idea: The title cuts through the sky like a blade, slashed letters over the forest.

0312_samurai-spy.jpg.People: One masked figure in white wrappings and robe seen from low angle at lower left, holding a long chain or rope that whips up toward the upper right; only the eyes show.
0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Composition: Big diagonal: the figure at the bottom left and the line sweeping to the upper right, with a large empty pale blue field to the right. The title bar is at top, with SPY as a giant white shape on the right.
0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Medium: Duotone teal halftone-like photograph on flat pale blue ink, with white speckle and scratches on the band.
