0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Typography: SAMURAI in white capitals on a teal band at left, SPY in massive white sans letters on the right running out of the band and cropped by the edge. The credit sits on a white wedge. Flat typeset, overlapping the band's edge.
0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Color and light: Teal, pale blue and white, cool and flat.
0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Story it suggests: A hidden watcher in disguise, poised to strike from below.
0312_samurai-spy.jpg.Visual idea: The oversized S P Y letters tower like a skyline above the small hidden man.

0313_kill.jpg.People: One man, face and shoulders close-up in the lower left corner, glaring sideways with raised eyebrows, a sword held up diagonally from his hand beside him.
0313_kill.jpg.Composition: Giant white letters cover the upper two-thirds on an orange panel, with the man pushed into the lower left on a yellow field, while empty yellow fills the lower right. Strong diagonal from the sword to upper right.
0313_kill.jpg.Medium: Flat two-color ink in orange and yellow with white, a duotone brown photo, and speckled white scratches on the orange ink.
0313_kill.jpg.Typography: KILL! in colossal white blocky capitals, rotated and askew, each letter chopped and cropped by the edges, and the exclamation mark split into a bar and a rounded dot at the bottom. The credit is small and rotated vertical beside the K. Hand-cut paper feel.
0313_kill.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange and yellow with white and brown tone, flat saturated light.
0313_kill.jpg.Story it suggests: A swordsman about to strike, with violence literally spelling out the title.
0313_kill.jpg.Visual idea: The letters become slabs that overwhelm the man, collapsed into broken blocks.

0314_pickpocket.jpg.People: Only a hand: a pale hand with thumb and fingers pinching, emerging from a gap in a dark jacket. No faces.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Composition: Central hand in a V-shaped opening made by the dark fabric of two coat panels, with the title above in the upper third. The jacket lines converge toward the hand.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Medium: Duotone sepia-brown photograph with film grain and a charcoal-like fabric texture, flat yellow ink for the title.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Typography: pickpocket in big yellow slab-serif lowercase letters across the top, with an odd t shaped with a flick; credit small beige capitals at the bottom. Typeset and sits on the dark cloth.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Color and light: Dark chocolate brown with a bright pale hand and mustard yellow lettering; low soft light.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Story it suggests: A furtive hand slips into a coat, quietly stealing.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Visual idea: The hand is the sole actor, framed by the garment as if by a curtain.
0314_pickpocket.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French crime drama, minimal and austere.

0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.People: One man, full body, seated on a stool in profile, drawn; his back wears a target with red hits, one hand stretched out like on keys.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Composition: Figure on the left half, arm reaching right, with a tilted white title card at the upper right; the target sits centered on his back. Lots of orange pattern fills the background.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Medium: Illustrated with flat cut-out or gouache style, woven orange textile pattern, grey-toned figure, printed ink look.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Typography: SHOOT THE PIANO PLAYER on a white tilted card in hand-cut red letters of mixed size, big and uneven; the credit beside it in a small black serif. Hand-drawn, angled card placement.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Color and light: Orange and yellow check pattern with black suit, red type and bullet holes; flat, even light.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Story it suggests: A man at his work who has been marked for death and does not know.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Visual idea: The suit becomes a shooting target, joke and menace together.
0315_shoot-the-piano-player.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave pop illustration, cartoon thriller.

0316_ran.jpg.People: No clear people; a large red brush shape that might be a figure leaping or a character. Ambiguous, not a person.
0316_ran.jpg.Composition: Splatter fills the whole page, with a big red shape at center-left and a tall red form at right, and the letters R A N spaced across the middle. The mass is balanced between yellow at left and blue at right.
0316_ran.jpg.Medium: Splattered paint or ink in red, yellow, blue and black, thick glossy red brush strokes with a raised, wet look, on white paper.
0316_ran.jpg.Typography: R A N in black widely spaced serif capitals across the middle at medium-large size, set on top of the splatters; a credit in thin widely spaced capitals along the bottom. Typeset over the painting.
0316_ran.jpg.Color and light: White ground with primary red, yellow and blue, black accent; bright, even and loud.
0316_ran.jpg.Story it suggests: Chaos erupting from a single act, a battlefield rendered as paint.
0316_ran.jpg.Visual idea: Action painting as war: color armies splashed together.

0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.People: Four small painted figures: a ballerina in a white feathered tutu leaping high at right, a dancer in a dark sparkly bodysuit reaching up in a boat, a man reclining in a purple coat, and a gondolier with a pole at left. Full body, tiny against the sky.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Composition: Diagonal: the title sweeps from upper left, the ballerina arcs through the middle right, and a long gondola curves across the bottom. Everything is set in a blue night with a big dark arch behind.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Medium: Gouache or poster-paint illustration with brush strokes, painted gradients and sprinkled star sparkles, vintage hand-painted look; a signature in the corner.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Typography: The title is huge hand-brushed script in orange-to-peach gradient, slanted and swooping across the top two-fifths; 'Powell and Pressburger's' in small white script above. The calligraphic letters look like flames or ribbons and overlap the painted arch.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Color and light: Deep cobalt blue with warm orange lettering, gold-yellow fabric and white tutu, lantern glow; magical night light.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Story it suggests: A fantastical night in a gondola where a dancer takes flight above the water.
0317_the-tales-of-hoffmann.jpg.Visual idea: The title lettering and dancer's leap share one gesture, a stage spectacle painted as a dream.

0318_forbidden-games.jpg.People: Two children, a boy at left and a girl at right, in half-body close-up lying at a table, he looking at her intently, she resting her cheek on a hand and looking sadly away; a card in her hand.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Composition: Children in the lower third, a church with a bell tower and graves in the middle ground at left, and a bomber plane with falling bombs and a smoke plume at right. Title across the top, centered.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white pencil or charcoal-like painted illustration with soft shading, scratches and a paper-canvas texture, like an aged print.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Typography: FORBIDDEN GAMES in medium-large brown-grey sans capitals centered across the top, with the credit centered below in smaller text. Clean typeset, sits in the sky over the scene.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Color and light: Greys and sepia, soft overcast light with a hazy sky.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Story it suggests: Two children share a quiet bond while war goes on behind them.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Visual idea: The children's close, tender faces in front of a church and a bomber suggest innocence against destruction.
0318_forbidden-games.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French postwar drama, graphite storybook illustration.

0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Composition: Black top and white bottom divided by a diagonal skyline-like edge; the white mass is a grid of gray angled marks like a building facade, with a single red X on it at left. Title across the top, cropped on both sides.
0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in black, white, gray and red; vector-clean with a brushy X.
0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Typography: THE BAD SLEEP WELL in tall condensed white capitals running edge to edge across the top and cut at both sides, with BAD in bigger red. The credit in bold red below at right. Typeset, strong, with the title sitting on the black field above the building.
0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray with one vivid crimson accent; flat graphic.
0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Story it suggests: Something marked and doomed in a large impersonal building.
0319_the-bad-sleep-well.jpg.Visual idea: A mark on a facade: the X targets a single window among hundreds, one among many.

0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.People: One man in a dark suit, bow tie and top hat in hand, seen in profile at right, looking toward a river; full body, medium size in the frame.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Composition: The man is placed at the right and the title overlaps the water at the center-left. Water and a tree line behind him, tall grass in front, forming horizontal bands.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Medium: Sepia photograph with soft haze and grain, plus a faint print texture; embossed, paper-like lettering.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Typography: YOUNG MR. LINCOLN in huge cream-white western-style woodtype letters with chipped, curved ends, stacked over three lines on the water, and DIRECTED BY JOHN FORD at the bottom in the same style. The letters look raised and embossed, and overlap the man.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, cream and tan, soft hazy light.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Story it suggests: A thoughtful man pauses by a river before his path begins.
0320_young-mr-lincoln.jpg.Visual idea: The old-style lettering grounds the image in the 1800s, with the man posed like a historical portrait.

0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.People: One young woman, half body, in profile with her face lifted and eyes closed, long hair falling down her back, wearing a fur-trimmed dress.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Composition: Large diagonal body from lower left up to the face at upper right, dark ground left and foliage behind. The title sits at center over a small drawn dagger or ornament running vertically through it.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with grain and strong backlight.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Typography: The Virgin Spring in narrow white serif letters at medium size, centered at the middle, with a thin italic credit below; a gray carved-looking dagger ornament runs through the letters. Typeset, overlays the dark garment.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Color and light: Black and white, bright sunlight on the face and hair against deep shadow.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl in a sunlit forest, serene and unaware of the danger.
0321_the-virgin-spring.jpg.Visual idea: A dagger running down the title through her body hints at a coming violence amid peace.

0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.People: One man's face, close-up and angled down, rendered in halftone dots, with dark hair and a mustache, part of the head in shadow.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Composition: The big head fills the center and left, with the dark text blocks and puzzle shapes around; the title is a heavy block stacked across the bottom third. The head is tilted on a diagonal.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Medium: Halftone dot portrait over a dense layer of typewritten book text, with jigsaw puzzle pieces cut out of it; printed in dark red monotone like a photocopy.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Typography: THE COMPLETE small white above, MR. ARKADIN huge in white slab-serif capitals, A.K.A. CONFIDENTIAL REPORT and the credit in white bold capitals below. All four lines are stacked at the bottom, packed to the edges. Text and the puzzle are behind the letters.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Color and light: Deep brick red and black with pinkish highlights on the face; dim flat light.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Story it suggests: A man whose identity is a puzzle to be pieced together from written reports.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Visual idea: Puzzle pieces and printed words build and break the face, a dossier that is incomplete.
0322_mr-arkadin.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century paranoid mystery drama, retro report-style design.

0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.People: Two people: a boy in sharp close-up, face half in shadow and looking up, and an adult's head, dark and large, leaning toward him at the left edge, partly cropped.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Composition: The child's face sits center-lower, the adult looms at upper left, and the title is stacked at the right in four lines over the black. The two heads tilt together.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Medium: Duotone sepia photograph with grain and strong shadow, fading into a black ground.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Typography: THE CHILDREN ARE WATCHING US in large white high-contrast serif capitals stacked in four lines at the right, with VITTORIO DE SICA'S in small olive letters between. The title crosses over the boy's head. Typeset.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Color and light: Black with sepia tone, a spotlight across the child's eyes, cold and dramatic.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Story it suggests: A child sees what the adults do not want him to see.
0323_the-children-are-watching-us.jpg.Visual idea: The adult face looms over the boy's wide-open face, the child as a witness.

0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.People: One man, extreme close-up of a sweaty, squinting face in a cap with goggles pushed up on it, collar of a work jacket below.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Composition: The face is large and centered, tilted slightly up, filling most of the frame, with the title across the upper area above the cap and dark smoke behind.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned photograph with strong contrast and grain, printed look, billowing black cloud behind.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Typography: LA BÊTE HUMAINE in large rough red slab-sans capitals across the top, eroded edges, and a small italic credit below it. Typeset, with a distressed finish, above the head.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, black smoke and bright cream skin highlights, with a vivid red title; hard sunlight.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Story it suggests: A weary working man, squinting into harsh light and smoke, carries something heavy.
0324_la-bete-humaine.jpg.Visual idea: Face as machine: the goggles and smoke make him part of the industrial scene.

0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.People: Nine people: eight small head portraits (seven men and one figure in a woman's hat) in costume, in shield-shaped frames on the tree, and a full-body man in a dark suit at right holding a red axe behind his back. Several faces look strikingly similar, as if one face wears different costumes.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical-ish family tree rising from center-bottom, with portraits at the branch tips, and the single figure stands apart on the right, looking at the tree. Title block at bottom.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic illustration: cut paper-like white tree with ragged edges, decorative leaves, vintage black-and-white portrait photographs in shield frames, and a color-tinted figure; matte textured teal paper.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Typography: KIND HEARTS and CORONETS in a decorative Victorian wood-type face with ornamental fill, brown with cream and ornaments, across the bottom, and 'Directed by Robert Hamer' in elegant script with flourishes. Names of the portrait subjects curve along the branches in script.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Color and light: Teal blue-green ground with cream tree, sepia portraits, and a bright red axe accent; flat, even light.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Story it suggests: A man at the edge of a family tree holds an axe, plotting against the line above him.
0325_kind-hearts-and-coronets.jpg.Visual idea: The family tree is a hit list: portraits as targets, the axe pointed at the branches.

0326_metropolitan.jpg.People: Five drawn figures in formal evening wear, three-quarter length, grouped in a tight pyramid: two standing at the back facing each other, three seated in front. They gaze in different directions, forming a stiff society portrait.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Composition: Central vignette floating in a large white field, title above and credit below; the group forms a triangle with a lamp at the right as vertical counterweight. Soft irregular edges fade into white.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Medium: Pen-and-ink cross-hatching with light watercolor tints on a white paper ground; the hatched background dissolves at the edges like a book illustration.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Typography: Title in widely letter-spaced, slightly wobbly hand-drawn serif capitals across the top, black on white; a smaller elegant serif credit sits at the bottom. Typeset-feeling but with a quirky inked edge.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Color and light: Muted olive-grey and cream with warm yellow lamp glow and small dabs of red on lips; soft interior lamplight.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Story it suggests: A small circle of elegant young people gathered after a formal party, polite yet watchful of one another.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Visual idea: A storybook illustration frame that treats the cast as a formal family portrait, with the lamp as the single warm accent.
0326_metropolitan.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s literary comic-illustration, New Yorker-style, wry and refined.

0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.People: A tall panel of a school-class photo with about nine boys and clergymen in rows, plus a large close-up of a man in a blue work shirt in the lower half, head resting on one hand with a pipe in his mouth, eyes closed. The two images are unrelated in scale and not linked in gaze.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Composition: Black field divided into upper collage and lower close-up; the class photo sits upper left with orange corner brackets, a framed text box at right, and the man's head at lower right on a diagonal tilt.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Medium: Layered collage of halftone-like black-and-white photo, grainy color film still, and printed ransom-type labels over a ghosted large serif word.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Typography: A huge washed-out grey serif surname spans the width behind everything, partly hidden; a white strip of cut-out newsprint capitals runs across the middle with script titles scratched underneath; small spaced sans capitals in a black outlined box list three titles.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Color and light: Near-black ground with grey-blue and rust-red accents; dim, low-key light on faces.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Story it suggests: Memories of a group of schoolboys under watching adults set against a tired, pensive man.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Visual idea: A scrapbook collage that stacks three works as layers of memory under one giant surname.
0327_3-films-by-louis-malle.jpg.Feels like: Early-2000s arthouse box-set design, mid-century European cinema, moody and archival.

0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.People: One boy in profile, huge close-up filling most of the poster, eyes closed, holding a cigar to his lips with lit end near a lighter; hands visible at the bottom. No one else shown.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Composition: Diagonal-leaning large head dominating the lower two thirds, with title strip and credit box crowded at the top; the face occupies the left and center, the right is dark empty space.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color film still with heavy visible grain and sepia warmth; text strips look like pasted newsprint.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Typography: Title in cut-and-pasted newsprint serif capitals on a white strip crossing the top edge, partly extending off the right side, with a tiny script echo below; a huge ghosted grey surname sits behind. A small outlined box holds sans credit text.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Color and light: Amber, brown and olive tones with a dim bronze glow; murky, smoky interior light.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy trying on adult habits in private, caught between innocence and mischief.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Visual idea: Tight profile makes the act of imitation the whole subject, with the ransom-style title echoing a sneaky secret.
0328_murmur-of-the-heart.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s to 1970s French coming-of-age film, nostalgic and slightly illicit.

0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.People: One young man, half body, looking back over his shoulder at the viewer with a hard, wary stare; a long pole or tool handle slants across his shoulder from the left. A dark shape peeks at the top left.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from the pole running upper left to lower right, face at upper right third, text pushed to the bottom; large dark empty area top left.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Medium: Grainy color film still, desaturated and grey-green, with a fuzzy photographic texture.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Typography: Title in pasted newsprint capitals on a white strip at the lower right, with small script echo; a huge ghosted grey surname spans the bottom edge; a small outlined box with sans credit at lower left. Thin top band reads the collection name in spaced capitals.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Color and light: Slate blue, grey and charcoal black; flat overcast light.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Story it suggests: A rough rural youth carrying a tool and glancing back, suspicious and unreadable.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Visual idea: The pole cuts the frame like a barrier and the sideways stare conveys distrust.
0329_lacombe-lucien.jpg.Feels like: 1970s French period drama, austere and rural.

0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.People: Two children shown in tight close-up, heads overlapping: one in a dark cap and heavy tweed coat in profile facing right and down, a second lighter-haired child directly behind peering in the same direction. Faces fill the lower two thirds.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Composition: Black top area with title strips, faces crowding the lower half; the foreground profile is diagonal toward the lower right, the second face tucked behind it.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Medium: Grainy, soft color film still with speckled noise; title strip like pasted newsprint.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Typography: Wide cut-out serif capitals on a white strip stretching nearly edge to edge near the top, with script duplicate beneath; behind it a huge ghosted grey surname; small sans credit in an outlined black box below. Collection mark overlaps the ghosted letters.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Color and light: Deep black with warm, pale skin tones and brown wool; dim, diffused low light.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young companions pressed together, listening or hiding from something just out of view.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Visual idea: Overlapping faces as an intimate bond, with the dark all around them.
0330_au-revoir-les-enfants.jpg.Feels like: 1980s European historical drama, hushed and wartime-feeling.

0331_late-spring.jpg.People: A woman in traditional bridal attire in half body at lower left, eyes down; a distant walking man with a cane, two tiny figures standing on a ridge by two bicycles, and a few small shots of rails and a tree. The people are small or solitary.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Composition: Grey panel on top, title filling it; below, a collage of black-and-white film stills in a tidy asymmetric grid with a large frame at right and three stacked small frames in the middle.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film stills with fine grain; title made of real pine needles photographed on a grey gradient sky.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Typography: Giant two-line title taller than half the poster, in letters spelled out of pine needles, brown and thin, uneven and hand-assembled; centered across the upper panel with a typeset credit in black and red beneath.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Color and light: Silver grey with warm brown needle lettering and one red accent in the name; soft overcast daylight.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet departure and the distance growing between loved ones, hinted by bikes, trains and a bride looking away.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Visual idea: The handmade letters of spring on a cloudy sky, paired with a grid of quiet life moments.
0331_late-spring.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Japanese family drama, gentle and contemplative.

0332_viridiana.jpg.People: One woman lying on her back seen in profile, shown from the face downward, eyes closed, with a mass of small white blossoms around her neck. The head is rotated horizontally, like lying down.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Composition: Face placed horizontally across the lower half, title in the black area above and wrapping around the nose; strong diagonal from upper left to right.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with heavy grain and white painted lettering.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-brushed white title with a dripping, uneven stroke across the top at about a quarter of the poster height; small lettering for the credit stacks under the initial V, tilted and shaky. Letters nearly touch the face.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with silver halftones; strong frontal light on the face against deep shadow.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Story it suggests: A pale woman lying still among flowers, serene yet uncomfortably like an effigy or a sleeper.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Visual idea: The flowers and horizontal face turn a figure into a still life, while the brush lettering feels like an intrusion.
0332_viridiana.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s European art cinema, stark and religiously charged.

0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.People: One young man in extreme close-up profile, face turned to the right and slightly down, mouth closed; a collar visible at the bottom. Single figure, filling the frame.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Composition: Square photo cropped into a rough rectangle on white, title block beneath; face fills the picture and is placed centrally, leaving margins of white.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph scratched by white brush or scraping marks, with ragged torn edges like a printed linocut.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Typography: Title in blocky hand-cut black capitals across the lower width, with a smaller rust-orange credit line beneath; uneven, stamped look, strongly separated from the picture.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white with rust orange in the credit; flat, grainy side light.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense, brooding young man whose violence is kept below the surface.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Visual idea: Scratches and brush marks across the face suggest a damaged or scarred portrait.
0333_fists-in-the-pocket.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian New Wave, raw and agitated.

0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.People: About twenty small portraits and action shots of ordinary working people: faces of older men and women, miners in helmets, a woman with a donation sign, a man holding a rifle, picketers. Mostly close-ups and half-bodies, each isolated in its own tile.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Composition: Six-by-six grid of torn paper tiles on black; the middle three rows are lettered tiles forming the title, with photo tiles above and below. Title letters fill tiles one per square in a crossword-like block.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Medium: Faded sepia photo stills printed on rough, torn, speckled paper tiles, with stencil-cut lettering; coarse grain and ragged edges.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Typography: Huge stencil capitals, one per paper tile, filling about half the poster in three rows, black on pale grey with a faint yellow offset shadow; a loose handwritten lowercase credit in white at the bottom right. Typography is built into the grid and matches the photos' tile shape.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with warm sepia, brown and dusty cream; dim, dusty documentary light.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Story it suggests: A community of strikers and families seen face by face, pressed together in a hard-fought standoff.
0334_harlan-county-usa.jpg.Visual idea: A bulletin board of letter tiles and faces suggests a collective, where words and people are the same material.

0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.People: A woman shown from face to chest, hand at chin, gazing off to the left with worried eyes while holding what looks like a telephone receiver; another blond head partly visible at the far right edge. Seen through vertical bars.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Composition: Strict vertical rhythm: a black arrow rising from the lower left, white title block at center, and the photo cut by white vertical slits into strips. Upper third is empty white.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Medium: Flat blue duotone photograph combined with solid black ink shapes and white paper; clean offset-print look.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Typography: Bold black heavy sans capitals, ELEVATOR over GALLOWS, set tight across the width of the poster, with a small sans credit above and a tiny rotated word along the left; tightly stacked and aligned to the arrow.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Color and light: Cyan-blue and black on white; cool, hard studio light.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman waiting by a phone, trapped and anxious, while something rises or stalls out of her reach.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Visual idea: The arrow and vertical strips turn the poster into a shaft or cage, literalizing the title.
0335_elevator-to-the-gallows.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s European noir, modernist Swiss-graphic and jazz-era cool.

0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.People: Five small circular portraits and a group of four teens in shorts, scattered on the poster: young people smiling, smoking, posing or sleeping with headphones. They are small, separate bubbles with no obvious relation.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Composition: All-over dense composition with letters filling the center and circles floating around like stickers; no clear empty space, the photos orbit the title.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn black marker doodles with red marker fills and blue outlines, plus printed circular photo stickers and star shapes; flat saturated ink with dotted shading.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Typography: Gigantic hand-drawn bubble letters, red with blue outline, stacked in two lines and covering nearly the whole poster, tilted and wobbly; a small cursive credit at the top. The letters interlock with doodles and photo circles.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Color and light: Red, blue and white with purple and yellow touches; bright, flat, playful.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Story it suggests: A chaotic day of kids hanging out, disoriented and drifting between friends and parties.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Visual idea: A school notebook doodle that turns the title into the mood; the photo stickers read as yearbook stickers.
0336_dazed-and-confused.jpg.Feels like: 1970s teen-comedy nostalgia drawn in early-1990s doodle-poster style.

0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.People: A young woman with tousled hair lying on her side, head propped on her hand, looking glumly to the camera; a bare-chested man's torso fills the lower half in foreground, with a faint head at left. Two people framed in tight, intimate crop.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Composition: Face at upper right third, a big horizontal diagonal torso across the bottom, thin rule lines at top and below the title; title sits at the bottom.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color film still with heavy visible grain, warm skin tones.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Typography: Small, lightweight lowercase sans in white across the bottom, spanning most of the width, plain and low-key; a thin white rule line above and below. Text sits over the bottom of the image without effect.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Color and light: Warm peach and olive-green with creamy white; soft indoor light.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Story it suggests: A bored, unsatisfied girl in a bed with a man who is not looking at her.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Visual idea: The proximity of bodies contrasts with her distant gaze.
0337_a-nos-amours.jpg.Feels like: Early-1980s French drama, intimate and naturalistic.

0338_equinox.jpg.People: A giant shaggy monster with fangs towers over the top and left, reaching down with claws; below at right two running men and a hooded face. The monster is huge versus tiny running figures.
0338_equinox.jpg.Composition: Diagonal sweep of the monster from top center to lower left, huge title across the middle, small running figures at the lower right; dense and packed with energy bursts at the edges.
0338_equinox.jpg.Medium: Halftone-dotted four-color comic print with rough black line work and misregistered color; ink feels like pulp paperback.
0338_equinox.jpg.Typography: Enormous white dripping, ragged letters spanning the full width in the middle, outlined in red and black; the letters look like melted wax or slime and overlap the monster's body.
0338_equinox.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange-yellow and red with teal-green and black; hot, lurid, comic-book light.
0338_equinox.jpg.Story it suggests: People run in panic from a looming beast.
0338_equinox.jpg.Visual idea: A pulp comic cover where the monster literally overshadows the title.
0338_equinox.jpg.Feels like: 1970s horror paperback and drive-in monster comic.

0339_yi-yi.jpg.People: One young boy seen from behind, from the shoulders up and down to the lower back, filling most of the poster. His face is hidden; his short dark hair and ears are visible, and he faces a red curtain. Pink balloons crowd around him at both sides.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Composition: Strictly centered and nearly symmetrical, with the boy's head at the middle top and a white rectangular title box in the middle of his dark jacket. Red curtain folds make vertical stripes behind, and pink balloons at the left and right edges frame him.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism, a clean sharp studio-like photograph with natural skin and fabric detail; flat white thin-line typography overlaid.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Typography: Small, centered white serif capitals YI over YI, stacked inside a thin white rectangular frame placed on the back of the jacket, so it works like a label or a name tag; a spaced sans credit line sits at the bottom center. The type is quiet and typeset.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Color and light: Deep curtain red, soft candy pink and very dark brown-black, with soft even light that looks like a stage or a party.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Story it suggests: A child stands facing a curtain, turned away from us, at the edge of some performance or celebration, and we cannot see what he feels.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Visual idea: A back view that withholds the face makes the viewer wonder what the boy is looking at; the title box on his back turns him into a mark or a name.
0339_yi-yi.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary arthouse, quiet, formal and composed, with the look of a portrait photograph.

0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.People: One gorilla in side profile, upper body, chin resting on its fist in a thinking pose, looking up and left; sign-language hand icons overlay the lower part.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Composition: Photographic cut-out gorilla sitting centered on a cream field, cropped abruptly in a hard rectangle at the bottom, with title and credit stacked beneath; the animal points up-left.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with grainy texture printed on warm cream paper, with thin outline line icons.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Typography: Large heavy sans KOKO in black across the full width at the bottom, letterspaced, with smaller spaced subtitle and credit below; rows of small hand-sign icons spell the words, repeating the title in outline form.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Color and light: Black and warm beige-cream; soft, even studio light.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Story it suggests: An animal that seems to think and speak, contemplating like a philosopher.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Visual idea: Hand-sign icons replace letters, making the gorilla's thought visible as text.
0340_koko-a-talking-gorilla.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary documentary about animal intelligence, vintage science-book feel.

0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.People: One young woman in green blouse seen from waist up, looking up and off to the right with a hopeful expression, one hand holding a bag strap; tiny soldiers and a distant town far below.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Composition: Figure at right third, large title top left; diagonal light rays fall from the upper left over the countryside; a small cathedral town sits on the left horizon.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Medium: Soft painted illustration with brush texture in digital or gouache style, airy blurred edges.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Typography: Very large tall condensed white serif title with elegant art-deco flourishes stacked over two lines, spanning most of the width at top; small credit in a light serif at the bottom. The word TALE drops below and overlaps the sky.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Color and light: Pale slate grey sky with pale golden sunlight and a bright fresh green blouse; hazy, hopeful light.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman walks through wartime countryside toward a distant town, with a quiet sense of pilgrimage.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Visual idea: Light breaking through clouds blesses the path, a gentle homage to 1940s poster painting.
0341_a-canterbury-tale.jpg.Feels like: 1940s British wartime pastoral film poster look.

0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.People: Six film stills of mostly young adults in portraits and couples: a man and woman at a table, a girl with a lighter, a woman reclining on bed, a couple holding hands, a woman smoking, a man looking down. Mostly one or two people in close or half-body frames.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical: a row of three photos at the top, a row of three at the bottom, with cream paper strips and a big white band holding the title in the middle; strongly horizontal layers.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Medium: Mix of black-and-white and faded color photographic stills with grain, plus textured cream paper strips.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Typography: Small, letter-spaced black serif capitals in two lines at center, modest in size, with ample white space; typeset and understated.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Color and light: White and cream with sepia, grey and muted warm skin tones; soft natural light.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Story it suggests: Six different stories of attraction and hesitation between ordinary people, glimpsed in quiet moments.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Visual idea: A deck of index cards or contact sheet: one title, six faces, equal weight.
0342_six-moral-tales.jpg.Feels like: 1960s-70s French New Wave literary cinema, restrained and intellectual.

0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.People: One young man at the center-right seen from the side and back, half body, turning to look ahead on a tree-lined street; tiny passers-by and parked cars far behind.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Composition: A cream paper card sits over a white field with the photo as a wide band across the lower half; card and photo overlap slightly, title text centered in the upper half, large white margins. The man sits in the lower third, with a diagonal row of trees behind him.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned black-and-white photograph with fine grain and slight overexposure, paired with a textured paper card.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish. No ornament, ink-on-paper feel.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Color and light: Cream, grey and soft sepia; dappled sunlight through leaves.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man pauses on a Paris sidewalk, looking for someone or something just out of frame.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Visual idea: The index-card title and snapshot photo suggest a notebook entry, keeping the voice detached.
0343_the-bakery-girl-of-monceau.jpg.Feels like: Early-1960s French New Wave, observational and light.

0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.People: One woman lying back with head resting against someone's lap, seen in profile with eyes looking upward, bare foot propped on a rail; a man's hand rests on her head and another arm lies across the foreground. Two people, one only partly seen.

The woman reclines diagonally from lower left to right, with water in the background.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Medium: Soft black-and-white photograph with fine grain, sandy and pale; textured paper card.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Color and light: Silver-grey and cream with sepia; bright sunlit reflective glare off water.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman lounging by the water while others hover over her, at ease and indifferent.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Visual idea: A seaside snapshot pinned below a card as if a case file.
0344_suzanne-s-career.jpg.Feels like: Early-1960s French New Wave, summery and offhand.

0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.People: One man lying propped on a couch under a fur blanket, arms crossed on his chest and one hand at chin, glancing sideways with a wary face; a phone sits on a dresser behind him.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Composition: A cream paper card sits over a white field with the photo as a wide band across the lower half; card and photo overlap slightly, title text centered in the upper half, large white margins. The man lies diagonally low in frame with a vase and telephone on the right.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with grain and slightly muddy contrast; paper-textured card above.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Color and light: Warm grey and cream; dim indoor night-lamp light.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Story it suggests: A man, ill at ease and awake in an unfamiliar room, waiting for something to happen.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Visual idea: The photo shows a man literally put on hold, with a phone he doesn't touch.
0345_my-night-at-maud-s.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s French New Wave chamber drama, talky and intimate.

0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.People: A shirtless man in an unbuttoned shirt reclining on a stone balustrade smoking, and a woman or girl seated on a deck chair in the foreground talking on a phone. Two figures separated by a wall, medium-wide.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Composition: A cream paper card sits over a white field with the photo as a wide band across the lower half; card and photo overlap slightly, title text centered in the upper half, large white margins. The man lies on a diagonal across the balcony wall in the upper half, the woman below, a doorway frames both sides.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Medium: Faded color film still with warm grain and soft hazy tones; paper-textured card above.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Color and light: Golden olive-green, warm terracotta and soft blue-gray; hazy late-afternoon sunlight.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Story it suggests: A lazy summer day at a villa, with two people sharing a terrace but not their attention.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Visual idea: A frame within a frame: open doors, balcony and wall layer the figures at different depths.
0346_la-collectionneuse.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s French Riviera summer leisure drama, languid and sensual.

0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.People: A young woman in extreme close-up wearing a large wavy straw hat, long hair falling past her cheeks, looking directly at the viewer with a calm, level gaze; a knee is visible at the bottom.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Composition: A cream paper card sits over a white field with the photo as a wide band across the lower half; card and photo overlap slightly, title text centered in the upper half, large white margins. The face sits at the center-bottom, the hat brim sweeping to both sides.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with fine grain, crisp contrast; paper texture on the card.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Color and light: Silver-grey and cream; bright direct outdoor light with soft shadow beneath the brim.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl in a hat meeting the camera's gaze in the open sun, composed and unreadable.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Visual idea: The wavy hat brim frames the face like a lens.
0347_claire-s-knee.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s French New Wave summer film, sun-washed and observational.

0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.People: Two people in tight embrace seen mostly from behind; a man with dark hair has his face pressed to the bare shoulder of a woman whose arm wraps around his neck. A close, half-body crop.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Composition: A cream paper card sits over a white field with the photo as a wide band across the lower half; card and photo overlap slightly, title text centered in the upper half, large white margins. The embrace fills the lower half, heads placed left, arm sweeping diagonally across.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Medium: Faded color film still with soft warm grain; paper texture on card.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Typography: Title in small, widely letter-spaced black serif capitals centered on a cream paper card, two short lines, with a small roman numeral above the card; quiet, typeset and bookish.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Color and light: Muted teal-grey wall, warm flesh pink and brown; soft, even indoor daylight.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Story it suggests: A hesitant embrace with the man's eyes looking aside, as though torn.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Visual idea: Warm skin in the picture contrasts with the cold, formal card.
0348_love-in-the-afternoon.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s French romance, tender and uneasy.

0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.People: No people shown; only speech bubbles, which act as stand-ins for voices.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Composition: All-over field of linked oval speech bubbles on green, stacked in a loose column; the title bubbles run diagonally down the center, with bubbles of dialogue crowding both sides.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Medium: Watercolor and ink on paper: mottled green wash, thin white hand-drawn outlines, and maroon and red ink fills in the title bubbles.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Typography: Title in big hand-lettered wobbly capitals, dark maroon in cream bubbles, with the credit in red bubbles; all other text is smaller white handwritten caps in green bubbles. The lettering is the picture, and each phrase has its own bubble.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Color and light: Olive green with cream, plum and red accents; flat, even paper light.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Story it suggests: A chatter of witty, anxious conversations that fills the air among people who can't leave.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Visual idea: The whole poster is overheard dialogue, with the title as the loudest voice among many.
0349_kicking-and-screaming.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1990s American indie talk-comedy, quirky and literary.

0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.People: Three drawn figures: a huge sweating man with a mustache and wide, panicked eyes in extreme close-up at the bottom, a small man in a suit floating mid-air at left, and a woman in a dress falling or floating at right, grimacing. They seem to be spinning around him.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Composition: Concentric red rings radiate from the center behind a big face at the bottom; the two smaller figures hang in the upper left and right, the title block sits at the top as a black inverted trapezoid.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Medium: Flat comic-style ink drawing with thick black outlines, spot-color fills in tan and red, and hatching; clean vector or screenprint look.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Typography: Huge white condensed sans capitals stacked in a black trapezoid at the top, SEDUCED above ABANDONED, with a tiny AND between; a smaller black label box holds the credit. The type is oversized and compressed like a headline.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Color and light: Blood-red background with khaki-tan figures and black; flat, hot, graphic light.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Story it suggests: A nervous man stunned by a scandal while others spin out of control around him.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Visual idea: The red bullseye of rings makes him the target and the dizzying center of the scene.
0350_seduced-and-abandoned.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian satire poster rendered in modern retro comic style.

0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.People: Two small girls on railway tracks: one standing frontally holding a small case and looking directly at the viewer, the other crouched with her head against the rail at left. Both are shown full body, tiny against the empty plain. Inside the hexagon are childlike line drawings of two girls and a figure.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Composition: Strong one-point perspective down the tracks to the horizon; an orange hexagon with a child's drawing sits upper left, title strip crosses the hexagon; thin honeycomb patterns frame the top and bottom edges.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Medium: Faded sepia photograph, slightly overexposed like old print, with a smooth orange gradient hexagon and white childlike pen-line drawing; faint honeycomb pattern.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Typography: Tall thin black sans capitals in one wide line across the middle, partly overlapping the hexagon, with an elegant script credit above it. Type is spaced and light, set horizontally against the tracks.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Color and light: Pale cream and sepia with a warm amber hexagon; soft hazy daylight.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Story it suggests: Two children alone in a vast empty landscape, one listening to the rails, with something uncanny about to arrive.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Visual idea: A hive cell holding a child's drawing links the childhood imagination to the film's title.
0351_the-spirit-of-the-beehive.jpg.Feels like: 1970s Spanish art cinema, quiet and haunted.

0352_jigoku.jpg.People: No clear people; swirling red flames that contain faint hints of faces or bodies, ambiguously drawn.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Composition: Entire poster covered by the flame drawing in a dense central mass, rising in tongues to the top right; title across the lower third in huge letters partly behind the flames.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Medium: Red ink and watercolor brushwork with fine line contours over rough orange paper texture and dust speckles; woodblock-like look.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Typography: Huge muted tan sans capitals JIGOKU across the lower width, the J and the U cut off at the edges, with a smaller spaced white serif credit across the middle; letters seem laid on top of the red flames in a translucent finish.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange paper with crimson reds; fiery, warm, smoky light.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Story it suggests: A world consumed by fire, with torment implied by the flickering shapes.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Visual idea: The flames are so large that they become the entire world, and the title is half engulfed.
0352_jigoku.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s Japanese horror, with traditional hell-scroll imagery.

0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.People: A bearded man's face at upper left, a woman's face looking at the viewer at lower right in high-contrast graphic form, plus a cupid with bow in the lower middle. Figures are small, cut-out and scattered.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Composition: Radial scatter of motifs around a central title: skyscraper at left, long strips (tickets or film), moons, planes, cupid, cactus at right; title arranged in a stacked block with red arrows.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Medium: Flat printed collage: screenprint-like high-contrast black cut-outs with spot colors, confetti dots, and rough marker lines.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn, jagged black capitals in three stacked lines at center, with thin red arrows pointing left and right through them; the credit curves in an arc above. Letters are irregular and hand-cut.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Color and light: Mint green with black, red, light blue and tiny pastel dots; flat, graphic, festive.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Story it suggests: A romantic mix-up of a man, lovers and airplanes where love is a game of arrows and chance.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Visual idea: Everything points at everything else; Cupid's arrows and red arrows make the poster a wiring diagram of attraction.
0353_solo-con-tu-pareja.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s Latin American comedy graphic, pop and collage-like.

0354_clean-shaven.jpg.People: One man in giant close-up, face tilted downward, eyes cast low, wearing a blue checked shirt and dark tie; the face fills most of the poster. A small landscape band repeats above and below.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical sandwich: landscape strips top and bottom, giant face in the center, black horizontal bars cutting across at the neck and forehead; title bottom-right.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Medium: Overexposed, grainy color film still with scratchy black bars and ink texture; photographic.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Typography: Heavy black stencil-like capitals CLEAN, SHAVEN in the lower right, with a comma, stamped and uneven; small spaced serif credit at the top right. The type is blunt and rough, set under the face.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Color and light: Bleached white, pale pink skin and blue checks with green landscape; harsh, bright overexposed light.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Story it suggests: A troubled man staring down at himself, cut off from the rural world around him.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Visual idea: The face is split by black bars like a cut or scratch across a film frame.
0354_clean-shaven.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s independent Canadian film, raw and psychological.

0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.People: Two repeated faces of a smiling man in a suit on torn election posters at the bottom, in coarse high-contrast black-and-white; the same face appears twice side by side. No other people.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Composition: Top half is a black city map filling the field with the street grid curved at the upper right; the title in a black rectangle sits at center with a pale blue credit box, and a double-poster collage in the lower half.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Medium: Black ink on white halftone and photocopied texture; torn paper, stenciled spray look.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Typography: Bold white condensed sans in a black label at center, with a pale-blue box below carrying the credit, and cropped sans text VOTA NOTT... along the bottom as part of the poster image. Typeset boxes overlay the collage.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with a pale blue block; harsh, flat graphic light.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Story it suggests: A face smiling from posters hides the political deals that reshape a city.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Visual idea: The map and the repeated face form a collage of urban grid and political advertising.
0355_hands-over-the-city.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian political drama, protest-poster collage style.

0356_sweetie.jpg.People: A woman's face and dark hair in extreme close-up at upper right, face tilted down so only an eye, cheek and smile are visible; below, three small toy horses on a table.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Composition: Split horizontally: warm orange upper half with the cropped face; dark blue lower half with the toy horses; the title straddles the seam between them.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color photographic still on top with shallow depth of field; a glossy macro still life of plastic toys below.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Typography: Large white flowing calligraphic script across the middle, partially broken and scratched at points, spanning most of the width; a small spaced white sans credit sits just below. The script lies across both halves like a ribbon.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange and deep navy blue with white; warm indoor glow above, cool dim light below.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl's private mood and play world, tender but slightly off, with broken toys hinting at damage.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Visual idea: Warm human face above, cold toy horses below, with the broken script bridging the two.
0356_sweetie.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s Australian arthouse, intimate and quirky.

0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.People: One figure, a child, shown only as the top of a head and one eye peeking out from the bottom center. The face is cropped by the frame edge and half hidden behind a dark vertical gap in the curtains.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Composition: Tall vertical stripes of curtain folds fill the whole frame, with a black vertical slot right of center. The title stack sits top center and the small peeking head sits bottom center, leaving a large gray empty field between them.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with soft film grain and smooth gray tonal gradations. Flat white lettering is overlaid on top.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Typography: Huge bold white sans-serif 'FALLEN IDOL' stacked on two lines, taking up about a third of the poster height, with a small italic script 'The' above it and a small caps credit line below. Typeset, clean, sitting over the curtain without breaking it.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with a pure black slot and white type. Soft, even interior light with the eye catching a small highlight.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Story it suggests: A child secretly watches something from behind a curtain, seeing more than he should.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Visual idea: Peeking through a gap: the viewer shares the child's furtive point of view, and the black slot works like a keyhole.
0357_the-fallen-idol.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century British black-and-white suspense drama, in a modern restrained reissue layout.

0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.People: One woman, tight half-body close-up with a frontal face, lifting a sheer dark veil over her head with both hands. She looks straight out at the viewer.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical, centered portrait with raised arms forming a triangle around the face. Name at the very top and a huge title at the bottom, with the face centered between them.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with fine grain and glossy highlights on the satin clothing and lips. Crisp white letters are laid over the image.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Typography: Very large thin high-contrast Didone-style capitals in white. 'PANDORA'S' spans the full width and 'BOX' is even bigger, its O forming a circle that holds the small credit text. The letters overlap the figure's dark clothing and the top name touches the logo.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Color and light: Silver and charcoal grays with deep blacks. Dramatic studio spotlight on the pale face with a soft gradient background.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Story it suggests: A magnetic, knowing woman unveils herself with a cool stare, hinting at temptation and trouble.
0358_pandora-s-box.jpg.Visual idea: The veil frames the face like an opening box lid, and the O of BOX is a circle echoing the head.

0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.People: One young woman, half-body close-up, head tilted with eyes closed and a hand pressed to her hair. She appears dreamy and withdrawn.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Composition: The face sits center-right with two translucent spheres stacked vertically above and below it, forming a loose figure-eight along a vertical axis. Dark empty area fills the lower left and the title sits at bottom right.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Medium: Color film still with grain and soft focus. The two glassy bubbles are overlaid transparent circles that distort what is behind them.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized bold sans-serif title at the bottom right, printed twice with an offset: an orange-yellow copy and a ghosted gray striped copy slightly shifted so letters overlap and double. Typeset with a halftone-like stripe texture.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Color and light: Murky gold, olive and amber against black. Warm low autumn-like light filtering through bare trees.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman lost in private reverie, as if sensing a double or echo of herself.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Visual idea: Doubling: the two spheres and the doubled title express two selves or mirrored lives.
0359_the-double-life-of-veronique.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s European art film, dreamy and melancholic.

0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.People: About a dozen people lying and sitting on grass in a group, plus one man walking at lower right, all seen small from above. A film crew with a camera on tripod is among them.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Composition: The photo is rotated sideways and set in a frame offset to the right, with a cream column on the left. A red polygonal wire network connects the people across the image, and a cream band at the bottom holds the title.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Medium: Color snapshot photograph with an overlaid flat red vector line drawing. Flat cream solid ink panels frame it.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Typography: Long lowercase thin sans-serif title across the bottom, large and left-aligned, over a smaller spaced gray caps subtitle. Typeset, clean, dark gray on cream, outside the photograph.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Color and light: Bright green grass, bright red lines, faded 1970s color and cream. Flat daylight.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Story it suggests: A casual outdoor gathering of a crew, with the lines hinting at hidden connections between the people.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Visual idea: The red graph links people like a network or constellation, turning a snapshot into a diagram of relationships.
0360_symbiopsychotaxiplasm-two-takes-by-.Feels like: Experimental 1970s documentary, in a contemporary graphic treatment.

0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.People: Two elderly women pose close together in front of a shingled house, one seated behind in yellow and the other crouched in front with a headscarf. Strips at top and bottom show smaller photos of men with cameras and handwritten signs.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Composition: A central color photo is sandwiched between two black contact-sheet strips with sprocket holes, creating frames within a frame. The women sit right of center, with the title at left.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Medium: Color photograph surrounded by black-and-white contact sheet frames with grease-pencil check marks and visible film edge markings. Textured, distressed lettering.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Typography: Medium-large blocky sans-serif title in two lines, 'THE BEALES OF' in yellow and 'GREY GARDENS' in white, placed at the left over the wall and slightly rough-textured. A small credit block sits underneath.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Color and light: Faded yellow, purple and weathered gray-brown wood. Flat daylight, slightly washed 1970s color.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Story it suggests: Two eccentric women look back at the camera, aware of being filmed in their decaying home.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Visual idea: The contact sheet reveals the making of the film, showing the crew and the subjects looking at each other.
0361_the-beales-of-grey-gardens.jpg.Feels like: 1970s direct-cinema documentary, with a scrapbook feel.

0362_border-radio.jpg.People: Three separate small photos: a man in a cowboy hat reading a newspaper, a tiny silhouetted figure standing by a beach fire, and a woman on a phone. All are different scales and not interacting.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Composition: A collage of three rectangular photos arranged diagonally, from top left to bottom center, over a white background with faint gray tangled pylon lines. A large purple signpost shape at right carries credits.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographs with grain, plus flat solid purple and sage green cutout shapes and a pale line drawing of a power tower.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Typography: Big bold white sans-serif 'BORDER RADIO' across the middle, half over the top photo and half over the purple signpost, with the letters cut where they overlap. Credits are in a quirky hand-lettered uneven font on the sign.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Color and light: Gray, white, dusty purple and sage green. Flat, matte, with the desert sun in the photos.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Story it suggests: Drifters in different places connected loosely by signals and travel.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Visual idea: A road signpost and radio tower collage: fragments scattered like transmissions crossing a landscape.
0362_border-radio.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American indie road film, zine-like punk collage.

0363_mouchette.jpg.People: One young girl in a tight close-up from the shoulders up, in profile with a downcast gaze to the right. Her hair is tied in ribbons.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Composition: A centered, slightly left-weighted portrait filling the frame. Title and credit sit at the bottom over her clothing.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic portrait with visible grain and soft focus in the background field. Flat yellow type on top.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Typography: Medium-size pale yellow serif title 'Mouchette' at the lower center, with a small credit line above in white. Typeset, slightly irregular and sitting on the textured sweater.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome with a single pale yellow accent. Soft, flat daylight.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary, serious child stares away, withdrawn from the world around her.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Visual idea: An unadorned face carrying all the emotion, with the one yellow word as the only color.
0363_mouchette.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art cinema, austere and humanist.

0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.People: One huge central drawn face of a scowling gray-haired man, plus a tiny astronaut, a hand holding a knife, and a hand with a saw in surrounding panels. The figures are drawings, not photos.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Composition: A tilted, irregular patchwork of five or six angular comic-like panels around a central face panel, with title text on a black band above the face. Each panel holds a separate scene and a small caption.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Medium: Loose gouache and ink illustration with visible brush texture, rough black ink lines and a cardboard-like paper grain. Flat color planes are scribbled over by sketchy outlines.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Typography: Large lowercase italic serif title 'monsters and madmen', gray 'monsters' above a white-and-black 'and madmen' with slightly overlapping letters. Small bold sans-serif caps labels sit inside each panel. Typeset, crowded into the center band.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, navy, teal, mustard and brown with acid yellow-green highlights. Flat poster-color with no real light source.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Story it suggests: Several separate pulp tales of terror and space adventure bundled together around one menacing face.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Visual idea: A comic-page collage where each panel advertises one film in the set and the central glaring face ties them together.
0364_monsters-and-madmen.jpg.Feels like: 1950s B-movie pulp advertising, recreated as modern retro illustration.

0365_first-man-into-space.jpg.People: One large hulking figure in a bulky space suit with a dark faceless head, facing front. Six small bystanders in outline, including a woman with a hand to her mouth and uniformed men, stand behind him looking alarmed.

0365_first-man-into-space.jpg.Typography: Big white chunky Gothic-flavored capitals with flared serifs, 'FIRST MAN' and 'SPACE' large and 'INTO' tiny in between, stacked at the upper left and slightly overlapping stars and the rocket. Typeset and decorative.
0365_first-man-into-space.jpg.Color and light: Purple-indigo sky, electric blue ground, acid green floor and orange accents. Stylized flat color with a spotlight feel on the green floor.

0366_the-atomic-submarine.jpg.Typography: Very large slanted white lettering with jagged, shaky edges and an orange offset shadow, 'THE ATOMIC SUBMARINE' running across the middle. The letters tilt upward to the right and hang in front of the tentacles.
0366_the-atomic-submarine.jpg.Color and light: Teal, blue-green and acid lime with black and orange accents. A pale beam of light from the eye gives an eerie glow.
0366_the-atomic-submarine.jpg.Story it suggests: A submarine is caught under the gaze of a giant alien creature in the deep.
0366_the-atomic-submarine.jpg.Visual idea: An eye and spiral as a hypnotic watcher looming over the small sub.

0367_the-haunted-strangler.jpg.People: A pale, red-tinted woman drawn in outline floating diagonally, mouth open in fright. A huge animal-like face (cat-like eye and whiskers) fills the background, and two tiny cloaked figures with a lantern and a shovel stand in a graveyard at the bottom.

0367_the-haunted-strangler.jpg.Typography: Giant white speckled, spattered capitals 'THE HAUNTED STRANGLER' stacked across the top, with splatter and ink dots eating into the letters. Hand-drawn feeling and sits over the image.
0367_the-haunted-strangler.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, blood red, navy black and white with pale pink. Sinister glow with no clear source.

0367_the-haunted-strangler.jpg.Visual idea: The terror is built from a huge giant face behind the victim, as if the whole page is a nightmare.

0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.People: One large drawn face made from the whole image: wide red-rimmed bloodshot eyes with bushy brows, a beaker as a cheek and a smoking cup as the mouth. Hands and a saw sit at the edges.
0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.Composition: A frontal, nearly symmetrical face composed of laboratory objects (flasks, bottles, a saw, a flame). The title sits at the top in two lines above the eyes.

0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.Typography: Giant chunky orange-yellow lettering with a thick black outline and a wavy, bubbly edge, 'CORRIDORS OF' small above 'BLOOD' huge. Hand-drawn feel and covers much of the top of the face.
0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.Color and light: Rust red and brown with gray, pale blue, orange and mustard accents. Flat color with a candle flame glow.
0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.Story it suggests: A mad experimenter peers out from a laboratory of dangerous potions and instruments.
0368_corridors-of-blood.jpg.Visual idea: The face is assembled from lab equipment, merging the man with his experiments.

0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.People: One man in a dark suit and tie, three-quarter body, leaning forward with a slight smile and looking at the camera. He fills the upper two thirds of the poster.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Composition: A centered, slightly diagonal portrait with the figure rising from the bottom, and the title block set over the lower dark area. A list of titles is set in a centered list at the bottom.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with a warm sepia tone, soft focus and a smooth gradient. Gold engraved-style lettering over it.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Typography: Gold Victorian-style Tuscan serif capitals, 'PAUL ROBESON' large and 'PORTRAITS OF THE ARTIST' below in bold inline letters, separated by a thin ornamental rule. Small centered film titles beneath in lighter tracked caps.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Color and light: Brown-black, warm gray and antique gold. Soft studio light from the upper left with deep shadow on the face.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Story it suggests: A dignified portrait of a performer presented as a collected body of work.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Visual idea: A formal portrait with ornate old-style lettering, like a theater bill or a monument.
0369_paul-robeson-portraits-of-the-artis.Feels like: 1930s studio portrait with a refined archival boxed-set look.

0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.People: One man, an extreme close-up cropped at the right edge showing half a face from forehead to cheek, with one eye looking out in shadow.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Composition: The face occupies the right half and the left half is a flat taupe field. Title text is centered across the middle over the boundary, with the eye low at the bottom.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned photograph with deep shadow and soft focus, with fine gold engraved-style lettering and ornamental rule.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Typography: Gold Victorian serif capitals, 'PAUL ROBESON' large with a thin ornamental line below, 'ICON' in bold inline caps, and smaller lines of titles below. Centered and crossing from light into dark, lower contrast over the face.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Color and light: Warm brown, taupe and dark chocolate with gold. Dim, low-key light that leaves most of the face in shadow.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet, intense gaze emerging from darkness, suggesting a person larger than the frame.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Visual idea: The half-cropped face conveys a monumental icon, with the single eye as the point of contact.
0370_the-emperor-jones.jpg.Feels like: 1930s portrait photography, in a refined archival style.

0371_body-and-soul.jpg.People: One man shown as an extreme close-up cropped through the middle of his face: dark hair, one eye and an ear, with the right side of the face cut off by a gray field.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Composition: The face fills the left two thirds and bleeds off the left edge, with a flat gray area at right. The title block is centered across the middle and the eye sits low at left.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned black-and-white photograph, soft and grainy with deep shadows. Gold engraved-style lettering is laid over it.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Typography: Gold Victorian Tuscan serif caps, 'PAUL ROBESON' large with an ornamental rule below, then bold inline 'OUTSIDER' and two smaller film titles separated by a vertical bar. Centered and crossing from face into gray with low contrast.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Color and light: Dark brown-black, olive gray and tarnished gold. Low-key, dim light.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Story it suggests: A watchful gaze half hidden in shadow suggests someone apart from the room around him.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Visual idea: The cropped face and the word OUTSIDER suggest standing at the edge of the frame.
0371_body-and-soul.jpg.Feels like: 1930s portrait photography in a refined archival box-set style.

0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.People: One man, extremely cropped to the lower half of his face: a nose tip, mouth and chin at upper right, then a dark body. He is only partly visible.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Composition: The face fragment sits at top right, with a diagonal light-gray shoulder line crossing from upper left and a large black empty area at the bottom. The title block runs across the center.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Medium: Sepia-tinged black-and-white photograph with smooth gradients and film-like softness. Gold engraved-style type on top.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Typography: Gold Victorian serif caps 'PAUL ROBESON' with an ornamental line, bold inline 'PIONEER' beneath and two small titles separated by a bar. Centered, low contrast where it crosses the shadow.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal black, mid gray and dull gold. Strong side light leaving most of the frame dark.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Story it suggests: A person is revealed only in fragments, suggesting presence without a full view.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Visual idea: The mouth fragment stands for a voice, with the large black space below it holding the type.
0372_sanders-of-the-river.jpg.Feels like: 1930s studio portrait photography, in a refined archival style.

0373_the-proud-valley.jpg.People: One man, cropped to a smiling mouth and chin at the upper left and a tweed jacket and white collar beneath. His eyes are out of the frame.

0373_the-proud-valley.jpg.Typography: Gold Victorian serif caps 'PAUL ROBESON', an ornamental rule, then 'CITIZEN of the WORLD' in inline caps with a small italic 'of the', and two film titles. Centered, low contrast over the lapel.
