0373_the-proud-valley.jpg.Story it suggests: A warm, unseen smile above a formal coat suggests a gracious public figure.
0373_the-proud-valley.jpg.Visual idea: A cropped smile and a suit's texture stand in for the whole person.
0373_the-proud-valley.jpg.Feels like: 1930s studio portrait photography, in a refined archival style.

0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.People: One man in a tight half-body close-up, in a brimmed hat, looking away to the right with a hard, worried expression. His shoulders fill the lower frame.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Composition: The face is slightly right of center. The huge word 'BICYCLE' runs across the top and 'THIEVES' across the bottom, so the figure is sandwiched between two heavy bars of type.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Medium: Gritty black-and-white photograph toned sepia, with film grain, scratches and a slightly cut-out look against the street behind him. Flat white type.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Typography: Enormous white condensed slab-like sans capitals taking about half the poster height, 'BICYCLE' cut off at the top with the logo overlapping the B and 'THIEVES' running through the jacket. A small mustard-orange credit sits at left. Typeset, heavy, and overlapped by his hat.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Color and light: Sepia, cream and black with mustard-orange accents. Hard natural daylight with shadow cutting across the face.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Story it suggests: A working man scans the street anxiously, as if something vital has gone missing.
0374_bicycle-thieves.jpg.Visual idea: The words pressed against the figure from above and below box him in.

0375_green-for-danger.jpg.People: Several faces drawn in stylized pieces: four partial faces with only eyes visible above surgical masks and caps, plus a tiny silhouette of a hatted man in a white circle at lower left.
0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Composition: A tilted black square at center with the eyes poking from the edges, and a diagonal white operating-lamp shape holding the title. Strong diagonal movement from upper right to lower left.
0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Medium: Gouache-style flat painted illustration with a chalky, slightly grainy paper texture and crisp edges. Flat opaque ink areas.
0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Typography: Large heavy condensed sans capitals tilted about 20 degrees, 'GREEN FOR' in green and white on the lamp shape and 'DANGER' in black below it, with a small credit line along the bottom edge. Typeset, crossing the shapes and overlapped at the edges.

0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Story it suggests: Watchers in surgical masks surround something, with an unseen figure observed from below.
0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Visual idea: The masks reduce faces to eyes, turning suspicion into a pattern of glances.
0375_green-for-danger.jpg.Feels like: 1940s British mystery thriller poster, mid-century graphic illustration.

0376_49th-parallel.jpg.People: No people. A giant shadow of a swastika is cast across the map as the only symbol.

0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned photographic map texture with the shadow in dark brown, overlaid by flat cream and red-outlined letters.
0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Typography: Extremely tall condensed Didone-style cream letters with a thin red outline and offset, '49' taking more than half the height, 'th' small and 'PARALLEL' packed to the full width. 0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown and mustard with cream and deep red. Warm, low and ominous.
0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Story it suggests: A hostile threat looms over a map of a northern land.
0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Visual idea: The shadow of the emblem is laid across the map like a map of invasion, while the giant 49 becomes the geographic line itself.
0376_49th-parallel.jpg.Feels like: 1940s wartime adventure, in a bold propaganda-poster style.

0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.People: One woman in a kimono, full body, climbing a narrow staircase and glancing back down over her shoulder. She is seen from behind and below.

0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain and glowing, slightly lavender-tinted sign boxes. Crisp serif type on top.
0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.Typography: Medium-size elegant serif title in two lines, with 'When a Woman' in tan and white and 'ASCENDS THE STAIRS' in white and tan, plus Japanese characters in an ornamental frame and a small credit. Centered over the figure and darkness, sized to fit the stair width.
0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.Color and light: Deep black with white highlights, lavender glow in the signs and warm tan type. Night street light from neon with a bright upper doorway.

0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.Visual idea: The stairs and neon signs frame her ascent into work at night.
0377_when-a-woman-ascends-the-stairs.jpg.Feels like: Late 1950s Japanese nightlife drama, urban noir.

0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.People: One small standing figure on a rock crest looking down, plus several bodies lying on the slope below. The figures are small relative to the poster.

0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned black-and-white photograph with film grain, bleeding into a white sky with stained, smoky blotches. Letters have a faded gradient finish.
0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Typography: Large sans-serif 'FIRES' in a gradient from dark to pale gray, with 'ON THE PLAIN' smaller below and a small serif credit. Typeset, centered at the top in the white space, fading at the edges like smoke.
0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, ash gray and white with yellow smoke stains. Harsh overexposed daylight washing out the sky.
0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone survivor stands over the dead in a barren, scorched landscape.
0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Visual idea: The white void and faded letters mimic smoke and exhaustion, isolating one figure in an empty world.
0378_fires-on-the-plain.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s Japanese war drama, bleak and austere.

0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.People: One barefoot man in a draped robe, full body, walking straight toward the viewer with a small bird on his shoulder. Tiny figures of a crowd of soldiers are visible behind him in the far distance.
0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Composition: Central, vertically aligned figure on a plank path leading toward the viewer, with the horizon at mid-height. Title at the top in the white sky and a lot of open space around him.

0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Typography: Large sans-serif title, 'THE BURMESE' and 'HARP', with letters fading from black to pale gray, smoky at the edges, and a small serif credit below. Typeset, centered on the white sky and not touching the figure.
0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, cream white and olive brown with yellowish smoke. Hazy, flat daylight.
0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary man walks alone away from a distant crowd, carrying a quiet purpose.
0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Visual idea: The figure emerges from white mist as if from memory, apart from the small group behind him.
0379_the-burmese-harp.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese post-war drama, quiet and elegiac.

0380_the-naked-city.jpg.People: One man seen from behind as a black silhouette, standing on a bridge framework and looking down, holding a gun by his side. He is a dark mass in the lower left.

0382_overlord.jpg.People: One huge eye as an extreme close-up of a face at the top, and a crowd of dozens of tiny soldiers on a beach at the bottom. The soldiers are in groups, wading and walking.
0382_overlord.jpg.Composition: Two stacked halves: an enormous eye filling the upper half and a wide beach scene below, with the title at right between them. The eye is almost centered and the soldiers' line crosses the lower edge.
0382_overlord.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographs with film grain, the eye soft and the beach photo gritty, merged through a white fade. Crisp serif type.

0386_sansho-the-bailiff.jpg.Typography: Wide-spaced elegant serif, large 'Sansho' in white overlapping the dark silhouette, with 'THE BAILIFF' in small caps below and a small credit above; typeset, light and airy, centered.
0386_sansho-the-bailiff.jpg.Color and light: Sage grey-green ground, charcoal black ink and pale cream; flat, soft, muted light.
0386_sansho-the-bailiff.jpg.Story it suggests: A stern figure of authority stands over a quieter, fading human presence.
0386_sansho-the-bailiff.jpg.Visual idea: A brushstroke figure of power overlapping a ghostly face, ink versus memory.
0386_sansho-the-bailiff.jpg.Feels like: Classical Japanese cinema, 1950s, handled with refined modern minimalist design.

0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.People: Four separate image panels: a woman in a large black-and-white close-up with a finger at her nose, a woman in a headscarf looking sideways at the camera, three blond children linking arms on grass, and a group of white cat figurines. Each panel is a different subject with no shared scene.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Composition: A clean white grid: a wide landscape panel at top with the face on its right, the title in the middle band, then three smaller panels below, with the cats on the right as the largest. Plenty of white margin around each frame.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Medium: Photographic film stills: crisp black-and-white with grain on top, and faded, grainy color film in the lower panels. Flat white background.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Typography: Medium-size thin sans-serif caps in dark gray, 'LA JETEE | SANS SOLEIL' on one line separated by a vertical bar, with a small spaced credit below, right aligned. Typeset, clean, and sitting alone in white space between image blocks.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white on top, then saturated warm tones of orange, green and teal below, and bright white and red from the figurines. Flat natural daylight.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Story it suggests: Scattered glimpses of faces and places across times and countries, like memories being sorted.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Visual idea: A mosaic of unrelated fragments, laid out like a contact sheet, suggesting memory as a collage.
0387_la-jetee-sans-soleil.jpg.Feels like: 1960s to 1980s European essay-film, minimalist art-house layout.

0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.People: Two figures: a young boy with a bowl haircut and a large older man with a mustache in a flat cap, seated close with the man's arm around the boy's shoulders. They are shown from the chest up. The boy looks straight out and the man looks off-camera with a gentle smile.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Composition: The pair fills the top two thirds as a tightly cropped photo block with a thin white margin around it. A white lower panel holds the title off-center right, and a gray stripe peeks at the very bottom edge.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with soft film grain and gentle contrast. A handwritten brown ink lettering sits on a flat white panel.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Typography: Handwritten lowercase brown script title 'the two of us' of moderate size placed right of center, with a smaller script credit below. Hand-lettered, unframed, completely outside the photograph.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Color and light: Soft grays and whites with a single brown ink for the text. Gentle, even indoor light.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Story it suggests: An old man and a small boy form an affectionate but uneasy bond.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Visual idea: The man's arm wrapped around the boy shows closeness, while the handwritten title adds an intimate, personal touch.
0388_the-two-of-us.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French human drama, warm and nostalgic.

0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.People: About a dozen faces and arms in a symmetrical collage: two large profile faces turn inward at mid-height, a red-haired woman is repeated mirror-style holding up frames, an older man peers from a central arch, and babies, shouting faces and hands fill the bottom. The figures are cut-out photo fragments rather than one scene, and many are doubled or mirrored.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Composition: Strict left-right mirror symmetry around a vertical axis, stacked in tiers from a hanging scale at the top to a half-circle at the bottom. Raised arms form a V shape and the huge title sits dead center as the hinge of the layout.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Medium: Photographic cutouts collaged and duotone-tinted, with a mottled paper-like background and coarse grain. Cut edges and layered pieces give a physical paste-up look.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Typography: Chunky white slab-serif title letters, very large and centered across the middle third, with a thick black outline and drop edge, sitting on top of the figures. A smaller white outlined condensed subtitle sits below and a small hand-cut-looking credit line sits at the top.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Color and light: Muted teal, mustard, pink-mauve and olive over a dusty sage ground, flat with no real light source; black-and-white faces tinted by color.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Story it suggests: Bodies, faces and family fragments are weighed and mirrored as if someone is examining human nature as a specimen.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Visual idea: A mirrored symmetric collage built around a weighing scale, turning people into balanced, mirrored specimens.
0389_wr-mysteries-of-the-organism.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s/70s European art-house and political-satire poster, psychedelic-surrealist collage.

0390_sweet-movie.jpg.People: One large woman shown from the side, torso and midriff crop, wearing a lace bonnet and lace-trimmed underclothes; her face is partly veiled and cropped at the top left. She is the only visible figure and fills most of the frame.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Composition: Full-bleed photo with the figure on the left two-thirds, a dark dotted background on the right, and a diagonal sweep of the title from left to right over her body. Drips fall vertically from the title and from black blobs at top and bottom.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Medium: Grainy, scuffed, slightly faded color photograph with scratches and dirt, overlaid by flat white and dark-brown graphic elements and scattered white speckles like snow or confetti.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Typography: Huge white calligraphic swash script title spanning almost the full width, tilted and layered over the body, with letter strokes dripping into long thin drips like liquid. A small sans-serif credit sits in the middle and is overlapped by the title.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Color and light: Warm skin tones, cream lace and deep brown-black, lit like an old color film still with muddy amber warmth.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Story it suggests: A sugary, innocent costume covers a body that is being exposed, and the sweetness is melting away.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Visual idea: Syrup or melted chocolate dripping from the lettering and bubbles of dark blobs stand for sweetness turning messy.
0390_sweet-movie.jpg.Feels like: 1970s provocative European art film with a modern confectionery-meets-grunge design treatment.

0391_if.jpg.People: One young man shown from the chest up, centered, staring at the viewer with a furrowed brow and a finger to his temple; a second hand reaches out of the dark at lower left. The figure is a cut-out against black, so the hand looks detached from the body.
0391_if.jpg.Composition: Central vertical column: head at top, olive title in the lower right, hand at the bottom left forming a diagonal counterweight. A large black field surrounds the figure on all sides.
0391_if.jpg.Medium: Color photo cut-out on flat black ink with a fine halftone-dot speckle at the edges; the title looks like a rough letterpress or woodcut stamp.
0391_if.jpg.Typography: Large lowercase olive-green slab title with an oversized curled 'f' and a row of four big dots, placed lower right, about a fifth of the poster height. A tiny group of running silhouettes is cut into the letters, and a small orange circle holds the credit text.
0391_if.jpg.Color and light: Black, olive-gold and one orange dot; the face is evenly flash-lit against void.
0391_if.jpg.Story it suggests: A thoughtful, defiant student in formal dress is lost in a hypothetical, with violence waiting inside the letters.
0391_if.jpg.Visual idea: A tiny charging crowd hidden inside the title letters hints at rebellion inside a buttoned-up exterior.
0391_if.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s British counterculture poster, graphic and slightly ominous.

0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..People: None. The only human trace is a giant fingerprint.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Composition: A large tilted fingerprint centered and filling the lower two-thirds, with a block of right-aligned text stacked at upper right. Wide white margins and a lot of empty space.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Medium: Flat single-color gray ink on white, a high-contrast bitmap-like fingerprint with ragged broken ridges, like a stamp or photocopy.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Typography: Right-aligned stack of bold gray sans-serif titles in capitals, with a lighter 'THREE FILMS BY' and a bolder director name below. The text takes up about the top fifth, all in the same pale gray as the print.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Color and light: Pale gray on pure white, no light or shadow.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Story it suggests: Identity and evidence: someone is being traced and identified by a mark they have left behind.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Visual idea: The fingerprint stands for identity and for traces left on a person, and echoes the single-color restraint.
0392_three-films-by-hiroshi-teshigahara..Feels like: 1960s Japanese New Wave, minimalist modern box-set design.

0393_pitfall.jpg.People: A face only partly visible: one eye, lashes and brow seen through a ragged hole in a surface. It is a tiny view of one person, shown as a peek, not a portrait.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Composition: A framed rectangle sits on a white page with the title above right; inside, a torn hole is placed center and slightly right, with wood-like streaks radiating around it. The hole creates a frame within a frame.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus black-and-white photograph with fine grain and shallow depth of field, looking at a torn paper or wood surface.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Typography: Small gray sans-serif title and credit lines in the top right, aligned right, about a tenth of the poster height. They sit in the white margin and do not touch the picture.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray-black with a bright white torn edge and a soft pale face glow.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is watching, or being watched, through a break in a wall.
0393_pitfall.jpg.Visual idea: A peephole in a torn surface, voyeurism and hidden observation.

0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.People: Two figures entwined in close-up, mostly torso, arms and hands; one woman's face is thrown back with open mouth at the center, and another person's hands grip her head and arm. Bodies fill the frame and the faces are small or hidden.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Composition: Diagonal, curling composition: arms and bodies spiral from upper left to lower right, with the woman's face at the center-right. The cluster fills the frame and has no horizon.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with heavy grain, bodies and sand tones blending together like a charcoal drawing.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Typography: Small gray sans-serif title and credit stacked at the top right in the white margin, about a tenth of the height, completely separate from the photo.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with a pale, bright skin-like glare against deep shadows, strong raking light.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people grapple in a struggle that could be intimacy or violence.
0394_woman-in-the-dunes.jpg.Visual idea: Bodies and sand merge into a single landscape, so skin becomes dune.

0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.People: One man in close-up, head and shoulders, in dark suit and tie, with his entire face wrapped in bandages except two dark eyes and a mouth slit. The figure is clearly human but anonymous.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetrical, frontal head filling the frame; curving dashed lines sweep across the face and spread out like a web or map.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with soft focus and bandage texture, overprinted with dashed stitch-like lines that look like stitches or a surgical marking.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Typography: Small gray sans-serif title and director credit at top right in the white margin; they do not overlap the picture.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome with a bright, flat studio glow on the white bandage against dark clothing.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Story it suggests: A man hides his identity behind a manufactured face and is stitched together.
0395_the-face-of-another.jpg.Visual idea: Dashed cut lines on the bandaged face as if the face is a pattern to be cut and sewn.

0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.People: One man's face in halftone, close-up in the lower right, looking up at the viewer with a worried or scheming expression; a hand is at his head. He is a newspaper photo rather than a real scene.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Composition: Page laid out like a newspaper front page: masthead at the top, a huge two-line headline, a narrow text column on the left, and a halftone photo at lower right. The headline is stacked and fills the upper half.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white newsprint look with coarse halftone dots in the photo, grainy ink and small columns of body text, printed on pale gray paper.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Typography: A blackletter masthead at the top, then giant black heavy sans-serif capitals 'ACE IN THE HOLE' stacked in two lines, cut off at the left and right edges and filling the width. Below, a bold italic subhead and small serif body copy make up the real article.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Color and light: Pure black on pale gray-white, no color, like a newspaper.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's trouble is turned into a sensational headline story.
0396_ace-in-the-hole.jpg.Visual idea: The poster becomes a newspaper front page, so the title is a headline.

0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.People: One small boy standing alone, full body but tiny in the center, seen through a collapsed wooden ruin. He is a lone small figure surrounded by wreckage.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Composition: Top half is a dark frame of splintered beams radiating around a bright opening where the boy stands; the bottom half is empty pale fog with black roots or branches hanging down into it like a reflection. The boy sits just right of center.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film grain photograph merged with brush-like ink edges and bleeding black that melts into the pale bottom.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn, uneven brush capitals for the title and director name in the lower right, about a tenth of the height each, jagged and shaky, on pale gray.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray; a cold overcast light in the opening, deep shadow around.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Story it suggests: A child stands alone amid the wreckage of a destroyed place.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Visual idea: The ruin's beams form a broken frame and the roots reflected below make the whole scene feel like it hangs upside down.
0397_ivan-s-childhood.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Soviet-era black-and-white war drama, poetic and bleak.

0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.People: Two faces overlapped in profile and three-quarter view: a pale woman with soft hair on the left and a young man in profile on the right, who is partly merged into black. They are big and close, filling the upper two-thirds.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Composition: Split vertically between pale gray left and black right, the faces overlap along the diagonal; the title is below and the faces fade softly into it.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus black-and-white photograph with grain, blended with a smooth gradient between gray and black; red lettering looks brushed in ink.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Typography: Red hand-lettered script title in loose brush cursive, large, stacked in two lines at lower center-right, with a smaller white handwritten signature above and a typeset credit below. The script overlaps the faces' fading edge.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Color and light: Black, warm gray and a single saturated red; soft, theatrical lighting.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Story it suggests: Two intimate, nearly merged young people, as if sharing one fate.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Visual idea: One face emerges from the other, suggesting twins or doubles, and the red handwriting adds a personal intimacy.
0398_les-enfants-terribles.jpg.Feels like: Postwar French art-house drama, poetic and handwritten.

0399_house-of-games.jpg.People: None visible; a faint wisp of smoke rises in the dark as if a smoker sits unseen above the table. Ambiguous trace of a figure.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Composition: Top-down vertical: a hanging lamp at top center, a cone of light falling to a round green card table in the lower third, with poker chips and cards at the lower left of the pool of light. Large empty black space between lamp and table, with smoke wisps in the middle.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Medium: Photographic still-life with a staged, rendered look, soft grain, glowing light and smoke, and the shadow of lettering cast on the felt.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Typography: Title in bold condensed white caps spanning the right three-quarters, set at the table's edge in the lower third, with a smaller word in the middle. A second line of text below appears as a dark cast shadow on the green felt, reading like a shadow-written name. Vertical strip at lower left with year and collection name.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Color and light: Black with a pale lamp glow and teal-green felt, and a single warm orange chip; a single hard overhead source, noir lighting.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Story it suggests: A smoke-filled gambling table in the dark, where someone unseen is waiting with the cards.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Visual idea: The title stands on the table and casts its own shadow, as if the words were physical objects in the room.
0399_house-of-games.jpg.Feels like: Neo-noir thriller, 1980s crime and gambling drama.

0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.People: Three people in a photo at the bottom: two men in hats and sunglasses lean on a car at left and right, and a woman in sunglasses rests her chin on her arms in the car window between them. They are half-body to knee-length and arranged as a deadpan trio.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Composition: Split horizontally: the upper 43% is a solid black block with the title, the lower part is a photograph. In the photo the two men flank the car window in a symmetrical V, with a painted mural sign behind them.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with film grain, above a flat solid black ink field; the mural text is part of the photo.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Typography: Giant white bold condensed sans-serif capitals stacked in three lines, right-aligned and filling the black block, with a spaced-out credit line below. The title is cut flush with the right edge and has a stencil-like rough edge.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with mid-gray photo tones, flat daylight.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Story it suggests: Three bored travelers pause at a roadside stop under a sign that promises a destination.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Visual idea: A heavy block of text over a plain snapshot, as if a title card sits on top of a vacation photo.
0400_stranger-than-paradise.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American indie, deadpan black-and-white road movie.

0401_night-on-earth.jpg.People: About nine people in five photo panels, each a close-up of faces inside a car at night: a driver with a mustache, a woman smoking in the back, a man in sunglasses, two women, and a group of three. The faces are medium close-up, mostly looking away or sideways.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Composition: A loose collage of five rectangular photo frames of differing sizes around a central black space, which holds the title. The frames are arranged around the title like a mosaic with black gutters.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Medium: Color film stills with saturated night grain, cut as torn or ragged photo blocks on solid black; the title letters look like cut paper.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Typography: Large black block capitals on ragged white cut-out paper rectangles, stacked in three lines with each letter on its own scrap, left of center and about a third of the poster width. A clean sans-serif credit line is under it in white.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with neon-ish teal, red and magenta glows from the car interiors and street lights.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Story it suggests: Different strangers share intimate late-night rides, each with its own mood.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Visual idea: Ransom-note lettering and fragmented windows suggest scattered stories in one night.
0401_night-on-earth.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s American indie, punk cut-and-paste graphic.

0402_the-milky-way.jpg.People: One bearded long-haired man in close-up, his face mostly covered by a large white arrow graphic; his eyes and lower face remain visible. He is cropped at the shoulders and fills the whole image.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Composition: A white crossroads of arrows radiates from the center, crossing the face; the face is on the left and titles stacked on the right. Vertical and horizontal lines divide the poster into quadrants with bent arrows at the ends.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Medium: Grainy color film still with a muted, slightly soft look, overlaid by a translucent flat white graphic.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Typography: Red condensed serif name at upper right and bigger orange slab-serif title stacked in three lines at lower right, cutting in along the right edge. Colors pop against the blue-green image.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Color and light: Teal-gray blue background, brown robes, white arrows with red and orange text; soft overcast light.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Story it suggests: A traveler faces a crossroads with countless directions to choose.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Visual idea: A road-sign junction of arrows laid over a face, standing for choice, wandering and pilgrimage.
0402_the-milky-way.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s European art-house, with 1960s pop graphic design.

0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.People: No people. Three white bird shapes (crow-like) perch on the frame outlines; they are painted white silhouettes.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Composition: Two hand-drawn white outlines, a large irregular circle above and a rounded banner below, hold the title and credit like frames within a frame. Birds sit on the outlines: two upper, one at lower right. The circle encloses a bouquet-like painting.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Medium: Thick impasto oil or gouache painting of red and grey flowers on a murky ground; the white lines and birds look like dry-brush or white ink on top. Visible brush ridges.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered white script, uneven, slanted, scratchy, in large size for the title in the upper circle and a smaller credit in the lower banner; the letters run over the painted flowers and are cut into the loop.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Color and light: Olive, ochre and brown with bright blood-red patches and white; dim, painterly light.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Story it suggests: Dark birds gather around something beautiful that is a little decayed.
0403_cria-cuervos.jpg.Visual idea: Bouquet framed like a mirror or crystal ball with birds as watchers, as in a child's drawing.

0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.People: Two figures: a large foreground astronaut in a clear helmet whose face looks like a monkey or ape, and a small figure climbing a slope at upper right. The big one is half-body at the lower left; the small one is full body.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Composition: Diagonal rock slope from top right, with the helmet figure at lower left and the climbing figure at the right, the title stacked down the lower right. A small sun sits at the top center against a starry sky.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Medium: Loose painted illustration in gouache or oil with visible brushwork, scratchy pencil lines and paper grain, like a vintage hand-painted poster.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Typography: Huge white condensed sans-serif capitals stacked in three lines at lower right, filling about a third of the poster height, with a smaller credit line above. The letters are crisp and clean over the painting.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink and red-orange sky and rocks, black shadows, a yellow sun and a glowing white helmet rim.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Story it suggests: A castaway in a space suit struggles across an alien red landscape, accompanied by an odd companion.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Visual idea: A spacesuited stranded figure on a red planet, painted in loud color.
0404_robinson-crusoe-on-mars.jpg.Feels like: 1960s retro sci-fi adventure paperback and pulp painting.

0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.People: A giant gentleman in a top hat and gloves stands over the scene, with a cigar or pipe in his mouth, painted as a caricature; below, five smaller figures including a woman in a green coat and hat, a soldier or police in a tall helmet, a bearded man and a blonde woman seen from behind. They are stylized and flattened.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Composition: One huge figure dominates the center and top, with the title at the left over a long diagonal cane; the small crowd is at the bottom, and newspaper-like banners peek in at the corners. The scale contrast makes the man towering.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Medium: Naive painterly illustration, flat gouache with visible brush strokes and soft pencil outlines on an orange ground.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Typography: Large rust-red geometric sans lettering with a number 3 and stacked words, left of center, about a third of the height, in a flat poster style; a cream serif credit sits below. It is crossed by the diagonal cane.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange sky, muted brown-gray coat, olive green and rust red accents, flat light with a small crescent moon.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Story it suggests: A dandy overshadows a poor crowd in a satirical city scene.
0405_the-threepenny-opera.jpg.Visual idea: Scale: the rich gentleman is a giant towering over the little people, a caricature.

0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.People: One woman dancer in a full-body mid-air pose with one leg kicked high and a long wrapped cloth, with her arms flung out. She is large and fills the height of the poster.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Composition: Diagonal sweep from the foot at upper left down through the cloth to the planted foot at lower right, with a piece of driftwood-like sculpture left and a wooden floor below. Title is centered at lower middle.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with soft film grain and smooth gradations, as in an old dance still.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Typography: White spaced-out serif capitals stacked in two groups with a thin flourish line between, centered at the lower middle and about a quarter of the height, set over the draped fabric. The words sit on the image without any box.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome, dim stage with a soft spotlight, wooden floor highlights.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Story it suggests: A moment of powerful, frozen movement on a bare stage.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Visual idea: A single swirling fabric shape traces the motion of the dance.
0406_martha-graham-dance-on-film.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century modern dance photography, elegant and classical.

0407_mala-noche.jpg.People: One young man repeated in five fragmentary photos, shirtless, with dark curly hair, shown in tight crops of face, chest or arm. The faces are partly covered by shadow or cropped out, so he feels like a series of fragments.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Composition: A vertical grid of overlapping, torn-edged photo strips on black, with the title scrawled across the center diagonally and the credit on a torn white paper scrap. The panels fill nearly the whole poster, a bit like a contact sheet.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Medium: Grainy sepia-toned photos with torn paper edges on flat black, and brush-like white handwriting.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Typography: Big hand-painted white brush lettering, rough and uneven, stacked in two lines with letters tilting and sprawling across the middle, about a third of the poster. A tiny typeset credit sits on a torn white strip.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Color and light: Brown-black sepia, white lettering, harsh low light with deep shadows.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Story it suggests: An obsessed gaze studies a body in the dark, piece by piece.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Visual idea: A collage of torn strips and a handwritten scrawl, like a personal photo diary or a scrapbook.
0407_mala-noche.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American underground indie, raw and intimate.

0408_breathless.jpg.Composition: Text-only poster: all lettering is rotated 90 degrees and runs vertically, with a thick vertical bar dividing the title column from the credit column. The words fill the poster edge to edge with almost no empty space.
0408_breathless.jpg.Medium: Flat black ink on pale gray paper, with slightly fuzzy, soft edges as if from an ink-stamp or photocopy or rubber type.
0408_breathless.jpg.Typography: Enormous black condensed rounded sans-serif capitals rotated sideways; the director's surname in the largest size covers the left half, while the title and credit are smaller on the right. Letters touch the edges and one is cut by the corner logo; it is all uniformly bold with soft ink-gain edges.
0408_breathless.jpg.Color and light: Black on light gray, no light effects.
0408_breathless.jpg.Story it suggests: A rush and a pressure of words that leaves no room to breathe.
0408_breathless.jpg.Visual idea: Type crammed to the edges, rotated so you must turn your head, evoking breathlessness.
0408_breathless.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave typographic poster from around 1960, hand-printed, with a modernist feel.

0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.People: One blurred man in a wide-brimmed hat, shown from behind-side at the bottom left, out of focus and cropped; a tiny figure stands on the porch of the house in the distance.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Composition: Horizon at about 40% height; big house on a hill upper center, wheat field filling the lower two-thirds; the blurry figure is a foreground anchor at lower left, with title sitting right at the horizon line.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with warm saturated tone and visible grain, shallow depth of field blur in the foreground.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Typography: Dark brown serif caps and small caps on a single line at mid-height, about 60% of the width, with 'of' small; small credit above. Sits on top of the wheat field without distortion.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Color and light: Golden wheat, blue sky, brown house; warm low sun, magic hour.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Story it suggests: A drifter watches a grand house on a hill from the fields below.
0409_days-of-heaven.jpg.Visual idea: A lone blurred figure in the foreground looks toward a distant mansion, contrasting poor workers and the owner.

0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.People: One man in a tight close-up, face and collar in a black bow tie, wearing large dark aviator sunglasses; below, a blurred skull face in a dark band. The man fills the upper two-thirds and the skull is a ghostly second face.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Composition: Split in two horizontal zones: the top is a huge frontal face, centered and symmetrical, and the bottom is a dark band with a blurry skull at the right and text at the left. The skull sits on the right side below the face.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Medium: Warm color film photograph with a soft grain, over a flat dark brown band with an out-of-focus skull image.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Typography: Small distressed condensed gray-beige sans-serif title stacked on the left of the lower band, about a tenth of the poster height; a smaller credit line sits under. It is modest and does not overlap the face.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange-amber skin against black, a harsh single light; dark brown-black lower panel with ghostly pale skull.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Story it suggests: A sweaty, self-destructive man hides behind dark glasses while death looms under him.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Visual idea: Tiny mountains reflected in the sunglasses and a skull beneath, as if the man's fate sits below the surface.
0410_under-the-volcano.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American literary drama, moody and hot, with a modern minimal redesign.

0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.People: One man's face and shoulders in a heavily stylized image, mostly black with some pale areas; he wears a hat that hides his eyes. He is large and fills most of the poster.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Composition: A big stacked title across the top, a central head and shoulders in a wedge, and bold credit lines across the bottom, with a flat ochre field at right. Text and image interlock in a tight frame with no gaps.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Medium: Woodcut or linocut-style print with thick black outlines and flat tan, ochre and gray fills, with a rough paper texture.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Typography: Gigantic jagged black block letters with tan fill for BERLIN across the top, filling the width and bleeding off the edges, then ALEXANDERPLATZ in a strip, and credit lines in similar chopped letters at the bottom, all cut by the edges. The letters are hand-cut, uneven and woodblock-like, tightly integrated with the face.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Color and light: Black, ochre yellow, dusty beige and mauve gray, flat with no real light source.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Story it suggests: A hat-shadowed man in a harsh city, anonymous and under pressure.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Visual idea: A woodcut face merges with the lettering of the city name, so the man and the city are the same thing.
0411_berlin-alexanderplantz.jpg.Feels like: German Expressionist woodcut poster from the 1920s, revived for a 1980 production.

0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.People: One woman in a long period dress and feathered hat stands tiny and full-body at the bottom center, in a pool of light. She is a small lone figure in a huge dark void.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Composition: Vertical stack: ornate crown and swashy title at the top center, a hanging lantern on a cord below it, and a lit patch of stage floor at the bottom with the woman. A large black emptiness fills the middle.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film grain still on a flat black field, with white calligraphic lettering that looks like ink or engraving.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Typography: Ornate white Victorian flourish script title with exaggerated swashes, stacked in three lines in the upper middle and about a quarter of the poster height, above a small yellow name in a circus-poster style and a decorative crown. The lantern cord hangs down from the T's swash.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Color and light: Black and white, with one pool of spotlight on the floor and a small yellow accent for the credit.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone performer waits on a dark stage, exposed and small.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Visual idea: The hanging lantern connects to the title's flourish, and the empty stage makes the figure feel lonely.
0412_sawdust-and-tinsel.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European theater or circus drama, with Victorian poster lettering.

0413_drunken-angel.jpg.People: One man in a dark suit, sketched in running or leaping pose at upper right, full body and fairly small, as a drawn figure. A larger ghostly shape, possibly a face, is built from white splashes in the lower right.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Composition: Split vertically: left half is a gritty olive-gray gradient, right half is white with black ink; the title crosses the dividing line in the middle. The running figure is at upper right, with white splatter running down the center.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Medium: Ink and brush sketch with splatters and dry-brush texture, over a scratchy painted gray field, like a rough painting or screenprint.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed white bold caps for DRUNKEN on the gray side, switching to black caps for ANGEL on the white side, so the letters invert at the split. Rough, speckled edges; a small credit line in white serif sits above.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Color and light: Olive-gray, black and white, with an orange accent in the corner band; harsh flat contrast.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in a dark suit runs from a cruel, divided world.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Visual idea: The title flips from white-on-dark to black-on-white at the center, splitting the poster as if two sides of one person.
0413_drunken-angel.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Japanese noir, redone with a modern ink-splatter graphic style.

0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.People: Faintly visible occupants inside the car window, too blurred to count or read. Basically no clear person, only silhouettes behind glass.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Composition: A battered gray car sweeps diagonally across the frame from lower left to right, filling most of the poster, with the road running off to the lower right. Title crosses the middle of the car.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Medium: Color photograph with strong motion blur on the road, trees and wheel, with film grain and faded tones; the lettering looks scratched and worn.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Typography: Large mustard-yellow squared-off stencil-like capitals in two lines, spread across the poster width over the car body, with a small spaced-out credit line above. The letters have scratches like a worn metal sign.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Color and light: Faded gray-blue car, green trees, overcast sky, with the title in mustard yellow; flat overcast daylight.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Story it suggests: A car speeds down an empty road with no clear destination.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Visual idea: The motion blur and the title's weathered paint make the car feel like speed and dust.
0414_two-lane-blacktop.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s American road movie and car culture.

0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.People: Top: one man's face half hidden by a rough stone or cloth, with one eye staring out; bottom: five tiny silhouetted figures running with spears along a ridge. The face is a big close-up and the runners are tiny full-body silhouettes in a line.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Composition: Divided into two horizontal bands with a torn edge between them: the upper is a close-up face, the lower is an orange field with the title, a thorny branch crossing diagonally and a line of runners descending along a slope toward the left.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Medium: Warm-toned photograph with grain on top, with flat screen-printed silhouettes and textured paper on the bottom; the title has a mottled, worn texture.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Typography: Bold dark red-brown sans-serif capitals with a speckled texture, across the middle of the lower band, about a tenth of the poster height; a small lowercase credit sits below it. The letters sit in empty orange space without overlapping the figures.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, amber and dark brown, a hot desert sunlight.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Story it suggests: A man peers out from hiding while a pack of hunters runs him down.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Visual idea: A single watchful eye above and a hunting party in silhouette below, hunter and hunted in two bands.
0415_the-naked-prey.jpg.Feels like: 1960s adventure and survival film, redone in a modern screenprint style.

0416_miss-julie.jpg.People: Two people in close-up: a young woman at lower left, looking straight out, and a man with a mustache behind and right, gazing off to the side. Two hands grip her neck and chest from behind or the side, so they are entangled in a confrontation.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Composition: The two faces are split by a diagonal vertical edge, with her on the pale left and him on the darker green right, and the hands reach across the dividing line. The title is across the bottom, overlapped by her hand.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Medium: Thick oil or gouache painting with visible brushstrokes and impasto texture, like a painted portrait.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Typography: Large dark teal flourished calligraphic script title spanning the bottom width, the capital letters drawn with swashes and overlapping the hands and the bodies; a small typeset credit sits below. It looks like ink handwriting on top of paint.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Color and light: Soft peach and cream against slate green and dark teal, a gentle painterly light.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people locked in a tense, intimate struggle where one holds the other.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Visual idea: A diagonal cut between two worlds, with the hands bridging the gap as a grip.
0416_miss-julie.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European romantic drama, hand-painted poster look.

0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.People: One man in tight close-up, head and shoulder, looking sideways at the viewer with a stern, bruised look; a big fist and forearm enter from the top right in the foreground and a hand is held up near his face. The foreground fist is much bigger and blurred.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Composition: A diagonal arm slashes from upper right toward the face at left; the face is at the left-center and the title is stacked at the lower right. The raised fist seems to be aimed at the viewer.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain and shallow depth of field.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Typography: Bold yellow slab-serif capitals stacked in three lines at lower right, about a tenth of the poster each, left-aligned, with a smaller cream credit line below. The yellow is the only color and sits over the dark coat.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray, with yellow type as the single accent; hard side light.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A rough man braces for a fight or a blow.
0417_this-sporting-life.jpg.Visual idea: The fist is thrust toward the camera, putting the viewer in the line of the punch.

0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.People: One woman with a dark bowl haircut and a scarf, leaning on a window frame and looking toward the viewer, half-body. She is large and centered.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Composition: A frame within a frame: she stands in a dark doorway or window with a bright opening behind her, and the scribbled text is spread over the whole poster. White border around the photo.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Medium: Warm color photograph with soft grain, overlaid with loose white handwriting like a marker or chalk.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Typography: Casual, thin white hand-written titles, large and sprawling in a list down the right two-thirds of the poster with irregular sizes and slanting baselines, overlapping the figure and cut off at the edge. It feels like personal notes written on the photo.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Color and light: Deep green-black, maroon red, ochre and cream, soft daylight from behind.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Story it suggests: A person pauses at a window and looks calmly out, an inviting portrait of a maker.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Visual idea: A handwritten list scrawled over a portrait makes the poster feel like a personal scrapbook.
0418_4-by-agnes-varda.jpg.Feels like: 1970s-80s French personal cinema, intimate and handmade.

0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.People: Two faces in close-up: a woman in the front right looking off to the side, and a man behind her at the left looking toward the viewer. Both are large, filling the frame, shoulders overlapping.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Composition: Diagonal arrangement with the two heads staggered from the upper left to the lower right and the title sweeping across below. White frame border around the photo.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with coarse film grain, high key, overlaid with white handwritten script.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Typography: Large white handwritten cursive title and credit, sprawling across the lower half in three lines of different slants, over the body and clothing. The lettering looks like marker or chalk and sits directly on the photograph.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome with bright overexposed whites and deep dark hair and clothing; strong natural light.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people stand close but look in different directions, estranged though together.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Visual idea: Two faces side by side but turned away from each other, with the handwritten title like a letter.
0419_la-pointe-courte.jpg.Feels like: 1950s French art-house, a precursor of the New Wave.

0420_le-bonheur.jpg.People: A family of four in the middle distance, blurred: a man in a red shirt and a woman in a yellow dress holding hands with two small children in red. They are small and out of focus, walking through a field.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Composition: A sharp sunflower in the lower left foreground against a blurred yellow field, with the family in the center right and handwritten title in the top. The sunflower's diagonal petals lead the eye into the family.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color photograph with grain and a thin white border; the title is white hand-drawn lettering.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Typography: Handwritten white marker-like title and credit sprawled over the upper third in loose, slanted lines, the biggest word at top right and cut by the right edge. It is unpolished and casual.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Color and light: Golden yellow and warm ochre with strong red accents on the clothing, sunny and warm.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Story it suggests: A happy family strolls through a golden summer field, though everything looks too sweet.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Visual idea: The sharp flower versus the blurred family makes happiness a pretty surface the family is lost in.
0420_le-bonheur.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French color film, sunny and sweet.

0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.People: A man and a woman in half-body at the bottom: he smokes a cigarette and looks sideways; she touches her lips with lipstick and holds a stuffed monkey. Both are fairly large and cropped at the bottom edge.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Composition: Giant stacked title letters in the upper two-thirds with F, O and U spaced across the width, over a blank pale sky; the two figures sit in the lower third. The huge letters leave a lot of open sky between them.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Medium: Color photograph with grain and flat sky, combined with solid flat-color letters; looks like a clean graphic print.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Typography: Gigantic red F, white O and blue U spread across the full width and cut off at the right edge, taking up a third of the poster, under smaller letter-spaced brown and gray lines at the top that run off the page. The huge colors form a tricolor and the small text is stretched wide.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue with red, white and blue letters and a red dress; bright flat daylight.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Story it suggests: Two carefree people goof around against open sky, ignoring the world.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Visual idea: The title letters in three flag colors split across the page, a pop-art gag of the tricolor.
0421_pierrot-le-fou.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave pop, playful and graphic.

0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.People: One tiny child figure seen as a full-body black silhouette, in a robe and tall hat, running away from the viewer toward a glowing doorway; a faint reflection of the figure on the floor.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Composition: Strongly symmetric: a bright yellow rectangle of light framed by dark carved door panels left and right, the figure dead center. The lower half is an empty black field with the title block centered in it.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with soft grain and a deep black vignette; the lower half is flat black ink.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Typography: Wide-tracked small serif credit above a large condensed all-caps serif title in muted gold, centered in the lower third; a small red seal-like block of Chinese characters sits at its right end. Typeset, clean, sitting on the black void rather than on the image.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow backlight against near-black, with gold type and a small crimson accent; strong contre-jour.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Story it suggests: A small child bolts toward a blinding outside world from inside a dark, ornate, enclosed interior.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Visual idea: The doorway of light as a threshold: a tiny figure dwarfed by the architecture of the space he is leaving or fleeing.
0422_the-last-emperor.jpg.Feels like: Prestige historical epic, late-1980s, restrained and formal.

0423_walker.jpg.People: One man shown full body, large, walking straight at the viewer with a rifle raised in one hand; the face is a blank flat skin-colored shape with no features.
0423_walker.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure splitting the poster; flames and a town skyline form a horizontal band behind his legs, with empty red above and yellow ground below. The title crosses his chest.
0423_walker.jpg.Medium: Flat gouache or airbrushed illustration with crisp cut-out shapes, a faux-pop-art look; flames have jagged paint-like edges.
0423_walker.jpg.Typography: Huge yellow western slab letters with red-and-black outlines spanning nearly the full width at the figure's chest level, overlapped by his body; a hand-brushed red credit in the yellow foreground with splatter dots.
0423_walker.jpg.Color and light: Hot red, yellow and black with a cool blue-white town as relief; flat, poster-bright, no real light source.
0423_walker.jpg.Story it suggests: A faceless gunman marches calmly through a burning town.
0423_walker.jpg.Visual idea: The blank face turns the man into a symbol, a stencil of a conqueror in front of a town on fire.

0424_mafioso.jpg.People: One man in a black beret and striped shirt, shown large from the chest up, head turned three-quarters with a stern gaze, filling the lower two-thirds.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Composition: A big pale grey-violet heart with a scalloped lace border and jeweled beads frames the portrait; the head overlaps the heart's bottom, title sits inside the heart's top lobe, symmetric frame with an off-axis head.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or acrylic with visible brushstrokes, thick black contour lines and paper texture; a handwritten signature at the lower right.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Typography: Chunky white serif title with a navy outline, wide across the heart; a small all-caps credit line above. Typeset but decorative, sitting over the painted heart without touching the face.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Color and light: Vivid orange skin against black, silver-violet and white; flat, no cast light.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard, menacing man set inside a sentimental valentine, an unsettling mix of tenderness and threat.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Visual idea: Contrasting a tough man with a lacy heart like a bead curtain or kitsch shrine.
0424_mafioso.jpg.Feels like: Hand-painted contemporary illustration of a 1960s Italian crime comedy-drama.

0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Composition: A tall, narrow tower of faceted architecture climbs diagonally from the lower left to the top center-left, leaving the right half white; text sits in the white at the upper right.
0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic cutouts, collaged with halftone grain, with rough stepped paper edges.
0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Typography: Large light sans-serif title stacked in two lines, upper line orange-rust and lower line deep red, right-aligned block in the upper right; a small tracked all-caps credit line below. Clean typeset, set against empty white.
0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Color and light: Stark black and white with only rust and red type; flat, high-contrast, chalky.
0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Story it suggests: A monumental, strange building seems to grow up out of a blank page.
0425_antonio-gaudi.jpg.Visual idea: Cut-and-pasted photo fragments echo the mosaic building, whose tiles also spell letters.

0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Composition: A black upper half with the title pushed to the right edge; the lower half is a dense field of ice and drops, with a vertical red smear at the center; text cropped off the right edge.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Medium: Macro photograph with grain and glassy water or ice texture, high-contrast and slightly abstract.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Typography: Thin lowercase sans-serif with joined words and alternating light and bold weights (ice, film, ang), white on black, flush right and cut off at the right edge. Typeset, tight, no spaces.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Color and light: Black, icy blue-white and a hot red streak; cold, wet, glinting.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Story it suggests: A cold, frozen surface hides something raw and bloody underneath.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Visual idea: Ice crystals and red color suggesting violence or heat trapped in cold.
0426_the-ice-storm.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s indie drama, cold and atmospheric.

0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.People: Two figures: a man in a trench coat, large and in the foreground, striding toward the viewer; a smaller woman in a dark coat further back, also running toward the viewer; they seem linked by urgency.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Composition: A diagonal arrangement from the woman at left center to the man at right; a road runs to the horizon, with a car behind; broken bike parts across the bottom form foreground debris.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned black-and-white film still with grain, softened by a hazy gradient sky.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Typography: Heavy sans-serif title in sepia-brown across the top, with slices and cracks cut through the letters; the small 'of a' is tucked between words. Lighter serif credit under it. Distorted, fragmented title blends with a fog gradient.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome sepia and brown with a pale foggy sky; flat overcast light.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people flee a scene on a deserted road, leaving wreckage behind.
0427_death-of-a-cyclist.jpg.Visual idea: The cracked title echoes the broken wreckage, so the damage appears in both image and type.

0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.People: One man in a huge close-up, head and shoulder in profile, drawn rough in stark white against black; a second shadowy shape on the left is almost a silhouette.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Composition: Right-weighted face emerging from a black mass; upper left window onto a city street with a BAR sign (frame within frame); the title stack occupies the lower left.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Medium: Hand-inked illustration, brush and wood-cut-like marks with white paint splatter, purple watercolor wash in the city corner; paper-like texture in the color areas.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed hand-cut capitals 'BLAST OF SILENCE' stacked in pale blue, with cracked, splintered lines running through the letters like broken glass or bullet fractures; set in the lower left and 'OF' smaller, with a purple credit line below.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with violet, purple and blue accents; night lighting with strong contrasts.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard, weary man in a night city, tense and alone.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Visual idea: The title shattered as if by a gunshot, silence broken.
0428_blast-of-silence.jpg.Feels like: Hard-boiled noir pulp illustration, late 1950s to 60s crime.

0429_the-lovers.jpg.People: Two hands clasped together in close-up, with a man's cuffed sleeve above and a woman's fingers below; only hands, no faces.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Composition: A big red brushstroke oval frames the clasped hands at the center, cropping the image like a lens or a mirror; the title sits at top inside the oval.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with a painted red ink ring over it, semi-transparent where it overlaps shadows.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Typography: Handwritten black script title at the top, slanted and loose, inside the ring, with a clean grotesque credit at the bottom partly overlapping the red ring. Handmade title versus typeset credit.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with a bold single red; soft, intimate light.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate, secret touch between two people.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Visual idea: The red ring is both a ring and a circle drawn around desire, isolating the touch.
0429_the-lovers.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s French romantic drama, tender and sensual.

0430_the-fire-within.jpg.People: One man in tight close-up on the left half, face cropped at the forehead and chin, eyes looking at the camera with a worn, grave expression; shoulders in a tweed jacket and open collar. A blurred building stands behind him.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Composition: Face and shoulders on the left, a giant red X of two crossing brushstrokes spanning nearly the whole poster and crossing right over his eyes and mouth; the handwritten title sits in the right half, stacked diagonally downward between the X's arms.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with grain, overlaid with translucent red paint strokes showing bristle streaks, drips and dry-brush edges.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered title in thin black ink script, three stacked lines, tilted and cascading down the right side, about a quarter of the poster width, written across the photo and the red paint. Small white spaced sans credit at the bottom, and sideways collection name at left.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Color and light: Gray photographic tones with a single vivid red; flat, overcast daylight.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Story it suggests: A man marked or crossed out, a person struck through, hinting at self-erasure or a deadline.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Visual idea: A hand-painted X over the face, like a cross-out or a mark of rejection.
0430_the-fire-within.jpg.Feels like: French new wave, early 1960s black-and-white drama with gestural contemporary design.

0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.People: Four kinds of figure, all painted: a giant bare-chested man with pointed ears and a topknot, smiling down, whose huge hand cradles a small couple on a flying carpet; a small bare-chested boy in green shorts standing with hands on hips at right; a cloaked rider with a curved blade on a white horse at top right.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Composition: Scale play: the giant fills the lower left and centre, the tiny couple sit in his palm, and the boy stands beside him. The rider floats in the sky at upper right, and a pink skyline of domes lies behind. A large pale moon-like disc sits behind the title.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache illustration with visible brush strokes on textured paper, flat decorative shapes with fine hair and pattern details.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy dark-red Western-style slab capitals with diamond cut-outs, stacked over three lines ('The' in a thin italic), sized to cover the top third and overlapping the moon and the giant's head. A credit in cream outlined caps sits on a scalloped border at the bottom.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Color and light: Lavender, cream, blush pink, with red and green accents; soft, storybook daylight.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful giant holds a pair of lovers in his hand while a masked rider swoops overhead.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Visual idea: Using scale to make the fairy-tale world feel handmade and toy-like.
0431_the-thief-of-bagdad.jpg.Feels like: Modern folk-art storybook reinterpretation of a 1940s adventure fantasy.

0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.People: Many repeated figures: four large stylized heads stacked in a column, flanked by pairs of small men in black suits, mirrored left to right; one face resembles a mask.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Composition: Perfect bilateral symmetry on a vertical axis with radiating sunburst stripes behind; the totem of heads and mirrored bodies sits dead center and the title cuts across the middle.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Medium: Screen-printed collage with halftone dots, flat inks, woven paper texture, brushed bamboo and cherry blossom, wave patterns.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Typography: Medium-small gold sans-serif title with a red italic serif subtitle, centered on a black band in the middle of the column; credit below in a grey sans. Typeset, integrated into the image as a band across the figures.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink, orange-red, mustard, sage green, and cyan; flat, decorative, no real light.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Story it suggests: A life divided into stages, mirrored and stacked like a shrine.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Visual idea: Four chapters shown as four faces on a totem, with a rising-sun burst.
0432_mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.jpg.Feels like: 1960s-70s Japanese pop poster, psychedelic and ornamental.

0433_patriotism.jpg.People: One man in a military uniform kneeling upright on the floor, shown full body, with a cap hiding his eyes; a dagger lies on the floor in front.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Composition: A large red disc behind the upper body; the figure centered, rising out of white space; the title runs vertically at the right, with a vertical credit above it and ink stamps in the corners.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph cut out, with a grainy red watercolor-like or spray texture disc, paper-like label, and ink stamp textures.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Typography: Vertical title in thin outlined letters on a beige label at the lower right, with a vertical credit above it; a huge white brushstroke Chinese-style character over the red disc, hand-brushed; stamp marks in the upper right.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Color and light: Red, grey and white; flat and cold with a faint dusty look.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in uniform kneels in stillness, facing an act of sacrifice.
0433_patriotism.jpg.Visual idea: A rising-sun circle with the figure half merged into it, turning the body into a flag.

0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.People: Many: two big faces in high-contrast, one upper left and one at right; below, a crowd in a street with one man collapsed on the ground and another running.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Composition: Three layers: top band torn black with two faces on a diagonal, big stacked title in the middle, a gray street photo at the bottom with figures spread across.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Medium: Photocopy-like high-contrast threshold print with rough ragged edges, plus a halftone-like photograph; torn-paper look.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Typography: Huge italic condensed bold sans-serif title stacked in three lines in pale grey-blue, spanning the width over the black field; small credit in black italic at left. Slanted, punchy, overlaps the faces.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Color and light: Black, pale grey-green and slate teal; harsh contrast.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Story it suggests: A violent street scene with two hunted men looming above it.
0434_classe-tous-risques.jpg.Visual idea: Stark faces are pasted over a scene of chaos, as if torn from a crime newspaper.

0435_the-furies.jpg.People: One woman with curled blond hair and a scarf, seen from the waist up in profile gazing up and left, on a horse; tiny riders and wagons appear far away on the horizon.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Composition: Title at top left, big empty sky in the middle, the woman anchored in the lower right corner, with a small ranch in the distance; diagonal from the title to the figure.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Medium: Tinted old black-and-white photo with sepia overlay on a textured paper background; a mix of photo and paper grain.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Typography: Big black wood-type Western title, with a swashy small 'The' and a rough, inked texture; small credit in smaller slab type. Large, upper left, directly on the paper-like sky.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber, sepia and brown with a dusty sunset gradient.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Story it suggests: A determined woman looks out across her family's land.
0435_the-furies.jpg.Visual idea: The woman as a dominating presence above a tiny ranch.

0436_before-the-rain.jpg.People: Two figures in a tight embrace, large and cropped by the left edge, faces hidden; a faint ghost of a hand in the upper right.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Composition: Embrace fills the left half, a hazy landscape of buildings and rocky ground on the right; the title sits across the middle at the seam.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Medium: Double exposure film photograph with heavy grain, washed-out haze, and transparency.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Typography: Rough ragged white title in uppercase sitting at the center, a thin serif quote across the width, a red typewriter-like credit line below. Hand-distressed, partly clashing with the image.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Color and light: Muted grey with warm skin, dark clothes and a small red accent; diffuse light.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Story it suggests: A grieving or desperate embrace in front of a hazy, half-ruined landscape.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Visual idea: A layered double exposure joins intimate comfort with a distant, damaged landscape.
0436_before-the-rain.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European arthouse drama, raw and melancholic.

0437_vampyr.jpg.People: One young woman lying asleep or lifeless on a bench in the lower part, small; a large shadow of a scythe-like shape on the wall above.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Composition: Split in two: bright, patterned plaster wall above with the title, dark carved wooden paneling below with the woman; a diagonal scythe shadow links them.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with film grain, with damask pattern overlay and plaster texture; looks like an old print.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Typography: Large black gothic blackletter title with ragged, ink-splatter edges across the center-left, with a small tracked credit above. Hand-lettered, dripping onto the wall.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome in grey and black with a bright diffuse wall; a spooky chiaroscuro.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Story it suggests: A sleeping woman lies below a looming shadow of death.
0437_vampyr.jpg.Visual idea: The scythe shadow suggests an unseen presence; the title seems stained onto the wall.

0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.People: One young boy's face in extreme close-up, cropped at the forehead and left side, eyes looking sideways toward the left; red shirt barely visible below.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Composition: The face fills the left two-thirds with the eye at upper left; title offset to the right, over the blurred dark green background, descending toward the lower right.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still, with shallow depth of field, soft grain and natural skin texture.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Typography: Lowercase light serif title in white, in two lines, stepped to the right, large relative to poster width and cropped at the right edge; a small credit below. Thin and quiet, sits on the dark background beside the face.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Color and light: Warm skin tones, olive green, a touch of red; soft natural light.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy quietly looks on, watching something just out of frame.
0438_mon-oncle-antoine.jpg.Visual idea: The extreme close-up makes the child's gaze the entire story.

0439_trafic.jpg.People: One small man in a hat and overcoat, drawn full body in profile, walking left to right with a pipe in his mouth and a blue jerrycan in hand; no other people.
0439_trafic.jpg.Composition: He walks on a white road arrow near the bottom, with giant road-sign shapes (roundabout ring, dashed curved line, blue up arrow) filling the space around him; the title is bottom-left and a round blue sign at bottom right.
0439_trafic.jpg.Medium: Flat screen-print or gouache shapes with a soft pencil-line figure, on a textured paper background.
0439_trafic.jpg.Typography: Thin, tall blue hand-drawn all-caps title (with a long T stem) at lower left, about a quarter of the poster width; a small handwritten credit inside a blue circle that looks like a road sign. The type is designed as part of the traffic signage.
0439_trafic.jpg.Color and light: Warm grey and off-white with spot cyan-blue and white; flat, matte, no cast light.
0439_trafic.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man walks on foot through a world designed for cars.
0439_trafic.jpg.Visual idea: Road markings and traffic signs become the scenery, turning the person into a pedestrian in a traffic diagram.
0439_trafic.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French comic design, playful mid-century graphic illustration.

0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.People: Several: two faces (a woman, a large partly cropped second face) in a keyhole-shaped panel, and a tiny silhouetted figure standing below them; a huge eye above, so a dreamlike layering of figures.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Composition: Strict vertical symmetry: a giant eye with radiating red rays at the top, a tapering keyhole or tower in the center holding the faces and figure, with title descending at the bottom and waves on either side.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Medium: Layered paper-cut and collage look with torn paper edges, pencil handwriting, grainy black-and-white photos, flat color.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Typography: Rough hand-painted white capital title stacked in three lines in the lower central column, with exclamation mark, large; a small stamped serif credit in a paper tag at the top; handwritten notes in pale script scattered around the sides.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Color and light: Dark brown-black with rust red rays, pale blue water, grey photographs; dim, theatrical.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Story it suggests: A man alone, watched by a giant eye, remembers a haunting past.
0440_brand-upon-the-brain.jpg.Visual idea: The all-seeing eye and keyhole turn memory into surveillance and a peephole.
