0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.People: Two: a man shown large in close-up at right, half in shadow, holding a telephone receiver near his mouth with a wary stare; a woman in a coat standing small and distant in a lit doorway at left.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Composition: Diagonal split: the man's big face upper right, the woman small in a vertical frame at upper left, bottles and a clock at the bottom, with the title at the bottom center.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Medium: Sepia-tinted black-and-white photographic collage, high contrast, with some grain.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Typography: Big red stencil-like all-caps title in two lines at the bottom center, with a thin sans-serif credit in white below; the red letters sit over the dark photo with a rough, flat finish.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Color and light: Sepia, black and cream with a strong red title; low-key film noir lighting from the side.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense man on the phone, torn between a pressing call and a woman waiting.
0441_the-small-back-room.jpg.Visual idea: Scale contrast between the foreground man and a distant woman frames a split between work and love.

0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.People: A group of about twelve small children in patterned kimonos posed in rows with a woman on crutches at the center, tiny against the beach; in the right foreground a large man bends over a tripod camera, half-body, photographing them. Photographer and group face each other across the beach.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Composition: Wide horizon at mid-height with a hazy sky above and a pebbly beach below; the group sits lower left, the photographer right foreground, so the diagonal runs from camera to subjects. The huge script title sweeps across the middle, diagonal and wrapping the group.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Medium: Soft black-and-white photograph with a gray gradient sky; clean flat white vector lettering over it.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Typography: Enormous white flourished script, split into three stacked lines ('Twenty-', 'four', 'Eyes') with swashes that cross the whole poster and loop around the children; the hyphen is cut across the line break and the Y tail extends into the photographer area. Small sans 'a Keisuke Kinoshita film' nestled in the curl. Hand-lettered, ornate, interacts with the image by encircling the group.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Color and light: Pale silver-gray monochrome with white type; soft hazy overcast light.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Story it suggests: A teacher and her young pupils pose for a photograph by the sea, a moment already looking like a memory.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Visual idea: The looping script wraps the children like a frame, and the camera in the corner makes the whole poster a photo being taken.
0442_twenty-four-eyes.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Japanese humanist drama with a nostalgic, calligraphic modern reissue design.

0443_la-ronde.jpg.People: One man in a top hat and tailcoat, shown from the waist up, head tilted with a sly look, holding a cane.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Composition: Large diagonal figure from lower left to upper center; the handwritten title curves across the top; empty burgundy at right with a few leaf-like gold flecks at the top right.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and ink painting with white gouache highlights, drips and torn white edges, on a flat burgundy field.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Typography: Big white loose handwritten script title spanning the top, overlapping the hat; a small lighter serif credit at right middle. Hand-lettered, flowing like a brush line.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Color and light: Deep burgundy, black and white with gold-green accents and a small red flower; flat, theatrical.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Story it suggests: A debonair gentleman sets out on a romantic evening.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Visual idea: Looping handwriting suggests a round or circle of romance, a dance.
0443_la-ronde.jpg.Feels like: Hand-painted elegant French romantic comedy of the 1950s.

0444_le-plaisir.jpg.People: One woman in profile, from shoulders up, large, with a cigarette in red-lipped mouth, an earring and necklace, looking up and to the right.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Composition: The figure fills the lower left and middle, curving smoke trail rising to the right, the flowing title across the top, bits of flowers at the bottom right.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Medium: Watercolor and ink with white gouache, visible brush marks, torn paper edges, and a flat sky-blue ground.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Typography: Large, light white hand-brushed script title across the top, with a small serif credit at the upper right. Loose and flowing; the smoke line echoes the letter curves.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Color and light: Soft sky blue and white with red lips and flower accents; light, airy, flat.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman muses over her cigarette.
0444_le-plaisir.jpg.Visual idea: The smoke and handwriting share the same curved line, making the title feel like smoke.

0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.People: One woman, large, shown from the chest up, with red-orange curled hair, red lips and a sparkling heart-shaped earring, gazing up and away.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Composition: Her face sits right of center on a black background, the title zigs diagonally down the left from upper right to the left side in white script, with a credit at lower right.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache painting with rough white edges against flat black ink.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Typography: Giant white handwritten script in several lines, slanted and sweeping, with a long swash tail flying out of the top right; ellipsis after 'de'. Brush-lettered and expressive.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and soft violet skin with red lips and orange hair; glamorous spotlight feel.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Story it suggests: A poised woman's calm face hides emotion around a sparkling jewel.
0445_the-earrings-of-madame-de.jpg.Visual idea: The earring is the single bright sparkle that holds the portrait, and the swash tail is like a trailing ribbon.

0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.People: Two figures, a man in a gray suit and a woman in a patterned kimono, standing side by side at a railing in the lower panel, both looking left, mid-distance.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Composition: Three horizontal bands: factory smokestacks at the top, a blue band with a centered white title box in the middle, a couple at a railing in the bottom; strongly stacked and symmetrical, with the vertical posts echoing the chimneys.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Medium: Color film stills with visible grain, and a blue textured painted or printed middle band.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Typography: Small elegant serif title in a white box with a double-line border, centered in the blue band, about a third of the width; a vertical column of Japanese characters in a white tab at the right. Quiet typeset, framed like a label.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue sky, red-and-white stripes, deep indigo band; flat daylight.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet pair stand apart looking at something off-frame, near industrial towers.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Visual idea: Chimneys above and the couple below mirror each other, with the title as a calm label between.
0446_an-autumn-afternoon.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese domestic drama, calm and formal.

0447_le-doulos.jpg.People: Four elements: a hand holding a revolver aimed upward-left, and three cut-out faces (a man large at lower left, a woman looking down in the middle, an older man at right), all floating without bodies.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Composition: Everything is tilted on a diagonal axis in a black void: the gun hand above, the title bar slanting across the middle, the faces clustered below.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic cutouts with grain, set on flat black ink with a single pink shape.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Typography: Chunky white sans-serif title slanted on the diagonal, mid-lower, with the L replaced by a pink pistol silhouette; small tilted credit above. Heavy, bold, integrated with the image through the pistol letter.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with one hot-pink accent and a cyan band at left; harsh spot-lit contrast.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Story it suggests: Three people orbit a loaded gun in a crime where trust is unclear.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Visual idea: The letter L becomes a handgun, merging title and threat.
0447_le-doulos.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French crime thriller, stylish and modernist.

0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.People: One man shown from the chest up, arm stretched upward holding a pistol with the barrel pointing up and left; his face is partly turned and shadowed on the right.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from the upper left gun down to the lower right face and title; the rest is black void; title stacked in the lower right.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photo cut out on flat black, with a rough grain.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Typography: Large tilted bold sans-serif title in white and blue, stacked in two lines (SOUFFLE is the biggest, in blue), with yellow and blue vertical credit lines on its left, angled to match the gun; heavy and punchy.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Color and light: Black, white with saturated blue and yellow type; hard side light.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Story it suggests: A hunted man points a gun, his body tilted as if mid-motion.
0448_le-deuxieme-souffle.jpg.Visual idea: A diagonal composition turns the arm and gun into a line pointing out of the frame.

0449_missing.jpg.People: One young man at the left on a balcony, seen from behind in shorts and a T-shirt, looking toward a helicopter; the helicopter has crew visible but tiny.
0449_missing.jpg.Composition: The top third is empty white with a credit line along the photo edge, the photo below is split diagonally by the balcony railing, with a bay and mountains behind; title at the bottom right is cut off at the bottom.
0449_missing.jpg.Medium: Faded color photograph with warm film grain, set against flat white paper.
0449_missing.jpg.Typography: Heavy sans-serif title at the bottom right, with the letter I missing, cut off by the bottom edge; a colored credit line at the top right is cropped by the photo edge. Typeset but deliberately cropped, with a missing letter.
0449_missing.jpg.Color and light: Teal sea and sky, red-brown balcony, hazy sunlit daylight, a washed-out look.
0449_missing.jpg.Story it suggests: A man sees a military helicopter swooping near a seaside town, and something is wrong.
0449_missing.jpg.Visual idea: The missing letter and the cropped text echo the title's absence.

0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.People: Three young men standing full-body in a row on a lawn at the bottom, one smoking, one with hands in pockets, one holding out a lit bottle rocket; they are small and separate.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Composition: Layered bands: pink sky with title, a long two-story motel, a fenced pool, a big green lawn, and the three men along the bottom; symmetric motel and central pool.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Medium: Flat ink-and-colour illustration with fine line hatching and stippled textures, like a risograph or screenprint.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Typography: Big bold red hand-drawn sans-serif title in two lines at the top center, with small yellow hand-lettered cast credits floating next to each man on the green. Casual and naive, color-matched to the drawing.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Color and light: Bubblegum pink, grass green and red, with bright yellow accents; flat and sunny.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Story it suggests: Three slackers goof around at a drab motel with a firework.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Visual idea: A tidy, deadpan diagram of suburban boredom, with names placed like labels.
0450_bottle-rocket.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American indie comedy, quirky and pastel.

0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.People: Four: a smiling swordsman in a red vest with a raised sword and a rose; two scowling swordsmen in hats reaching in from the left; a woman in a low-cut dress in the foreground looking up and aside.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Composition: Crossing swords make an X across the sky at the center, with the woman anchored lower left and the swordsman right; a stone wall runs along the bottom; the title at the top.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Medium: Hand-colored illustration over pencil lines, like a painted lobby card, with soft shading.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Typography: Large cream swashy italic title at the top right, 'Fanfan' bigger than 'la Tulipe', tilted, overlapped by the swords; credit in a matching cream script at the bottom. Playful and hand-lettered, sitting against the sky.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Color and light: Bright blue sky with red, green, mustard and pink costume colors; flat sunny daylight.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful, carefree rogue fights off several attackers while a woman watches.
0451_fanfan-la-tulipe.jpg.Visual idea: The crossed blades create energy and an X-shaped frame around the title.

0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.People: No people visible, only a faint shadow near the base of the wall.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Composition: A tall concrete wall runs diagonally from the lower left up to the right with barbed wire coiled along its top; a distant building at left; title stacked along the right side.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Typography: Huge condensed white sans-serif all caps stacked in four lines, with 'SPY' and 'COLD' enlarged, right-aligned, laid over the wall texture and following its tilt; no other text.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Color and light: Grayscale with a black night sky; harsh, cold, flat lighting.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Story it suggests: A fortified border where someone is on the wrong side of the wall.
0452_the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold.j.Visual idea: The wall and the enormous type are equally massive, so the title seems built into the barrier.

0453_chungking-express.jpg.People: A boy or young man in large profile close-up at the right, face lowered, partly in shadow; a second blurred figure behind at left, out of focus; a hand fragment at lower left.
0453_chungking-express.jpg.Composition: Large face cropping off the upper right, soft diagonal toward the lower right chin; blurred second figure left of center; title centered lower.
0453_chungking-express.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with visible grain, shallow depth of field, soft blurred focus.
0453_chungking-express.jpg.Typography: Small wide-tracked white thin sans capitals 'CHUNGKING EXPRESS' centered in the lower third, with a delicate script 'a film by' and spaced capitals below; typeset and light, floating over the blur.

0457_magnificent-obsession.jpg.People: Two: a woman, large, seen from the side with her face tilted up, wearing a strapless gown and a pearl necklace, cradling a man's head against her; the man, smaller and lower, eyes closed, being held.

0460_simon-of-the-desert.jpg.People: One bearded man, half body, tilted back with a hand pressed over his eyes and mouth open, filling the lower left. A passenger jet crosses the sky above (an object, not a person).

0475_the-friends-of-eddie-coyle.jpg.Medium: Photographic film stills with film grain, separated by thin cream gaps, with printed flat cream background.
0475_the-friends-of-eddie-coyle.jpg.Typography: 'THE FRIENDS OF EDDIE COYLE' in thin black condensed sans with FRIENDS bold, about a sixth of the height, right-aligned in the cream area, with 'A PETER YATES FILM' below. Typeset and clean.
0475_the-friends-of-eddie-coyle.jpg.Color and light: Warm browns, black, and a bright lime-yellow car; flat 1970s light.
0475_the-friends-of-eddie-coyle.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's tired face above a home invasion, with the lone car outside.
0475_the-friends-of-eddie-coyle.jpg.Visual idea: The top-to-bottom stack goes from close face to scene to distant landscape, like a zoom out.

0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.People: Two people, half faces of a man at left and a woman at right, cropped at the edges, looking out; a black gap between them.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Composition: Symmetrical: a framed box with two half faces on opposite edges and a black keyhole shape in the middle; title centered below.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Medium: Smooth glossy studio photographs, retouched, on solid black.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Typography: 'The Curious Case Of' in italic serif above 'BENJAMIN BUTTON' in large serif caps, centered, about a tenth tall, in taupe; two actor names in small caps at top. Typeset, elegant.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Color and light: Warm skin tones against deep black; soft studio lighting.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Story it suggests: Two people look out, separated by a dark space between them.
0476_the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button.Visual idea: Two half faces make a vase or keyhole in the gap, suggesting a connection across time.

0477_bergman-island.jpg.People: One elderly man, half body, looking at the camera, large at left in a leather jacket.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Composition: The man fills the left half, the right a seascape with a pine tree and pebbly shore; title top right.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Medium: Casual, flat snapshot-like color photograph, digital video look.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Typography: Serif caps 'BERGMAN ISLAND' at top right, about a tenth tall, black on the sky; 'A DOCUMENTARY BY MARIE NYREROD' in smaller serif below. Typeset, left aligned.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue sky, grey shore, green pine, brown jacket; bright overcast daylight.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Story it suggests: An old man stands by the sea, looking at us as if he is guiding a visit.
0477_bergman-island.jpg.Visual idea: Man and landscape as one, a portrait of a place.

0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Composition: Text-only layout: four stacked lines (LAST / YEAR / AT / MARIENBAD) with director credit below, staggered, with double rules beside LAST and YEAR and flanking AT. Everything is white-on-white and centred, with the logo at top left.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Medium: Embossed or debossed paper look: white letters raised from a pearly grey-white surface with soft shadows and a slight gradient sheen, like blind embossing.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Typography: Big slab-serif capitals, letterspaced, stepping left and right in a zigzag; lines of different scale (LAST, YEAR big; AT smaller; MARIENBAD wide). White on white means the type is only visible by soft drop shadow and the double bar rules.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Color and light: White and pale silver-grey with no hue; soft, even, almost shadowless light.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Story it suggests: Something hard to make out or remember, nearly erased.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Visual idea: The title almost vanishes into its surface, as faded memory.
0478_last-year-at-marienbad.jpg.Feels like: Minimal, ghostly, 1960s European modernism translated into a quiet modern packaging.

0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Composition: Top-down still life: a big white plate dead center with a folded napkin, a fork and a knife standing as two vertical lines; near-perfect symmetry around the vertical axis. Title in the empty lower brown area.
0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Medium: Glossy product photograph of silverware and plate on a dark brown textured ground, with handwritten script around the plate rim.
0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Typography: Shaky, hand-scrawled gold-beige letters, lowercase and uppercase mixed, in three loose lines with the director credit as a second small block tilted next to it, at the bottom right-center; more handwritten ink around the plate rim reads like notes or confession (partly hidden).
0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Color and light: Deep chocolate brown, white and silver, cream-gold type; soft overhead restaurant light with specular highlights on metal.
0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Story it suggests: A dinner table set for conversation, with scribbled thoughts all around the plate.
0479_my-dinner-with-andre.jpg.Visual idea: The empty plate stands for the film's only event, a meal and talk, with handwriting on the plate as the spoken words.

0480_the-human-condition.jpg.People: A line of about nine small silhouetted people with hats walking up a diagonal slope from lower left to upper right, tiny figures.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Composition: A strong diagonal from lower left to upper right splits the poster into sky (upper left) and black ground (lower right); the huge brush calligraphy sits at the bottom right.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with an ink brush calligraphy in white.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Typography: Large white brush-painted Japanese characters at bottom, half the height, ragged brush strokes; small olive 'THE HUMAN CONDITION' and 'A FILM BY MASAKI KOBAYASHI' at the mid-left, typeset.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and cloud grey; stark light.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Story it suggests: A column of tired people trudges up a hill under a big sky.
0480_the-human-condition.jpg.Visual idea: The slope turns the figures into a procession, the black mass of earth looming.

0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.People: One woman, a large close-up face in half body with her eyes glancing sideways, repeated twice, once large, then cropped at the bottom.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Composition: Vertical bands of blue, cream and red; the face repeated in two stacked panels, with the title running vertically down the right.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with posterized color overlays and torn paper posters background; flat color blocks.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Typography: Huge white and blue sans-serif caps 'MADE IN U.S.A' rotated 90 degrees on the right, repeated and cut off at the bottom (DE IN); handwritten 'Godard' above; tiny credits on the bottom right. Overlaps the red panel.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Color and light: Blue, white and red with black; bright, flat, graphic.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman glances sideways, suspicious, as if being followed.
0481_made-in-u-s-a.jpg.Visual idea: The repetition and the blue-white-red split make a flag and a double-take.

0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.People: One woman, a half-body three-quarter profile with long hair, shown twice, in the upper right and lower left panels. No one else visible; a tower block appears in the upper left.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Composition: A grid of unequal black-ruled panels like a comic or contact sheet; the giant white numerals 2 OR 3 run down the center axis and overlap the panel lines. The two portraits sit diagonally opposite each other.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Medium: Slightly grainy color film stills with thick hand-ruled black lines; faded 1960s film color.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Typography: Huge white sans '2 OR 3' stacked vertically in the center, about the full height of the poster, overlapping panels; smaller white 'THINGS I KNOW ABOUT HER' and 'A FILM BY JEAN-LUC GODARD' at either side. Typeset, white, clean.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue with brown hair and a bit of red; cool, soft daylight.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks away from the city, lost in thought, split between two frames.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Visual idea: Panels and doubled portraits suggest multiple views of one person, with numbers like a count.
0482_2-or-3-things-i-know-about-her.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave, modern graphic design.

0483_repulsion.jpg.People: One woman, face looking up in fear in a narrow vertical slice, with the rest of her as a black silhouette arm reaching down. Reads as a shadow arm: the black shape is an arm and hand.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Composition: A tall vertical strip bends like a long arm down the left-center, ending in a hand at the bottom; the rest of the white page is empty, and the title sits at right of center.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photo inside a solid black silhouette, flat white paper.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Typography: 'REPULSION' in a heavy italic sans that fades from black to grey, about a tenth tall, right of the arm; magenta-red 'ROMAN POLANSKI'S' above in smaller italic. Typeset.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with one crimson accent in the credit; stark flat light.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Story it suggests: A frightened woman is trapped within a threatening shadowy limb.
0483_repulsion.jpg.Visual idea: The face is inside an arm and hand, as if something is reaching for her, or her own body is the danger.

0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.People: One woman, half body, seated at a kitchen table drinking from a glass; in the lower copy of the frame she is absent, leaving an empty glass.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Composition: A symmetrical stack of two near-identical frames, top with the woman and bottom without; bottle at left and thermos at right in each, title between at center-right.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Medium: Photographic film still with the faded color of 1970s film stock, a flat locked-off look.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Typography: Serif title in white lowercase mix 'Jeanne Dielman 23, quai du Commerce 1080 Bruxelles' in 3 lines at the middle right, about a twelfth of the height, 'Chantal Akerman' in bold; typeset, overlapping the tabletop.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Color and light: Mustard yellow tiles, orange table, red and silver thermos; flat indoor light.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Story it suggests: A woman sits alone in a kitchen, and the repeated frame shows her gone.
0484_jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-.Visual idea: Spot-the-difference doubling suggests routine, repetition and absence.

0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.People: Two women, half bodies, drawn at the bottom of the poster: one at left with dark hair and eyes closed, painting her nails; one at right with blonde hair, hand on her head, looking away.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Composition: A cream band at the top holds the title in the upper right, and the illustration fills the lower third as a horizontal strip with the two figures side by side.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Medium: Pen-and-ink cross-hatching with watercolor washes of pink and yellow on paper; hand-drawn illustration.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Typography: Thin, monoline, art-deco-like lowercase 'The Last Days of Disco', about a third of the poster's height in four lines, charcoal; 'a film by Whit Stillman' in the same hand. Handlettered, airy, in the cream space.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper, charcoal black and pink skin; flat, soft light.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Story it suggests: Two friends are preoccupied in separate worlds.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Visual idea: Cross-hatching makes a netted, fabric-like background behind modern women.
0485_the-last-days-of-disco.jpg.Feels like: Wry 1990s indie comedy of manners, illustrated.

0486_homicide.jpg.People: One man, a tiny black silhouette standing on the sidewalk at upper left; no one else.
0486_homicide.jpg.Composition: The upper third is a collage cityscape with a pole, mailbox and building and yellow tape; the big lower two-thirds is empty tan paper with two dark smears running diagonally.
0486_homicide.jpg.Medium: Halftone and typewriter-print, rubber-stamp texture, collage of cut paper in orange and black on tan cardboard.
0486_homicide.jpg.Typography: Typewriter-style 'Homicide' with 'A film by David Mamet' below, about a twentieth of the height, left-aligned in the lower left, dark brown. Looks typed, with uneven ink.
0486_homicide.jpg.Color and light: Tan, orange-brown and black, with a yellow tape; flat, warm.
0486_homicide.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands near a taped-off crime scene in an empty street.
0486_homicide.jpg.Visual idea: Smear marks on blank paper look like skid marks or strokes of evidence; emptiness is the clue.
0486_homicide.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American crime drama, in a case-file look.

0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.People: Two people: a woman in a tilted close-up face at center and a man's face half cropped at the upper left, hand at chin. A tiny sailing ship at right.
0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.Composition: The woman's face tilts diagonally across the center; the man's cropped face and hand at left; a black cartouche with the title at the bottom.
0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.Medium: Very high-contrast black-and-white photography, nearly posterized with grain, like newsprint.
0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.Typography: Serif caps 'THAT HAMILTON WOMAN' in white inside a black ornamental plaque with swirls, at the bottom, about a tenth tall; script 'an Alexander Korda film' below. Typeset, classic.
0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks down in thought as a man looks on, with ships in the distance.
0487_that-hamilton-woman.jpg.Visual idea: The woman's face fills the sky with a ship at the edge, linking romance and sea.

0488_howards-end.jpg.People: One woman, seen from behind in a long dress walking toward a house, full body, drawn faintly.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Composition: The figure sits at left-center in a meadow path leading up to a cottage at the top; the right side is empty white with the title at lower right.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Medium: Fine pencil and pen drawing, loose hatching, on white paper.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Typography: 'HOWARDS END' in large olive-green serif caps at right of center, about a tenth tall; italic 'Merchant Ivory Productions presents E. M. Forster's' above and small caps credits below. Typeset, elegant.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Color and light: White paper, grey pencil, and soft green type; light airy daylight.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman walks quietly toward a country house.
0488_howards-end.jpg.Visual idea: Pencil sketch suggests an architectural study and a longing for the house.

0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.People: Two drawn faces in profile-like line art, one blue and one yellow, overlapping; they are line drawings, not photographs.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Composition: The two oversized heads overlap at center-top, with continuous looping lines running off the edges; the title block sits in the lower third, left-aligned.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink on orange, with single-weight marker-like continuous line drawings, no shading.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Typography: Lowercase yellow 'monsoon' above big blue caps 'WEDDING', then blue 'and seven short films' and magenta 'directed by MIRA NAIR', about a tenth tall for the title, left-aligned and staggered. Typeset, rounded sans, colors matching the faces.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange, cyan, lemon yellow and magenta; flat, bright, no light source.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people joined together, sharing a line and a gaze, as in a pairing.
0489_monsoon-wedding.jpg.Visual idea: A single continuous line links the two faces, like a bond; the magenta dot reads as a bindi.

0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.People: One man in a long dark overcoat, full body, standing on a ledge, head bowed, with a faint translucent angel wing behind him (the wing looks like a ghostly overlay).
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Composition: A central vertical figure on a pedestal rising out of clouds, with the city seen far below; the title scratched across the middle at his chest and the credit near the bottom.
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photo with a misty, soft overlay and scratchy hand-drawn lettering.
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Typography: Thin scratchy white capitals 'WINGS OF DESIRE', spread out wide with gaps between letters and broken with scribble lines, about a tenth tall, crossing over the figure's chest; small spaced hand-drawn 'A FILM BY WIM WENDERS' near the bottom, black.
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Color and light: Soft greys and white clouds, black coat; hazy diffuse light.
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary being watches over a city from a high perch, burdened with longing.
0490_wings-of-desire.jpg.Visual idea: The wing is visible only as a ghost, so the angel is almost an absence.

0491_z.jpg.People: A crowd of helmeted figures, blue-helmeted guards at the top, blurry and repeated; one man in a brown coat at the lower right with head thrown back and hands on his head, mouth open.
0491_z.jpg.Composition: A giant 'Z' fills the center, splitting the picture; the guards up top and the screaming man lower right form a diagonal.
0491_z.jpg.Medium: Blown-up grainy color film still, out of focus, with a distressed rough-textured letter.
0491_z.jpg.Typography: One giant white distressed 'Z' covering about two thirds of the height, with ragged, eaten edges showing the picture through, and a small serif credit below; the letter dominates the image and slashes it in a diagonal stroke.
0491_z.jpg.Color and light: Deep blue, navy, brown and white; harsh, flat, street-level light.
0491_z.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in anguish before a wall of police.
0491_z.jpg.Visual idea: A single slash-like letter that cuts through the scene like a mark of violence.
0491_z.jpg.Feels like: Political thriller, late 1960s, gritty protest-era graphic.

0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.People: No people. A cigarette at the bottom center with smoke that forms a ghostly Christmas tree.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Composition: Strong central axis: the star at the top, the smoke tree in the middle, the cigarette at the bottom, in vertical symmetry on a flat blue ground.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Medium: Photographic smoke, composited over a linen-cloth texture, with a gold glossy star.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Typography: Wide white condensed sans 'A CHRISTMAS TALE' across the top, about a tenth tall, with the star overlapping the S/T; 'A Film By' in script, then white 'ARNAUD DESPLECHIN' at the bottom, with the cigarette cutting between letters. Typeset, white.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue-grey with white smoke and a single warm gold star.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Story it suggests: A festive symbol made from a cigarette's smoke, suggesting something fragile and disappearing.
0492_a-christmas-tale.jpg.Visual idea: The smoke tree turns holiday cheer into something unhealthy and fleeting.

0493_gomorrah.jpg.People: One slim youth, a giant, nearly naked in briefs and sneakers, striding over a city holding a pistol, head bowed. Scale is surreal, like a giant.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Composition: The giant figure on a diagonal across the left half; the city bay and volcano below him; the title stacked in the upper right.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Medium: Photomontage of a photographic figure on an aerial city photograph, slightly faded as in old print.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Typography: Huge off-white slab-like stencil caps 'GOM ORR AH' broken into stacked chunks at the upper right, about half the poster's height; small 'A FILM BY MATTEO GARRONE'. Distressed texture, overlapped by clouds.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue sky, grey bay, red rooftops, warm skin; hazy daylight.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy with a gun looms over a city like something he owns or is trapped by.
0493_gomorrah.jpg.Visual idea: The enormous scale suggests a boy who grows to loom over the city, and the broken title cracks the word.

0494_downhill-racer.jpg.People: One skier, motion-blurred, crouched at the lower right, tilted along the slope.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from upper left down to lower right: the title tilted with the slope, the blurred racer at the end, and white space around.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Medium: Overexposed, blown-out color photograph with motion blur and grain; the type is flat tinted ink.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Typography: Heavy tilted condensed caps 'DOWNHILL RACER' in pale blue-grey shades running diagonally down, about a third tall, with tilted credit lines above and below. Typeset, matching the slope; the colors fade in step.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Color and light: White snow with cold blue and teal; bright, hazy, washed out.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Story it suggests: A racer speeds down a slope, nothing but blur and white.
0494_downhill-racer.jpg.Visual idea: The title itself slants as the slope, so the type is also racing downhill.

0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.People: Dozens of close-up faces, 48 or so, each in its own small rounded-corner screen; a few show two people together. They are all tight face shots of anguished, laughing, shouting or weeping expressions, with no relation between neighbors beyond sharing the grid.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Composition: A strict 6-column by 8-row grid of identical rounded-rectangle TV-screen frames on white, with gutters between. The big title block overprints the right and lower-middle of the grid, breaking the regularity.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic stills with high contrast and visible video-like grain, placed on flat white paper. The lettering is flat solid ink.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy sans-serif caps stacked in four lines (THE / GOLDEN / AGE / OF) down the right side, then TELEVISION across the lower third, each line flush right and large enough to cover whole screens. Flat metallic gold-tan, typeset, laid over the images so faces are partly hidden.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Color and light: Neutral grayscale pictures on white with a single muted gold for the title; flat, even light.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Story it suggests: A wall of emotional, melodramatic faces suggests many small human dramas playing out at once.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Visual idea: A grid of tiny TV screens standing in for the medium itself, a collage of expressions as an anthology.
0495_the-golden-age-of-television.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century broadcast-era anthology, a modern archival collection design with 1950s TV nostalgia.

0496_che.jpg.People: One man, shown as a huge head and shoulders filling the poster, facing the viewer. He wears a beret with a star and has long hair and a beard. It is a stylized graphic portrait, not a plain photo.
0496_che.jpg.Composition: Centered, frontal, symmetrical-ish portrait occupying about 85 percent of the frame, with the face in the upper-middle and title anchored at the bottom. Strong vertical stack of beret, face, title.
0496_che.jpg.Medium: Flat two-color screenprint look: black ink over orange with a speckled, slightly worn paper grain. The high-contrast threshold shapes lose all midtones.
0496_che.jpg.Typography: Short title in extra-bold slab-serif capitals across the bottom, about a quarter of the poster height, cream colored with a speckled, distressed texture. It sits in the black of the shoulders and overlaps the figure's clothing.
0496_che.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange and black with an off-white accent; flat, no real light, graphic and hot.
0496_che.jpg.Story it suggests: A defiant, iconic figure gazing out at the viewer, presented like a rallying image.
0496_che.jpg.Visual idea: The portrait is reduced to a protest-poster stencil, so the person becomes a symbol.

0497_rome-open-city.jpg.People: None. A few hand-stamped numerals (9, 8, 14) appear but no figures.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Composition: A large irregular circle sits just right of center and below the middle, surrounded by other roughly cut shapes, all outlined by zigzag stitching lines. The pieces look like patchwork panels filling the whole frame.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Medium: Close photograph of worn cloth or canvas with faint stamped markings and map-like printed lines, rendered in high-contrast black and white with a coarse dotted grain. Thick black zigzag thread stitches trace the edges.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Typography: Small to medium title in black geometric sans-serif caps inside the circle, centered, with a tiny widely letterspaced credit line above and below. Typeset, clean, quiet against the busy cloth.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale, pale gray fabric with bold black stitching; flat, slightly harsh light.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Story it suggests: A mended, stamped piece of fabric hints at a hurried, makeshift survival in a wartime setting.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Visual idea: Stitched cloth as a map of a city, a patchwork that is both repaired and marked by official stamps.
0497_rome-open-city.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century wartime documentary, contemporary art-house design with textile found-object texture.

0498_paisan.jpg.Composition: Split vertically in two: pale frayed cloth on the left, dark cloth with large star-shaped cutouts on the right, joined by a seam running slightly right of center. The title straddles the seam in the middle.
0498_paisan.jpg.Medium: Macro photograph of woven cloth, showing threads, a torn hole with loose strands, seam stitching and linen texture, in monochrome with fine grain.
0498_paisan.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized wide-tracked geometric sans-serif caps, centered over the seam. The letters flip color, black on the light side and white on the dark side, so the type is split by the same division as the image. Small letterspaced credit lines above and below.
0498_paisan.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray; soft even light that emphasizes thread texture.
0498_paisan.jpg.Story it suggests: A torn, mended flag-like cloth implies two sides stitched together and damaged.
0498_paisan.jpg.Visual idea: The title letters invert color across the seam, echoing a divided cloth with stars.
0498_paisan.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century wartime, rendered with a contemporary tactile minimalism.

0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Composition: A ring of rubble and broken stones frames a clean white cloth patch in the middle, a vignette framing; the title block sits center, with credit above and below, and bright space at the lower center. Large dark stones crowd the corners.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph, macro close-up of stones and weave of cloth, high detail, a slightly gritty look.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Typography: Bold geometric sans title in near-black capitals, two lines, about half the poster width, centered on the white cloth; small wide-spaced sans credits above and below. Clean typeset, sitting in the empty clearing.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray, with hard directional light on the rubble and a pale center.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Story it suggests: A blank, cleared space amid wreckage, as if life is rebuilt or buried among ruins.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Visual idea: A white patch inside a circle of debris, a blank page surrounded by destruction.
0499_germany-year-zero.jpg.Feels like: Postwar neorealism, with a contemporary minimal restoration design.

0500_roberto-rossellinis-war-trilogy.jpg.People: None visible; at most a speck of figure on the rooftop. The subject is a destroyed building.

0501_paris-texas.jpg.People: None visible; the only human trace is a billboard.
0501_paris-texas.jpg.Composition: A big empty pale sky takes the top half; a broken billboard on four posts sits left of center at the mid-height, with the horizon line low behind it. The desert scrub fills the lower third, with the sign pulled to the left leaving a wide open space at the right.

0502_revanche.jpg.Medium: Photographic, film-like with soft grain and deep blacks, slightly saturated, with strong contrast between silhouette and sky.
0502_revanche.jpg.Typography: Very large bold white sans-serif caps spanning the full width in the black middle band, with the letters tightly packed. A small credit line right-aligned above. Typeset, flat white, no distortion.

0503_lola-montes.jpg.Typography: Large hand-lettered brush script in black, spanning the top half, with tall slanting letters and ink drips; it feels painted and energetic. Small red serif credit at the foot, with the italic lowercase words in a lighter style.

0503_lola-montes.jpg.Visual idea: Fashion-sketch glamour; the spontaneous brushwork lettering matches the painted portrait.

0504_hunger.jpg.People: One man, shown in an extreme tight crop of a bowed head and bare shoulder and arm, with a hand at the bottom edge. The head tilts down and away so the face is mostly ear, jaw and hair; the body fills the left half.

0504_hunger.jpg.Typography: Small white sans-serif title and credit, right-aligned in the black area at lower right, taking up well under a tenth of the poster. Typeset, plain, no effects.

0504_hunger.jpg.Visual idea: Body treated as landscape or sculpture, fragmented and cropped to show strain without a recognizable face.

0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.People: Two elderly figures, a man and a woman, drawn full length walking in opposite directions with heads bowed, back to back. They are in the lower third and about a third of the poster height each.
0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Composition: Title at the top, a dense skyline of tall rectangular buildings in the middle, and the two figures in the foreground, mirrored in direction and nearly symmetrical about the center. The gap between them sits on the vertical center line.

0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Typography: Large condensed hand-drawn style caps in light gray in two lines at the top, and a bottom credit line in similar chunky capitals. 0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Color and light: Purple-violet buildings and ground, black night sky, pale gray figures and lettering; moody night, flat color.
0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Story it suggests: Two old people heading apart through an indifferent city at night.
0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Visual idea: The couple's opposed walking directions against a wall of towering buildings expresses separation and being overshadowed by the modern city.
0505_make-way-for-tomorrow.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Art Deco and Depression-era graphic illustration, filtered through contemporary indie comics.

0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.People: One woman in an extreme close-up, face blurred and partly cut off, tongue out, with a gas-mask like object covering the left side of the frame and a hand at lower left holding a flask-like metal object. Her eyes are closed or squinting.

0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus film still with heavy blur, grain and color cast, like a blown-up 16mm frame, with crisp white type on top.
0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.Typography: Very large white dotted-outline capitals (made of tiny dots) in stacked lines: top line spans the full width, IS small, DEAD in the middle, then credit lines at the bottom, all about the same big scale. 0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.Color and light: Dark browns and olive greens with pinkish skin, orange hazard stripes at the left edge; murky, warm interior light.
0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange, intimate, disturbing moment involving a mask and a woman's defiance or play.

0506_dillinger-is-dead.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s European experimental cinema, surreal and pop, with a modern design layer.

0507_bigger-than-life.jpg.People: Three people: a man at left in a white shirt with a fist at his mouth, a woman at right in a green blouse looking up, and a boy in a red shirt seen from behind in the center foreground. 0507_bigger-than-life.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed sans-serif BIGGER and LIFE in white-to-gray gradient fading into black, with a small script word Than between them, filling most of the lower half. Typeset caps with soft metal-like gradient, centered; a tiny credit line at the bottom.

0509_ossos.jpg.People: One young man in a close-up from the chest up, head tilted down and looking away, with a faint pale vertical doorway or window to the right. A single figure, quiet and still.

0509_ossos.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man withdrawn and weighed down, alone in a dim room.
0509_ossos.jpg.Visual idea: The face emerging from darkness with text hung apart in the void, a restrained portrait.
0509_ossos.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European social-realist art film with painterly cinematography.

0510_in-vanda-s-room.jpg.People: One person, seen from above or the side, head bowed so hair and a sliver of face are visible, shoulder and chain necklace at the left. Ambiguous, tucked inside a dark oval of light.

0510_in-vanda-s-room.jpg.Story it suggests: A person withdrawn in a cramped, dim room, perhaps ill or lost in thought.
0510_in-vanda-s-room.jpg.Visual idea: A circle of dim light holding a bowed head, like a private chamber within darkness.

0511_colossal-youth.jpg.People: One older man with a gray-flecked beard, shown head and shoulders, pressing his face against a rough wooden post at the right and glancing sideways out of frame. A single figure, lit sharply.

0512_vivre-sa-vie.jpg.People: One woman in a close-up from behind and the side, head bowed, with a dark bob haircut filling most of the image and her profile partly visible at the lower left. A second person may be implied by an embrace at the lower left, but it is unclear.

0512_vivre-sa-vie.jpg.Visual idea: The title is split like a sentence broken around the image, framing the woman's life in two halves.
0512_vivre-sa-vie.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave early 1960s, with a clean modern Swiss-style layout.

0513_summer-hours.jpg.Composition: Overlapping large flowers, a daisy with yellow center slightly right of the upper center and another cut off at the lower right, blooming out of a bright white haze. 0513_summer-hours.jpg.Medium: Soft, washed-out, double-exposure look with film-like color fringing and blotchy white bleach-out areas, like a damaged or overexposed painting or print.

0515_the-fugitive-kind.jpg.People: Three people: a man in a rough textured jacket dominating the center and right at three-quarter length with hands in his pockets; a dark-haired woman peeking from behind his right shoulder; and a blonde woman at lower left covering her mouth with her hand. 0515_the-fugitive-kind.jpg.Composition: Large central man leaning on a wooden frame, one woman peeking behind him, another small at lower left. A diagonal from the upper left title to the man to the lower-left woman. Title column at left over the wooden wall.

0516_stagecoach.jpg.Feels like: Classic western reissued with a mid-century printed-poster look.

0521_mystery-train.jpg.Typography: Giant chunky white wood-type title MYSTERY TRAIN in two stacked lines across the top, occupying a quarter of the poster, with cast names in tall black condensed caps and the director in heavy slab serif. 0521_mystery-train.jpg.Color and light: Black, saturated yellow-orange, white and red; flat, high-contrast, print-like with no real lighting.
0521_mystery-train.jpg.Story it suggests: A traveling show or odd collection of travelers, announced like a vaudeville or railway-era bill.
0521_mystery-train.jpg.Visual idea: A rock-and-roll handbill where the cast list itself is the picture.
0521_mystery-train.jpg.Feels like: 1950s American handbill and rockabilly gig poster, with Americana kitsch.

0522_red-desert.jpg.People: None visible; the blurry scene contains only a building and sky.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Composition: Very large empty blue-gray sky filling the upper two-thirds, with the title placed right-of-center in the middle. A heavily blurred industrial or warehouse building with a pitched roof sits at the bottom right, and soft clouds behind it.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Medium: Out-of-focus, soft film photograph with fine grain, like a lens blurred into abstract fields of color.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Typography: Thin, light sans-serif title in black at right-of-center, medium-small at about 40 percent of the width, with a small possessive credit line above it. Typeset, right-aligned, calm.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Color and light: Cool desaturated gray-blue with muted beige-gray structures; overcast, diffuse light.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Story it suggests: A flat gray wasteland with an industrial building, an alienating, quiet place.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Visual idea: Defocus turns the landscape into a mood and a feeling of detachment rather than a place.
0522_red-desert.jpg.Feels like: 1960s modernist European art cinema about alienation and industrial landscapes.

0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.People: One tiny figure dangling from a cable car, hanging by the arms below the gondola, at the center of the lower half. A distant, silhouetted human.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Composition: Giant slanted title in the upper half, a big angular mountain range in the lower half with a cable line stretching diagonally from the upper left peak to the right peak. Big diagonal bars in the sky echo the cable.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Medium: Screenprint or linocut feel with flat inks, paper speckle and a rough hand-cut edge on the snow and rocks.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Typography: Tall, slanted, condensed cream capitals and italic letters, with NIGHT TRAIN in huge italic letters, then small 'to' and bold MUNICH at the lower right, all tilting forward. A script credit and bold letters at the bottom. The lettering is nearly as large as the mountains and is poster-like with a handcrafted feel.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Color and light: Chocolate brown sky with cream snow and pale sage-green rock; flat, muted, three-color print.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Story it suggests: A desperate escape or struggle in the mountains, a person hanging from a cable in danger.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Visual idea: The cable and the tilted bold slashes create a sense of precarious dread; the forward-leaning lettering mimics motion.
0523_night-train-to-munich.jpg.Feels like: 1940s wartime thriller poster, vintage travel poster style.

0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.People: None. The room is empty; only objects.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Composition: The top 60 percent is an interior view through a sliding-door opening into a Japanese room with a low table, red kettle, cushion and large grid windows; the lower 40 percent is a flat dark navy band holding the title. Strong horizontals and verticals with deep one-point perspective.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Medium: Clean comic-book style illustration with inked linework, flat fills and hatching; smooth digital color.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Typography: Medium-large condensed serif title in white in two lines (The Only Son / There Was a Father) in the navy band at lower left, with a lighter gray credit line beneath. Typeset, left-aligned, calm, sitting clear of the illustration.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Color and light: Cream and tan with pale blue-gray window panes, a single red kettle accent and deep navy below; soft daylight.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Story it suggests: An empty room waiting for someone to return, quietly domestic.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Visual idea: A room left with the figures absent, with the grid of paper windows doing the framing.
0524_the-only-son-there-was-a-father-two.Feels like: Mid-century Japanese domestic drama, drawn in a contemporary graphic-novel style.

0525_the-only-son.jpg.People: Two figures seen from behind or the side, sitting on the ground: a woman in a teal kimono at left looking off at the factory, and a man in a suit and hat at right hugging his knees with his head lowered. They are medium-small in the lower third.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Composition: A large pale blue sky in the upper two-thirds with the title, and the pair on a sandy ground in the lower third with a factory with smokestacks between them in the distance. The figures sit side by side at slightly different heights, asymmetric.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Medium: Flat, inked comic-book illustration with crisp black line, hatching texture on grass and flat color fills.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized condensed serif title at upper center, with the director's name in white and the title in black on the same line. Typeset, wide, sitting in the empty sky.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue, white smoke and clouds, sand beige, teal and slate gray clothing; calm, flat daylight.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Story it suggests: A mother and son sit quietly together near a factory, lost in thought and unable to say what they feel.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Visual idea: Two bodies turned in different directions at the foot of a smoking industrial building show a gulf between them.
0525_the-only-son.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Japanese family drama in a contemporary illustrated style.

0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.People: Two figures from behind, a man in a black suit and hat and a small boy with a satchel, walking away down a narrow lane. They sit in the lower middle at about a fifth of the poster height.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Composition: A lane narrowing with perspective toward the center, flanked by a large gray wall and roof at right and a hedge at left; the title at the top and a big beige sky of empty space above the figures.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Medium: Flat inked comic-style illustration with crisp black outlines, hatching on hedges and gravel, simple flat fills.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized condensed serif title in two tones, director's name in white and title in black, across the upper area. Typeset, centered, sitting in empty sky.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Color and light: Beige, olive gray, black silhouettes and a small yellow satchel, with teal accents; muted, overcast, quiet.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Story it suggests: A father and son walking away together, the child following the parent's steps.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Visual idea: A man and boy as matching silhouettes in a narrow street, mirroring each other as one generation follows the next.
0526_there-was-a-father.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century Japanese family drama drawn in modern graphic-novel style.

0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.People: One woman, drawn full length in profile, arms raised near her head in a dance-like pose, with ghostly line-echoes of other limbs and figures. A single expressive figure with additional outlined echoes around her.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Composition: A tall S-curved figure fills the center, with a yellow field at left and a black field at right behind her, cutting the poster in two. Handwritten title runs diagonally along the left, beside her hips.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Medium: Flat solid red silhouette with loose gestural drawn lines in yellow, orange and white, like marker or brush-pen drawing; printed flat inks.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered black brush-script title in four stacked lines at the lower left, cursive, loose, with a credit in matching handwriting. Large, over a third of the height, and set in the yellow field, touching the figure's edge. Handwritten and spontaneous.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, yellow and black with orange and white linework; flat, bold, no real lighting.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman dancing or moving with fervor, sensual and anxious at once.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Visual idea: The echoing lines imply motion and repeated gestures, like a dancing body caught in a multiple exposure.
0527_the-secret-of-the-grain.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary Mediterranean art poster with a Matisse-like sensuality.

0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.People: One man in a tight close-up from the chest up, facing the viewer with a thin mustache and wavy hair, eyes shadowed. A single portrait.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Composition: Centered, nearly full-frame head and shoulders, with a block of title text across the lower quarter overlaying the tweed jacket. A classic studio portrait composition with a dark vignette.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Medium: Black-and-white studio portrait photograph with soft focus and fine grain, dramatic chiaroscuro.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Typography: Three lines of Art Deco style all-caps lettering in silver with dark outline across the lower quarter, spanning most of the width, then a slim, decorative line of smaller letters with ornate initial capitals. Typeset, geometric, metallic-looking, overlapping the jacket.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Color and light: Monochrome grays and black; soft, low-key studio light with one side of the face shadowed.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Story it suggests: A brooding, intense gaze from a man half in shadow.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Visual idea: A classic silent-era portrait turned into the cover, with Art Deco inline type to evoke the period.
0528_3-silent-classics-by-josef-von-ster.Feels like: 1920s-30s Hollywood studio portrait and Art Deco title cards.

0529_underworld.jpg.People: One man, huge close-up of the face in three-quarter profile filling the right two thirds, eyes looking out of frame. Shoulders and a tie are faintly visible at the bottom; no one else.
0529_underworld.jpg.Composition: Face pushed to the right, with a dark empty field on the left. A diagonal black bar of shadow cuts across his eyes and nose, and a shattered-glass crack radiates in the left field. The title block sits low in the lower middle.
0529_underworld.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with visible grain and soft focus, glowing highlights and crushed blacks. The crack lines have a glinting, beaded sparkle.
0529_underworld.jpg.Typography: Title in a small-to-medium Art Deco outlined capital face, grey with a dark fill, set low and left of center. Below it a thin, elegant deco script credit line. Both sit over the dark jacket without breaking the image.
0529_underworld.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grey and black. Hard directional light rakes across one side of the face against deep shadow.
0529_underworld.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense, watchful man is caught in a moment of private menace, with something fractured behind him.
0529_underworld.jpg.Visual idea: The cracked glass beside the face suggests a broken mirror or fractured self, and the bar of shadow across the eyes suggests concealment.
0529_underworld.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era or early-sound crime drama, 1920s-30s Hollywood noir lighting, restored as a classic art-house release.

0530_the-last-command.jpg.People: One man, tight close-up from head to chest in three-quarter view, head tilted down, eyes glancing sideways at the viewer. A cross-shaped medal hangs on his collar.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Composition: Face fills the right and center, angled diagonally from upper right down to the lower left. The left third is a blurred, empty grey wall. The medal acts as a secondary focal point in the lower right, and the title sits at the bottom.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with grain, a scuffed or scratched look on the face, and soft vignetting.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Typography: Title in wide outlined deco capitals, grey, medium size, along the bottom, partly over the dark coat. A thin deco script credit line sits underneath.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Color and light: Greys with deep blacks. Soft overhead light picks out wrinkles, hair and a bearded jaw.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Story it suggests: A weathered, battered man with the bearing of an old officer looks down with weary intensity.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Visual idea: The medal against a worn face contrasts past honor with present ruin.
0530_the-last-command.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era melodrama from the late 1920s, a restored art-house classic.

0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.People: One man, close-up from the chest up, wearing a cap and jacket, a cigarette hanging from his lips, eyes squinting sideways at something out of frame.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Composition: Large head on the right with the cap clipped by the top edge, and a diagonal cigarette leading the eye down-left. A soft blurred grey field fills the left, and the title is anchored at the bottom spanning the width.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photo with silky gradients, glossy highlights on leather and skin, a slight vignette and fine grain.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Typography: Title in wide outlined deco capitals, grey, spanning most of the poster width at the bottom, with a thin deco script credit line beneath. It overlaps the dark jacket.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Color and light: Silvery grey with deep blacks. Soft sidelight and a hazy backlit glow suggest smoke or fog.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Story it suggests: A tough, suspicious man sizes up someone near the water's edge.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Visual idea: The cigarette is a single bright diagonal that carries the gaze and mood.
0531_the-docks-of-new-york.jpg.Feels like: Late-1920s silent film, glossy studio-era portraiture, restored classic.

0532_louie-bluie.jpg.People: Three figures drawn as illustration: a grinning man in a plaid jacket and beret holding a violin at the center, a curvy woman in heels on the left, and a horned, grinning devil on the right holding a cauldron. The two side figures peek around the central frame; the man is nearly full length.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Composition: Symmetric trio around a gold picture frame, with the man stepping out of the frame. Below, a swooping white curved band splits the green background and carries the giant title across the lower half.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Medium: Comic-style pen-and-ink illustration with dense crosshatching and flat colored fills in gold, orange and green, printed in a slightly pulpy way.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Typography: Giant hand-lettered bubbly yellow title in two stacked lines with thick black outline and shadow, jammed in quotation marks, about half the poster. A small italic cream credit line sits at the bottom right.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Color and light: Saturated green background, golden yellow, orange and cream. Flat even color with no real light source.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful old musician is flanked by temptation and the devil, as though earthly and devilish forces compete over his fiddle.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Visual idea: The man stepping out of a framed portrait while a woman and a devil flank him recalls a folk morality play.
0532_louie-bluie.jpg.Feels like: 1960s-70s underground comix or old-time music poster, with a vintage hand-lettered feel.

0533_crumb.jpg.People: One man drawn in profile, head and shoulders, wearing a bowler hat and glasses with a grimacing open mouth. A disembodied hand holds a pistol to his temple from the right edge.
0533_crumb.jpg.Composition: Tall central oval vignette on a mustard ground, with the figure facing left and the gun entering from the right. Title sits directly below the oval, with credit near the bottom.
0533_crumb.jpg.Medium: Detailed ink drawing with crosshatching and dense line shading, flat color fills in slate blue and tan, on a paper-like ochre field.
0533_crumb.jpg.Typography: Large chunky cream title in a hand-lettered slab style with black shadow, filling most of the width below the oval. A smaller hand-lettered black credit line at the bottom.
0533_crumb.jpg.Color and light: Mustard ochre, slate blue, cream and brown, matte with no light source.
0533_crumb.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense, anxious man is held at gunpoint, grimacing in dread.
0533_crumb.jpg.Visual idea: A cameo-portrait format used for a violent gag, a classic oval portrait undermined by the pistol.
0533_crumb.jpg.Feels like: Underground comics from the 1960s-90s with an old etching feel.

0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.People: One boy, head and shoulders in profile facing right, looking out of frame, wearing a dark sweater with red trim over a checked scarf. No others.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Composition: Boy in the right half against a nearly empty black field, with the left half dark space holding the title block at mid-height. Subject and title balance across the center line.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Medium: Color photographic film still with fine grain and soft focus, a naturalistic look.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Typography: Title in clean narrow sans-serif capitals, medium size, two-tone: pale blue-grey for the first words and bold white for the last word. A smaller credit line below. Left-aligned and placed over the black.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Color and light: Deep black with a cool blue cast, warm skin tones and red edging. Dim, low-key side light.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet, withdrawn child looks away, isolated and wary.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Visual idea: The boy emerges from darkness, with the empty black standing for loneliness.
0534_l-enfance-nue.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house drama, a restrained social-realist portrait.

0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.People: Two men in close-up facing each other almost nose to nose: a blond man in uniform on the left looks directly out, while the other man is seen from behind, in a cap and white shirt, filling the center. Rows of soldiers or prisoners stand in the background on both sides.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Composition: Overlapping heads in a triangle at center, with a wide horizontal line of tiny figures in a yard behind them. The back of the foreground figure acts as a white field for the title.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Medium: Color photographic film still, slightly overexposed and sharp, with a washed-out look against a white background.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Typography: Large hand-written brush script in black, loose and uneven, in two lines spread over the white shirt, with a star scribble in place of a dot. A small clean sans credit line sits below at left.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Color and light: Olive green, tan, white and blue sky. Bright tropical daylight with a white border.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense face-off between two men in an assembly of troops or prisoners.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Visual idea: The nose-to-nose standoff against rows of lined-up men, with the shirt used as a canvas for handwriting.
0535_merry-christmas-mr-lawrence.jpg.Feels like: 1980s international war drama, with a hand-lettered, art-house feel.

0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.People: A line of tiny soldiers climbs a hillside in the lower left, and three large helmeted soldiers seen from behind fill the bottom edge. Roughly a dozen figures, mostly small, with the big ones cropped.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Composition: Wide landscape: empty overcast sky takes the upper two thirds, a green hill with a diagonal ridge and explosions sits below, and soldiers in the foreground look at it. A thin dark vertical line runs down the whole image at about 70 percent of the width, like a book gutter, and splits the title letters.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Medium: Color photographic film still with a soft, muted grade and a faint fold or crease effect at the vertical line.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Typography: Large dark-red serif capitals in three stacked lines at upper right, splitting along the vertical line so letters are cut and overlap oddly. Italic serif credit lines below. Letters are elegant, typeset and sit on the sky.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Color and light: Cool grey-blue sky, green grass, dark red lettering, orange fireballs. Flat dusk or overcast light.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Story it suggests: Soldiers advance up a quiet hill toward distant explosions, small against vast sky.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Visual idea: A split line like a book spine or fold cuts through the title and the scene, dividing the poster into two halves.
0536_the-thin-red-line.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s literary war drama, meditative and painterly.

0537_the-magician.jpg.People: One face, in extreme close-up, cut into vertical strips so that only a mouth and one dark eye socket are clear. A charcoal-drawn skull-like face overlays the strips.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Composition: Vertical, curtain-like panels slide against each other down the whole poster, with a face glimpsed through the gaps. The title sits at the bottom, with scribbled marks and a roman numeral VI in the lower left.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photo with heavy grain, overlaid by rough charcoal or crayon drawing and smudges.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Typography: Title in wide, distressed, textured grey capitals across the bottom, with letters worn as if printed on rough paper. Small spaced capitals for the credit below. A hand-drawn roman numeral and cross marks add scrawled lettering.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and grey. Harsh light and shadow with deep blacks.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Story it suggests: A masked or painted face appears in glimpses through strips, suggesting hidden identity and occult trickery.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Visual idea: Photo cut into strips and defaced with chalk drawing, like a tarot card or a skull carved over a living face.
0537_the-magician.jpg.Feels like: 1950s gothic art-house horror reimagined with modern gritty collage.

0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.People: One soldier, a huge close-up of the face and shoulders in a helmet, with eyes nearly shut and mouth open. Nothing else.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Composition: Head tilted and lying diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, filling the right two thirds, with a wall of logs at left holding the title. A strap crosses the bottom diagonally.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with heavy grain and dirt on the face, a documentary feel.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Typography: Title in bold, clean geometric sans capitals stacked in three lines at left, white, over the log wall; a thin condensed name line above and a small credit line below. Lettering is typeset and legible, tucked into the left column.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Color and light: Greys, with a bright face against darker surroundings. Flat overcast daylight.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Story it suggests: An exhausted, dirt-covered soldier lies down, possibly dying or dazed, in a trench.
0538_paths-of-glory.jpg.Visual idea: A face that fills the frame and is cut at the helmet, with collar numbers stamped on the neck, turning him into a number.

0539_house.jpg.People: No people. A giant cat-like face with a grinning, fanged mouth fills the poster, while a tiny white haunted house icon sits in the title.
0539_house.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical central face from top to the middle, huge mouth in the center, flaming title across the bottom, and a thin white border all around.
0539_house.jpg.Medium: Flat screen-print style in solid inks with ragged, fuzzy photocopy-like edges, and a few thin whisker scratches. Limited layers.
0539_house.jpg.Typography: Giant wobbly, flame-shaped letters in dark maroon spanning the bottom third, with tiny hand-scrawled white credit and a house icon where the letter U is. Lettering is hand-drawn and melts into the face.
0539_house.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange-red with maroon and cream. Flat, no real light.
0539_house.jpg.Story it suggests: A monstrous grinning cat looms over a dwelling, promising a playful but terrifying haunting.
0539_house.jpg.Visual idea: The cat's smile and the title's flame letters merge into one hungry mouth, and the little house sits as bait.
0539_house.jpg.Feels like: 1970s Japanese psychedelic horror comedy, a camp pop-art poster.

0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.People: Three men shown in separate compartments: a man peeks from a door shaving with lather in the center, a hand with a cigarette appears in a mirror at left, and a pair of legs in slippers at the bottom. Small, partial figures.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Composition: Cutaway cross-section of a train car, like a dollhouse, divided into panels, with a patterned blue ceiling on top and the title across it. Everything is arranged flat and frontal in a grid.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Medium: Watercolor and ink illustration with fine pencil lines, soft washes and visible paper texture.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Typography: Bright yellow hand-painted title in chunky capitals with dashes around it, across the ceiling pattern at top, and small cast credit lines scattered inside each compartment in white or yellow.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Color and light: Blues, mustard-orange, green and a red trunk. Soft, even, flat light.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Story it suggests: Three travelers share cramped quarters, each lost in his own space.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Visual idea: A train car as a doll's house, with each compartment a separate room and credits placed next to each person.
0540_the-darjeeling-limited.jpg.Feels like: Mid-2000s quirky indie comedy with a retro 1970s palette.

0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.People: A man in a dark suit and bow tie holds a small girl in a checked dress who clutches a doll. Two figures, half-body to knees, facing each other and looking close.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Composition: Pair in the middle, lit by a diagonal beam of light across the upper left. Title stacked in the lower right in a narrow column, balancing the pair on the left.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with a warm cream tone.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed Didone serif capitals in cream, stacked in three lines down the right, large, about a third of the poster; small star names at top right, small credit at the bottom.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Color and light: Black and warm cream. A hard slanted spotlight against a dark room.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Story it suggests: A man holds a child tenderly, but his dark suit and close gaze make the embrace feel menacing.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Visual idea: A father figure becoming a predator, with the slanted light acting as a doorway or spotlight and the doll as the child's innocence.
0541_the-night-of-the-hunter.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Hollywood gothic thriller with film noir lighting.

0542_antichrist.jpg.People: Bare human legs, cut at the knees, sit curled in the lower half; only limbs, with faint red scratches. No face.
0542_antichrist.jpg.Composition: Black field with the legs bulging in the center and bottom, and the title across the upper third. A small credit line sits above the title.
0542_antichrist.jpg.Medium: Dark photographic still with soft focus and a shallow depth of field. Title letters made from real twigs and dried plants photographed on black.
0542_antichrist.jpg.Typography: Large title spelled in thin twigs, with grass and a red berry, spanning the entire width, irregular and broken, as if scrawled; a small serif spaced credit above it.
0542_antichrist.jpg.Color and light: Black, skin-beige, faint red and dusty brown. Low-key dim side light.
