0542_antichrist.jpg.Story it suggests: A body curled up in pain in darkness, scratched, with nature spelling out an ominous name.
0542_antichrist.jpg.Visual idea: The title spelled by branches ties the body to nature, as if wounds and twigs are the same thing.

0543_modern-times.jpg.People: One man, a large close-up of the face in a bowler hat with a toothbrush mustache; two gear wheels replace his eyes. The face fades into white on the right side.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetric-ish head filling most of the frame, hat at the top, with the title running along the bottom edge. A rounded white border frames the whole thing.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white halftone-like photo with grain, cut out against white, with the gears as flat graphic shapes in white and black with speckled texture.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Typography: Bold wide slab-serif capitals on one line across the bottom, full width: the first part in grey and the second in black. Typeset and clean; the line anchors the poster.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and grey. Flat, high-key lighting with a bleached face.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Story it suggests: A man whose eyes are replaced by machine parts, as if the mechanical world has taken his sight.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Visual idea: Gears for eyes: a human turned into a machine part.
0543_modern-times.jpg.Feels like: 1930s silent-era comedy given a bold modernist graphic treatment.

0544_head.jpg.People: An empty purple suit with no head, only a floating piece of film strip where the head would be. Nobody is shown.
0544_head.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical stack: credit line at the top, the film strip tilted above, the suit below, all on a folded poster that sits inside a gray metal display frame. A strip of dark metal with bolts runs along the left.
0544_head.jpg.Medium: Photo of a physical poster showing fold creases and paper texture, with the suit in flat duotone purple printing and a cut-out film frame.
0544_head.jpg.Typography: Title in tall thin black sans capitals inside the film frame, and a small purple credit line at the top. The title is tilted with the frame, and the typography is part of the image.
0544_head.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper, purple and gray metal. Flat, even, matte light.
0544_head.jpg.Story it suggests: A man whose head has been replaced by a film frame, as if he is only a screen.
0544_head.jpg.Visual idea: A suit with a film frame for a head: the person is turned into the medium.
0544_head.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s psychedelic pop-art collage, retro cinema display.

0545_easy-rider.jpg.People: No people. A long road winds up through the picture.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Composition: Flag-like stripes and a star field fill the poster; a winding road runs diagonally up from the bottom through the red stripes. The bottom edge of the road is ripped like torn paper.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Medium: Flat screen-print or cut-paper collage with a speckled grain, torn edges, and a gritty paper-like finish.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Typography: Huge blocky, drop-shadowed black capitals on white at the bottom edge, partly cut off by the poster border; small bold credit line above. Chunky retro lettering.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Color and light: Red, black, cream and charcoal. Flat matte inks with no real light.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Story it suggests: A road runs through the heart of a flag, hinting at travel through a land that is cracking apart.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Visual idea: A road cut into the American flag, with the flag torn at the bottom.
0545_easy-rider.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s counterculture road movie, a protest-poster look.

0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.People: One man seated at a piano on the bed of a flatbed truck, small and in profile, wearing sunglasses. Only one figure.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Composition: Sheet music at top, tilted bar crossing it diagonally, title in the middle, and the truck with a piano in the bottom half. Lots of empty pale sky, and the truck is cropped at the bottom.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Medium: Color photo of the truck with a muted 1970s film grade, combined with printed sheet music in a flat gray.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Typography: Title in red-brown serif capitals at the center, medium size, with a small credit line above. The sheet music works as lettering in itself.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue-grey sky, rust brown wood and a warm red title. Soft, hazy daylight.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Story it suggests: A man plays a piano in the open back of a truck on an empty road, as if music belongs to a drifter's life.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Visual idea: A musical score sliced by a diagonal bar echoes a road, and the piano is a misplaced object in a rough landscape.
0546_five-easy-pieces.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American character drama, mellow and melancholic.

0547_drive-he-said.jpg.People: A figure in a baseball-style jersey covers his face with both hands, with an orange where the face should be; below, a woman in white lies in a dark photo on its side. Two figures, one with an obscured face.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Composition: Two stacked posters: a folded paper poster in a black frame with the figure in the top half, and a smaller dark image with the second title overlapping its lower half. Both are centered vertically, forming a double bill.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Medium: Photographic cutouts in halftone black and white, a flat orange fruit, and a duotone blue-grey photo, set on creased paper inside a framed case.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Typography: Bold black condensed sans for the first title, set at upper center; the second title in a large white didone serif italic over the dark photo; small credit lines above each. Different type for each film.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Color and light: Off-white paper, black frame, blue-grey and one orange. Flat even light.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Story it suggests: A man hides behind his hands with a fruit for a face while another image shows someone lying down, suggesting two different stories on one program.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Visual idea: An orange standing in for a face, and a double-feature poster.
0547_drive-he-said.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s New Hollywood double bill, a pop-art feel.

0548_a-safe-place.jpg.People: A man whose face is covered by an orange fruit and his hands, in a letterman-style jacket, at the top; below, a woman in white lies or floats, mirrored in a dark pictorial panel.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Composition: A real poster hanging in a black door frame (frame within frame) with two stacked images: the upper figure centered, the lower rectangle with rounded corners overlapping; a mirrored, symmetrical lower image.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Medium: Photo of a printed poster with fold creases and paper texture; halftone black-and-white photo with one color accent; a video-like glitched dark panel.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Typography: Two titles, 'DRIVE, HE SAID' in bold condensed black sans at top and 'A Safe Place' in white high-contrast serif in the dark panel, with small credit lines; typeset, stacked, placed over images.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Color and light: White paper, black frame, single orange, steel-blue and navy panel; flat, even light.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Story it suggests: A man hides his face behind an orange while a dreamlike woman drifts nearby, two worlds on one wall.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Visual idea: Two posters in one frame, a faceless figure as the visual hook.
0548_a-safe-place.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s counterculture film, displayed as a street poster.

0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.People: A young woman and a young man in tight close-up, cheek to cheek, her eyes closed and his lowered, both in plaid shirts. Intimate and romantic.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Composition: The faces fill the frame, and a vertical torn paper ticket sits at the center, overlapping both faces and carrying the title.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with heavy film grain, and a flat paper ticket with a torn edge.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy condensed black wood-type capitals stacked on the ticket, with smaller lines above and below; the ticket is ripped across the middle, cutting through the word Picture.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Color and light: Greys and black on white. Soft flat daylight.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young people cling together tenderly, and the torn ticket suggests the end of something.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Visual idea: The title printed on a ripped movie ticket laid over a couple, so the ticket stub stands for a memory.
0549_the-last-picture-show.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s American small-town drama, nostalgic and grainy.

0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.People: Two men in long coats, each on a horse, facing each other across a beach. Small to medium, full body and in profile, apart.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical: horses face each other left and right, the beach hotel in the background, framed by a blue rectangle and a yellow title box above. A folded poster sits within a gray framed display case.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white grainy photo on folded paper, with a flat yellow box, and a case photographed with studs along the left.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Typography: Title in bold dark green spaced capitals inside a yellow box at the top, medium size; small blue credit line above. Tidy, typeset and centered.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Color and light: Cream, mustard yellow, navy, grey. Flat, even, overcast light.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men on horseback meet face to face on an empty winter beach, a standoff or reunion.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Visual idea: Mirror-image horses meeting in the center, as in a board-game card.
0550_the-king-of-marvin-gardens.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s American drama, a retro lobby-display look.

0551_cronos.jpg.People: No people. A single oval object, carved or insect-like, sits in the center.
0551_cronos.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical stack on a black field: ruled line and title at the top, credit line below, and a large oval object in the lower middle with a blood drop dripping from its bottom point. Wide empty black space around it.
0551_cronos.jpg.Medium: Woodcut or linocut-style ink illustration with rough black outlines and flat gold and red fills, with a slight scratchy texture.
0551_cronos.jpg.Typography: Title in gold classical serif capitals, large, centered at the top beneath a thin gold rule, with an italic gold credit line below. Elegant, typeset, unbroken.
0551_cronos.jpg.Color and light: Black, metallic gold and a vivid red wedge. Flat, graphic, with no cast light.
0551_cronos.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange golden artifact holds a clockwork core and bleeds, implying a mechanism that feeds on life.
0551_cronos.jpg.Visual idea: A shell or scarab cut open to reveal red gears, and the single drip of blood links machine and body.
0551_cronos.jpg.Feels like: Gothic horror with a handmade, antique-book look, 1990s art house.

0552_broadcast-news.jpg.People: Several: a woman in close-up with a headset at upper right on a big screen, a man in a suit sitting at a news desk in the center, and two more men on small monitors at bottom. Four to five people, all on screens.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Composition: A wall of television monitors, with a large screen at the top and two small ones at the bottom, divided by dark bezels. The title overlays the big screen on the left; a label strip sits in the dark middle.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Medium: Photograph of video screens showing scan lines, noise, and a slightly blurred, glowing video look; yellow tape and a label plate add physical texture.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Typography: Big white bold serif capitals in two lines at upper left, overlapping the screen, with a small cast line above; a hand-lettered marker on yellow tape for 'a film by', and a gray label-plate credit.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Color and light: Blue-gray, brown map, dark black, with yellow accents. Cool monitor glow in a dim room.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Story it suggests: Several people are watched through screens in a newsroom, each in a separate frame.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is itself a control-room bank of monitors, with the label tape as a studio gaffer note.
0552_broadcast-news.jpg.Feels like: 1980s workplace comedy-drama about TV, a video-era look.

0553_fish-tank.jpg.People: One young woman, a mid-body view in profile, turning away to look out of a window, in a hooded top. Hand holding something at the bottom.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Composition: Figure cropped off the top and moving through the frame, with a large translucent teal rectangle at the center holding the title. Window light at left.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Medium: Color film still with soft grain, motion blur and an overexposed, washed look; a flat semi-transparent teal block overlays it.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Typography: Title in wide-spaced white sans capitals, two huge lines inside the teal box, with a small spaced credit line between; edges slightly rough and distressed.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue and teal with pale gray and white. Cold, diffuse daylight from a window.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Story it suggests: A restless girl is caught in motion, glancing at the outside world from a confined interior.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Visual idea: The translucent box lets her body show through, suggesting a glass tank or pane that boxes her in.
0553_fish-tank.jpg.Feels like: 2000s British social-realist drama, handheld and raw.

0554_still-walking.jpg.People: Three figures walking away on a path seen from behind: a man in a white shirt, a small boy, and a woman with a white parasol. Small to medium, full body.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Composition: A curved sandy road sweeps from lower left up into the hills, with the figures placed in the middle third and the title below in open ground. Green hills and sky frame the top.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Medium: Gouache or oil painting with visible brushstrokes, loose and flat, in a quiet illustrative style.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Typography: Light thin green sans-serif title in sentence case, large, set lower right over the sand, with a smaller credit line below. Soft and airy, not touching the figures.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Color and light: Sandy peach path, deep emerald greens and a turquoise sky. Warm summer sunlight with short shadows.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Story it suggests: A family walks a country road together on a bright summer day, facing away.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Visual idea: Everyone turned away on a long winding path, a sense of the passage of time.
0554_still-walking.jpg.Feels like: Quiet contemporary family drama, gentle and nostalgic.

0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.People: A man in a blue suit, a three-quarter figure in the foreground, with serious eyes, and a crowd of silhouettes behind him; a portrait of a bespectacled man on a bus ad, plus newsstand magazine covers with faces. Around eight faces, large to small.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Composition: A dense city street at night, with the man in the lower right, a newsstand at left, a bus in the middle and neon signs filling the top. Title spans the upper half.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Medium: Painted gouache illustration with chunky brushwork, flat planes and hand-painted lettering.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Typography: Large hand-painted yellow-cream brush letters in jagged, bouncy lines, spanning the upper half and overlapping neon signs; small condensed credits above and below.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Color and light: Neon reds, deep blues and cream yellow. Night glow of electric signs.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense young man stands in the glare of a city at night, among advertising and newspapers.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Visual idea: Faces and headlines multiply around him, suggesting fame and publicity eating the city.
0555_sweet-smell-of-success.jpg.Feels like: 1950s New York noir drama, an illustrated pulp-style poster.

0556_senso.jpg.People: A woman in a white off-shoulder gown, looking down, and a man in a white jacket standing behind her, looking back at the viewer. A sword hangs at his side. Two figures, half body to three-quarter, back to back.
0556_senso.jpg.Composition: The pair at center, filling the upper two thirds, with confetti-like red, white and green scraps scattered on black. Title block spans the bottom, with the handwriting credit above it.
0556_senso.jpg.Medium: Oil or gouache painting with thick, expressive brushstrokes, in a classic romantic poster style.
0556_senso.jpg.Typography: Huge cream chunky Victorian-style capitals with a crosshatched fill and drop shadow filling the bottom, plus a looping italic script above; ornate, printed-poster lettering.
0556_senso.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with white costumes, and red, green and white confetti. Theatrical stage light with strong contrast.
0556_senso.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple stands back to back at a festive moment, she downcast with a flower and he glancing coolly at us, an uneasy love under a celebration.
0556_senso.jpg.Visual idea: Confetti in three colors implies a flag and a celebration while the pair turn from each other.
0556_senso.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European costume melodrama, classic hand-painted cinema poster.

0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.People: A smiling man in profile with a raised fist, wearing a pink flower lei, a bunch of flowers in his other hand; a crowd of people at the bottom left. Mostly one large figure.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Composition: Figure large and off to the right with his arm reaching diagonally to the upper left, trees and sky behind him, and the title overlapping across the middle.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Medium: Enlarged frame from an old video or film, soft and low-resolution with scan-line artifacts and color bleeding.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Typography: Huge white bold sans capitals in two lines across the middle, with a TV-like glow and scan-line distortion, edges colored yellow and blue; a small credit line wedged between lines.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Color and light: Sunny greens, sky blue, white and bright pink. Bright outdoor daylight.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Story it suggests: A man celebrates joyfully in the sunshine, among a crowd, with a triumphant gesture.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Visual idea: Low-fi video texture on the title ties the image to archival footage.
0557_the-times-of-harvey-milk.jpg.Feels like: 1980s documentary with a grainy video look.

0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.People: One man's face drawn upside down, with a mustache and curly hair, which also reads as a face the right way up. A single figure, a big face.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Composition: Rotationally symmetric: the face is in the center with the title and credits printed both right side up at top and upside down at bottom, framed by red theatre curtains on both sides.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn ink and wash illustration on mottled green paper with a vintage printed look.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Typography: Art Nouveau-style hand-lettered title in navy, large, repeated twice: once upright at the top and once inverted at the bottom, with matching mirrored small credits. Quirky, ornamented letterforms.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Color and light: Mint green, brick red, navy and flesh. Flat, even stage-poster color.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Story it suggests: A solemn man whose face turns into a different face when flipped, a playful theatrical joke.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Visual idea: A face that works upside down, and a doubled poster that works in both orientations, enacting the title.
0558_topsy-turvy.jpg.Feels like: Victorian music-hall or circus bill, a playful period comedy.

0559_the-mikado.jpg.People: Three women in conical hats, each holding a red fan, huddled together with white-painted faces and flowers in their hair. Three figures, half-length, smiling.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Composition: The trio fills the upper half in a tight cluster, with their bodies merging into one big tan robe that carries the title. A patterned backdrop fills all around.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Medium: Printed illustration in the style of a woodblock or Art Nouveau print: flat layered inks with fine brush lines and a paper texture, with decorative pattern fills.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Typography: Title in tall, thin green Art Nouveau lettering with curly flourishes, stacked in two lines on the robe, with matching hand-lettered credit below. Decorative and part of the illustration.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, olive green, peach, red-orange and mint. Warm, flat decorative color.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Story it suggests: Three coquettish women giggle behind fans, a light comic mood.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Visual idea: One merged robe shared by three bodies, and patterned wallpaper-like leaves and waves behind.
0559_the-mikado.jpg.Feels like: Late-19th-century decorative print for a light stage show, with a late-1930s costume-musical spirit.

0560_white-material.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up profile filling the left two thirds, with a second blurred figure in a cap behind her on a painted-looking backdrop. The woman looks off to the right; the figure behind is ambiguous, possibly a mural or billboard of a soldier with a raised fist.
0560_white-material.jpg.Composition: Large profile face on the left, vertical split with a soft out-of-focus yellow-green field on the right. Title block sits low over her cheek, left-aligned, with the cover's vertical side band at left.
0560_white-material.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with visible grain, warm skin texture and sharp freckles against a defocused, painterly background.
0560_white-material.jpg.Typography: White stenciled all-caps title two lines high in the lower left, about a third of the poster width, with a slight distressed texture; small caps credit above and below. It overlays the face directly, in a plain sans.
0560_white-material.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange-red hair and skin against acid yellow-green and dusty purple; hard natural daylight.
0560_white-material.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stands in front of a threatening armed figure and a raised fist she does not look at.
0560_white-material.jpg.Visual idea: The living face in sharp focus set against a flattened, aggressive image of power behind her, like a poster inside the scene.
0560_white-material.jpg.Feels like: Late-2000s European art-house drama with a political edge.

0561_kes.jpg.People: A boy's face in close-up at right, looking toward a bird of prey held up on a gloved hand at left. A second subject, the bird, is blurred in the foreground; the boy is in a zipped dark jacket.
0561_kes.jpg.Composition: Face on the right third, bird upper left, diagonal of the arm rising from lower left; empty pale sky behind them. Title box sits at bottom center-right.
0561_kes.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still, soft focus on the bird, slightly faded color grain.
0561_kes.jpg.Typography: White bold sans-serif title KES inside a mustard-yellow rectangle, roughly a quarter of the poster width, bottom center; smaller bold credits below. Solid flat box laid over the jacket.
0561_kes.jpg.Color and light: Olive green, grey and dull skin tones against a washed-out white sky; flat overcast daylight.
0561_kes.jpg.Story it suggests: A young boy gazes with concern and attention at a wild bird he is trying to handle.
0561_kes.jpg.Visual idea: Boy and animal bound by a shared gaze, the blurred bird as the focus of his attention.

0562_blow-out.jpg.People: A man sits slumped in a chair at center-left with hand to his head, full body, small in the frame, surrounded by clutter. A large machine dominates the right foreground, so the person is secondary.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Composition: Busy room with shelves of film cans behind, cables and reels spilling across the floor, large green machine cropping the right third in sharp foreground. Man is near the vertical center line, slightly left.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Medium: Photographic color film still with grain, deep focus and cluttered detail.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Typography: Bold condensed white sans-serif all caps in one line across the middle, spanning nearly the full width; the title BLOW OUT sits in a black box at right. The text overlaps the man's legs and the machine.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue-green and olive tones, with a denim blue shirt and brown shoes as accents; flat indoor light.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Story it suggests: A man surrounded by a mess of tape and recording gear seems trapped in thought over his work.
0562_blow-out.jpg.Visual idea: Isolated figure tangled in tangled media: the spilled tapes suggest recording and listening as obsession.

0563_something-wild.jpg.People: None; a handcuff drawing contains a heart. No human figure, only an object.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Composition: Handcuff on a diagonal running from upper left to lower center, circular cuff with a heart at lower left center, chain crossing upper left. Title in the right upper half on a dark empty field.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Medium: Flat screenprint-style ink illustration with soft speckle, slightly rough edges, matte paper-like texture.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Typography: Condensed bold title in two colors: SOMETHING in pink, WILD in white with a skewed W, right side at mid-height, about half the poster width. Small teal credit line above; sits in empty black space beside the drawing.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Color and light: Teal and hot pink on near-black; flat, graphic, no real lighting.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Story it suggests: Love is held captive or tied to a chain, romance entangled with restraint.
0563_something-wild.jpg.Visual idea: The heart locked inside the handcuff, pairing romance and captivity.

0564_pale-flower.jpg.People: A hand with three painted fingers dominates the top, and a small framed photo of a man sitting on a chair, hunched, is inside a smaller panel below. The man is small and dark, shown in full body as an image inside the image.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: giant fingertips pointing down onto a framed inset, flanked by two tilted decorative cards left and right. Black border frame around the whole image, title in a wide band beneath.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white halftone-like photography with a blue-grey vignette, plus graphic printed card art.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Typography: Wide extended sans-serif PALE FLOWER in thin dark letters across nearly the full width near the bottom, aligned with the frame edges; credit smaller and centered below. Typeset, not touching the image.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue-grey monochrome with black borders; soft vignette glow from the center.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man waits beneath a hand that seems to hold or choose his fate like a card.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Visual idea: Frame within frame: a gambler-like pressing hand over a tiny man, as if he were a playing piece.
0564_pale-flower.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s Japanese noir, graphic and gambling flavored.

0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.People: No actual person; a hat, mustache and chin are drawn as floating silhouettes forming an implied face, ambiguous as separate shapes rather than a figure.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Composition: Perfect central axis: bowler hat, small square mustache and chin beard stacked vertically with the gaps implying a face. Title appears twice, upside down at top and upright at bottom, mirroring.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink, black shapes on saturated red field, rough ink-stamp edges on the lettering.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Typography: Blackletter, rough title The Great Dictator at the top (flipped 180 degrees) and bottom, about 60 percent of poster width each, black with white sans credit; slightly distressed, like stamped. The flipped copy makes a mirror.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Color and light: Bright red-orange with black and soft pink; flat, no light.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's identity is reduced to a few symbols, hinting at doubled identity or mistaken identity.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Visual idea: Mirror symmetry and doubling: the title flipped like a playing card, and the face assembled from props, to suggest two sides of one man.
0565_the-great-dictator.jpg.Feels like: Bold political graphic design, 1930s propaganda reinterpreted with modern minimalism.

0566_insignificance.jpg.People: One woman in a white pleated dress and sunglasses, blonde, full body, sliced into fragments and repeated in the upper left. She is cut into shifting pieces so the figure reads as a collage.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Composition: Vertical figure running from upper center to bottom center, surrounded by scattered tilted squares of paper with equations and torn rectangles. Large white empty space around the lower right.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Medium: Photographic collage of cut paper, translucent layers, handwritten notes and a ticket stub; matte paper-like texture.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Typography: Wide sans-serif INSIGNIFICANCE in black and white across the middle, about 80 percent of the width, cut in two colors where it crosses the figure; faint ghosted copies of letters repeat behind. Overlaps the collage and is partly obscured.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, peach, mustard and brown notes against white; soft and slightly faded, like old photographs.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman is surrounded by fragments of math and memory, as if she is part of a puzzle.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Visual idea: Fragmentation: the woman and the title are cut up, like a mind or an image disrupted by scientific notation.
0566_insignificance.jpg.Feels like: 1980s British art-house drama with a collage design.

0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.People: Four women in kimonos stand in a row at the lower half, half-body to three quarters, all looking up and to the left, close together. They read as a family or group.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Composition: Black band across the top holds the title; photo below with cherry blossoms overhead and the four women lined up along the bottom, a horizontal frieze. The women occupy the lower half.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Medium: Photographic color film still, sharp, saturated and glossy, with flower detail.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Typography: Small spaced serif capitals in pale pink, right-aligned in a black band at the top, about a quarter of the width; elegant, light, and separate from the image, with the tiny credit line below.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Color and light: Rich kimono colors: burgundy, blue, yellow, white-pink, against dark background with white-pink blossom; bright natural daylight.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Story it suggests: Four sisters pause together under spring blossoms, facing the future with hope and some unease.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Visual idea: Cherry blossoms and kimono as seasonal beauty and as ephemeral time, arranged like a family portrait.
0567_the-makioka-sisters.jpg.Feels like: 1980s Japanese period drama, refined and nostalgic.

0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.People: Two people, large and nearly full body: a standing man in a suit looks down and presses a revolver toward a seated woman whose chin he grips; she is tied to a chair with rope and stares up at him. Captor and captive, a clear power imbalance.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Composition: Man fills the left half as a tall vertical, woman below right on a diagonal tilted-back posture; red title box at upper right, black credit box at mid right, red banner across the bottom. Rope lines form diagonals across her torso.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio publicity photograph, glossy and smooth with soft grey gradient backdrop, overlaid with flat solid red and black ink boxes.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Typography: Chunky white condensed sans-serif title KISS ME DEADLY stacked in two lines inside a red rectangle, about a third of the poster width, upper right, with a clipped corner where the man's head pokes over it. A bottom banner in wide white sans on red shouts a tagline, and a small black box holds the credit. All typeset, hard-edged, pasted on like labels.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Color and light: Greyscale photograph with strong red as the single accent color, plus black and cream; hard studio flash lighting.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Story it suggests: A man threatens a bound woman at gunpoint, and violence is delivered with a coldly calm posture.
0568_kiss-me-deadly.jpg.Visual idea: Pulp paperback and exploitation lobby card language: a lurid staged photo with loud red labels announcing danger.

0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up, her head tilted sideways with eyes closed and a faint smile, resting on a hand; another hand appears at the bottom right, probably reflected or belonging to a second person. The image is rotated so the face lies sideways.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Composition: Face rotated about 90 degrees filling the top two thirds, diagonal flow from upper right to lower left, hands cradling it along the lower middle. Title sits bottom right in a large block.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph, heavy film grain, soft contrast, slightly blurred like an old print.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Typography: Chunky rounded hand-cut sans-serif letters stacked in two lines, PEOPLE and SUNDAY, in yellow, olive green and white with alternating colors per letter, about 55 percent of the poster width, bottom right. Yellow underline and credit beneath. Looks cut from paper, sitting on top of the photograph.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Color and light: Grey monochrome photograph with warm yellow and olive-green lettering; soft diffuse light.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman dozes contentedly, relaxed and intimate, in a lazy moment with someone close.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Visual idea: The title's mismatched colored letters bring a playful, handmade mood against the grave grey photo of calm.
0569_people-on-sunday.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era documentary-style romance with a modern, warm graphic update.

0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.People: One figure drawn as a face and head only, a girl with eyes shut, a wide grin and her tongue sticking out, wearing a checked beret; a drawing, not a photograph.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Composition: Single centered head on a vertical axis, filling the middle two thirds; the title floats in a cloud-shaped speech bubble at the top and the credit curves along the bottom, with ink splatters and radiating lines as emphasis.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Medium: Flat solid blue ink with cut-out paper shapes, brushed ink lines and splatter dots, looks like a hand-painted gouache and pen illustration.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Typography: Loose black handwritten script, with a title in a cloud outline at the top about 70 percent of the width and a hand-lettered credit at the bottom; cursive, slanted, with splatter and underline, part of the illustration.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue with black ink, brown fringe, a red tongue as the single hot accent; flat, shadowless.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheeky child teases the world with a grin and her tongue out.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Visual idea: The whole face is made from a single blue field, with the red tongue as the joke; a doodle brought to life as a poster.
0570_zazie-dans-le-metro.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s French playful comedy, with a mid-century children's-book illustration look.

0571_black-moon.jpg.People: A symmetrical stylized face, closed-eyed and mirrored, with a lion-like muzzle, set among profiles: two bird heads at top, a unicorn at left, an eagle and a human profile at right. Human and animal faces are ambiguous and merged in a drawing.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Composition: Perfect left-right mirror symmetry in a rounded emblem, with a central face and creatures ringing it like a crest or mask; title beneath. Heavy black mass with white interior details on a white ground.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Medium: Flat solid black ink, bold vector or linocut illustration with fine white hatching lines, no gradients.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy black display letters with frayed, brush-like hairy ends on some strokes, wide across about 60 percent of the width, a little overlapping at the 'o's that join. Small spaced serif credit beneath. Hand-made, quirky, integrated with the emblem's style.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white, high contrast, no shading.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Story it suggests: A dreamlike world where human faces and animals blend into one another.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Visual idea: A mirrored mask of mythic beasts and sleeping faces, like a Rorschach or heraldic seal.
0571_black-moon.jpg.Feels like: 1970s psychedelic fantasy and surreal Art Nouveau-inspired graphic.

0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.People: One young man in half-body portrait, seated with a hand resting on a knee, wearing a dark buttoned cassock, looking straight at the viewer with a heavy lowered brow. Alone.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Composition: Figure centered and slightly left, leaning, with a bare wall and a hanging wire behind him; huge title in the lower right overlapping his chest and arm, balancing against the figure on the left.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic film still with fine grain, soft grey tones.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Typography: Tall white light-weight sans-serif capitals in three stacked lines, LEON MORIN, PRIEST, taking up about half the poster width and a third of its height, lower right, with a rounded apostrophe; neat, geometric, unobstructed over the dark clothing. Credit in mixed-case smaller below.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with a deep burgundy side band; soft window-like daylight.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Story it suggests: A young cleric holds a direct, guarded stare as if tempted to speak and cannot.
0572_leon-morin-priest.jpg.Visual idea: Plain portrait: the black garment becomes a dark plane that holds the white title like a clean slab.

0573_the-music-room.jpg.People: None visible; possible figure only as an abstract pattern. The white scatter at right may suggest a chandelier shape, not a person.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Composition: Dense all-over ornamental pattern with a white form like a chandelier hanging to the right, with the title stacked at upper left and the name across the very top. Pattern fills the edges, no empty space.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Medium: Flat two-color printed pattern, like cut paper or stencil, with small white geometric shapes (diamonds, drops, circles) on charcoal grey.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Typography: Wide white thin sans-serif credit running across the top, nearly full width; the title THE MUSIC ROOM stacked in three lines, made from dots, drops and arrow shapes in the same ornament vocabulary, about a third of the width. The letters dissolve into the pattern. At right a second ghost of text breaks apart into the chandelier shape.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal grey and white only; flat, glittering light implied by white dots.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Story it suggests: A grand hall's chandelier glitters with a title that appears to be made of its crystals.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Visual idea: Letters turn into the chandelier crystals: the pattern becomes both title and the light fixture.
0573_the-music-room.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1950s Indian art film with Mughal ornament in a modern graphic style.

0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.People: One boy standing full body at the center, facing front, holding a white tulip with both hands, staring blankly. He is painted with exaggerated doll-like proportions, an oversize head, bowl-cut hair and tiny hands.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical, figure on the central axis below a swirling title; clouds fill the sky and a green hill line cuts across the bottom. Clouds repeat in a regular spacing around him.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Medium: Painted look, acrylic or gouache brushwork with a smooth flat finish, soft naive illustration texture and visible small strokes in the clouds.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Typography: Orange-red looping hand-drawn script in the upper half, two big swashy lines for the title, about 60 percent of the width, with a smaller script credit at the sides. Flowing, calligraphic, it floats in the sky among the clouds.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Color and light: Pastel sky blue, white clouds, spring green, with an orange-red title; soft, even daylight.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Story it suggests: A solemn boy stands in a cheerful, empty pastoral setting that feels unsettling.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Visual idea: Sweet naive painting that hides something unnerving: the cute pastoral landscape against the vacant stare.
0574_life-during-wartime.jpg.Feels like: 2010 indie dark comedy-drama with a folk-art, pop-surreal illustration look.

0575_the-killing.jpg.People: One man, three quarter length, standing in a hat and coat and holding a long gun across his body; his face is half-lit and grinning in shadow. Drawn, not photographed.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Composition: Figure centered and slightly right in a pool of light, surrounded by dark scratchy strokes; title in the bottom third spanning most of the width, credit centered below.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn scratchboard or black ink drawing with white chalky highlights, visible hatching and brush strokes.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered white serif title The Killing with outlines and drop-shadow, cut or inked, about 75 percent of the width, bottom. The white letters feel carved into the black and share the same scratchy line as the drawing.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Color and light: Near-total black and white with a few grey tones; a single harsh spotlight from the front.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Story it suggests: A lurking armed man steps out of darkness for a heist or a hit.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Visual idea: The man emerges from scratches of black as if carved out of the dark, with a title carved from the same black.
0575_the-killing.jpg.Feels like: 1950s American crime noir pulp, reinterpreted as an ink illustration.

0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.People: One woman, three-quarter length, standing facing the viewer with clenched fists and a tense, worn expression; she is alone, centered, with stray hair blown across her face.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Composition: Strict central axis: the figure fills the height of the poster against a nearly blank white-grey field, with the title running across her chest and the credit lower down. Almost no other element.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still, soft natural texture, slightly overexposed, matte.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Typography: Thin, widely letterspaced white sans-serif capitals, SECRET SUNSHINE, in two lines across her torso, about 45 percent of the width; very light, so it fades against the pale striped shirt and the white background. A small spaced credit line below.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Color and light: Washed-out white and pale grey, with a brown corduroy jacket and mauve stripes as the only darks; flat overexposed daylight.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman walks forward with raw resolve after something has gone wrong.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Visual idea: A grieving figure against a blank white field, the overexposed white acting as a numbed emptiness.
0576_secret-sunshine.jpg.Feels like: 2000s East Asian realist drama, restrained and naturalistic.

0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.People: Three small standing figures, shown as black silhouettes (one in a white robe, one holding something white over his shoulder, a tall central one); they stand in a row on a ridge, and relationship is unclear but they appear to be facing the viewer.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Composition: Wide horizontal band of figures sits at the lower third, between a telegraph pole at right and the title high above. The upper half is open flat grey, and the grassy mound forms a jagged horizontal strip.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Medium: High-contrast threshold print: black ink and white shapes in a photocopy or woodcut style, with ragged grass edges and speckles, over a flat grey field.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Typography: Title in huge, chunky, hand-cut white capitals, upper centre across the full width; credit line in small black sans beneath, offset left. The white letters pop off the grey like cut-outs.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Color and light: Cool mid grey, black and white; flat, no cast light.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Story it suggests: Three people stand on an exposed rise in a bleak landscape, watching.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Visual idea: Reducing a scene to black-and-white shapes so that the three characters read as pure, stark symbols.
0577_cul-de-sac.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European black-and-white art-house thriller, stylised and minimal.

0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.People: Two faces: a smiling woman in a small crown or lace headband in close-up at lower right, and a large blurred male face at left, out of focus. Two overlapping portraits, one sharp and one ghostly.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Composition: Giant title across the upper half; faces overlap diagonally, the woman at lower right, the blurred man at left. A small envelope-like logo and a credit sit at bottom center, with a film list in a line at the very top.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned photographic film still with grain, mixed with a textured, speckled letterpress or stencil lettering; soft vintage print feel.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed sans-serif VIGO in translucent light grey, spanning nearly the full width at the top, overlaying and blending with the faces and speckled like worn ink; a row of small white film titles above it and a small credit below.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome sepia and tan with brown-black shadows and pale grey type; soft diffused light.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Story it suggests: A radiant woman laughs, while a looming figure haunts the other half of the frame.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Visual idea: The title stamped over double-exposed faces suggests a body of work layered in memory.
0578_the-complete-jean-vigo.jpg.Feels like: 1930s French poetic cinema, collected into a vintage box set.

0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.People: A hooded figure with a scythe sits in a horse-drawn carriage, in silhouette, with a drooping horse in front; the figure is small and merges with the shape of the cart. Skeletal and ambiguous.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Composition: Horizontal band across the middle: horse, cart and lamp-post in a straight line along a ground line, with the black lower third carrying the title. The carriage is placed at right of center and the lamp at left balances it.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Medium: Flat silhouette in mottled watercolor-like texture, with a paper-like grain and soft stains in the sky.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed art-deco serif title in mustard gold, stacked THE / PHANTOM / CARRIAGE, taking up around half the poster's width and height; a smaller teal credit beneath. It sits in solid black at the bottom, clean and unaffected by the image.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal-green sky with black silhouettes and a single yellow glow from the lamp; cold night light.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Story it suggests: Death arrives on a quiet night road, pulled by a tired horse.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Visual idea: Death in silhouette on a night road, lit only by a single lamp, with the ground as a black stage.
0579_the-phantom-carriage.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era gothic horror folk tale, recalled with a retro fairy-tale poster look.

0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.People: Two young men in profile, both with downcast heads, large; one lower left looking to the right, one upper right looking down; they mirror each other across the center without meeting eyes.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Composition: A zigzag of overlapping triangles (arrows) running down the center, alternating black, magenta, and translucent gray, with the two faces on opposite sides forming a diagonal and half-mirror symmetry; title in the black triangle at the center-left.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photos with flat vector triangles overlaid at partial transparency; film grain visible.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Typography: Light gray classic serif caps, small and refined: 'LE' small over 'BEAU SERGE' in a black triangle, 'A FILM BY / CLAUDE CHABROL' in a magenta triangle. Typeset, aligned inside the shapes.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale with a single deep magenta; soft diffuse daylight, moody.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men tied together but looking away from each other, an unspoken tension.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Visual idea: Pointing triangles cut and join two portraits into one doubled image, with magenta marking the divide.
0580_le-beau-serge.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave drama of the late 1950s with a modern geometric graphic treatment.

0581_les-cousins.jpg.People: Two men's faces in close-up, side by side, one at left (young, dark-haired, looking intently) and one at right (mustached, looking off aside), each cropped at the face and divided by a vertical split.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Composition: Vertical split into two portraits, overlaid with a chain of translucent grey, blue and black triangles pointing right that zigzag across both. Title sits inside the black triangle at lower right, credit inside the blue triangle at lower left.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic grain with flat vector triangles of translucent grey, solid black and blue overlaid; clean graphic overlay.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Typography: White bold serif lower-case title Les cousins in two lines inside a black arrow shape, about a quarter of the width, lower right; credit in matching serif inside the blue triangle. Typeset and framed by shapes rather than overlapping the faces.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Color and light: Mostly greyscale with a single steel-blue triangle; harsh high-contrast lighting on the faces.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men, perhaps two sides of a rivalry, face away from each other and are cut apart by sharp shapes.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Visual idea: Mirrored faces on opposing halves, with triangles like arrows or play buttons pointing at each other.
0581_les-cousins.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s French new-wave drama with a modern geometric update.

0582_carlos.jpg.People: One man walking down airplane steps, full body, in a leather jacket, sunglasses and beret, carrying a submachine gun in one hand and a cigarette in the other; shown alone, striding toward the viewer.
0582_carlos.jpg.Composition: Image in a bordered photo frame with a wide white margin; the man is at center, the stair running diagonally from upper left to lower center, wings above. The title sits below, filling the margin.
0582_carlos.jpg.Medium: Sepia-tinted photographic film still, warm and slightly grainy, with an off-white border like a printed photo.
0582_carlos.jpg.Typography: Heavy black slab-like blocky title CARLOS, stretched across the full width at the bottom, with rough ink-stamp texture and worn spots; a small credit line below. It sits under the picture, like a stamp.
0582_carlos.jpg.Color and light: Orange-sepia monochrome sky and tarmac, with the figure in dark brown; low warm sun.
0582_carlos.jpg.Story it suggests: A confident armed man steps off a plane into a foreign place, as if arriving to do something dangerous.
0582_carlos.jpg.Visual idea: The framed photo and chunky stamp lettering imitate a dossier or wanted-style file photo.
0582_carlos.jpg.Feels like: 1970s political thriller, with a retro dossier look.

0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.People: Two men in desert clothes, one in a turban holding a spear and one leaning on him, trudging across a ridge; they are small, full-length and stand in the lower right, painted. The relationship looks like one helping the other.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Composition: Open sky above and the two figures low on the right with a rocky ridge at the bottom. A white rectangle with title at the upper center, with a feather shape sticking out of its right edge.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushstrokes and canvas texture, in a soft impressionistic style.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Typography: Small brown serif title THE FOUR FEATHERS in capitals, with an italic credit under a rule, in a white box about 50 percent of the width, upper center. The feather breaks out of the box, connecting it to the sky.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue sky with sandy, pinkish desert and rust-brown rocks; hazy, bright desert daylight.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men struggle across a desert, with one supporting the other.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Visual idea: The white box and feather float like a flag or card above the landscape.
0583_the-four-feathers.jpg.Feels like: 1930s British adventure epic, in a vintage painted-poster style.

0584_kuroneko.jpg.People: One woman in a pale kimono with dark leaf patterns, standing at center, full body, half transparent and floating, in a misty bamboo grove; she looks ghostly, with a blurred face. The figure is ambiguous between a person and a spirit.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical vertical bamboo trunks framing a central clearing, with the woman placed at the exact center and lit like a glow; a black vignette frames the edges, and the title is at the bottom.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photography with double-exposed fog and a soft vignette; ghostly translucence.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Typography: Rough white brushstroke lettering KURONEKO, spanning about 70 percent of the width at the bottom, jagged and hand-painted like calligraphy, with a small serif credit above. It looks painted on dark ground.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white, with a pale glow around the woman; misty moonlit light.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Story it suggests: A spirit woman drifts through a dark bamboo forest toward whoever enters it.
0584_kuroneko.jpg.Visual idea: Vertical bamboo trunks like prison bars frame a glowing apparition, with the brush title like a claw scratch.

0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.People: One figure seen from behind, a man (or an ambiguous dark silhouette) standing at right, half dissolved in fog; shoulders and head are barely distinguishable from the haze. Small relative to the large empty field and only vaguely human.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Composition: Large empty fog field with the figure on the right third, back turned, and the title block at upper left balancing it. A strong diagonal of weight from upper left text to lower right figure.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus photographic film still, heavily veiled in haze, matte and low in contrast with a faded print feel.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Typography: Italic old-style serif in dark green-grey, two lines (a small credit, then a large title), about half the width, placed upper left in the empty space; elegant, quiet, with the same dull color as the image so it blends in.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Color and light: Muted grey-green and beige, with a pale milky fog; flat, diffused daylight.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A man walks into a fog, turning away, as if the thing he looks for cannot be seen.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Visual idea: Fog erases the person like a half-formed memory, and the title floats in the same grey.
0585_identification-of-a-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1980s European art-house drama about alienation, quiet and austere.

0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.People: No full person; a hand is split into two halves, left half pale and human with halftone dots, right half dark and furry or hairy, with an orange skull and anatomical labels drawn over the palm. The hand is a hybrid, ambiguous between human and beast.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Composition: Large vertical hand running from the top-center to the bottom, pointing downward, with a green circle behind its right side and small stacked circles at the lower right. The title is stacked above, cut off from the image by a ragged black rule.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Medium: Halftone print with a photocopy or screenprint feel: coarse dots, speckled cream paper with ink noise, and flat orange and green overprint.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Typography: Distressed hand-cut orange condensed sans-serif letters ISLAND OF LOST SOULS in two lines across the top, nearly 60 percent of the width, rough-edged like stamped ink with misregistration; small black credits above and below it. It is separated from the image by a torn black bar.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper, orange-red, sea-green and black; flat printed inks with no light.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Story it suggests: A hand half human and half animal, hinting at an experiment that blurred the line.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Visual idea: Split hand and an anatomical skull with numbered labels: a diagram of a body being rewritten.
0586_island-of-lost-souls.jpg.Feels like: 1930s horror, rendered as a retro-modern screenprint with a scientific-diagram look.

0587_three-colors.jpg.People: None; abstract streaks. No identifiable figure, only radiating light trails.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Composition: Streaks of light fan out from a dark center knot toward the corners, with a strong diagonal sweep from lower left to upper right. The title is stacked in the upper right corner.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Medium: Long-exposure or motion-blur photography with luminous color streaks on black, glossy and smeared.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Typography: Thin white geometric sans-serif capitals, four lines, flush right and top right, about 40 percent of the width, light weight and crisp against the dark streaks; the line three colors is slightly bolder. Sits over the image, partly crossed by the blue and red streaks.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Color and light: Black with red, orange, white and blue streaks; saturated, glowing, artificial light.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Story it suggests: Rushing lights suggest a journey or a speeding passage through a dark tunnel.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Visual idea: Three colors in a burst, red, blue and white, as streaming light; color as the subject.
0587_three-colors.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art cinema, tied to sleek modern design.

0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.People: One tiny dark figure in the upper left, in mid-air, arms out, tethered by a long thin line that wiggles down the poster. Reads as a person falling or bouncing on a rope, but is ambiguous.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Composition: Huge empty blue field with the figure at the upper left third and a long diagonal line running to the lower right edge; the title stacked at top right balances it. A lot of empty space.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Medium: Coarse video-like pixel or woven-grid texture, a flat blue photographic frame with scanlines and soft grain.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Typography: Light thin white geometric capitals, four lines flush right at the top right, about 35 percent of the width; the word BLUE is slightly heavier. Clean typeset text over the blue, not interacting with the figure.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Color and light: Saturated cobalt and periwinkle blue with a dark navy figure; flat, bright, cold light.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone hangs from a thin line against empty blue, between falling and suspension.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Visual idea: Blue as an enveloping field, with a figure suspended by a single fine line.
0588_three-colors-blue.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art film, minimalist and poetic.

0589_three-colors-white.jpg.People: One outstretched hand in extreme close-up, fingers spread and blurred, taking the lower left; a pale second shape at lower right is ambiguous (maybe a shoulder or a veil). The person is unseen except for the hand.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Composition: Hand rises from lower left toward the upper center, with blurred vertical streaks behind; the title is at upper right. Large soft blur and empty areas.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus, overexposed film photograph with a dreamy blur, creamy texture and no sharp edges.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Typography: Light thin pale-grey geometric capitals in four lines, flush right at the top right, about 35 percent of the width, with WHITE slightly bolder; low contrast, almost dissolving into the white-beige image.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Color and light: Creamy white, pale peach and beige; overexposed, soft, hazy light.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Story it suggests: A hand reaches out through a bright haze, as if toward something half-seen.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Visual idea: White as a blurred, overexposed dream; the hand is the sole anchor in a field of pale light.
0589_three-colors-white.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art film, soft and dreamlike.

0590_three-colors-red.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up profile, looking up and to the left with parted lips, her hair falling across her face; part of her fur collar is visible at lower right and a blurred ghostly shape at upper left.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Composition: Face fills the center-right in profile along a diagonal, a flat red field at left and dark hair at right. The title sits at the top right over the hair.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with grain, soft focus, a red color cast and slightly faded print quality.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Typography: Thin white geometric sans-serif capitals, four lines flush right top right, about 35 percent of the width, with RED slightly bolder. Crisp over the dark hair, and it does not touch the face.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Color and light: Dominant saturated red with pale skin, dark brown hair; soft, warm, filtered light.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman gazes upward at something off-frame, absorbed, concerned and drawn toward it.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Visual idea: Red envelops the face like a curtain, the profile turning toward what lies outside the frame.
0590_three-colors-red.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art film, intimate and lyrical.

0591_12-angry-men.jpg.People: Twelve men's faces, one per panel, each in head-and-shoulders close-up; all are different expressions of worry, suspicion or tension, none look at each other. They are alone in their frames though they relate as a group.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Composition: Strict grid of three columns by four rows with white gutters; the title band cuts through the middle between the second and third rows. The center-lower face, in a yellow panel instead of red, is the only one with a different background.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with thick gouache or oil brushstrokes in two-tone orange, ochre and red; visible textured strokes with rough highlights.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Typography: Bold slab-serif capitals in a single line across the white band, in three colors: gold for the actor name at left, dark red for the title at center, gold for the director at right. About 90 percent of the width in total; they sit in the white gutter row without touching the faces.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Color and light: Red, mustard yellow and orange only, with a white grid; flat, warm, theatrical lighting.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Story it suggests: Twelve men are locked in a shared room, each a distinct, tense face, with one standing apart.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Visual idea: Grid of faces like a jury panel or a mugshot sheet; the yellow panel makes one man the exception among eleven.
0591_12-angry-men.jpg.Feels like: 1950s American courtroom drama, rendered as a mid-century illustrated poster.

0592_design-for-living.jpg.People: Three people with heads together in a triangle, shown in close-up faces, all smiling, rotated so one man is upside down at top, a man on the left, and a blonde woman at lower right; tightly clustered like a love triangle.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Composition: Three faces arranged in a pinwheel around a central point, all against black; the title is curved along the circular arrangement at the lower center. No empty space except the black gaps.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio portrait photography, glossy and smooth, with a purple tint only in the text.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Typography: Light geometric sans-serif letters in a curve, DESIGN in white and for LIVING in lilac purple, angled along the circle of faces, about a third of the width; small curving credit text at upper right. The arc follows the heads, tied closely to the image.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with lilac purple lettering; bright glamorous studio lighting.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Story it suggests: Three charming people crowd into one playful, intimate arrangement, hinting at a triangle.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Visual idea: Rotating pinwheel of heads: a triangle of attraction drawn as a circle, with type curving around it.
0592_design-for-living.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood romantic comedy, with Art Deco glamour.

0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.People: One woman, half body, shown from head to waist and leaning forward on her arm toward the viewer. She has long blonde hair and a sideways, heavy-lidded gaze; she is a painted figure, not a photograph.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Composition: Black upper area with a diagonal sweep of white below, the figure's head breaking the border between them. The face sits just right of center, with the title arcing around her head like a crown and lots of empty white lower left.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache with visible wet washes, drips of red-orange paint on the garment, and a rough ink-black ground. Brushstrokes and paper white are clearly visible.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Typography: Very large hand-brushed title in orange-red, spanning the whole top and curving down the left and right sides, letters irregular and tilted. A small script credit in black sits at the bottom, overlapping the painting.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Color and light: Black, warm cream and blonde yellows, with hot orange-red accents. Flat, graphic light with no cast shadows.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Story it suggests: A cool, composed beauty gazes sideways while red splashes on her clothes hint at something violent or hidden beneath her calm.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Visual idea: The painted red drips on the dress and the matching red brush lettering tie the title to a suggestion of stained surface, contrasting a pale, delicate face with a dark, wild ground.
0593_belle-de-jour.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house drama with an erotic, fashion-illustration flavor, reinterpreted in a contemporary hand-painted style.

0594_godzilla.jpg.People: None visible; a giant monster silhouette is the central figure, seen from behind with arms spread.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Composition: Huge central vertical creature with a curved tail sweeping in an arc at right; a giant title across the top; power lines cutting across the bottom and left at slanted angles.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Medium: Expressive painted illustration with mottled, watercolor-like textures, ink splatters and fine black wire lines.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Typography: Gigantic blocky distressed white capitals 'GODZILLA' crossing the full top width, cut off at the edges and overlapping the monster's spikes; rough hand-cut, speckled, with a small credit at the upper right.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Color and light: Fiery orange, yellow and brown with white-hot glow behind the beast; blazing backlight.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Story it suggests: A colossal creature rises before a burning city while wires fall around it.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Visual idea: The monster and fire as a single burning silhouette, the title as large as the threat.
0594_godzilla.jpg.Feels like: Atomic-age monster film, 1950s, in a gritty modern painted treatment.

0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.People: One main figure in white, upper body blurred and cropped at the top, with a red cloth hanging beside the legs, facing a large dark animal on the right. The figure is only partly legible because of motion blur.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Composition: Diagonal flow from upper left (white figure) to lower right (dark animal), with a thin white line slicing across the middle and a red cloth anchoring the lower left. The title block is tucked into the lower right over the animal's body.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Medium: Heavy film grain, soft focus and motion blur, like an enlarged frame from old color film stock. Looks photographic, with blotchy color noise.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Typography: Bold slab-serif capitals stacked in four short lines in the lower right, the top two lines in rust red and the rest in cream. Medium-large, left-aligned, sitting directly on the image.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Color and light: Sandy ochre ground, rust red, dark brown-black, and creamy white. Warm, hard daylight.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense close encounter between a human and a powerful animal in an open dirt arena, caught in a split second.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Visual idea: The blur and crop turn the encounter into pure color and gesture: a red cloth, a white body and a dark mass colliding.
0595_the-moment-of-truth.jpg.Feels like: 1960s documentary-style color film, gritty and sun-baked, in a bold slab-serif vernacular.

0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.People: Three men seen from behind in a tight cluster, full or three-quarter body, each holding a sword or spear. Faint, ghostly gray figures of more men fill the lower corners.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Composition: Central triangle of three figures with the middle one tallest and facing away; swords make diagonals crossing the picture. Large empty cream space at the top holds the title, with the figures anchoring the lower half.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Medium: Black ink brush drawing with dry-brush strokes, a gray wash behind and gray ghost figures. Looks like sumi-ink illustration on cream paper.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Typography: Very large, heavy, distressed serif capitals in black stacked on three lines at the top center, with grainy worn texture and a small spaced credit line beneath. Typeset, not hand-drawn.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray on cream. Flat, graphic light.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Story it suggests: Three fighters stand back to back, ready for an attack from all sides by a larger enemy.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Visual idea: The back-to-back triangle formation and the faint crowd in the corners suggest a small group surrounded by many.
0596_three-outlaw-samurai.jpg.Feels like: Black-and-white period swordplay drama from the 1960s, rendered in a modern ink-illustration style.

0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.People: One face as an extreme close-up, cropped so only both eyes, nose and mouth fill the entire poster. She looks straight out.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Composition: Face fills the frame edge to edge, symmetrical with eyes at the top corners and mouth at the bottom. A thin white keyline border sits inside the edge, and the title runs in a single horizontal line across the upper middle, across the nose bridge.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Medium: Digitally pixelated, mosaic-like blocks over a grainy photograph, as in a low-resolution enlarged image or webcam still.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized condensed sans-serif capitals in one line, the title in white and the credit in hot pink-red, placed across the nose. Flat typeset with no distortion, sitting on top of the face.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange and salmon skin tones, with red lips and pink-red text. Flat, close, warm light like a screen or flash.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman stares straight into a camera in an awkward, unguarded moment, as if looking at herself or into a webcam.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Visual idea: The pixelation turns the intimate face into a low-res digital image, a metaphor for self-exposure on a screen.
0597_tiny-furniture.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary indie comedy-drama, 2010s, with a digital-age, awkward self-portrait feel.

0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.People: One tiny man in a white suit and tie, running, silhouetted in white inside a small black circle at the center. A figure so small it reads as an icon.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Composition: Two large overlapping circles stacked vertically, orange-red on top and blue below, forming a vertical figure-eight; their overlap is an amber eye shape with a black pupil holding the running man. Strictly symmetrical along the vertical axis, with thin vertical lines dripping down from the eye into the blue.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Medium: Flat color with soft noise and gradient texture, like screenprint or airbrushed paper, over a deep black ground.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Typography: Credit at the top and the title at the bottom in bold white sans-serif capitals, medium size, tightly spaced and centered; the vertical lines run right into the title as if hanging from it.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Color and light: Black, burnt orange, amber, and deep blue with violet-white lines. Glowing, as if lit from within.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man runs inside something that looks like a giant watching eye, trapped in a constructed world.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Visual idea: The overlapping circles form an eye, with the man as its pupil, and the vertical lines like strings or wires or tears suggest being watched and controlled.
0598_world-on-a-wire.jpg.Feels like: 1970s science-fiction paranoia, in a modern minimalist poster style.

0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.People: Six people seated in a row at a table, shown half body in a black-and-white snapshot, looking at the camera; four men and two women. They are close together, with one man's arm around the woman next to him.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Composition: A tilted photo, paperclipped, laid over a page of typed dialogue. The photo is the central block, with a hanging lamp at upper right and the cast bunched along the lower edge, while the title sits in the upper right and credit at the lower right.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Medium: A black-and-white photographic print with white border and paper clip, set on textured paper with typewriter text. Slight shadow under the photo for a collage feel.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Typography: Large thin condensed serif title in dark red at the upper right, stacked on three lines and overlapped by the typed script lines; a black credit at the lower right in the same face. The background is typewriter monospace, cropped by the edges.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Color and light: Black and white photograph on warm off-white paper, with dark red lettering. Single pool of lamplight over the group.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Story it suggests: A group gathers around a table for a rehearsal or a reading, caught in a quiet, intimate pause.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Visual idea: A script page with a clipped group photo suggests a rehearsal, with the typed dialogue as the backdrop of the people performing it.
0599_vanya-on-42nd-street.jpg.Feels like: 1990s theatrical chamber drama, with a documentary, rehearsal-room intimacy.

0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.People: One figure, a body lying flat, built from cut-paper black shapes: head, torso, arms and legs separated into pieces. It is a graphic silhouette, not a real person.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Composition: The body is centered on a large orange rectangle, tilted, with limbs splayed out; below sits a separate red-orange block with cast names. Blocks are slightly skewed with white gaps between them, like cut paper pasted down.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in cut-paper style, with rough hand-cut edges and no gradients. Looks like a screenprint or paper collage.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Typography: Title lettering is cut into the black body pieces in orange, hand-drawn, tilted and compressed to fit each piece. Cast names below are outlined condensed capitals in dark red-brown, stacked in a left-aligned list.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Color and light: Orange, red-orange, black and white. Flat color with no light or shadow.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Story it suggests: A body lies dismembered, the scene of a death reduced to a diagram.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Visual idea: The corpse is cut into pieces, with the title inside the pieces so the words are literally the dissected body.
0600_anatomy-of-a-murder.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s modernist graphic design, bold and cut-paper, mid-century thriller.

0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.People: Two small silhouetted figures standing in the lower middle, one with a pack and long antenna-like pole on his back, the other bent over a bundle or bag. They are tiny against the sky and read only as black shapes.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Composition: Pale sky field with big title stacked down the upper half; two figures stand on a black ground band with smoke clouds on both sides and a small patch of fire at the right. Symmetrical framing by dark smoke and bare branches.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photo, grainy, with a stencil or lithograph-like texture and slight paper mottling; the red flames look overprinted as a spot color.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Typography: Huge, tall sans capitals in dark charcoal, three lines stacked, taking about 55 percent of the width and 40 percent of the height at the top, sitting in the empty sky. A small coral-red credit near the bottom.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Color and light: Cream, black and coral red; backlit, with a bright haze and dark smoke.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people trekking through a burning landscape, their message lost in the smoke.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Visual idea: Silhouettes against a bleached sky, with a single red spot color for the fire.
0601_letter-never-sent.jpg.Feels like: Late 1950s war and survival drama rendered as modern two-color print.

0602_the-war-room.jpg.People: Two men in extreme close-up, one above and one below, each cropped so only part of the face shows. The top man looks forward with his eyes lost in shadow; the bottom one is in profile, turned right, in dark light.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Composition: Two stacked images split by a black horizontal band holding the title, which sits right of center. Faces fill the upper and lower thirds, one tilted toward the viewer and one in profile, facing the band.
