0602_the-war-room.jpg.Medium: Grainy video or film stills with soft focus and noise, over a rough paper-like texture; the band edges look torn like a strip of tape.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Typography: Large bold sans-serif capitals in pale gray, single line across the black band, with a smaller credit line below it in the same pale tone. Straight, typeset and flat, overlapping the image edges.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Color and light: Muted beige, brown and dull red, with a black band; dim, harsh, smudged light, bright flare at the lower right.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Story it suggests: Two intense men in different places, each caught in a moment of pressure and focus, linked by the headline between them.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Visual idea: The split screen with the title as the divider suggests two sides of one story, or a confrontation between faces.
0602_the-war-room.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s documentary or news-footage look, raw and political.

0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.People: Two men in the foreground, one leaning from a boat ledge and talking down to the other, who is waist-deep in water, wet. Several crew members behind them near a camera and boom.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Composition: Diagonal from the standing man at the upper left to the wet man at the lower right, with a long boom arm running across the top. A dark ornamented title plate fills the bottom.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Medium: A black-and-white photograph with fine grain, like a vintage behind-the-scenes press photo.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Typography: A dark plaque with scalloped corners at the bottom holds the names in thin serif capitals, white, centered, in two sizes and two lines of titles. Typeset, formal, sitting over the photo.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white with high contrast; bright studio lamps in the upper left and hard daylight at the top right.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Story it suggests: A director talks to a drenched actor in a water tank, in the middle of a film shoot.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Visual idea: A behind-the-scenes shot with camera and crew visible, to show the making of the films rather than a scene from them.
0603_david-lean-directs-noel-coward.jpg.Feels like: 1940s British studio filmmaking, a classic retrospective box set.

0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.People: A crowd of sailors seen from behind in the lower half, ranks of white caps and dark collars, facing two officers who stand above them. A few more men lean on a rail in the background.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Composition: Rows of caps fill the foreground in diagonals leading to the officer at the center, with boat hulls and rigging above. A dark octagonal plaque with the title at the bottom center.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with fine grain and crisp contrast.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Typography: Title in a large, thin, wide-spaced sans-serif in white inside a black octagonal plate, two lines with a smaller credit line above and below. Centered, typeset, covering the lower part of the picture.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white with bright white caps and dark uniforms; flat overcast daylight.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Story it suggests: A crew is assembled and addressed by an officer before a voyage.
0604_in-which-we-serve.jpg.Visual idea: Rows of identical caps become a pattern, repeating the many facing the one.

0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.People: A few tiny figures walking along a pavement, nearly lost among the buildings. No close people.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Composition: High-angle view of a street running diagonally from top right to bottom left, with rows of houses on one side and rooftops and chimneys at the lower right. A dark title plaque sits at the upper right.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Medium: Soft, grainy color film frame, slightly faded, like old Technicolor-style footage.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Typography: Serif capitals in cream on a black plaque with a decorative scalloped border, three stacked lines of title with small credit lines above and below. Medium size, centered inside the plaque.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Color and light: Brick red, slate gray, green and yellow garden patches; soft daylight.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Story it suggests: An ordinary street of terraced houses seen from above, with life going on in small steps.
0605_this-happy-breed.jpg.Visual idea: The rooftop view suggests many families living side by side in identical houses.

0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.People: One woman, cropped from the lips down to the hand, with blonde curls and a pale green dress. Face cut off above the mouth; her hand with red nails rests on a couch arm.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Composition: Body reclining along a diagonal from upper left to lower right, with the hand in the lower center and a floral wallpaper at the upper right. The title plaque sits right of center.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Medium: A soft color film frame with a slightly faded, tinted, grainy look.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Typography: Script title in pale green inside a black scalloped plaque, with small spaced capitals above and below. Centered inside the plaque, medium size, decorative and typeset.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Color and light: Pale sage green over everything, with red lips and nails as the only strong accents; soft, even light.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous, strangely greenish woman lounges elegantly, as though not quite of this world.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Visual idea: The green tint turns her skin and dress into a ghostly cast, with red lips and nails as the only living color.
0606_blithe-spirit.jpg.Feels like: 1940s drawing-room comedy with a supernatural wink.

0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.People: One bearded man in close-up with a thick band of white light across his eyes, both hands raised beside his head, palms out. His fingers are also cut by white bars.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Composition: Central symmetric face with raised hands on each side, set against a dark top where the title floats. A horizontal glare band runs through the eyes and across the hands.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Medium: A grainy black-and-white photograph that looks scratched and smudged, with an embossed, metal-stamp title and a warm cream tint.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Typography: Title in wide-spaced stamped capitals that look pressed into metal, in two lines in the upper part, partly eroded and blurred. Cream-white on black, integrated with the scratches.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Color and light: Black and warm cream, with strong white streaks of light over the eyes.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands pressed against a glass-like surface, his eyes blinded by a flash of light.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Visual idea: The bar of light blotting out his eyes and fingers makes the image look like a film strip or exposure error.
0607_a-hollis-frampton-odyssey.jpg.Feels like: 1970s avant-garde, experimental film, in a scratchy, analog look.

0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.People: Two figures in the lower right, full-body, holding hands while walking: a young man in a black coat and an old woman in a white coat with an umbrella. On the left, a hanging figure and bodies and flames shown in muted orange.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Composition: Vertical split: orange left band holds the hanging man on a noose, with chaos below, and a bright yellow field on the right with the walking pair. The title and credits stack on the upper right.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-like illustration, with clean outlines and flat solid colors, in a comic-book or graphic-novel style.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Typography: Large slab-serif title in orange, stacked on two lines at the upper right, with small wide typewriter-like credit lines below. Typeset, bold and crisp.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, burnt orange, dark red blood and black and white clothing. Flat, bright, graphic.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man and an elderly woman cheerfully hold hands, while grim scenes of death sit behind them.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Visual idea: Cheerful yellow beside the muted orange scenes of death contrasts life and death in a single image.
0608_harold-and-maude.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s dark comedy in a modern indie comic-illustration style.

0609_alambrista.jpg.People: One young man standing upright in the center, full body, hands in pockets, surrounded by about nine bent-over figures working the ground, shown as dark blobs. He is the only one standing and looking at the viewer.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Composition: A standing figure at the center and a field of stooped figures scattered across rows. Title and credit sit at the upper right over open pale sky, with the figures filling the lower two thirds.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Medium: Rough two-color screenprint or linocut look with heavy ink texture, misregistered speckles and paper grain. Photographic source reduced to flat ink shapes.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Typography: Bold condensed sans-serif title in dark brown with exclamation marks, upper right, with a smaller olive green credit line below. Typeset, right-aligned and modest in size.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Color and light: Yellow cream paper, brown-black and olive green ink. Flat and sunbaked.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Story it suggests: One young man stands out among laborers bent over in the fields, apart from the work around him.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Visual idea: The one upright figure among stooped ones shows an outsider in a landscape of labor.
0609_alambrista.jpg.Feels like: 1970s social-realist, protest-poster look, gritty and hand-printed.

0610_the-organizer.jpg.People: About a dozen men and women crowded together, half-body and close faces, with the central figure seen from behind in a brown coat and hat, hands on a table. All the faces look toward him.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Composition: The back of the central man forms a large dark shape at the bottom center, with faces packed in layers around him in a ring. A tilted brown banner with the title cuts diagonally across the top.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration with clean outlines and painterly shading, like a stylized caricature or editorial illustration.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed sans-serif title in pale yellow on a tilted dark brown banner across the top; smaller credits in the same yellow, stacked on the central man's back. Typeset, bold and flat.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Color and light: Earth tones, browns, gray-greens, pale yellow and salmon. Flat and warm, with no strong source.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in a hat addresses a packed crowd of ordinary people who watch him with doubt and hope.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Visual idea: The viewer stands behind the speaker and sees the crowd the way he does, with the title banner slicing above like a flag.
0610_the-organizer.jpg.Feels like: Early-twentieth-century labor drama in a contemporary editorial style.

0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.People: One tiny figure crawling on hands and knees inside a tunnel, seen through the pupil of a giant eye. Tiny, seen from far away, with the face invisible.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Composition: A big circle takes up the lower two-thirds and is centred on the poster, with title and credit above in centred lines. The eye's radial iris leads the viewer's eye to the pupil, where the figure is; near-symmetric.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Medium: Photographic macro of an iris blended with a film still; smooth, saturated, slightly soft, printed on flat cream.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Typography: Title in medium-size dark brown rounded humanist sans, centred near the top, with a smaller credit line below. Clean and unobtrusive, with no interaction with the image.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Color and light: Cream background, amber, gold and rust iris, black pupil; soft, even light.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone crawls through a passage that leads into another person's eye.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Visual idea: The eye as a portal: the pupil as a tunnel into a person.
0611_being-john-malkovich.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s quirky indie comedy, tidy and playful.

0612_certified-copy.jpg.People: Two people, a man and a woman, in profile with their heads close together; the pair appears twice as a mirrored copy. They are cropped at the shoulders and appear intimate or about to speak.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Composition: Strict left-right mirror symmetry, with the pair facing each other across a narrow gap in a framed rectangle in the lower half. The title fills the upper half in two lines on gray.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Medium: Clean photographic print inside a cream frame on a flat gray ground, digitally mirrored.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Typography: Very large light-cream sans-serif capitals in two lines, centered, with a small black name above and a small quoted subtitle below. Typeset, simple and flat.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Color and light: Cool gray ground, cream, black hair and warm skin tones. Soft, even light.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people are close and unsure whether they are the same couple or a repetition of one.
0612_certified-copy.jpg.Visual idea: The mirrored image of the couple literally makes a copy of the original, echoing the title.

0613_summer-interlude.jpg.People: Two small figures in swimwear at the lower left, standing on a rocky outcrop and holding arms, seen from behind as they look at the lake; a small white dog or object lies lower center.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Composition: Large calm lake fills the center, framed by trees on both sides and rocks below; the pair sits in the lower left third, and the title spans the top across the water.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with crisp grain and sparkles on the water.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Typography: Large sky-blue light serif caps stacked in two lines, nearly full width at the top, over the water and trees; small black italic script credit above. Typeset, clean, overlapping the lake like a reflection of sky.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Color and light: Silver-gray monochrome with a single bright cyan title; sunny bright summer light.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple at the edge of a lake, about to dive into a carefree summer moment.
0613_summer-interlude.jpg.Visual idea: Blue lettering stands in for the missing color of water and sky in a monochrome scene.

0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.People: One woman lying on her back on a boat deck, seen from above, with her knee raised and her head cropped toward the lower center. Her shirt is open, and she faces away from the camera.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Composition: Diagonal body stretching from upper left to lower right across the deck, with calm water behind and a coil of rope at left. The title runs down the upper half over the water.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Medium: Soft black-and-white photograph with film grain and gentle gradients.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Typography: Large light serif title in warm yellow in three lines, centered, with a smaller italic credit above. Typeset, elegant, set over the water without any box.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white photo with a yellow title; bright, hazy summer sun.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman lies sunbathing on a boat, alone in a still, sensual afternoon.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Visual idea: The still water and relaxed pose set a feeling of languid freedom, and the yellow type adds warmth.
0614_summer-with-monika.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European romantic drama, sun-soaked and sensual.

0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.People: One small figure at the top in a bowler hat, tight jacket and baggy trousers, holding a cane and shading his eyes with a hand while looking into the distance. Drawn as an illustration.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Composition: Horizontal split: white mountains and sky above with the figure at center, and a black field below with a giant gold nugget holding the title. The figure stands on the dividing line, as if on the surface above the ground.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink illustration with rough hand-cut edges, like screenprint or woodcut with a limited palette.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy black slab-serif capitals stacked on two lines inside the gold nugget, centered, with a smaller credit line below in the same face. Typeset with a rough, worn edge, and fills the whole lower half.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, gray-beige and gold yellow. Flat graphic light.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Story it suggests: A small, ill-equipped traveler looks across a snowy land while a huge treasure lies hidden beneath him.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Visual idea: The cross-section shows the surface and what lies under it, with the title as the buried gold.
0615_the-gold-rush.jpg.Feels like: A 1920s silent-film comedy adventure, with a retro woodcut look.

0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Composition: About twenty hammers hung on a pegboard in an interlocking grid of horizontal and vertical orientations, forming a rectangular spiral around a central open space that holds the text. Near-symmetrical, with the title in the center.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism, with a gritty, desaturated, grainy look and a vignette; pegboard holes form a dot pattern.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Typography: Lowercase bold sans-serif title in black at the center, two stacked lines with small cast names above and a small credit below. Typeset, medium size, surrounded by the tools like a fitted puzzle piece.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Color and light: Olive-beige pegboard with silver, wood and black hammers. Flat, harsh overhead light with darker corners.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Story it suggests: A collection of hammers suggests violence prepared, hanging neatly and waiting to be used.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Visual idea: The mundane tool collection arranged as a pattern turns domestic order into a threat.
0616_shallow-grave.jpg.Feels like: 1990s dark British thriller, with a cold, deadpan look.

0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.People: One man in a dark jacket and shirt, full body, jumping in mid-air with legs spread and arms flung in opposite directions, looking down. Cut out against the sky.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Composition: Single centered figure floating on a pale gray field with a few soft clouds behind him; the title sits at the lower left in large letters, leaving open space around the figure.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph cut out and set on a flat light gray background with pale clouds.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Typography: Large white condensed sans-serif capitals in one line at the bottom, left-aligned, with a smaller credit line above. Typeset, bold and flat, but low contrast against the gray.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and light gray. Flat, soft light.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Story it suggests: A man seems to leap or fall through empty space, suspended between moments.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Visual idea: The mid-air pose without a ground suggests falling or floating, in contrast to the title's calm claim.
0617_and-everything-is-going-fine.jpg.Feels like: A 2010s documentary portrait, minimalist and wry.

0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.People: One older man seated at a plain white table at the lower right, half body and small, in a plaid shirt, with a microphone before him, gesturing with a finger to his temple. He is tiny relative to the empty space above.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Composition: Huge empty hazy space with the figure pushed into the lower right corner; the title is split vertically down the center like an eye chart, with letters shrinking from top to bottom. A single cloud floats at the upper right.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Medium: Soft, foggy photograph with film grain and a gradient fade into gray; looks like a hazy still with a typographic overlay.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Typography: Title letters in gray slab-serif, stacked in broken lines of decreasing size like an optician's eye chart, with the word cut mid-way (GRA / Y'S / ANA / TOMY). Wide-spaced small credit lines below. Typeset, low contrast, blending into the fog.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Color and light: Pale gray, white and cool blue-green haze, with only the shirt's green, orange and red plaid as color. Diffuse, dreamy light.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone speaker sits at a table facing an enormous emptiness, talking to an unseen audience about something in his head.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Visual idea: The eye-chart title that shrinks and blurs into the clouds suggests failing or fading vision, a mind clouded.
0618_gray-s-anatomy.jpg.Feels like: 1990s monologue film, quiet, minimal and contemplative.

0619_le-havre.jpg.People: Three people and a dog: an older white-haired man leaning on a container while holding a match, a small boy crouched at lower left looking up, and a man in a dark coat and hat standing farther back. A golden dog sits at the older man's feet.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Composition: A red shipping container on the left edge, with the leaning man in front, converging rows of containers receding toward a distant harbor at right. The title is slanted up the upper right, set against open pale sky.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Medium: Flat gouache or acrylic painting with visible brushwork and simplified shapes, with a hand-painted look and a signature in the corner.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Typography: Large bold slanted italic capitals in yellow with a dark drop shadow, top right, with a smaller credit below in black and yellow. Typeset, tilted along the receding perspective.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue sky, ochre, rust red, olive green and mustard yellow. Bright, clear daylight with long shadows.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet dockside town where an older man shelters a boy while a man in a dark coat watches.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Visual idea: The same lines of containers draw the eye from the boy to the watcher, setting up a sheltering and a threat in one scene.
0619_le-havre.jpg.Feels like: A 2010s deadpan European comedy-drama, in a naive, painted style.

0620_la-promesse.jpg.People: Two small figures walking on a bridge, a woman carrying a baby in a sling and a young person with a bag, seen full-body, tiny and distant; the baby is partly visible on her back.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Composition: Wide, mostly empty pale sky in the upper half with the figures low at the right on a horizontal bridge railing; a long horizon and river bridge in the background.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with soft grain and pale haze; handwritten pencil lettering overlaying it.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Typography: Large loose hand-drawn pencil 'la promesse' across the empty sky, slightly slanted, with a small white handwritten credit at the bottom; sketched, graphite-textured, on top of the photograph.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Color and light: Pale mint-white haze with muted grey, tan and a touch of orange; cold overcast morning light.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people move through a foggy, vast city, carrying their burdens in silence.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Visual idea: A small human pair under a big handwritten word, promise as a fragile scrawl.
0620_la-promesse.jpg.Feels like: 1990s social realist drama, intimate and quiet.

0621_rosetta.jpg.People: One young woman seen in profile from behind the shoulder, her face partly hidden by dark hair, in a red jacket. Medium close-up, cropped at the shoulders, looking to the left.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Composition: Head in profile at the left and center, with the red collar filling the lower third. A hand-drawn title loops over the face, with credit lines handwritten across the red jacket.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Medium: Grainy color film frame, slightly soft, with chalk or pencil lettering drawn over it.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Typography: Huge scrawled white chalk-like handwriting across the face and hair, with the letters looping and uneven; credits in pink-white handwriting across the jacket. Hand-drawn, covering much of the poster, and overlaps the face.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Color and light: Dark green-brown background, with pink skin and a vivid red jacket; flat, dim daylight.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Story it suggests: A determined young woman is turned away from the camera, closed off and focused on something ahead.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Visual idea: The scrawled name over her face is like graffiti or a signature, as if the title were written on her.
0621_rosetta.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s social-realist drama, raw and handheld.

0622_weekend.jpg.People: Two men in bed, one lying face down with his bare back filling the frame and another half-hidden behind, face pressed into a blue pillow. They are cropped, intimate and asleep or resting.
0622_weekend.jpg.Composition: A large curved bare back across the center diagonal, with faces and pillows around it and the white wall above. The title sits at the upper left in the empty space.
0622_weekend.jpg.Medium: A soft photographic image with slight grain and a washed color gradient, like a snapshot taken on film.
0622_weekend.jpg.Typography: A thin, light, wide-set sans-serif title in dark gray at the upper left with a small italic credit beneath. Typeset, delicate and small compared with the image.
0622_weekend.jpg.Color and light: Soft pastel blue, pink, white and warm skin tones. Gentle morning light.
0622_weekend.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people share a quiet, intimate morning in bed.
0622_weekend.jpg.Visual idea: The back as a landscape filling the frame turns the bodies into an intimate close-up of a shared bed.
0622_weekend.jpg.Feels like: 2010s intimate indie romance, naturalistic and tender.

0623_lonesome.jpg.People: A man and a woman in black swimsuits sitting on the sand facing each other, nearly touching noses. They are full-body or three-quarter size, drawn as flat figures.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Composition: A symmetrical rainbow of concentric bands sets a halo behind the couple, which sits at the center with a horizon line behind them. Confetti-like dots scatter over the poster, and the title sits at the bottom.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Medium: Flat gouache painting with solid color shapes and smooth edges, like a 1920s travel-poster or Art Deco illustration.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered looped blue script title at the bottom, in a single line, with a small gray sans-serif credit above. Hand-drawn, large but airy.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy, pink, yellow, orange and lavender, with pale gray-blue sand. Sunset glow.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Story it suggests: Two strangers meet on a beach at sunset and are drawn together.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Visual idea: The sunset's concentric arcs wrap around the pair like a halo, with the dots like fairground lights or bubbles.
0623_lonesome.jpg.Feels like: 1920s romantic silent-film, in Art Deco poster style.

0624_quadrophenia.jpg.People: One young man seen from the front, half-body and centered on a scooter covered in mirrors, looking at the camera. Shown in high-contrast black-and-white.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Composition: Strict central symmetry, with the scooter and rider at the center of a target of concentric rings made of text, blue outside and red inside, with the headlight at the bullseye. The title is at the bottom center.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph, like a photocopy or halftone cut-out, over cream paper texture, with colored text rings.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Typography: Rings of small, tightly set, curved text wrap in spiral circles around the rider, blue on the outside and red in the center, readable as repeated question phrases. The title is in bold quirky black capitals at the bottom, with a red line above and a gray credit below.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper, black and white photo, bright blue and red text. Flat, graphic, with a glowing headlight.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Story it suggests: A young rider sits in the middle of a target of repeating voices, asking to be seen as himself.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Visual idea: The target made from rings of text turns the rider into a bullseye, and the mirrors on the scooter reflect his fractured identity.
0624_quadrophenia.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s British youth-culture, mod and punk graphic style.

0625_eating-raoul.jpg.People: None, apart from a cartoon mouth with big teeth chewing a tiny shoe-and-leg bit; the mouth is the only human element.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Composition: A huge black frying pan, round in the center with its handle pointing straight down, on a flat yellow field. The title circles inside the pan around the central mouth.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink, with vector or screenprint look and a worn texture on the pan's edge.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Typography: Large rounded, bouncing, hand-drawn blue letters, bent into a ring around the mouth, with a small black rounded credit at the bottom. Distorted, uneven baseline, tightly packed.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Color and light: Acid yellow, black, cyan blue and hot pink. Flat, loud, with no shadows.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is being eaten, and a shoe sticking out of a grinning mouth makes it a joke about cooking people.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Visual idea: The frying pan as a plate with a mouth chewing a shoe makes the title literal and darkly comic.
0625_eating-raoul.jpg.Feels like: Early-1980s black comedy and cult B-movie, in a pop-art style.

0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.People: Two small riders on pale blue-gray horses, seen from behind, each holding a lute or mandolin, riding toward a castle. They are small in the lower right.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Composition: A tall blue-white castle wall rising at the left and curving down toward the lower right in a diagonal, with a road leading to the two riders. Title at the upper right over the yellow sky.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Medium: Loose gouache or oil painting with visible brushstrokes, blotchy layers and a rough canvas texture.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Typography: Ornate medieval-style capitals with a decorative first letter, in blue and brown, set in two lines at the upper right, with a small black credit above. Typeset, in a manuscript style that matches the setting.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Color and light: Bright yellow sky, pale blue-gray stone and horses, pink and green ground. Warm, hazy evening light.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Story it suggests: Two traveling minstrels approach a castle at dusk, arriving as strangers.
0626_les-visiteurs-du-soir.jpg.Visual idea: The painted castle and manuscript letters present the film as an illuminated storybook of the Middle Ages.

0627_the-game.jpg.People: One tiny figure, a dark silhouette falling or tumbling in the center right, almost lost within the picture. It could be a person in mid-fall.
0627_the-game.jpg.Composition: Large black empty left half, with the right half filled by tall vertical stripes of blue-green light, where the title runs vertically on a tilt and is cut off at the top and bottom. The tiny figure sits in the center of the stripes.
0627_the-game.jpg.Medium: A dark, grainy photographic or digital image with blurred vertical streaks and noise, like a smeared glass facade at night.
0627_the-game.jpg.Typography: Very thin white outline capitals, stretched tall and tilted, running vertically along the stripes and cut off by the poster edges, so the title is hard to read. Typeset, enormous in height but light in weight.
0627_the-game.jpg.Color and light: Black with teal, blue and green glow; cold, nocturnal light from within.
0627_the-game.jpg.Story it suggests: A man tumbles through darkness past a wall of light, out of control and alone.
0627_the-game.jpg.Visual idea: The cropped, stretched title mimics a falling or looming structure, reinforcing disorientation.
0627_the-game.jpg.Feels like: 1990s paranoid psychological thriller, cold and slick.

0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.People: One young man in profile, huge close-up filling the left half and cropped at the top; his hands clasped at the bottom right. He looks down, away from the viewer, alone.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Composition: Large face on the upper left, a blurred landscape on the right and below; a square outline (open at the top left) sits at center holding the title. Empty sky at upper right.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism with soft shallow focus and slight film grain; the red frame has a rough, distressed ink edge.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed white sans-serif capitals stacked on three lines, centered inside the red square, mid-size; a small spaced serif credit line below. It overlays the blurred hills without distortion.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Color and light: Muted greens, olive and pale gray sky with a dark navy jacket and a crimson frame; soft overcast daylight.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man lost in grave, silent thought in a quiet rural place, weighed down by something unspoken.
0628_the-forgiveness-of-blood.jpg.Visual idea: A red box framing the empty space in front of the figure, like a boundary or an enclosed fate he is staring into.

0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.People: Several faces of men plus a woman, in tight close-ups; a woman lies at left near a man, and a face at far right lies beside another reclined face. Faces repeat across strips, so it may be the same person shown at different moments.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Composition: Top half is a row of vertical photo strips with shifted crops, like a fanned film strip; the bottom half is filled edge to edge by the stacked title. Strong horizontal division.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white halftone-like photographs on cream paper; flat solid dark brown ink for the title.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Typography: Enormous high-contrast fat-face serif title on three lines, filling nearly the whole width and half the height; letters are cropped at the edges and overlap the bottom of the photo strips. Dark brown, typeset, with tiny spaced credit line below.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Color and light: Cream and tan with dark chocolate brown; soft, intimate bedroom light in the photographs.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Story it suggests: Intimate, tangled closeness between several people, with desire and unease in a shared bed.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Visual idea: Slicing a face into shifting strips to suggest multiple viewpoints or a triangle of relationships.
0629_sunday-bloody-sunday.jpg.Feels like: Early 1970s European or British drama, with a retro serif poster look.

0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.People: One woman's face, enormous and upside-down, ghostly in the haze across the upper two thirds; a tiny baby carriage stands on the black hill below. The face is partly a superimposition or reflection in the sky.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Composition: Layered: giant face in green mist above, black silhouetted rocky mound in the lower half, tiny pram at the exact center peak. Large empty black area at bottom with the small title.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Medium: Photographic composite with film grain and a double exposure; a flat black mass; white border with the image set inset like a framed print.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Typography: Small white bold sans-serif title at bottom center on two lines, with a green credit line beneath; modest relative to the poster, sitting in the black void.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Color and light: Murky green monochrome with deep black; foggy, eerie glow.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman's dreamlike dread hanging over a lone baby carriage, as though something watches over it.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Visual idea: The tiny pram against a giant looming face, scale used to show vulnerability and haunting.
0630_rosemary-s-baby.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s psychological horror, eerie and quiet.

0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.People: About a dozen small cut-out figures arranged in a ring, some full body and some half-body, mostly nude or costumed, some embracing; faces are blanked by flat color shapes or left photographic. Several are partly redrawn as flat color silhouettes.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Composition: A circular wreath of figures around a central block of hand-lettered text, on a large empty cream field. Everything is centered with a large margin.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Medium: Collage of grainy black-and-white and color photo cut-outs with flat opaque painted color overlays; crayon or marker handwriting on off-white paper.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn irregular crayon capitals in black, stacked on seven or eight lines at the center, with doodled arrows, a cross, a crown and a crescent; moderate size, scrawled and uneven, with crossed-out marks.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Color and light: Off-white ground with saturated orange, red, purple, blue and yellow patches; flat, no real light.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A merry carnival of bodies and stories circling a common center.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Visual idea: A circle of figures suggesting a cycle or round of tales, with a childlike scribbled title.
0631_trilogy-of-life.jpg.Feels like: Pop-art collage zine, 1970s irreverent and bawdy.

0632_the-decameron.jpg.People: About nine figures: seven children in white robes with yellow halos around their faces, and a nun-like figure with a blue blank face seated with an outstretched leg painted blue. Medium to full body, grouped in a cluster.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Composition: Cluster of figures at center-right below a big block of hand-lettering; the blue leg drops diagonally to the bottom edge. Lots of open cream space at the left and top.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Medium: Collage of grainy halftone-like black-and-white photos with flat paint cut-outs in blue and yellow; thick crayon or oil-stick scrawl on cream paper.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Typography: Large hand-scrawled black capitals, uneven and rough, at the top (credits) and bottom (title), underlined with heavy strokes; arrows, a cross and doodles; the title is broken into stacked words interrupted by the blue leg.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Color and light: Cream, bright cyan blue, lemon yellow, brown and black; flat graphic light.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Story it suggests: A holy-looking choir of children gathered around a blank-faced, irreverent nun, mixing the sacred and the cheeky.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Visual idea: Haloes on children against a hidden face and a loud blue leg, to contrast piety and body.
0632_the-decameron.jpg.Feels like: 1970s underground pop-collage, with a Basquiat-like scribble.

0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.People: A standing nude man in gray photo with red boots and a red cloth, pointing at the viewer with a winged-devil outline behind him; a reclining woman on a sack below with a yellow silhouette leaning over her. Full body, two groups.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Composition: Text block at the upper left, red wing at center, tall figure on the right, small reclining scene along the bottom; diagonal movement from top left to bottom right. Open cream space at left.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Medium: Collage of grainy black-and-white and faded color photographs with flat red and yellow paint cut-outs; crayon-scribbled handwriting on cream paper.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Typography: Hand-scrawled black crayon capitals, uneven and tilted, in several lines with underlines, arrows, a crown and a star, with a crossed-out line; text overlaps the red wing. Credits large, title at medium size.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Color and light: Cream ground, vivid red, mustard yellow and gray; flat poster light.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Story it suggests: A devilish, mocking tempter confronting the viewer while a couple lies tangled in a bawdy scene.
0633_the-canterbury-tales.jpg.Visual idea: A red bat wing turns an ordinary man into a devil, using flat color to turn a photo into a comic figure.

0634_arabian-nights.jpg.People: Two figures at the bottom lying together: one half-nude person leaning over another reclined figure with a painted orange belt; a tiny statue-like robed figure stands in a purple arched niche at right. The niche figure may be a statue or doll.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Composition: Large block of hand-lettering across the top, a purple arch at right, and the reclining pair along the bottom; weight sits lower left to right, with a lot of empty cream space.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Medium: Photo collage with flat purple and orange painted overlays; thick crayon-like scrawl on cream paper; grainy photographs.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn black capitals, rough and spaced, large on the credit name and title (ARABIAN NIGHTS broken over two lines), with underlines, arrows, stars and doodled scribbles, not typeset.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Color and light: Cream, deep purple and bright orange with black and gray photographs; flat, no real light.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate encounter in the foreground while a small idol or sage watches from an alcove.
0634_arabian-nights.jpg.Visual idea: The niche suggests an oriental temple window, with the alcove acting as an outside observer of the scene.

0635_weekend.jpg.People: A few small figures: a girl and a man clinging to a car at top, and a tiny man in a suit at the bottom right waving a white cloth. They are tiny and cropped; the cars dominate.
0635_weekend.jpg.Composition: The photo is rotated 90 degrees, so a red car and a yellow truck stack sideways and tilt like a pile-up. Title band crosses the center; the weight is in the middle.
0635_weekend.jpg.Medium: Saturated photographic print with strong color and slight grain; sideways rotation of the whole image.
0635_weekend.jpg.Typography: Mid-size bold sans-serif title "WEEKEND" in white and red across the center, with a small blue handwritten-like credit to its left; sits horizontally over the sideways image, so text is upright while the image is not.
0635_weekend.jpg.Color and light: Hot red, yellow and orange against green foliage; harsh bright daylight.
0635_weekend.jpg.Story it suggests: A chaotic roadside wreck or traffic jam where people cling to the scene as the world tips over.
0635_weekend.jpg.Visual idea: Rotating the picture 90 degrees makes the crash feel like the world has been turned on its side, while the text remains upright and the colors echo a flag.
0635_weekend.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave pop, anarchic and political.

0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.People: One man standing full body, backlit, in a long coat and hat, holding a pistol down at his side. He stands alone, facing the viewer in silhouette.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Composition: Figure sits at the right of center, vertical, with the title stacked on the left; hazy dusty background of wagons or buildings. Strong verticals.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Medium: Grainy sepia-toned monochrome photograph with heavy film grain and blown-out light.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed Western-style slab serif in dark brown, stacked on three lines at the upper left, a large size; typeset with a woodtype look, with a slightly rough texture.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Color and light: Sepia, tan and near-black; strong backlight with smoky haze.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone armed man waits in a dusty, smoke-filled street, ready for a confrontation.
0636_heaven-s-gate.jpg.Visual idea: A silhouette against hazy light as a mythic gunman; the old woodtype lettering signals the frontier.

0637_purple-noon.jpg.People: One young man in profile, head and shoulders, large; behind him a faded double-exposed second man's face and shoulders in gray. The ghost-like second image may be a photo or a portrait; the two are the same or similar looking.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Composition: Large profile left of center, title above; a faint ghost portrait offset lower right; faded handwriting across his head. Centered, with a pale surround.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism overlaid with faded gray photo and ink handwriting in a double exposure; smooth with slight grain; paper-like pale ground.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Typography: Bold sans-serif capitals with a blue gradient, textured and slightly distressed, across the top at wide size; small spaced credit above it. Cursive signature text appears faintly within the image.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Color and light: Cream white with a warm-skinned face, dark brown hair, blue title; soft bright daylight.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Story it suggests: A handsome young man whose identity is doubled or forged, with a signature suggesting he is pretending to be someone else.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Visual idea: The ghost portrait and the practiced signature represent stolen identity.
0637_purple-noon.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s European crime thriller, sun-drenched and stylish.

0638_following.jpg.People: One man's face, split across a horizontal band: the top half and the bottom half are shown rotated or mirrored, so two faces seem to press together. Close-up, cropped, ambiguous because it is a single person doubled.
0638_following.jpg.Composition: Image split at the middle by the title band; the two halves are rotated sideways so the profile appears to be lying down; diagonal shapes of collar and shoulders. Strong horizontal axis.
0638_following.jpg.Medium: Heavy film grain, black-and-white photography, with flat gray tones.
0638_following.jpg.Typography: White condensed sans-serif capitals running the full width on a single line at the center, with the title in a gray box in dark type; wide letter spacing, cut across the image and out of reading order ("by Christopher Nolan FOLLOWING a film").
0638_following.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome with deep black; flat, dim light.
0638_following.jpg.Story it suggests: A man who is observed or followed, doubling or trailing himself, with a sense of disorientation.
0638_following.jpg.Visual idea: The split, rotated face as a duplicated self or a mirrored pursuer, with the text bar as the seam.

0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.People: Seven or eight tall rock-art human figures painted in dark brown, in a row of varying size; one has a patterned, striped body and a headdress. They are not real people but ancient drawings.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Composition: A row of figures across the middle of a cliff face, title block at the bottom; a horizontal band composition with empty rock above.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Photograph of a rough rock surface with pictograph paint, tinted monochrome with grain; textured stone.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Bold angular blocky title in pale peach across the lower portion at large size, with three smaller words beneath and a small spaced credit; typeset with a futuristic, cut-corner display face.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Rust brown, terracotta and pale peach; warm raking light.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: Ancient figures watching, a primordial presence standing in a line like an assembly.
0639_the-qatsi-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: Cave painting as a source or origin, set against a futuristic type.

0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Composition: Aerial view of a landscape and city that runs diagonally; red light trails fan from the upper left across the middle to the lower right, and a white streak cuts across the top. The title sits slightly left of center in the middle.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with heavy grain and color noise, with painted or time-exposure light streaks and scattered glowing dots.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Typography: Title in cream, blocky, angular all-caps with chiseled, notched edges, about 55 percent of the width, a single line in the center, sitting on the red trails. Vertical strip with collection name and year at left.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Color and light: Deep red, orange, brown and blue-gray; fiery dusk light and glowing city lights.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Story it suggests: A vast landscape and urban sprawl seen from above, with streaming light as energy or speed.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Visual idea: Light trails as arteries running over land, a time-lapse feeling.
0640_koyaanisqatsi.jpg.Feels like: 1980s experimental, with a cosmic, apocalyptic mood.

0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.People: A crowd of people bending over in a field at the bottom, seen as a mass of backs and hats; not individually distinguishable. A hand drawn in red outline and a drawn figure at left are also ambiguous drawn shapes.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Composition: Layered multiple exposure: a hillside with a thatched hut, terraced fields and a crowd at the bottom, with horizontal bands. Overlaid translucent Chinese characters and circuit-like lines at the top; the title sits at the centre.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with heavy layering, a digital-glitch and thermal-scan feel; visible grain, scanlines and neon outline drawings.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Typography: Title in a compact, angular, heavy pale-gold sans, small to medium in width, placed on the middle line and sitting flat over the land with no distortion; the translucent large characters in the sky are more prominent than it is.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Color and light: Green, ochre, rust brown and gold, with red, blue and magenta line accents; warm natural sunlight turned into synthetic glow.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Story it suggests: People work the land, overlaid by a wash of signs and machines.
0641_powaqqatsi.jpg.Visual idea: Overlaying old-world labour with the layered signals of a modern, technological world.

0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Composition: Horizon at the upper third: orange-yellow sky and a dark mountain at the right; below, a dim blue cityscape that reflects like water; title floats in the center. Vertical streaks run through the whole image.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Medium: Digitally processed image with vertical scratch lines, noise specks and layered gradients, like degraded video or film; painterly distortion.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Typography: Blocky angular gray capitals, small to mid-size, centered over the middle; typeset futuristic face with slightly rough edges, laid over the image without distortion.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Color and light: Fiery orange sky and teal-blue lower half; glowing, luminous, artificial.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Story it suggests: A city and landscape dissolving into digital static under an unnatural sunset.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Visual idea: A cityscape melting into a mirrored screen of noise, nature and technology merged.
0642_naqoyqatsi.jpg.Feels like: Early 2000s digital experimental documentary, techno and apocalyptic.

0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.People: One man's face in a large drawn close-up, with a cigarette in his mouth; a scar and stitches on his forehead; a smoky ghost outline surrounds his head. A rifle barrel points in from the right, with straps or curtains behind.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Composition: Face on the left half, huge orange title stacked on the right and overlapping curtains and the gun; diagonal drapery lines. Text and image are about equal in weight.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Medium: Detailed graphite pencil drawing with soft shading and smudged smoke, in grayscale; a flat, solid orange ink for the title.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Typography: Huge tall Art Deco display capitals in bright orange, stacked on four lines at the right, with a small script "the" at the left; the letters are cropped and overlap the drawing; the credit at the bottom is in a white sans-serif and serif mix.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Color and light: Gray pencil tones with vivid orange accents; moody, dramatic light.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Story it suggests: A tough man with a cigarette and a scar is watched down the barrel of a gun.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Visual idea: A pencil-drawn face against a screaming orange title, the contrast heightening menace.
0643_the-man-who-knew-too-much.jpg.Feels like: 1930s thriller, with an Art Deco look and hand-drawn illustration.

0644_pina.jpg.People: One dancer, seen from behind or above with her face hidden by wet hair, airborne in a tucked jump with arms spread wide. Full body, alone, small relative to the black field.
0644_pina.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: red lowercase title at the top, tagline beneath, the figure floating below the middle with a spray of droplets around her. Large black space on either side.
0644_pina.jpg.Medium: Sharp photographic realism with frozen water droplets; a high-contrast, glossy look.
0644_pina.jpg.Typography: Very large red serif lowercase "pina" at the top center, with a light serif tagline in pale gray beneath on three lines; a small mixed-weight credit at the bottom. Elegant typeset, clean, no distortion.
0644_pina.jpg.Color and light: Black background with an orange-coral dress, red title and white sparkling water; theatrical spotlight with rain.
0644_pina.jpg.Story it suggests: A dancer leaps ecstatically in the rain, expressing a feeling beyond words.
0644_pina.jpg.Visual idea: Freezing a moment of motion in rain, the droplets forming an aura around the body.
0644_pina.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary dance film, 2010s elegant and emotional.

0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.People: One elderly woman, small, kneeling at the bottom center with hands clasped in prayer, covered by a straw mat or cloak, with a red rosary. She is drawn, not photographed, alone in snow.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Composition: Dark rectangle of snowfall above with the title at the center; a pale snowy ground below with the tiny figure at the bottom center. Symmetrical and centered.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or ink illustration with textured, deckled edges around the dark panel; looks like paper with brush marks and splattered dots.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Typography: Angular, cut-paper-like capitals in pink and cream, big for the main word "NARAYAMA" with a small "THE BALLAD OF" above; hand-lettered with rough edges, laid over the dark snow field.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Color and light: Black and warm gray-beige with white snow dots and a red rosary accent; muted, wintry, quiet.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Story it suggests: An old woman waits in the falling snow in silent prayer and resignation.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Visual idea: The tiny praying figure under a huge dark snowing sky, scale as solitude and acceptance.
0645_the-ballad-of-narayama.jpg.Feels like: Japanese folk-tale illustration, 1950s traditional and stylized.

0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.People: A boy in a red jacket in profile, half body, looking straight ahead; a woman at the left edge, cropped to her face and curly hair, with her hands on his cheek and shoulder. They are close, she is protective or restraining.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Composition: The boy sits at center right, the woman fills the left edge; their hands form a diagonal across the lower left. Dark blurred background with the title in the upper right.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism with shallow depth of field, soft film-like grain.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Typography: Small to mid lowercase white condensed sans-serif title at the top right, with a small serif credit above it; typeset, plain, floating in the dark background.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber and dark brown with a red jacket; night street light, warm glow.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman gently holds a stubborn, solemn child who stares ahead, a bond forming under tension.
0646_the-kid-with-a-bike.jpg.Visual idea: Touch as the connection: her hands on his face and arm, while he looks away.

0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.People: One man sitting on a rooftop, leaning against a brick chimney, face in shadow, knees up. A flock of white birds flies above. A single figure, small in the bottom right.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Composition: Large empty slate-gray sky takes the middle, harbor with cranes at the lower left, chimney and figure at the lower right; flock climbing diagonally to the upper right. The weight sits at the bottom.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Medium: Linocut or screen-print look with rough brush-edge borders; flat solid ink in two or three tones, hand-inked textures.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Typography: Heavy condensed sans-serif capitals in black and cream at the top, spanning the full width, with a distressed, inky edge; two lines of different color, plus a small credit line.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Color and light: Slate gray-blue, black and cream; flat, cool, overcast tone.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man sits apart above the busy docks, thinking while birds fly free.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Visual idea: The empty sky above a lonely man, with the birds as freedom or conscience.
0647_on-the-waterfront.jpg.Feels like: 1950s American urban drama, with a mid-century screen-print poster look.

0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.People: Three faces in black and white at different positions: a man at upper right, a woman at left center, another woman at the bottom right with hands to her head. Close-ups, cropped, each looking in a different direction, not touching.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Composition: Three faces scattered diagonally in a black field, with text overlapping; a yellow circle badge at the upper left. A zigzag from top right to bottom right.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film stills against a flat black; a flat yellow ink circle.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Typography: Big white condensed sans-serif capitals stacked on several lines, centered, covering much of the poster and overlapping the faces; hand-cut look with rough edges, plus a yellow circle with "PARIS 1960" that overlaps the credit.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and a mustard yellow; high-contrast documentary light.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Story it suggests: Ordinary people in a city, caught speaking or lost in thought during one summer.
0648_chronicle-of-a-summer.jpg.Visual idea: Faces scattered among the huge words, like interview subjects emerging from darkness.

0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.People: One small black silhouette of a man in a hat and coat walking in the lower left; a small airplane silhouette at the upper right. Tiny compared with the shapes.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal split: a black wedge rising to the right and a white and blue streaked area at left; title across the upper middle; the man on the diagonal edge. A dome building sits near him.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Medium: Gouache or cut-paper style flat shapes with slightly textured brush edges, like a screen print.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Typography: Huge chunky hand-drawn red-orange capitals in two stacked tiers filling the upper half, overlapped by the diagonal shadows; plus a bold white sans-serif credit at the bottom.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, steel blue and vivid red-orange; stark, dramatic shadows.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man hunted in a city under shadow, with an aircraft overhead.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Visual idea: A diagonal shadow looming over a small figure, with the title as a warning sign.
0649_ministry-of-fear.jpg.Feels like: 1940s wartime spy thriller, with a mid-century graphic style.

0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.People: Only a pair of hands emerging from the upper edge, twisting a coiled rope or wire loop; sleeves visible. No face.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Composition: A large circular loop of braided rope lies at the center on a rumpled cloth, with the hands at the top; title at the bottom. The circle dominates.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photographic realism with high-contrast shadows and tactile textures.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Typography: Big pale gray condensed sans-serif title at the bottom spanning nearly the full width, with a small spaced credit above; typeset, cropped nowhere, laid over the image bottom.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome, with deep shadows; low side light.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is patiently braiding a makeshift rope in secret, preparing for a way out.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Visual idea: Close focus on hands and an improvised rope loop, showing patience and craft, with a circle echoing a noose or a cage.
0650_a-man-escaped.jpg.Feels like: 1950s austere European film, spare and tactile.

0651_badlands.jpg.People: A young man and a young woman, half body, seated close together; he sits in the front in a denim jacket looking at the viewer, she peers over his shoulder holding a smoking revolver upright. Painted, not photographed.
0651_badlands.jpg.Composition: The pair fill the lower two thirds in a pyramid, the title across the top; a small orange sun and low hills at the right. Centered, with a bold diagonal slant to the title.
0651_badlands.jpg.Medium: Gouache or oil painting with visible brushstrokes and flat blocks of color, like a vintage paperback or pulp-style illustration.
0651_badlands.jpg.Typography: Huge slanted, speed-style capitals in maroon with a white outline, spanning the full width at the top; a smaller italic tagline in brown beneath; typeset, with a dynamic, forward-leaning angle.
0651_badlands.jpg.Color and light: Warm yellow-cream sky, denim blue, green and an orange sun; sunny, flat afternoon light.
0651_badlands.jpg.Story it suggests: A young couple on the run in open country, with a smoking gun showing violence behind the sweet pose.
0651_badlands.jpg.Visual idea: A romantic pose with a smoking pistol, putting innocence next to danger.
0651_badlands.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American outlaw road movie, with a pulp poster look.

0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.People: One character shown four times as portraits in different frames and costumes (a hat, a beret, a uniform cap, a bow tie), each in a head-and-shoulders view; a shadowy hand and a dark silhouette drift between the frames. They look like the same person in different disguises.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Composition: A 2x2 grid of framed portraits, each with a different frame shape (rectangle, oval, rounded, diamond), over a striped wallpaper; a shadow figure threads down the middle. Symmetric and balanced.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Medium: Vector-like flat illustration with smooth gradients and a gray, Art Deco look; crisp edges, smooth shading.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Typography: Elegant script title at the top center in white brush calligraphy, mid-size; spaced serif credit at the bottom; typeset and refined.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Color and light: Silvery grays and black with small red lips; spotlight glow on the wallpaper.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Story it suggests: A man who wears many faces and identities, with a dark presence lurking behind each frame.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Visual idea: One face in multiple frames as multiple identities, with a shadow hand tying them together.
0652_monsieur-verdoux.jpg.Feels like: 1940s dark comedy, with a refined Art Deco look.

0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.People: A woman in a red kimono, shown from the shoulders up, with a large flat face tilted and wide green eyes; a large hand reaches in from the right and grips her shoulder or hair. She seems frightened. Stylized and drawn.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Composition: A diagonal, tilted layout: face at top center, a huge hand at lower right, kimono at lower left; gray swirls of waves or smoke behind. The title runs vertically in an orange block at the right.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-like illustration with fine grain or stipple shading and gradients, like a risograph or screen print.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Typography: Vertical orange block at the upper right with the title in yellow capitals stacked top to bottom, and the credit set sideways in yellow beneath; small relative to the image, typeset, neat, rotated 90 degrees.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Color and light: Vivid orange-red and green on charcoal and cream gray; dramatic flat lighting.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman recoils as a looming hand seizes her, in fear and coercion.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Visual idea: An oversized hand grasping a tiny, wide-eyed face, using scale and tilt to show threat.
0653_gate-of-hell.jpg.Feels like: Japanese period drama, with a modern graphic reinterpretation of classic woodblock style.

0654_repo-man.jpg.People: A skull head in profile facing left, with a mohawk of spikes, plus a skeletal hand at the bottom edge. It is a skeleton or X-ray-like figure, not a living person.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Composition: Large skull at center-left with spikes radiating up and to the right; the title at the lower right overlapping the neck. Dense filled field.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photocopy or threshold-print look, with flat white and green overlaid on black; a street map printed over the skull.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Typography: Rough, chunky, hand-cut or stencil-like green capitals stacked on two lines at the lower right, large, with a small credit beneath; the letters are jagged and sit over the skull.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and acid neon green; stark, no real light.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Story it suggests: A punk skull wired into the city's streets, the grid of Los Angeles becoming its brain.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Visual idea: A city map as the skull's circuitry and the spiked hair as roads, merging a punk with an urban grid.
0654_repo-man.jpg.Feels like: 1980s punk zine and sci-fi cult comedy.

0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.People: One cartoon figure, drawn from the waist down: blue shorts, striped socks, black shoes, white gloved hands, holding a tall stack of colored book-like boards on which titles are written; the head is hidden behind the stack.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Composition: Vertical stack of colored bands rising from a body on a yellow spotlight circle, centered; a dark charcoal halo around it. A big name at the very top.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Medium: Colored pencil and crayon with smudged charcoal, pen lettering and a red plastic heart sticker, on textured white paper, like a hand-made sketchbook or collage.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Typography: Many lettering styles per band: a large serif name at the top, dotted marquee capitals, ornate decorated capitals, plain bold serif, handwritten script and cartoon-bodied letters; each is different and sits on its colored band.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Color and light: Blue, cream, green, pink and orange bands with charcoal gray; flat and playful, with a soft yellow spotlight.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Story it suggests: A clown-like fellow struggles under a tower of his own works.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Visual idea: A stack of titles as a heavy load carried by a comic figure, the films as books.
0655_pierre-etaix.jpg.Feels like: Whimsical French comedy retrospective, 1960s hand-drawn playfulness.

0656_jubal.jpg.People: Three figures: a tall man in a white shirt and cowboy hat turned and looking back over his shoulder in the front right; a smiling man in a red shirt at the left holding a woman, who stares coldly out from between them. Painted, half-body.
0656_jubal.jpg.Composition: Cluster at the lower half with the large title above; the front figure forms a strong diagonal; clouds in the background. Weight at the lower left and right.
0656_jubal.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushwork, like a vintage Western film poster illustration.
0656_jubal.jpg.Typography: Huge ornate Western-style slab-serif letters in peach with orange shading and a 3D drop shadow, spanning most of the top; a small orange credit above it; typeset with a woodtype flair.
0656_jubal.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue with white clouds, cream and red-brown clothing; bright outdoor daylight.
0656_jubal.jpg.Story it suggests: A tense triangle: a smug man clutches a woman while a stern cowboy glances back, wary.
0656_jubal.jpg.Visual idea: Three faces with three different attitudes in one clump, drawing a love triangle.

0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.People: Two men in profile, standing side by side: one in a cowboy hat on the left, another with curly hair on the right holding a rifle. Half to three-quarter body; both looking left, like partners or captor and captive.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Composition: Two tall figures against a building wall with a sign; white smoke or dust billows at the lower left; a white title band at the bottom.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Medium: Oil or gouache painting rendered in grayscale, with visible brush texture; a thick, woodtype lettering printed in flat black.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Typography: Big black Western woodtype capitals with decorative flourishes on a white band at the bottom, spanning full width, partly cut off at the bottom edge; script credit above it; typeset.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white with a warm brown cast; smoky, high-contrast light.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men stand ready with a rifle, watching for trouble as the dust rises.
0657_3-10-to-yuma.jpg.Visual idea: Two men facing the same direction, hinting at a shared threat or a dangerous escort.

0658_medium-cool.jpg.People: A man's face in profile (a silhouette-like head), filled with a stack of tiny crowd scenes: protesters with signs, police in blue helmets. A crowd inside a head; the face is composited with a crowd.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Composition: A huge camera lens fills the poster, with concentric rings; the head profile sits at the center-right with the crowd along the line of the face; title below on pale ground. A circular composition.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Medium: Grainy photographic composite with a glossy lens rendering and gradient colors; paper texture in the lower white area.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Typography: Big lowercase bold gray sans-serif title at the bottom, spanning the whole width, with a smaller credit; typeset and clean, with a heavy weight.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Color and light: Dark charcoal, teal, purple and pink glints, with a pale gray base; cool, reflective light.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone observer through a camera, with the world's unrest reflected inside his eye or mind.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Visual idea: Face as the lens: the crowd is seen through the camera, linking media and the viewer.
0658_medium-cool.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s counterculture drama, with a modern, designed look.

0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.People: None; only an empty snack-bar caravan.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Composition: A trailer sits at the lower middle on bare ground in front of piles of pallets, under a huge empty sky; the title block is at the upper right. Lots of empty blue space.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Medium: Photograph with a painted, matte look; textured, soft brush-like texture on the sky.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Typography: Big bold condensed cream sans-serif capitals stacked on two lines at the upper right, large; a smaller spaced credit below; typeset, flat. The red hand-painted lettering on the caravan ("SNACKS") echoes it.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue with cream and a worn blue and white caravan, with red accents; soft, calm daylight.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Story it suggests: A modest roadside snack stand stands alone, drab and quietly hopeful.
0659_life-is-sweet.jpg.Visual idea: An ordinary, shabby trailer under a big blue sky, which makes the title ironic or affectionate.

0660_things-to-come.jpg.People: One man, large, shown from the chest up inside a huge domed helmet; he looks up and to the side, calm and resolute. No other figures, only small aircraft.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Composition: The giant helmet fills the left and center and tilts slightly; the city interior is seen through its glass. A flock of planes streams diagonally from upper right, and the big block title sits bottom right, forming a stepped E that anchors the base.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Medium: Fine engraved line work and halftone-like hatching in grayscale, rendered as a crisp vector-style illustration over flat orange.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Typography: The title is huge, extruded in 3D block letters at the bottom, cut off at the right edge, ridged gray; small credit lines are tilted along the helmet's diagonal in white and orange.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Color and light: Vivid orange-red ground against cool silver-gray and black; flat graphic light with metallic sheen.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man in a futuristic suit gazes toward a new world rising over a ruined, smoking old one.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Visual idea: The helmet works as a window onto a future city while the ruins sit at its feet, so past and future share one frame.
0660_things-to-come.jpg.Feels like: Retro-futurist science fiction, 1930s deco propaganda style reimagined as a modern screenprint.

0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.People: One young person with long loose hair lies sprawled on their back at the bottom, seen from above and partly cropped, among dark fur or cloth. Three small dogs or wolves stand tiny in the left middle.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Composition: Mostly empty pale space with a small sun-like disc at the top. The fallen figure is at the bottom right, the animals at left, and the title block sits in the center right, producing a loose diagonal from animals down to the figure.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film photograph with soft fog, bleached highlights and heavy grain.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Typography: Title is large and stamped: a blackletter first name above a heavy sans surname, in rough gray ink that looks printed with worn texture. Credit lines are smaller, centered below and staggered.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Color and light: Near monochrome white and silver-gray with deep black patches; hazy overcast or snow light.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Story it suggests: A person lies in a white wilderness while animals approach from a distance.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Visual idea: Whiteout emptiness makes the body and creatures feel isolated and exposed, and the medieval lettering anchors a distant past.
0661_marketa-lazarova.jpg.Feels like: Austere arthouse drama, 1960s European black-and-white cinema.

0662_safety-last.jpg.People: One man in a dark suit, round glasses and hat hangs from a clock hand, full body, seen from above and slightly blurred. Tiny pedestrians and cars appear far below on the street.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Composition: A steep vertical composition: the clock face at the top, the body hanging down the left center, and the street sloping away at lower right. The high camera angle sets up dizzying depth with converging building lines.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with grain, sharp brick detail and some motion blur on the cars.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Typography: The title is printed on the clock face itself, in bold slanted serif capitals, black, split over two lines and tilted with the clock hands. A vertical marquee sign reading a star's name runs down the right as part of the scene.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Color and light: Gray scale, from bright white clock to dark suit; plain daylight.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Story it suggests: A man dangles high above a busy street, held by nothing but his grip.
0662_safety-last.jpg.Visual idea: The clock face doubles as the title card, so time running out and height become a single image.

0663_shoah.jpg.Composition: One-point perspective: railway tracks converge to a vanishing point at the center, disappearing into mist; trees frame the left and right, and the title sits on the vertical axis above the vanishing point.
0663_shoah.jpg.Medium: Soft, grainy color film still, dreamy and out of focus with heavy haze.
0663_shoah.jpg.Typography: Small widely spaced caps for director credit, with 'SHOAH' in tall condensed pale sans caps, about a third of the width, centered above the tracks; light gray, flat, floating in the mist.
0663_shoah.jpg.Color and light: Muted green and gray-blue with white fog; diffuse overcast light.
0663_shoah.jpg.Story it suggests: An empty track leads into fog, a journey toward an unseen place.
0663_shoah.jpg.Visual idea: The converging rails lead the eye into a blank, misty void that stands for what is absent.

0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.People: One woman in a kimono, half-reclining on the floor in profile, looking down and away; she occupies the lower left and center as a full-body figure. She appears alone.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Composition: Dark empty upper space, with the figure low and stretched horizontally while the title letters run in a tall vertical column through the center. The vertical stack crosses her body and balances the horizontal pose.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Medium: Soft black-and-white film photograph, rich grain and deep blacks with a glowing pale kimono.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Typography: Title letters are huge, stacked one per line vertically, white thin elegant serif, with the O, R and U slightly sliced or broken. Letters overlap the figure's robe. Small credit lines sit at the top in gray.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Color and light: Black and gray with pale highlights; soft spotlight-like glow on the figure.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman rests wearily in the dark, burdened and withdrawn.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Visual idea: The tall column of letters cuts through the horizontal body like a falling line, a sense of a life vertical and a woman laid down.
0664_the-life-of-oharu.jpg.Feels like: Classical Japanese period drama, refined 1950s black-and-white cinema in a contemporary typographic treatment.

0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.People: Only two hands are visible, from the sleeves down, one flat on a board and one resting on a bottle; no faces. A person is cooking or preparing food.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Composition: A tight close-up crop of a table: hands in the upper middle, a bottle on the right, a glass jar at left, and porcelain bowls along the bottom. Title sits lower center-right over the dark bottle.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Medium: Soft photographic film still with warm grain, shallow focus and slight blur on the foreground.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Typography: Title is large, a flowing white calligraphic script in mixed case, with a smaller italic credit line beneath it. It sits over the dark bottle and wood for contrast.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Color and light: Warm browns, olive and cream with glints of glass; dim candlelight-like interior.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Story it suggests: Careful preparation of a lavish meal, seen only through hands and table objects.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Visual idea: The meal is told by tactile details instead of faces, so the cook stays anonymous and the food stands for devotion.
0665_babette-s-feast.jpg.Feels like: Intimate European period drama with a still-life quality, 1980s art film.
