0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.People: One boy, full body, stands barefoot and slightly floating above the ground, with pale, cracked, ghostly skin and glowing eyes, facing us. A red plume rises from his head.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Composition: A diagonal giant bomb leans from upper left to lower right, with the boy standing in its beam of light. Title is at the top; a window glows in the lower left; large black empty areas surround.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn digital illustration with ink outlines, flat color blocks and painterly red smoke with splatter, in comic-book style.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Typography: Title is big, stacked in two lines at the top, gold serif capitals, partly overlapped by the red smoke, with thin gold rules. Credit in smaller gray italic serif at lower right.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Color and light: Black dominating, with brown bomb, slate-blue figure and a vivid red plume; moody night, with a spotlit figure.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Story it suggests: A ghostly child haunts a dark place where an unexploded bomb looms and blood-like smoke drifts upward.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Visual idea: The bomb stands in for a backbone, and the red smoke from the boy's head suggests a violent wound.
0666_the-devil-s-backbone.jpg.Feels like: Gothic ghost story with comic-book illustration, a modern horror-fantasy poster.

0667_seconds.jpg.People: One tiny figure, drawn in anatomical muscle style, lies stretched in a small black box; it reads as a body or specimen rather than a person. No other people.
0667_seconds.jpg.Composition: Large black open case, like a briefcase or a coffin, at the center, with the lid raised above and the tray below; a small figure at its heart. Strong perspective with the title in a band at the bottom.
0667_seconds.jpg.Medium: Flat solid black ink on white, bold woven brush-pen lines and white cut-outs, like a woodcut or ink illustration, with a visible signature.
0667_seconds.jpg.Typography: Title is wide, heavy, custom red block capitals with squared, interlocking letterforms, across the bottom, with a bold black sans credit line below. All typeset and graphic.
0667_seconds.jpg.Color and light: Stark black and white with one bold red for the title; flat, shadowless.
0667_seconds.jpg.Story it suggests: A body is packed away in a box, as though a person were an object to be stored.
0667_seconds.jpg.Visual idea: The case opens like a coffin and holds a flayed figure, so identity is an object kept in a box.
0667_seconds.jpg.Feels like: Cold-war paranoid thriller, 1960s graphic design in the Saul Bass tradition.

0668_the-big-city.jpg.Composition: A dense tangle of horizontal and vertical black lines and blocks fills the center, with the title letters built into the grid; one tiny red square sits near the top center. Open blue margin on the left and right, a credit line across the top.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in thin and thick black lines on flat color, like a geometric vector graphic.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Typography: The title is made of blocky pixel-like black letters stacked in three lines, merged into the line grid so that they are hard to separate from it, with a typeset spaced-out credit in thin serif capitals on top.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Color and light: Dusty periwinkle blue with black and a single crimson accent; flat, even light.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Story it suggests: A city's streets and buildings form a maze in which one small point stands out.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Visual idea: The title's letters become city blocks and streets, so lettering and urban map are the same thing, and the red square stands as the lone human.
0668_the-big-city.jpg.Feels like: Modernist geometric graphic design, 1960s Mondrian-like abstraction in a contemporary print.

0669_charulata.jpg.People: One woman's head and neck in profile, a single brush-drawn line figure facing left; it is a drawing, not a photograph. Large, from head to shoulder.
0669_charulata.jpg.Composition: A big sweeping contour line fills the upper two thirds, with the face pointing left and a long hair line curving off to the right. The title sits across the bottom, with large empty cream space within and around the figure.
0669_charulata.jpg.Medium: Black ink brush lines with dry-brush streaks and a small red dot on a cream paper ground, like calligraphy.
0669_charulata.jpg.Typography: Title is large, a flowing hand-lettered script in deep crimson with long swashes and curls, spanning the lower right; small spaced black serif capitals for the credit below. It extends the brush line of the neck.
0669_charulata.jpg.Color and light: Cream, black and a wine red; flat, matte paper-like light.
0669_charulata.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet woman looks away, absorbed in her own thoughts.
0669_charulata.jpg.Visual idea: One continuous gesture draws the woman and flows into the lettering, tying her inner life to the written name.
0669_charulata.jpg.Feels like: Elegant minimalist ink drawing, 1960s Indian art cinema.

0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.People: A hand wrapped in a ruffled period sleeve holds up a human skull at the center; behind it is a large uniformed officer in a peaked cap, cropped to cap and torso with no face, and more officers repeat as dim silhouettes at the sides. Hand and skull are staged in front of the figure.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Composition: Strict symmetry: the cap sits on the axis with the skull below, and rows of identical silhouetted officers repeat left and right. The title arches across the top while the hand rises from the lower left.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Medium: Digital gouache-style illustration, flat shapes with soft shading and painterly texture.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, in tall cream condensed capitals with orange extruded block shadow in a fan, spanning the full width at the top, with a small italic word between. Yellow credits above and right, bold sans.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Color and light: Slate blue-gray with yellow-orange and cream accents; theatrical, stagey spotlight.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Story it suggests: A theatrical gesture meets a military uniform, so performance and menace collide.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Visual idea: The skull is held up like a prop in front of the cap, so the actor's role and the uniform cover each other, and the faceless officers repeat like a chorus.
0670_to-be-or-not-to-be.jpg.Feels like: Wartime satire with a 1940s theater poster look in modern illustration.

0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.People: Six cartoon figures in all, full body or heads and arms: a blond figure in pink gown reclining on the title, an angry man in a gray suit, a man in a tan suit leaning on his fist, and three others tumbling among the letters. They are caricatures, not photographs.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Composition: The big letters stack in four lines, filling the whole poster like a marquee, with the figures draped, clinging and sprawled over and around them in a zigzag. Crowded and busy but balanced by white space around.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and brush-pen ink caricature, with bold black outlines and fresh color washes on white paper.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Typography: The title is gigantic, in stacked block capitals with black outlines and rows of hand-painted circles as light bulbs, in yellow, orange, green and pink for each line; figures overlap and interact with the letters. A small bold credit is centered at the bottom.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Color and light: Bright pink, yellow, green and orange on white; cheerful flat studio light.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Story it suggests: A madcap, rowdy comedy of misfits fighting and flirting around a cabaret.
0671_la-cage-aux-folles.jpg.Visual idea: The title is a stage marquee and the characters hang on it, so the sign is the set.

0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.People: One woman lies on her back, shown from the shoulders up and rotated, so that she looks upward and out of frame; one arm is bent overhead. Only her, seen as a close, large face.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Composition: Diagonal: the figure's head sits upper left and the body falls toward lower right in a patterned blouse. A dark void is at the top right, and the lower third is a bold title block with three film names across the base.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with heavy grain.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Typography: Huge yellow sans capitals in two lines, 'surname' large at lower right, with small yellow script and sans label to the left and three smaller white sans film titles in a row at the very bottom. Flat type over the photo.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Color and light: Black and white with a single punchy yellow; strong side light on the face.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Story it suggests: A woman lies gazing upward at something we cannot see, vulnerable and wondering.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Visual idea: Black-and-white image with a saturated yellow name makes the star's name the main subject.
0672_3-films-by-roberto-rossellini-starr.Feels like: Postwar Italian neorealist-era melodrama, packaged as a modern collection set.

0673_stromboli.jpg.People: One woman, close-up from the chest up, face tilted up, her mouth parted and eyes wide in worry or awe; she looks into the distance with wavy hair.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Composition: The figure fills the middle, with dark volcanic ground behind her and a pale sky above. The very large title is in the lower third, across the full width, over her torso, and a credit line below.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film photograph with fine grain and strong contrast.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Typography: The title is a giant yellow slab-serif in extruded capitals with black drop shadow, spanning the whole width and crowding the left edge; a smaller yellow spaced credit line is below. It overlays her jacket.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Color and light: Gray scale plus saturated yellow type; hard natural daylight under a bright sky.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stands in a harsh barren place, searching the sky in anxiety.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Visual idea: Her upward gaze meets the heavy letters pressing from below, which pins her between sky and ground.
0673_stromboli.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Italian drama, 1950s black-and-white cinema with bold modern type.

0674_europe-51.jpg.People: One woman in a dark coat is shown from the waist up in profile, looking off to the left; three small figures walk in the background.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Composition: The main figure leans right with her face at the upper middle, with a flat gray field and white apartment blocks behind; the title spans the lower third at the left and bottom right.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with grain and soft focus in the background.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Typography: Title is large, yellow bubbly brush script in mixed case, tilted slightly upward to the right, partly overlapping her coat, with a smaller wide yellow sans credit below.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Color and light: Gray scale with a bright yellow title; flat overcast daylight.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stands apart on an empty open ground in front of the modern city, lost in thought.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Visual idea: The figure's profile against distant housing blocks sets personal solitude against the city's scale.
0674_europe-51.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Italian neorealist drama, 1950s black-and-white cinema.

0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.People: One woman, large close-up of face and shoulders, gazing slightly past the viewer with a worried, serious look; no others.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Composition: The face sits in the upper center, filling most of the frame, with a soft blurred background of a pale vertical shape. The title spans the full width just below, across her collar, and the credit sits at the bottom.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film photograph, fine grain, soft focus background, rich blacks.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed yellow serif capitals spanning the full width in a single line, with a tiny italic 'to' between the words tucked at the baseline; it crosses her collar and shoulders. A wide-spaced yellow credit sits at the bottom on black.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Color and light: Gray scale with saturated yellow type; soft frontal studio light with a dark base.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks out with uneasy, unspoken feeling, as though something is slipping from her.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Visual idea: A tightly cropped face against bold yellow letters makes the emotion the whole event.
0675_journey-to-italy.jpg.Feels like: Postwar European melodrama, 1950s black-and-white cinema in a modern collection series.

0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.People: One woman drawn as an illustration: only an eye with a lash, red lips and a hint of face, framed by huge flowing white hair; she is cropped and abstracted, with a face looking down. She is a drawing, not a photograph.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Composition: Giant swirling white hair shapes sweep from the top left down to the lower left and top right, forming a curving frame around a small pale face. The title is at the lower right, with a small cluster of flames at the bottom left.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Medium: Flat screenprint look with solid ink shapes, soft grain gradient in the white and a speckled texture.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Typography: Title is in bold hand-cut black type, with a tiny heart over the i, in mixed case, the big 'Witch' at lower right, tilted slightly, with a white bold credit at the bottom. It sits on the blue and echoes the hair shapes.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Color and light: Pale teal blue, white and black, with a single hot red-orange for lips and flames; flat graphic light.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Story it suggests: A seductive woman made of smoke and hair seems to drift up from a small fire.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Visual idea: The hair becomes smoke rising from the flames, so a witch's allure and the fire are one shape.
0676_i-married-a-witch.jpg.Feels like: Light fantasy comedy, 1940s romantic poster look in a modern flat illustration.

0677_the-uninvited.jpg.People: One woman in a long gown bends backward in mid-air, arched and floating, as if faint or lifted by something unseen; her face is turned away and she is largely pale and bluish. A butterfly or ribbon rests at her neck. Ambiguous: reads like a ghost or a falling body.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Composition: The figure floats at the center in a diagonal arc, and a large black void surrounds her. Credit at top center, with the title slanted in the lower half rising toward the right.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Medium: Painterly oil-paint illustration with visible brush streaks and glowing fabric against inky black brush marks.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Typography: Title is large, hand-lettered in rough, slightly torn cream script and slanted upward to the right, in two lines at the bottom; small centered serif credit at the top. The letters look brushed or cut paper.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with warm golden ochre dress, cold blue-white skin; a dramatic, ghostly glow from within.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman hangs in darkness, weightless and drained, as though a presence has her.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Visual idea: The dress glows like a lantern in the dark, so the body reads as a haunting rather than a person.
0677_the-uninvited.jpg.Feels like: Gothic ghost story, 1940s haunted-house cinema in a painterly modern treatment.

0678_la-notte.jpg.People: Three faces appear in black slivers: a woman at the left, another woman in the center, and a man at the right, each cropped through a vertical cut, with their eyes cast down or aside. They are separate portraits, not interacting.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Composition: Black field divided into vertical strips, with the same title repeated and offset in each strip so that it is cut off at the edges. Faces sit in the lower half, with empty black above.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white film photograph with deep blacks, slightly grainy.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Typography: Title is a bold white sans with horizontal slits cut through the letters, repeated across the strips and cropped at both edges, with small spaced thin capitals above; letter fragments run off the poster.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Color and light: Black and white, with deep night darkness; faces lit by hard, dramatic side light.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Story it suggests: People are apart, each in his or her own darkness, drifting from one another.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Visual idea: The shifted strips cut each face from the next, as though the poster itself were splitting people apart.
0678_la-notte.jpg.Feels like: Modernist European art film, 1960s black-and-white existential drama.

0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.People: One man, close and large, hunched forward and looking down with a fierce, scowling face as he draws or wipes a sword; hands in white halftone cuffs grip the hilt. It is an illustration.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal: the head tilts down toward the lower left and the blade flashes across the middle. A giant title column runs vertically down the right edge, and a hatched diagonal background fills the rest.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Medium: Two-color comic-book style: thick black ink outlines, flat mustard-gold fill, halftone dots and fine diagonal hatch lines.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Typography: Giant white blocky condensed capitals stacked vertically, rotated 90 degrees along the right edge and running from top to bottom, edge to edge; small spaced white subtitle at the bottom right. Letters overlap the figure's shoulder.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Color and light: Mustard gold, black and white; flat, graphic light with hard contrast.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Story it suggests: A swordsman grimly prepares to strike.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Visual idea: The vertical word runs like a blade along the figure, so lettering and weapon share the same cut.
0679_zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman.jpg.Feels like: Pulp samurai action, 1960s Japanese chanbara in a modern screenprint.

0680_city-lights.jpg.People: One man, close and large from the chest up, eyes closed with a blissful smile, holds a white flower to his nose; he wears a bowler hat, a toothbrush mustache and a polka-dot bow tie. A cartoon drawing, not a photograph.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Composition: The head and hat sit at the center, framed by a repeating grid of skyscrapers in outline behind. The flower and hand at lower right, with a title on the hat and a credit band at the bottom.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic cartoon with thick black outlines, flat fills and thin gray outline architecture, like a screenprint.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Typography: The title is spelled in light bulbs, white dots on the black bowler hat, in two lines of sans capitals, as if it were a marquee on the hat; a bold gray slab credit sits in a white band at the bottom.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Color and light: Cobalt blue, gray and black with white accents; flat, even light.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Story it suggests: A gentle man savors a flower in a big city.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Visual idea: The hat becomes a lit sign, joining the man and the city's lights in one icon.
0680_city-lights.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era romantic comedy, 1930s Art Deco cartoon style.

0681_frances-ha.jpg.People: One young woman, running or dancing mid-stride across a street, arms out and head thrown back; she is blurred by motion and cropped at the head and feet. She appears alone.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Composition: The figure sits on the right with a diagonal sweep of her arm to the left; the road and a white crosswalk line run through the left. The title overlaps her body in the center.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with motion blur and soft focus.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, a white refined serif in two stacked lines, 'Frances' across the middle and 'Ha' beneath, running off the right edge, with a small serif credit at the bottom; the letters overlap and cover her torso.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Color and light: Gray scale with strong white type; flat, overcast daylight.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman rushes across the city street, carefree and unsteady.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Visual idea: The motion blur and the title on her body make her seem to be spilling out of the frame.
0681_frances-ha.jpg.Feels like: Indie urban comedy, a modern take on 1960s French New Wave black-and-white.

0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.People: One man's face, large, from forehead to chin, looking sidelong at us with a hard, wary gaze; the face is overlaid by fingerprints, so it is a photo blended with print patterns.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Composition: The face fills the left and center, tilted slightly, with a giant fingerprint spiral covering it and a second purple print on the right. The title block sits on the right middle, left-aligned, in an open space.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Medium: Photographic face double-exposed with scanned fingerprint ridges, with heavy halftone-like line texture and a slightly grainy printed look.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Typography: Title is bold, orange condensed capitals in four stacked lines, left-aligned at the right middle, with a small white credit beneath; it sits on the purple print without overlapping the face.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Color and light: Deep indigo and purple with warm orange-pink skin tones and black ridges; dark moody light.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Story it suggests: A man is under scrutiny, his identity read as evidence.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Visual idea: The fingerprint becomes the face's skin, so a person is reduced to a police record.
0682_investigation-of-a-citizen-above-su.Feels like: Political thriller, a 1970s Italian crime film look, as a modern composite.

0683_nashville.jpg.People: Dozens of small full-body silhouettes in red, in three rows: musicians and singers at the top, a mix of ordinary people and a pianist and motorcycle in the middle, and police and a crowd of children and adults at the bottom. They stand side by side, facing out, like a group portrait. Some are cut-out photographs.
0683_nashville.jpg.Composition: Layered horizontal bands: a blue field of white stars in the upper left, the title in the center and three rows of crowds spaced evenly above and below. Strong horizontal rhythm with a wide cream margin.
0683_nashville.jpg.Medium: Flat two-tone print: red-tinted cut-out photographs on cream paper with a navy blue flag block, like a screenprint, with paper-toned texture.
0683_nashville.jpg.Typography: Title is wide, spaced navy sans capitals across the middle, almost the full width, evenly spaced between the crowd rows; a small navy credit line sits below it. It is flat and typeset.
0683_nashville.jpg.Color and light: Red, white and navy blue; flat, evenly lit.
0683_nashville.jpg.Story it suggests: A large community of people gathers under one flag, each with a separate story.
0683_nashville.jpg.Visual idea: A flag is built from people, so the crowd is the nation, and the rows read like a lineup or a stage.
0683_nashville.jpg.Feels like: Ensemble satire of America, 1970s Americana in a modern screenprint look.

0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.People: Several small film stills in tinted boxes show a number of people: a group of men seated outdoors, a sleeping woman's face, silhouettes of fishermen, a man on a motorcycle with horns, a veiled woman, and two women. Each is a film frame, not a single narrative.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Composition: A collage: seven irregular rectangular images scattered around the page like a grid, a long film list in the left center, and a big circular seal at the right. The title is stacked in the upper center, with asymmetric balance and open cream space.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Medium: Duotone-tinted film stills (teal, red, yellow, pink, orange), printed flat on cream paper; the circular stamp is flat line art.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Typography: Main title in tall, thin orange condensed capitals stacked in four lines, large, at the top center; film names in dark condensed sans with small serif director and country lines in a list; a circular seal with text running around. Typeset, flat.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Color and light: Warm cream with saturated duotone teals, coral red, mustard and rose; flat, even printing light.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Story it suggests: A collection of films from different countries gathered together as an archive.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Visual idea: Each film gets its own colored window in a scattered mosaic, with the globe seal tying them into one project.
0684_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Feels like: Archival film-restoration box set, a modern editorial collage with a vintage feel.

0685_touki-bouki.jpg.People: Two young men ride a motorcycle, shown to the waist: the driver is in front, facing us with a serious look, and a passenger looks out from behind his shoulder. A large pair of horns, from a skull, is mounted on the handlebars. They are looking just past the viewer.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Composition: Strong central axis: the motorcycle's front, the horns spanning wide like a smile and the two heads stacked above. The giant title fills the top third; a small credit sits right of the heads.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Medium: Grainy color film still, sun-faded and slightly soft.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, hand-painted in cream block letters with a red 3D shadow, tilted slightly and spread across two lines at the top; a small slate-blue credit sits to the right below it. It rests over the pale sky and nearly touches the heads.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue above, dry golden-brown scrub and green fatigues; hot, bright daylight with faded color.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young people set out on the road on a bike, restless and watchful.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Visual idea: The horns on the handlebars turn the bike into a bull's head, tying the ride to a symbol of desire and escape.
0685_touki-bouki.jpg.Feels like: West African New Wave road movie, 1970s sun-faded color film with a hand-painted title.

0686_redes.jpg.People: Several small film stills: a couple in hats and sunglasses sitting in grass, a figure standing on a car with an arm raised and another driving, a bearded man in profile reaching with a bundled arm, and tiny fishermen at the shore at the bottom. People are small to medium and shown in separate frames.
0686_redes.jpg.Composition: Collage of three tinted boxes stacked on the left, with film names set in two blocks on the right, a seal at the upper right, and small images at the top and bottom. Loose grid with a lot of cream space.
0686_redes.jpg.Medium: Duotone film stills in red, green and teal, printed flat on cream paper; stamp is line art.
0686_redes.jpg.Typography: Film titles are in bold, black condensed sans with a small italic credit above each, at the right middle, with a circular seal text; all typeset and left-aligned. The type is smaller than the images.
0686_redes.jpg.Color and light: Cream with intense coral red, olive green and teal duotones; flat light.
0686_redes.jpg.Story it suggests: Different stories from far-off places share one page.
0686_redes.jpg.Visual idea: The arrangement of colored windows and aligned labels reads like a catalog of discoveries.
0686_redes.jpg.Feels like: Archival film box set, a modern editorial look with a retro duotone.

0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.People: Several small stills: a woman's face in tall red grass looking down with a stern expression, two men face to face with tense stares (one wearing a checkered cap), a boat on a teal beach with a person, and a young woman in a headscarf. People are shown in close or medium frames within separate boxes.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Composition: Three stacked rectangles in a loose grid, with two big stills on the left, a pair of title blocks on the right and a circular seal at the upper right. Small images are at the top and the bottom as markers.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Medium: Tinted duotone stills (red, orange, teal, crimson) on cream paper, flat print with a film-grain look.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Typography: Film names in large, black condensed sans capitals in two lines each, with small italic credits above; all left-aligned, medium size, with a circular stamp. Flat typeset, no distortion.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Color and light: Cream with saturated red-orange, golden orange and teal; flat even printing light.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Story it suggests: Two stories of struggle and rivalry across landscapes.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Visual idea: Each film is given one close face and one wider scene, so the pair appears like a split screen.
0687_a-river-called-titas.jpg.Feels like: Archival world-cinema box set, a retro duotone editorial layout.

0688_dry-summer.jpg.People: Several small stills: a woman's face in tall red grass looking down with a stern expression, two men face to face with tense stares (one wearing a checkered cap), a boat on a teal beach with a person, and a young woman in a headscarf. People are shown in close or medium frames within separate boxes.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Composition: Three stacked rectangles in a loose grid, with two big stills on the left, a pair of title blocks on the right and a circular seal at the upper right. Small images are at the top and the bottom as markers.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Medium: Tinted duotone stills (red, orange, teal, crimson) on cream paper, flat print with a film-grain look.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Typography: Film names in large, black condensed sans capitals in two lines each, with small italic credits above; all left-aligned, medium size, with a circular stamp. Flat typeset, no distortion.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Color and light: Cream with saturated red-orange, golden orange and teal; flat even printing light.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Story it suggests: Two stories of struggle and rivalry across landscapes.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Visual idea: Each film is given one close face and one wider scene, so the pair appears like a split screen.
0688_dry-summer.jpg.Feels like: Archival world-cinema box set, a retro duotone editorial layout.

0689_trances.jpg.People: Four small purple silhouettes of musicians, a drummer and guitarists, standing in a row, full body and tiny, with a small star below.
0689_trances.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical stack: the band, a star, Arabic script, then an enormous mirrored title block; wide orange margins.
0689_trances.jpg.Medium: Flat solid two-color ink, vector-like, with no texture.
0689_trances.jpg.Typography: Massive geometric blocky Arabic lettering in purple with Latin 'TRANCES' set in a matching stencil-like geometric face below, filling most of the width, with a small Arabic name above; custom designed, interlocking, tightly stacked.
0689_trances.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange and plum purple only; flat graphic color with no lighting.
0689_trances.jpg.Story it suggests: A band stands as a unit, a group performance seen as a monument.
0689_trances.jpg.Visual idea: Script and Latin type built in the same geometric language, merging two alphabets into one image.
0689_trances.jpg.Feels like: 1970s-80s North African music film, psychedelic-era graphic design.

0690_the-housemaid.jpg.People: Several small stills: a singing man with curly hair playing a stringed instrument, a woman leaning on a doorway in a sweater with two people behind her, veiled figures against a stone wall, and a pair of hands in the lower corner. Mostly people shown close or medium in separate boxes.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Composition: Two stacked rectangles on the left and a pair of title blocks on the right, with a seal at the upper right and small images at the top and bottom. Loose grid with cream space.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Medium: Duotone-tinted film stills in yellow, teal and rust, printed flat on cream paper.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Typography: Film names in large, black condensed sans capitals, with small italic credits above, left-aligned on the right; a circular seal with ring text. Flat and typeset.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Color and light: Cream with mustard yellow, teal green and brick red duotones; flat light.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Story it suggests: Two stories of domestic and communal life, one of music and one of tension.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Visual idea: Single faces in colored windows lined up, so each film is reduced to one telling frame.
0690_the-housemaid.jpg.Feels like: Archival world-cinema box set, a retro duotone editorial layout.

0691_thief.jpg.People: One man in a leather jacket and jeans leans against a pillar at the left, full body, hands in pockets, glancing back over his shoulder. A tripod leg shows at the lower left.
0691_thief.jpg.Composition: The figure stands tall along the left third in a diagonal lean, with a blurred industrial gate and wet street at the right and below. The title sits just right of his torso, in the middle, with credits above and below.
0691_thief.jpg.Medium: Soft color film still with motion-like blur and shallow focus; slightly glossy, rain-wet look.
0691_thief.jpg.Typography: Title is a small, blue brushed script that slants upward, with spaced white serif capitals above and below. It is modest in size and floats in the middle of the picture.
0691_thief.jpg.Color and light: Purple-blue and amber with dark shadows; wet neon-like night light with rim glow on his hair.
0691_thief.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man waits in a wet night street, alert to something behind him.
0691_thief.jpg.Visual idea: The glossy wet street and rim light give the loner a solitary neon-noir aura.
0691_thief.jpg.Feels like: Neo-noir crime drama, 1980s color-saturated night photography.

0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.People: A huge pile of about 40 caricatured figures in various sizes, clambering and sliding over a globe; most are small half-body cartoons with panicked or greedy faces, one arm reaching down from the pile to grip a suitcase. They are a crowd competing against each other, drawn as comic caricatures, not photographs.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Composition: A large globe sits just above center with the figure heap spilling over its top and down one side, funneling into a single arm and a briefcase at the bottom center. A white ring orbits the globe, and the title block sits lower left on generous white space.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Medium: Loose pen-and-ink caricature with watercolor or gouache washes, visible hatching on the oceans, on a clean white ground. It looks like a hand-painted illustration.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Typography: Bold red condensed all-caps title stacked in four lines in the lower left, set in quotation marks, with each line widening toward the bottom. Small blue serif credit above it; the type is flat typeset and sits on white without touching the artwork except for the briefcase near the last lines.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Color and light: Saturated blue and green globe, reds, yellows and greens in the clothing, on white; flat bright illustration light with no cast shadows.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Story it suggests: A swarm of people scramble and fall over each other, all desperate to grab a case of cash dangling at the bottom of the world.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Visual idea: The world as a heap of greed: the globe is buried under people, and the single money case at the bottom is the magnet pulling the pile down.
0692_it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world.jpg.Feels like: Early-1960s big-budget comedy ensemble poster in the caricature illustration style of the period.

0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.People: Three men seated shoulder to shoulder at a bar table, shown half-body and large, filling the upper half. The left man looks down, the center man props his head on his hand and stares at the viewer, and the right man looks off to the side with a cigarette in his mouth; they appear as a tired trio.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Composition: A horizontal band of three figures across the top 55%, with the photo fading into a solid black field below. The center man is the focal point, flanked symmetrically, and the table edge makes a diagonal in the lower middle.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white film still with visible grain, its lower edge dissolving into flat black ink.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Typography: Very large yellow condensed sans-serif title stacked in two lines, occupying the bottom 40% and slightly tilted upward to the right. A smaller yellow line 'A film by AKI KAURISMAKI' runs along the bottom edge at the same slant; it is flat typeset against black and does not overlap the photo.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray with a single saturated yellow on black; low-key bar lighting from above with deep shadows.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Story it suggests: Three broke, weary friends sit with drinks and cigarettes, waiting out another empty evening together.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Visual idea: A dim photographic frame melting into black with a hard yellow title, the contrast of cold gray and shouting color, like a poster of a mood rather than a plot.
0693_la-vie-de-boheme.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s or early-1990s European art-house drama, deadpan and minimalist.

0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.People: A single child or young boy, large and blurred, head bowed with his face turned down and away, filling the center of the poster as an out-of-focus half-body figure. The soft focus makes the face almost unreadable.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Composition: The figure is a dark mass in the center and slightly right, with a patterned wallpaper at upper left. Giant looping script lettering sits on top of the figure, filling the middle in a loose diagonal.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Medium: Heavily grainy, out-of-focus photographic film still, like a warm faded print or home movie.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Typography: Enormous swirling cursive script title in cream, stacked across three lines at the center and overlapping the face and hair, with long flourishes and descenders reaching across; the smaller serif 'a film by' and 'Terence Davies' in the same script style are slightly blurred and sit lower right. Hand-lettered feel, semi-transparent so the image shows through.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Color and light: Murky ochre, brown and olive with warm cream lettering; dim amber lamplight as in an old interior.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Story it suggests: A lonely child lost in thought in a dim house, a memory seen through a haze.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Visual idea: The blur and swirling script work as nostalgia: a half-remembered childhood moment, with the lettering floating like a memory over the face.
0694_the-long-day-closes.jpg.Feels like: Intimate period memory film, 1950s childhood recalled in a British art-house register.

0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.People: Two women in extreme close-up profile, noses almost touching, one on each side filling the left and right halves; the right has blue hair and closed eyes, and a blurred third face is faintly visible between them at the top. They are about to kiss.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Composition: Mirrored face-to-face profiles with a narrow vertical gap of soft blue and white background at the center. The title stack sits in the upper center in that gap and the faces cut off at the edges.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus color photographic film still with shallow depth of field and fine grain.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Typography: Title in light sans-serif, stacked and stepped: 'BLUE' large in saturated blue, 'IS THE WARMEST COLOR' smaller in progressively lighter teal, right-aligned, with the director credit above and cast names at the bottom in white. The word BLUE is the largest and clean, flat on top of the blurred background.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Color and light: Warm skin tones against a cool blue and pale teal blur; soft natural daylight.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women lean in toward a first kiss, the moment charged and intimate.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Visual idea: Warm skin versus cool blue: the title's gradient from blue to teal echoes the blue hair and background, making color itself the subject.
0695_blue-is-the-warmest-color.jpg.Feels like: 2010s French romance drama, intimate and naturalistic.

0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.People: Two small-to-medium figures: a man in a bowler hat and light trench coat at lower left, bent over with a hand raised against an umbrella, and a dark silhouetted man in a hat at upper right, holding a pistol and turned away. Between them are many umbrellas without visible people.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Composition: A strong diagonal from upper right to lower left through the umbrellas, with the two figures at opposite corners and the umbrella mass in between. Titles occupy the upper left and lower right, forming a counter-diagonal.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Medium: Black ink and brush illustration with spattered white, high-contrast woodcut or linocut look, plus rain streaks scratched in white.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Typography: Large condensed all-caps blue lettering, slanted and slightly wobbly, in two blocks: the director credit at upper left tilted, and the title stacked in two lines at lower right and rising up to the right. Hand-drawn, with uneven edges and rough texture, laid over the dark art.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Color and light: Nearly monochrome black, white and gray with a single flat periwinkle blue for the type; stark, wet night contrast.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Story it suggests: A man crouches in a storm of umbrellas while an armed figure stalks above him.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Visual idea: A sea of umbrellas is a crowd that hides the gunman; the rain and brush marks turn the scene into a graphic of paranoia.
0696_foreign-correspondent.jpg.Feels like: 1940s thriller recast as a modern graphic ink illustration.

0697_tess.jpg.People: One young woman in a straw hat with a dark ribbon and a white ruffled blouse, shown from the chest up in three-quarter view, large in the frame and looking back over her shoulder at the viewer. She appears alone and wary.
0697_tess.jpg.Composition: The figure is centered and slightly right, the head near the top third, and a smoky blank area fills the left. The title sits across the lower part of the poster and overlaps her body.
0697_tess.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with warm grain and soft focus, like a period-colored photograph.
0697_tess.jpg.Typography: Giant cream italic high-contrast serif 'Tess' spanning most of the width at the bottom, with a very large swash T and lowercase letters; small italic 'A Film by Roman Polanski' above in the same cream. Typeset, flat, partly overlapping the dress and fading into the image.
0697_tess.jpg.Color and light: Muted olive, ochre and dusty cream with a smoky haze; soft, diffuse morning light.
0697_tess.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman in rural period dress turns and stares, uneasy, as if caught in something she cannot escape.
0697_tess.jpg.Visual idea: The oversized elegant title mirrors the weight of a single name, and the mist and gaze make a quiet portrait of vulnerability.
0697_tess.jpg.Feels like: Period literary adaptation, 1970s European art cinema.

0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.People: One child, small, seen from directly above lying on a bed in a red top, dark shorts and white socks, face buried in a pillow with legs stretched out. Posture reads as sleeping or hiding.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Composition: High-angle view down onto a wooden-framed bed running diagonally from upper left to lower right; the figure sits in the upper half, with the title across the lower middle. Bed frame bars cut dark diagonals across the mattress.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushstrokes, thick impasto highlights on the bedding and soft blended edges.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Typography: Title in tall, narrow, high-contrast serif capitals mixed with small lowercase words, spanning about 80 percent of the width, a thin rule beneath, then an italic serif credit. Cream-colored, set on the painted bedding, looking elegant and period.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Color and light: Warm browns, ochre and mauve with a red accent; low, amber lamp-like light and deep shadows.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Story it suggests: A lonely child left alone in a bare room, curled up on a bed.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Visual idea: A bird's-eye view that makes the child small and isolated in a big bed.
0698_king-of-the-hill.jpg.Feels like: Realist painting for a quiet period drama, 1930s Depression-era memoir.

0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Composition: A black circle with a fuzzy glowing rim sits in the middle, surrounded by a field of white specks. The three title fragments are scattered around it at upper left, right middle and lower left, each linked by a dashed line to a dot, and the credit sits lower right.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Medium: Stippled white specks on flat black, like a star chart or pen-and-ink diagram with a grainy particle texture.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Typography: Small, wide, italic all-caps white labels in the style of a scientific diagram; 'A BRIEF', 'HISTORY' and 'OF TIME' are separated and spread across the poster, each pointed to by dashed leader lines ending in dots or an arrow. The text is small relative to the poster and hand-drawn in feel, and its pieces are broken up so reading follows the diagram.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Color and light: Pure white on black; no light source other than the dotted halo around the void.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Story it suggests: A look into space and a black hole, explained like an annotated diagram.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Visual idea: The title is turned into labels on a star chart, so reading the title means tracing the cosmos.
0699_a-brief-history-of-time.jpg.Feels like: Scientific explainer or astronomy-chart documentary from the early 1990s.

0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.People: About twenty animal characters in human clothes (foxes, badgers, otters, weasels) painted as people. Seven foxes stand in the painted landscape on the wall, and a crowd at a long table in front, mostly seen from behind, with one fox in the centre raising a glass.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Composition: Frame within frame: a huge framed landscape painting fills the centre and the dinner scene sits below it, with symmetrical standing waiters at left and right. The table forms a horizontal band, and the title bends in an arch over the picture.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Medium: Oil-painting look with visible brush texture and warm glazing; stylised, theatrical, slightly naive.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Typography: Title in yellow-orange with red inline, ornate serif capitals set on an arc over the painting, about 70% width; the curved line follows the picture's top edge. Credit in smaller matching italic and caps at the bottom.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Color and light: Amber, orange and red-brown, a candle-lit glow; deep shadow floor with reflections.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Story it suggests: A banquet of animals is gathered and a toast is being proposed.
0700_fantastic-mr-fox.jpg.Visual idea: A painting inside a painting: animals imitating human ceremony and grandeur.

0701_persona.jpg.People: Two faces in extreme close-up profile, pressed forehead to forehead and nose to nose, cropped so each face fills an upper corner. They appear as nearly identical dark masses, a pair or a doubling.
0701_persona.jpg.Composition: The two heads meet at the center, forming a diagonal V of dark gray against a white lower half; the faces fill the top 60% and white space with the title below.
0701_persona.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic reproduction with smooth tones, almost silhouette, on white paper.
0701_persona.jpg.Typography: Large thin, widely spaced black serif-less capitals 'PERSONA' centered in the white area below, with a smaller 'A FILM BY INGMAR BERGMAN' centered underneath. Clean typeset, quiet, with no overlap with the image.
0701_persona.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal gray and white; flat, almost shadowless light that leaves the faces dark against a white void.
0701_persona.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people so close they seem to merge into one, their identities blurring.
0701_persona.jpg.Visual idea: Two heads meeting in a mirrored silhouette: the white negative space between them is a third shape, and the faces become interchangeable masks.

0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.People: One man in a bright yellow blazer and white trousers, seated small at the center on a marble bench, shown full body. Behind him, a huge reclining statue of a bearded man looms; the statue is a sculpture, not a living figure.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Composition: Symmetric-ish stage-like frame: the seated man at the center under the statue's gaze, with a marble bench forming a horizontal band across the middle and an empty light-filled floor below. The statue reclines along a diagonal from upper right.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Medium: Polished photographic film still with rich, saturated color, glossy and cinematic.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Typography: Italic serif title 'The Great Beauty' in dark charcoal across the lower third, with a small spaced-caps 'A FILM BY PAOLO SORRENTINO' below; typeset and sits over the pale marble floor without covering the figure.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Color and light: Warm golden stone and shadow with a bright yellow jacket and pale marble; a spotlit pool of light on the floor against a dark ceiling.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Story it suggests: A dapper man lounges before an enormous ancient monument, dwarfed by history but unbothered.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Visual idea: The tiny live man and the colossal stone figure set up a contrast of present vanity and ancient grandeur.
0702_the-great-beauty.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European prestige drama with a baroque, decadent look.

0703_the-freshman.jpg.People: About a dozen football players in dark jerseys and leather helmets, most half- to full-body and spread across the field; one bespectacled player in round glasses runs toward the camera holding a ball, large in the center, with others crouching, lying and tackling around him. The scene has comic energy, not quite sport.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Composition: A high-angle view with the running player in the center foreground, others scattered along diagonal lines leading to the upper corners. Long shadows fall across the grass, and the title sits across the bottom.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white silent-era photographic still with grainy texture, printed with a gritty halftone feel.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Typography: Huge white all-caps slab-serif letters spelling 'FRESHMAN' across the full width at the bottom, cut off at the left edge and stencilled to look like chalk lines on turf; a small 'THE' sits above and 'STARRING HAROLD LLOYD' below. The lettering is textured with the grass and appears painted onto the field.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray with bright white type; hard midday sun with long shadows.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Story it suggests: A bespectacled newcomer clutches the ball and sprints alone through a field of fallen and scattered players.
0703_the-freshman.jpg.Visual idea: The title is lettered as field markings on the grass, so the poster's ground is the playing field itself.

0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.People: About ten men crowded in the lower third, shown from the waist or chest up, several staring straight at the camera and some holding weapons; a shirtless-looking man in a white undershirt at the center-right brings a blade to his mouth. They look like prisoners as a tense group.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Composition: A heavy title block fills the top half, and a horizontal band of figures runs along the bottom with a rule line separating them; the faces are lined up like a row of portraits.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Medium: Gritty high-contrast black-and-white photo, with coarse grain and a halftone feel on a flat black field.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Typography: Very large white slab-serif all-caps title in two lines, 'RIOT IN / CELL BLOCK 11', spanning almost the full width, with a double rule below and a smaller bold 'DIRECTED BY DON SIEGEL' under it. Typeset, centered, rough-edged like letterpress or newspaper headline type, set on solid black.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and gray; stark flat flash-style lighting.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Story it suggests: A mob of men stands defiantly together, armed, with one leader looking dangerous.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Visual idea: The poster reads like a newspaper headline above a mugshot lineup, with the type as heavy as the crowd.
0704_riot-in-cell-block-11.jpg.Feels like: 1950s prison exploitation drama, tabloid and documentary-like.

0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.People: One tiny figure standing with arms slightly out on dark rocks at the bottom center, seen from behind at distance and dwarfed by the sea and sky. Alone, with no one else in view.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Composition: A very tall sky occupies over two thirds of the poster, with a low horizon and a small figure at the bottom center between two splashing waves. The title is centered at the top, so the poster is a vertical stack of title, sky, sea and rocks.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with heavy grading and a soft vignette, with a painterly, slightly oversaturated sky.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Typography: Medium-size white bold sans-serif title 'BREAKING THE WAVES' in two lines, centered near the top, with a smaller white credit below; clean typeset on top of the dark gray clouds.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Color and light: Heavy gray storm clouds fading into golden amber light near the horizon, with teal water and black rocks; dramatic backlit dusk.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone person stands at the edge of a violent sea, facing something far bigger than themselves.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Visual idea: Scale: the vast sky and crashing waves against one tiny person, with the title floating at the top like a heading over the weather.
0705_breaking-the-waves.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art-house melodrama, moody and elemental.

0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.People: Seven or eight silhouette figures split across four panels: a man writing at a desk and a woman serving, a woman and children, a man bending over laundry, and a couple holding hands; a large profile head at the center. They are cut-paper shapes with no faces, a family in daily routines.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Composition: A cross-shaped black frame divides the poster into four white windows around a central circle holding a male profile; strict symmetry, with a birdcage and a hanging ornament repeated in each panel. The title words flank the center circle.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Medium: Cut-paper silhouette (paper-cut, shadow puppet look) in solid black and white, with slightly rough scissor edges.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Typography: Pale gray old-style serif in all caps, with 'MASTER' to the left of the circle, a small 'OF THE' in the circle's center, and 'HOUSE' to the right, set in a horizontal line crossing the middle; a small credit centered at the bottom. Typeset, sitting on black next to the central head.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with a slightly warm paper gray; flat, no light source.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Story it suggests: A household's daily work and tenderness seen from within, with one man's profile at its center.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Visual idea: A cross or window grid of the house, with the man in the center keyhole circle like a portrait at the heart of the home.
0706_master-of-the-house.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era European drama retold in folk paper-cut style.

0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.People: Two men in an open convertible, shown half-body behind the windshield; the driver shouts or sings with his mouth wide open and the passenger grins. They look like two friends on a road trip.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Composition: The car fills the lower half diagonally from the lower left to the right, with the photo fading into cream at the top. The title sits at the top and the dashed road line below it continues the road.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film still fading to flat cream paper, with a slight blur on the trees to show speed.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Typography: Big green rounded, brush-script all caps 'IL SORPASSO', slanting upward to the right with the S oversized, and a row of five dashes beneath as a road's center line; the gray 'A FILM BY DINO RISI' is smaller and right-aligned. Flat typeset on the cream area, upbeat.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Color and light: Black and white photograph on warm cream with a single lime green; bright sunny daylight.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men speed down an open road in a convertible, one shouting with glee.
0707_il-sorpasso.jpg.Visual idea: The title's dashed line turns into the road's lane markings, so the text itself is in motion.

0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.People: Two figures: an older man in glasses and a gray sweater, leaning over a lamp at left, and a young woman asleep in bed at lower right, seen from chest up with her face on a pillow. The relationship is unclear; he seems to be watching over or tending to her.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Composition: A diagonal composition: the man's body leans from upper left to the lampshade at center, and the woman's sleeping head sits lower right, with a bedside table and phone between them. The room's corner forms a vertical line in the center.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with warm color grading and soft, naturalistic grain.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Typography: White bold geometric sans-serif title at the top right, with a thin yellow lighter credit under it. Small relative to the poster, clean and typeset, sitting on the wall.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Color and light: Golden, honey-yellow tungsten lamp glow with dim brown shadows; a cozy, quiet night.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Story it suggests: An older man adjusts the lamp beside a sleeping young woman, tender and ambiguous.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Visual idea: The lamp as the glowing hinge between the two figures, with the hush of the night.
0708_like-someone-in-love.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary quiet art-house drama about private relationships, Japan-set interior.

0709_red-river.jpg.People: About a dozen figures: two main men face each other across a rail track, one in the foreground seen from behind with a cowboy hat and fringed jacket, the other approaching from the middle distance; a crowd of riders and cattle in the far background. A horse's head appears at the right edge.
0709_red-river.jpg.Composition: Frame within a frame: a wagon wheel and a fence post in the foreground, with two men facing off in the center and a horizon of cattle behind. The huge title is tilted and crosses the top half, with credits stacked in the lower right.
0709_red-river.jpg.Medium: A sepia-toned photographic still printed in one ink tone with flat red and orange overprinted type on cream paper, with paper texture and slight misregistration.
0709_red-river.jpg.Typography: Very large red slanted western-style letters 'RED RIVER' with orange flame-like gradient fill on the lower parts, spanning the top two thirds, partly overlapping the hat and hut; secondary credits in red slab type, also tilted. Display type that interacts with the image, hand-lettered feel.
0709_red-river.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown and cream with hot red and orange; hard dusty daylight.
0709_red-river.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men face each other at the edge of a cattle town, with a confrontation about to start.
0709_red-river.jpg.Visual idea: The oversized flaming title takes over the sky like a brand burned onto the scene.
0709_red-river.jpg.Feels like: Classic 1940s Western reissue with vintage screenprint styling.

0710_judex.jpg.People: A large figure in a bird mask and black suit towers over the poster, with a bird head in profile at the top; at lower right a masked man holds a frightened woman with a knife at her throat; a hand and loose hands at lower left. All are drawn; the bird head is a mask or costume.
0710_judex.jpg.Composition: A tall vertical figure runs from top to bottom with the bird head at the top, while the struggling pair is crowded at the bottom right; the left strip is a pale vertical band. The title crosses diagonally through the middle.
0710_judex.jpg.Medium: Flat ink illustration with black outlines, a few gray tone washes, and paper-like texture, resembling a screen print or comic line art.
0710_judex.jpg.Typography: Giant orange hand-lettered script 'Judex' with swooping strokes that cross the figures diagonally, the J stretching across the left side, plus dark condensed 'a film by GEORGES FRANJU' on the left. The orange script floats over the drawing and the crossbar of the 'x' slashes through like a knife.
0710_judex.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal, gray and white with one vivid orange; flat, theatrical light.
0710_judex.jpg.Story it suggests: A masked villain-hero looms while a woman is held at knifepoint by another masked figure.
0710_judex.jpg.Visual idea: The bird mask as a looming emblem of menace, with the title slashing across the scene like a blade.

0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.People: Four young men in dark suits caught mid-air or standing, shown full body and large across the center; three leap with arms flung out and the one in the middle stands still with arms down. They are a group of four, shown as a band.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Composition: A radial burst of thin black lines converges behind the figures at the center, with the title bars at the top and bottom framing it symmetrically. The four are placed in a horizontal row across the middle.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic cutouts on a flat white ground with fine ink line work, like a graphic print.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Typography: Huge bold black condensed all-caps title 'THE BEATLES' across the top and 'A HARD DAY'S NIGHT' across the bottom, both stencil-like and spanning almost the full width; smaller director credit centered below. Typeset, flat, with the radiating lines running behind the letters.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Color and light: Strictly black and white; flat graphic light with no shadows.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Story it suggests: Four young men burst into joyous, frenzied motion, as if tossed into the air.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Visual idea: The sunburst lines make jumping look like explosive energy, a pop-art emblem of excitement.
0711_a-hard-day-s-night.jpg.Feels like: 1960s pop-art and mod graphic design, youthful and kinetic.

0712_scanners.jpg.People: One man's face in extreme close-up, mouth open, eyes rolled, a trickle of blood from the nose, with a bulging third-eye-like mark on the forehead; the head and shoulders are drawn, not photographed. Small tiles of other faces, eyes and mouths are scattered in the black squares around him.
0712_scanners.jpg.Composition: A central face fills the poster from the top to the bottom, broken into a grid of square tiles with black squares missing, like a pixelated or glitched mosaic. The title sits at the top above the face.
0712_scanners.jpg.Medium: Illustration with fine hatching and flat color, like risograph or scratchboard ink, cut into a digital pixel-tile effect.
0712_scanners.jpg.Typography: Glowing pale lime-green pixel-style display letters 'SCANNERS' across the top center, with the S shapes resembling a digital readout, and a smaller 'A film by David Cronenberg' in the same font; the glow suggests a screen. The type is typeset, sits over black tiles, and matches the mosaic.
0712_scanners.jpg.Color and light: Acid green, yellow and orange skin tones against deep black-green; lit like a sickly screen glow.
0712_scanners.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's mind or head is overloaded and breaking apart, with blood coming out of his nose.
0712_scanners.jpg.Visual idea: The face is shattered into missing tiles like a corrupted digital image, a visual metaphor for a mind being scanned or breaking down.
0712_scanners.jpg.Feels like: Early-1980s sci-fi body-horror seen through a modern glitch-art poster.

0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.People: A single man's head and shoulders in a photo, resting his cheek on his fist and looking at the viewer with a calm half-smile; the photo is cut into pieces and the sweater fragments fill the lower right.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Composition: Cut-paper collage: five irregular shapes of yellow, green, purple, red and pink spread diagonally from the center to the lower right, with the portrait in the yellow shape at the center. The title block is on top, with a list of eight titles in three columns below a rule.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Medium: Collaged duotone photo cutouts and flat paper shapes on cream, with grain in the halftone-like photo.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Typography: Large high-contrast didone serif 'JACQUES DEMY' in black caps across the top, with a small italic 'the essential' above, then a thin white rule and eight small italic film titles in three columns. Typeset and clean, with no overlap with the image.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Color and light: Pastel cream background with yellow, green, red, purple and pink duotone tints; flat, soft.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Story it suggests: A box set honoring one filmmaker, introduced through his relaxed, thoughtful portrait.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Visual idea: The portrait is cut apart and each fragment is tinted a different color, as if each film in the set were a shape in one collage.
0713_the-essential-jacques-demy.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave collage design, a playful cut-paper look.

0714_lola.jpg.People: One woman, shown from the shoulders up in a three-quarter view, with voluminous teased hair and winged eyeliner, gazing off to the left. Her photo is cut out in an irregular shape.
0714_lola.jpg.Composition: The photo occupies the lower center-right, an irregular polygon, with a blue shard at the right edge. Above is a grid of red star marks filling the upper right, and the title at the upper left, with credits stacked in the lower left.
0714_lola.jpg.Medium: Duotone photographic cutout in pink and black with grain, placed on flat cream paper, with a flat printed look and the cutout edges visible.
0714_lola.jpg.Typography: Large black high-contrast didone serif caps 'LOLA' at left, medium size; smaller credits in thin sans caps with italic labels, separated by thin blue rules. Typeset, clean, set beside the star grid.
0714_lola.jpg.Color and light: Cream background with pink-mauve duotone, coral stars and cobalt blue; matte, soft flat light.
0714_lola.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman looks off with a guarded expression, thinking of someone not in the frame.
0714_lola.jpg.Visual idea: Stars arranged in a grid and a cut-out portrait, like a cabaret star in a collage, with the stars as marquee glitter.
0714_lola.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave romance, rendered in a modern cut-paper style.

0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.People: One woman with windblown platinum-blond hair and a feather boa, seen from the shoulders up, in profile or three-quarter view, looking away to the left. The photo is a cutout.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Composition: A grid of alternating red and black diamonds fills the upper left and center, stepping down at the left, while the yellow photo shape fills the lower right. The title sits across the middle between them, with credits below left.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Medium: Yellow-black duotone photographic cutout with heavy grain on flat cream paper, with flat cut-paper diamonds.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Typography: Large black high-contrast didone serif caps 'BAY of ANGELS' spanning the width in the middle, with a small italic 'of'; credits in small thin sans caps with italic labels and red rules. Typeset and clean.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Color and light: Cream ground with red, black and yellow; flat and graphic.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman with hair blowing in the wind looks away with a distant expression, suggesting a gambler's luck.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Visual idea: The diamonds recall playing-card suits and harlequin patterns, framing the face as a card dealt from a deck.
0715_bay-of-angels.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave drama, cut-paper pop design.

0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.People: A young woman in a trench coat holding a blue handkerchief and a red umbrella in front, seen from the hips up in profile, and behind her a young dark-haired man in a brown jacket in profile, facing left. They are illustrated and look apart.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Composition: A diagonal line cuts the poster from the upper right to the lower left, splitting pink on the left and floral blue stripes on the right, with the umbrella spanning the line and the two figures on either side. Credits stack at the upper right and left; the title is at the bottom.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Medium: Digital painterly illustration with smooth airbrush shading and a fine grain texture, with a flat floral wallpaper pattern.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Typography: Big pale pink display serif title 'The Umbrellas of Cherbourg' in a chunky, curvy, high-contrast face at the bottom, in three lines with a pink outline shadow and swash 'g'; the cast names are in a bold pink serif at the top right. Typeset, overlapping the umbrella and coat, with a hand-drawn sweetness.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Color and light: Hot magenta, rose and sky blue with beige and teal accents; bright, flat, candy-colored.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Story it suggests: A young couple stands back to back under one umbrella, unable to look at each other.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Visual idea: The color split of the poster mirrors the couple divided by a diagonal, with the umbrella as the only link.
0716_the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg.jpg.Feels like: Pastel 1960s French musical romance, rendered in a contemporary illustrated style.

0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.People: Two young women in matching white dresses and wide-brimmed hats, one red and one yellow, seated on a settee and turned toward each other, shown half-body in the heart-shaped photo. They look like sisters or twins.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Composition: A large heart-shaped photo at the center top, symmetrical, with the credits stacked at the lower left and the title below. A row of red dots runs along the top and bottom, and a yellow trumpet shape curves behind the title at the bottom.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Medium: Color photographic still cut into a heart shape, pasted on flat cream paper with cut-paper shapes.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Typography: Large black high-contrast didone caps 'YOUNG GIRLS' and 'ROCHEFORT' with small italic 'the' and 'of', overlapping the yellow trumpet shape at the bottom; credits in thin sans with yellow rules at left. Typeset, and the letters sit on the yellow shape.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Color and light: Cream with coral dots, yellow trumpet, and pink tones in the photo; soft, flat, cheerful.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Story it suggests: Two sisters sit side by side, chattering and dreaming of romance.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Visual idea: The heart frames the sisters as a pair of mirrored hats in red and yellow, with the brass trumpet echoing the music.
0717_the-young-girls-of-rochefort.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French musical comedy in a paper-cut pastel design.

0718_donkey-skin.jpg.People: One figure wearing a donkey-head costume with a hand covering the mouth, only the eyes of the person visible beneath, cut out at the lower right; the animal head is a mask or costume, not a real animal.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Composition: The green silhouette occupies the lower right, rising diagonally, with a large yellow crown shape floating at the top and the title overlapping it. Small leaves and credits sit at the left, with empty space.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Medium: Green duotone photographic cutout with grain, placed over flat cream paper with cut-paper style shapes.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Typography: Large black high-contrast didone caps 'DONKEY SKIN' stacked in two lines at the upper left, overlapping the yellow crown; small credits in thin sans with green rules. Typeset and clean, and the title's top overlaps the crown.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Color and light: Cream background with a green duotone figure and yellow crown; matte and flat.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Story it suggests: A hidden royal peers out in fear from inside an animal disguise.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Visual idea: The crown above and the donkey head below give royalty and disguise in one stack, as if the crown were waiting for her.
0718_donkey-skin.jpg.Feels like: Fairy-tale musical of the late 1960s, in a cut-paper pastel design.

0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.People: One woman, shown from the head to the hips at the upper right, wrapped in a dark fur coat with a bare shoulder, her head tilted and looking at the viewer with a sly half-smile. The photo is a cutout.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Composition: A red irregular shape fills the top half with the woman at the upper right and the title at the left overlapping her coat; below, a row of red slivers and three overlapping blue and yellow speech-bubble-like shapes fill the bottom third.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Medium: Red-and-black duotone photographic cutout with coarse grain, set against flat cream paper with cut-paper blue and yellow shapes.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Typography: Large cream high-contrast didone caps 'CHAMBRE' and 'VILLE', with small italic 'une' and 'en', stacked and staggered across the red area, overlapping the woman's coat so the letters run across her body; credits in thin sans caps with italic labels and black rules. Typeset.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Color and light: Coral red, cream, cobalt blue and mustard yellow with black; flat and matte.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman draped in fur looks knowingly at the viewer, with a hint of seduction and secrecy.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Visual idea: The blank blue and yellow shapes suggest empty rooms, windows or speech bubbles, a stack of anonymous city rooms under the portrait.
0719_une-chambre-en-ville.jpg.Feels like: 1980s French musical melodrama in a cut-paper graphic design.

0720_the-big-chill.jpg.People: Eight adults posed on a lawn in front of a large white house, shown full body or three-quarter and medium-sized, some seated on rocking chairs and a wicker settee, others standing behind. They look like a group of friends, casually relaxed.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Composition: A group portrait spread horizontally across the middle, with the porch and live oak tree behind and a cream title panel across the bottom third. The faces are spaced around the center, in a loose row.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Medium: Color photographic publicity still with a slightly dated, saturated film look, with a flat solid cream panel below.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Typography: Big bold red-brown slab-serif caps 'THE BIG CHILL' on the cream panel at the bottom, wide and spanning almost the full width, with a small 'THE'; below, two rows of names in thin sans caps separated by bullets and a thin rule, and an italic director credit. Typeset, separate from the photo.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Color and light: Warm sunlit greens and browns with a cream and rust panel; golden afternoon daylight with dappled shade.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Story it suggests: Old friends gather on a Southern lawn, relaxed but with unspoken tension.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Visual idea: A classic ensemble group portrait where the chairs and posed relaxation tell the story of reunion.
0720_the-big-chill.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American ensemble dramedy, warm and nostalgic.

0721_love-streams.jpg.People: A woman with blond hair in a black dress, sitting on a folding chair at a kitchen table, shown full body in a middle shot, smiling down while holding the hand of another person whose arm and white cuff enter from the right edge. The second person is only a sleeve and hand.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Composition: The poster is split horizontally: the top half is empty cream space with the name block, and the bottom half is the photo with the woman at the center, offset to the right. The title spans the full width at the dividing line.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Medium: Color film-grain photograph in the bottom half, with a flat off-white paper area above; the photo has soft, slightly faded color.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Typography: Large heavy black sans caps 'ROWLANDS' and 'CASSAVETES' with small names above, and 'LOVE STREAMS' in huge golden mustard heavy sans below, spanning the full width and sitting just above the photo, with a small serif credit at the bottom. Typeset, stacked in a tight block.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Color and light: Cream and yellow with a mustard-gold title and warm tungsten interior light; muted, lived-in.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman holds the hand of someone beside her at a table, tender and a little sad.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Visual idea: A big blank cream upper half pushes the type and the quiet domestic scene to the lower half, as if the title were a line that anchors the photo.
0721_love-streams.jpg.Feels like: 1980s independent American drama, intimate and naturalistic.

0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.People: A pair of figures drawn as bold flat shapes: two large red hands reach toward the center and two pale hands are bound together at the wrists with colored cords at the lower center; the bodies are simplified into red and black shapes. Hands only, with no faces.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Composition: A symmetric vertical composition with red hands placed top-left and top-right over a black center, and the tied wrists at the middle pointing downward. Diagonal pale arms lead down to the bound hands, with a checker-like red/black split at the sides.
