0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Medium: Flat vector or screenprint style, solid ink shapes in red, black, cream, blue and green without texture.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Typography: Hand-brushed lettering in orange for 'Tie me up!' tilted at top and green 'Tie me down!' below, plus a red 'a film by Almodóvar' at the bottom; the words are painted with loose brush strokes and wrap around the hands, with letters sloping at an angle between the hands.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red and black with cream skin, blue, green and orange accents; flat, high-contrast poster color.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people's hands are tied together in a struggle between desire and captivity.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Visual idea: The bound wrists are the center of the design, with hands closing in from above as if the poster were a binding.
0722_tie-me-up-tie-me-down.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s Spanish pop-art comedy, bold and erotic.

0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.People: Three figures on a beach: a woman in a straw hat at left, large, half-body, arms crossed over her chest and facing the viewer; a small boy-like figure wading in the water at the center, seen from behind and tiny; a shirtless man cropped at the right edge, turned away. They are separated, not interacting.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Composition: Triangular spacing of the three figures around a bay; the foreground figures are cut off at the left and right edges and out of focus, while the central tiny figure and a car on the hillside road sit on the central axis under the title.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Medium: Home-movie or super-8 look: soft focus, pink and violet lens-flare circles, light leaks, faded warm film color.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Typography: Light-weight wide sans caps in white, about 60% of poster width, placed at mid-height across the hill with a subtle fade gradient; a smaller credit line below. Typeset, clean, overlapping the landscape.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Color and light: Washed-out pastel blue sky, warm tan rock, aqua water, with pink and violet flare; hazy, overexposed summer sun.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Story it suggests: A hot beach holiday where people drift apart in a sun-blurred, uneasy summer.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Visual idea: The flare and blur make the poster look like a degraded memory or home movie.
0723_y-tu-mama-tambien.jpg.Feels like: Early-2000s road-trip coming-of-age film with a faux-vintage film look.

0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.People: None; a marquee sign of lights spells out the title. A credit refers to an actor but no figure is shown.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Composition: A tall tilted stack of glowing bulb letters runs from the top center down to the lower right, with the J swinging in a curve at the lower left. The left third is empty black with the credit in the upper left, and the director credit at the bottom right.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic reproduction of an electric sign, with glowing round bulbs and heavy grain.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Typography: The title is made of white light bulbs on a theater-style marquee, tilted and stacked in several lines, huge relative to the poster and slightly distorted by perspective; small thin white sans-serif credits ('ROY SCHEIDER IN', 'A BOB FOSSE FILM') are clean and typeset, sitting on black.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Color and light: Pure white lights on black, glowing; night marquee light with blooming highlights.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Story it suggests: A showy theater marquee that burns bright against the dark, hinting at show business and spectacle.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Visual idea: The title literally is the spectacle, built of bulbs, so the sign is both lettering and image.
0724_all-that-jazz.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s Broadway musical drama, theatrical and nocturnal.

0725_eraserhead.jpg.People: One man, shown from the chest up, large in the lower half of the frame, facing the viewer with wide, startled eyes. His hair rises into a huge white fluffy plume, so the head reads as a rendered or painted portrait rather than a plain photo.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Composition: Centered, vertical stack: small credit line, huge title across the upper third, then the face and hair plume centered below. Dark vignetted edges push attention to the bright face and hair.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Medium: Painted or heavily retouched black-and-white photograph, with brushy smoky texture in the background, grainy speckles and a halo of white around the hair.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Typography: Title spans the full width in tall, condensed white serif capitals, about a quarter of the poster height, sitting directly over the dark smoky field. A small sans-serif possessive credit line sits above it, centered.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome black, grey and white; a harsh spotlight from the front makes the face and hair glow against murky darkness.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Story it suggests: A stunned, anxious man stares out of a dark void, as if something unnatural has just happened to him.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Visual idea: The electrified hair as a visible halo of shock, turning a head into an emblem of mental disturbance.
0725_eraserhead.jpg.Feels like: Surreal midnight-cinema horror, with an updated 1970s black-and-white art-house look.

0726_macbeth.jpg.People: Only an outstretched forearm and hand, half buried in sand or earth, gripping a dagger; no face or body is visible, so the figure is a fragment, possibly a corpse.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Composition: Diagonal arm rising from lower right to the upper left, with the dagger vertical and a coiled rope loop circling around it; the title stack sits at the bottom over sand.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with grainy film texture, sandy surface, real-looking dirt on skin.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Typography: Old-style serif lettering: 'ROMAN POLANSKI'S film of' in white small caps and italic at top, 'MACBETH' in large golden-ochre capitals spanning the width at the bottom, 'by William Shakespeare' in swash italic; typeset with a period flavor, set over the sand like an inscription.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Color and light: Muted slate blue-grey sand with a warm pink-tan hand and a gold title; flat, cold overcast daylight.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Story it suggests: A hand clutching a blade emerges from the ground beside a noose-like rope, violence and death half-buried.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Visual idea: Weapon and rope as an omen, the body reduced to a hand and the dagger.
0726_macbeth.jpg.Feels like: Gritty 1970s historical tragedy, earthy and grim.

0727_the-innocents.jpg.People: One woman, her head and neck filling most of the poster, shown in profile with her head thrown back and eyes closed, a lace collar at the bottom. A tear or droplet sits on her cheek.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Composition: A strong diagonal sweep from the hair at upper left to the chin and collar at lower right, set on a large black field. Streaks of white run down the top right and bottom edges.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Medium: A painted grayscale portrait with visible brush and dry-brush strokes, smeared white streaks and ink-like black fields.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Typography: Title in a wide-spaced, silvery metallic serif with a gradient sheen, set across the lower fifth. Part of it fades into the white streaks, and the letter N is oddly taller. A small italic director credit sits underneath.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with grey gradations; soft, theatrical glow on the face from the front-left.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman in anguish or ecstasy, caught between grief and something unseen, is swallowed by darkness.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Visual idea: A face emerging from darkness, with ink smears hinting at a haunting.
0727_the-innocents.jpg.Feels like: Gothic psychological ghost story, with a modern painterly mid-century look.

0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.People: Ambiguous: dense scribbled charcoal shapes suggest several vertical figures or a tall hooded form with a small pale face near the lower left; it could also be reflections on water. Not clearly countable.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Composition: A central vertical mass of dark scribble runs top to bottom through a field of horizontal hatch strokes, symmetrical around the center, with white gaps at the top corners. Title sits at the center on the darkest part.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Medium: Charcoal or graphite drawing with loose scribbled lines, smudged shading and bright white scratch marks.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Typography: Thin white hand-written cursive title in two lines, slightly slanted, about 40 percent of the width, in the middle of the dark mass; a small italic credit below. The writing looks like it was scratched into the drawing.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Color and light: Gray, black and white only, with a luminous pale sky and sunlit water feeling.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Story it suggests: A figure dissolving into the shimmer of water or light, a fragile, dreamlike presence.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Visual idea: A reflection in rippling water rendered as scribble, so the image wobbles.
0728_sundays-and-cybele.jpg.Feels like: Poetic French drama of the early 1960s, hand-drawn contemporary design.

0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.People: One small, hunched man in a trench coat and hat, a pipe in his mouth, hands clasped behind him holding a closed umbrella, looking down. Drawn in pencil, standing in the lower right.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Composition: Scattered pattern: about a dozen tulip-style chairs float across the paper at different angles, each with a single dab of colour; the man sits low right and the title stack fills the upper centre with a big red 'T' dominating.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Medium: Ink and pencil outline drawing with gouache colour dabs on rough tan paper; hand-drawn and slightly smudged.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn title in black thin condensed capitals ('THE COMPLETE JACQUES'), with a huge red 'TATI' whose T overlaps the upper line; the stack is about 40% of the width and sits in the upper middle, with the letters irregular.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige paper with red, cyan, orange, green spots; flat, shadowless.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man wanders through a sea of empty modern chairs.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Visual idea: Chairs as colourful ghosts around a small figure who is out of step with modern design.
0729_the-complete-jacques-tati.jpg.Feels like: 1950s-60s French illustrated poster, light and witty.

0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.People: One large cartoon-like man, full body down to the knees, seen in profile with a mustache and cap, carrying a bag and holding a bicycle wheel. Small silhouettes of carousel riders and a crowd are grey shapes in the background.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Composition: The figure dominates the right half as a vertical form, with the title stacked at upper left. A grey fairground silhouette with a carousel, a flagpole and a steeple runs along the bottom, and flag bunting hangs across the top.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn crayon and pencil outlines with scribbled grey fill, over flat solid-ink spot color and a visible paper grain, in a risograph or screenprint style.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Typography: Title in hand-lettered, uneven condensed capitals stacked on two lines, blue and red, roughly a fifth of the poster height, at upper left. A small hand-lettered credit sits below.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Color and light: Warm greige paper with spot blue, red and white bunting; flat, even, daylight-like.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Story it suggests: A lanky local is out among festival decorations carrying a bicycle wheel and looking off to the side as if something is about to go amiss.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Visual idea: A flat children's-book fairground in tricolor festive colors, with the figure rendered as a comic caricature.
0730_jour-de-fete.jpg.Feels like: Light French comedy with a mid-century illustrated, nostalgic feel.

0731_parade.jpg.People: One drawn man in top hat and tailcoat, shown full body in profile, lifting one leg in an exaggerated step. A dark tail-like smear trails from his coat.
0731_parade.jpg.Composition: He is placed right of center inside a diagonal spotlight beam that cuts across vertical stripes. The title sits below at the bottom and a row of white dots underlines it.
0731_parade.jpg.Medium: Flat screenprint-style spot colors on textured paper, with hand-drawn charcoal-pencil figure lines and shading.
0731_parade.jpg.Typography: Title in thick hand-drawn black capitals, about a fifth of the poster height, across the bottom center. A small hand-lettered credit sits at the top, and white dots below the title read like marquee bulbs.
0731_parade.jpg.Color and light: Orange, grey and cream stripes; the spotlight wedge is the lightest area, evoking stage lighting.
0731_parade.jpg.Story it suggests: A performer in a spotlight strides across a striped circus stage, with an odd comic detail.
0731_parade.jpg.Visual idea: The striped curtain and spotlight cone turn the poster itself into a stage.
0731_parade.jpg.Feels like: Playful circus or music-hall comedy, with a retro 1950s-60s graphic look.

0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.People: One man seated in a chair, large in the left foreground, leaning back with his boots up against a post. Two small riders on horseback are in the middle distance, and tiny wagons behind them.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Composition: The man sits at lower left in a diagonal reclining line, framed by heavy porch posts and roof beams that create a foreground frame. Open desert and mesas run to the horizon on the right, and the title sits in the top right.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Medium: A black-and-white film still with fine grain and a crisp photographic look.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Typography: Title in orange condensed slab capitals on two lines in the top-right, over a bright sky. A small sans-serif credit sits above and below it.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Color and light: High-contrast monochrome with a single orange text accent; bright hard sunlight and sharp shadows.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Story it suggests: A man lounges calmly on a porch as visitors approach across the dusty street of a frontier town.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Visual idea: A deceptive relaxed posture, with a watchful scene across a wide, spare landscape.
0732_my-darling-clementine.jpg.Feels like: Classic Western from the 1940s, in a restrained modern design.

0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.People: Two small figures, a man in a suit and a woman in a dark dress, stand holding hands in knee-deep water at the bottom. Many stone statues of figures and horses fill the monument above them.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Composition: A big baroque fountain facade fills the whole frame, with the tiny couple at lower center for scale. The giant title letters are stacked over the monument.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Medium: A high-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain; the white lettering has scratched, distressed erosion.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Typography: Huge white high-contrast serif letters, cut off by the edges, split across four lines (LA / DOLCE / VITA) and covering most of the poster. The lower letters are speckled and broken, so the title and monument interlock. A small bold sans credit sits at top.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and grey; bright diffuse daylight on weathered stone.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple wades into a grand fountain, dwarfed by an ancient monument, in a playful moment of romantic abandon.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Visual idea: Oversized type interleaved with the scene, so the lettering and the architecture become the same stone mass.
0733_la-dolce-vita.jpg.Feels like: Glamorous European art cinema, with a bold contemporary-editorial design.

0734_the-shooting.jpg.People: One partial face, cut into a vertical paper strip, showing nose, mouth and shadowed eyes in extreme close-up. No other figures.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Composition: The torn-paper face strip sits vertically at the right, with a ragged brown mesa at lower left and a radiating sun at lower right. The title and credit fill the left, with the blue sky as the background.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Medium: Paper collage with torn edges, halftone printed fragments, a sunburst drawn in ink lines and visible paper fibers.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Typography: The title is hand-written in a dark thin marker, in uneven slanted capitals on two lines. The credit is in dark red slab-serif capitals, and the letters are much smaller than the image.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Color and light: Faded cyan sky, brown clay, cream and ink black; flat, warm printed-paper tones.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Story it suggests: A hidden, shadowed face watches from a barren desert, hinting at menace and a long, tense pursuit.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Visual idea: A face reduced to a cut-out slice that suggests a sliver of identity, with a sun and a rock as landscape symbols.
0734_the-shooting.jpg.Feels like: Offbeat 1960s existential Western with a handmade zine-collage feel.

0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.People: One man's face and shoulders, large at left, in a cut-out paper silhouette, shaped like a hat and a hair mass; he looks off with a half smile. No other figures.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Composition: The tall cut-out portrait runs down the left, with the title stacked on the right in the blue sky. A mountain, a red rock and a radiating sunburst fill the bottom and the edges.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Medium: Paper collage mixing a grainy black-and-white photo cutout with halftone-dotted color print scraps, a hand-inked sunburst, and torn edges.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Typography: Title is hand-written in a thin dark marker, three loose slanted lines at upper right. Credit in dark red slab-serif capitals below. The lettering is about a quarter of the poster height, uneven and unpolished.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Color and light: Turquoise sky, rust orange and mustard with black and white; flat printed-paper daylight.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Story it suggests: A weathered, wary man stands out against a vivid desert backdrop that feels like a memory.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Visual idea: A black-and-white face cut and pasted onto a faded colored landscape, as if remembered or scrapbooked.
0735_ride-in-the-whirlwind.jpg.Feels like: Offbeat 1960s existential Western, with a handmade scrapbook look.

0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.People: Two people, both about half-to-full body, in a small bedroom: a woman standing at left in men's-style pajamas, and a man sitting up in bed at right in a patterned robe. A blanket hung on a rope between them divides them.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Composition: A hanging sheet runs vertically down the center like a curtain, splitting the frame into two halves. The woman is at left and the man is at right, glancing at each other, and the title sits at the top right.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Medium: A grainy black-and-white film still with soft studio-era contrast.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Typography: Title in white monoline outline script with a looped, rounded cursive, stacked on two lines at upper right, about a quarter of the height. An arrow drawn above points left, and a script credit runs along the bottom.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and mid grey, with soft flat lamp-like light on bedclothes and pajamas.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people sharing a bedroom with only a blanket between them, curious and slightly wary of each other.
0736_it-happened-one-night.jpg.Visual idea: The hanging sheet as a dividing wall, with the arrow in the lettering echoing the barrier.

0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.People: Several, in a mosaic: a large bearded man eating from a spoon in an oval cutout at the upper right, a man in a cowboy hat and sunglasses at lower left, and a close-up of a grinning mouth with teeth at upper left. A garlic bulb and a country road are other tiles.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Composition: A grid of overlapping, uneven panels, with an oval portrait cutting across them at the right. The lettering runs down diagonally across all of them.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Medium: A photographic collage of grainy film frames, with painted white brush lettering over them.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Typography: Title in thick, hand-painted white capitals, stacked over four lines and going down the poster in a zigzag. Letters are chunky, wobbly and brushy, about half the poster's height in total, and overlap all the images.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Color and light: Muted greens, pinks and cream with black; soft, mixed, amateur-film daylight.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Story it suggests: A joyful, sensory celebration of food, faces and country life, glimpsed in snapshots.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Visual idea: A scrapbook of sensory moments, with the title painted over it like a hand-made banner.
0737_les-blank-always-for-pleasure.jpg.Feels like: Warm folk documentary with a 1970s scrapbook look.

0738_tootsie.jpg.People: One woman with a big auburn hairdo and large glasses, seen from the waist up, smiling with her arms crossed, in a glossy instant-photo print. A stack of prints behind hints at a pile of headshots.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Composition: A tilted stack of white-bordered photos sits in the middle on a sparkly background, with the big title below at the bottom.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Medium: A glossy color studio portrait on instant-film-style paper, over a macro photo of red sequins.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Typography: Title in massive white slab-serif capitals across the bottom, about a fifth of the height, set against the red. A cursive handwritten autograph-style credit crosses the photo, and a small credit line sits below.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Color and light: Deep sequin reds and a warm cream portrait; soft glamour studio lighting.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful, glamorous woman in a publicity headshot, as if someone is playing a persona.
0738_tootsie.jpg.Visual idea: A headshot signed like an autograph, hinting at a performance and a persona.

0739_safe.jpg.People: One woman's face, front-on, close-up, with a visible bruise on her forehead, framed in the center of a square. She has a neutral, tired expression.
0739_safe.jpg.Composition: Nested squares, like a frame inside a frame inside a frame, from the outer landscape to a white interior to a face. Symmetrical and centered, with the title in a small box at top right.
0739_safe.jpg.Medium: Collage of grainy film frames printed on a cream paper, with rough edges and fine grain.
0739_safe.jpg.Typography: The title S A F E is in widely spaced monospaced letters inside a thin rectangle with gaps, small relative to the poster, at the top right. The credit is small and monospaced.
0739_safe.jpg.Color and light: Pale mint, sage green, and cream with a coral accent; flat, cold fluorescent light.
0739_safe.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman trapped inside a sterile, boxed-in space, her face the only sign of distress.
0739_safe.jpg.Visual idea: The nesting frames suggest layers of containment, with a person at the center of the boxes.

0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..People: Two women as articulated mannequins or dolls, a large one bending over a smaller one on her lap. Both have joints visible in the arms and legs.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Composition: A diagonal, interlocked pose in the right two-thirds, the large figure leaning from top right down to bottom left, with the title stacked on the left. Lots of empty gradient space.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Medium: A smooth, detailed illustration with a stippled airbrushed look and shiny doll-like skin, with gold and fabric detailing.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Typography: Title in thin, elegant, high-contrast serif capitals in olive and rust, stacked on four lines at left, sized from small to large. The credit is in a lighter script-serif below.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Color and light: Silvery grey with black, rust red and gold accents; soft studio-like gradient light.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Story it suggests: One figure looms and cradles another, a tense mixture of tenderness and control.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Visual idea: Women as jointed dolls, which turns a relationship into one of manipulation.
0740_the-bitter-tears-of-petra-von-kant..Feels like: Stylized, artificial melodrama with a modern fashion-illustration look.

0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.People: None; a drowned horse is a non-human figure.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Composition: Centered, vertical: a dark horse half in a blue water strip at the top of a red shield-like shape, its head above the waterline, rearing legs below; empty cream space around, title at top and credit at the bottom.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache on cream paper, with visible brush edges and pigment pooling; hand-drawn lettering.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Typography: Black hand-inked blackletter-like caps with a medieval, wobbly feel, about 85% of the width at the top and smaller at the bottom, centered; no distortion beyond hand irregularity. A tiny signature at bottom right.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Color and light: Deep red, dark brown, teal blue on cream; flat, no light source.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Story it suggests: An animal trapped under frozen water, a strange emblem of a city.
0741_my-winnipeg.jpg.Visual idea: A coat-of-arms or cutaway showing a horse frozen in ice, mixing heraldry with folk myth.

0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.People: Five or six caricatured figures: a man in a plane with a bouquet, a man in a cap on a boat with a ring box, a woman with a pink hat on a train, and two men holding canes on a train. Each head is oversized on a vehicle body.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Composition: The figures are scattered around a curving shoreline, with a big title across the top. The woman is large at right, and the three men circle the bay at left.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Medium: A loose gouache and ink illustration with watercolor washes and bright flat color.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, in hand-lettered outlined capitals filled with watercolor palm-tree patterns, stacked on three lines across the top half. A script credit sits at the bottom, and actor names at the top are in dark brush capitals.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Color and light: Cyan sea and sky with orange, yellow and pink; bright sunny, resort-like light.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Story it suggests: Several suitors race by plane, boat and train toward a woman, in a comic chase.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Visual idea: People turned into vehicles, so the chase becomes a travel map.
0742_the-palm-beach-story.jpg.Feels like: 1940s screwball comedy with the look of a travel brochure.

0743_la-cienaga.jpg.People: Several people sunbathing around a pool, partly cropped by the frame, full or half body, seen from behind or above; a dog stands at the edge of the pool; at least five people.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Composition: A large curved green pool dominates the left and center, leading the eye along a diagonal curve; people crowd in the lower right; dense foliage above.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with grain, slightly faded and slightly muddy colors.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Typography: Huge loose hand-lettered 'La Cienaga' in pale cream, scrawled like chalk or paint across the foliage and cut off at the right edge, with a handwritten credit below; hand-drawn, rough-edged, drawn onto the trees.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Color and light: Murky green water, dark foliage, warm skin and pink wine glasses; dull, damp, overcast light.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Story it suggests: A lazy, stagnant gathering by a dirty pool with a sense of decay under the summer languor.
0743_la-cienaga.jpg.Visual idea: A stagnant green pool as the center of the idle bodies around it.

0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.People: Two or three people, blurred and overlapping, in a kitchen, seemingly a woman in a striped top and another figure in blue wrapped in a struggling or embracing tangle. The same action is repeated in several bands, so the number of people is ambiguous.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Composition: Horizontal bands of the same scene, each shifted and doubled, are stacked like a sliced film strip, with the image rotated sideways. The title sits on the right in the middle.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Medium: A color film frame with motion blur, ghosting and slit-scan-like horizontal displacement, soft and grainy.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Typography: Title in bold white and pale grey condensed sans-serif capitals, stacked on two lines at right of center, about a seventh of the height. A smaller dark director credit sits above.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Color and light: Washed-out cream, faded blue and pink stripes; dim, flat domestic daylight.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate or violent domestic tussle, smeared by motion so that it is hard to say whether it is affection or conflict.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Visual idea: A body in motion cut into slices, as if time itself were stuttering.
0744_every-man-for-himself.jpg.Feels like: Experimental late-1970s European art film, with a video-glitch look.

0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.People: No clear figure; a large red blot has a hooded or coat-like shape, with a white hole where a head might be. It is ambiguous whether it is a small raincoated person or just a spill.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Composition: A single large irregular red shape sits in the center on an empty pale background, with splatter drops scattered around. The title is at lower right and names are in the middle.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Medium: A glossy, liquid-looking photographic red stain, like paint or blood, with cut-out white holes; flat, clean pale background.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Typography: Title in lowercase heavy condensed sans-serif, stacked on three lines at lower right, filled with a brown photographic texture. Actor names are in white bold condensed type over the red, and the director credit is in grey.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Color and light: Saturated blood red and dark maroon against pale grey; glossy, wet light.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Story it suggests: Something violent or tragic has happened, and a figure has been reduced to a stain.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Visual idea: A hooded figure dissolved into a puddle of red, so the clothing and the spill are one and the same.
0745_don-t-look-now.jpg.Feels like: Chilling 1970s psychological horror thriller, with a minimalist art-poster look.

0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.People: Four people sit in a group on grass, shown from the waist up, half body: two men in casual striped clothing at left, and two women in white period dresses at right. The men look at the women and the women look down or aside.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Composition: A photograph in a thin-lined rectangle sits in the upper half, with a matching framed panel below for the title. The people are lined up horizontally.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Medium: A grainy black-and-white film still, with a thin white double-line border and a dark textured panel.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Typography: Title in white, with a typeset serif for 'A Day in', and a big flourished calligraphic script for 'the Country', with swashes and a line running through the letters. It sits centered in the lower panel, about a fifth of the poster's height. The credit is small, and uses sans-serif capitals.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey; soft, overcast outdoor daylight.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young men flirt with two women during a lazy summer outing.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Visual idea: A framed picture above an ornate title card, like a vintage postcard or a title slate.
0746_a-day-in-the-country.jpg.Feels like: Pastoral 1930s French romance, with a nostalgic, antique-card feel.

0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.People: One large symmetrical double profile: two faces back to back in black silhouette, wearing a horned headdress with curly hair on top. Mirror-like figure, ambiguous between a single mask and two heads.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Composition: Strict mirror symmetry along the vertical axis, with the black head filling the center, horns cropped at the top, and a fringe at the bottom edge. Title is written over the silhouette, and two small yellow dots sit where the eyes would be.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink on matte textured paper, hand-cut or gouache-like, with small velvety smudges at the cheeks.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Typography: Thin, angular, hand-drawn capitals in red, tall and jagged, stacked in two lines and filling about 75 percent of the width and half the height; stretched thin like stencil-brush lettering. Overlays the black head and merges with the background red.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange-red and black with two yellow accents; flat, matte, no light source.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Story it suggests: A decadent, half-beast world, two faces looking in opposite directions.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Visual idea: A Janus-like horned head as a mask with the title as a tattoo.
0747_fellini-satyricon.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s Italian spectacle, mythic and pagan, redone in contemporary gouache print.

0748_watership-down.jpg.People: One animal, a large rabbit shown as a black silhouette with its head thrown back, snout up; no human. It is ambiguous whether it is sniffing or howling.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Composition: Diagonal black mass rising from lower left to upper right, with its head near the upper right, and a setting sun and tree at left. Wild grass and flowers frame the foreground; the title is at upper right, above the head.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Medium: Painted gouache or cel-style illustration with soft airbrushed sky and detailed, fine-ink grass in front; flat black cut-out silhouette.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Typography: Title in cream calligraphic italic script with swashes, about half of the width, upper right, with a smaller italic credit above it; the letters sit on the cloud without touching the figure.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Color and light: Dusk palette: slate grey-green clouds, peach glow, black, with lilac grass; low sunset light.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Story it suggests: A creature faces the sky at day's end, alert to something not seen.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Visual idea: A silhouette built as a cut-out against a painterly landscape: the rabbit as a dark totem.
0748_watership-down.jpg.Feels like: 1970s British animation, pastoral with a dark undertone.

0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.People: One man in a dark suit and tie, shown from the waist up and looking straight at the viewer with a blank, serious expression. A woman's large hand, with a pearl ring, reaches up over his torso in the foreground, cropped from the wrist.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Composition: The man is centered, with the title at the upper right. The hand sweeps diagonally across the lower half, partly covering the body, over a nearly empty light textured field.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographs cut out and set on a linen-textured cream background.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Typography: Title and director in tall, thin, lowercase condensed sans-serif in a muted orange-coral, stacked at the top right, about a fifth of the height. 'A film by' is small and grey.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Color and light: Black and grey photo on warm cream with coral type; soft, even studio-like light.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Story it suggests: A buttoned-up man is touched by an unseen woman, an intrusion into his composure.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Visual idea: The hand, bigger than the man's head, as a looming temptation over him.
0749_the-soft-skin.jpg.Feels like: Cool 1960s European romantic drama with a refined modern book-cover look.

0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.People: One large man in a blue pinstripe suit and fedora, half body, pointing a pistol at the viewer. Behind him is a crowd of painted faces, including a bearded man in a sombrero, a woman, and revelers and a carousel horse.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Composition: The man is in the center, in front of a dense background of overlapping faces and fairground imagery. A decorated scalloped border frames everything, and the title sits across the lower middle.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Medium: A painted, folk-art-like illustration with a cracked, aged paint surface, like craquelure on a mural.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Typography: Title in big, slanted, hand-lettered capitals in pink to peach gradient, with a dark outline and cracked texture, stacked on three lines across the lower half. The credit in teal is smaller, slanted and tilted.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Color and light: Violet, magenta, pink and teal with ochre skin tones; warm, flat, festive and dreamlike.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard man with a gun is out of place amid a lively fiesta crowd, with menace in the middle of celebration.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Visual idea: A noir figure on a Mexican folk-art mural, with a fiesta wall as the backdrop.
0750_ride-the-pink-horse.jpg.Feels like: Hardboiled 1940s crime story, with a vivid mural-painting look.

0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.People: None; two objects stand in for characters (a dog-bone tag and a shield-shaped plaque with bird feet).
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Composition: Two stacked panels split by a thin horizontal rule, each with a centered object and a handwritten title; the lower object is slightly left, its title to the right.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Medium: Halftone-dotted photocopies with offset spot-color blobs (blue, red) misregistered, on speckled paper; hand-written pen lettering.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Typography: Scribbled cursive ink handwriting in black for both film titles and the credit line, sizeable but loose, with uneven baselines; the collection logo has a red brush swipe behind it. Sits directly on the paper like notes.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Color and light: Off-white gray paper with cyan blue and vermilion red patches over black halftone; flat, no light.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Story it suggests: Two small memorials for pets and animals, handmade and slightly odd.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Visual idea: Pet-tag and trophy-plaque objects stand for the subjects, shown as cheap print objects with off-register color.
0751_gates-of-heaven.jpg.Feels like: Handmade zine or DIY screen-print, indie documentary.

0752_vernon-florida.jpg.People: None; two objects stand in for characters, a bone-shaped dog tag and a shield-shaped plaque with two bird feet.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Composition: Two stacked panels separated by a horizontal hand-drawn line, each with a centered object, the titles at the top and beside the lower object; the layout is airy and divided in two.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Medium: Halftone-dot printing with off-register color blocks in blue and red, over a speckled paper-grain background and hand-written marker text.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Typography: Handwritten black marker titles 'Gates of Heaven' and 'Vernon, Florida' and 'TWO FILMS BY Errol Morris' in uneven casual script, placed beside and above the objects, the last line cut off at the bottom edge; hand-drawn and informal.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Color and light: Off-white paper with cyan blue and vermilion red, black halftone; flat printed color.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Story it suggests: Two small keepsakes, a pet tag and a trophy of bird feet, hint at odd, tender, eccentric subjects.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Visual idea: Each film summarized by one quirky object, in misregistered print.
0752_vernon-florida.jpg.Feels like: Indie zine and screen-print aesthetic, 1980s documentary with a modern craft look.

0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.People: A face in profile or three-quarter view, barely readable, made out of halftone blue brush shapes. Whether it is a person or just brushstrokes is ambiguous.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Composition: A blue brushy form in the center column, sitting on a black field, with the title at the top and the credit at the bottom. Handwritten lines are spread widely, with lots of empty black.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Medium: Rough blue brush strokes carrying a halftone dot photo, over solid black, with chalky, crayon-like white handwriting.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Typography: Title and credit in white chalk-like handwritten lowercase and mixed case, uneven and loose, stacked in separate places. 'a film by' overlaps the end of the blue stroke, and the name at the bottom is large.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Color and light: Pure black with a single saturated cobalt blue and white; flat, graphic, nocturnal.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Story it suggests: A single identity is dimly picked out of darkness, as a thin trace of evidence.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Visual idea: The 'thin blue line' literally drawn as a smeared blue stroke that forms a face.
0753_the-thin-blue-line.jpg.Feels like: Stark late-1980s documentary and true-crime, with a hand-made look.

0754_odd-man-out.jpg.People: One man, as a dark silhouette in a long coat standing in profile, in a bare brick alley or cell, mostly covered by the title letters.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Composition: A narrow brick-walled space with a single light on the wall at left, converging toward the center. The title letters are huge and stacked down the middle, with the figure behind them.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Medium: A grainy, high-contrast black-and-white photograph with large overlaid white type, slightly translucent.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Typography: Title in huge, heavy, white sans-serif capitals, stacked on three lines (ODD / MAN / OUT) and filling most of the poster's height; letters are slightly translucent so the figure and bricks show through. The credit is bold, small, and at the bottom left.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Color and light: Black and white only; a harsh shaft of light from a high window creates deep shadows.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man is trapped in a dark, confined space, waiting for something to find him.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Visual idea: The block letters act as the walls that box the man in, so the title and the cell are one.
0754_odd-man-out.jpg.Feels like: Postwar British film noir, with a modern, blunt poster look.

0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.People: One tall, thin figure in a green military-style coat and cap with no face, rendered as a vertical stripe of paint; only a hat and coat are visible and the face is a black void. A bundle of sticks or wood lies at his feet.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Composition: Tall figure running down the right-center of a black field, a very strong vertical; left half is empty black. Bundle at the bottom with lettering across the base.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with brush drag, streaky gouache texture, and ragged edges, like a vintage lithograph poster.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Typography: Title in a cream outlined condensed capital with an olive-green inner fill, across the bottom at about 85 percent of the width, a little rough, like old posters. A hand signature and date in tiny script above the left. Smaller credit beneath with the surname in bold blue-gray.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Color and light: Black, olive green, with accents of brown, pink and red; a dark, murky, night-like mood with low light.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Story it suggests: A faceless uniformed man looms over a quiet household or a bundle of wood.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Visual idea: A tall coat with no face, as menace and anonymity reduced to a stripe.
0755_le-silence-de-la-mer.jpg.Feels like: 1940s French postwar poster art, resistance-era drama.

0756_limelight.jpg.People: One older man with curly pale hair, head and shoulders, large and centered in the lower two-thirds, looking at the viewer with a weary, sad expression. He wears a frilled, striped costume collar.
0756_limelight.jpg.Composition: A centered bust portrait on a plain dark field, with the big lettering stacked across the top and tilted. The face's heavy shading draws attention to the eyes.
0756_limelight.jpg.Medium: A painted or colored-pencil portrait with fine hatching and grainy pigment, in the style of a vintage theatrical poster.
0756_limelight.jpg.Typography: Name in large cream capitals with an orange outline across the top, running into the corner logo. The title below in angled, bold orange capitals with a yellow outline, tilting upward to the right. Small caps credit text at upper right.
0756_limelight.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal-green background with warm skin tones and cream, orange and red accents; stage-like spotlight on the face.
0756_limelight.jpg.Story it suggests: An aging performer in costume faces the viewer with melancholy, as if the show's glory has passed.
0756_limelight.jpg.Visual idea: The clown's costume with a tired face; a theatrical bill-poster style used for a sad subject.
0756_limelight.jpg.Feels like: Early 1950s theatrical drama in a vintage showbill style.

0757_the-rose.jpg.People: One woman lying on her back on a stage floor, with a halo of curly hair, holding a microphone up in one raised arm and another near her face. She wears a glittering costume.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Composition: The figure is low at the bottom right in a diagonal reclining pose, and the giant title floats above her. Much of the dark middle area is empty.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Medium: A color photograph of a stage, saturated with red and magenta stage light, with flat vector-looking hand-lettered type on top.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, in swirling, curly yellow script with a pink outline, filling the top half, and slightly tilted. The pink brush script of the star name and director credit sits above and below it.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Color and light: Deep brown-maroon with hot pink, orange and yellow; saturated, hot stage lighting.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Story it suggests: A singer sprawled on the stage floor, in the middle of a raw, exhausted performance.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Visual idea: A giant, ornate title that blooms like a flower over a spent performer.
0757_the-rose.jpg.Feels like: 1970s rock-and-roll music drama with a psychedelic look.

0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.People: One man standing full body, a color cutout photo of a man in a plaid shirt, apron and trousers, with his head thrown back and his mouth open. A flat cream-colored drawn torso and arms are above him, like an oversized shirt.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Composition: A tall, centered vertical figure with the photo cutout inserted into the white silhouette so that the drawn upper body forms the shoulders. The title overlaps the lower body.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Medium: A paper collage on brown kraft paper, with a color-tinted photograph and a flat screenprinted cream drawing, with crinkled paper texture.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Typography: Title in pale blue slab-serif capitals stacked in left-aligned lines, partly cutting across the apron and the legs, taking about a third of the height. The credit at the bottom is in widely spaced slab capitals.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Color and light: Warm brown paper, cream and pale blue with a dark blue-brown photo; flat, even.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Story it suggests: A working man seems overwhelmed and cries out, as if he does not fit into the life that has been drawn for him.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Visual idea: A real person inserted into an empty outline of an ideal figure, showing how he does not fit.
0758_the-merchant-of-four-seasons.jpg.Feels like: Austere 1970s German drama, in a handmade collage design.

0759_the-confession.jpg.People: One man in a suit and tie as a bold cut-paper figure; his head is a black block with ear shapes and no eyes or nose, only a mouth full of white teeth around a star symbol. Reads as a symbolic, faceless figure.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure on a flat red field; the head is large at the upper two-thirds, with the title set on the forehead block at upper right, and the white shirt and tie below. Symmetric, bold and frontal.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Medium: Torn-paper or linocut look with rough hard edges and a threshold texture on the teeth; flat spot colours in red, black and white.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Typography: Title in big bold red condensed sans capitals, set inside the black head in two lines (THE / CONFESSION), about 40% of width, upper centre-right; small white credit under it. The red type matches the background and appears as cut-out of the head.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Color and light: Saturated crimson, black and white; flat graphic light.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Story it suggests: A silent, anonymous official clenches his teeth around a political emblem.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Visual idea: A face replaced by black, with the mouth holding the emblem as the only expression: oppression and silence.
0759_the-confession.jpg.Feels like: Political thriller poster of the 1970s, Eastern European graphic style.

0760_state-of-siege.jpg.People: One man in profile and a hand holding a revolver to his face, large and tightly cropped; the man's head and shoulders fill the poster. The gun is held at his temple/eye by a hand coming from below, so a second person is implied but only the hand appears.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Composition: A large cut-out silhouette of head and shoulders, centered and slightly right, against white; the gun forms a strong diagonal across the face; title stacked at the lower right over the dark coat.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone newsprint with a collage cutout; hand and gun are photographic pieces pasted on.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Typography: Heavy slab-serif condensed caps in light gray, stacked in three lines ('STATE / OF / SIEGE'), left-aligned and covering the lower-right third; small caps credit above. Typeset, sits over the dark coat.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and warm gray-tan; harsh flat print light.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Story it suggests: A man held at gunpoint, political violence at close range.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Visual idea: The gun cuts across the eye so the man is blinded, the hand from nowhere suggesting a faceless power.
0760_state-of-siege.jpg.Feels like: 1970s political thriller, newspaper or protest print.

0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.People: No people; a large white daisy is the sole subject, with red drops on the petals.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Composition: The flower is centered in the upper two-thirds on a plain black field, with the title in the lower third. The flower is seen from the front, symmetrical, radiating outward.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Medium: A black-and-white photograph of a flower, with the yellow center and the red drops hand-tinted on top.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Typography: Title in thick, rounded, psychedelic white capitals, about a fifth of the height, set across the lower middle. The subtitle is thin, white and condensed beneath it, with a small italic credit at the bottom.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with a spot of yellow and red; lit hard against pure black.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Story it suggests: Something innocent and pretty has been wounded, hinting at a hidden violence behind a pretty surface.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Visual idea: The daisy as a stand-in for a girl, with blood spots as a threat in the middle of purity.
0761_valerie-and-her-week-of-wonders.jpg.Feels like: A dreamlike, sinister late-1960s fairy tale, with a hand-colored look.

0762_a-master-builder.jpg.People: One older bald man, half body, with a faint woman's face and flowing hair ghosted behind his shoulder. Her hands rest on his shoulder and waist. His hands press down on a model town.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Composition: The man is large and central, standing behind a tabletop of model houses and a church tower, with a pencil holder at right. The title is at the bottom.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Medium: Ink and wash drawing with loose pen lines, grey and navy watercolor fills and flat spot color; the woman is a faint, translucent line drawing.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Typography: Title in bold navy sans-serif capitals across the bottom, about an eighth of the height. Several rows of credits in light grey-blue letterspaced capitals below it, getting smaller down the page.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Color and light: Cream background, navy, slate grey and blue-grey; flat, muted, no strong light source.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Story it suggests: A man who builds towns is haunted by a woman's presence behind him, as if she were guiding or pressing on him.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Visual idea: A giant man looming over a toy town, with a ghostly woman hovering over his shoulder.
0762_a-master-builder.jpg.Feels like: Literary stage drama with a refined modern editorial-illustration look.

0763_the-bridge.jpg.People: A group of six or seven young men in uniform and helmets, shown from the chest up, packed in a staggered cluster and all staring forward at the viewer. The two in front are large; others sit behind.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Composition: A tight, layered group portrait along the bottom two-thirds, with the title in widely spaced letters above on an empty dark field. Eyes line up roughly in a row.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Medium: A grainy, low-key black-and-white photograph with a dark vignette.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Typography: Title in widely spaced, thin serif capitals with a gradient that fades to dark at the bottom, across the upper third in two lines. The credit is small, in serif letters, at the bottom.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Color and light: Black, charcoal and grey; dim, dark, with soft side light on the faces.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Story it suggests: Very young soldiers are lined up, serious and tense, facing something threatening off-camera.
0763_the-bridge.jpg.Visual idea: A wall of faces, young and uniformed, confronting the viewer.

0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.People: A swarm of tiny abstract, stick-like figures in orange and blue, writhing around the cup. Large outlined arms reach in from the edges. They are dancing or pulling.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Composition: A large grey chalice is placed in the center, and figures crowd at the top and bottom. Giant arms reach in from the left, the right and the lower corners, creating a radial layout.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn marker and felt-tip pen on cream paper, with silver-grey fill, bold black outlines and a naive graffiti-pop look.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Typography: Title in large, heavy black sans-serif capitals, bleeding off the bottom and sides, about a sixth of the height. Names in bold black capitals above in small size.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Color and light: Cream with orange, cobalt blue, black and silver; flat and even.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Story it suggests: A crowd is frantically reaching for a sacred cup that sits still in the center.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Visual idea: A holy grail surrounded by street-art squiggle people, mixing the sacred with the chaotic city.
0764_the-fisher-king.jpg.Feels like: Playful 1980s-90s urban fantasy, in a graffiti-pop style.

0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.People: One tiny rider, arms raised, on a dark galloping horse in the upper right, in the surf. The figure is very small compared to the sea and rocks.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Composition: A large rocky foreground at the bottom, and shoreline foam running diagonally toward the horizon, with the horse and rider far away at upper right. The title is set over the rock at the bottom center.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Medium: Fine pen-and-ink engraving or scratchboard, with dense hatching lines in the rocks and water, and a flat gold foil-like title.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Typography: Title in thin, elegant, art-deco-style gold letters with long vertical strokes, over the dark rock at lower center, around an eighth of the height. A small serif presenter credit is at the top and the director credit below the title.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with a single gold accent; bright light on the foam with dark rocks.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy and a horse race joyfully along a wild shore, small against a vast sea.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Visual idea: Tiny figures in a huge landscape, engraved as in a storybook.
0765_the-black-stallion.jpg.Feels like: Classic adventure for young readers, in an old-engraving style.

0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.People: One person (a young man in a cap), half body, with his arm raised across the head as if shading his eyes, looking up and off to the side. A small black bird is blurred in front of the arm.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Composition: The figure is large and centered-right in the lower two-thirds, with the title across the upper right on a pale empty ground. The bird crosses the arm diagonally.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Medium: A blue-toned monotone photograph with heavy grain, like a duotone print, with a rough paper background.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Typography: Title in condensed, woodgrain-textured red-brown capitals and lowercase, in a block at upper right, about a sixth of the height. The credit is in small, widely spaced dark capitals below it.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Color and light: Pale cyan-blue figure on off-white with red-brown type; bright, overexposed, hazy light.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy squints into a bright sky as a bird flashes past, at the edge of something new.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Visual idea: A single-color figure washed out by sunlight, with the bird as a sign of fleeting freedom.
0766_here-is-your-life.jpg.Feels like: Quiet 1960s coming-of-age drama, in a muted Scandinavian look.

0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.People: Two large embracing figures fill the top half, one seen from behind with dark hair, the other in profile wearing a white cap with his tongue out and a blue streak on his cheek. Below, a small street scene shows a hugging pair and two other men standing by a ladder.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Composition: The poster is split in two stacked photographs, a huge close-up above and a wide street shot below, joined by diagonal title strips that run from upper left to lower right. The main subject sits in the upper right.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Medium: Heavily grainy, color-saturated photographic print with a green-yellow cast, overlaid with photocopied paper cut-outs and rough xerox texture.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Typography: Title is set in huge black blocky capitals on torn white paper strips, stacked in three tilted lines, with ransom-note style scraps, smudged ink and a stamped 'directed by' label; the director name sits on a black torn strip in white letters. The strips cover parts of the photographs.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Color and light: Washed green, olive and cream tones with black type and a small cyan accent; flat overcast daylight.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Story it suggests: An intimate, impulsive embrace in the foreground is echoed by a smaller public hug on the street, suggesting a private desire played out in a rough neighborhood.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Visual idea: Punk cut-and-paste zine collage: the intimate close-up is torn and labeled like a flyer, the street scene grounds it.
0767_my-beautiful-laundrette.jpg.Feels like: 1980s British punk and DIY zine aesthetic, urban social drama.

0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.People: One woman, a large head-and-shoulders portrait, hooded or cloaked, looking at the viewer with a wary sideways gaze. The face is the only clear area; her hood and shoulders dissolve into text.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Composition: Single central portrait on a white field with generous empty margins, shaped like a teardrop or hooded mass tapering to the lower right. Names sit across the top, title and credit centered at the bottom.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photocopy or typewriter-print look: the whole image is built from tiny lines of typed text, dense and black near the face, fading to grey toward the edges.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Typography: Cast names at top are small spaced typewriter capitals; the title at the bottom is typewriter type with dashed underline marks, small relative to the poster. The image itself is made of the same typed script lines, so lettering and picture are one.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white only, on bright flat white paper; soft contrasty light on the face.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A guarded woman wrapped in words and secrets seems to be looking at someone out of frame.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Visual idea: Her portrait and cloak are literally woven from lines of a script or letters, suggesting a character composed of text and narrative.
0768_the-french-lieutenant-s-woman.jpg.Feels like: Literary period drama, typewriter and manuscript feel of the late 1970s-80s.

0769_day-for-night.jpg.People: A crowd of about ten hand-drawn figures, mostly in profile or half body, stacked in the upper diagonal half: a bespectacled young woman in large close view, a man on a phone, a woman reading a red book, a man in a coat, a person with a small spotlight. Small figures overlap each other; a cat and a fish appear in the lower half.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Composition: The poster is cut by a strong diagonal from lower left to upper right into a busy illustrated upper triangle and a flat red lower triangle. Lettering and a looping cable sweep through the red area.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Medium: Gouache or screen-print style illustration with dry-brush texture, flat layered shapes, speckled dots and visible brush edges.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Typography: A thin hand-lettered script credit curves across the red; 'DAY' and 'NIGHT' are tall, thin white capitals, with a 'for' in script between them. A thick black cable loops through and across the NIGHT letters, partially striking them out. Hand-drawn, large, lower right.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Color and light: Salmon red, deep navy and black with cream and ochre highlights; flat graphic light with a spotlight glow.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Story it suggests: Many people at work around a mysterious production, with a black cat watching from the cable's end.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Visual idea: Clearly a film-set metaphor: a cable and a crank machine feed the scene, the diagonal splits two worlds into a stage and the red ground.
0769_day-for-night.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary retro-illustration homage to 1960s-70s French and Polish poster art.

0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.People: Large legs of one woman cross in high heels and fill the lower right; her face is out of frame. A shadowy man in a top hat and gloves peers from behind a doorway in the background, nearly a silhouette.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Composition: Strong vertical diagonals: the crossed legs sweep from upper right to lower left, the dark doorframe and figure sit left of center, tiled floor lines converge at the bottom. Title crosses the middle.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Medium: Extremely grainy, high-contrast photographic print with posterized red-and-black toning, almost a screened or photocopied look.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Typography: Title in bold white serif capitals with a red drop-shadow across the middle, large and wide; the word 'KILL' is in red with a sharp, blade-like K. Credit below in small bold caps. The title overlaps the legs.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Color and light: Blood red, hot pink-white and black with burnt highlights; stark glaring light.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman is being watched by a menacing, hidden figure.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Visual idea: Seduction and threat are put in the same frame, with the red coloring turning a leg shot into a warning.
0770_dressed-to-kill.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s-80s erotic thriller, slasher and giallo tone.

0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up, face tilted up and looking away with a worried, damp-eyed expression; hair is tousled, with a coral top at lower right. Skin pores and tears are visible.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Composition: The face is cropped tightly, filling the whole frame and tilted diagonally upward to the right. The title runs down the left-center, credit at the bottom.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Medium: Sharp, natural photographic realism with fine skin texture and soft focus background; no stylization.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Typography: Title in huge thin yellow sans-serif capitals stacked in three lines, 'TWO DAYS, / ONE / NIGHT', spanning most of the poster height and laid directly over the face; a small yellow credit line at the bottom. Clean, typeset, tightly stacked.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Color and light: Warm skin tones, brown hair, blue eyes, coral pink and a single saturated lemon yellow; soft natural daylight.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks up with anxiety and hope, as if waiting on others' decisions.
0771_two-days-one-night.jpg.Visual idea: A raw human face is bluntly overwritten by bright yellow lettering, creating tension between the intimate and the graphic.

0772_blind-chance.jpg.People: One man in profile facing left, a large painted head and neck, tight crop; hair is short and dark, expression intense and strained.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Composition: Centered profile head against a dark ground, sliced by four cream horizontal bands that split into curved branches, like railway tracks switching. Title bottom center.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Medium: Painterly portrait with oil-like brushstrokes, overlaid by flat cream vector bands with a paper-grain texture.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Typography: Title 'BLIND CHANCE' in tall cream condensed sans-serif capitals at the bottom center, medium size; credit below in cream italic serif. Same color as the stripes, no distortion.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Color and light: Muted dark brown, olive and cream with pale pink skin tones; flat, quiet light.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Story it suggests: A single man's path forks into several possible directions.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Visual idea: The stripes act as diverging tracks cutting through his face, suggesting branching fates.
0772_blind-chance.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century European art-house, a painted-portrait and Constructivist-flavored graphic design.

0773_breaker-morant.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, large, half body to thigh, wearing suspenders with hands tied behind his back; a long line of small helmeted soldiers faces him across the horizon.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Composition: Symmetric-ish: the man at the lower center, the horizon line of rifles at the mid-height, and a giant title filling the sky above; strong central axis.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Medium: Digital painted illustration with a gritty textured, paper-like finish and speckles.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed sans capitals 'BREAKER MORANT' in cream across the upper half, tightly stacked and nearly touching the head, with a gold credit line above; typeset heavy, with a worn texture.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Color and light: Sepia, ochre and dusty orange with a pink glow at the horizon; warm hazy dusk light.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Story it suggests: A bound man stands alone facing a firing squad.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Visual idea: One back-turned man against a wall of identical soldiers, the title looming over him.
0773_breaker-morant.jpg.Feels like: Military drama, a gritty historical illustration.

0774_mister-johnson.jpg.People: One man, full body, standing front-facing in a cream three-piece suit with red tie, leaning on a closed umbrella, with a straw hat and a halo-like ring around his head. He faces us with a calm, slightly amused look.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Composition: Man placed in the exact center of a road that narrows toward the horizon, giving a strong one-point perspective; pink sky above, ochre scrub both sides, and the title across the lower road area. Symmetric and frontal.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Medium: Digital or gouache painting with visible brush texture in the sky and ground, and pencil outline lines on the suit.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Typography: Title in huge bold condensed sans, pale gray, stacked in two lines, filling about 55 percent of the width on the road surface, with a darker mauve credit line below. Typeset, clean, sitting on flat road color.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Color and light: Pink sky, ochre earth, mauve road, cream suit; warm, hazy, sunset-like light with a long shadow to the left.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Story it suggests: A dapper man strolls proudly down a long dusty road, optimistic and somewhat out of place.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Visual idea: The road as a pedestal, with the halo hat making him look saintly or ironic.
0774_mister-johnson.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary illustrated poster for a 1990 colonial-era comedy-drama.

0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.People: Two figures in an embrace, a man seen from behind with blond hair and a curly-haired woman with her eyes closed resting her head on his shoulder, half-body, lower right. A letter is in the man's hand.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Composition: Lower right holds the couple while the lower left opens to a city view with a large domed building; top half is mostly empty pale sky containing the title. Strong diagonal from the couple to the dome.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus, filmic photograph with fine grain and a pastel gradient sky; photographic realism.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Typography: Title is large, in two or three stacked lines at the upper center, in thin ornate Art Nouveau-style capitals with a bronze-to-copper gradient; the V and R are elongated. A small tracked credit sits mid-left. Typeset and decorative.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Color and light: Lavender-pink pastel sky, terracotta roofs, warm browns on the couple; hazy golden-hour light.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Story it suggests: A tender embrace overlooking a faraway city, a private moment with a letter.
0775_a-room-with-a-view.jpg.Visual idea: The window view and the couple are placed together, the title floating in the open sky like the view itself.

0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.People: No visible people at close view; a tiny campsite with a tent, fire, easels and signs sits on a beach, with only very small marks that could be figures or objects. If anyone is present they are specks.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Composition: A high aerial view of a curved bay: the shoreline sweeps from upper left down to lower right, with sky filling the upper half and the land mass in the middle. The campsite is small at lower right; the title appears in the sky at the top right and again as stones on the sand.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Medium: Painterly photographic look, like a matte painting or oil-glazed photograph with smooth gradients and soft detail.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Typography: Title is set in yellow looping script with flourishes at the top right on dark cloud, medium size; the credit below is smaller yellow italic script. The title is repeated as white stone letters laid along the beach, small and tilted, part of the scene.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Color and light: Dusky grey storm clouds, pale cream sky, green-brown trees, amber sand and teal-dark water; low golden evening light.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Story it suggests: A secret hideaway on a remote coast, with a storm brewing overhead.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Visual idea: The title is written into the landscape itself, as if someone on the beach spelled out the name of their own imagined kingdom.
0776_moonrise-kingdom.jpg.Feels like: Storybook, nostalgic 1960s-feel Americana adventure, handmade and whimsical.

0777_the-brood.jpg.People: One woman, half-body, wrapped in a big white robe and staring at the viewer with wide eyes; she holds two small blood-spotted, metallic-looking infants or creatures in her hands at the bottom. Faint eye-like knots stare from the wood behind.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Composition: Central diagonal from the face at upper right down to the cradled bundle at the lower right; the white robe forms a large teardrop mass against a vertical wood-grain background. The title sits in the middle of the robe.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Medium: Detailed gouache or colored-pencil illustration with charcoal scribbles on the robe, dry matte paper texture and speckled blood spatter; the title looks stamped.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Typography: Title 'THE BROOD' in massive rough-edged red slab capitals over the white robe, with BROOD very large and slightly eaten by the paper texture. 'A film by' and director name in smaller red capitals at the bottom, overlapping the robe hem.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Color and light: Muddy brown, bone white and blood red, with dull grey skin; flat, cold interior light.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Story it suggests: A frightened woman clutches something monstrous and newborn, hidden from the world.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Visual idea: Maternal protection is turned into horror, with the wooden walls watching like eyes.
0777_the-brood.jpg.Feels like: 1970s body horror and a modern screen-print-style tribute.

0778_a-special-day.jpg.People: Two people in close-up, a serious man in a vest, shirt and tie looking directly out and a woman leaning her head on his shoulder, looking down; her hand rests on his shoulder.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Composition: Tight two-shot filling a framed rectangle with a cream border; the man is left of center, the woman at right, the title lies along the bottom.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned film still with grain, with a slightly rough torn-edge frame like a print.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Typography: Title 'A SPECIAL DAY' in very large black Art Deco display capitals across the bottom, with thin outlines and a cream inner line; credit in small brown serif. The title overlaps the bottom of the photograph's frame.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Color and light: Warm sepia, brown and cream, near monochrome; soft indoor light.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Story it suggests: A stern, guarded man and a worried, leaning woman share a quiet, uneasy intimacy.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Visual idea: The cream border and Deco lettering make the still feel like a period keepsake, an old photograph from the past.
0778_a-special-day.jpg.Feels like: 1930s-40s European period drama and old studio portrait, filtered through 1970s cinema.

0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.People: Two women's faces side by side, extreme close-up and heavily blurred: one blonde on the left, one dark-haired on the right, both with parted lips looking upward. Their faces are partly out of focus.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Composition: The two faces fill the top half; below, a night view of a city at night with the title angled across it, and an upside-down, mirrored 'HOLLYWOOD' hillside sign at the bottom. Symmetrical-ish split down the center.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus, grainy, dreamy photographic blur with glow and haze, like an out-of-focus film frame.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Typography: Title 'MULHOLLAND DR.' in large angled white-to-blue capitals, blurred to the right and diminishing, slanting upward to the right; a small 'DAVID LYNCH'S' sits tilted above. The title looks like a sign seen in perspective.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Color and light: Hazy peach and skin pink above, black in the middle and amber city lights with icy blue-white type below; neon-lit nighttime glow.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women gaze up in a dreamlike haze, as if one could be the other's reflection.
0779_mulholland-drive.jpg.Visual idea: Mirroring: two faces, an inverted sign and a blurred title, a doubled, unstable identity.

0780_code-unknown.jpg.People: A crowd of about two dozen tiny pedestrians seen from above, walking in separate directions, each with a long shadow; a cyclist at left. Most are anonymous silhouettes.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Composition: Top-down view split by a curving pavement edge: asphalt at left, tiled pavement at right. White rounded vertical outline shapes, like capsule brackets or a stylized letter, run through the center and right edge, framing the title.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic grain with a cold blue duotone and clean vector shapes over it.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Typography: Title 'CODE UNKNOWN' in condensed bold sky-blue sans-serif capitals, two lines, mid-right; the director's name below it in thin white condensed capitals. Medium size, left aligned, set inside the white outline.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Color and light: Cool grey-blue and black, with a sky-blue accent; hard sunlight casting long shadows.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Story it suggests: Strangers pass each other in a city without connecting.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Visual idea: The white outlines isolate one walking woman, as if a symbol or code overlays the crowd.
0780_code-unknown.jpg.Feels like: Austere, art-house modernism of the late 1990s-2000s.

0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.People: No people. Abstract dark ink or burnt-paper shapes: a large leaf-shaped black blot and a fragment at the bottom edge.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Composition: One large dark teardrop mass is centered, with the title laid over it, and a second dark fragment cut off at the bottom edge; lots of blank cream space around.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Medium: Ink blot, smudged and printed with stained, burnt or etched texture, with speckled splatters and paper grain.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, in tall high-contrast Didone serif capitals, stacked in four lines in cream on the dark blot, large and tightly set with letters touching; credit in the same style in black below the blot. Very large, left of center, partly broken by the stain's texture.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Color and light: Black and cream, with a hint of sepia and a maroon logo; flat paper light.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Story it suggests: Something dark and violent has stained a pale surface.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Visual idea: The dark blot reads as a stain, ink or blood, with the title carved from it.
0781_in-cold-blood.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s literary and crime-drama book-jacket design.

0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.People: One child's face in extreme close-up, half hidden behind a rough stone or iron column at left, looking at the viewer with big wet eyes and messy dark hair.
