0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Strong vertical split: the pillar at left, the face tilted slightly at center-left, blurred dark foliage right. Titles stack at the lower right, and the three film names run in a row across the bottom.
0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photographic grain with soft blurred background.
0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Title 'THE APU TRILOGY' in heavy yellow condensed slab capitals at lower right, large, left aligned in a stack. Three film names in smaller yellow capitals in a row below, with small white subtitles and a bold yellow director line.
0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with a single mustard-yellow for type; soft diffused light.
0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A solemn child peers out from behind a post, watching the world with curiosity and sorrow.
0782_the-apu-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: A child's gaze peeking round a column suggests a tender story of growing up, framed like a documentary photograph.

0783_pather-panchali.jpg.People: One young boy, close-up, head and shoulders, with tousled dark hair, looking to the side with wide worried eyes, hugging his knees and holding an open book. Fills most of the poster's lower two-thirds.
0783_pather-panchali.jpg.Composition: The head is diagonally placed in the lower centre against a rough wall, with title at the top as a large band and the knees at the bottom. The face is off-axis and looks toward the left.
0783_pather-panchali.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic film still with visible grain and rough wall texture; slightly soft focus.
0783_pather-panchali.jpg.Typography: Title in large chunky yellow, angular, slightly condensed sans capitals across the full width, in the upper quarter, with a small white credit above and a thin italic subtitle below. Flat and clean over the textured wall.
0783_pather-panchali.jpg.Color and light: Greyscale with a single bright mustard-yellow; soft, flat daylight.

0784_aparajito.jpg.People: One young man standing full-body in the middle of an empty street, looking up and away, clutching a bundle of cloth under one arm and a suitcase with a round object in the other hand.

0786_don-t-look-back.jpg.People: One young man in half-body inside a car, wearing dark sunglasses and a suit with a cigarette in his mouth, with big, tousled, backlit hair; he looks down and away.

0787_jellyfish-eyes.jpg.People: One cartoon-like creature, a pink, bell-shaped head with a pointed tip and two big green eyes, large and cropped at the bottom, looking up and to the sides. It is a character or doll, not a human.

0787_jellyfish-eyes.jpg.Typography: Thin, hand-drawn white rounded letters, nearly full width, in the upper third; small widely spaced caps credit above; the pointy top points to the center of the title. Light, playful, typeset-to-handwritten look.

0787_jellyfish-eyes.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange, friendly creature peers up at the sky.
0787_jellyfish-eyes.jpg.Visual idea: Pink jellyfish-like head and big eyes in a blue sky give the title literally.

0788_speedy.jpg.People: Two people, a woman in a cloche hat and a man in a straw hat with round glasses, tumble together inside a huge cylinder, drawn smaller in the lower section; the woman reaches out, the man's leg flies up.
0788_speedy.jpg.Composition: The cylinder or tunnel makes a swirling spiral: concentric wood-plank walls rush toward a black circle at center showing a glowing amusement park at night. The pair is at the bottom, the title sweeps around the top of the circle.
0788_speedy.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic collage with motion blur and radial streaks, a high-contrast silver-gelatin look.
0788_speedy.jpg.Typography: 'SPEEDY' in gigantic white curved capitals bending around the top of the central circle, partly cut at the edges, with a smaller curved 'STARRING HAROLD LLOYD' along the lower rim. The lettering follows the swirl, as if on a wheel.
0788_speedy.jpg.Color and light: Silver grey, white and black; spotlit with pinpoint lights in the circle.

0788_speedy.jpg.Visual idea: Letters, walls and lights all curve into the same vortex, making speed visible.

0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.People: One elderly man in a tight close-up portrait wearing a fedora and a pinstriped jacket with a tie, with a deadpan, deeply lined face that looks directly into the camera.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Composition: Face is centered and fills most of the frame with hat at top; a white band holding the title runs across the bottom. A shadowed diagonal shape at the right edge.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Medium: Sharp black-and-white flash photograph with fine grain, stark and harsh.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Typography: Title 'BURROUGHS' in huge black slab-serif capitals, widely spaced, on a white band across the bottom; two small black credit lines under it, left and right. Typeset with no distortion, fully separate from the picture.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and greys; hard, direct flash light.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Story it suggests: A weathered man calmly stares down the camera, unreadable.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Visual idea: A flat, document-like mugshot or ID portrait presented without decoration, with a slab-serif title like a typewriter.
0789_burroughs-the-movie.jpg.Feels like: 1980s documentary portrait, a literary-underground and typewriter look.

0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.People: One woman, full figure, in a kimono holding a drawn sword in one hand while shielding with a large purple parasol behind her; she looks to the right, away from the viewer.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Composition: The figure sits left of center, leaning diagonally forward, with the large circle of the parasol behind her head. The title block sits in the open white space at the upper right; snow-capped flowers fill the lower area.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Medium: Flat vector or woodblock-print style illustration with crisp black outlines, watercolor-like tonal washes and grainy texture, and printed blood spatter.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Typography: Title 'LADY SNOW BLOOD' in tall condensed grey-beige capitals, stacked in three lines at the upper right between two thin bars, with a small credit beneath. Large, left aligned, typeset.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Color and light: White ground with lavender purple, crimson, black and beige; flat, bright, cold light.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Story it suggests: A solitary woman with a sword walks on through a snowy field, with traces of blood on her parasol.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Visual idea: Beauty and violence are placed together: the delicate umbrella and flowers carry blood spots.
0790_lady-snowblood.jpg.Feels like: Retro Japanese ukiyo-e-inspired period action and 1970s revenge film.

0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.People: One woman partly shown, her face hidden by a huge purple parasol, only red lips visible; her white hand lifts and a sword blade lies diagonally behind her in a kimono.
0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.Composition: A big diagonal: the parasol sweeps down from the top, the figure sits in the lower right, a sword and the title are on the left. A large white empty field is left of the figure.
0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.Medium: Flat vector illustration with thin black lines, soft watercolor-like washes and fine textures, clean and printed.
0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.Typography: Title 'LADY SNOW BLOOD' in tall condensed muted-purple capitals stacked in three lines on the left between thin bars, with subtitle and credit below in smaller caps. Typeset, left-aligned and mid-size.
0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.Color and light: White and lavender-purple with ivory, brown and red accents; quiet, flat light.

0791_lady-snowblood-love-song-of-vengean.Feels like: 1970s Japanese period action, ukiyo-e-styled and modern minimal design.

0792_bitter-rice.jpg.People: Two women in the foreground, a redhead standing with a hand on her hip in a red top, shorts and stockings, facing viewers with defiant eyes, and a dark-haired woman in a purple headscarf crouched at right. 0792_bitter-rice.jpg.Composition: Two foreground figures lie on a diagonal, with the red-haired woman tall at left and the second lower right, and faded workers in the middle ground. Title sits at the upper right.

0792_bitter-rice.jpg.Visual idea: Pulp-novel seduction set against farm work: the bright sexy figure interrupts the field.
0792_bitter-rice.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Italian melodrama and pulp-paperback painted poster.

0793_the-american-friend.jpg.People: One man in half-body, mustached, wearing a tan trench coat and looking back over his shoulder at the viewer. Behind him is a ghostly second figure in profile, a dark double exposure of a man in a wide-brimmed hat.

0798_death-by-hanging.jpg.People: No people. The only figure-like shape is a coiled rope forming a hanging noose, with a red sun-like shape at the bottom.

0798_death-by-hanging.jpg.Typography: Title 'DEATH BY HANGING' in heavy black stencil-style capitals in two lines, broken by stencil gaps and speckles, large and centered below the rope; vertical Japanese characters at the upper right; spaced credit in thin capitals. Rough, hand-cut.

0801_i-knew-her-well.jpg.Visual idea: The title lives in a tear that doubles as a teardrop and a wound across the face.
0801_i-knew-her-well.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1960s European art-house drama, modern graphic restyling.

0802_paris-belongs-to-us.jpg.People: One tiny man standing on a rooftop in one panel; other panels show cityscape with specks of pedestrians and cars. Figure is distant and nearly lost.
0802_paris-belongs-to-us.jpg.Composition: Black field with five photo panels of uneven sizes staggered in two rows like a displaced contact sheet; title stacked in the top left and split around the credit line.

0802_paris-belongs-to-us.jpg.Typography: Wide-set white sans capitals, medium-large, left aligned in the upper third; the title is broken by 'A FILM BY JACQUES RIVETTE' inserted between 'BELONGS' and 'TO US'. Typeset, no interaction with the images.

0802_paris-belongs-to-us.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man surveys a vast city from above, small against a place that seems to belong to others.
0802_paris-belongs-to-us.jpg.Visual idea: Misaligned film frames as a map of a city, with the title cut apart like the story's fragments.

0803_the-manchurian-candidate.jpg.Typography: Bold condensed white sans capitals, stacked in three lines inside the blue flag at top left, large (about a third of the width); smaller black credits to the right and below. Typeset, the flag is hinged on the pole.

0803_the-manchurian-candidate.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is watched, or a mind is held in a gaze, with a card face and a red square planted in the eye.
0803_the-manchurian-candidate.jpg.Visual idea: Eye as pendulum and flag, with American stripes hinting at political hypnosis.
0803_the-manchurian-candidate.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s Cold War modernist screen-print poster.

0804_a-brighter-summer-day.jpg.People: No person is visible; clothes laid flat in a body shape (bloodied white shirt, black skirt, shoes), like an outline of a figure. Ambiguous: the arranged objects stand in for a body.
0804_a-brighter-summer-day.jpg.Composition: Top-down view of objects arranged vertically along the center line, record sleeve with a singer's face at the top, shoes at the bottom, knives and books to the sides, framed by a thin dark red border.

0804_a-brighter-summer-day.jpg.Typography: Large cream italic serif capitals in three stacked lines, widely letter-spaced and centered, laid right over the shirt and skirt; small italic credit at the bottom. Typeset, partly overlapping the objects.

0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.People: One figure, three-quarter view from behind, long hair, arm raised with a pointing hand, in the lower right at about a third of the poster; seen in a stage spotlight.

0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Medium: Grainy colour film still of a stage with blue tint, overlaid with flat printed ornament in metallic gold and cream ink.
0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Typography: Very large hand-lettered western-psychedelic capitals in olive and cream, stacked five lines tall in a central column, with ornate swirling vines framing it; the raised hand touches the word POEM, lettering partly overlaps the person. Hand-drawn.
0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Color and light: Deep blue and black with golden olive lettering; a theatrical spotlight cone.
0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Story it suggests: A musician on stage reaches up toward the words as if conjuring them.
0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Visual idea: The lettering as a carved totem or gig poster, with the performer's pointing hand touching the title.
0805_a-poem-is-a-naked-person.jpg.Feels like: Early 1970s American concert film and rock poster.

0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.People: One man, half body, leaning forward in a wide-brimmed hat holding a telephone receiver, with a tense sideways look; a tiny pilot appears in a small biplane at the top.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonals: a beam of pale yellow light and a biplane run from the top right, and the man sits bottom left on a counter-diagonal; title and names sit lower right under him.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Medium: Illustrated inked artwork with flat limited-ink areas and bold black outlines, like a comic or screen print.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Typography: Cast names in grey heavy sans capitals and the title in yellow hand-lettered italic script, leaning at an angle and stacked at the bottom right, at medium size; director in bold capitals below. Hand-drawn, tucked under the figure.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Color and light: Black, greys and pale butter-yellow; hard dramatic light from top right through the palm leaves.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Story it suggests: A man by a radio in a jungle outpost waits for a plane in danger.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Visual idea: Palm shadows and an airplane in a spotlight framing the man as the one who waits on the ground.
0806_only-angels-have-wings.jpg.Feels like: Late 1930s adventure film, drawn in a modern comic noir style.

0807_barcelona.jpg.People: Two men, half body, standing side by side facing left and right, one in a brown suit with a tie, one in a dark double-breasted naval-style coat; they look in different directions.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Composition: Two figures fill the lower middle, in front of a tall double window; a frame of cross-hatched wall surrounds it, with lots of cream paper around the whole picture and the title at the top.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Medium: Pen and ink cross-hatching with soft watercolour washes on cream paper, with visible paper texture.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered title in cream and ink-outlined letters with a wobbly, calligraphic outline at the top center, medium size; 'A film by Whit Stillman' in handwritten script at the bottom. Hand-drawn, the Criterion logo is also hatched in the same style.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Color and light: Muted olive, grey-brown, navy and pale cream, with small yellow buttons; soft light through a window.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men stand close but look away from each other, an uneasy companionship.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Visual idea: The film as a storybook drawing, with the logo and spine redrawn by hand.
0807_barcelona.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1990s American indie comedy, rendered as a hand-drawn illustration.

0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.People: One man in a dark suit, half body, leaning against a wire fence and looking off to the right; a small woman in a coat walks on the sidewalk at right in the distance.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Composition: Man occupies the left half in a diagonal lean; the right half is a receding street with utility poles and a pale sky; the title block stacks along a vertical axis in the right center, over the man's chest edge.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Medium: Coarse-grained black-and-white documentary photograph with visible film grain.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Typography: Stacked condensed sans capitals, the film list at the top right in red and grey, and the main title in big white then grey then dusty-blue letters running down the lower right, nearly a third of the poster's width; typeset, aligned to one left edge and partly overlapping the man's coat.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Color and light: Grey monochrome photo with accents of red and blue lettering; flat overcast daylight.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Story it suggests: A public figure paused in an ordinary street, watched from close by.
0808_the-kennedy-films-of-robert-drew-as.Visual idea: Candid documentary frame with the film titles acting as a headline column.

0809_phoenix.jpg.People: One woman in profile, half body, facing right, in a red coat, partly swallowed by clouds of smoke; her face is partly veiled.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Composition: Figure sits just right of center, centered in a column of billowing smoke that fills the whole frame; the title crosses her chest at mid height.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Medium: Photographic image desaturated to grey with soft smoke, selective colour, and a faint blurred bokeh of lights at the top.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Typography: Wide-tracked thin white serif capitals across the middle that fade in and out of the smoke, with letters like P, H and I washed to near transparent; small spaced credit below. Typeset, interacts with the smoke by being half erased.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Color and light: Grey and charcoal with only the woman's red coat as colour; diffuse smoky light.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman emerges from a fog, as if from ashes, barely visible and half erased.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Visual idea: Smoke as veil and erasure, with the lettering dissolving with it.
0809_phoenix.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European drama, post-war melancholy mood.

0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.People: Two people: a man in a suit with a loosened tie seated in front, about half the poster, with a worried look aside; a woman lies behind him, face turned away on a bed, mostly cropped at the lower left.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Composition: Man in the right-center upright, the woman lying diagonally at left; the blurred bed head in the background; the title written big across the bottom, over her hair and his knee.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Medium: Sharp black-and-white studio still with soft focus background and smooth gloss.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Typography: Large white flourished script mixed with tall serif capitals, 'In' and 'Place' in curling calligraphic swashes around a bold LONELY, spanning the lower half; credit in spaced caps. Typeset script that overlaps the figures.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with deep contrast and a soft top light on his face.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Story it suggests: A tired man sits beside a woman lying still, uncertain whether he is guilty or protective.
0810_in-a-lonely-place.jpg.Visual idea: The title's loop letters wrap around the bodies like the tangle between them.

0811_the-naked-island.jpg.People: One figure, full body, bent under a shoulder pole carrying two buckets, seen as a rough drawing; ambiguous because only a smeared charcoal silhouette.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Composition: Big diagonal from upper right to lower left, with the buckets balanced at left and right; most of the poster is blank white around the figure; title tilted at the top right.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Medium: Charcoal and smeared graphite drawing with rough grain on white paper, in greyscale.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Typography: Hand-drawn thick charcoal capitals at a slant, stacked in three lines in the upper right, medium-large; the credit is in pale grey rough lettering below. Hand-made, it matches the drawing's marks.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white; no real light, only paper white and soft smudges.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone laborer carries water, burdened and bent.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Visual idea: The weight of labor expressed through a swaying yoke and smudged strokes.
0811_the-naked-island.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Japanese humanist cinema, rendered as a sketch.

0812_the-player.jpg.People: One huge faded grey silhouette of a man's head and shoulders behind everything, shown in profile; no face detail, reading as a shadow.
0812_the-player.jpg.Composition: A film-strip noose hangs from the top center and loops down through the title, with the silhouette behind; names right-aligned in a column and a dense credit block at the bottom.
0812_the-player.jpg.Medium: Soft gradient shadow, matte printed paper texture and a glossy rendering of the film strip; the lettering has a 3D extruded look.
0812_the-player.jpg.Typography: Chunky 3D gold block capitals 'PLAYER' with black extrusion, and a brush-script 'The', spanning most of the width and tangled with the noose; right-aligned grey condensed cast names, plus a tiny classic credit block at the bottom.
0812_the-player.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream and grey with gold, black and red film; soft diffused light.
0812_the-player.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in shadow faces a noose made of film.
0812_the-player.jpg.Visual idea: Film strip as hangman's rope, an industry that can hang its players.

0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.People: One man, half body, standing in front of a roadside shop and gas pump, wearing a hat, glasses and suspenders, hands clasped, looking at us.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Top 55 percent is a photo box set in a white margin, the man at the right and a red gas pump at left; the lower white space holds a handwritten title and a short film list, offset right.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Faded instant-print photograph (Polaroid look) with soft focus and yellowish cast on a white card-like page.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Large loose handwritten pencil title 'The Road Trilogy' above a dashed line, plus small typewriter-style monospace credits above and below; the dashed line looks like a form line. Hand-drawn script with mono text.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Warm faded oranges, reds and browns with white; flat daylight.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A traveler stands at a stop along the road, caught in a snapshot.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: The poster as a photo and handwritten note, like a postcard or travel diary.
0813_wim-wenders-the-road-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: 1970s road movies, with a snapshot and notebook feel.

0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.People: One girl, full body seated on a long bench, resting her cheek on her hand while leaning on a suitcase, looking aside.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Composition: Photo box in the upper two thirds, set in a white frame; child at the left, large suitcase center, bench slats form horizontal bands; handwritten title below in the lower right area.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with soft grain; white page layout.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Typography: Handwritten pencil script title about a third of the width, slanting up, above a dashed line, with small typewriter capitals above and below and a series number below. Hand-drawn, separated from the image.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Color and light: Greys and white; soft indoor light from the left.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Story it suggests: A child waits alone with her luggage.
0814_alice-in-the-cities.jpg.Visual idea: Waiting, with the suitcase as companion; a photo pasted on a notebook page.

0815_wrong-move.jpg.People: Two people in a close two-shot: a blond man looking down with a heavy expression and a young woman resting her head on his shoulder, glancing sideways. They sit on a red seat in a vehicle-like interior; her hand and his bandaged hand are visible.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Composition: A framed photo with a white margin occupying the top 55 percent; the lower half is white with right-aligned text blocks. Two figures lean diagonally into each other. Title sits on a dashed line.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Medium: Color photographic still with film grain, in a snapshot-like manner, framed like a print on a white page.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Typography: Title in loose black handwriting script, about 35 percent of the width, set on and crossing a dashed line like a signature on a form. Small widely spaced typewriter-like capitals for the director, series name and number, all aligned to the right.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Color and light: Warm browns, red seat, light blue shirt and sweater; soft, dim interior light.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Story it suggests: Two travelers sit tiredly together on a journey, tender but uneasy.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Visual idea: A photograph tucked in a form with a dashed line to sign on, like a travel document.
0815_wrong-move.jpg.Feels like: 1970s German road-movie, with a minimalist modern layout.

0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.People: One man, half body, from below, both arms raised in fists; a small statue of a leaping figure floats at the left.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Composition: Man at the center-right looming against sky, statue diagonal at left echoing his pose; horizon low, a truck edge at the right; white page below with handwritten title.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with grain, framed in a white card layout.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Typography: Handwritten pencil title, 'Kings of the Road', crossing the dashed line below the photo, with typewriter credits; hand-drawn and offset to the right.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and bright cloud grey; strong sunlight and low angle.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Story it suggests: A man shouts in triumph, or in defiance, in an empty field.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Visual idea: Real man and statue pose the same gesture, echoing each other.
0816_kings-of-the-road.jpg.Feels like: 1970s German road movie in documentary snapshot style.

0817_le-amiche.jpg.People: Five young women in a row at the bottom, half body to knee, leaning in with chins on fists and heads tilted, smiling or gazing up and out; they are close together and overlap.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Composition: Horizontal band of faces along the bottom third with a huge swooping title above on a pale empty ground; the director credit arcs along the top.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Medium: Clean black-and-white studio portrait photograph with soft studio lighting, on a near-white gradient background.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Typography: Huge crimson brush-script title 'Le Amiche', about two thirds of the width, rising on a diagonal with a long underline swash that sweeps under into the women's heads; grey italic script credit above. Hand-lettered, it overlaps the top of the leftmost woman's hair.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey with a deep magenta-crimson title; soft frontal studio light.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of women friends pose together with different moods, sociable but each lost in her own thoughts.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Visual idea: The sweeping script title like a ribbon tying the five faces together.
0817_le-amiche.jpg.Feels like: 1950s European women's drama, a classic studio-portrait poster.

0818_la-chienne.jpg.People: Two figures: a man in a dark suit with glasses, bent over on his hands, head down, crying or grimacing, and a pale woman beneath him, upside down and mostly white, face at the bottom; drawn in a distorted way.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Composition: Man's body forms an inverted V at the center, arms braced; the woman's pale body fills the lower half in a diagonal; the title cuts across the top.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Medium: Loose pencil and charcoal drawing with smudged grey and pale green washes, visible paper grain.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Typography: Very large tan brush-painted lowercase title 'la chienne', roughly a third of the poster height, cropped at the right edge, with dry-brush texture; a small italic credit at the top right. Hand-painted and sitting on a dark top band above the figures.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal black, grey-white and muted sage with a beige title; dim, flat light.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Story it suggests: A man bends over a woman in a moment of anguish or violence, ambiguous between grief and attack.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Visual idea: The upside-down figure and heavy brushed title speak to degradation and obsession.
0818_la-chienne.jpg.Feels like: 1930s French drama redrawn in an expressionist sketch.

0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.People: Two men seen from behind, sitting side by side on a cloud, heads turned toward each other: one in a striped orange robe holding a saxophone, the other older, in a dark suit with a hand on his companion's back. Mid-body, large.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Composition: Two figures are centred in the upper middle, their legs dangling out under a puffy cloud at the lower centre where the title sits; clouds scatter around the blue sky; the whole thing is symmetrically balanced.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Medium: Smooth digital painting with soft airbrushed clouds and clean, graphic faces; polished illustration.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Typography: Title in warm yellow looping brush-script lettering, 'Here Comes Mr. Jordan', stacked diagonally on the cloud at about 55% width, with a small orange script credit; it sits on the cloud, not the figures.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Color and light: Turquoise sky, white clouds, warm orange, yellow and brown; bright, soft daylight.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men share a quiet, friendly moment up in the sky.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Visual idea: The cloud swallows their legs, making them seem to float: a gentle afterlife image.
0819_here-comes-mr-jordan.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary warm retro illustration of a 1940s comedy-fantasy.

0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.People: One giant blue humanoid head and shoulders, front-facing, bald with fin-like ears and big red eyes; a tiny pinkish human figure sits in its open palm at the bottom.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Composition: Strictly symmetrical frontal figure centered; the hand in the lower third holds the tiny person; the head fills three-quarters of the height.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Medium: Airbrush or grainy stippled illustration with soft gradients and a fine noise texture.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Typography: Red-orange angular hand-lettered title tilted across the forehead, about a quarter of the width; the credit is above in matching lettering; hand-drawn and follows the head's curve.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow-orange background, sky blue skin, red eyes; flat even light.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Story it suggests: A tiny human is held and studied by a calm giant creature.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Visual idea: Scale reversal, with the human as a pet cupped by something gigantic.
0820_fantastic-planet.jpg.Feels like: 1970s animated science fiction, psychedelic European illustration.

0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.People: None visible; only a bomber aircraft is shown.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Composition: Upper band holds a long horizontal airplane flying right; the long title column hangs from just below the plane down the center like a falling bomb, with a lot of empty grey sky.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph of a plane in the sky, plus hand-drawn white line lettering.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Typography: Hand-lettered white outline caps in a tall tapering column shaped like a bomb, stacked in eight lines from a big 'DR.' down to 'BOMB' at the bottom; credits rotated sideways in thin type above it. Hand-drawn, the shape of the text is the object.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Color and light: Cool grey monochrome with white lettering; flat overcast sky light.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Story it suggests: A bomber overhead lets a bomb fall, with the title as the bomb itself.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Visual idea: Title text shaped into the falling bomb below the plane.
0821_dr-strangelove-or-how-i-learned-to-.Feels like: 1960s black comedy about the Cold War, hand-lettered satirical poster.

0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.People: Three women's faces, large and layered: one big close-up at the upper right, one with glasses at center-bottom, and one fainter in profile behind; two tiny hikers at the bottom.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Composition: Left half is sky and cloud with the title; right half is a vertical torn mountain-edged strip with overlapping faces cut by jagged silhouettes of rock; the mood is a diagonal from the upper right to lower left.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Medium: Photographic double exposure, with faces blended with mountain textures, soft digital grading.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Typography: Spaced-out grey serif capitals with italic small words, about a third of the width, on the left in the clouds; cast names stacked above in small caps; clean, typeset, floating in the sky.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Color and light: Pale cloud white, sky blue, slate and mauve; diffuse cool alpine light.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Story it suggests: Three women's lives and moods are tied to a mountain landscape, with the youngest nearly dissolved.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Visual idea: Faces carved out by mountain ridgelines, like geological layers of identity.
0822_clouds-of-sils-maria.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European arthouse drama, moody and atmospheric.

0823_the-in-laws.jpg.People: Two men, half body, blindfolded with ornate orange paisley cloths, both wearing green medals; one smokes a cigarette and tilts his head back, the other laughs wide open.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Composition: Two figures at the bottom against a flat wooden fence; huge title takes the upper half; the men's heads form a roughly symmetrical pair of diagonals.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Medium: Slightly grainy colour film still on a grey fence, with flat printed lettering on top.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Typography: Giant 3D-extruded hand-drawn capitals, white with black shadow, stacked 'THE' tilted and 'IN-LAWS' in tall letters, covering the upper half; script credits in thin cursive; the title is like a signboard, and the men sit below it.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Color and light: Concrete grey with red-orange, green and tan; flat bright daylight.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men are blindfolded as if before a firing squad but laugh, a joke about danger.
0823_the-in-laws.jpg.Visual idea: Blindfold plus medals reads as a mock execution turned into comedy.

0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.People: One woman, seen from behind and side in an old photograph, her face scratched or smudged out with a white blotch; she is at a balcony overlooking a plaza.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Composition: Central vintage photo with a deteriorated border tilted slightly, over a collage of letters, snapshots and doodles; a dark grey title box sits under it at the bottom center.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Medium: Collage of scanned archive paper: typewritten letters, snapshots with deckled edges, ink doodles, a scratched face; paper texture and a pencil signature.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Typography: Elegant white italic serif capitals 'MURIEL' with wide tracking in a dark grey rectangle at the bottom, medium size; handwritten signature of the director on the photo, and typewriter text in the background. Typeset in the box, handwriting on the photo.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Color and light: Greys, off-white and faded greens; flat archival light.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone's memory or identity has been rubbed out of a photograph, with letters left behind.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Visual idea: Archive scraps as the mind, with the missing face as the center of the story.
0824_muriel-or-the-time-of-return.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave drama, scrapbook aesthetic.

0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.People: One woman, large, half body in motion, with a topknot and small black cap, glancing sideways, gripping a long sword; three tiny fighters leap in the lower right.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Composition: Big diagonal sweep: woman from the upper right to the lower left, a sword line crossing from the top right to the bottom left; red title block in the upper left; tiny fighters give scale in the bottom right.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Medium: Digital painting with soft airbrushed gradients, painterly glow and blurred bamboo leaves; slight paper-like grain on the title block.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Typography: Tall narrow cream capitals in a red rectangular block in the upper left, like a seal stamp, about a quarter of the width, with 'ZEN' largest; rough ink texture, hand-cut. It overlaps the bamboo and the edge of her shoulder.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange, red and cream with fresh yellow-green bamboo; glowing backlit morning light.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman warrior is mid-motion, with sword drawn, looking at an unseen opponent while small fighters leap behind.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Visual idea: Seal stamp title plus a sword line that slices the picture, with bamboo as the ink-painting backdrop.
0825_a-touch-of-zen.jpg.Feels like: Early 1970s Chinese martial arts epic, painterly modern re-illustration.

0826_the-new-world.jpg.People: Three figures seen from behind or sideways at the water's edge: a long-haired woman at the center with her arm around a man at the right wearing a feather in his hair, and a crouching figure at the left; all barely clothed.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Composition: Figures spread across the lower half in grass, facing a wide bay with three sailing ships in the distance; a white title block sits at the lower right.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Medium: Realistic oil painting with soft glowing edges and brushed grass strokes.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Typography: Black-green serif title in a tall white rectangle at the bottom right, medium size, with the first letter and last letters cut off by the box's edges; 'written and directed by' in small italic. Typeset in a panel over the grass.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Color and light: Green grass, brown skin, pale grey-blue water and sky; misty, soft dawn light with a glow behind the woman.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Story it suggests: People on a shore watch ships arrive in a bay, uncertain about what is coming.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Visual idea: The back-turned onlookers seeing strangers approach by sea.
0826_the-new-world.jpg.Feels like: 2000s American historical epic, oil painting like a book illustration.

0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.People: One man, full body, standing in a huge shaggy fur coat and bowler hat with a beard, facing us; horses and wooden buildings behind him.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Composition: Man in the center column, framed by horses at the left and a lumber shed at right; the lettering washes over the entire frame in layers, in a symmetrical block of names above and title below.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Medium: Slightly desaturated colour film still with natural grain; chalky white hand-lettering painted over the photo.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Typography: Very large hand-drawn western-style capitals in white chalk-like fill with thin dark outlines, names at the top, title in the middle, director at the bottom, covering almost the whole image; letters overlap the man's body semi-transparently. Hand-lettered.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Color and light: Muddy tan, rust-orange fur, cool grey-green mountain; flat overcast daylight.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Story it suggests: A fur-wrapped man arrives in a muddy frontier settlement and stands waiting.
0827_mccabe-mrs-miller.jpg.Visual idea: The letters as painted signage on a frontier town, wrapped around the man like his coat.

0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.People: One woman, half body, in a checked jacket, holding a small movie camera to her eye and smiling slightly, facing right; she takes up the left half.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Composition: Woman at the left, her camera pointed right toward the title column; blurred door at the lower right; title stacks in the upper right in a column that bulges in the middle.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white archival photograph with soft grain and warm grey wash.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed bright yellow capitals, 'INGRID BERGMAN IN HER OWN WORDS' in four lines, about a third of the width, with the left sides of letters sliced diagonally as if shaped by a bulging curve; small yellow credit below. Typeset, aimed by the camera lens.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with a single saturated yellow for lettering; warm sunlit daylight.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks through a movie camera, being the observer rather than the observed.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Visual idea: Title curved like a lens bulge, answering the camera in the woman's hand.
0828_ingrid-bergman-in-her-own-words.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century portrait documentary, contemporary graphic restyling.

0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.People: One person implied, a black profile silhouette of a head facing left, painted in ink; no face details.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Composition: Large head silhouette on a blue field, with a hanging light bulb at the right hanging into the head's space; title letters scattered in a zigzag from the top left to the lower right, wrapping around the head.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Medium: Cut-paper collage and dry-brush black ink on a gridded textured paper; red crayon scribble.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Typography: Large cream grid-textured capitals, with 'A TASTE OF HONEY' stacked with each word tilted at different angles, partly worn out like torn paper; cutouts, big (a third to half of the poster tall). Hand-cut and arranged around the silhouette, 'HONEY' climbing up.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Color and light: Cyan-blue, black, cream and a bit of red; flat, no real light, but the bulb glows white.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl lost in thoughts, with a heart scribbled inside the bulb of her mind.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Visual idea: The bulb as a head's idea, containing a child's crayon heart.
0829_a-taste-of-honey.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s British kitchen-sink drama, hand-made collage.

0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.People: Three figures: a bearded stout old man in the center, a crowned figure in robes in profile at the left, and a helmeted figure from behind at the lower right; they appear in a stage-like confrontation.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Composition: Central man framed between the king at left and the helmet at right, a long diagonal staff or pole cuts across; patterned castle wall in the background; title across the top.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Medium: Gouache or ink wash painting in sepia and greys, with dry brush texture and white highlights, like a monochrome illustration on paper.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Typography: Large white italic sans capitals, bold with brown drop shadow, 'CHIMES at MIDNIGHT' in two lines across the top, about two thirds of the width; 'at' in lower case; credit in italic below. Typeset on top of the painted ceiling.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Color and light: Sepia brown, grey and white; theatrical light on the central man's face and robe.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Story it suggests: A fat knight stands before a king, face to face with his authority.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Visual idea: The staff as a barrier or tension between friendship and royalty.
0830_chimes-at-midnight.jpg.Feels like: 1960s medieval drama, a dramatic painted film poster.

0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.People: Two heads at the bottom, a younger person with dark hair seen from the side lying close to an older white-haired face tilted up with open mouth; above them a faint veiled figure under lace, partly drawn.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Composition: Triangle of lace veil between dark red curtains at the top, with a pair of faces lying horizontally at the bottom; a thin white frame line inside the border; title in the middle.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration in washed magenta, with lace pattern that looks like drawn white ink on dark; thin border.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Typography: Large white serif capitals, widely letter-spaced, stacked in three lines in the center with 'STORY' largest, about two thirds of the width; the director credit sits in a break of the bottom frame line. Typeset, laid on the lace.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Color and light: Dark maroon, plum and pale lilac with white; stage-like soft glow from the top.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Story it suggests: An old man and a young person lie close, while a veiled presence looks down; intimacy mixed with something eerie.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Visual idea: Lace curtain as a shroud over two bodies, like a tale told by a veil.
0831_the-immortal-story.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European literary costume drama, painted in gothic style.

0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.People: Two women, half body to knee: an older woman in a hood and shawl embracing a younger woman who clutches her head, both looking down and sadly; a bare foot shows at the bottom.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Composition: Pair at the center, with a huge flower stem rising from behind them to fill the top; wooden logs form a mirrored X pattern at the lower corners; black background.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film still collaged with a photographed flower and logs, high contrast.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Typography: Thin white serif capitals with wide tracking, centered across the lower middle in three sizes ('THE STORY', small 'of the', 'LAST CHRYSANTHEMUM'), overlapping the women's bodies; small credit at the bottom. Typeset.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Color and light: Black with grey and white highlights; a moody and soft side light.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Story it suggests: Two women hold each other in sorrow, with a wilting flower above as their omen.
0832_the-story-of-the-last-chrysanthemum.Visual idea: Chrysanthemum as a halo or crown above the two women, a symbol of fading beauty.

0833_cat-people.jpg.People: One woman's face, in a large close-up, half in shadow and half in light; one eye is a normal human eye and the other a slit-pupil cat eye in the dark side.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Composition: Face on the left in a diagonal split between lit and unlit halves; dark hair around; title stacked in the right side in tilted lines.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Medium: High-contrast ink and grainy photocollage, with rough black ink texture; printed look.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Typography: Big cream jagged hand-cut capitals with rough edges, 'CAT PEOPLE' stacked and slanted in the upper right, about a third of the width, with credits in the same ragged type below. Hand-lettered, with spiky edges like claws.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and warm cream; harsh half-lit like a single lamp, a sharp contrast.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman is turning into something else, her one eye already like a cat's.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Visual idea: Split face as a human and animal, light and dark.
0833_cat-people.jpg.Feels like: 1940s horror noir, a moody monster film.

0834_blood-simple.jpg.People: One man on all fours on a road, half body, head bowed, lit from behind in a silhouette; a second tall figure holding a shovel stands in the dark background, cut off at the head. A car with two bright headlights sits behind them.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Composition: Large neon title at the top, a credit line in the middle, and a lower scene with the crawling figure at center and two headlights flanking it; the standing figure forms a tall vertical at the right.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Medium: Grainy night film still with glowing neon type; photographic realism.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Typography: Large teal-green neon tube letters in two stacked lines, nearly 80% of the width at the top, with a glow and visible tube joints; small credit in light teal below. Reads as a sign hanging in the dark.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Color and light: Black, teal-green neon and yellow headlights; harsh back-lit night, sodium and neon glow.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Story it suggests: A wounded man crawls along a dark road while another stands over him with a shovel.
0834_blood-simple.jpg.Visual idea: A neon sign sits above the scene as if the title were a bar sign watching the crime.

0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.People: Three young women in the lower half, half-body to three-quarter length, drawn illustrations. One in a pink robe sits at left glancing back over her shoulder, one lies reclined at center looking straight out, one in a cream trench coat stands at right with a blank stare. They cluster on a bed and look detached from one another.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Composition: Pyramid of three figures anchored at the bottom with an ornate wrought-iron headboard behind them at center; the big title stacks in the top half over a repeating wallpaper pattern. Roughly symmetrical about the vertical axis, with the center figure largest and lowest.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Medium: Digital drawing that mimics loose ink linework with flat, slightly translucent color fills and visible sketchy outlines; a handwritten artist signature sits at lower left. Wallpaper is a flat repeated vector pattern.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Typography: Huge high-contrast Didone-style serif title stacked on three lines, filling the top half; 'Valley' and 'Dolls' black, 'of the' in grey, with letters overlapping the pattern. Small caps credit lines sit centered beneath in black; typeset, clean, slightly overlapped by pill shapes behind.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Color and light: Soft beige and tan ground with pink, white, and black accents; flat even light with no strong shadows.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Story it suggests: Three women lounging on a bed in a pill-patterned room suggest glamour tinged with numbness, dependence, and unspoken rivalry.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Visual idea: Wallpaper made of two-tone capsule shapes turns the setting itself into a pill motif, tying the title's 'dolls' to medication and fashion.
0835_valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s melodrama revisited through a contemporary fashion-illustration lens.

0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.People: A crowd of roughly eighteen drawn figures, mostly women with large busts in revealing outfits, plus several men, some cropped at the edges. Faces range from close-ups at the top (one upside down) to half and three-quarter body at the bottom. A caped figure with a headband stands in the center, and a woman at right drags a chain. Figures are crammed together and overlap.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Composition: Dense collage with no empty space; figures fill the frame edge to edge and overlap, with the title weaving among them in a diagonal cascade from top left to lower right. A reclining row of women anchors the bottom while heads cap the top.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Medium: Bold black ink outlines with flat saturated fills and slight paper texture, like underground comic or pulp illustration; swirling psychedelic stripes fill the background.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Typography: Each title word is a different hand-lettered style and color: pink bubble 'Beyond' with red outline, black 'THE', yellow tall 'Valley', pink block 'OF', thin scrawl 'the', white swashed 'Dolls'. Words are large, tilted, stacked and interlock with the figures; credit in yellow block caps.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Color and light: Loud saturated rainbow: yellow, pink, orange, red, purple, green swirls, flat and unshadowed.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Story it suggests: A wild cast of glamorous and grotesque characters crowds into one hallucinatory, sexed-up party.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Visual idea: Overcrowding as excess: the whole cast and every lettering style pile in, mirroring the film's hedonistic overload.
0836_beyond-the-valley-of-the-dolls.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s/early-70s psychedelic exploitation comic, revived in modern illustration.

0837_dekalog.jpg.People: None. There are no figures or faces; only abstract black shapes.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: ten black squares stacked in a cross-like cutout arrangement with thin gaps, centered on the poster, leaving large empty space on both sides. The title sits at the bottom center, small.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Medium: Torn, aged cream paper with fibrous texture and a visible rip line running down the top center; the black squares look like inked or cut paper pieces with rough, matte, slightly mottled texture.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Typography: Small, widely letterspaced serif capitals at the bottom, centered; title in black with a smaller line above it. Quiet, typeset, no interaction with the image beyond sitting beneath it.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Color and light: Warm off-white paper and matte near-black; flat, even, muted light.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Story it suggests: A set of ten blocks assembled into a cross suggests ordered rules, weight, and moral gravity.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Visual idea: Ten squares arranged into a cross-like figure, a modular count that reads as a sign or a tablet of commandments.
0837_dekalog.jpg.Feels like: Austere European arthouse minimalism, late 20th-century graphic design with a handmade collage feel.

0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.People: One small girl, full body, standing alone at center inside a red slit, eyes closed, holding a bloody dagger against her chest. Three tiny winged fairy figures flutter at the edges. The towering tree creature's face, with two huge glowing eyes, is a giant looming presence; it reads as figure-like but is ambiguous (tree or monster).
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Composition: Strict bilateral symmetry: massive twisting roots form a pair of horns and a giant face with two green eyes; a narrow vertical red opening at the center frames the girl (frame within frame). Title in the top third, centered.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Medium: Flat screen-print-like illustration with dense black ink hatching and linework in layered solid color; no photographic content.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Typography: Large widely spaced yellow serif capitals, 'PAN'S' stretched across the width and 'LABYRINTH' beneath, centered, with a thin yellow rule above and small grey italic credit; typeset, sits over the dark roots without distortion.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Color and light: Black and deep green with a single glowing red void and gold lettering; high-contrast, eerie, spot-lit by the red glow.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Story it suggests: A tiny child confronts a vast, ancient, monstrous forest while holding a weapon, suggesting danger and a fairy-tale trial.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Visual idea: The labyrinth as a face: roots form a monstrous head with the girl standing in its mouth-like opening.
0838_pan-s-labyrinth.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary dark-fantasy fairy tale in modern screen-print poster style.

0839_boyhood.jpg.People: A grid of about twenty close-up black-and-white portrait faces: a girl, a woman, a boy and a man, each shown at different ages in successive frames. Faces are straight-on head-and-shoulders and look at the viewer; the same four people repeat down each column. They do not interact.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Composition: Contact-sheet grid of four vertical columns of portrait frames running off the top and bottom edges; a yellow tape label sits slightly off-center across the lower middle, overlapping frames.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic portraits on a black film strip with frame numbers and tiny edge marks; a strip of yellowed masking tape holds a hand-printed title; a red grease-pencil circle is partly visible.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Typography: Title 'BOYHOOD' handwritten in black marker on a strip of masking tape, mid-sized, slightly tilted; credit in tiny sideways white caps repeated along the film edges.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome greys on black with a pale yellow tape accent and a touch of red; soft studio light.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Story it suggests: The same four people photographed over successive frames suggest the passing of years and growing up.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Visual idea: A contact sheet as time-lapse: each column is a person aging frame by frame.
0839_boyhood.jpg.Feels like: Documentary photography archive, a photographer's proof sheet; modern indie film.

0840_the-executioner.jpg.People: One man, half body, centered, facing front, wearing a black hood over his whole head with only his wide eyes visible, and a white jacket; he holds a pink ice cream cone in his hand. The pose is frontal and deadpan.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical central figure on a plain field with a big empty salmon background; the hood forms a tall black triangle at center, the ice cream cone near the bottom center, and the title across the top.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink collage look with a cut-out photographic figure in greyscale, subtle speckled paper grain across the background, and flat black hood shape.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Typography: Bold heavy white sans-serif caps 'EXECUTIONER' spanning the top with a small 'THE' above and a small salmon credit line; large, tight, clean, no distortion.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Color and light: Salmon pink, black, white, pops of yellow cone; flat, graphic light.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Story it suggests: A hooded executioner casually eating ice cream is a darkly comic mismatch of menace and everyday ease.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Visual idea: Pairing a terrifying hood with a sweet treat in the same color as the background creates deadpan absurdity.
0840_the-executioner.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary pop-graphic satire evoking 1960s European black comedy.

0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.People: One standing man with a small child in his arms, seen in silhouette from behind at the center on top of a pile of bodies; a mass of fallen figures fills the lower half.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure on a pyramid of bodies, flanked by fire on the left and a giant wave on the right; a black cloud on the upper left; the title in the upper right.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Medium: Ink and watercolor illustration with brush linework, woodblock-like wave and flat color gradients.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Typography: Bold italic slanted capitals 'LONE WOLF AND CUB' stacked in dark red at the top right, almost tone-on-tone with the red sky, with a small seal-like signature at right; typeset, heavy, in slanted motion.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red sky, black, teal and blue for the bodies, yellow flame; dramatic, stylized glow of fire.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Story it suggests: A warrior carrying a child stands unmoved atop a heap of the dead.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Visual idea: Father and child as calm silhouettes over carnage, with fire and wave framing them.
0841_lone-wolf-and-cub.jpg.Feels like: Samurai manga-style epic, modern illustrated cover in the Hokusai tradition.

0842_dreams.jpg.People: One tiny figure at the bottom center of the painting, standing alone in a flower meadow, seen from behind, dwarfed by the rainbow and storm.
0842_dreams.jpg.Composition: A framed painted picture floats on a white page; a big rainbow arch spans the center symmetrically, with the figure at the bottom below its apex. Below the picture, a black brushed character and title are centered.
0842_dreams.jpg.Medium: Gouache or oil-pastel painting with thick, scrubby brushstrokes, dabs of color, visible paper edges, set against clean white.
0842_dreams.jpg.Typography: A large black calligraphy brush character above a thin light sans title in capitals, about 40 percent of the width, centered. Small italic credit above the title. Calligraphy is hand-painted; the title is typeset, with plenty of empty space around.
0842_dreams.jpg.Color and light: Teal-gray storm, red and yellow rainbow, green and yellow meadow on white; rainy, bright after-storm light.
0842_dreams.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone person stands in a field of flowers under a rainbow after a storm, half in a dream.
0842_dreams.jpg.Visual idea: A painting as a dream or a vision, with the small figure showing scale.
0842_dreams.jpg.Feels like: Naive painterly art-house, late 1980s fantasy anthology.

0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.People: Two people in extreme close-up in profile, a woman's face above leaning down toward a man's face below, noses nearly touching, with cropped hair and ear visible. Faces fill almost the entire poster; they are intimate and tender.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Composition: Diagonal stacking of two profiles with faces filling the frame and cropped by the edges; bright white space only at the right edge; title sits at lower left on a blue light band.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with soft focus, film grain, and heavy colored lens-flare washes of magenta and blue.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Typography: Title 'PUNCH-DRUNK LOVE' in tall condensed white sans-serif caps, mid-sized, left-of-center lower area over a blue glow; actor names above and small credits below in light spaced caps.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Color and light: Saturated violet, blue and magenta glow against blinding white at right; dreamy, diffuse backlit light.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people lean close in a hazy, overwhelming moment of tenderness and uncertainty.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Visual idea: Colored light bleeding across faces turns romance into a dizzy, intoxicated feeling.
0843_punch-drunk-love.jpg.Feels like: Early-2000s indie romance with a dreamlike, light-leak look.

0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.People: A man in a dark coat and scarf in large half-body profile at right, looking down with a grim face and holding a pistol low. Far smaller, a man with a star badge and hat stands in the middle distance, and two women stand in a doorway at left. Scale contrast makes the foreground man dominant and the others watchers.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Composition: Foreground figure cut off at the right edge, creating a diagonal against a deep space of an adobe courtyard receding to the middle; the badge-wearing man sits at the central vanishing point. The title block fills the upper left over sky.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Medium: Painterly rendering that looks like oil or gouache on canvas with soft blended brushwork and slight sheen, like a vintage hand-painted poster.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Typography: Ornate Victorian-style Western display letters in cream, big and stacked over three lines with flourishes and a swash underline; 'One-Eyed' is smaller above huge 'Jacks'; credit in the same decorative face. Hand-lettered look, sits over the sky without being cut off.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Color and light: Warm sunlit ochre and dusty blue sky, deep navy shadows on the foreground figure; soft, late-afternoon painterly light.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Story it suggests: A brooding armed man looks away while a lawman waits in the open, suggesting a coming standoff.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Visual idea: Extreme scale jump between the near, looming gunman and the tiny waiting man creates tension of confrontation.
0844_one-eyed-jacks.jpg.Feels like: Classic 1960s Western, revived as hand-painted period poster art.

0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.People: Four small-to-medium figures on an indoor tennis court: a bearded man in a baseball shirt in half-body view from behind at lower center looking sideways, and three others far off, one boy and two adults, playing. They are separate and distant from one another.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Composition: Bottom-heavy: a photograph at the bottom third with court lines converging, and a vast dark empty field above carrying the text. The big title block is centered in the upper two-thirds.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with muted film-like grain and slight softness, set against a flat dark navy field.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Typography: Very large uneven hand-cut sans-serif title in pale sage, 'SQUID' and 'WHALE' larger than 'The', 'and', 'the', centered; cast names in smaller grey-green caps above and a lowercase credit below. Rough-edged, informal lettering in stacked lines.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy, muddy green court, pale mint lettering; dim, flat, fluorescent-like indoor light.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Story it suggests: Family members share a court but stay apart, hinting at tension and a lopsided rivalry.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Visual idea: A giant title looming over a small court scene, echoing the oversized-versus-small imagery of the title.
0845_the-squid-and-the-whale.jpg.Feels like: Mid-2000s American indie drama with a 1970s-flavored handmade look.

0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.People: One dog's face, extreme close-up, with huge round eyes, a pale stripe over the nose and a big dark nostril filling the lower centre. It is a drawing; no humans.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Composition: The snout fills the whole poster, centre symmetrical, with two eyes at the top corners and the nose at the bottom; the title is at the very bottom. The image is cropped heavily.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Medium: Charcoal and white chalk or ink drawing with dense scribbled hatching and smudges on dark paper.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Typography: Title in large thin, hand-drawn white capitals, wobbly and uneven in height, across the bottom third, with the first 'H' as tall vertical bars, and a small credit below. They look scratched in chalk.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Color and light: Black, charcoal and silver-white grey; dim, grainy, no direct light.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Story it suggests: A dog looks right at us, close and intense.
0846_heart-of-a-dog.jpg.Visual idea: The dog's nose as landscape; the viewer is in its eyeline.

0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.People: One man in dark suit and fedora, full body at left, leaning against a concrete column and glancing sideways; small relative to the poster. A car in the distance has no visible driver.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Composition: Wide perspective with columns marching toward the horizon and converging railroad tracks; the man is tucked at left; the title slants diagonally across the lower right foreground.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with film grain, slightly hazy, overlaid with a flat teal and white lettering.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Typography: Large bold script in teal with white offset outline and shadow, slanted upward at an angle across the lower half, 'The' small, 'Asphalt' and 'Jungle' stacked; credit in small white caps. Dimensional, hand-lettered sign-painter look drawn over the ground.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Color and light: Grey monochrome photo with one accent teal; foggy, flat daylight.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man lurks in a deserted rail yard as a car rolls up, implying a watched, secretive rendezvous.
0847_the-asphalt-jungle.jpg.Visual idea: Diagonal letters on the street surface echo the receding rails, tying the title to the ground itself.

0848_roma.jpg.People: No living people clearly. A stone statue group stands in the center of a fountain, ambiguous and drawn translucently, with tiny shapes along the fountain edge.
0848_roma.jpg.Composition: Centered fountain in a spiral of swirling red-green streaks, with a symmetric avenue of light-bulb arches receding to a skyline; title across the top; strong vertical center axis.
0848_roma.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache or watercolor on paper with visible bleeding, wobbly outlines, and dotted paint marks.
0848_roma.jpg.Typography: Large white serif capitals 'ROMA' widely spaced across the top, with a handwritten script credit above; clean and bold on a dark starry ground.
0848_roma.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with saturated green, red, orange dots and streaks; glowing, festive light.
0848_roma.jpg.Story it suggests: A night city of lights and a swirling fountain suggests a dreamlike, celebratory view of a city.
0848_roma.jpg.Visual idea: The fountain as whirlpool with lights as stars, turning a city into a hallucination.
0848_roma.jpg.Feels like: Naive folk-painted festival art in early-1970s European arthouse style.

0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.People: Two people at half-body: a man in a suit on a candlestick telephone at left, and a woman in a hat seated at a typewriter at right, looking up at him with a sly glance. They are close and relate as sparring partners.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Composition: Diagonal arrangement of two figures at the bottom with giant stacked title above, behind it an office with arched windows and a coat rack; layered desk objects crowd the base.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white pen-and-ink illustration built from halftone dots, hatching and stipple, with no gray tones.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Typography: Huge white three-dimensional block letters with black drop shadows, stacked as 'HIS GIRL FRIDAY', tilted and overlapping, filling the top half; handwritten script credit above, small caps names beside.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white; high contrast with flat graphic light.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Story it suggests: A busy newsroom scene where a man works the phone while a woman beside him looks on knowingly.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Visual idea: Engraving-style linework treats a screwball comedy like a vintage newspaper.
0849_his-girl-friday.jpg.Feels like: 1940s newspaper-comedy art, redrawn in modern woodcut-engraving style.

0850_something-wild.jpg.People: A woman's face in large close-up, tilted, mouth slightly open, held against a tweed shoulder; a man partially visible behind her with wide eyes at upper right, and a dark-clothed arm at left. The embrace feels tense and ambiguous.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Composition: Face fills the upper right with a large diagonal; text column stacked at left; lower right occupied by textured jacket pattern.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain and soft focus.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed sans-serif caps stacked at left, names in grey, 'SOMETHING WILD' large white; mixed sizes and shades; small boxed credit at bottom. Typeset, aligned left, overlaps the dark background.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome greys and white with black shadow; harsh, close, flash-like light.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman caught in someone's grip looks off in alarm or confusion, suggesting a fraught encounter.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Visual idea: Cropped embrace reads as both comfort and threat.
0850_something-wild.jpg.Feels like: Early-1960s American independent drama, raw and gritty.

0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.People: One man seen from behind in a Polaroid-style photo, head and shoulders, wearing a denim jacket with studded letters on the back; tiny relative to the poster and unknown from the front.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Composition: Frame within frame: an ornate gilded picture frame holds a mat and a Polaroid at the exact center against a repeated wallpaper; title on a black block at the bottom center. Strongly symmetric.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Medium: Real photographed objects: carved gilt frame, flocked wallpaper texture, instant-film print; photographic realism with cast shadows.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Typography: Title in bold white sans-serif caps on a black rectangular box with a yellow credit line; centered, clean, modest, set below the frame.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Color and light: Gold, cream and maroon wallpaper with a cool blue photo at the center; soft indoor light with a drop shadow.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Story it suggests: A man with his back turned, framed like a museum piece, hints at isolation inside a decorated, bourgeois world.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Visual idea: A casual snapshot given a grand gilded frame, comparing cheap and precious.
0851_fox-and-his-friends.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European art cinema with domestic, kitsch interiors.

0852_black-girl.jpg.People: One woman in close-up profile-three-quarter, head and shoulders, wearing a white head wrap, a flower earring and layered bead necklaces, gazing off to the left with a serious expression. She is alone and fills much of the lower poster.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Composition: Single large portrait anchored in the lower two-thirds, slightly right of center, with calm empty grey space around her head and title across the top; the wrap sweeps diagonally toward the lower right.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with visible film grain and soft tonal gradation.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Typography: Large dark grey serif capitals 'BLACK GIRL' spanning the full width at the top, with a small white serif credit above; simple typeset text sitting on the flat grey background, the logo mark slightly overlapped by the first letter.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome mid-greys with a bright white wrap; soft, even, diffuse light.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Story it suggests: A composed woman looks away, withholding emotion, suggesting dignity and quiet unease.
0852_black-girl.jpg.Visual idea: The white head wrap and jewelry glow against dark skin and grey ground, making the portrait itself the whole message.

0853_cameraperson.jpg.People: None visible. Only an empty road and tunnels.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Composition: Frame within frame: a dark tunnel mouth forms a round black aperture around a road disappearing through a second smaller tunnel at the center, a strong one-point perspective with the road line leading in. Title at the very bottom, large.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Medium: Video-like photographic still with low-resolution texture, vignetted into black.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Typography: Very large condensed sans-serif capitals 'CAMERAPERSON' in pale grey, spanning most of the width at the bottom; small credit line above. Typeset, plain, set apart from the image in the black field.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Color and light: Black surround with muted greens and greys and rust-brown tunnel wall; dim, overcast daylight.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Story it suggests: A viewpoint travels along a road through successive tunnels, as if looking from behind a lens.
0853_cameraperson.jpg.Visual idea: The tunnel as a camera lens or aperture, the black vignette framing the view.

0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.People: A young boy at center sitting at a table with eyes lowered, half body, and a second figure partly visible at the bottom left in a lace-patterned cap, sleeping or leaning. They are small and dim in the frame.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Composition: Layered frames: a blurred, vignetted still with a window at top, boy at center, candle at lower right, and a second image strip at the bottom; title overlays the lower center.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Medium: Grainy, soft-focus film still, with heavy grain, smudged torn edges, and the look of old, slightly degraded film stock.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Typography: Medium-large rustic hand-cut serif capitals in cream, 'THE TREE OF WOODEN CLOGS' stacked in three lines centered in the lower half, with a small italic credit below; irregular, slightly Gothic letterforms laid over the image.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal-green and black with a cold blue window and warm lamp and candle glints; low, flickering lamp light.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Story it suggests: A child quietly occupies a dim farmhouse room by lamplight, implying a humble, hushed domestic life.
0854_the-tree-of-wooden-clogs.jpg.Visual idea: The image degrades at the edges like a faded memory, with the glowing lamp and candle as warmth.

0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.People: One woman shown only as red lips, hands with green nails, and a dark hair mass, cropped from the nose down; she grips a red telephone handset and its tangled cord. Mostly body parts, stylized, no full face.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Composition: Tightly cropped vertical stack: lips top, hands and phone in the middle, blue dress below, title in the lower right; the red telephone cord loops down and frays at the bottom.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Medium: Flat vector-style graphic illustration with solid ink shapes and crisp edges, and halftone-like polka dots in the background.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Typography: Large flowing white script with bouncing baselines, 'Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown', stacked on four lines in the lower right, with red credit text beneath; hand-lettered, playful, overlapping the red cord.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Color and light: Primary red, blue, black and cream with green nails; flat, pop-art color without shading.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Story it suggests: A woman clutches a phone, anxious and waiting, with the cord unraveling like her nerves.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Visual idea: A frayed phone cord as a visual of nerves coming apart.
0855_women-on-the-verge-of-a-nervous-bre.Feels like: Pop-art 1960s graphic style in a modern comedic-melodrama poster.

0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Composition: A large single blob centered slightly right of middle, with the title overlaid across its middle; empty peach field around; film names in a row at the bottom.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Watercolor or ink bleed with soft feathered edges and visible paper grain.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Large serif title 'The Before Trilogy' in red to near-black, with 'The' in italic, spanning the width mid-poster and overlapping the blob; smaller italic subtitle and a row of three italic titles at the bottom separated by thin vertical bars. Typeset, elegant, color shifts with the paint beneath.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Warm peach ground with yellow, orange and red; soft, glowing sunrise-like light.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A sun-like glow as a single image standing for three connected moments in time.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: A single sun blob whose color changes from yellow to red, suggesting the arc of a day.
0856_the-before-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary watercolor box-set art with a romantic, literary tone.

0857_before-sunrise.jpg.People: Two young people in a tight half-body embrace: a woman with long strawberry-blond hair behind, her hand resting on the man's shoulder, and a man with tousled dark hair in front looking at the viewer. They are close and affectionate.
