0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Composition: Large orange-yellow sun shape at the top, text at upper right, couple at the bottom center in a pyramid-like cluster; plenty of paper-colored space between.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache portrait with visible brushstrokes, speckles, and tinted paper tone; sun is a soft-edged paint blot.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Typography: Medium-large serif title 'Before Sunrise' in red-brown at upper right, with italic credit and cast names; elegant typeset letters overlapping the sun's edge.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream, orange, yellow, with rose and black accents; soft, early-morning glow.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Story it suggests: Two strangers lean together under a rising sun, suggesting a newly born romance.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Visual idea: The sun above the couple marks the dawn of a relationship.
0857_before-sunrise.jpg.Feels like: 1990s romantic drama painted in contemporary illustration style.

0858_before-sunset.jpg.People: A man and a woman in close half-body, heads touching: a man in the center-left with brown hair and stubble looking at the viewer, a woman with blond hair resting her head against his shoulder with eyes lowered. Faces are large and weary, affectionate.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Composition: Couple fills the lower two-thirds, with a large glowing orange disc behind them like a halo; title text at the upper right.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache portrait with scratchy, thin brush lines and a pigment-saturated paper background.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Typography: Large dark red-burgundy serif title 'Before Sunset' at upper right, with italic credit and names; typeset, elegant, sitting on the flat orange field.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange and burnt sienna with soft pink skin tones; warm, late-afternoon glow.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people, older and wearier, lean together as daylight runs out.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Visual idea: The sun disc behind their heads acts as a halo, echoing the dying day.
0858_before-sunset.jpg.Feels like: Mid-2000s romantic drama in watercolor poster style.

0859_before-midnight.jpg.People: A man and a woman in half-body, close together: a woman at lower left with wavy blond hair, eyes closed, smiling broadly; a man behind her at right with tousled brown hair and beard, looking down at her. They are affectionate and relaxed.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Composition: Couple fills the lower half in a diagonal cluster, with a pale moon disc rising behind them and a mottled blue sky above; title and credits at upper right.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache painting on warm paper, visible brushwork and mottled washes in the sky.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Typography: Mid-large serif title 'Before Midnight' in dark slate blue at upper right, with italic credit and names; typeset, elegant, set on the open sky.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Color and light: Cool teal-blue night sky with a pale moon and warm peach skin tones; soft moonlit glow.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple shares a quiet, laughing moment under the moon late at night.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Visual idea: The moon behind the couple completes the sun-and-moon cycle of the series, now cool and calm.
0859_before-midnight.jpg.Feels like: 2010s romantic drama in painterly poster style.

0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.People: One woman in a fur coat, full body, small within the frame, leaning on a pier railing and looking downward with a worried expression, holding a purse. She is alone on a wooden pier at night.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Composition: Diagonal pier railing and deck run across the lower half with a tall street lamp at left; the woman stands right of center; title in the top third and credits at right; empty dark sky.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Medium: Painted or digitally painted illustration with flat color planes, noir-like shadow and soft glows; slightly rough brushy lettering.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Typography: Huge yellow hand-brushed script title in quotation marks, slanted and stacked on two lines across the top; credit text in yellow serif caps and italics. Looks painted, loud against the dark purple.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Color and light: Deep violet and purple with acid yellow lettering; a pale cyan glow from a lone street lamp.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman alone at night on a pier seems to contemplate a desperate decision.
0860_mildred-pierce.jpg.Visual idea: A single glowing lamp and violet night turn the pier into a stage of loneliness.

0861_45-years.jpg.People: None. Only snow and ice forms.
0861_45-years.jpg.Composition: Large expanse of smooth white snow shaped into diagonal planes meeting at a dark crevasse near center, with title in white handwriting at the lower center; names stacked at top center.
0861_45-years.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism: close-up of snow and ice with soft diffuse light and fine texture.
0861_45-years.jpg.Typography: Delicate white handwritten script title '45 Years' in the lower half, thin, slightly slanted and low-contrast against grey-white snow; cast names in widely spaced thin typeset caps at the top and a small credit at the bottom.
0861_45-years.jpg.Color and light: Pale white-grey with a deep emerald-green hollow; cold, soft, overcast light.
0861_45-years.jpg.Story it suggests: A hidden dark crack in a smooth, pristine surface hints at something concealed under a calm exterior.
0861_45-years.jpg.Visual idea: A crevasse in the snow as a metaphor for a hidden rift in something that looks perfect.

0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.People: One huge face of a man, cropped at the eyes, filling the upper half; below, a tiny crowd of silhouetted figures with raised fists and sticks is framed in a white window inside the figure's black clothing. The scale contrast makes the face a looming presence.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Composition: Vertical stacking: giant face on top, a small crowd silhouette in a white slot at the collar, then the title across the black chest at the bottom. Strong central axis, very simplified.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Medium: Rough screen-print or linocut texture with scratchy crayon-like lines, flat solid inks, and speckled edges.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Typography: Big red brush-script 'CANOA' slanted across the lower black area with a smaller 'A Shameful Memory' below; green credit above in bold caps. Hand-painted, rough and aggressive on the black field.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange and red with black and a flat green accent; flat, harsh, poster-paint light.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Story it suggests: A mob rises beneath a stern authority figure's gaze, suggesting violence incited from above.
0862_canoa-a-shameful-memory.jpg.Visual idea: The crowd is placed in a tiny window under the huge face, as if the face is looming over a mob it controls.

0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.People: One face in extreme close-up, tilted and grimacing with a wide-open mouth, huge eyes and thick dark makeup, dominating the whole poster. The cast names are listed, but only one figure appears.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Composition: A diagonal, cropped face filling the lower two-thirds, with the stacked title above overlapping its forehead; a round badge sticker at left; credits stacked at lower right.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Medium: Extremely high-contrast black-and-white photograph with coarse grain, almost halftone-like stipple.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed red sans-serif caps 'MULTIPLE MANIACS' stacked in two lines across the top, cut off by the face and overlapping it; red circular sticker with 'A celluloid atrocity!' in comic-like lettering; cast names in a descending-size block of red caps. Loud, tabloid-like.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Color and light: Stark black, white and signal red; harsh flash-like light.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Story it suggests: A manic, grimacing figure lunges at the viewer in a lurid, shocking display.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Visual idea: A grainy face as a trashy exploitation shock image, overwhelmed by red lettering.
0863_multiple-maniacs.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s underground grindhouse and trash-cinema poster.

0864_being-there.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, full body, in an overcoat and hat, carrying a suitcase and a closed umbrella, floating in the sky above a mansion; small but central.
0864_being-there.jpg.Composition: Strong central vertical axis and one-point symmetry: the man hovers at the center over a snowy avenue lined by bare trees leading to a large mansion at the bottom; title at the top center.
0864_being-there.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with soft airbrushed clouds and fine brushed detail, slightly textured, in the style of a magic-realist painting.
0864_being-there.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized bold geometric sans-serif title 'Being There' in dark blue at the top center, with a small credit line below; clean, typeset, floats over clouds.
0864_being-there.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue and white clouds with rusty brown mansion and dark winter trees; bright, soft daylight.
0864_being-there.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in a plain coat seems to drift above a grand estate, a quiet outsider ascending into a world he doesn't belong to.
0864_being-there.jpg.Visual idea: The man levitates over the mansion, a surreal image of a simple person elevated above everything.
0864_being-there.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s satirical fable with surreal magic-realist art.

0865_blow-up.jpg.People: A small man in blue shirt kneeling or straddling a woman lying on her back, aiming a camera; tiny figures cut-out photo at the bottom center-right. The pose is ambiguous but looks like a photographer shooting from above the body.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Composition: Huge title letters filling nearly the whole poster, tilted slightly and cropped, with the small photo figure placed at the bottom right overlapping the final letters; the scale contrast is the point.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Medium: Flat solid red ink on cream paper for lettering; the small figure is a cut-out color photograph.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Typography: Gigantic tall condensed red capitals 'BLOW-UP' stretched vertically and tilted, occupying almost the whole height, with a smaller distressed serif-less line above; the small image overlaps the letters 'UP'. Stretched, bleeding off the frame feel, very high impact.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red on warm cream with muted natural colors in the photo; flat graphic light.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Story it suggests: A photographer crouches over a motionless woman, hinting at an ambiguous, perhaps sinister scene captured on camera.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Visual idea: The title is literally blown up in scale next to a tiny image, making enlargement the concept.
0865_blow-up.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house graphic design, mod and bold.

0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Composition: Boxed layout: a postage-stamp-like scalloped red border around a black panel, with text filling it top to bottom in stacked lines of alternating sizes.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Medium: Distressed, worn print texture: scratched ink, speckled, with cracked, weathered finish like an old sign or hand-printed ticket.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Typography: Gigantic bold cream block capitals 'BUENA VISTA SOCIAL CLUB' stacked in four lines with teal drop-shadow outlines, interleaved with lines of orange condensed names separated by stars; red handwritten script above. Hand-lettered, dense, fills the whole frame.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Color and light: Black, cream, orange and red with teal accents; flat, warm, vintage-sign look.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Story it suggests: A line-up of performers announced like a billing at a vintage club.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is itself a stamp or old marquee sign, with all the names packed in like a billboard.
0866_buena-vista-social-club.jpg.Feels like: Retro Latin American club signage and ephemera.

0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.People: Two caricatured figures facing each other: a woman at left in a green polka-dot headscarf with closed eyes and red lips, and a man at right in a cap and tweed jacket with a bat behind him, smiling. They look like cut-out paper dolls and are in close face-to-face pose.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Composition: Frame within frame: a wooden window box holds a diorama of a spotlit world map with figures at the sides, mic stand on a crate at lower left, and a golden seal at upper right. Face-to-face symmetry across the center.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Medium: Three-dimensional diorama collage of cut paper, fabric, wood and metal props, photographed, with a gold foil embossed seal and a wooden frame texture.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Typography: Title within a gold embossed circular seal 'WOMAN of the YEAR' in thin light serif capitals, with small 'directed by George Stevens' around its lower rim; metallic, sits at upper right over the map.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Color and light: Warm browns and golds with teal-blue map, green polka dots and pinks; spotlit, theatrical glow.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman of the world and a down-to-earth man meet nose-to-nose, hinting at a battle-of-the-sexes romance.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Visual idea: A tiny stage set where a world map and radio microphones stand for her fame while a bat stands for his world.
0867_woman-of-the-year.jpg.Feels like: 1940s romantic comedy, reinterpreted as tactile mixed-media collage.

0868_tampopo.jpg.People: A giant upside-down lower face (chin, mouth, red lips) fills the top, slurping a noodle; three tiny cartoon figures in white (a cook chopping, a person tumbling through the air, a woman lifting noodles) sit inside a bowl below. Scale is deliberately absurd: a huge mouth against tiny workers.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Composition: Vertical S-curve of a noodle strand runs from the mouth at top center down to the bowl at bottom, cutting the poster in two. A big round bowl rim arcs across the lower half, with the inverted head as a dark dome at the top; chopsticks enter diagonally from the left.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Medium: Gouache-like flat brushwork with visible dry-brush streaks in the noodles and hair, hand-painted illustration with slightly uneven edges.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-lettered cream title across the top third, letters tall, slanted and bouncy, overlapping the dark dome and the blue sky; smaller hand-drawn credit lines in the middle, matching the same casual brush style.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Color and light: Saturated sky blue, cream, yellow noodles, red-orange skin and chopsticks, pale grey bowl; flat bright daylight with no shadows.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Story it suggests: A single mouthful of noodles is treated as an epic, with tiny people laboring inside the bowl to prepare it.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Visual idea: Scale inversion: eating becomes a landscape, the noodle a river connecting the giant mouth and the miniature kitchen world.
0868_tampopo.jpg.Feels like: Playful food comedy, contemporary indie illustration homage to 1980s Japanese pop.

0869_rumble-fish.jpg.People: A teenage boy's head and shoulders, head bowed with eyes lowered, in tank top, large and filling the lower-left; a ghostly double-exposed profile of a head in the clouds looms behind him facing right. The second face is a translucent silhouette, ambiguous between sibling, memory or spirit.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Composition: Diagonal from the lower-left shoulder up to the dark hair at center; the large cloud-profile frames him like a halo behind and to the right. Subject sits center-left, with title on his hair.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic double exposure with film grain, soft cloud texture, rough print-like contrast.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Typography: Small white brush-scrawled title, jagged and rough, set in two stacked lines right on the boy's black hair; small thin serif credit at top in dark grey.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome greys with a deep black hair mass; soft overcast sky light.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Story it suggests: A troubled young man looks down, shadowed by another presence or a version of himself he can't escape.
0869_rumble-fish.jpg.Visual idea: Double exposure of a head over a sky, suggesting a haunting or inner doubling.

0870_othello.jpg.People: Two faces in extreme close-up: a man's half-lit face with one eye staring, emerging from darkness at upper right, and a woman's pale face tilted upward and blurred below him, nearly touching. Their closeness reads as intimacy and menace at once.
0870_othello.jpg.Composition: Diagonal from upper right to lower left across a black field; the two faces stack in the right half while the left half is empty black. Title at the bottom center.
0870_othello.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph, film grain, soft focus on the woman, strong chiaroscuro.
0870_othello.jpg.Typography: Large thin white serif title across the bottom third, tall letters with rough edges like etched type, with a smaller credit beneath; clean and set on black.
0870_othello.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grey; single hard side light carving the man's brow and cheek, soft glow on the woman.
0870_othello.jpg.Story it suggests: A man watches and looms over a sleeping or swooning woman, with love and threat entwined.
0870_othello.jpg.Visual idea: Light and dark faces interlocked, using lighting contrast as a metaphor for opposition.

0871_dheepan.jpg.People: A man seen from behind, large in the lower center, arm stretched toward a window of the building; five tiny hooded figures stand along the roof edge at top. The one in front is a hand-drawn illustration; the roof figures are small and anonymous.
0871_dheepan.jpg.Composition: Grid of repeated red windows fills the middle as a flat facade, a strict horizontal roofline splits grey sky from building, and a diagonal arm line cuts across the grid. Man anchors the bottom, tiny figures at the top, trees frame the sides.
0871_dheepan.jpg.Medium: Ink line drawing with hatching combined with gouache-like painted washes, visible brush streaks in the facade.
0871_dheepan.jpg.Typography: Big bold white sans-serif title across the top over a pale grey sky, wide and heavy, followed by a small italic credit line; clean typeset.
0871_dheepan.jpg.Color and light: Salmon red facade with deep red windows, charcoal and navy figures and trees, pale grey sky; flat overcast light.
0871_dheepan.jpg.Story it suggests: A man faces a looming housing block watched from above by a threatening group.

0896_the-lure.jpg.Composition: Top-down view; tub is a tall vertical rectangle in the center, the figure runs along it with the tail curving at the bottom; a box and a cat picture at upper left, tiled wall and a shower hose at right.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with visible oil-like brushwork, glossy wet highlights and moody realism.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Typography: Yellow hand-lettered brush script title, 'The' small and 'Lure' large with flourishes, set over the tail in the lower half; credit in small caps white below.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal and blue with sickly green; cold, eerie underwater glow.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Story it suggests: Something dangerous and alluring waits in a domestic bathtub.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Visual idea: A mythical creature placed in an ordinary tiled bathroom mixes the fairy tale with the mundane.
0896_the-lure.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary dark fairy-tale horror, Eastern European retro.

0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.People: One figure only as a black silhouette from the waist down: legs in tall boots, with an arm holding a long pistol hanging at the right. No face is shown, and the head is cropped out by the top edge.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Composition: Tall vertical black shape hanging from the top edge and ending at a boot toe pointing at a red rose near the lower right; the left and right are empty white. Title stacked in the bottom third. Strong central vertical with the rose as the single accent.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Medium: Flat solid black ink with torn, rough paper-cut edges, like a linocut or cut-paper silhouette; the rose is a flat red cutout with a stem.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Typography: Title in an ornate, curly old-style serif with swashes, two lines stacked, about 55 percent of the width, black on white; a small lowercase credit with a small-caps name below. The rose stem passes behind the title's top, so type and image touch.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with one red rose; flat, no light or shadow.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Story it suggests: A duelist or soldier stands over a rose, with violence and romance in one image.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Visual idea: A faceless pair of boots and a pistol, with a lone flower as the tender counterpoint.
0897_barry-lyndon.jpg.Feels like: 1970s minimalist silhouette poster for a period piece.

0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.People: A smiling blonde woman's face and shoulders inside a heart-shaped pendant hanging on a cord. The photographic portrait is framed by the metal heart; ambiguous whether a photo within the locket or a window.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis: pendant hanging from the top, centered, against a red curtain; flames lick the right side of the heart; a zigzag floor pattern at the bottom under the title.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Medium: Photographic compositing with a real flame photo, glossy metallic pendant, cinematic look.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Typography: Large italic bold silver-white sans-serif title across the bottom, slanted, with a smaller italic subtitle and credit; metallic gradient finish, set over the curtain and chevron floor.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Color and light: Rich saturated red, orange flame, gold metal, dark blacks; dramatic theatrical light.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Story it suggests: A bright, smiling girl is trapped in a pendant that is about to burn.
0898_twin-peaks-fire-walk-with-me.jpg.Visual idea: A portrait in a locket being consumed by fire suggests a pretty surface with danger beneath.

0899_personal-shopper.jpg.People: One young woman with short dark hair, eyes closed, head bowed, shown from the chest up in a pale blue shirt; she fills the centre and most of the height. Her face is partly dissolved by a blur of light at right, so it is unclear whether she is behind glass or doubled with a ghostly image.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure on a dark ground, with a blurred cream smear and two glowing white flares drifting across the right half; the lower third is left clear for the title.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus, grainy digital or film photograph with glow and bloom, as if shot through frosted glass.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Typography: Title in white thin, widely tracked geometric sans capitals in two stacked lines, centred in the lower third at about 40% width; credit in tiny italic and small caps below. It sits on the blurred shirt without interacting with the face.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Color and light: Near-black, soft blue-grey and cream, with white flares; dim, diffused, glowing light.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman in a quiet, closed-eye moment, haunted by something hovering at her side.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Visual idea: Blur and light flares make her seem half-present, like an apparition.
0899_personal-shopper.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European art-house ghost story, hushed.

0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.People: A single muscular athlete, shown in profile mid-stride or leaping, full body, seen from the side as a sculpted silhouette lit against black. One anonymous figure.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Composition: Centered and symmetric on black; the giant number 100 sits behind the figure, whose body overlaps the zero; stacked text below in a column, with a date at the bottom.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white studio photograph cut out and set on flat black, with flat solid gold type.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Typography: Huge thin gold geometric sans-serif '100' occupying the top half, with 'YEARS OF OLYMPIC FILMS' in large stacked lines below, centered; the athlete overlaps and interlocks with the lettering; small date at the bottom.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Color and light: Black and warm bronze-gold; strong rim light on the body.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Story it suggests: A century of athletes in motion compressed into one runner.
0900_100-years-of-olympic-films-1912-201.Visual idea: The athlete leaping through the numerals, with the zero like a hoop or medal.

0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.People: Two men in half-body profile facing each other in the foreground, one in a suit and tie and one in a robe; between them and behind, a small woman in a white gown stands on a high diving platform with hands on hips. Three figures, a triangle of rivalry and an elevated woman.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical triangle: men at left and right edges facing inward, woman at the center top on a diving tower framed by the pool; script title arcing across the top.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white ink and wash illustration with halftone-style shading, paper grain.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Typography: Large white swashing script title with drop shadow across the top, one big 'O' as a ring around the woman's head; bold sans surname credits at the bottom with small script first names; black heavy 'GEORGE CUKOR' at right.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Color and light: Silvery grey monochrome with strong highlights; soft studio light.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men stare at each other while the woman they care about stands above them, unreachable.
0901_the-philadelphia-story.jpg.Visual idea: The 'O' in the title becomes a halo around the woman on her pedestal.

0902_desert-hearts.jpg.People: Two women, large half-body framing, seen from the chest up side by side in an open convertible; both wear sunglasses and look in different directions, the one on the left turned away and the one on the right gazing ahead with her chin on her hand on the steering wheel. They sit close but do not look at each other.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Composition: Split in two horizontally: the upper half is open sky with the title, the lower third is the car interior with the two figures along the bottom edge. A flat horizon line crosses at about 55 percent height, and a road runs diagonally behind the figures.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with visible grain and a soft, slightly faded color cast; the surface looks like a printed frame from a 35mm film.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Typography: Title is huge, stacked in two lines (DESERT / HEARTS) in a thin, widely spaced white sans-serif that fills almost the full width of the upper half. The letters are semi-transparent and let clouds show through, so they sit in the sky as part of it. A small tracked-out credit line sits below.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue, teal and soft green with white clouds; bright, hazy daylight sun.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women with very different styles travel together down an empty road, with an unspoken distance or curiosity between them.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Visual idea: The title dissolves into the sky so that the wide open landscape and the two figures in a car become the whole mood of the poster.
0902_desert-hearts.jpg.Feels like: Early 1980s American independent road drama, a sun-faded romantic film.

0903_jabberwocky.jpg.People: One small figure, full body and seen from behind, a knight with a sword raised toward a huge creature. The other main figure is a winged monster, not a person.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Composition: Vertical stack: a giant flying dragon at the top, a castle on a rocky hill at the center, and the tiny knight at the lower right, with the title along the bottom. The monster's tail curls around the left side, forming a loose S curve that leads down to the lettering. Scale contrast between creature and knight is the main structure, with blank paper around.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Medium: Detailed pen-and-ink engraving lines with hand-applied watercolor-like color on a crumpled, creased cream paper texture with stains.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Typography: Title in ornate medieval blackletter-style capitals in red and navy, with a huge swirling initial J, about a quarter of the poster width-wise full and sitting right under the image. It is surrounded by flourishes and thin scrolls; the credit line mixes small caps with decorative red initials. Hand-drawn and decorative, overlapping the base of the rocks.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Color and light: Cream paper with deep red, olive-yellow and brown; flat illustrative color with no real light source.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone knight faces a giant monster threatening a distant castle.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Visual idea: A fake old manuscript or storybook page, where the tiny hero and gigantic beast make the scale of the threat obvious.
0903_jabberwocky.jpg.Feels like: Medieval fantasy storybook illustration, a 1970s comic fantasy film.

0904_election.jpg.People: No face; only a single hand and part of a blue-sleeved forearm coming from the bottom right, holding up a cupcake. The hand is large and in extreme close-up.
0904_election.jpg.Composition: Central round object (the cupcake) held up on a diagonal from lower right to center, with title across the top and a big empty yellow field around it. The cupcake overlaps the bottom of the title.
0904_election.jpg.Medium: Glossy studio photograph with sharp, saturated colors and flat solid yellow backdrop; the frosting has shiny highlights.
0904_election.jpg.Typography: The title ELECTION is enormous, bold, italic teal sans-serif spanning the full width at the top, cropped on the left and partly hidden by the cupcake. Smaller teal actor names sit above it, a small director credit to the right. The cupcake carries hand-piped yellow frosting letters PICK FLICK, tilted and uneven, which is the second, playful text built into the image.
0904_election.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow background, teal title, chocolate brown frosting; bright, even studio light.
0904_election.jpg.Story it suggests: A small, sweet gesture offered as a pitch for votes, with an undercurrent of mild pressure.
0904_election.jpg.Visual idea: A school-election slogan written in frosting turns a cupcake into a campaign poster, a sugary and slightly aggressive joke.
0904_election.jpg.Feels like: Late 1990s American teen satire, bright pop comedy.

0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.People: Five young people, half-body to full-body, packed together in a pile and all looking at the camera with serious or sullen expressions. Four are sitting or leaning and one lies on the floor in front, each in a different clothing style.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Composition: Diagonal pyramid of bodies filling most of the poster, with a lying figure forming a long diagonal across the bottom. Large pale empty space above their heads and a thin colored border framing the whole poster.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Medium: Studio photograph in 1980s style with a soft cutout against a smooth gradient backdrop; slightly airbrushed.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Typography: Title in wide-spaced red-brown serif capitals at the bottom, centered and underlined by a thin rule, with a few letters bolder than the others. A small credit line sits below. The text is modest and clearly separate from the group photo.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Color and light: Pale lavender-gray background with navy, denim blue, pink and brown clothing; soft, even studio light.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of very different teenagers stuck together and wary of each other.
0905_the-breakfast-club.jpg.Visual idea: Different types arranged in one tight group portrait, each with a distinct style, as if sorted in a single frame.

0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.People: One man, full body, small and in the lower right corner, crouching on the pavement against a wall with a hat and jacket, holding a bottle and looking up and aside. He is alone.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Composition: Large flat wall dominates the upper two-thirds; a dark granite base band below; the figure is tucked into the bottom right corner, leaving the left and center empty. Strong horizontals from window row, wall and base.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Medium: Naturalistic photographic film still with fine grain and muted color; the graffiti looks hand-sprayed onto the wall.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Typography: The title is huge hand-sprayed black graffiti letters in two lines, uneven and drippy, covering most of the wall; the letters are cut by the wall's panel seams and tile joints, as if painted on the real surface. Small white typeset credits at lower left are quiet and aligned.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Color and light: Gray beige wall, dark maroon and brown stone, red window frames; flat overcast daylight.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Story it suggests: An ordinary man sits outside a building asserting his name as a protest against being ignored.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Visual idea: The title is a piece of street protest scrawled on the institutional wall, with a tiny man beneath as the person behind the name.
0906_i-daniel-blake.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary British social realism, a bleak, politically angry drama.

0907_westfront-1918.jpg.People: One soldier in a helmet, seen from behind and blurred, large in the lower left, crouching in a trench. He is partly out of focus and shown as a dark mass.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Composition: Title block in the upper middle, with a band of barbed-wire posts across the horizon at the middle and the soldier's large shape in the foreground diagonal. A trench edge runs diagonally from the lower right up to the center.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with heavy grain and soft focus, vignetted dark edges.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Typography: Title WESTFRONT 1918 in massive bold white geometric sans-serif capitals, stacked, with the number much larger than the word, centered in the sky. The credit line is a thin hand-lettered white script, tilted slightly, like chalk on the picture.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays from near-black to white; overcast, dim, gloomy daylight.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Story it suggests: A soldier stays low in a trench, watching an empty field of barbed wire before an attack.
0907_westfront-1918.jpg.Visual idea: A big clean title hanging over a bleak battlefield contrasts modern bold type with archival footage.

0908_kameradschaft.jpg.People: Ambiguous: a dark, partly glimpsed face at the top and an inverted gas-mask-like shape or reflection at the lower middle, seen inside what looks like a window or mirror. It is unclear whether they are real people, masks or reflections.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Composition: Fractured into diagonal black slabs and light shards; a tilted shape runs from the lower left to the upper right while the title cuts across on a rising diagonal. Most of the poster is black.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with heavy grain, high contrast and murky deep shadows; looks like a reflection on glass.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Typography: Title in rough, white dry-brush hand-lettered capitals, sloping upward to the right and slightly overlapped by black shapes; some letters are cut or hidden. Small white typeset credit at the bottom center. The brushed lettering feels hurried and tactile.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Color and light: Almost pure black and white with mid-gray; low-key, lit by faint glints.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone in a mask or a distorted reflection appears in the dark, hinting at danger underground.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Visual idea: A broken, mirrored image that blends faces and objects, with slashing letters adding urgency.
0908_kameradschaft.jpg.Feels like: Early 1930s German expressionist-influenced drama, dark and gritty.

0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.People: Three people, half to three-quarter body, huddled in the center: a frightened woman, a man in a white shirt holding a rifle at the front, and an older man behind. Around them reach many large, decayed grasping hands, which belong to unseen figures.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Composition: Title stacked down the upper left, cropped at the top edge; the three people cluster in the lower center, ringed by hands from the right, left and bottom, forming a closing circle. The man's body creates a strong diagonal.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Medium: Painted in gouache or ink-wash style in grayscale, with visible brush texture and white highlights on a flat black ground; looks like illustrated pulp art.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Typography: Title is gigantic, chunky, hand-cut white-gray capitals stacked in four lines on the left, the first line cut off at the top and the letters leaning in jagged, uneven angles; they take up nearly half the poster and the figures overlap the last word.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray and white only; harsh spotlight-like highlights on faces in a dark void.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Story it suggests: A small group of frightened survivors is surrounded by reaching hands in the dark.
0909_night-of-the-living-dead.jpg.Visual idea: Hands closing in from every edge turn the frame itself into the trap, with the oversized title as another wall.

0910_tom-jones.jpg.People: One person drawn, head and shoulders, large close-up, face tilted down with a hand under the chin; the face looks hesitant or musing. It is an ink drawing, not a photo.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Composition: The face sits in the upper center on a white page with a heavy black brush smear on the left; the title sits across the bottom. The loose figure leans slightly diagonally.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Medium: Loose pen-and-ink line drawing with watercolor-like flesh wash and black brush or gouache strokes on white paper, with small spatters and a scanned-sketch feel.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Typography: Title TOM JONES in tall condensed dark gray sans-serif capitals, spanning the full width at the bottom with a gap between the words; the last letters are close to the edge. A small italic and serif credit sits underneath. Clean, typeset, and set apart from the drawing, though the figure's line touches the S.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Color and light: White paper with black, gray and a muted salmon-brown skin tone; no lighting, flat wash.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Story it suggests: A pensive young man appears lost in thought, mischievous or uncertain.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Visual idea: A quick sketch as a portrait, presenting the character as an artist's study rather than a star image.
0910_tom-jones.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century British sketchbook illustration with a 1960s art-school look.

0911_the-hero.jpg.People: A man's face in extreme close-up, cropped to nose, mouth and eyes; and a small inset portrait of a woman with glasses, half body, resting her chin on her hands. The woman sits inside the white shape covering the man's eyes.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Composition: The huge face fills the right and bottom, cut off on the diagonal by a flat teal area at the left. A white sunglasses-shaped cut-out crosses the eyes, containing the title, credit and the small woman, which makes a frame within a frame.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph cut out and pasted onto flat solid teal ink; collage with crisp paper-cut edges.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Typography: Title in quirky hand-drawn teal letters with a looped H and decorative curls, plus a small starburst, placed inside the white glasses shape; the 'A film by' line is small, widely spaced caps beside it. The lettering is playful and fits inside the cut-out.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Color and light: Teal, black, off-white and gray; flat graphic color with soft photographic tones in the face.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Story it suggests: A famous man is hidden behind dark glasses while someone watches him from within his shield.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Visual idea: The sunglasses become a window or mask that holds the title and the woman, a face as a screen.
0911_the-hero.jpg.Feels like: 1960s pop-art collage design, glamorous and playful.

0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.People: Two tiny figures in the middle: a standing man in a dark robe with a round hat held at his side and a figure lying on the ground in a bright red and yellow robe. Both are very small, full-body, far away.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Composition: A horizontal band like a stage or diorama cuts across the middle of the black poster, with a night starry sky above and a black void below; a bare snowy tree on the right balances the figures on the left. The giant title cuts vertically across the band.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Medium: Film-still photography of a staged, painted set with falling snow, combined with a starry sky as flat black with white specks; the lettering is soft, smooth and glowing.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Typography: Title is enormous, spidery, thin white calligraphic strokes that lean and stretch, running vertically from the sky to the bottom of the poster, tapering into blade-like points. It overlaps the scene and is semi-transparent, soft and ghostly, and quite hard to read. Small widely spaced credit at bottom.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray-blue and white with one bright red spot; cold, theatrical night light.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Story it suggests: One man stands over a fallen figure on a snowy stage at night.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Visual idea: Sharp slashing letters cut through a calm tableau, like blades of violence over a stage set.
0912_an-actor-s-revenge.jpg.Feels like: Stylized 1960s theatrical period drama, quiet and cold.

0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.People: None visible; the image is an extreme close-up of a flower with lace laid over it. The names of three actors appear as text only.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Composition: A flower shape fills the whole poster in an irregular silhouette against black corners, with the stamen at the center. The title crosses the lower middle and the three names in a row at the top.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Medium: Macro photograph with a lace pattern overlaid, producing a textured, double-exposed look with soft grain.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Typography: Title in flowing cream script with swashes, centered across the lower middle at about the full width of the poster, sitting over the flower's heart. The three names above are elegant small-caps serif in three columns, and the director credit below is small caps too. All typeset in a refined, formal manner.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Color and light: Amber, gold and rust brown on black; warm, glowing, candle-like light.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Story it suggests: Repressed passion hidden under delicate social surfaces.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Visual idea: A flower covered in lace means desire wrapped in propriety, a delicate and intimate object standing in for the people.
0913_the-age-of-innocence.jpg.Feels like: Early 1990s lavish period romance, a Victorian-style design.

0914_baal.jpg.People: One man's face, huge, filling the entire poster in a frontal close-up with heavy beard and closed eyes, drawn in thick paint strokes. It is a painted portrait with a distorted, battered look.
0914_baal.jpg.Composition: The face is centered and cropped, framed within a black border that holds the text on the right as a vertical band. Dark hair and shoulders frame the head in a symmetrical, frontal way.
0914_baal.jpg.Medium: Expressive painting in gouache or watercolor and ink with wet smears, drips and rough brushwork; a signature is faintly visible at the bottom.
0914_baal.jpg.Typography: Credits are set vertically in yellow sans-serif capitals along the right border, rotated 90 degrees, with the title BAAL in bold at the top. Small, tidy and outside the image, which leaves the painting untouched.
0914_baal.jpg.Color and light: Black, deep teal, ochre, pink and gray-white flesh tones; painted, moody light.
0914_baal.jpg.Story it suggests: A rough, ruined man with closed eyes, a self-destructive or dissolute figure.
0914_baal.jpg.Visual idea: A raw, painted portrait as the character's face and spirit, boxed in like a framed canvas.
0914_baal.jpg.Feels like: German expressionist portrait painting, a 1970s art-house drama.

0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.People: A large, stylized bald face with a small moustache floating in a halo at the upper right, and a naked, slender female figure swinging on a giant musical note at the left, arms and leg stretched up. Both are drawings.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Composition: Two focal points balance diagonally: the face at upper right and the note with the woman rising from lower center to upper left. The title takes the lower right corner in stacked lines. The face is surrounded by concentric halo shapes.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Medium: Flat gouache-style illustration with soft airbrushed gradients and fine ink linework, in the manner of a 1920s-30s print.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Typography: Title block stacked in the lower right in thin art-deco capitals of varied size and color (cream, grey, pale), the name larger than the film title, with small widely spaced lines between. Hand-drawn feel, with letters slightly uneven; it sits on the image and shares its teal.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Color and light: Teal green with red notes and pale cream skin; flat decorative color with a glowing halo.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Story it suggests: A musical spectacle in which a dancer rides a note under the gaze of a calm, smiling bandleader.
0915_king-of-jazz.jpg.Visual idea: Music made visible: a musical note as a swing and a big smiling head as a moon or deity of jazz.

0916_women-in-love.jpg.People: Two nude figures, large and nearly filling the poster, tangled together and seen sideways or upside down, with arms and legs overlapping and hands near the faces. They are painted, and the pair is hard to separate; the orientation is rotated 90 degrees.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Composition: The tangled bodies run on a diagonal across the center, surrounded by a dense, mottled surface of leaves and pooled paint. The title is stacked vertically in three lines over the bodies. No clear horizon.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Medium: Thick oil or encaustic painting with scraped, glossy layers, embedded leaf fragments and a faint signature at the left; looks like a heavily worked painted panel.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Typography: Title WOMEN / IN / LOVE in thin, widely spaced pale pink serif capitals, stacked down the center, each word spread wide and laid right on top of the limbs. Small credit lines in matching serif below. Typeset and delicate, floating over the busy paint.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Color and light: Murky teal, olive green, ochre and flesh pink with orange accents; damp, underwater-like glow.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers are entwined or sinking together in an intimate, almost drowning embrace.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Visual idea: A rotated painted embrace among fallen leaves makes desire feel like nature and decay at once.
0916_women-in-love.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s European art-house sensuality in a contemporary fine-art treatment.

0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.People: A man and a woman, both nearly full body and large, standing side by side; he has crossed arms and a sidelong glance under a top hat, she leans toward him with a coy look. A small dog at the lower left holds a hat in its mouth.
0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Composition: Figures fill the right two-thirds on a slight diagonal, and the title slants up the left side. The dog crouches in the lower left corner, linking the title to the cast names at the bottom. Strong vertical black shapes of clothing.
0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration in a polished grayscale with flat, solid mustard-gold ink behind; smooth shading like a retro airbrushed print.
0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Typography: Title in huge white brush-script letters with drop shadow, slanting steeply upward across the left half and partly cut by the woman's hat; it overlaps the figure's head. 0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Color and light: Mustard gold, black and white; flat graphic color with crisp highlights.
0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Story it suggests: A bickering couple in evening wear play a cat-and-mouse game, with the dog stealing the show.
0917_the-awful-truth.jpg.Visual idea: The pair as stylish comic caricatures, the glance and crossed arms hinting at a playful stand-off.

0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.People: None; only three pomegranates on a cloth. A red stain on the cloth stands in for a body, which is a suggestion rather than a figure.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Composition: Overhead view of a white cloth with a horizontal stain across the lower middle and three fruits in an even row on top of it, with a small separate blot below. The title scrawl sits in the upper half, leaving open white space.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Medium: Photograph of real cloth with a dyed or bled red stain and texture of fabric weave; the title looks like black ink brushed on paper.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Typography: The title and credit are one hand-brushed script in black ink, spidery and uneven, in multiple lines at varied sizes and tilts; letters are thick in places and break apart. It takes up the upper half and is loosely stacked, with the credit line mixed into the title block.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Color and light: Pale gray-white cloth with crimson and magenta; soft, flat daylight from above with short shadows.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Story it suggests: Fruit and a spreading red stain suggest bleeding, something cut open.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Visual idea: The fruit's juice becomes a stain like blood on linen, linking food, color and wound.
0918_the-color-of-pomegranates.jpg.Feels like: Poetic 1960s art-house cinema, a hand-made, folk-craft feel.

0919_dead-man.jpg.People: Two tiny riders on horses, full body, at the bottom: one wears a feathered headdress and fur, the other a dark coat and hat. They are seen at distance in a fern forest, not interacting visibly.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Composition: Giant redwood-like trunks and mist fill the frame vertically; the title block is placed in the upper middle, and the two riders sit at the bottom, very small. Vertical lines everywhere.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with soft grain, mist and layered double-exposure feel.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Typography: DEAD MAN stacked in two lines of huge white dry-brush capitals, jagged and angular, each letter built from rough strokes with streaks; the credit below in the same brushed hand in small size. It floats over the foggy trees and looks painted onto the image.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray from deep black to misty white; diffused light filtered through fog.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Story it suggests: Two riders move quietly through a vast, ominous forest toward something unknown.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Visual idea: Dwarfed travelers and a brushed warning title turn the forest into a threshold between life and death.
0919_dead-man.jpg.Feels like: 1990s black-and-white revisionist western, dreamlike and spare.

0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.People: Several young girls, shown only as long blond hair and backs, blurred and cropped; a hand rests on a head at upper left and another girl's back at the right in an embroidered white blouse. No faces are visible.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Composition: Soft layered figures fill the lower half and sides, and the title is stacked top center over a pale peach field. Heavily cropped and out of focus, with a hazy central empty area.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus photographic film still with scratches, dust and dreamy blur, like a glimpse through a veil or glass.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy cream-white retro serif in two stacked lines, large, upper left of center and clearly legible; a pale pink credit line below in a light sans-serif. The type sits cleanly over the haze.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Color and light: Peach, blush, honey blond and cream; warm, glowing, faded sunlight.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Story it suggests: Sisters huddled together are seen from outside, a closeness that is intimate and unreachable.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Visual idea: Faces withheld, only hair and haze, which makes the girls feel like a memory and a mystery.
0920_the-virgin-suicides.jpg.Feels like: 1970s suburban nostalgia seen through a 1990s indie dreamy lens.

0921_moonrise.jpg.People: One man, large, in side profile from the shoulders up. A rope noose-shaped white cutout runs down his head and neck, which makes the figure ambiguous: a real face split by a graphic gap.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Composition: Head profile faces right and fills the center to lower right; a noose-shaped negative space cuts vertically through the skull; the title is a huge band across the top that the head rises into. Large empty cream background.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Medium: Grainy photographic halftone-like portrait in soft sepia gray, merged with flat cream paper; a cutout or double-exposure effect.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Typography: Title MOONRISE in giant bold gray sans-serif capitals spanning the full width at the top, pale and partly faded or cut off by the head; the logo sits inside the M. The small director credit at the lower right is simple tracked caps. The big pale lettering is almost a background texture.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Color and light: Cream, warm gray and charcoal; soft, muted, low-contrast with dark hair mass.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Story it suggests: A man haunted by a hanging, the noose literally cut out of his head.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Visual idea: The noose as negative space within the profile, a guilt or fate that the head carries.
0921_moonrise.jpg.Feels like: 1940s film noir reimagined as a modern minimal design.

0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.People: Two men: one large in the left foreground, cropped at the face and torso in a red-pink blazer and tie; the other, smaller, in a doorway in the center, holding a small dog. A third large dark shadow of a figure on the wall at the right.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Composition: Layered depth: big foreground man on the left, doorway frame within a frame in the center, a bottle and glass at the lower right, and a giant shadow on the upper right wall. The title is stacked on the upper left.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Medium: Gouache or painted illustration with flat color planes and visible brush marks.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy, slanted yellow condensed sans-serif capitals stacked in three lines at the upper center, tilted slightly with the room's perspective; smaller yellow credits above, cast names in two lines. Large and bold, placed over the blue wall.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Color and light: Saturated blue, yellow, rose pink and orange skin; low sunlight casting hard shadows.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in a doorway holding a puppy faces an imposing man in the foreground, with a shadow looming.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Visual idea: Foreground authority and a small, vulnerable figure in a doorway shown by scale and a looming shadow.
0922_the-other-side-of-hope.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European painted-illustration poster, deadpan, with a hint of 1950s mid-century style.

0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.People: A young woman in a black headscarf, large, shoulders up, staring straight at the camera with a serious expression. In the foreground are two other black-covered figures, cropped and bowed, one with her head bent down; religious icon paintings are visible at the left edge.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Composition: Central face in the upper half with a pyramid of black shapes below; the foreground heads crowd the bottom corners, and the title is centered over the black clothing. Dark mass with a few ornate textured areas at the sides.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still, slightly grainy and naturalistic, muted and soft, with glossy tiles at the right.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Typography: Title BEYOND / THE / HILLS in widely spaced thin white sans-serif capitals stacked in three lines, centered, increasing in size toward the bottom word; small tracked credit lines below. Clean, typeset, and placed on the dark clothing for contrast.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with cool blue-gray, pale skin and brown tile; dim, cold indoor light.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman among a closed community of black-clad figures looks out with quiet intensity.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Visual idea: A single watching face above dark, huddled forms suggests a closed, ritual world.
0923_beyond-the-hills.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European realist drama, austere and religious.

0924_graduation.jpg.People: A man, very large close-up from the chest up, wearing glasses and looking down; behind him at the right, a young woman is seen from the side and back with long wavy hair, cropped and out of focus. They are close but not looking at each other.
0924_graduation.jpg.Composition: The man's head cuts in from the upper left in a large diagonal-edged shape; the girl fills the right edge. Title sits low across the lower left on the man's shirt.
0924_graduation.jpg.Medium: Naturalistic digital film still with soft shallow focus and subtle grain.
0924_graduation.jpg.Typography: Title Graduation in large, heavy, white rounded sans-serif (Helvetica-like), bold, left-aligned at the lower left over the shirt; a smaller credit line below mixes light and bold weights. Plain, flat and modern.
0924_graduation.jpg.Color and light: Muted blue shirt, brown-gray and honey hair; soft, overcast window light.
0924_graduation.jpg.Story it suggests: A worried father and his daughter stand near each other, a tension unsaid.
0924_graduation.jpg.Visual idea: The big weary face beside a blurred daughter shows a parent's burden and distance.

0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.People: Two men, full body, walking side by side in the center: one in a long coat looking down, the other in a cowboy hat and fringed jacket. They are recolored in bright overlays, with the second figure slightly ahead.
0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Composition: Overlapping translucent circles in red, purple, green, teal and pink fill the page like a Venn diagram, with a large pale circle under the figures at the bottom. 0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Medium: Layered collage with halftone-grain photos tinted in flat translucent color and screen-print style overlap, and city signage faintly visible inside circles.
0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Typography: Names in bold red slab serif, title MIDNIGHT COWBOY in a stenciled cream display face that is partly cut by shapes, and the credit line in yellow; all stacked at the top right and overlapping the circles, with some letters tinted or hidden by the overlap.
0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with saturated red, magenta, violet, teal, olive and orange; psychedelic, flat transparent color.
0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Story it suggests: Two mismatched men drift together through a neon city.
0925_midnight-cowboy.jpg.Visual idea: Overlapping color circles act like city lights and a Venn diagram of two lives.

0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.People: One man's face, huge and fragmented into horizontal slices, with a dark cap and dark glasses; the pieces are shifted like torn strips. A street scene sits in the lower part.

0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photocopy or screen-print texture in black ink with rough stippled edges, like a threshold xerox on cream paper.
0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Typography: MANILA in huge, heavy, black blocky letters cut into by street lights and grit, sitting in the black base; the rest of the title in smaller condensed type below. The small credit is slid into a gap between slices. The lettering merges with the photographic dark.
0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Color and light: Black and cream with one red accent from the logo; harsh, glaring, contrasty.
0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in sunglasses is lost in a harsh city whose lights tear him apart.
0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Visual idea: A face sliced and shifted like torn paper, a city and a person broken into strips.
0926_manila-in-the-claws-of-light.jpg.Feels like: 1970s gritty protest-poster, a Xerox print style.

0927_el-sur.jpg.People: One young girl, large, face lit from below in a dark area at the lower center, looking at the camera with an anxious, wide-eyed expression. She emerges from near-black.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Composition: A framed window shape at the top holds a twilight sky and a dark roof peak with a weather vane; below is a vast black mass with the girl at the bottom center. The roof's diagonal edges lead the eye down.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Medium: Film still with fine grain, a rounded window frame with film-edge look, soft low-light photography.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Typography: Title EL SUR in thin black serif capitals at the center of the sky, with a weather vane and bird forming the gap between the words; a faint gray 'A film by' line sits in the black below. Small, quiet, integrated into the sky.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Color and light: Deep black with violet-gray and a pale yellow glow at the horizon; low, dusky, lamp-like light on the face.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Story it suggests: A child sits in the dark, watching or waiting, as night falls over a house.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Visual idea: The title sits on a weather vane, pointing the viewer to the sky while the child stays in darkness.
0927_el-sur.jpg.Feels like: 1980s Spanish art-house drama, quiet and sepia-dusk.

0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.People: None; only a row of bowling pins and their reflection as bullets.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Composition: Symmetric-ish triangle arrangement of white pins at the top center, reflected on a black surface as bullets pointing down; the reflection mirrors across a horizontal line, and a large title is at the bottom.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Medium: Studio photograph with a dark glossy surface and rendered reflection; clean and sharp.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Typography: Title in massive, heavy white sans-serif capitals, tightly packed in two lines at the bottom left, with 'FOR' small and red; the 'A film by' line is red, and the director's name is bold red, set in the same width. Typeset, dense, forceful.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and red with silver; spotlit, dramatic low-key light.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Story it suggests: A game's pins turn into bullets in the reflection, linking play and violence.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Visual idea: A visual pun: pins and bullets are the same shape, mirrored.
0928_bowling-for-columbine.jpg.Feels like: Early 2000s documentary, a bold political-poster design.

0929_female-trouble.jpg.People: One face, large and stylized, with a huge black beehive hairdo, blue eyeshadow flaring up, green eyes and glossy red open lips; the face is cropped to eyes, nose and mouth in a mask-like graphic shape. It is a drawing.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Composition: The big black hair shape fills the top half like a mass, and the face runs down the center on a flat lilac field; text in the upper left and lower right. Strong vertical axis.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Medium: Flat ink illustration with rough brush edges and slightly offset color blocks, like a screen print on colored paper.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Typography: Title in huge hand-brushed red letters stacked in two lines (Female / Trouble) across the black hair, with energetic uneven strokes; 'Starring Divine' in a red script at the lower right. The red lettering is part of the image and sits over the hair.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Color and light: Lilac purple ground, black, hot red and sky blue; flat and loud, no real light.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Story it suggests: A fierce, glamorous woman glares at you with a defiant, mocking grin.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Visual idea: The face reduced to bold graphic shapes like a mask, glamor turned monstrous.
0929_female-trouble.jpg.Feels like: 1970s underground camp, a hand-made trash-glam poster.

0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.People: Two people, half-body, side by side in studio portraits: a man in a pale sweater and tie holding a cigarette at the left, and a woman in a leather flight cap, goggles and jacket at the right. Both look at the camera with a calm, cool gaze.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Composition: Two portraits sit side by side against black, with a soft spotlight on the man and the woman's face; the title is stacked at the lower right over her jacket, with a list of film titles below. Roughly symmetrical pairing.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Medium: Classic black-and-white studio photography with soft focus, glowing highlights and deep shadows.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Typography: Title in tall, thin art-deco copper-brown capitals, stacked and large at the lower right with a swashed S crossing lines; the six film names are listed in smaller tracked caps below. Elegant, typeset, and placed across the woman's dark jacket.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Color and light: Black, silver and white with copper-brown lettering; glamorous, low-key studio light.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Story it suggests: A director and his star pose as partners, one with a cigarette, the other dressed as an aviator.
0930_dietrich-von-sternberg-in-hollywood.Visual idea: A double portrait of creator and muse, joined in one frame.

0931_morocco.jpg.People: One woman, large, half body, wearing a man's tuxedo, bow tie and top hat with a cigarette in her mouth and eyes half closed with a faint smile. She faces the camera calmly.
0931_morocco.jpg.Composition: Centered, frontal, symmetrical portrait with the hat at the top and the white shirt front as a vertical axis; the title spans the bottom across her torso.
0931_morocco.jpg.Medium: Classic black-and-white studio photograph with soft, glowing, silky tones and fine grain.
0931_morocco.jpg.Typography: MOROCCO in huge copper-brown, chunky, rounded decorative capitals (diamond-shaped O's), spanning most of the width at the bottom and overlapping the shirt. A small credit line in matching copper sits below, a mix of small caps and a swashed S. Typeset, display, with a subtle outline.
0931_morocco.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray and white with copper-brown lettering; soft spotlit glamor light from the front.
0931_morocco.jpg.Story it suggests: A confident woman in men's evening dress smokes with a knowing, cool smile.
0931_morocco.jpg.Visual idea: Gender-bending elegance in a single stylish portrait, a star image presented as an icon.

0932_dishonored.jpg.People: One woman in a tight close-up, head and shoulders filling most of the frame, facing the viewer with a direct, level gaze; one hand with a large ring rests on her opposite shoulder.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical portrait with the face in the upper-middle and the hand forming a diagonal toward the lower right; title block sits in the dark band at the bottom, with a narrow label strip along the left edge.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with soft grain and a blurred, hazy backdrop; the sequined garment glitters like halftone dots. The title is flat tan ink over a solid black base.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Typography: Big hand-cut, condensed, slightly uneven capitals across the lower third in a flat copper-tan, with small spaced credit text below in a thinner Art Deco style; the letters are irregular like cut paper and sit on the dark clothing/background without overlapping the face.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with a single copper-brown accent; soft glamour lighting that rims the hair and makes the sequins sparkle.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Story it suggests: A poised, self-possessed woman stares back with guarded confidence, hinting at a glamorous figure holding her secrets.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Visual idea: The icon-portrait: a classic studio glamour shot lets one face and a single warm color carry the whole identity.
0932_dishonored.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood glamour portrait, romantic drama, reissued with restrained modern archival design.

0933_shanghai-express.jpg.People: One woman in close-up from head to chest, face tilted sharply upward, both hands cupped under her chin, one holding a cigarette; the body below dissolves into a dark fur wrap.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Composition: Central vertical axis with the face high in the frame and the hands forming a pyramid below; large dark empty areas to the sides and bottom, title stacked centered in the lower third.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with deep shadows and a soft, slightly foggy glow; fine grain. Title in flat copper ink.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Typography: Two stacked lines of tall, narrow, elegant Art Deco capitals, mid-size and centered in the lower part, in a muted copper-tan; small credit line below. The lettering sits on pure darkness so it stands apart from the photo.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with silvery highlights on the face and hands; a single spotlight from above, with a copper-brown accent in the type.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman gazes upward in a moment of longing or reverie, lit like a vision against the dark.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Visual idea: A face emerging from darkness like a holy or silent-film icon, with the tilted gaze giving the image a yearning look.
0933_shanghai-express.jpg.Feels like: Early-1930s Hollywood romantic melodrama, moody glamour still.

0934_blonde-venus.jpg.People: One woman in tight close-up, shoulders and chest included, facing the viewer with heavy-lidded, half-closed eyes; her cloud of curly pale hair frames the whole top of the poster.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical, centered, a frontal bust portrait; the pale hair mass is a large halo above, the beaded necklace and fur collar form a wide V below, and the title spans the bottom.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white soft-focus photograph with glowing highlights and sparkling glints on beads; slight grain. Title in flat copper ink with outline strokes.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Typography: Large, wide, geometric Art Deco capitals spanning almost the full width at the bottom, drawn as copper outline letters with tall, narrow strokes; the V and N shapes are elongated. Small spaced credit line beneath, right-aligned.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Color and light: Silver and charcoal tones with a bright white halo of hair; diffused, dreamy glamour light, copper accent only in lettering.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman drifts in a haze of sparkle and softness, glamorous but seemingly somewhere else in her mind.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Visual idea: The woman as a luminous idol or goddess, with the halo of hair and glittering jewels turning her into an icon.
0934_blonde-venus.jpg.Feels like: Early-1930s Hollywood glamour romance, Art Deco showgirl era.

0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.People: One woman in a half-body close-up, head tilted and resting on her raised hand holding a cigarette, with her other hand lying on a ledge; a large flower sits in her hair.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Composition: A diagonal tilt of head and arm; a big lace fan or comb arcs behind her head like a halo, and the arms form a triangle toward the bottom right; title crosses the bottom edge.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with rich textures of lace, flowers and fabric, grainy and softly lit; title in flat copper ink.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Typography: Mixed-style title in the bottom band: a swashy script 'The' next to heavy condensed serif capitals 'DEVIL' and 'WOMAN' with a small 'is A' tucked in; copper-tan color, wide-spanning, aligned along the bottom without covering the face.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray with dark black lace; soft frontal light that picks out the face, hands and flower petals against a dark ground.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A languid woman toys with the viewer, her sidelong glance mixing boredom, invitation and mischief.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Visual idea: Ornate frames of lace and flowers around a knowing face, turning seduction into a decorative portrait.
0935_the-devil-is-a-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood exotic romantic drama, theatrical glamour.

0936_bull-durham.jpg.People: Almost none; only a forearm and a clenched hand tied to a bedpost with a cord at the lower right, plus a tiny player figurine on the shelf and a faint group photo in a frame.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Composition: Dense still-life crowding the whole frame: a mantle with candles and a vase in the lower left, a pennant slanting from the upper right, a cap hanging on the wall, and a glove in the upper left; the eye zigzags from pennant to cap to hand.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with visible oil brushwork and canvas texture, slightly soft edges and warm glow.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Typography: Title is painted into the scene as lettering on a white pennant, large and cropped at the top and right; small credit text in a white typeset serif at the middle right. The lettering takes the pennant's perspective and is cut off by the frame.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Color and light: Deep greens, browns and blue with warm orange candlelight; a cozy low light from the flames.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Story it suggests: A room devoted to baseball keepsakes like a shrine, while a tied hand hints at a private, slightly erotic or comic tension.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Visual idea: The cluttered shrine: sports memorabilia and candles set up like an altar, mixing devotion to the game with intimacy.
0936_bull-durham.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American sports comedy-romance, painted like a retro illustrated paperback cover.

0937_dragon-inn.jpg.People: Five or more figures in costume: a swordsman seen from behind with an arm raised, a fierce young person in red in the foreground, an older man with a headband and dagger at left, and two fainter faces at the lower corners; all in dynamic mid-action poses.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Composition: Overlapping layered figures swirling on diagonals, with raised arms and blades crossing the frame; a tall red rectangle in the upper right holds the title, and the bottom left and right corners hold small faded faces.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Medium: Digitally painted illustration with soft shading, pencil-like line work, subtle paper texture and mist washes; the red title block looks like a rubber-stamp or seal print.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Typography: Tall, thin condensed capitals stacked vertically in cream inside a distressed red seal-like rectangle; 'DRAGON INN' is large and the credit lines are small and rotated beside it, with ink-stamp texture.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige haze with strong reds on faces and robes; dramatic dusk-like light and rim glow.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Story it suggests: Fighters circle one another with weapons drawn in a tense stand-off.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Visual idea: A martial-arts melee composed like a calligraphic seal, where the red stamp carries the title while the figures spin around it.
0937_dragon-inn.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Chinese martial-arts adventure, rendered as a contemporary hand-illustrated reissue.

0938_sex-lies-and-videotape.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up, the face large and cropped at the forehead, with her chin resting on the grip of a camera held at lower left; her hand is visible at the bottom.
0938_sex-lies-and-videotape.jpg.Composition: Face off-center to the right and filling most of the frame, with the dark camcorder body crossing diagonally from lower left to center; text sits low on the left over the dark clothing.
0938_sex-lies-and-videotape.jpg.Medium: Image looks like a video or monitor screen with visible scanlines and a pixel/halftone mesh over the whole photo; slightly low-resolution, analog video feel.
0938_sex-lies-and-videotape.jpg.Typography: Lowercase sans-serif title in plain white, medium-large, placed at the lower left with a smaller lowercase credit line beneath; clean and typeset with no distortion, overlaid on the scanline texture.
0938_sex-lies-and-videotape.jpg.Color and light: Muted browns and skin tones with cold blue patches at the left; flat, dim, indoor video-like light.

0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.People: One man seen full-body as a flat graphic figure, lying back and falling or floating with one arm reaching up toward a rose; a single small figure in a vast sky.
0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.Composition: A bold diagonal: a long staircase beam runs from the top right corner toward the lower left where the figure lies in its spotlight; the title stacks at the upper left and credit at mid-right, leaving open sky and cloud shapes around.

0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.Typography: Large chunky slab-like capitals stacked in three lines in the upper left, in pale yellow with a speckled, grainy finish; 'OF' and 'AND' are smaller and one is rotated sideways; credit in mustard gold bold type at right, with small names turned vertical beside it.
0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy to bright cerulean blues with pale yellow beam and a single pink-red rose; night-sky glow with a spotlight from the staircase.
