0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.Visual idea: The staircase to the sky as a light beam, with the falling body hanging between earth and heaven.
0939_a-matter-of-life-and-death.jpg.Feels like: 1940s fantasy romance, reinterpreted as a modern mid-century-styled screenprint illustration.

0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.People: One horseback rider seen from behind at the front, hat and shoulders large, riding away; four other riders with rifles spread across the background, facing him.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Composition: A framed rectangle with a margin of blank paper; the main rider and horse take a strong diagonal from lower left to right, while four riders line up horizontally across the top above a striped sky.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Medium: Black woodcut or linocut print on tan paper, with gouged, directional carved lines for the field, sky and fabric; all flat black ink with no gradients.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Typography: Bold condensed black sans capitals along the bottom: a name above in smaller type, 'THE BALLAD OF' medium and 'GREGORIO CORTEZ' much larger beside it, with a small credit line at the right; typeset, flat, sitting just below the print frame.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Color and light: Two colors only, black ink on warm tan, with strong contrast and no soft light; the vertical sky lines suggest a blazing sun.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone rider is pursued across open land by a line of armed horsemen.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Visual idea: The woodcut folk-print look turns a chase into a ballad or broadside, with carved lines making both land and sky move.
0940_the-ballad-of-gregorio-cortez.jpg.Feels like: Western folk-art, Mexican-American broadside printmaking, a ballad-style poster.

0941_smithereens.jpg.People: One woman's face in tight close-up on the right half, cropped from forehead to chin, mouth open, wearing oversized checkered sunglasses.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Composition: The big face fills the right two-thirds and bleeds off the edge; the title runs vertically along the left against a black field; a red torn-paper strip across the top holds the credit; strong left/right and top/bottom blocking.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photocopy or stencil-like print with black ink and white paper, with torn red paper and ransom-note cut-out letters; rough, DIY collage texture with a yellow checkered pattern.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Typography: Title is rotated vertical and made from mismatched cut-out letters in varied typefaces and sizes, white on black, running up the left side; small typewriter-style credit on the red strip. Broken, collaged letters in a ransom note style.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, hot red-pink and mustard yellow; flat graphic color with no realistic lighting.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Story it suggests: A loud, defiant young woman shouts at the viewer from behind her shades.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Visual idea: Punk fanzine collage: a photocopied face with torn paper and cut-out letters, so the poster itself looks smashed and reassembled.
0941_smithereens.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s to early-1980s punk or new wave zine, DIY downtown style.

0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.People: One woman seen full-body from behind, small in the lower center, walking barefoot toward the horizon; the upper half contains a row of tiny inverted figures along a flipped horizon.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Composition: Mirrored, vertical: the sky and horizon repeat upside-down at the top, creating a symmetrical frame; the walking figure is on the central vertical axis with her long shadow pointing toward the viewer; title floats in the sky at the center.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Medium: Photographic, film-like with soft grain and a dreamy, slightly faded look; the mirrored top half is a flipped copy of the same photograph.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Typography: Wide-tracked small capitals in muted steel blue across the middle of the sky, with a smaller italic line above the name; light, elegant and widely spaced, fading slightly into the clouds on the right.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Color and light: Pale cyan, white and soft peach-pink; low golden sunlight flaring behind the mountains and glowing sky.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman walks alone across a vast white flat toward a distant light, as if between earth and sky.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Visual idea: The inverted sky mirrors the ground, as if the world has a second hidden world on top of it, and a person walks between.
0942_the-tree-of-life.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary art-house drama, a quiet, spiritual, lyrical American film.

0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.People: A dense crowd of many faces and raised fists, with a back-turned man at the center holding up a hand; a few faces shouting at the bottom; waving flags above.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Composition: The title blocks the top third, filling the full width, with the crowd packed in below and the flag pole and banners rising into the letters; a central figure facing away anchors the center.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Medium: Ink or brush-and-spray illustration with high-contrast black blots, splatter and dry-brush streaks on cream paper; looks like a screenprint or stenciled woodcut.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Typography: Huge, tightly packed, condensed bold capitals in red-orange across the top in two lines, cropped at the edges; the crowd and flag poke through and overlap the letters; small thin credit line between the two lines.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Color and light: Red-orange, black and off-white; flat, graphic, with no realistic light.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Story it suggests: A mass of people rallies, shouting and waving flags, with one man standing apart facing them.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Visual idea: Propaganda-poster energy: the title and the crowd are the same weight, as if the crowd is holding up the letters.
0943_memories-of-underdevelopment.jpg.Feels like: 1960s revolutionary political poster, Latin American screenprint style.

0944_cold-water.jpg.People: Two figures, a couple or pair, pressed together face to face in a blurry close-up kiss or embrace; they are indistinct and smeared by motion and light.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Composition: Large black empty area in the upper left; the blurred heads fill the lower right as a glowing diagonal mass; title spreads across the top edge and credit across the bottom.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Medium: Grainy, out-of-focus film frame with heavy noise, light bloom and smeared highlights; looks like a degraded 16mm or video image.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Typography: Wide-spaced thin, slightly irregular capitals in muted beige across the full width at top and bottom, with a gap splitting 'COLD' and 'WATER'; hand-cut, slightly wobbly and edge to edge, partly crossed by the logo.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, amber and black; firelight-like glow in the dark, with warm flares in the corners.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people cling to each other in the dark, lit by a flickering fire, their faces dissolving into each other.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Visual idea: The blur turns intimacy into heat and fire, with faces melting into one glowing shape.
0944_cold-water.jpg.Feels like: 1990s European art-house youth drama, grainy and intimate.

0945_a-raisin-in-the-sun.jpg.People: Two black silhouetted hands, one open with fingers spread and one clenched in a fist, reaching upward toward a bright sun; no faces.

0945_a-raisin-in-the-sun.jpg.Typography: Lowercase hand-lettered title in orange stacked in four lines, with the actor's name above in cream hand-drawn letters; small serif credits in italic and bold capitals; casual, brushy letters aligned in a loose column.

0945_a-raisin-in-the-sun.jpg.Visual idea: The sun as a dream or desire, with hands reaching for it as the central metaphor.
0945_a-raisin-in-the-sun.jpg.Feels like: 1960s American drama poster, mid-century hand-painted illustration.

0946_eight-hours-don-t-make-a-day.jpg.People: A crowd of about ten people in a layered collage: two large smiling faces at the top (a dark-haired man and a curly blonde woman), an older woman with a flowered hat and a bald older man in the middle, and several smaller figures including a bar patron, factory workers and a couple at the bottom.

0946_eight-hours-don-t-make-a-day.jpg.Visual idea: The ensemble portrait: each character is a floating vignette, with the workplace and the pub placed at the base like a foundation.
0946_eight-hours-don-t-make-a-day.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European television drama or family saga, rendered as a retro illustrated poster.

0947_shampoo.jpg.People: Three people in tight close-up, one man at the top with his arm raised and a woman on each side below him, all looking straight at the viewer; the three heads are stacked in a triangle.

0947_shampoo.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands over two women, linked to each other by a gesture at the hair, hinting at a playful triangle.
0947_shampoo.jpg.Visual idea: The comb as a thread connecting three faces, turning a love triangle into a single compact shape.
0947_shampoo.jpg.Feels like: 1970s Hollywood sex comedy, glossy star-driven poster.

0948_the-princess-bride.jpg.People: Two figures, a masked or hooded man and a long-haired woman with a flower crown, facing each other forehead to forehead and holding hands, shown at half-body size.
0948_the-princess-bride.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical arch: two leafy trunks curve up from the base and bend over the top to frame the couple like a doorway, with the title centered at the top inside the frame.

0948_the-princess-bride.jpg.Typography: Medium-sized, narrow Art Nouveau-style capitals in mustard yellow, centered in two stacked lines near the top, with decorative flared letters like S and R; hand-drawn look, set inside the opening of the foliage.

0948_the-princess-bride.jpg.Visual idea: The poster as a storybook binding: the border of trees and vines makes the couple look like an illustration in an old book.
0948_the-princess-bride.jpg.Feels like: Fairytale adventure romance, a Victorian storybook illustration.

0949_a-story-from-chikamatsu.jpg.People: Two figures in a small boat, a standing man at right with a pole and a woman crouching in the boat at left with an elaborate hairstyle; both small relative to the frame.

0949_a-story-from-chikamatsu.jpg.Typography: Light, widely spaced serif capitals in white; 'A STORY' and 'CHIKAMATSU' are large with 'FROM' small and floating between them, so the words are spaced far apart vertically; the big word crosses the man's figure.

0950_some-like-it-hot.jpg.People: Three people: a man in drag playing a saxophone on the left, another in drag with a double bass on the right, and a blonde woman at the bottom center with a ukulele, looking up and laughing.

0950_some-like-it-hot.jpg.Typography: Huge red letters stacked in three lines: 'SOME LIKE IT' in a tilted, hand-cut brush-like style climbing upward and a gigantic geometric 'HOT' spanning the full width, with the O ringing the woman's head; the letters overlap and partly hide the people. Small credit in white at the lower right.

0950_some-like-it-hot.jpg.Story it suggests: A lively comic trio of musicians in costume plays and plots, with a woman glowing at the center.

0951_true-stories.jpg.People: One face, upside-down, filling the center of the poster as a cut-out blob; features are shut-eyed and flattened by the halftone.

0951_true-stories.jpg.Visual idea: Turning the face upside-down makes the familiar uncanny, like an image seen through a screen from the wrong side.
0951_true-stories.jpg.Feels like: 1980s pop-art and new wave graphic design, a quirky American indie.

0952_the-magnificent-ambersons.jpg.People: Four people in two small groups: a man in an overcoat embracing a woman in a dark dress on the right, and a seated man with a woman in a pale gown on the steps at the lower left; all in full or half-body at a small scale.

0952_the-magnificent-ambersons.jpg.Typography: Tall, decorative Victorian-style capitals in cream, stacked in three lines at top center with ornamental cuts in the letters; the director's name is in cream capitals at the bottom, partly fading into the pale paper. 0958_4-months-3-weeks-and-2-days.jpg.Color and light: Muted beige, olive and wood tones with a green sweater and a spot of red from the rose; flat, dim indoor light.
0958_4-months-3-weeks-and-2-days.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman waits in a plain room, anxious and withdrawn, while something intimate and uncomfortable happens just out of view.
0958_4-months-3-weeks-and-2-days.jpg.Visual idea: The cropped knees at the bottom put the viewer in an awkward position, making the waiting room tense.
0958_4-months-3-weeks-and-2-days.jpg.Feels like: Late-2000s realist European drama, grim and austere.

0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.People: Two men in profile and three-quarter close-up facing each other, one bare-headed on the left and one in a peaked cap on the right; a small figure in the diner doorway and another person lying on the ground at the bottom.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Composition: Two huge heads in a tense face-off in the upper half; a roadside diner, car and lamp posts line the middle horizon; a body lies at the bottom edge; title and names run in a band across the lower area.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Medium: Gouache and ink illustration with thick black brush contours, pink highlights and flat, vivid color fields; looks hand-painted with visible brush marks.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Typography: Bold slab-serif capitals in pale cream with a black drop shadow, spanning the full width in a single line; the names above and the credit below are in smaller cream sans-serif; the sign lettering on the diner is also drawn in.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red-orange with hot pink faces and black outlines, plus yellow street-lamp glows; an overheated, feverish night.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men size each other up in a hot night in a small town, with a body on the ground behind them.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Visual idea: The whole poster is overheated: the red ground and glowing lights make heat and tension the real subject.
0959_in-the-heat-of-the-night.jpg.Feels like: 1960s American crime drama, pop-influenced hand-painted style.

0960_la-verite.jpg.People: One woman in a dramatic close-up profile, head turned up and to the right with her mouth slightly open; her pale hair is swept across her face.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Composition: Face and hair occupy the left two-thirds, leaving a black empty field at the right; the title sits at the lower right and the credit above it; the face is cropped at the left edge.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain and deep shadows; red flat ink in the title.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Typography: Big condensed red capitals, 'LA VÉRITÉ', across the lower right corner and bleeding off the edge; small gray condensed credit text above; clean, tall and typeset, set against black.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Color and light: Black and silver with a single vivid red; hard side lighting that cuts half of the face into shadow.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman caught mid-breath in half-light, torn between speaking and silence.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Visual idea: The half-lit face as a split between truth and concealment, with one strong red word as a stamp.
0960_la-verite.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s French drama, a stark black-and-white New Wave style.

0961_shame.jpg.People: Two figures in full-body standing side by side, a woman in a knit cap with arms crossed and a man in a leather jacket and boots, both facing the viewer with grim, tired expressions.
0961_shame.jpg.Composition: Two upright figures centered in the lower two-thirds, with smoke and burning ground behind them; the title crosses the top third and the horizon line of flames sits at their knees; space above for the text.
0961_shame.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film still with thick smoke and fire; a red hand-drawn stroke over the title.
0961_shame.jpg.Typography: Widely letter-spaced dark serif capitals 'S H A M E' across the upper third, with a small spaced credit above; a hand-painted red slash cuts diagonally through the whole word like a strikethrough; the stroke is rough and crayon-like.
0961_shame.jpg.Color and light: Gray, black and white with a single streak of blood red; dim smoky daylight with flames glowing white.
0961_shame.jpg.Story it suggests: Two worn-out people stand in a scorched landscape after something terrible has burned around them.
0961_shame.jpg.Visual idea: The red slash through the title as a mark of censorship or guilt, striking the word out.
0961_shame.jpg.Feels like: 1960s European art-house war drama, bleak and austere.

0962_death-in-venice.jpg.People: One head-and-shoulders bust of a figure with wavy hair, which looks like a sculpture or statue rather than a living person, with eyes closed or blank; the lower torso breaks away into a jagged point.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Composition: A single central bust floating in a black void, symmetrical, with the broken torso tapering down to the title; large empty black space around.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Medium: Painted or rendered image of a weathered statue with verdigris-like texture, streaks and cracks, looking like corroded bronze or stone with watery drips.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Typography: Widely spaced, thin, chiseled serif capitals in pale gray, medium-sized across the lower third, with the bust's pointed base passing through the gap between words; the letters have a worn, stone-like texture; small credit text at the bottom.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with muted teal, gray-green and pale cream; cold, dim light like moonlight on metal.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Story it suggests: A beautiful figure is eroding and dissolving, hinting at decay and fading beauty.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Visual idea: Beauty as a corroding statue, with the broken bust pointing at the title like a drip or a wound.
0962_death-in-venice.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European art-house tragedy, funereal and classical.

0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.People: Two large painted faces dominate the lower half: a man in close-up holding a knife blade near his chin, and a laughing white-haired woman behind his shoulder. Above and left, smaller painted vignettes show a couple dancing in a crowd, two men in a doorway, a trumpet player and a framed oval portrait, so the crowd is collaged in layers.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Composition: A vertical stack: the big man's face and hand sit low and slightly right of center, while smaller scenes pile upward in a tower-like arrangement topped by a bowl of fruit with a flame. A black doorway acts as a frame within a frame near the top center, and birds scatter in the upper right.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Medium: Loose acrylic or gouache painting with visible brushstrokes, thick black ink contour strokes and dry-brush hatching on the faces, over a mottled wash background.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Typography: Title in cream-white serif capitals spanning nearly the full width at the bottom, typeset and slightly flared, with a smaller credit line below in matching caps; it sits over the painted purple-blue ground without distortion.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange, teal, violet and pink washes with dark brown skin tones and black ink; warm, painterly, stylized light.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Story it suggests: A man with a blade is surrounded by memories, music and family scenes, hinting at a menacing presence haunting a household.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Visual idea: A memory collage in which a looming face and a knife dominate a patchwork of community and music scenes.
0963_to-sleep-with-anger.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary hand-painted reissue art evoking a 1990s American drama with a folk and jazz flavor.

0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.People: One man, full body, standing on a porch in a cowboy hat, round glasses, vest with a star badge, holding a revolver and glancing sideways. His long shadow falls on the wall at right.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Composition: Subject sits just left of center in a doorway-like frame formed by a trellis ladder at left and a wooden house wall at right; a diagonal pole slants at the right edge. Lettering runs across the porch floor in the lower third.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with fine grain and soft contrast, like an old film frame.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Typography: Large cream-white wood-type capitals (THE KID BROTHER) painted onto the porch boards, stacked and partly broken by the planks, the man's legs and a shadow; 'starring Harold Lloyd' is smaller, echoing the same floor.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with bright sunlit field behind and soft hazy shadows.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Story it suggests: A bespectacled lawman-looking figure creeps cautiously with a gun, an awkward hero in a tense moment.
0964_the-kid-brother.jpg.Visual idea: The title is lettered onto the ground as if part of the set, merging type with the photograph.

0965_wanda.jpg.People: A woman's face in tight close-up fills the center, looking toward the viewer with a worried expression. A uniformed shoulder with a blue patch intrudes at right and another dark head at upper right; a few blurred bystanders appear at left including one in yellow sunglasses.
0965_wanda.jpg.Composition: Face centered and cropped by the uniform shoulder, which cuts diagonally from the right; a solid pale band holds the title below, giving a photo-above, text-below split.
0965_wanda.jpg.Medium: Grainy 16mm-style color film still, soft focus, noticeable grain and slight blur.
0965_wanda.jpg.Typography: Title WANDA in large heavy dark-gray sans-serif capitals centered in the lower band, with small 'Written and directed by' and a bold name beneath; flat, clean, typeset.
0965_wanda.jpg.Color and light: Washed pastel blues, creamy blonde, faded red and yellow in flat daylight.
0965_wanda.jpg.Story it suggests: A drifting woman caught in a crowd, pressed against an authority figure and visibly anxious.
0965_wanda.jpg.Visual idea: A face squeezed between a shoulder and a crowd, isolation within public space.

0966_detour.jpg.People: A hitchhiking man in full body, rumpled suit and loose tie, holds a suitcase and thumbs a ride; a woman's face in large close-up fills the lower right corner with glaring eyes. Both are pencil-drawn.
0966_detour.jpg.Composition: Strongly diagonal: a tilted road runs through the image with striped black and white bands, a car on a slanted horizon at top, and the title angled along the road. Man at left, woman bottom right, creating a diagonal tension.
0966_detour.jpg.Medium: Graphite pencil crosshatching rendered over flat spot-color yellow and solid black shapes, with a printed paper texture and halftone grit.
0966_detour.jpg.Typography: Huge yellow block capitals DETOUR running on the angle, partly overprinted by black director credit in bold chunky type; a slanted italic tagline at top. The title is cut off and rides the road's perspective.
0966_detour.jpg.Color and light: Stark yellow, black and white with only yellow accents on the eyes, lips and tie; high contrast graphic lighting.
0966_detour.jpg.Story it suggests: A stranded drifter is pulled off course by a dangerous woman, as the tagline hints at a fateful turn.
0966_detour.jpg.Visual idea: The road stripes become the title and the layout, so the poster itself is a diversion.
0966_detour.jpg.Feels like: Retro noir pulp revival, 1940s B-movie with modern graphic design.

0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.People: About ten young people in a tight crowd, half-body and close-up faces screaming, shocked or ecstatic, with hands raised; a girl holds a camera and another reaches out with red gloves. Some are overlapping and partially cut off.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Composition: Densely packed, faces arranged in a pyramid with large figures in the bottom center and a banner across the top; a horizontal barrier strip reading do not pass runs along the bottom.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Medium: Highly detailed colored pencil or airbrushed illustration with smooth realistic rendering, drawn caricature-like features.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered black marker title on a white banner held by the crowd, spanning the top width and partly hidden behind heads; small hand-written 'Steven Spielberg presents' above, grey stenciled barrier text at bottom.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Color and light: Black background with bright red lips, gloves and pink details, blue sweaters and warm skin tones.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Story it suggests: A frenzied crowd of fans pressing against a barrier in hysterical excitement.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Visual idea: The crowd forms a wall of faces, the title literally held up as a fan banner.
0967_i-wanna-hold-your-hand.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s teen comedy rendered as nostalgic illustration.

0968_japon.jpg.People: One figure, a black silhouette seen from behind in a hat with a walking stick, standing in a valley, outlined with a glowing multicolor line. Tiny relative to the landscape but large at the frame's lower center.
0968_japon.jpg.Composition: Central vertical silhouette framed by dark rocky foreground slopes on both sides, leading into layered green mountains receding to a cream sky; title block at top in symmetric arrangement.
0968_japon.jpg.Medium: Flat digital vector illustration with soft gradients and cut-paper-like layering.
0968_japon.jpg.Typography: JAPON in heavy rounded black display capitals, centered high and wide, with a small blue-purple script credit below; typeset with a retro 1970s feel.
0968_japon.jpg.Color and light: Greens and teals with pops of colorful flowers against cream; soft misty glow.
0968_japon.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone traveler gazes over a vast, flowering valley, contemplating the journey ahead.
0968_japon.jpg.Visual idea: A neon outline makes the walker both a hole in the landscape and a glowing presence.
0968_japon.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary retro-modern travel poster, folk-art and 1970s-inflected.

0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.People: Two running figures in dark coats at lower left and right, mid-stride; above them a row of armed men in caps stand among trees, one aiming a rifle. Figures are rough drawn silhouettes.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Composition: Split top and bottom: dark vertical tree trunks and hunters on top, pale snowy ground with two runners and branching white twigs below. Vertical strips make a fractured panel look, title between runners in the center.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Medium: Gritty ink, charcoal and collage with torn paper layers, scratchy brush marks and rough textures.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Typography: Hand-brushed black title in jagged, tilted capitals, centered between the runners, with smaller handwritten director credit below; it feels spontaneous and sits directly on the image.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome blacks, grays and warm beige-cream; stark winter light.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Story it suggests: Two fugitives flee through snowy woods while armed men close in.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Visual idea: The white twigs and vertical strips splinter the image like shards, evoking panic and fragmentation.
0969_diamonds-of-the-night.jpg.Feels like: Eastern European art-house war drama of the 1960s, rendered as expressive print.

0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.People: One man, full body, bent forward in a leaning, grinning pose pointing at a TV monitor that shows his own image; he is drawn at about a third of the poster's height. The screen repeats his face as a smaller reflection.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Composition: Cream empty space at left and top, with the man on the left and a tall TV camera on a stand on the right forming a vertical mass; a boom microphone cuts diagonally from the top. A grey brushed rectangle sits behind the equipment.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Medium: Loose charcoal or gouache-like illustration in grayscale with rough dry-brush edges and flat spot red and blue accents, over a paper-like cream ground.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Typography: Playful hand-cut, mismatched letterforms in red, navy and light blue, stacked on three lines at upper left with a lowercase 'a' and varying sizes and heights, like cut-out type; credits in small red condensed caps at the bottom.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Color and light: Gray tones on cream with red, navy and sky blue accents, flat and matte.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Story it suggests: A performer is delighted by his own image on a monitor under an ON AIR sign, suggesting fame feeding on itself.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Visual idea: A person and his duplicate on screen, the studio equipment towering over him like an idol.
0970_a-face-in-the-crowd.jpg.Feels like: Late-1950s American media satire with a mid-century illustrated look.

0971_police-story.jpg.People: A man in green overalls swings full body from a red umbrella hooked on a double-decker bus, grimacing; a bald man in sunglasses and a gray suit leans out of a bus window aiming a pistol, and a small figure peeks from a car at the bottom.
0971_police-story.jpg.Composition: Dynamic diagonal: the hanging man runs from upper right to lower left across a bright sky, with the green bus filling the right edge and a street lamp as a vertical line behind. Title is tilted, tucked into the left.
0971_police-story.jpg.Medium: Polished digital painting with smooth gradients and realistic shading, almost airbrushed.
0971_police-story.jpg.Typography: Heavy red condensed capitals stacked on two lines, tilted upward at the angle of the action, large (about a fifth of the poster) over the sky and partly overlapped by the man's body; small white credit above.
0971_police-story.jpg.Color and light: Vivid blue sky and clouds, green hills, green and lemon-yellow bus, with a red accent; bright daylight.
0971_police-story.jpg.Story it suggests: A hero dangles perilously from a moving bus while a gunman targets him.
0971_police-story.jpg.Visual idea: The body and the title share the same slant, as if the title were thrown into the stunt.
0971_police-story.jpg.Feels like: 1980s action-comedy poster painting, updated with modern polish.

0972_police-story-2.jpg.People: A man in a cream jacket vaults a railing in the foreground, full-body and frozen mid-jump, with a small flame at his back; a second man far above holds a blue barrel overhead, and a third barrel is falling near the top.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonals from staircase railings and beams slanting across the frame; the main figure sits left of center, with a large flying barrel top right and fireworks bursting below.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Medium: Smooth, highly rendered digital painting with realistic shading and glowing spark effects.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Typography: Bold red condensed capitals stacked on two lines with a big '2' at right, tilted along the stairs and partly hidden behind the barrel and figure; small 'Jackie Chan' above is clipped by the barrel.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Color and light: Dim olive-gray industrial interior with saturated blue barrels, red type and multicolored firework sparks below; dramatic artificial light.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Story it suggests: A man dodges falling barrels and flames in a precarious stair-and-railing chase.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Visual idea: A freeze-frame of mid-air action in which the title and numeral dive with the hero.
0972_police-story-2.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s Hong Kong action movie poster.

0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.People: One woman in close-up, face and bust turned back over her shoulder looking at the viewer with wind-whipped red-brown hair; she fills the lower two-thirds.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Composition: A split: handwriting fills the top third on a pale sky-blue field, while the head occupies the bottom center; her gaze is offset slightly left. A script credit runs along the bottom edge.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Medium: Soft-grain color photograph, with hand-written script lettering overlaid like ink on a letter.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Typography: A full paragraph of white cursive handwriting across the top, in a letter-like voice, with the film's title picked out in dark red ink within the text; 'A film by' credit is also white script at the bottom. Handwritten and informal, mixing text and image.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue, russet hair, tan earth; soft natural overcast light.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Story it suggests: A determined, unconventional young woman announces her own story in her own words.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is a personal letter; the title is embedded in a sentence, so voice precedes image.
0973_my-brilliant-career.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s period drama with a literary, confessional tone.

0974_the-heiress.jpg.People: One woman's portrait, head and shoulders in profile three-quarter, looking up and away with a faint smile, wearing a pearl necklace and drop earrings; the figure is embroidered.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Composition: A circular embroidery hoop with a brass screw at top is centered on a pale linen field, the portrait filling the circle; title placed beneath.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Medium: Hand embroidery with thick visible thread stitches in gray, white and black on fabric inside a wooden hoop; a woven linen background.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Typography: Title in wide-tracked serif capitals in dark blue, THE small above and HEIRESS spread across the full width at the bottom, partly cropped at the edges; 'William Wyler's' is embroidered in script within the portrait.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome blacks and silvery whites with navy flecks inside a warm copper-brown hoop on off-white; soft even light.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Story it suggests: A poised woman's face, hopeful yet guarded, suggests a stitched, constrained domestic life.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Visual idea: A portrait stitched in a sewing hoop to evoke domestic craft and confinement.
0974_the-heiress.jpg.Feels like: Handmade, craft-based reissue art for a 1940s period melodrama.

0975_funny-games.jpg.People: One figure with a head covered by a pale knitted mask or sock, close-up and facing the camera; the face is blank, the shoulders in blue striped clothing barely visible at the bottom.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetrical, with the masked head filling most of the frame and the title laid over the head's center; blurred domestic background.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Medium: Grainy, slightly soft color film still with photographic realism.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Typography: Huge bold red sans-serif capitals FUNNY GAMES in two stacked lines spanning almost the full width, directly covering the mask; red director credit at the bottom, in the same condensed face. Flat, typeset, aggressive.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Color and light: Muted beige-gray and brown with a saturated red title; flat interior light.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Story it suggests: An anonymous, faceless person confronts the viewer, implying menace in an ordinary room.
0975_funny-games.jpg.Visual idea: A blank face covered by loud text, a mocking, expressionless mask.

0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.People: One woman in close-up, face and shoulders, in a dark glossy leather jacket, smiling slightly and looking right at the viewer.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Composition: The face sits right of center filling the frame, with the left third a blurred golden background; the title runs down the left over the jacket and a credit sits at the bottom right.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus photographic color film still with shallow depth of field.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Typography: Thin, elegant light sans-serif capitals stacked vertically (LET / THE / SUNSHINE / IN), in cream, large and spanning most of the height; 'Juliette Binoche' above in a lighter weight; credit in the same thin face at the bottom. Typeset and delicate.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber, honey and brown with soft glowing light.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman's warm, open, slightly wry gaze suggests a search for connection.
0976_let-the-sunshine-in.jpg.Visual idea: The title spells a literal invitation as it drops down the portrait like light.

0977_blue-velvet.jpg.People: None; the surface is only fabric-like texture.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Composition: A full-bleed field of crumpled dark fabric with no focal object; the title sits in the center as the only anchor, a quiet and symmetric layout.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Medium: Photographic close-up of crushed velvet, with glowing highlights and soft film grain.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Typography: Elegant white swash-script title with long looping flourishes underlined and overlined, about a third of the poster width, centered; a small spaced serif credit 'David Lynch's' sits above. Typeset, classic, floating over the texture.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Color and light: Deep indigo and electric blue against near-black, with glimmering highlights on the folds.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Story it suggests: Nothing is shown, only a sensuous, dark surface, hinting at something hidden under a smooth skin.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Visual idea: A single luxurious material stands in for the whole film; the title is a whisper over cloth.
0977_blue-velvet.jpg.Feels like: Moody 1980s erotic mystery, refined and minimal.

0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.People: Two women's heads floating in a cloud: one in front with curly orange hair smiling and facing the viewer, another behind in profile and more ghostly, facing right. They mirror each other as paired portraits.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Composition: The two heads form a diagonal overlapping pair at the center, with a pink cloud banner above holding the credit and a rainbow arc below left; a blue border frames the whole poster.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Medium: Soft airbrushed gradient illustration blended with photographic faces, slightly grainy, with a vintage print feel.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered lowercase script in purple, stacked in two lines at the bottom, slanting and slightly bouncy; the credit in matching handwriting on the cloud above. Casual and warm.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Color and light: Pastel pink, peach, lavender and sky blue with a bright rainbow; dreamy, diffuse light.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women bound together yet different, drifting side by side in a daydream.
0978_one-sings-the-other-doesn-t.jpg.Visual idea: A doubled portrait in the sky, two sides of one friendship rendered like a postcard from the clouds.

0979_swing-time.jpg.People: A man and a woman, full body, dancing together mid-step, both smiling, her skirt swirling and his leg kicked back; they fill the center and are large relative to the frame.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Composition: Two dancers on a diagonal rhythm against a blurred ballroom with curved bands; names across the top and a musical staff swirling around the title crossing over their bodies in a banner.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with fine grain, overlaid with flat gold-tan graphic lettering and line ornaments.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Typography: A mix: thin outlined art-deco capitals for the stars' names in cream with gold script first names above, and a wavy gold block title SWING TIME with white squiggles, set on a curving musical staff with notes; the title overlaps the dancers and bends along a swoosh. Decorative, typeset.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with warm bronze-gold lettering; glamorous soft studio light.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Story it suggests: A joyful, effortless dance between two partners in perfect sync.
0979_swing-time.jpg.Visual idea: The title is a musical staff that dances with the pair.

0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.People: One man, half-body and shirtless, hands behind his back and head slightly bowed, shown in a rough drawn style and filling the poster. Ambiguous as an image because it is painted/printed in smears, with the face scribbled over.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Composition: Figure centered and large with white empty space at the margins; title in a row across the upper area at the figure's neck level, split by his head.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Medium: Smeared crayon, oil-pastel and monoprint-like texture with scratched and smudged marks, red outline drawn on top of a rough photo.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Typography: Small, widely spaced olive-green capitals 'LA VIE / DE JÉSUS' split on either side of the head, with a small credit below left; thin and typewritten-looking, subordinate to the figure.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Color and light: Raw red, olive green and white with charcoal smudges; flat, no light direction.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Story it suggests: A bare-chested young man stands bruised, withdrawn and exposed.
0980_la-vie-de-jesus.jpg.Visual idea: The body rendered in blood-red smears evokes wounds and raw flesh.

0981_l-humanite.jpg.People: One tiny figure running at the upper right on the horizon, far smaller than the landscape; trees at the top left are drawn as dark smudges.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Composition: A huge empty field filling nearly the whole poster, with a thin horizon strip at the top holding trees, sky and the runner; the title sits right of center in the middle of the field. Strong negative space.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Medium: Mottled painted or monoprint texture with scratchy lines, smudges and crayon-like strokes on a fibrous surface.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Typography: Small, wide-tracked typewriter-style capitals in off-white (L'HUMANITÉ) and a small credit, placed to the right of center; modest compared to the field, typed look.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Color and light: Muddy olive, mustard and brown ground with a thin band of turquoise, orange and dark sky at the top; dull, overcast light.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone person runs across an empty land under a heavy sky, as if fleeing or searching.
0981_l-humanite.jpg.Visual idea: The enormous field dwarfs the runner, emphasizing isolation and the size of the earth.

0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.People: One performer, half body, hand on hip, large blond hair with a huge yellow-black fan or crown behind the head, wearing dramatic eye makeup, red lips, a mesh scarf, a yellow crop top with painted words and zebra pants; striking a defiant pose looking down.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Composition: The figure occupies the right two-thirds on a diagonal tilt, while the title stacks vertically along the left edge in jagged letters; the crown shape arcs out of the top.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Medium: Hand-colored photocopy or screen-print look with grainy halftone, crayon and marker lines, rough scribbled edges on flat red.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Typography: Huge black hand-drawn jagged capitals stacked vertically down the left (HED WIG / AND THE ANGRY INCH), spiky and uneven, with the C logo in yellow; credits in the same scrawl. Raw and punk.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink-red field, yellow and black, with warm skin tones; flat, graphic, high contrast.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Story it suggests: A glam punk performer stands defiantly, showing off and daring the viewer.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Visual idea: A gig flyer aesthetic, title and body both scrawled like fanzine art.
0982_hedwig-and-the-angry-inch.jpg.Feels like: Early-2000s glam-punk rock musical, DIY zine.

0983_war-and-peace.jpg.People: Two foregrounds dancing couples at the top, one in uniform with a woman in a pink gown, another smaller couple below; beneath them a violent melee of about ten soldiers in blue and gray with bayonets and a flag, some fallen; a ghostly mounted figure sits at right. Large, layered crowd.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Composition: Two tiers: elegant waltz above, battle chaos below, separated by a smoky cloud band; the title is stacked at the top right and the diagonal bayonet lines lead to the lower right flag.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Medium: Colored pencil and pastel drawing with chalky smudges, soft gradients and line work, on warm paper.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Typography: Large heavy gray-blue condensed capitals stacked at the top right (WAR / AND / PEACE), running down along the edge and overlapping the dancers' hands; a small credit below. Typeset, bold.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Color and light: Cream ground with dusty blue, rose, red and gray; soft diffuse light.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Story it suggests: Romance and ballrooms coexist with soldiers fighting and dying beneath them.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Visual idea: The poster splits into stacked halves, dancing above and dying below, a visual war-and-peace contrast.
0983_war-and-peace.jpg.Feels like: Epic period drama, illustrated in the manner of a 1960s big-budget film.

0984_1984.jpg.People: Two giant stylized faces whose staring eyes appear above, mostly hidden by lettering; below, two crossed forearms with raised fists form an X, and a tiny crowd of dark figures with raised arms packs the bottom edge. The faces are poster-style drawings, not real figures.
0984_1984.jpg.Composition: Strong symmetry: a large X made by crossed arms in the center, eyes in a mirrored pair above it, a huge numeric title across the top; the crowd silhouettes line the base like a skyline.
0984_1984.jpg.Medium: Screen-printed propaganda poster look: flat inks, rough edges, creases and torn, pasted-up paper texture with peeling edges.
0984_1984.jpg.Typography: Massive black blocky numerals '1984' with a cream outline, filling the entire top third and cropped at the edges, with a small label strip 'a film by' and a cream box reading INGSOC; angular, stencil-like, typeset in a constructivist style.
0984_1984.jpg.Color and light: Red, black and cream with muted olive-gray; harsh flat poster color.
0984_1984.jpg.Story it suggests: A watching authority looms above a crowd while a defiant crossed-arms gesture signals both unity and control.
0984_1984.jpg.Visual idea: A wheat-pasted state propaganda poster, with the all-seeing eyes and X-crossed arms as emblem.

0985_europa-europa.jpg.People: One boy, full body, standing barefoot and head bowed with hands clasped, wearing a long dark coat over bare skin with a red-and-white armband; he is centered and about two-thirds of the poster's height. He is painted, not photographed.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical figure against a dark wall with a white bathtub intruding at lower left; the title stacked above, directly over the boy's head, with the second line mirrored and a yellow star placed where a letter would be.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Medium: Painted with oil-like texture, matte brush marks and a dark glazed background.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-lettered capitals: EUROPA in red on top, and the second EUROPA flipped upside down and mirrored in white, a yellow six-pointed star replacing the O; rough chalky edges. Credit at lower right in red caps. The mirrored line makes the title double.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Color and light: Deep maroon and black with red, white and a single yellow star; dim, low, muted light.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Story it suggests: A vulnerable, undressed boy wears a symbol that may not be his own, hiding in plain sight.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Visual idea: A reversed duplicate title reflects a double identity, with the star and the armband as opposing badges.
0985_europa-europa.jpg.Feels like: Somber European historical drama, late 20th century, painterly.

0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.People: One man, waist-up, in a white cap and apron under a dark jacket, a cigarette in his mouth and heavy-lidded eyes, standing at the right; he fills the right half. A black cat walks across a counter at left.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Composition: Man placed right, shop shelves of bread at left, the cat low at lower left, and the title stacked at the top left in huge letters with a signature at the bottom.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Medium: Ink and gouache or watercolor with visible brush outlines, flat washes and paper texture.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-lettered cream capitals with golden-brown outline (THE BAKER'S WIFE), stacked on two lines at the top, filling the width and partly behind the man's cap; a handwritten black signature at the lower left. Casual, hand-painted.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Color and light: Warm ochre, tan and cream with black and brown accents; soft matte, diffuse.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Story it suggests: A weary baker looks sidelong at something with a wry, knowing expression while a stray cat wanders his shop.
0986_the-baker-s-wife.jpg.Visual idea: A cozy shopfront portrait whose cat adds a hint of mischief; the handmade title feels like a shop sign.

0987_klute.jpg.People: Two sets of faces cropped into a grid: a woman's eyes, noses and lips repeated in about ten squares on the left, and a man's face fragments in a few squares at right; no full bodies.
0987_klute.jpg.Composition: A mosaic of square tiles with gaps, packed on the left and thinning out into the black right side, with names stacked at the top right and the title lower right; reads like a surveillance contact sheet.
0987_klute.jpg.Medium: Halftone-grain black-and-white photographs tinted into flat single-color duotones, arranged in a grid like a collage.
0987_klute.jpg.Typography: Large rounded white lowercase sans-serif names (jane fonda / donald sutherland) stacked at upper right in a 1970s style, with a small credit line and bold lowercase title 'klute' in quotes below; typeset, heavy and tight.
0987_klute.jpg.Color and light: Red, orange, yellow, olive and green duotone tiles on a black background; flat graphic light.
0987_klute.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman is watched, her face cut into fragments, while a man's gaze looks on from the other side.
0987_klute.jpg.Visual idea: Faces chopped into tiles, a voyeuristic mosaic of eyes and lips.

0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.People: None visible; the scene is a landscape with tiny town buildings only.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Composition: Aerial view across a turquoise sea with a small wooded island with a red torii gate at the center, a town and dark hills along the top, and a black pine branch curving across the bottom right; the title runs vertically in stacked words through the image.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Medium: Flat digital or collage-like illustration with textured paper-cut shapes and speckled water pattern.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Typography: Huge thin white sans-serif capitals (THE / INLAND / SEA) spread in broad lines across the whole poster, overlapping the sea and the island; delicate, translucent, tracking wide; small credit text lower left.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Color and light: Saturated aqua and cyan with dark teal hills, a splash of red at the gate; bright, clear daylight.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Story it suggests: A calm, remote island set in a vast sea hints at quiet travel or solitude.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Visual idea: The thin title floats like light on water, tying type and sea together.
0988_the-inland-sea.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary Japanese-inspired travel illustration with quiet art-house tone.

0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.People: Two small figures, a woman in a patterned kimono and a man in a suit, seated at a low table eating from bowls and facing each other in profile; they sit in the lower right and are small.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Composition: A dark interior seen through a frame of vertical thin branches and sliding screen grids; a glowing orange lintel and doorway leads the eye to the couple at lower right, with the title at top right.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Medium: Flat, gouache-like digital illustration with soft textured shapes and layered silhouettes.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Typography: Light, rounded sans-serif in coral and cream, right-aligned at the top over the dark area; small, quiet, typeset and two lines.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Color and light: Dark brown, black and plum with glowing coral and peach where lamplight hits; warm lamp-lit dusk.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Story it suggests: A quiet intimate meal between two people in a dim house, seen from outside.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Visual idea: A voyeuristic glimpse of domestic life through the layered lattice, with the lit scene tucked inside darkness.
0989_the-flavor-of-green-tea-over-rice.j.Feels like: 1950s Japanese domestic drama, calm and refined.

0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Composition: A centered square photograph in a dark frame in the middle of the poster, surrounded by wide empty cream margin; the picture shows a zigzag path up a bare hillside with a lone tree at the top left.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Medium: Soft film photograph of a landscape set on paper-textured cream stock with a thin dark border.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Typography: Small, refined serif capitals: credit above the image, title in two centered lines below; quiet and symmetrical, with lots of white space.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Color and light: Earthy brown and ochre soil, pale blue sky, cream surround; soft natural daylight.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Story it suggests: A winding path up a barren hill suggests a long, determined search.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Visual idea: The zigzag path is the story; the frame displays a single image as an artifact, the first of a sequence.
0990_where-is-the-friend-s-house.jpg.Feels like: Minimalist 1980s Iranian art cinema, restrained and meditative.

0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Composition: A central square with a thick dark frame and a second pale beveled frame, split on a diagonal: upper left a cracked, peeling green wall, lower right the brown zigzag hill; the diagonal cut echoes a fold of paper. Title below, credit above.
0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Medium: Photographic details combined with a layered paper-cut or folded-paper graphic effect with soft shadows, on a textured sage-green stock.
0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Typography: Small serif capitals centered, credit above the image and the title beneath; plain, evenly spaced, calm.
0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Color and light: Sage and gray-green ground with brown earth, turquoise wall and cream; soft, even light.
0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Story it suggests: A cracked wall and a hillside path are joined together, suggesting damage and continuing on.
0991_and-life-goes-on.jpg.Visual idea: A frame that folds and overlaps another frame, joining images from two places on a diagonal as if carrying one film into the next.

0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Composition: A square nested frame in progressive steps: the dark outer frame, a pale bevel, and diagonal wedges of three photos, a green hillside with a zigzag path, a cracked wall, and a brown hillside, meeting at the center like folded triangles. Text sits above and below, centered.
0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Medium: Photographic fragments arranged in a layered paper-cut or folded-paper collage with soft cast shadows, on textured cream stock.
0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Typography: Small serif capitals centered: credit above and the title below, with calm spacing, subordinate to the image.
0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Color and light: Green, brown, sage and cream with charcoal frames; soft, even daylight.
0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Story it suggests: Glimpses of three landscapes converge, hinting at a path linking separate places.
0992_through-the-olive-trees.jpg.Visual idea: The frame within frame accumulates images from the earlier films in the sequence, completing the nested set.

0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.People: One woman, close-up of the eyes and upper face, seen through a lattice; her lower face is covered by a cloth. She looks out at the viewer.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Composition: Diagonal lattice of wooden slats runs from upper left to lower right across the whole poster, with the face as a small window at right of center. The soft vignette fades to flat color at the edges; the title stack sits left of the face on the slats.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Medium: Monochrome photographic image tinted with a single mustard-gold ink, grainy and soft-focus with a hazy vignette. It reads like a duotone print of an old black-and-white still.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Typography: Large stacked serif title in four lines (THE / CLOUD- / CAPPED / STAR), dark rust red, ornamental with flared strokes, typeset and slightly tilted along the diagonal. Small credit line below in the same red; it overlaps the lattice and image.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow-gold monochrome with deep brown shadows; diffused, misty light.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman peers out from behind bars or a screen, watched or confined, her gaze direct and guarded.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Visual idea: Confinement and the single watching gaze: the grid of slats cuts the face into fragments while the eyes stay whole.
0993_the-cloud-capped-star.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century art-house melodrama poster, 1950s-60s black-and-white cinema in a retro duotone treatment.

0994_local-hero.jpg.People: Two figures: a man in a suit seen in profile at left, head tipped back to look up at the sky, full body; and a tiny motorcyclist far off at right.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Composition: Vertical split: the upper half is open starry sky with a fan of meteor streaks radiating from the upper center; the lower half has a red phone booth as the central vertical object, a curved bay and village behind. Title sits right of center between sky and booth.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration, gouache or airbrush-like with smooth gradients and slight paper tooth; crisp realistic detail on the booth.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Typography: Title LOCAL HERO in off-white classical serif small caps, medium-large, upper right of the booth, with two smaller credit lines in yellow-gold small caps beneath. Typeset, clean, sits quietly on the night sky.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Color and light: Deep midnight blue night with a glowing red booth lit from inside as the one warm accent; cool moonlit water.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands by a lit phone booth in a small seaside village while strange lights streak overhead, a quiet encounter with the extraordinary.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Visual idea: The ordinary red booth set against a cosmic sky: small-scale human life under a vast event.
0994_local-hero.jpg.Feels like: 1980s British whimsical comedy, storybook-illustrated poster style.

0995_polyester.jpg.People: Two large figures, a tall man in a white shirt leaning in to whisper at the ear of a heavy woman in a cream dress who swoons with her mouth open; half body to knees, filling the center; a couple in an embrace-like hold.
0995_polyester.jpg.Composition: Central vertical pair filling the frame, with a night suburban house, trees, a car and a mailbox behind; the giant title across the bottom overlaps the woman's dress.
0995_polyester.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with visible brushwork, glossy, dramatic realism like a paperback romance painting.
0995_polyester.jpg.Typography: Ornate Victorian-style swash capitals 'POLYESTER' in deep plum with a cream outline and shadow, very large across the lower third, with 'JOHN WATERS'' in similar decorated lettering at the top flanking the man's head; typeset, decorative, wrapped around the figures.
0995_polyester.jpg.Color and light: Stormy navy and purple sky with streaks of hot red, cream dress and warm skin; melodramatic twilight light.
0995_polyester.jpg.Story it suggests: A romantic clinch in a suburban garden at dusk, one lover swooning while the other presses in, staged as high melodrama.
0995_polyester.jpg.Visual idea: A romance-novel cover used with a wink, glamorous passion applied to an ordinary suburb.
0995_polyester.jpg.Feels like: 1950s-70s pulp romance and melodrama paperback art, camp.

0996_the-circus.jpg.People: Many figures: a small man in a bowler hat, tight jacket and baggy trousers stands alone in the center holding a whip-like cane with a hand on his hip, facing us; around him, clowns, a woman and seated onlookers are seen from behind or in profile, forming a ring.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Composition: Central figure in a spotlight circle surrounded by a semicircle of crowd figures on both sides, creating a symmetrical frame. Gigantic title arcs across the top; a round badge sits at lower right.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Medium: Screenprint-style flat colors with rough hand-drawn outlines in dark blue, visible paper grain, and slight offset misregistration with the yellow.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Typography: Gigantic block capitals, red with a navy 3D drop shadow, filling the width and about 20 percent of the height, with the circus word cut by the first letter wrapping around the collection logo. Name above in white outlined condensed capitals, and a navy circular stamp with white lettering at lower right. Letters overlap the figures' heads.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow background, red, navy and gray-blue; flat, bright poster color, no real light.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone performer faces a crowd of clowns and spectators who have all gathered around him.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Visual idea: A ring formed by the crowd that turns the page into a circus ring, with him as the single cool figure in gray among red.
0996_the-circus.jpg.Feels like: 1920s silent comedy retold as a retro three-color circus bill.

0997_cluny-brown.jpg.People: One woman, half body, smiling and glancing up at a sparkling wrench she holds; she wears a bow tie and white blouse. Drawn, not photographed.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Composition: Centered circular medallion with the figure inside a thick black ring and radiating glow, framed by huge stacked title above and a credit line below; strongly symmetric about a central axis, figure slightly right.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration imitating black-and-white studio photography and airbrush: smooth gradients, glow, soft paper-like grey background with slight texture.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed hand-lettered title CLUNY / BROWN in black with gray gradient, filling the top two thirds, letters slightly wobbly and overlapping the figure's head. Small mixed bold and script credit at the bottom.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Color and light: Grayscale only, warm light grey ground with a bright halo behind the figure; high-key studio light.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful working woman proudly holds a tool, playfully confident.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Visual idea: Pin-up and propaganda-worker iconography: the wrench as a sparkling trophy inside a badge-like circle.
0997_cluny-brown.jpg.Feels like: 1940s screwball comedy, retro Hollywood title-card poster revived as monochrome illustration.

0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.People: One man in the center, half body, facing the camera with a stern look, standing among a dense crowd of hundreds of onlookers, some in berets and uniforms.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Composition: Central figure rises above a packed crowd that fills the frame in a perspective funnel down a tree-lined road; patterned red-and-black chevron borders left and right, a thick horizontal band of chevrons across the bottom, and the title stacked below.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Medium: Color photograph with realistic film-like saturation, combined with flat graphic ink patterns and solid blocks.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Typography: Three-tier stacked lettering: yellow MUHAMMAD ALI, green WHEN WE WERE, huge red KINGS on black. Bold wide geometric display type, overlapping the man's body, letters cut and stretched to fit the width.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Color and light: Warm reds, yellow and green with black against a green-and-brown outdoor crowd; bright daylight.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone figure stands calmly at the head of an enormous crowd, the object of its attention.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Visual idea: Pan-African color scheme and woven chevron pattern frame a portrait photograph, tying the man to the crowd and the culture.
0998_when-we-were-kings.jpg.Feels like: 1990s documentary poster with African-textile graphic styling.

0999_matewan.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, large, cropped to the head and upper body on the left; seven small armed figures stand on railway tracks in the distance.
0999_matewan.jpg.Composition: Strong foreground-background contrast: huge dark silhouette at left, deep perspective down the tracks to the group at upper right. The heavy title spans the width at lower center, crossing the figure and track.
0999_matewan.jpg.Medium: Sepia-toned vintage photograph with visible grain, scratches and paper texture, framed by a black border; flat metallic gold ink for the lettering with a speckled finish.
0999_matewan.jpg.Typography: MATEWAN set in very large, tall condensed sans caps in gold-tan, filling the width at the lower middle, partly overlapping the man's back. Small credit in the same gold below.
0999_matewan.jpg.Color and light: Sepia and cream with black; hazy, smoky backlight.
0999_matewan.jpg.Story it suggests: A man faces a line of gunmen across empty railroad tracks in a standoff.
0999_matewan.jpg.Visual idea: Back-turned viewpoint places the viewer behind the man facing the threat; the title acts as a barrier between them.
0999_matewan.jpg.Feels like: Period Western-style labor drama, a worn old-photograph look.

1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.People: No humans. One giant, scaly, dinosaur-like monster, drawn in a roaring pose; it is a creature, not a person.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Composition: The huge head and neck rise diagonally from the lower right to the upper left, with an open mouth at the upper centre firing a blue-yellow zigzag beam to the upper right. It fills most of the frame and the title sits in the bottom centre.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Medium: Printed-ink illustration with bold black linocut-like shading, halftone dots in the beam and fins, speckled misregistered colour on a screen-printed pink ground.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Typography: Title 'GODZILLA' in chunky, angular, heavy yellow capitals, about 35% width, bottom centre, on the dark body of the monster; a smaller subtitle in white caps below. The text is flat and stamped onto the black mass.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Color and light: Hot pink, electric blue, acid yellow and black; flat, high-energy poster light.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Story it suggests: A monster throws back its head and unleashes a blast.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Visual idea: The roaring head and the lightning-like beam as pure pop energy.
1000_godzilla-the-showa-era-films-195419.Feels like: Retro-horror pop poster, with a gig-poster or comic print feel.

1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.People: Four people running toward the viewer, full to three-quarter body: a man behind holding coffee cups, a dark-haired woman in a green scarf, a blonde woman holding a paper, and a woman in a pink coat shouting. A car driver watches at right.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Composition: Diagonal running composition from upper left to lower right, with streets and rowhouses forming perspective lines behind. Title in the upper left sky, figures filling the lower two thirds.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Medium: Flat-color comic illustration with bold ink outlines, limited gradations, a clean ligne-claire look.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Typography: Title in bold hand-drawn red brush-script caps, big in the upper area, slanted and bouncing; credit line curves and tilts in small red caps. Letters sit in the sky and mimic the running motion.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Color and light: Pastel sky blue and pinks with olive green and red accents; flat bright daylight.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Story it suggests: A family group dashes through a city street in alarm and panic, chasing or fleeing something.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Visual idea: Motion and comedy frozen into a cartoon chase, each face with a distinct reaction.
1001_the-daytrippers.jpg.Feels like: 1990s indie comedy, New Yorker-style editorial illustration.

1002_betty-blue.jpg.People: One woman, shoulders up, head tilted and smiling at the camera from above, large hoop earring, short dark hair; shown in a loose close-up.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Composition: Image occupies the upper half and a thick pink painted block covers the lower half, with the face right above the paint edge; the title sits small at the bottom right in generous empty space.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Medium: Grainy color photograph with a hand-painted opaque pink brushstroke across the bottom, dry-brush streaks showing the photo beneath.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Typography: Title Betty Blue stacked in a delicate high-contrast serif in cobalt blue at lower right, with a handwritten script credit and underline sweeping below. Mixture of type and handwriting directly on the paint.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Color and light: Soft grey-blue sky, warm skin tones, large salmon pink area, a cobalt accent; hazy summer light.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Story it suggests: A playful, flirtatious woman looks down at us, hiding or erasing everything beneath her chin.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Visual idea: The paint stroke wipes out her body, as if the image has been painted over, hinting at obsession or violence.
1002_betty-blue.jpg.Feels like: 1980s French romantic drama, softly sensual and artisanal.

1003_all-about-eve.jpg.People: One woman, shoulders-up in three-quarter view, in a strapless dress, holding a cigarette; a second face, huge, blurred and out of focus, fills the far left edge.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Composition: Central portrait with the title column at right and a row of four star names across the top; the oversized soft face at the left edge creates a layered foreground-background depth.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Medium: Monochrome with a sepia-grey tint; airbrushed or pencil-shaded illustration with a grainy, misty halation, the cigarette highlighted as a bright white stroke.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Typography: Four condensed sans names spaced across the top in muted taupe; title in large slanted brush script stacked on three lines (All / About / Eve), the last word darker and larger. Small credit bottom right.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Color and light: Warm gray and cream, no true color; soft glowing studio light.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Story it suggests: A poised, wary woman is watched by a blurred figure lurking at her side.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Visual idea: The out-of-focus second face acts as a haunting double, a rival hovering in the periphery.
1003_all-about-eve.jpg.Feels like: 1950s Hollywood backstage drama, glamorous film-noir-adjacent star portrait.

1004_now-voyager.jpg.People: One woman, half body, leaning on a ship railing, in a wide-brimmed hat and dark suit, gazing up and away.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Composition: Strongly tilted diagonal composition: railing and ship decks run diagonally from upper left to lower right, with a funnel at the upper left; the figure's head is near the upper center-right. Names stack on the right, the title sweeps across the bottom.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Medium: Gouache-like painted illustration with visible brush and dry strokes, paper grain; flat poster color with crisp edges.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Typography: Large coral-orange brush script title Now, Voyager across the bottom with a darker drop shadow, rising on a slant; star names in cream condensed caps stacked at right. The script overlaps the railing.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Color and light: Cyan and sky blue with a navy railing; coral and cream accents; bright, breezy daylight.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Story it suggests: A confident woman at the ship's rail looks toward a distant horizon, newly free.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Visual idea: The ocean liner's sweeping diagonals project journey and transformation.
1004_now-voyager.jpg.Feels like: 1940s romantic melodrama in a vintage travel-poster style.

1005_cold-war.jpg.People: Two people, a man and a woman, in a tight embrace, half body; his face is buried by her head, hers turned up toward the camera.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Composition: Central cluster in the middle of a pitch-black field, rising diagonally from lower left to upper right. Title in a wide band at the bottom, credit line floating beneath the couple.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with deep crushed blacks and slight grain.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Typography: COLD WAR in tall narrow cream-white condensed caps, large, at the bottom center, aligned with the width of the couple. Small spaced credit line over the figures.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with a warm off-white; a single harsh light on the faces.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers cling to each other in the dark, desperate or tender, sealed off from the world.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Visual idea: Darkness as a stage: the embrace as the only lit thing.
1005_cold-war.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European art-house romance, modern black-and-white drama.

1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.People: One woman, large, kneeling and looking upward with an arm extended, in a light slip; stylized and almost statue-like.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Composition: Figure dominates the left two thirds against a black ground, title block stacked in the upper right and credits down the right side; strong diagonal from her raised face to her outstretched hand.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted lithographic look with flat saturated blocks, highlighted forms and rough shading; the figure's glossy skin is modeled with orange and pink.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Typography: Title in bold yellow hand-cut slab caps stacked on three lines in the upper right; the cast name in olive green; the credit in gray-green. Lettering has a rough, printed edge and sits beside the figure without overlapping.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with glowing yellow, pink and orange flesh; spotlight-like light.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Story it suggests: A vulnerable woman gazes upward, as if pleading or in distress.
1006_the-story-of-temple-drake.jpg.Visual idea: Her body is an iconic spotlighted object against the dark, melodrama condensed to one pose.

1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.People: One tiny blurred figure, perhaps two, in the innermost triangle; they are red-tinted silhouettes on a pink-yellow beach.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Composition: Concentric triangles nested at the center, framing the figures at the lowest tip, while a neon blue triangle outline is skewed off the pile. Title letters are stacked down the center axis.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Medium: Photographic collage of sky and desert with a glowing neon tube effect, solarized color and film grain in the central triangles.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Typography: Title in wide-spaced thin white caps, stacked down the vertical center axis, one word per line, running through the triangles and cut by edges. Small credit at the bottom in the same spaced caps.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Color and light: Bright blue sky, orange-yellow desert, hot pink and neon blue accents; saturated daylight.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is lost in a vast landscape that seems to bend into other realities.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Visual idea: Triangles as portals or warning signs: nested frames pull the eye to a blurred figure.
1007_until-the-end-of-the-world.jpg.Feels like: 1990s road-movie sci-fi, psychedelic video-era graphic design.

1008_old-joy.jpg.People: Two walking figures and a dog, seen only as legs and feet at top, and their reflection below, upside down with torsos and faces visible.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Composition: Mirrored vertical symmetry around a horizontal log or path in the middle; the lower half is an upside-down reflection with a white gap at the bottom for the title.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Medium: Watercolor, pencil and crayon on paper with bleeding washes, visible paper grain and smeared stripes along the center band.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Typography: OLD JOY in a thin, tall muted blue-gray sans at the bottom center-left, medium size, with the credit in small caps at right. Typeset and quiet, against pale space.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Color and light: Pastel greens, pinks and yellows with a rust-red center band; soft, damp, diffuse light.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Story it suggests: Two companions walk together through woods, reflected and doubled as if remembered.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Visual idea: A water reflection turns the walkers upside down, suggesting memory and a world turned over.
1008_old-joy.jpg.Feels like: Mid-2000s American indie, handmade art-poster style.

1009_holiday.jpg.People: Three or four people: a woman and a man in a reclining embrace in the lower left, and a huge blue-tinted woman's smiling face at upper right, a second larger portrait; people are drawn from different stills.
1009_holiday.jpg.Composition: Layered montage: upper right big face and title across the top, tiny sailboat landscape at left, lower orange arc cradling the couple, thin cream border around the poster.
1009_holiday.jpg.Medium: Heavily grained, halftone-like duotone and tritone printing; flat teal, blue and orange layers with visible noise, retro screenprint.
1009_holiday.jpg.Typography: HOLIDAY in huge wide slab-ish caps across the top with a peach-to-yellow gradient, slightly arched, partly overlapping the big face. Star names in thin cream caps above; director credit in cream at left.
1009_holiday.jpg.Color and light: Teal-green and aqua with a rust orange arc; sunny, flat, cool.
1009_holiday.jpg.Story it suggests: A romantic pair at leisure, while the dream of a holiday looms over them.
1009_holiday.jpg.Visual idea: Collage of leisure imagery, travel graphics and portrait scale-shifts expresses romance.
1009_holiday.jpg.Feels like: 1930s screwball romantic comedy, Deco travel-poster feel.

1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.People: Three people in a photo collage: a woman's eye and nose visible through a round hole in a sheet of paper held up by hands; a man in a dark suit, full body, hand to mouth, standing in front of the sheet; and a hand holding a pistol entering at the lower right edge.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Composition: Cutout figures on a white field: a gray photo square with a held sheet, the standing man cut out and extending below the photo, the gun hand intruding from the corner. Title on top in a wide block, left margin empty.
