1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film stills, cut out like paper collage, against a flat off-white ground; flat solid ink for the title.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Typography: LE PETIT SOLDAT in huge bold sans caps in two blocks above and below a small red credit line; mostly dark blue with the O in red; flat, clean, wide.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Color and light: Black and white photographs with blue and red as the only color; flat even light.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is watched through a peephole while a gun enters, a spy under surveillance and threat.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Visual idea: The round hole as a surveillance eye; the title's red O echoes it as a target.
1010_le-petit-soldat.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French New Wave, tricolor graphic design.

1011_fail-safe.jpg.People: No identifiable individuals; tiny marching crowds and flag-bearers in a parade appear in the photographs inside the letters.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Composition: Huge title letters dissolve into a black field, overprinted by concentric rings like a target or radar. City photographs show through the letters; the edges are sprayed and rough. A credit line sits small at top.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Medium: Black ink stencil or spray-paint texture over black-and-white halftone photographs of skylines and parades; speckled, rough edges.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Typography: Enormous stacked FAIL / SAFE letters fill the entire poster, so heavy they almost vanish into the black; legible only through photos inside the counters. Small white credit on top.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Color and light: Black and white only; high contrast, harsh.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Story it suggests: Two cities, two powers, under a crosshair, with disaster implied.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Visual idea: The title is a mask through which two cities are glimpsed: letters, target and sky mix into a single mark.
1011_fail-safe.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Cold War thriller, stark graphic protest-poster look.

1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.People: One tiny woman in a red coat holding a bag and furled umbrella, full body in profile; a giant profile of a face (only lips and cheek) dominates, and a second black silhouette profile at right.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Composition: A huge pink face profile in flat shapes fills the right two thirds, with a small figure in the lower left for scale; orange and black columns frame the left. Title is stacked at upper left over the orange disc.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Medium: Flat vector illustration, solid color shapes with small highlights, no texture, clean edges.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Typography: Title ALL ABOUT MY MOTHER stacked in three lines in angular jagged hand-cut royal-blue letters, tilted and interlocking with 'MY' squeezed between. Small blue credit under.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Color and light: Orange, pink, red and black with a royal blue; saturated, poster-flat, no real light.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Story it suggests: A small woman stands in the shadow of enormous faces and relationships bigger than she is.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Visual idea: Scale contrast and the enormous red lips: intimate emotion rendered as monumental pop graphics.
1012_all-about-my-mother.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European melodrama, late-1990s Spanish pop-graphic poster feel.

1013_teorema.jpg.People: Three photographic fragments: a woman's face turned upward in profile, a man's head and neck bowed at lower left, and a distant small figure standing in a vast landscape at bottom right.
1013_teorema.jpg.Composition: Triangles and rectangles meet at one central point, cutting the poster into wedges of gray-beige, with the photos set into the wedges. Title in lower right across the seam; credit upper left.
1013_teorema.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone and grain, duotone blue-and-white photo prints with flat blue ink; screenprint-like.
1013_teorema.jpg.Typography: Title Teorema in a large lowercase-ish grotesque sans in blue at the lower right, straddling the edge between wedges; credit in blue mixed lowercase at upper left. Typeset and clean.
1013_teorema.jpg.Color and light: Cobalt blue and white on a pale warm gray; flat, cool and clear.
1013_teorema.jpg.Story it suggests: Different people and a lonely figure are linked by an unseen geometry, as if part of a proof.
1013_teorema.jpg.Visual idea: Theorem as geometry: each face or figure becomes a vertex of a diagram.
1013_teorema.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Italian art-house cinema, Swiss-style modernist design.

1014_roma.jpg.People: One person, small, full body, backlit and walking or hopping through shallow water on a beach, seen as a dark silhouette.
1014_roma.jpg.Composition: Vast empty gray sky occupies the upper two thirds, the subject sits low and slightly right of center near a horizon with the sun behind; the title is centered in the empty space above.
1014_roma.jpg.Medium: Smooth black-and-white photograph, soft haze and lens flare, subtle gradient sky, polished digital finish.
1014_roma.jpg.Typography: ROMA in tall slim art-deco style white caps, large, centered in the upper half; small spaced credit in dark gray beneath. Clean, typeset and calm.
1014_roma.jpg.Color and light: Silver and gray, a bright sun glare; backlit hazy morning light.
1014_roma.jpg.Story it suggests: One person moves alone at the edge of a vast sea and sky, quiet and ambiguous.
1014_roma.jpg.Visual idea: Emptiness: a tiny figure against a large sky lets the title stand as a monument.
1014_roma.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary art-house drama, monochrome Latin American realism.

1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.People: A tiny group in a small boat in the middle distance on the lake; otherwise creatures only (pterosaurs, a stegosaurus, a small dinosaur eating grass).
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Composition: Frame-within-frame: thin border inset on the aged paper; creatures fill the corners (pterosaurs upper, stegosaurus lower left, small dinosaur lower right) around a central lake and mountains, with the big title stacked over the middle.
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Medium: Vintage collage of stop-motion model stills and hand-tinted color, with aged paper texture, grain and faded color.
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Typography: Tall ornate Victorian wood-type caps in red-orange with dark drop shadow, stacked in four lines that fill roughly 60% of the width and run across the center, small black credit above. Overlaps the lake, palms and a pterosaur, like an old adventure book cover.
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Color and light: Faded sea-green sky, tan and ochre rocks, red-orange title; warm, sepia-washed daylight.
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Story it suggests: A small boat voyage through a lost prehistoric world with huge creatures around.
1015_journey-to-the-beginning-of-time.jp.Visual idea: A pulp adventure-book cover where the huge animals and the tiny boat set the scale of discovery.

1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.People: A small man with a telescope atop a submarine tower, a winged flying man hanging beneath an aerostat at upper right, and a diver being attacked by a shark below; all appear to be engraving-like illustrations.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Composition: Vertical stack in a thin ruled frame: sky with the flyer and submarine at top, title across the center on the waterline, underwater scene with diver and shark below; the horizon splits the poster in half.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white image printed to look like an old engraving or wood grain, with horizontal scan lines, paper texture and mild grain.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Typography: Victorian-style ornate display caps in white with black drop shadow, large, stacked on three lines (INVENTION / FOR / DESTRUCTION) with swashes, the last line very wide and slightly curved; small credit above in engraved caps.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray and white; murky, diffuse underwater light.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Story it suggests: Fantastic machines and a sea monster threaten adventurers on sea and sky.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Visual idea: Jules-Verne engraving pastiche: the title sits on the water line, tying air, sea and sub-sea into one scene.
1016_invention-for-destruction.jpg.Feels like: Retro adventure fantasy, 1950s Eastern European trick-film, 19th-century book illustration.

1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.People: A flying man and a tripled pale figure at upper center, two armored flyers or divers at both sides, and a gauntleted hand holding flowers at the right; all tiny and collaged.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Composition: Symmetric framed collage: a gold border with medals at top, the title down the center, onion-domed minarets at the bottom, with flying objects around the title like a fanciful sky.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Medium: Collage of vintage engravings and photographs, halftone and grain, with gold-yellow tint and paper texture.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Typography: Huge Victorian circus-style slab-serif caps, stacked on four lines, filled with a yellow-to-red gradient and outlined in black with drop shadow. A crow sits on the F. A small yellow credit above.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Color and light: Teal night sky shading to golden yellow; theatrical, warm sunset glow.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Story it suggests: Impossible adventurers fly, float and leap through a fantastical sky.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Visual idea: A fairground-curio cabinet: every cutout object is a tall tale hung in a golden frame.
1017_the-fabulous-baron-munchausen.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Czech fantasy, Victorian circus poster style.

1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.People: One person, three-quarter body, striking a pose in a voluminous dark and sheer gown with eyes closed; five or six seated onlookers are small and blurred in the background.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Composition: The subject is central and leans on a diagonal against a wide hall; the photo fills the upper three quarters, with a cream band at the bottom holding the title. Trophies on a table and a bright window at the back add depth.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white documentary photograph, soft focus, with a flat cream panel and solid ink lettering.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Typography: PARIS IS BURNING in heavy bold grotesque caps, vermilion red, spanning almost the full width on the cream band; small widely spaced credit line below in the same red. Cleanly typeset and sits apart from the photo.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with warm cream and one vermilion accent; diffuse daylight from a window.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Story it suggests: A performer strikes a pose and ignores the onlookers, absorbed in the moment.
1018_paris-is-burning.jpg.Visual idea: The photograph is left untouched and the red title is a single stamp of color.

1019_bamboozled.jpg.People: Two men in front and back, half body, in blackface makeup with huge red lips and white gloves, one in a top hat with arms spread, one behind in a red jacket and boater; a cartoon figure at the lower right eating watermelon.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Composition: Figures lean from the right toward the left on a flat orange field; a curved ribbon banner with the title crosses the lower third, with cotton plants and a cartoon at the lower right. Cast list stacks at left.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Medium: Photographic cutouts mixed with flat, hand-inked cartoon drawing, in minstrel-show vintage-print style with flat solid colors.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Typography: BAMBOOZLED in thick red condensed Victorian-style letters, bold with a black outline, bent along a yellow scroll banner; script and slab credit lines at left and at the bottom, in white and black. Hand-drawn, deliberately old-fashioned.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Color and light: Saturated orange with yellow, red, black and white; flat, harsh poster light.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Story it suggests: Performers in caricature masks grin and mug on stage, uncomfortably cheerful, in a spectacle of stereotype.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Visual idea: Reappropriated racist period imagery put at full volume so the viewer sees its ugliness.
1019_bamboozled.jpg.Feels like: Vintage minstrel-show broadside, satire in the 1990s-2000s.

1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.People: One woman, large close-up of the face and shoulders, wearing round tortoiseshell sunglasses and a white jacket, looking straight ahead; her face fills the right two thirds.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Composition: The head is cropped by the top edge and shifted right, with a lake and forest landscape at the left behind her; the red title box spans the bottom. Reflection in the sunglasses mirrors the lake.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Medium: Smooth airbrushed painting with glossy highlights and crisp edges, hyper-polished retouched look.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Typography: Title in white condensed caps on a red banner across the bottom, with a small script 'to' in the middle; credit in dark red script and caps above it. Typeset, with the banner over the jacket.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Color and light: Teal sky and lake, auburn hair, red lips, red banner; bright cool daylight with warm skin tones.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Story it suggests: A cool, composed woman hides her gaze behind dark glasses at a lakeside, hiding something.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Visual idea: The sunglasses reflect the lake, turning her gaze into a blank mirror, a menace behind stillness.
1020_leave-her-to-heaven.jpg.Feels like: 1940s Technicolor film noir melodrama, vintage pin-up illustration.

1021_show-boat.jpg.People: One man, large, seated and leaning back on a dock bollard, eyes closed or looking away; a steamboat is tiny in the background.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Composition: Ornate frame with scroll corners, filled with the title and credit block as a text column down the poster, while the photo sits in the lower fifth, the man bottom-left and the paddle steamer on the water at right.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph under heavy grain and speckles, with letterpress wood-type look and ink texture, printed on pale gray paper.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Typography: SHOW BOAT in giant stacked, ornamented Western-style wood-type caps, dark with white inlaid patterns and drop shadow, filling the top half; many small credit lines in mixed fonts: slab, script, condensed. Typeset like a Victorian playbill.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Color and light: Gray and black with cream; hazy overcast daylight.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Story it suggests: A man sits quietly on a river landing as a showboat passes by.
1021_show-boat.jpg.Visual idea: A broadside playbill that frames a calm photograph beneath a barrage of type.

1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.People: Two people in an embrace in the upper half, a shirtless man gazing upward and a woman nestled against him with eyes closed; two tiny children on a dock at the lower right.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Composition: Layered double exposure: the huge couple's faces dissolve down into a sunset bay with a shrimp boat at the left and a dock at the right; floral wallpaper at the upper corners; the title column sits at the upper right.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus grainy photograph with blended overlays and a warm duotone-like wash, like a 1990s airbrushed film still collage.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Typography: Title in elegant cream serif caps, stacked on three lines at the upper right, medium size; the director credit in widely spaced dark caps at the bottom between small diamonds. Typeset and refined.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Color and light: Rust red, amber, plum and orange; warm sunset glow.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Story it suggests: Lovers hold each other while the memory of a childhood by the water lies beneath them.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Visual idea: Double exposure links adult intimacy to a childhood landscape that sits under it.
1022_the-prince-of-tides.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s romantic drama, Southern Gothic mood.

1023_the-cremator.jpg.People: One man's face, a cutout photo of a bald-ish man with a comb standing in the hair, cut out above scattered body fragments: arms, legs, feet, torsos, a hand; the body is disassembled.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Composition: Central vertical cluster: the face on top, a cascade of cut-up body parts tumbling beneath it; the title is split, with THE at left and CREMATOR written vertically up the right side. Much blank cream space.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Medium: Hand-made paper collage with black-and-white photo cutouts and charcoal or crayon lettering on cream paper; scissor-cut edges and shadows.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Typography: The title is hand-written in black charcoal capitals, THE small and horizontal, CREMATOR large and rotated vertically; a handwritten credit below in thin marker. Rough, childlike, directly drawn.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and cream; flat soft gallery light.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Story it suggests: A calm, ordinary man looks out while bodies are dismembered below him.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Visual idea: A smiling face over a heap of body parts, calm face and dismemberment united in one collage.
1023_the-cremator.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Czechoslovak black comedy-horror, handmade DIY art-poster.

1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.People: Two people, a woman seated at a table with a cigarette, looking sidelong, and a tall man in a dark suit leaning in from the right at table edge, head bowed; the background is a mass of sketched faces and hats.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Composition: Figures split the poster in two, the woman at left center, the man tall on the right edge; table in white across the lower third; the title block at bottom center, cast names at left.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Medium: Ink-drawn and painted illustration: the figures in grayscale with fine hatching, flat red ground with sketch faces in dark line, white table with red chips.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Typography: DESTRY in huge Western wood-type slab caps, black with a red offset shadow, DESTRY on the line and RIDES AGAIN smaller below; cast names in condensed cream caps at upper left. Printed, misregistered feel.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Color and light: Brick red and gray scale with white and black, a bit of green on the neckerchief; flat lamp light.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Story it suggests: A saloon singer and a lawman size each other up over a card table.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Visual idea: The crowd of sketched faces behind them is the saloon, the whole town watching.
1024_destry-rides-again.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood Western comedy, illustrated saloon poster.

1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.People: About fifteen tiny figures painted in stained-glass-like arched panels and niches: a central trio, flanking pairs, three faces in a doorway niche, two men in baths at lower right.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Composition: Symmetric tiled bathhouse interior seen frontally: three arched windows in the upper center with the figures, a curtained doorway below, tubs along the bottom, the title arced across the top. Perspective lines converge on the doorway.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Medium: Painting in gouache or oil with fine brushwork and visible tile grid, with crisp, handmade, diorama-like detail.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Typography: Title along the arch in deep blue hand-painted caps, small, arcing from left to right like architectural lettering; the credit at the bottom in small white caps. Integrated into the architecture.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Color and light: Powder blues and whites with brick red, purple and pink accents; even, soft interior light.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Story it suggests: A cast of eccentrics is displayed as saints in a spa, with a pink castle floating above them.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Visual idea: The bath hall becomes a chapel and the characters' icons, with the pink hotel as a holy relic.
1025_the-grand-budapest-hotel.jpg.Feels like: 2010s ornate comedic caper, storybook diorama design.

1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.People: A crowd of about thirty faces cut out and piled up, from children to old people, most gazing at the camera; one large face dominates at left with others overlapping it; a small goldfish at lower left.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Composition: All-over face collage that overlaps edge to edge, with the title in the center-right on top of the faces; larger faces at left and smaller on the right.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Medium: Photocopied black-and-white face cutouts overlaid with a smooth rainbow gradient, paper-cut edges visible.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Typography: Title in white medium-weight sans caps, two lines, centered above the credit, small and plain, laid directly over the faces. Typeset, with no effects.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Color and light: A full rainbow spectrum running from purple at the upper left through red, orange, green and blue; the warm gold fish is the single orange accent; flat glowing light.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Story it suggests: Many strangers' looks overlap, as if everyone is connected through quiet longing.
1026_me-and-you-and-everyone-we-know.jpg.Visual idea: A rainbow gradient binds the individual faces into one human mass.

1027_the-great-escape.jpg.People: One man, a close-up of only his head and eyes emerging from a hole in the grass, glaring sideways at the viewer; a far smaller figure is not visible. The head is painted, not photographed.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Composition: Stacked vertical layout: huge title on top, a lit watchtower at left middle, a fence across the middle, and the head low and centered-right at the bottom. The head sits at ground level, creating a tense low horizon.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Medium: Opaque gouache or acrylic painting with visible brushstrokes on the head, grass and tower; the barbed wire and title are flat solid ink.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Typography: Very large, heavy, blocky condensed capitals stacked in three lines across the top half, pale mint on near-black, with barbed wire tangled through and over the letters. Typeset, with the wire interlaced like it is caged in the lettering; small cast names sit in a narrow sans below.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Color and light: Night blues and blacks with pale mint-green highlights and one glowing orange lamp in the tower, a harsh searchlight feel.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Story it suggests: A man pokes his head out of the ground at night beside a guarded camp, watching for the moment to slip past the lights.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Visual idea: Barbed wire fused with the title so the lettering itself is a fence, while the head peeks out from beneath it.
1027_the-great-escape.jpg.Feels like: Classic 1960s war adventure painted poster, reinterpreted as a contemporary illustrated cover.

1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.People: Two women: one huge head-and-shoulders portrait on the left looking up and away, and one full-to-three-quarter-length standing figure on the right with arms crossed, staring at the viewer. They are separated in scale and attitude, like a rival and a double.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Composition: Two diagonal-ish masses side by side: giant face in the left half, tall standing figure in the right half, title along the bottom crossing both. Large figure scale contrast creates depth.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Medium: Painted gouache with soft flat shapes, visible canvas or paper tooth and gentle brush texture; stars have little glints of paint.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Typography: Large hand-lettered white capitals with brown drop shadow, in two bouncing lines, set low and angled slightly; names in a smaller italic-and-caps mix at left, all in a vintage showcard style.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Color and light: Warm golden tan and ochre monochrome with a white dress and gold stars, soft studio glow.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women share a stage world, one looming and glamorous, the other defiant with folded arms, hinting at rivalry.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Visual idea: Scale doubling: a giant idealized face as a looming ghost behind the standing performer.
1028_dance-girl-dance.jpg.Feels like: 1940s Hollywood showbiz poster in a modern painted pastiche.

1029_husbands.jpg.People: Three men, medium-range, blurry, close together in dark coats, pushing and grabbing at one another. They overlap as a clump, motion-smeared.
1029_husbands.jpg.Composition: Horizontal split: the top 40 percent is empty cream space holding only text, the bottom is a photographic scene with the trio in a diagonal tangle. Figures cluster slightly right of center.
1029_husbands.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus photographic still with grain and motion blur, set against a clean flat paper-cream area.
1029_husbands.jpg.Typography: Title in widely spaced slab-serif capitals in muted teal, spanning almost the full width, with bold black condensed credits stacked above and below like a stamped banner. Typeset, sits on the seam between blank panel and photo.
1029_husbands.jpg.Color and light: Pale cream above, cold steel blues and dark coats below, flat overcast daylight.
1029_husbands.jpg.Story it suggests: Three men in a chaotic scuffle or stumbling embrace in a winter street, hard to tell if it is play or fight.
1029_husbands.jpg.Visual idea: A blurred, unposed snapshot under a stark typographic banner, as if a documentary frame were slipped under a title card.
1029_husbands.jpg.Feels like: Late-1960s and 1970s American indie drama, gritty and raw.

1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.People: None visible; the image is a dense city of buildings.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Composition: Layered, multiple-exposure view of skyscrapers and apartment blocks with the title block across the center, set left and flush to the edges; a smaller list of titles below at the right.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Medium: High-contrast halftone photocopy look, black-and-white photographs overprinted on each other with paper grain.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Typography: Huge chunky rounded sans lowercase 'scorsese shorts' in off-white, stacked in two lines and running off the left and right edges, cut off; below, a small list of titles in condensed capitals with italic initial letters; typeset, with a stencil-like heavy feel.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and off-white only; flat, grainy, overcast city light.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Story it suggests: A crowded, layered city seen in fragments, an urban sketchbook of short pieces.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Visual idea: Stacked exposures of buildings suggesting several short films overlapped into one city.
1030_scorsese-shorts.jpg.Feels like: New York 1960s underground and student film, photocopy zine aesthetic.

1031_wildlife.jpg.People: Three people: a woman and a boy leaning over a book in the foreground left, and a man in a blue shirt sitting in an armchair at back right with a bottle and hand to his mouth. The figures form a triangle of separate attention.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Composition: A framed painting with thin border sits centered in a wide beige margin; title below. Foreground figures lower-left overlap diagonally, with the man balanced far right.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushwork and canvas texture, framed by a flat beige mat.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Typography: Large widely spaced serif capitals in warm brown, centered below the frame, with small italic and caps credits above and below. Quiet, typeset and classical.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber and ochre lamplight with a bright turquoise shirt accent against striped brown wall.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Story it suggests: A mother and son are absorbed in a book while a distant father sits apart, withdrawn and drinking.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Visual idea: Family seen as a framed domestic painting with distance between the figures.
1031_wildlife.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century suburban realism, like a hung painting in a quiet home.

1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.People: One woman shown in repeated vertical slices across the bottom, half body to head and shoulders, in white sweater, arms raised and hair flying. Each strip catches a different moment of her movement.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Composition: Mostly empty cream top; title centered in the middle; a horizontal band of strips along the bottom. The strips stagger like a staggered sequence.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Medium: Grainy photographic stills, noisy and washed out, cut into offset strips on a flat cream field.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Typography: Large soft serif in two lines, 'An' and 'Woman' in pale taupe and 'Unmarried' in dark brown, centered and stacked tightly with letters nearly touching. Typeset, with a small sans credit beneath.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Color and light: Creamy off-white, beige, pale pink and brown, hazy morning light.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman dances alone and moves through different moods, free and fragmented.
1032_an-unmarried-woman.jpg.Visual idea: Time-lapse slicing of one body into a stuttering filmstrip of motion.

1033_the-cameraman.jpg.People: One man, a caricature-like seated figure with a flat cap and long face, a tiny monkey on his shoulder, wrapped in film ribbon beside a huge anthropomorphic movie camera. The camera has a face-like lens and an open mouth.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Composition: A diagonal tumble from upper left to lower right, with the man and the camera locking into one angled mass on empty white. Title blocks are tilted and placed around the figure.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white illustration with ink washes, charcoal-like texture, and cut-paper or faceted shapes; grayscale only.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Typography: Big tilted sans capitals: gray 'BUSTER KEATON' split into two lines at top, black 'THE CAMERAMAN' at bottom running off the right edge. Typeset, the words lean with the figure and 'KEATON' overlaps the camera.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Color and light: Stark black, white and mid-gray, flat with no cast light.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Story it suggests: A hapless man is tangled in his own film gear and the machine seems to have a life of its own.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Visual idea: Film strip as rope binding the man to the camera, turning the camera into a character.
1033_the-cameraman.jpg.Feels like: Silent-comedy era with a modern constructivist-style illustration.

1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.People: One woman, seated three-quarter body in a green gown, head turned down in profile, with a thick smear of paint across her eyes. Her hands rest limp on her lap.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Composition: A tall framed painting sits in a pale margin, offset toward left; the title is broken into four pieces that jump around the frame's edges and cross over it. The figure runs diagonally from head to lower-right knee.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with heavy, visible brush smears and impasto in pink and yellow dragged across the image.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Typography: Large pink italic serif capitals, split as 'PORTRAIT', 'OF A', 'LADY', 'ON FIRE' scattered at corners, the first and third letters partially hidden behind the frame and the C logo. Typeset; words step down diagonally like a path across the picture.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Color and light: Deep emerald green against sage, gray-mauve and salmon pink, soft museum lighting.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman's face is wiped away in the act of being painted, as if memory or identity is erased.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Visual idea: A brushstroke that obliterates the eyes, making the portrait a thing both seen and erased.
1034_portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.jpg.Feels like: Eighteenth-century portrait painting reworked as a contemporary art-house cover.

1035_come-and-see.jpg.People: One young man, an enormous close-up of his face and shoulders filling most of the poster, staring straight at the viewer; the top of a rifle barrel rises beside his shoulder. Painted rather than photographed.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetric face on a low horizon, with a flat marshy landscape behind and a black band across the bottom for the title. The rifle pokes up at left as the only off-axis element.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Medium: Hyper-detailed oil painting with grimy skin texture, wrinkles and mud-spattered paint; the bottom band is flat solid ink.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Typography: Small, wide pixel-like blocky capitals in cool pale blue-gray on a black strip at the bottom center, with a tiny credit line below. Typeset, quiet, and dwarfed by the face.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Color and light: Gray-blue overcast sky, murky olive greens and bruised pinks in the face, flat dull light.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy with a hollow, exhausted stare stands in a wet wasteland, armed and changed by something he saw.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Visual idea: The face as the whole landscape of the poster, with an empty gaze meeting the viewer head-on.
1035_come-and-see.jpg.Feels like: Late Cold War-era war drama, rendered as a stark contemporary painted portrait.

1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.People: One man shown three times in overlapping fighting poses, shirtless, with open mouths and clawed hands and kicking limbs, close-in half-body. The multiple copies read as a single figure over time.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Composition: Dense, swirling diagonal composition filling the frame, with three bodies stacked in a spiral and a silvery vortex ring around them. Title bars the top and bottom.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Medium: High-contrast screenprint look, black ink spatter over flat yellow with wet-looking silver-and-white swirl and thin drawn lines; ink blotches break up the skin.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Typography: Huge chunky cream capitals with a black block shadow stretch across the full top edge ('BRUCE LEE'), the C logo overlapping the B; a smaller gray metallic-block line at the bottom. Typeset, blocky 3D, partly cropped by the edges.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow, black and silver-white, flat graphic light.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Story it suggests: A fighter's furious bursts of motion, one blow after another, in a blur of speed.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Visual idea: Repeating the body in sequence to show a flurry of action, like a multiple-exposure.
1036_bruce-lee-his-greatest-hits.jpg.Feels like: 1970s martial-arts exploitation poster, remade as expressive pop printmaking.

1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.People: Two people, a man standing behind a woman in a green dress, full to three-quarter body, on a heap of rubble in lower left; both gaze up at the sky in fear. They are small relative to the scene.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Composition: Diagonal, with the giant black craft sweeping from upper right toward the lower left, burning clouds filling the upper left, and rubble climbing into the lower-left corner. The title is set in the bottom third over the rubble.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Medium: Flat-ink comic or screenprint illustration with bold black outlines, halftone-like speckle and layered spot colors.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Typography: Huge tilted red condensed capitals, 'THE WAR / OF THE / WORLDS', rising out of the rubble with the 'W's towering; small 'H.G. Wells' above, credits in tiny caps at the base. Typeset, and the letters look like fallen blocks of the ruins.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange, acid yellow, black and sea-green, with explosion-lit glow.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Story it suggests: Two survivors on the wreckage of a city watch a huge alien machine arrive overhead.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Visual idea: The title as ruined architecture, while a gigantic craft dwarfs the humans like a manta ray.
1037_the-war-of-the-worlds.jpg.Feels like: 1950s sci-fi invasion pulp, reinterpreted through modern comic-book color.

1038_marriage-story.jpg.People: Three people packed into a close-up photo, a dark-haired man kissing a woman's head, her laughing with eyes closed, and a child in the foreground bottom-left laughing as well. They pile on each other, warm and close.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Composition: A square photo is centered on a beige field with wide margins, title below; the faces form a triangle, woman's face upper right, child lower left.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Medium: Soft, grainy real photographic still, framed within a flat beige page.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Typography: Large light humanist serif in black, title case, centered beneath the photo, with a small caps credit line below. Typeset, restrained.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige, skin tones and brown with a touch of red, soft indoor daylight.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Story it suggests: A family caught in a moment of happy affection, perhaps one that will not last.
1038_marriage-story.jpg.Visual idea: A family snapshot set like a keepsake photograph, with the title acting as a quiet caption.

1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.People: Six small cut-out black-and-white head shots in the lower panel: five on the left and middle (women) and one man at the right, set 'versus' each other. They are faces only, small, in a lineup.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Composition: A top-heavy block of huge title lines on cream, then a yellow band with the portraits and names in a grid; star ornaments and flanking names make a symmetrical bill. Two columns of credits flank the word HALL.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Medium: Letterpress-like flat red and black ink on cream paper with speckled grain and rough edges; coarse halftone photos cut out as stickers.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Typography: Enormous red condensed slab capitals stacked in three lines taking up most of the poster, with ink texture and gaps; small names in yellow, red and black condensed type, and a large black 'VS.' Typeset like a prizefight bill, everything fit tightly to the edges.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Color and light: Cream, hot red, mustard yellow and black, flat graphic print.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Story it suggests: A staged public face-off, with a panel of people billed like boxers for a big night.
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Visual idea: Intellectual debate presented as a boxing-match announcement, with 'Ringside!!' and 'VS.'
1039_town-bloody-hall.jpg.Feels like: 1970s event broadside or sports fight poster, with a revival print look.

1040_toni.jpg.People: One woman seen from behind, cropped at the top so that only the back of her head, neck and bare shoulder show, with her face hidden. A single bee sits on her neck.
1040_toni.jpg.Composition: A large pale shoulder and neck form a central vertical wedge against a dark gray field, with the title in huge letters across the bottom. The bee is a tiny orange point at the center.
1040_toni.jpg.Medium: Digital or gouache painting with dry, textured brush marks, flat shapes and chalky edges.
1040_toni.jpg.Typography: Gigantic bare off-white sans capitals 'TONI', cropped slightly at the edges, spanning the bottom width with a rough painted finish; small caps credit at lower right. The letters overlap the floral dress in the background.
1040_toni.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal and black with creamy white skin and a single yellow-orange accent, quiet and cool.
1040_toni.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman turned away, unreadable, while a small insect lands on her skin, a sense of intimacy and unease.
1040_toni.jpg.Visual idea: Hiding the face and putting a tiny bee on the exposed neck as the only focal point.
1040_toni.jpg.Feels like: Modern art-house minimalism, with a 1930s drama shadow.

1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.People: Two figures: a shirtless man reclining with arm raised and eyes closed, large and at left, and a partly hidden figure with curly orange hair and bare chest behind and at right; a hand with red nails at lower right. They are sprawled and overlapped, sleeping or limp.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Composition: Crowded all-over pattern; the man's body runs diagonally from upper left to lower right and a green stream of noodles or foam pours into a bowl at the bottom center.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Medium: Thick expressive oil painting with outlined shapes, visible strokes and patterned fabrics like a Post-Impressionist canvas.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Typography: Medium-large yellow decorative serif title with swashy lowercase and mixed-size caps, set at the upper center in two lines and overlapping the figures; names in small white caps above. Typeset with Art Nouveau flavor, partly tangled in the drapery.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Color and light: Saturated mint green, pink, teal, red and cream, jewel-bright and decorative.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Story it suggests: A languid, hazy indulgent scene with something sensual or poisoned in the air.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Visual idea: A lush decorative interior where bodies melt into ornament and a green liquid spills as the odd focal point.
1041_the-comfort-of-strangers.jpg.Feels like: Fin-de-siecle decadent painting meets 1990s erotic thriller.

1042_beau-travail.jpg.People: One man, a half-length figure seen from below, shirtless in green trousers, head fully in black silhouette so the face is unreadable. His arm hangs and a hand rests at his waist.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Composition: The body rises diagonally from lower center to upper left against a bare blue field, with the title overlapping his waist at the lower right. Lots of empty blue to the left.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Medium: Grainy photographic still pushed into saturated color, with a soft film-like noise.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Typography: Medium-large white sans-serif capitals 'BEAU / TRAVAIL' in two stacked lines at lower right, with letters sliced by diagonal cuts and clipped corners; sits over the torso. A small caps credit sits at the left center.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Color and light: Intense cobalt blue sky with sunlit warm skin and olive green fabric, harsh direct sun.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Story it suggests: A faceless, sun-struck man stands over the viewer, watchful and self-contained against the sky.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Visual idea: Face erased into a shadow while the body is lit, turning the figure into an anonymous form against a pure color field.
1042_beau-travail.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s European art film, sensual and spare.

1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.People: One man, small, full body at lower center on a stone stairway, head bowed, in a coat and scarf; a tiny second figure sits by a doorway and a dog is half visible near him.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Composition: Tall village street with a lower vertical diagonal of stone steps, and a dark wall wedge at left; houses stack up toward a big stormy sky filled with the title. The man is tiny relative to the space.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Medium: Grainy film still, desaturated and cool, with scrawled brush-pen lettering added on top.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-scrawled off-white capitals, 'CHRIST / STOPPED / AT / EBOLI', thin and shaky like marker strokes, stacked across the sky and dipping over the rooftops; the last letter is cut off at the right. Handmade, overlapping the buildings.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Color and light: Stormy teal-blue sky with muted white plaster and rust brick, cold overcast light.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man walks into a remote hillside village under a heavy sky, outsider and alone.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Visual idea: Handwriting scrawled across the sky like graffiti or a note left in the village.
1043_christ-stopped-at-eboli.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European social-realist drama, bleak and documentary.

1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.People: Many people across about seven small stills: a cloaked woman walking down a corridor, two men side by side in hats, a boy with a bloody nose, a man lying and being held by hands, two young faces close, soldiers carrying crosses. Mostly faces and half-body shots; each is a different person or pair.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Composition: Mosaic of film-still rectangles in staggered sizes, stepping down the left and a few at the top and bottom right, with text columns at top left and right and the title block in the middle. A large circular seal sits at the lower right.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Medium: Duotone-printed film stills (each in one flat color like orange, teal, red or green) on cream paper; the seal and some text are flat ink line art.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Typography: Large light red-pink condensed capitals 'MARTIN SCORSESE'S WORLD CINEMA PROJECT' stacked in four lines at the center-left, with small black serif-and-sans listings of directors, titles, countries and years in two columns; the seal has curved text around it and a bold '3'. Typeset, clean and orderly.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Color and light: Cream ground with orange, teal, pink-red, mustard and green duotone stills, flat print color.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Story it suggests: A set of faces from different corners of the world, each caught in a moment of worry, defiance or fear.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Visual idea: A collage of tinted frames from different films pasted together like a stamp-collection or archive sheet, with a stamped seal declaring the preservation project.
1044_martin-scorsese-s-world-cinema-proj.Feels like: Contemporary archival box-set design with a mid-century printed ephemera look.

1045_lucia.jpg.People: Several people across stills: a woman in a headscarf, hand on her head, large at left (half body); a man in a tie walking along a street, small; a tiny pair of faces at the lower edge; a cluster of faces in a pink tile at the top. Mostly separate unrelated individuals.
1045_lucia.jpg.Composition: Staggered stack of rectangles at left, one orange and one teal, with the titles aligned in a column at the right and a circular stamp at the upper right; small tiles pop out at top center and bottom right. Large empty cream margins.
1045_lucia.jpg.Medium: Duotone-printed film stills (each in one flat color like orange, teal, red or green) on cream paper; the seal and some text are flat ink line art.
1045_lucia.jpg.Typography: Two film titles in tall condensed black sans capitals, 'LUCIA' and 'AFTER THE CURFEW', each with a small italic serif 'A Film by' and director name above; right column, left-aligned. The stamp has curved red text and a bold '3'. Typeset and orderly.
1045_lucia.jpg.Color and light: Cream, orange, teal and magenta duotone stills, soft flat color.
1045_lucia.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman wipes her brow in a hot field while elsewhere a man walks alone through a street, two separate lives in two places.
1045_lucia.jpg.Visual idea: Stills in single flat colors arranged like a contact sheet, each title paired with its own picture.
1045_lucia.jpg.Feels like: Archival film-restoration series, 1950s-60s world cinema as seen through a modern designer's eyes.

1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.People: Several people across stills: a woman in a headscarf, hand on her head, large at left (half body); a man in a tie walking along a street, small; a tiny pair of faces at the lower edge; a cluster of faces in a pink tile at the top. Mostly separate unrelated individuals.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Composition: Staggered stack of rectangles at left, one orange and one teal, with the titles aligned in a column at the right and a circular stamp at the upper right; small tiles pop out at top center and bottom right. Large empty cream margins.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Medium: Duotone-printed film stills (each in one flat color like orange, teal, red or green) on cream paper; the seal and some text are flat ink line art.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Typography: Two film titles in tall condensed black sans capitals, 'LUCIA' and 'AFTER THE CURFEW', each with a small italic serif 'A Film by' and director name above; right column, left-aligned. The stamp has curved red text and a bold '3'. Typeset and orderly.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Color and light: Cream, orange, teal and magenta duotone stills, soft flat color.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman wipes her brow in a hot field while elsewhere a man walks alone through a street, two separate lives in two places.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Visual idea: Stills in single flat colors arranged like a contact sheet, each title paired with its own picture.
1046_after-the-curfew.jpg.Feels like: Archival film-restoration series, 1950s-60s world cinema as seen through a modern designer's eyes.

1047_pixote.jpg.People: Several people across stills: a boy in a knit cap with a smudged face turned toward the viewer in the foreground while an older man in a beret stands behind; a group of six youths lounging in a car at the top; a person hiding their face in hands inside a hood; a face in profile at the lower edge.
1047_pixote.jpg.Composition: Staggered stack of two big rectangles on the left with titles in a right-hand column, a circular stamp at upper right, and small tiles at the top center and bottom right. Generous empty cream space.
1047_pixote.jpg.Medium: Duotone-printed film stills (each in one flat color like orange, teal, red or green) on cream paper; the seal and some text are flat ink line art.
1047_pixote.jpg.Typography: Two titles in tall condensed black sans capitals, 'PIXOTE' and 'DOS MONJES', with small italic 'A Film by' and director name above each; left-aligned in the right column. The red seal shows a globe and '3'. Typeset.
1047_pixote.jpg.Color and light: Cream, golden orange, magenta-pink and teal duotones, flat print colors with a dark candle-lit pink panel.
1047_pixote.jpg.Story it suggests: A wary boy with a dirty face sits near an older man, while another figure buries his face in his hands by a candle, two stories of fear and survival.
1047_pixote.jpg.Visual idea: Tinted stills laid out like a contact sheet, each title paired with its own picture.
1047_pixote.jpg.Feels like: Archival world-cinema restoration series, 1930s and 1980s films with a contemporary print look.

1049_soleil-o.jpg.People: Many people across stills: a group of ten men standing close with arms crossed at the top; a man with a briefcase on a street corner, small, with a few passers-by; a man in glasses and a coat in the foreground with a crowd of schoolboys behind; a veiled woman in polka-dot cloth at the lower edge.

1049_soleil-o.jpg.Color and light: Cream, red-orange, mint green, orange and hot pink duotones, flat print colors.
1049_soleil-o.jpg.Story it suggests: A man with a briefcase stands alone in a foreign street while another man stands in front of a crowd of staring boys, two stories about being the outsider among many.

1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.People: One figure, seen from the side at half to three-quarter length, head covered by a cap and cloth wrapped across the face, dark coat; turned half toward the viewer. A brick wall is faintly behind. Face is hidden, so the figure is ambiguous.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Composition: Centered figure lit by a bright spot above, the rest of the poster in black; the title and cast sit at the bottom center. Strong vertical stance in a dark vignette.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white stipple, like spattered ink or heavy film grain, with a rough paper texture.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Typography: Medium white serif capitals with dots between words, 'THE . ELEPHANT . MAN .', centered near the bottom with a decorative old-style flavor; small gray cast names above and a small credit below. Typeset, quiet against the black.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and gray, dim spotlight from above.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Story it suggests: A hidden, shrouded man lingers in a dark alley, shielded from the viewer's gaze.
1051_the-elephant-man.jpg.Visual idea: Using granular darkness and a covered face to make a figure seen only as an outline and rumor.

1052_claudine.jpg.People: Roughly seven people: a woman and a man in large close-ups at the top (she looks stern, he grins), a teenager standing hand-on-hip, a girl being carried by another child, a teenage boy, and two kids on a bicycle at the bottom. The family is grouped in a pyramid.
1052_claudine.jpg.Composition: Vignette on a cream field: the two large heads at top, smaller family figures beneath tapering to a bicycle at the base; a building at left. Title in the lower third.
1052_claudine.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor and gouache illustration with dry brush edges and pencil or ink line over cream paper.
1052_claudine.jpg.Typography: Large bold italic slab-serif in mustard gold, 'Claudine' in quotation marks, centered under the vignette; small black cast names above and credit below. Typeset in a chunky 1970s style.
1052_claudine.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream with ochre, rust, teal and soft pinks, soft daylight.
1052_claudine.jpg.Story it suggests: A parent couple and a crowd of children share a cramped city life, stern and smiling at once.
1052_claudine.jpg.Visual idea: A family portrait built as a collage of faces and moments fanning down from the parents.
1052_claudine.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American urban family drama, warm and affectionate.

1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.People: About ten men: a mustached man seated in the foreground at left, head turned away, and a bartender plus a line of eight hat-wearing men standing or sitting at the bar's far end watching him. The central man is large; the others are small and grouped.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Composition: Deep perspective along a long bar running from the lower left to upper right; the large foreground man at left and the group at right face each other across the empty floor. The title sits above like a marquee.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white pencil or ink illustration with fine hatching and shading; only the man's shirt is hand-colored red.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Typography: Huge hand-lettered title: 'Gregory Peck' and 'The Gunfighter' in a rough western-style script, off-white with a black drop shadow and grungy edges, stacked across the top half and overlapping the room; small credit in black block letters on the floor.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Color and light: Silvery gray monochrome with a single orange-red accent on the shirt.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man sits tensely in a saloon while a hostile crowd waits at the other end of the room.
1053_the-gunfighter.jpg.Visual idea: The single red shirt isolates the man among gray surroundings, creating a face-off across the floor.

1054_parasite.jpg.People: Several tiny people only partly visible in the cut-out frames: a man with a black bar across his eyes, a boy with eyes barred, a woman reclining beside a man with eyes covered, a hand holding a wine glass, legs and a shoe. Everyone is cropped to fragments, faces hidden.
1054_parasite.jpg.Composition: Zigzag staircase of circles and rectangles stepping from top right to bottom right across a white field; the title sits at mid-right and the shapes lead the eye downward. Lots of white space.
1054_parasite.jpg.Medium: Photographic stills cropped into clean-edged shapes with soft drop shadows over a flat white page.
1054_parasite.jpg.Typography: Medium black serif capitals 'PARASITE' sit at center-right beside a photo tile, with a small widely spaced italic caps credit at lower left. Typeset, quiet and centered on the zigzag.
1054_parasite.jpg.Color and light: Stark white with deep teal-black windows and bright lawn green, flat daylight.
1054_parasite.jpg.Story it suggests: A privileged household is glimpsed in fragments from outside, faces masked, with a lawn and a ball below.
1054_parasite.jpg.Visual idea: Windows into a house punched out of white paper, with black bars censoring eyes as if peeping through holes.
1054_parasite.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary art-house minimalist, like a clean conceptual graphic.

1055_girlfriends.jpg.People: One woman, full body walking toward the viewer down a wet cobbled lane, with curly hair and glasses, a camera around her neck, a tripod over one shoulder and a bag and long case in her hands. She looks off to the side.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical figure on a narrow street, the walls blurred on both sides to form a corridor; title in the bottom quarter. Strong central axis.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Medium: Heavily grainy photographic still with a noisy, soft-focus color-pushed look, like an enlarged film print.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Typography: Large soft off-white serif 'Girlfriends' in title case at bottom, with a smaller 'A film by Claudia Weill' below; warm and bookish, overlapping the gritty street. Typeset.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Color and light: Cool gray-blue haze with dark denim and a warm reddish stripe, damp overcast light.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman with her camera gear walks alone through a city street, an independent artist on her way.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Visual idea: The photographer carrying her tools of the trade as a self-portrait on the poster.
1055_girlfriends.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American independent film, grainy and intimate.

1056_moonstruck.jpg.People: One woman, full body with her arms thrown wide and head tilted back, eyes closed and smiling, in a black coat and red skirt, one foot kicked up in a dancing pose. A cutout figure standing in front of a moon.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical Art Nouveau frame: a huge pale circle of moon at the top, a central arched purple ornamental panel, and the figure centered. Title at the bottom.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Medium: Cut-out photograph combined with flat purple and black ink illustration, with a decorative engraved pattern.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Typography: Large decorative serif capitals in pale lavender-blue with a purple outline, 'MOONSTRUCK', with the double O linked and the K tucked in; centered at the bottom with small cast names above. Typeset ornamental, in the style of Art Nouveau.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Color and light: Black, violet and pale moon-white, with red on the shoes and skirt, nocturnal glow.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman, dazzled and giddy, dances alone under a giant moon.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Visual idea: The big moon as a halo behind the figure so she is literally moon-struck.
1056_moonstruck.jpg.Feels like: 1980s romantic comedy with a theatrical, fairy-tale poster look.

1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.People: One man in a dark hood, half-length, looking up past the viewer with a calm gaze; blurred birds fly behind him, ambiguous silhouettes in the sky.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Composition: Man at right filling the right half, tilted slightly; hand-lettered text stacked in the left column and birds drifting across the blue background. Diagonal from upper left to lower right.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Medium: Blue-washed grainy photographic still with a paper-like texture; the lettering and the small emblem look drawn in pen.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Typography: Hand-lettered off-white capitals in marker-like strokes: 'GHOST DOG' large, 'THE WAY OF THE SAMURAI' smaller, with a thick underline between and handwritten credits; stacked in the left column and bordering the face. A small hand-drawn circular emblem sits at lower left.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Color and light: Monochrome indigo blue with a dim warm skin tone, dusk light.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Story it suggests: A hooded man quietly keeps watch while birds wheel over the city.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Visual idea: Handwriting and indigo wash make the poster feel like a personal notebook page.
1057_ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai.jp.Feels like: Late-1990s American indie drama with an urban, hip-hop and samurai flavor.

1058_the-irishman.jpg.People: Two hands in close-up, one large and sharp at right, one blurred at lower left; a dark figure's torso and a shadowed face at far left edge are barely legible. The hands are the subject; the person is mostly cropped away.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Composition: Diagonal sweep from the blurred lower-left hand up to the sharp right hand; the large hand sits right of center, the dark suit fills the upper half, and the face is pushed to the left edge.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Medium: Loose oil-painting brushstrokes with visible canvas texture, smeared dark passages and thick highlights on the skin.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Typography: Three actor names small and white across the top, then a large gray high-contrast serif title (THE IRISHMAN) with a smaller sans line between, set in the upper third over the dark painting; flat and typeset.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Color and light: Murky charcoal, olive-gray and brown with salmon-pink skin tones and two gold rings; dim, moody low light.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Story it suggests: A man of power in a dark suit extends a ringed hand, with a second hand and a half-seen face suggesting a transaction or a silent threat.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Visual idea: The ring-bearing hands stand in for the whole person, turning identity into gesture and status.
1058_the-irishman.jpg.Feels like: Prestige crime drama, painterly 1970s-flavored contemporary key art.

1059_crash.jpg.People: Two nude figures, seen from behind and tangled together, at lower left, painted pale against black; they merge with the wreckage. Their relation is intimate, embracing or collapsing into each other.
1059_crash.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal: a crumpled silver car body tilts from top center down to the lower right, while the figures sit lower left; vast black negative space frames both. A black tab holds the title across the left-center.
1059_crash.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with smeared, scraped brushwork; metallic highlights on silver, dark ground, painterly erasure around the figures.
1059_crash.jpg.Typography: Very large, widely letterspaced thin sans capitals reading CRASH, rotated 90 degrees to run vertically down a black rectangle, cream colored; small cast names also rotated at right, director credit rotated at left.
1059_crash.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with cool silver-gray metal, pale flesh and a small red tail light; dramatic spotlight on the wreck.
1059_crash.jpg.Story it suggests: Bodies and a wrecked machine merge in the dark, implying violence and desire fused together.
1059_crash.jpg.Visual idea: Flesh and crumpled metal rendered as one surface, tying collision to intimacy.

1060_amores-perros.jpg.People: None clearly; a bold abstract drawing with wavy bands, spirals and zigzag teeth that could read as a dog's open jaws or a totem. Ambiguous.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Composition: A large vertical mound of wavy stripes fills the lower two-thirds, nearly symmetric around a central zigzag channel; the title is stacked in the top third, in two big text lines.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Medium: Hand-drawn ink and marker on cream paper, dense stippled dots, thick black outlines, and brush-painted letters with visible bristle streaks.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Typography: Rough hand-painted block capitals, the title in black filling the full width, the director name in red even larger, with a small black lettered phrase between them; letters are uneven and slightly jittery. The top row overlaps the collection logo. No typeset font; it all looks painted.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Color and light: Cream, black and a bright red; flat, matte.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Story it suggests: Raw, snarling energy, jaws or flesh, a feral love story.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Visual idea: A naive tribal drawing where waves and teeth merge, so the poster looks like an animal mouth or a woodcut.
1060_amores-perros.jpg.Feels like: Folk art or outsider drawing in a contemporary indie design, around 2000.

1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.People: Three young men seen from behind as dark silhouettes, standing side by side at a railing, full or three-quarter body; one holds a skateboard, one a camera. They are companions looking in the same direction.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Composition: Frontal row of three figures filling the lower two-thirds, anchored by a horizontal railing and posts; a big sky above and a small town far below at the bottom edge; roughly symmetric balanced layout.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Medium: Digital gouache-like painting with flat blocky shapes and rough brushed texture in the sky, visible dabs of color.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered, uneven black marker-style capitals reading MINDING THE GAP at upper right, tilted and bouncy, with a smaller handwritten credit below; sits in the sky and reads as scribbled by hand.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Color and light: Coral pink and salmon sunset sky against deep navy-black silhouettes, soft warm dusk light.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Story it suggests: Friends pause at the edge of a town at sunset, looking out at a future or at where they came from.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Visual idea: Silhouettes turn the viewer into a fourth watcher beside them, sharing their view.
1061_minding-the-gap.jpg.Feels like: Coming-of-age indie documentary, contemporary illustrated nostalgia.

1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.People: A crowd of dozens: a giant mirrored face in a wide-brimmed hat top, a guitarist at center, and a pyramid of collaged heads and figures below, many cut-out and duplicated. Some are mirrored copies, and a small flag and document are mixed in.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Composition: Bilateral symmetry about a central vertical axis; the large doubled face forms the top, the figures stack in a triangle pointing up, and star-and-stripe sunbursts radiate from the center.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Medium: Cut-and-paste collage with halftone dots and duotone tints, print-like texture with worn paper and screenprint registration.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Typography: Big arched circus-style ornamental capitals with stars in red, white and blue, curving over the hat brim at the top; smaller bold serif credit line beneath; decorative, vintage, typeset.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Color and light: Dusty red, slate blue, tan and cream on a pale gray ground; flat even print light.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Story it suggests: A traveling show of performers and hangers-on crowd around a central singer, suggesting spectacle and a carnival of characters.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Visual idea: Mirror symmetry and radiating stripes make a patriotic circus poster out of a crowd of faces.
1062_rolling-thunder-revue-a-bob-dylan-s.Feels like: 1970s Americana, vintage circus and political poster, psychedelic collage.

1063_the-ascent.jpg.People: One man, extreme close-up of his face and hair, cropped at the bottom, lying on his back and looking up at the camera with wide eyes. He is alone.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Composition: Large empty top two-thirds, title floating in the middle, face pushed to the bottom edge; horizontal horizon band separates sky from snowy ground; central axis alignment.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Medium: Black and white photographic film still with grain, soft focus and foggy tone.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Typography: Wide-spaced thin italic serif capitals THE ASCENT in the middle, dark gray, with weathered, slightly eroded edges; small spaced sans credit above; centered and quiet over the empty sky.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Color and light: Almost monochrome pale gray and white, overcast diffuse light with dark gray face.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Story it suggests: A man lies exposed in a bleak white landscape, gazing up with fear or exhaustion.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Visual idea: The face sinks to the bottom beneath an enormous blank sky, turning emptiness into pressure.
1063_the-ascent.jpg.Feels like: Austere art-house war or survival drama, black-and-white 1970s cinema.

1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.People: One man's head and shoulders in profile facing right, shown only as a pale silhouette; face has no features. A bullet tunnel runs through the head, so it reads as a symbol more than a portrait.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Composition: Huge central silhouette on black, with a horizontal wedge cut out through the skull from left to right; a small bullet at the start of the cut in the middle. The title is at the top, across the full width.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic cut-paper look with grainy, speckled edges on the silhouette; the bullet has a hand-drawn or painted texture.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Typography: Title in large pale pink wide stencil-like capitals, with vertical slits and splits, across the top; a smaller condensed credit sits above it, partly merged with the logo. The slits make the letters look like bars or slats.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Color and light: Black with a dusty pale pink figure and a blue-red-white striped bullet; flat, high contrast.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is hit through the head by a bullet that carries a national symbol.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Visual idea: A bullet wearing a national flag boring through a head: violence as an emblem.
1064_the-parallax-view.jpg.Feels like: 1970s conspiracy thriller poster, modern print look.

1065_mandabi.jpg.People: A single man, front-facing, shoulders-up, with both hands raised on either side of his head as if showing his palms. He wears a patterned cap and a white garment; he is drawn, not photographed.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Composition: Strict central symmetry: a face at center with a pointed cap, two raised hands balancing left and right, columns of fabric at both sides, title across the top.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Medium: Paper collage with pen cross-hatching and ink contour lines over cut paper, patterned textile swatches, and a background of layered stamped postal forms with rubber stamps.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Typography: Large white serif capitals MANDABI across the top, with a smaller italic subtitle under; a credit line above in upright mixed-case; crisp and typeset, overlapping the background stamps.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Color and light: Warm yellow-ochre and orange with white, blue, green and purple stripes; flat even illustration light.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Story it suggests: A worried man holds up open hands amid paperwork and official stamps, suggesting a bureaucratic burden.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Visual idea: The face is built from the same cross-hatched paper as the bureaucratic forms, making the man part of the paperwork.
1065_mandabi.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century African art-house, handmade contemporary collage.

1066_man-push-cart.jpg.People: One man, full body, walking at the right of a street cart, staring ahead with a hooded or hatted head; he is alone and small relative to the cart behind him. A taxi sits behind.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Composition: Central vertical cart rising up the middle with the man at its right foot; title stacked above; bokeh street lights scattered around; deep perspective.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Medium: Photographic night still, grainy and soft with blurred bokeh circles.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Typography: Large widely spaced white sans capitals stacked in three lines (MAN / PUSH / CART) with offset indentation above the cart, slightly textured; small handwritten credit to the right; overlays the dark upper area.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy-black with warm orange, yellow and white lights; wet night-street glow.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Story it suggests: A street vendor trudges through a cold city night, pulling a lonely livelihood along.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Visual idea: The title wraps like a stacked sign above the cart, as if the lettering itself were pushed along the street.
1066_man-push-cart.jpg.Feels like: Gritty indie urban realism, 2000s American independent film.

1067_chop-shop.jpg.People: Two people, half-body: a smiling young woman wraps her arms around a boy in front of her, both looking off to the right. They are close, protective or playful.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Composition: Pair sits low-left of center; large blank white upper half holds the title; a blurred street with a sign and a parked car forms a horizontal band behind them.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with soft focus, faded color and film grain; the top dissolves into white with a faint watercolor-like edge.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Typography: Widely letterspaced sans capitals CHOP / SHOP stacked in two lines at upper center, the first dark brown and the second pale tan, with a halftone dot texture; a small handwritten credit sits to the right below it.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Color and light: Washed-out warm beige, white and sky gray with a maroon car and a bright yellow sign; flat overcast daylight.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman and boy share a moment of affection on a rundown city street.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Visual idea: The title dissolves into a blank white sky, leaving the street and the two figures as the whole story.
1067_chop-shop.jpg.Feels like: Naturalistic urban indie drama, mid-2000s American independent film.

1068_smooth-talk.jpg.People: Two people, half-body, a young blonde woman in a white camisole and a dark-haired young man leaning behind her with his arm over her shoulder, both looking at the viewer. He hovers over her; her expression is guarded or wary while he is intent.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Composition: Layered diagonal: the man's head at upper center, her figure forward at right; a porch post and plants frame the left; scripted title crosses the lower half; a lilac border frames the entire poster.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Medium: Colored-pencil or airbrushed illustration with fine hatching and soft blended skin tones, evoking a hand-painted 1980s poster.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Typography: Huge hot-pink flowing script, SMOOTH TALK, cut in two lines on a steep rising slant across the lower half, with thin outline; smaller black sans credit at right; the letters overlap the plant and figure.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Color and light: Pastel white, cream and green with hot pink and lilac accents; soft, even daylight.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl on a porch stands between boy-next-door charm and a growing unease.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Visual idea: Pink script draws a slanted line through the figures like a signature, adding glamour and menace.
1068_smooth-talk.jpg.Feels like: 1980s teen drama, hand-painted video-store poster, summer coming-of-age.

1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.People: Two figures drawn crudely, sitting or tumbling with legs kicked up, one with brown hair in a pink top and one with orange curls in pale blue; bare feet, waving hands. They are playful partners, drawn as sketchy cartoons, with some faces barely formed.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Composition: Scattered, loose composition with title at the top and credit at the bottom; figures in the lower middle; large white spaces with random paint splashes and long black lines like a floor and sky.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache and watercolor with brush ink, quick calligraphic black strokes, visible blobs and smears on white paper.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Typography: Huge black hand-lettered brush capitals spread unevenly across the top half, tilted, with irregular baseline and accent; handwritten credit across the bottom. Letters and figures share the same brush energy.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Color and light: White paper with sky blues, orange hair, pink, green and yellow spots; bright flat light.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Story it suggests: Two friends tumble in a messy, laughing heap, as if a game has gone out of control.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Visual idea: The poster looks like a child's rough painting, giving the title and figures equal scribbled treatment.
1069_celine-and-julie-go-boating.jpg.Feels like: 1970s French New Wave playfulness, contemporary hand-drawn art.

1070_secrets-lies.jpg.People: Two women seated side by side at a cafe table, both facing the camera at shoulder-up and half-body, one in a black blazer with a calm, guarded look and one in a pale jacket with a startled, worried face and a cigarette. Together but emotionally apart.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical frontal two-shot at the bottom with the figures flanking a central open doorway; large empty room above holds the title; a table with cups along the bottom edge.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with grain, slight muted tone and a hazy, translucent quality.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Typography: Very large heavy bold sans capitals SECRETS & LIES in dark olive-brown across the upper half; smaller letterspaced credit below; centered, bold and solid over the blurred ceiling.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Color and light: Muted olive, beige, brown and cream with a black jacket; flat fluorescent interior light.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women who barely know each other sit in an awkward public meeting, each holding something back.
1070_secrets-lies.jpg.Visual idea: Two women flank an open door, the gap between them and their expressions carrying the secret.

1071_defending-your-life.jpg.People: Two people, full body, a man and a woman in matching white robes standing close, facing each other and holding hands, small next to the billboard. They appear affectionate and calm.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Composition: Cutout composition on pure white: a large billboard fills the upper right, the couple stands at its left edge, and text blocks sit lower right; the white void gives lots of empty space.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Medium: Glossy airbrushed commercial illustration and photo composite with clean cutout edges, in a 1980s-90s promotional style.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Typography: Tall condensed black serif title Defending Your Life in the lower right, large, with credit names above and a smaller credit below; a small gray tagline across the top; typeset and understated. The billboard has its own white bold sans lettering.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Color and light: White ground with saturated blue billboard sign, white robes, red-and-silver bus; bright, clean, shadowless light.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple in white stands beside an advertisement for a mysterious, too-pleasant city, as if arriving somewhere surreal.
1071_defending-your-life.jpg.Visual idea: A billboard within the poster promises a destination, a frame-within-frame advertisement for an afterlife.

1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.People: Two people embracing in the center, half-body, faces nearly touching; four small heads and cutout silhouettes of dancing couples surround them. One head wears a chef's hat and has a mustache; another scowls. The central pair is clear and intimate; the rest are decorations.
