1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Composition: Central circle formed by a swirling golden-yellow ring with a sun disc behind the embracing pair; ship at the bottom and landmarks around the edges in a symmetric arrangement; stars scattered all over.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Medium: Flat screenprint-like digital illustration with textured grain, hand-cut shapes and wavy comb-like strokes in the halo and water.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Typography: Bold hand-cut orange-yellow sans capitals in two big lines, slightly bouncy and tilted, HISTORY IS / MADE AT NIGHT, across the top above the circle; small italic and caps credit above; textured, ornamental and blocky.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Color and light: Deep navy night with golden yellow, orange, cream, red and brown; glowing moonlit warmth.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Story it suggests: A passionate couple embrace under a huge moon, with a ship, a chef, a rival and landmarks hinting at a romantic sea voyage full of peril.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Visual idea: A moon-like halo holds the lovers while the plot props orbit around them like charms on a bracelet.
1072_history-is-made-at-night.jpg.Feels like: 1930s romantic adventure, Art Deco travel poster, contemporary reinterpretation.

1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.People: One partial human figure: only a bound hand and wrist, emerging from dense grass, with the rest of the body hidden. Whether it is a body is only suggested; no face is visible.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Composition: Dense all-over texture of grass with a small opening at lower right showing the hand; the title sits at top center in the upper-middle; strong contrast between full field and a single small focus.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Medium: Detailed ink-and-watercolor-like illustration with hatched blades of grass, crosshatched shadow and a yellow-green tint.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Typography: Tall, condensed cream capitals MEMORIES / OF MURDER in the upper center, with grass blades cut across the letters in front so parts of them are interrupted; smaller credit below in light sans; letters look woven into the grass.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Color and light: Olive green and yellow-green with cream and pale skin tones; flat late-afternoon haze.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Story it suggests: A body lies hidden in a field of tall grass, with its tied hand the only evidence left.
1073_memories-of-murder.jpg.Visual idea: The grass swallows both the title and the corpse, so concealment itself is the image.

1074_irma-vep.jpg.People: One woman, upper body, in a glossy black catsuit and mask-like makeup, leaning on a film strip and looking aside. She appears as a masked cat-burglar figure; a film strip frames her.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Composition: Diagonal: a film strip slants from lower right up to the upper left, with the woman perched on it; a skyline of a cathedral sits behind at upper left; the big title fills the dark lower half.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Medium: High-contrast photocopy or xerox collage with grainy black-and-white halftone, scratchy paint strokes and torn-paper stickers.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Typography: Large jagged hand-scratched white capitals IRMA / VEP in two lines, crackled and irregular like scratched into black paint, tilted and filling the bottom half; the credit in a torn label with cut-out letters; raw, DIY, ransom-note style.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and a little warm brown-gray; harsh flat photocopy light.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Story it suggests: A masked figure prowls above a city, as if slipping out of a film strip into real streets.
1074_irma-vep.jpg.Visual idea: The film strip is a bridge between cinema and the city; the scratched title looks as if etched by the character.

1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.People: Seven young people shown as portrait photos inside round pin-back buttons arranged around a central black button; each face is cropped tight, looking at the camera or off to the side. They appear as a peer group, one button per person.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Composition: Ring of seven small buttons orbiting a large black central button on a checkerboard field with overlapping blobs of color; roughly radial and centered, with credit labels in the corners.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Medium: Collage of halftone photos, torn-paper label strips and flat color shapes with glossy button highlights; Memphis-style 1980s pattern, with taped paper bits.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Typography: Huge outlined white-on-black chunky stencil-like letters FAST TIMES in the central button with smaller AT RIDGEMONT HIGH below; director and writer credits on white paper strips mixing spaced sans and a fractured black display font; punky and playful.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink, cyan, yellow and black-and-white checks; bright flat pop colors.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Story it suggests: A cast of teenagers is collected like badges in one school-days scrapbook, each a distinct personality.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Visual idea: The pin-back buttons turn characters into collectible badges that orbit a single school-spirit emblem.
1075_fast-times-at-ridgemont-high.jpg.Feels like: 1980s teen comedy, punk and Memphis pop.

1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.People: Two people, half-body, a man in a black suit and a woman in a lace veil and wedding dress, holding hands in a ceremony; he looks downward with a troubled face, and she looks up at him with worry. They are a newlywed pair under strain.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Composition: Two figures cut diagonally in the lower two-thirds; a church altar with candles and lilies behind; title in the upper half curving down to the right; central arched door gives symmetry behind them.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Medium: Digital painting in the manner of a vintage hand-colored poster, with soft shading, fine lace detail and subtle paper grain.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Typography: Large cream-yellow swashy brush-script title in quotation marks, angled uphill and fading to orange in the last line, with small stylized cast names at top and credit left; glossy, retro.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange-ochre, red carpet, black suit and white lace with candle glow; warm church light.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Story it suggests: A wedding that should be joyful is shadowed by doubt, and the title hints at ruin.
1076_merrily-we-go-to-hell.jpg.Visual idea: Wedding trappings of lace and candles contrast with the cheerful script saying they are headed to damnation.

1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.People: Faint ghostly faces of women, one at upper left with an ornate hair ornament and two or three more barely visible lower left and bottom, rendered like ink drawings; large flowers dominate. The figures are ambiguous, translucent and layered into the pattern.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Composition: Big chrysanthemum glowing at lower right center, peonies above, and the woman's face looming translucent at upper left; diagonal sweep of petals and smoky ink; title in the lower right.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Medium: Digital painting with ink washes, translucent layers, gold leaf-like texture and dark smoky gradients.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Typography: Thin elegant red-orange serif capitals FLOWERS OF / SHANGHAI in the lower right in two lines, with small credit below; light, spaced and calm over the dark ground.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Color and light: Dark green and black ground with glowing gold, cream and orange flowers; lantern-like glow in the dark.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Story it suggests: Women are half-seen behind a screen of flowers, suggesting beauty bound up with confinement and fading memory.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Visual idea: The flowers stand for the women, and layered transparencies make faces float like memories.
1077_flowers-of-shanghai.jpg.Feels like: East Asian period drama, Qing-era decorative art, lush and melancholic.

1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.People: One man, full body, hanging upside down by a rope tied to his ankle; his face is turned down at the bottom, partly in shadow. He is performing, trapped or condemned, and alone on stage.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Composition: Strictly symmetric theatrical frame: curtains on both sides, a banner arching across the top, the man dangling along the vertical center axis and two yellow credit blobs at the bottom corners.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Medium: Spray-grain screenprint look, flat red and orange inks with stippled shading and soft airbrushed glows; fairground banner and velvet curtains drawn in speckled texture.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Typography: Ornate carnival-style red-and-gold capital title NIGHTMARE ALLEY on a curling yellow ribbon banner across the top, with playful hand-lettered black credits on yellow circular glows; bold, decorative and period.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, black, mustard yellow and teal-blue trousers; spotlight on a dark stage.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Story it suggests: A showman dangles upside down on a stage, suggesting a stunt turned into downfall.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Visual idea: The title and the inverted figure invert a circus world, turning a theatrical stage into a trap.
1078_nightmare-alley.jpg.Feels like: 1940s film noir carnival poster, vintage showbill revival.

1079_streetwise.jpg.People: One boy, small silhouette-like figure in a cap and t-shirt, caught mid-air in a jump off a ledge, seen from below. Alone and tiny against sky.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Composition: Large empty pale sky with the figure placed upper center-left; a diagonal bridge or overpass railing runs from lower left; a tall vertical pole on the left; black title band across the bottom.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with visible grain and slightly faded color.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Typography: Bold white heavy sans capitals STREETWISE on a black bar at the bottom, centered and wide, with a small spaced credit line in gray and white below; separate from the image.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Color and light: Peach-beige sky with muted blue shirt and dark jeans, soft hazy daylight; black band at bottom.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Story it suggests: A kid leaps off a high structure, a moment of freedom or danger frozen against an empty sky.
1079_streetwise.jpg.Visual idea: The jump is frozen in an empty sky, the black bar below like the ground waiting.

1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.People: A girl in a dark dress, veiled cap and gloves, shown repeatedly across the frames of a contact sheet, arms crossed, half-body or cropped at the face; several frames, one marked. She looks sullen or guarded.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Composition: Tilted contact sheet filling the frame, with film strip borders and a central red circle and pink X marking the selected frame; black title band across the bottom.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Medium: Photographic proof sheet on film with edge numbers and Kodak markings, red grease-pencil circle and pink crayon X, a taped label, as if scanned from an actual darkroom print.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Typography: Bold white heavy sans TINY in large letters at lower left of the black band, with a smaller multi-line subtitle to its right and spaced gray credit; typeset and separate from the image. A black handwritten BOOK COVER on a red label inside the image.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Color and light: Black-and-white proofs with strong red and pink marker and a black band; flat scanned lightbox light.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Story it suggests: A photographer chooses one frame of a girl from many, picking a single image of someone's life.
1080_tiny-the-life-of-erin-blackwell.jpg.Visual idea: The editor's marks on the contact sheet turn the cover into an act of selecting and judging a person.

1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.People: Several runners and jumpers: a woman with arms up at upper left, a male athlete leaping over a bar at center, a female athlete tumbling at lower right, plus ghosted color copies of athletes. They are overlapping figures in motion.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Composition: Overlapping diagonals: a bar crosses the center from left to right, figures staggered along a diagonal from upper left to lower right; a list of eight segments lower left; title upper right.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Medium: Multi-layer color separation or risograph look: figures printed in overprinting red-orange, blue, yellow and green on cream paper with grain and misregistration.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Typography: Large dark gray rounded geometric sans Visions of Eight at upper right, mixed case, with a small spaced caps line above; a left-aligned list of eight titles with small director credits at lower left; typeset and tidy.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Color and light: Cream ground with vivid red-orange, cobalt blue, sunny yellow and green overprints; flat even light.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Story it suggests: Athletes strain, leap and fall in a blur of motion as an event is watched from many angles.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Visual idea: Overprinted color layers show each athlete as repeated exposures, making motion from eight perspectives.
1081_visions-of-eight.jpg.Feels like: 1970s Olympic sports documentary, Swiss-style print poster.

1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.People: One man in a very large close-up face looking straight at the viewer, with two other smaller images: a blurred pair in embrace at right and three repeating tinted face-to-face pairs along the bottom. The big face dominates; the others are fragmentary.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Composition: Large face at left center, tall title block at upper right, a scanline-striped blurred image at the lower right, and a row of three tinted pairs at the bottom; mostly dark ground.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Medium: Video-still look with scan lines, pixel noise, glitchy color shifts and tinted halftone duotones in red, blue and green.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Typography: Tall condensed beige-cream capitals stacked in four lines, filling the right third of the poster, flush left; flat, heavy and typeset, set against the dark.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Color and light: Black ground with a warm brown skin tone, bursts of red-orange, ice blue and green; dim CRT-like glow.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Story it suggests: A man looks directly at us while other bodies and kisses flicker past like images on a television.
1082_the-signifyin-works-of-marlon-riggs.Visual idea: Video screens layered together like a mosaic of tapes, with the stare of the central face tying them.

1083_pariah.jpg.People: Two overlapping faces of young people: a large close-up of a face in profile-ish three-quarter view at left, and a smaller, frontal face at right, both with short cropped hair or caps. Layered translucently, they could be two selves or two people; ambiguous.
1083_pariah.jpg.Composition: Two big faces side by side with overlapping translucent layers; huge title across the top edge and huge credit name across the bottom, so type frames the faces top and bottom.
1083_pariah.jpg.Medium: Digital painting with transparent overlaid planes, color-shifted blocks, soft brushwork and smeared edges.
1083_pariah.jpg.Typography: Very tall, thin, widely spaced pale mint-green sans capitals PARIAH filling the entire top width and cut by the top edge; the director's name in similar giant pink-gray capitals across the bottom, cropped at the edge; smaller spaced line between; translucent and gradient.
1083_pariah.jpg.Color and light: Purple, magenta and violet with acid green highlights; neon night glow.
1083_pariah.jpg.Story it suggests: A young person looks away in thought, while another self gazes straight out, suggesting a divided identity.
1083_pariah.jpg.Visual idea: Doubled, overlapping faces in a bruise-colored haze visualize someone caught between two selves.
1083_pariah.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary indie coming-of-age drama, 2010s digital-painting poster.

1084_mirror.jpg.People: One woman, seen from behind and small, sitting on a wooden fence and looking at a field; she appears twice, once right-side up and once reflected upside down above. The reflection is a mirror image rather than a second person.
1084_mirror.jpg.Composition: Exact vertical mirror symmetry about a horizontal axis through the center, with a blank white sky in the middle holding the title; trees, fence and fields at top and bottom reflect each other.
1084_mirror.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with soft natural color and grain, flipped digitally to form the mirror.
1084_mirror.jpg.Typography: Medium-size bold black sans Mirror at center right, with a smaller two-line credit left of it, all horizontal in the white sky, so the title sits in the exact gap between the two images.
1084_mirror.jpg.Color and light: Soft green, ochre and white sky; calm, even overcast daylight.
1084_mirror.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman sits alone gazing across a quiet field, and her world is doubled by a reflection, suggesting memory or an inverted self.
1084_mirror.jpg.Visual idea: The image is folded in half so the sky becomes a seam; the title sits at the line where the world reflects.
1084_mirror.jpg.Feels like: Slow, lyrical art-house cinema, 1970s Soviet pastoral.

1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.People: Two people shown only as small black-and-white head photos, a man with round glasses and a woman looking sideways, cut out and set inside the letters of the title, close together. Plus a cartoon leopard formed by the letters.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Composition: Title letters piled up in two layers, with the leopard's head at lower left and tail curling up the right; faces sit in the center between the letter U and P; open pale background.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Medium: Flat cutout illustration with spotted leopard-fur texture, brush-painted letters, thin line-drawn legs and paper-cut black-and-white photos.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Typography: Huge chunky hand-cut letters BRINGING UP BABY forming an animal: the top words in dark gray-brown with a bone for the I, the bottom word BABY in leopard-spotted orange as the leopard's body with a tail as the apostrophe-like stroke; playful, characterful, tactile; small spaced serif credits at top and bottom.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream background with leopard orange and dark brown; flat soft light.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Story it suggests: A bumbling pair is tangled up with a leopard that behaves like a pet.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Visual idea: The title letters become the animal, a typographic pun in which the word is the leopard.
1085_bringing-up-baby.jpg.Feels like: 1930s screwball comedy, playful mid-century lettering poster.

1086_deep-cover.jpg.People: One man, close-up from the chest up, looking directly at the viewer with a stern, wary expression; his face is split by two light colors. Several paper bills flutter around him.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Composition: Centered symmetric portrait filling the poster with money floating around his head; a huge title crosses the top and is partly cut off by the edge; credit at upper right.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Medium: Digital oil-like painting with visible brushstrokes, smooth neon color blocking and slight canvas grain.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Typography: Enormous bold condensed sans DEEP COVER spanning the full top width, with a vertical gradient from pink to blue, partly cropped by the top edge and overlapped by the logo; smaller blue credit at right; strong, glossy and cinematic.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Color and light: Split lighting in hot magenta and electric blue on a near-black ground; neon, nighttime club glow.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Story it suggests: An undercover man stares with suspicion as cash falls around him, hinting at temptation and double lives.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Visual idea: The two-tone light cuts his face in half, a visual double identity, with falling money as bait.
1086_deep-cover.jpg.Feels like: 1990s neo-noir crime thriller, synthwave-inflected modern art.

1087_working-girls.jpg.People: Two people shown in cropped fragments: at left an older man's arm and white shirt, with his reflection in a mirror above; at right a woman's torso in black lingerie, faces cut off. Their hands meet at the center passing a small card.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Composition: A framed photo in a gold border centered on a black field; title WORKING above and GIRLS below, hands meeting at the exact middle; symmetric stacked layout.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Medium: Color snapshot-style photograph with dim flash lighting, slightly grainy, set into a thick tan frame.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Typography: Very heavy bold sans capitals in tan WORKING across the width above the photo and GIRLS centered below it, both stretched to fill; a small spaced credit line at top; flat typeset.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Color and light: Black and tan frame, deep navy backdrop, cream shirt and black lingerie; harsh indoor flash.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Story it suggests: A transaction takes place in a small room, a card passing between anonymous hands.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Visual idea: Cropping the faces out turns the pair into a transaction, and the frame treats it like a document.
1087_working-girls.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American independent drama, stark photo-with-frame design.

1088_la-piscine.jpg.People: Two people, a shirtless man and a woman lying on a pool's edge, locked in an embrace with his face just above hers, their lips nearly touching. They are passionate, entangled bodies, close-up.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Composition: Diagonal composition of two intertwined bodies filling the lower two-thirds; blurred trees at the top, turquoise pool at left; title across the center above their heads, straight horizontal.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Medium: Color photographic still with warm film grain, sunlit, wet skin sheen.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Typography: Widely letterspaced white sans capitals LA PISCINE in a single line across the middle, with the S and E smeared by motion blur, as if the letters were splashed; small brown spaced credit at the bottom; overlays the dark trees just above the figures.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Color and light: Warm golden skin and sand with green trees and turquoise water; hot, sunny afternoon light.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers press together by a pool in the sun, with desire and a hint of threat.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Visual idea: The blurred letters mimic water ripples, and the pool is the stage of their passion.
1088_la-piscine.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French summer erotic thriller, sun-soaked color photography.

1089_after-life.jpg.People: Upper half: no people, an empty wooden chair against a green wall. Lower half: five people (an adult man, a woman and three children) seen from behind, waving cloths and handkerchiefs toward a painted sky and a tree with pink blossoms. The group is united, looking up.
1089_after-life.jpg.Composition: Split into two stacked panels, top and bottom, with a horizontal seam in the middle; the chair centered above and the group slightly right below; the title is divided across the seam, AFTER in the top panel and LIFE in the bottom.
1089_after-life.jpg.Medium: Photographic film stills, soft natural color and grain, with the lower image a painted-sky studio set.
1089_after-life.jpg.Typography: Large clean pale cream sans capitals, AFTER at the top and LIFE at the bottom, each placed in its own panel and overlapping the chair and the people; the credit in small spaced caps at the seam; typeset, quiet.
1089_after-life.jpg.Color and light: Pale green wall with brown wood on top and soft sky blue, cream clouds and pink blossoms below; gentle, diffuse daylight.
1089_after-life.jpg.Story it suggests: An empty seat waits in one room while a family waves to something above in another place, suggesting departure and memory.
1089_after-life.jpg.Visual idea: Two frames, empty chair and waving family, stand for before and after, with the word split between them.

1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.People: About eight small black silhouettes of performers (a singer with raised arm, a conductor, a seated pair, a woman at a music stand, a figure with hand on face, trombone and trumpet players) are each cropped inside a giant letter. They are tiny relative to the poster and do not interact, each in its own compartment.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Composition: Huge letters spell the title in a zigzag, stacked in a staggered arrangement down the poster, with the credits wedged into the gaps. A dotted border frames the whole page and a cast list sits left of the P and A. The eye moves from the top left C down to the bottom Y.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink in orange, white and plum on a speckled, paper-like textured purple ground, as in a screenprint or record sleeve. Letters are outlined with multiple concentric inline strokes.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Typography: The title letters are enormous, each spanning about a fifth of the poster, built from triple-line outlines and acting as picture frames for the silhouettes. A smaller white sans-serif line spells the album name at the top, with condensed white and orange credits and a centered cast list.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Color and light: Deep purple, bright orange and cream white; flat, no real light source, just a graphic glow.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of musicians and singers are caught mid-performance in a recording session, each separate yet part of one whole.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Visual idea: The letters of the title become windows or stage booths holding the people who make up the ensemble, like a group portrait in alphabet form.
1090_original-cast-album-company.jpg.Feels like: Early 1970s record album sleeve, psychedelic-era musical.

1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.People: One young person, shoulders up to chest, large and central, facing the viewer with a solemn stare. A band of ammunition drapes diagonally across the bare chest.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Composition: The head sits at the upper center and fills most of the upper two thirds, with the diagonal ammunition belt sweeping from the shoulder to the bottom right. Jagged yellow marks run down the right edge and the title sits in the lower right.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Medium: Rough two-color print with visible burlap or canvas weave texture, ink speckle and rough edges, like a stencil or linocut over woven cloth.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Typography: The title is stacked in three lines in white hand-drawn, chunky and chipped capitals in the lower right, angled slightly, partly overprinting the body. The credit below is in a loose handwritten lowercase and caps scrawl.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Color and light: Dark forest green on tan burlap with mustard yellow accents; flat, high contrast, no true lighting.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Story it suggests: A child is made to carry the tools of war and looks out with an unreadable, guarded gaze.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Visual idea: A portrait rendered as crude stenciled ink on sackcloth, making the bullets and the face look hand-made and improvised.
1091_beasts-of-no-nation.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary hand-printed war drama, protest-poster aesthetic.

1092_throw-down.jpg.People: Two men: a large close-up face of a man lying on the floor with a tear on his cheek, filling the lower left and middle; a smaller, full standing figure in a jacket in the background on a stage, facing him with hands slightly open.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Composition: A diagonal stack: the sprawled head and hand fill the bottom, the standing figure sits upper right beside a red disc, and the title arcs between them. Curtains form vertical stripes behind.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Medium: Painterly digital illustration with soft airbrushed gradients, glossy skin highlights and sparkling glitter points.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Typography: The title is huge, in yellow brush-script, stacked as two words slanting across the upper half, with a loose swoosh above, overlapping the figures. A small pink 'A film by' credit sits bottom right in plain capitals.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Color and light: Hot magenta, violet and crimson with yellow lettering; stage-spot neon glow with a red moon-like circle.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is down on the floor, crying and defeated, while another man stands over a stage watching.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Visual idea: Defeat is shown from the floor, framing the fallen face at gigantic scale against a distant looming rival under a neon spotlight.
1092_throw-down.jpg.Feels like: 1980s neon nightlife, retro synth-style crime or romance.

1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.People: A man and a woman in profile, large, shoulders up, side by side facing left, the man in front and the woman behind and smaller. A tiny inset shows a soldier in a cap inside a star.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Composition: A thick black frame holds a cream header panel with title, a credit box and a small star inset; below, a big rectangular photo takes about two thirds of the page. The two profiles are stacked diagonally and look in the same direction.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photographic still, with flat black frame and cream paper texture around it.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Typography: The title is in black condensed heavy sans-serif capitals, left aligned, in two lines at the top, about a tenth of the poster height; the credit is in italic serif capitals inside a ruled box.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grays on cream; soft low-key lighting from the left.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people close together look the same way, pensive and quiet, sharing something tender but uncertain.
1093_the-story-of-a-three-day-pass.jpg.Visual idea: A dossier or ID-card layout, with a small uniformed portrait in a star badge hinting at an official identity beside an intimate pair.

1094_watermelon-man.jpg.People: Two giant profile faces facing each other, one pale and one dark, cropped at neck, filling the whole lower panel; a tiny smiling face in a star at the top right.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Composition: Strict mirror symmetry: two profiles nose to nose across a central vertical split, one on a brown ground, the other on a cream ground. A header block holds the title above.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone dots in black, with flat tan or brown solid fills and a screenprint feel, on cream paper texture.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Typography: The title is in bold black condensed capitals, left aligned in the header, small relative to the faces; the credit is in italic serif in a box.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Color and light: Black, cream and burnt orange-brown; flat, graphic, no real light.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Story it suggests: Two faces confront each other as opposites, one becoming or mirroring the other.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Visual idea: A negative-and-positive mirror pair, swapping light and dark in the same face to suggest changing identity.
1094_watermelon-man.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s to 1970s protest and pop-art poster.

1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.People: A huge face of a man in a brimmed hat dominates the middle; below, a small police officer between two police cars; a tiny profile in a star at the top right. The giant face dwarfs the officer.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Composition: A strongly central, symmetric radiating composition: brown sunburst rays fan out behind the face, and the two mirrored cars flank the tiny officer at the bottom. The framed header sits above.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Medium: High-contrast posterized black and white, like a photocopy or woodcut, with flat tan rays on cream paper.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Typography: The title is in black condensed capitals, two lines, left aligned in the header; a red 'Rated X by an all-white jury' stamp-like box sits at the bottom right.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Color and light: Black, off-white and brown, with a touch of red; hard, stark, shadowy.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Story it suggests: A towering man looms over the police who are closing in, a standoff between one person and the law.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Visual idea: Scale inversion, making the pursued figure a giant over the tiny enforcers, in the manner of a propaganda poster.
1095_sweet-sweetback-s-baadassss-song.jp.Feels like: 1970s protest and propaganda poster, gritty exploitation-era.

1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.People: Three people, half body and large: a woman in yellow on the left, an older woman in a headwrap in gray in the middle, a young man in a red shirt with a wide scarf on the right, closer and bigger. Another small man's face is in a star above.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Composition: The three overlap in a staggered diagonal against a flat navy panel, the man in the right foreground and the woman at left smaller and farther. A framed header sits on top.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Medium: Cut-out photographs tinted with single flat colors (yellow, gray, red), with film grain, on a navy block and cream paper.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Typography: The title is black condensed bold capitals, left aligned in the header, small to medium; the credit sits in an italic serif box.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Color and light: Navy, mustard yellow, gray and red on cream; flat, graphic.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Story it suggests: A lively trio is singing and smiling, a joyful gathering of friends and neighbors.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Visual idea: Each person is tinted a different primary-like color, like paper cut-outs, so a group portrait reads as a colorful collage.
1096_don-t-play-us-cheap.jpg.Feels like: 1970s musical comedy and community theater, collage style.

1097_love-basketball.jpg.People: A man and a woman, half body, large, filling nearly the whole poster; she leans back against him looking straight at the viewer while he looks down with his arm around her. A basketball rests in her arms.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Composition: The couple is packed tightly in the center and lower area, overlapping bodies forming a diagonal from his bowed head down to the ball at lower right. The title sits low over their torsos; the credit at top right.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Medium: Photographic portrait with a sepia, duotone-like toning and soft film grain; title in hand-drawn marker.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Typography: The title is yellow, hand-scrawled brush-marker capitals, stacked in two lines at lower center, about a sixth of the poster height, drawn over the bodies, with a scribbled heart beneath. The director credit in gray-beige bold sans-serif at the top right.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Color and light: Warm brown, sepia and cream with yellow lettering; soft dim light on skin.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Story it suggests: Two athletes lean on each other in a quiet, intimate moment, sharing love and tension off the court.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Visual idea: The ball is held between them like a third presence, joining sport and romance in one embrace.
1097_love-basketball.jpg.Feels like: Late 1990s to 2000 romantic drama, glossy yet intimate.

1098_the-damned.jpg.People: A woman at left, pale blue, her face in profile with closed eyes, curled hair, kissing or clinging to a skull held between her hands; a second hand with red nails grips the skull from the right. Half-body, huge, filling the poster.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Composition: Large diagonal sweep from top-left hair to the lower-right arm; the skull is at the center, with a red banner hanging from the top right like a flag holding the title.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Medium: Dry-brush gouache or acrylic illustration with chalky strokes on a flat black ground.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Typography: Blackletter title in dark ink on a red ragged banner at the top right, about a third of the width; small sans credit beneath. The banner hangs from the top edge like a flag.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with cold blue-gray skin, and blood-red nails and banner; theatrical single-source spotlight, funereal.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman embraces death itself, a decadent love for something rotten.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Visual idea: Red nails and banner as the only warm accents, the skull taking the place of a lover's face.
1098_the-damned.jpg.Feels like: Gothic horror and Grand Guignol, with a political decadence overtone, 1960s.

1099_high-sierra.jpg.People: A man in a suit holding a pistol and a woman in a coat, both large, three-quarter body, in the lower half, looking tensely off to the left; they are close but not touching.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Composition: A huge two-line title takes the top two thirds over a mountain landscape; the pair sits lower left of center with the cast names stacked down the right edge. Rocky slopes form a V around them.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Medium: Detailed pencil and ink drawing with stippled grain, rendered in black and white and gray tones, like a hand-drawn illustration of a mountain.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Typography: The title is giant white condensed sans-serif capitals, roughly 55 percent of the poster, stacked on two lines and bleeding off the edges. The cast names are tall narrow white capitals with small script first names, set at right, and the director in a black box.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and many grays; dramatic misty light on peaks.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Story it suggests: An armed man and a frightened woman flee through the high mountains, being hunted.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Visual idea: The title letters are monumental as the mountain itself, dwarfing the fugitive pair.
1099_high-sierra.jpg.Feels like: 1940s noir crime thriller, black-and-white studio era.

1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.People: A tall man in a suit shown from the neck down at the upper left, huge; then the same man appears smaller four times, tiny, standing inside the gaps of the title letters, each smaller than the last.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Composition: The giant legs hang from the top edge and the title is stacked in a stair-step down to the right; the small figures step down in a diagonal descending staircase. Large empty white space remains lower left.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Medium: Flat solid black ink on white, with coarse grainy photo cut-outs of the figure, like a newspaper halftone.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Typography: The title is enormous heavy condensed black capitals across four lines, about 60 percent of the poster, left edges staggered. Small figures take the place of the letter I in INCREDIBLE and SHRINKING and the end of MAN, so the letters interact with the image.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and off-white; no light, graphic contrast.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Story it suggests: A man gets smaller and smaller in comparison to the world around him.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Visual idea: The figure literally shrinks as the text goes on, making the word the staircase of his decline.
1100_the-incredible-shrinking-man.jpg.Feels like: 1950s sci-fi, reinterpreted in modernist Swiss-style typographic design.

1101_uncut-gems.jpg.People: One smiling man in a tight, large close-up from the chest up, with curly dark hair, a beard, rimless glasses and a dark leather jacket. He leans forward with one forearm across the frame, wearing a chunky metal watch and a ring; he looks directly at the viewer with a sly grin.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Composition: The portrait fills the whole frame, with the face top-center and the arm and watch forming a diagonal across the lower half. A small credit line is above the bold title, which sits at the bottom edge.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Medium: A black-and-white-like photograph with a holographic rainbow foil gradient laid over it, a prismatic sheen like an iridescent print, with fine grain.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Typography: A massive, tightly set white condensed sans-serif UNCUT GEMS spans the full width along the bottom edge, with small lilac-tinted credit lines in a lighter sans on either side above it. It is clean, bold and typeset, partly overlapping the sleeve and hand.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Color and light: Dark charcoal and black with pastel iridescent teal, pink, lilac and gold shimmer, like light refracting through a gem.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Story it suggests: A cocky man with flashy jewelry grins as if he has a deal going or a gamble on, charming and a bit dangerous.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Visual idea: The prismatic foil effect turns a portrait into a faceted gemstone surface, with the wearer as the jeweled object.
1101_uncut-gems.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary, slick, 2010s-2020s crime drama; glossy and flashy.

1102_devi.jpg.People: One woman's face, huge, shown nearly as a mask, filling the upper two thirds, with ornate headband and earrings; the face is cut vertically in two halves.
1102_devi.jpg.Composition: Strictly symmetric and centered: the face sits at the top with a red dot between the eyebrows on the central axis; the title is at lower left and a red script glyph at lower right, with empty cream space between.
1102_devi.jpg.Medium: Duotone photograph, one half saturated blue and one half gray-lavender, with flat gold dots and red ink; slight halftone and paper texture.
1102_devi.jpg.Typography: The Latin title is bold navy condensed capitals at lower left, about a tenth of poster height; at right the same title in red hand-painted Bengali-style brush script with splattered edges, larger than the Latin. A small director credit in navy serif capitals.
1102_devi.jpg.Color and light: Deep blue, lavender, red and gold on cream; flat and even light.
1102_devi.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman has two sides, one human and one idol-like, looking out with fixed, unsettling eyes.
1102_devi.jpg.Visual idea: A split face, half blue like a painted deity and half pale like a living person, makes a mask-like duality.
1102_devi.jpg.Feels like: 1960s Indian art cinema, modern graphic poster style.

1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.People: One fighting figure in black silhouette at the lower right, kneeling in a martial pose with an arm outstretched and a braid flying; small relative to the poster.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Composition: The title takes the whole upper and left parts; a pale sun disc sits inside the big O. The figure sits in the lower right corner, with a swirling brush shape behind (dragon-like) curving across the page.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Medium: Painterly gouache or ink brushstrokes with paper grain and speckles; letters look letterpress-printed with ink spread.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Typography: The title is huge, mixing serif O, condensed bold and wide letters stacked on five lines, covering over 60 percent of the poster, brown on orange, with a decorative inline round O containing the sun. A small bold 'The complete films' at bottom.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Color and light: Saturated orange, yellow and dark brown; warm sunset glow.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Story it suggests: A lone fighter holds a low stance under a burning sun, ready for a duel.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Visual idea: The O becomes the sun and the swirling brush becomes a dragon, linking letters, landscape and motion.
1103_once-upon-a-time-in-china-the-compl.Feels like: Old Chinese martial-arts adventure, vintage wood-type poster.

1104_citizen-kane.jpg.People: None; a giant letter stands in for the subject.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Composition: A huge outlined 'K' fills nearly the whole center on black, with two vertical lines of small text running up the right edge; very sparse and symmetrical-leaning.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Medium: Flat solid graphic, a clean vector outline without texture.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Typography: Enormous geometric outline capital 'K' in pale grey, about three quarters of the poster height, the title and director in condensed capitals rotated 90 degrees running along the right edge; typeset, monumental and stark.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Color and light: Pure black with warm light grey; flat, no lighting.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Story it suggests: A single initial stands as a monument, the identity of a person reduced to a letter.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Visual idea: The title character as a letter, a monogram carved like a monument.
1104_citizen-kane.jpg.Feels like: Modernist minimalist graphic design, 1940s film given a contemporary treatment.

1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.People: Two young men, half body, large, standing side by side behind the big black numeral II, one looking up and aside and one looking straight out with braids. They are cropped into the numeral's interior.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Composition: A centered column: MENACE on top, SOCIETY at the bottom, and between them a giant black II with the two portraits as cut-out windows on red. Black margins surround it.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Medium: High-contrast thresholded photocopy-like halftone, flat red and gray ink on black, rough grain.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Typography: The title is bold extended gray capitals between ruled lines, spanning the width of the block, with the II as a black numeral shape acting as a mask. A small spaced red credit line at the bottom.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray and deep red; harsh high-contrast light.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young men stand together, wary and hardened, boxed in by the world around them.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Visual idea: The numeral II forms bars or pillars that crop the faces, hinting at a cage or limited view.
1105_menace-ii-society.jpg.Feels like: Early 1990s urban street drama, hip-hop era graphic design.

1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.People: Four men in a hotel room, small and full body at the lower edge: one photographing, one with arms raised, one seated in a chair, one playing guitar. Shown in a flat stylized drawing style.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Composition: The poster is split: the upper two thirds hold the huge title and credits inside two vertical bars like a bracket; the lower third shows the room scene as a frieze across the width, with drapes and a picture frame.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Medium: Hand-painted gouache look with flat opaque shapes, visible brush texture and a mottled paper surface.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Typography: The title is giant brown condensed capitals in three lines, filling the center, with four character names in medium capitals above, all ink-like with rough edges. Small script-like connectors such as 'as' in italic.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Color and light: Mustard orange, maroon brown, teal and olive; warm indoor lamp feel.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Story it suggests: Four friends gather in a room for a night of talk, music and celebration.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Visual idea: The title acts as a theatrical proscenium or doorway, over a small stage of the room where the men play out.
1106_one-night-in-miami.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century modern illustration, 1960s jazz-album picture-book style.

1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.People: A large young man's head and shoulders in the center foreground, looking off to the left; behind him two boys at left (one turned away) and a young woman at right holding a basket, all smaller. A tiny horse rider silhouette sits on a ridge at top.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Composition: Layered collage: the big face anchors lower center, smaller figures flank at mid-height, and a huge dark hill shape sweeps diagonally from upper left to right, topped by the title at right.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Medium: Cut-out color photographs pasted over a mottled, watercolor and ink-splatter texture with grainy paper look.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Typography: The title is orange, medium-weight serif capitals in three stacked lines at upper right, about a fifth of the poster's height, set over the dark hill shape; the credit is in smaller yellow capitals at left with a script 'A Film by'.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Color and light: Olive green, mustard yellow, purple-brown and sky blue with orange lettering; warm, daylight, dappled.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy comes of age in the countryside, surrounded by friends and a first love, gazing into an uncertain future.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Visual idea: A memory collage where the portrait emerges from a wash of earth and foliage, as if the landscape were his mind.
1107_the-learning-tree.jpg.Feels like: Late 1960s coming-of-age drama, hand-collaged contemporary reissue.

1108_the-celebration.jpg.People: None. Only objects are shown: a disc case, discs, and a folded printed paper.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Composition: A photographed clear plastic case seen from the front, with a big orange sheet filling most of it, rotated sideways so its text runs vertically; a small white label sits in the center, with two discs visible at left.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Medium: Product-photography realism: clear glossy plastic, translucent discs, printed paper with sharp type and slight shadows.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Typography: A dense paragraph of black serif text rotated 90 degrees fills the orange sheet, with a heading 'DOGME 95'; a white label in monospaced capitals reads title, number, runtime and year like a tape label. The text is the main content, cropped by the case edges.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Color and light: Vermilion red-orange, white and clear gray; flat, even studio light.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Story it suggests: A rulebook for how to make films is tucked into a case, implying a strict set of rules at the center of the work.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Visual idea: The manifesto itself becomes the cover, treating the film as a boxed document or archive item.
1108_the-celebration.jpg.Feels like: Late 1990s avant-garde film movement, stripped-down document or DIY zine aesthetic.

1109_time.jpg.People: None. A single large black brush ring and a small gold dot.
1109_time.jpg.Composition: Mostly empty cream space, with a big open ring in the center, offset slightly with a gold dot inside near the lower right; the title is widely spaced across the top and the credit centered at the bottom.
1109_time.jpg.Medium: Dry-brush ink stroke with visible bristle lines, printed on speckled paper with a slight letterpress look; a flat gold ink dot.
1109_time.jpg.Typography: The title is thin, small, widely letterspaced black capitals (T I M E) near the top, only about a twentieth of the poster height; the credit is a small italic and spaced capitals at the bottom, both centered.
1109_time.jpg.Color and light: Black ink on warm off-white with a small pale gold; calm, matte, even.
1109_time.jpg.Story it suggests: Something goes around in a loop, an unbroken cycle of waiting and passing.
1109_time.jpg.Visual idea: An enso-like brush circle that is incomplete and turning, standing for the cycle of time, with the gold dot as a sun or moon.
1109_time.jpg.Feels like: East Asian calligraphic minimalism, contemporary art-house.

1110_the-piano.jpg.People: One woman seen from behind, three-quarter length and large, centered, hands clasped behind her holding a small object; her face is not visible.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Composition: A central, symmetric vertical figure against a pale sky; the wide skirt widens toward the bottom, and the title sits on her back. Clouds sit left and right.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Medium: Retouched vintage photo or engraving with an illustrated botanical overlay; the dress interior is a drawn print of ferns and jungle plants, with painted flowers and vines climbing on the sleeves.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Typography: The title is cream, elegant serif capitals in two lines on the upper back, about a tenth of the poster's height, with a thin rule below and small italic credit; it sits on the dark fabric.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Color and light: Dark olive-brown figure against soft peach and pale yellow sky; warm glowing, hazy sunrise.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman turns her back, holding her silence, with a whole wild inner world growing inside her.
1110_the-piano.jpg.Visual idea: The skirt becomes a landscape, so her body contains nature, hinting at hidden emotion and growth.

1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.People: One older man, shoulders up, large and central, looking upward and laughing with open mouth, in a light blue shirt.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Composition: Central portrait with the title arching above his head and the word 'Dead' huge across the chest; fluffy clouds sit behind his shoulders, and the credit sits at the very top.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Medium: Staged photograph with real cotton-like clouds, over a sky with fine radiating line pattern; the lettering is gold metallic foil.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Typography: The title is ornamental gold blackletter capitals, in three parts: 'Dick Johnson' arcing over his head, a small ribbon 'is', and a giant 'Dead' filling the bottom; roughly 40 percent of the poster. The letters have a foil sheen and overlap the clothing.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Color and light: Pale blue, sky teal and gold with white clouds; soft, bright, heavenly glow.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful old man looks up at the sky as if in heaven, laughing about his own death.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Visual idea: A joke on the afterlife: a gravestone-like gold blackletter title and cotton clouds treat death as a sunny comic heaven.
1111_dick-johnson-is-dead.jpg.Feels like: Comic and sentimental contemporary documentary with Gothic tombstone typography.

1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.People: Two tiny figures at the lower center: a man in a black overcoat and hat holding a gun beside a kneeling man in white shirt and suspenders with raised hands.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Composition: A vertical forest of tall tree trunks fills the page; the pair sits small at the bottom center against an orange leaf floor, with strong vertical lines framing them. The title is at the bottom.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-like illustration with layered silhouettes and smooth gradients, a screenprint look.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Typography: The title is bold black condensed capitals across the bottom, one line spanning the width, about a twentieth of the poster's height; a small credit above. A cream border frames the page.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Color and light: Black and dark gray trees with amber, ochre and burnt orange; hazy autumn light filtering from the back.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Story it suggests: In an empty forest, one man pleads for his life while another stands over him with a gun.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Visual idea: The tall, dark trunks make a prison of bars around the small human drama, giving the forest a menacing scale.
1112_miller-s-crossing.jpg.Feels like: Retro travel-poster style applied to a gangster drama, 1930s mood.

1113_boat-people.jpg.People: Two people, nearly full body and large, standing side by side in front of a wall: a girl in a white blouse and a man in a pointed straw hat with backpack straps. They look at the camera, tense and wet.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Composition: A tilted frame with torn white edges shows the pair centered; the title is in big stacked letters lower right, with a column of Chinese characters on the left. A red sign line runs behind their heads.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Medium: Grainy, noisy photographic still with color cast, scan lines and a rough, torn-paper or taped-photo edge treatment.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Typography: The title is large pale gray-white hand-cut capitals in two lines, 'BOAT' and 'PEOPLE', each over a tenth of the poster, offset diagonally at lower right; a tall Chinese title column on the left and a small credit at right. The letters overlap the lower legs.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Color and light: Cold blue-gray and desaturated purple with red text on the wall; rainy, dim, flat light.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Story it suggests: Two travelers stand in the rain in a foreign place, wary and worn, with nowhere to go.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Visual idea: A damaged, crooked photo, as if a salvaged document, conveys displacement and instability.
1113_boat-people.jpg.Feels like: Early 1980s social-realist drama, news-photo and refugee documentation look.

1114_love-affair.jpg.People: A man in a fedora and checked overcoat and a woman in a fur collar, half body, large, facing each other in profile and about to embrace; a distant skyscraper rises behind them.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Composition: Title band across the upper third between dark horizontal bars; the couple sits lower center overlapping, with a tall tower silhouette rising between their heads, and the credit line below the title.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph with soft film grain and a painted-sky backdrop; a flat graphic type band above.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Typography: The title is giant white Art Deco capitals with geometric forms (diamond inside the O, split A's), spanning the width, about 15 percent of the poster height, set between two dark bars with thin grid lines. Star names above in white Deco serif and the credit in black Deco capitals with diamond ornaments.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome grays with white type; soft, misty glow.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people meet and lean in close, with a big city looming behind them, hinting at a romance in a metropolis.
1114_love-affair.jpg.Visual idea: The skyscraper stands between the lovers' heads like a third presence, tying the city and the romance together.

1115_adoption.jpg.People: Two faces extremely close, cropped: an older woman's eye, cheek and mouth on the left, and a younger girl's eyes and nose upper right, overlapping. Another body in a patterned blouse lies below.
1115_adoption.jpg.Composition: Thin red lines cut the poster into rectangles like a window grid, one vertical line down the middle and a horizontal one under the girl's face, so the faces are split and tiled into fragments. The title crosses the seam.
1115_adoption.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with film grain, overlaid with thin pink-red rules and flat dark panels.
1115_adoption.jpg.Typography: The title is large, thin elegant serif in off-white, in lowercase except for the initial, spanning about 70 percent of the poster width at mid height, running over both faces. The director's name is in salmon serif, large, stacked on two lines at lower right with a small spaced sans-serif credit.
1115_adoption.jpg.Color and light: Gray tones with salmon pink and near-black; flat, soft, matte.
1115_adoption.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman and a young girl are drawn together yet kept separated by a line, hinting at a fragile bond between them.
1115_adoption.jpg.Visual idea: Fragmented faces in a grid, one dominating the other, cropped to show only parts, suggest relationships built from pieces.
1115_adoption.jpg.Feels like: 1970s European art-house drama with modern typographic design.

1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.People: About six men: a large bearded man in a flat cap in the foreground looking back over his shoulder, a young man with glasses behind at right, a uniformed man at lower left, and several tiny figures by crashed planes in the distance.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Composition: The big face sits at lower center, with figures staggered on both sides; the horizon of pale dunes sits at mid-height with wrecked planes at left; the sky and title occupy the top half.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with gouache or acrylic brushstrokes, visible streaks and a vintage movie-poster look.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Typography: The title is in blue heavy italic slab-serif capitals, stacked on three lines in the center right, about a tenth of the poster height. Cast names in thin, tall cream capitals above, small credit below.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Color and light: Bright cyan-blue sky and warm yellow-orange sand; hot, harsh desert sunlight.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of men is stranded in a desert next to wrecked airplanes, and the leader looks back wary and worried.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Visual idea: A vast empty desert dwarfs the small survivors, while the weathered face tells the toll.
1116_the-flight-of-the-phoenix.jpg.Feels like: 1960s adventure and survival film, hand-painted studio poster.

1117_love-jones.jpg.People: Two people lying in bed in close-up, faces nearly touching, eyes closed, one above the other in a tender pose; they fill the whole frame.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Composition: A diagonal from the upper right to lower left through the two heads; the title is positioned upper right above the heads, with large dark areas of blankets around.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Medium: Warm, grainy photographic still with deep shadows, soft focus and a color grade like film.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Typography: The title is cream, very bold high-contrast Didone-style lowercase letters with slanted inner cutouts, stacked on two lines, about 20 percent of the poster's height, at the upper right; a small yellow lowercase credit beneath.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Color and light: Deep red, burnt orange and near-black; dim, warm lamplight.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers lie together in the night, intimate and quiet.
1117_love-jones.jpg.Visual idea: The couple's overlapping faces are shown in an almost abstract tangle of skin and fabric in firelight color, making intimacy the whole picture.

1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.People: Six people on a lit stage: five band members standing or sitting with instruments (upright bass, acoustic and other guitars, a slide guitar) and one person in the foreground with outstretched arms seen from behind, as a silhouette. They are small, lower third of the poster.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Composition: Wide row of musicians along a lit stage in the lower third, with a huge title filling the black upper two-thirds, centered; credit at the top. The ornate final letter curls down to the musicians.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph toned sepia, with fine film grain and a hazy stage-lit glow; title flat cream ink.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Typography: Title in enormous, decorative Art Nouveau-style serif capitals, stacked in three lines, in cream with ornate swashes, about 70 percent of the width and half the height; small serif credit above. The letters hang over the darkness and nearly touch the performers' heads.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream and brown-black; stage spotlights with smoky haze, high contrast.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Story it suggests: A band plays a final concert before an audience we only glimpse.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Visual idea: A monumental title like a stage curtain looming above small performers.
1118_the-last-waltz.jpg.Feels like: 1970s rock concert film, vintage record sleeve.

1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.People: About twelve people of varied ages in a crowd on a mound, in full body at mid-size; a smiling man in the center holding a white dove, a girl beside him, a woman in a towel, a man raising a roast on a tray; a tiny figure on a cloud above.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Composition: A diagonal beam of light from the upper right shines down onto the group on a hill; the title slants across the upper half in a rising diagonal; skyline silhouettes fill the lower sides.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Medium: Painterly gouache illustration with flat, bold shapes and visible brush edges; speckled stars.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Typography: The title is big brush-script lettering in two lines, 'Miracle in Milan', sloping upward, cream yellow on the gray part and white inside the light beam, taking about 35 percent of the poster; credit lines in cream condensed sans-serif at left.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Color and light: Slate gray, cyan blue spotlight, warm yellow and brown; dramatic beam of light.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful band of poor people gather on a hill under a heavenly light, as a figure watches from the clouds.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Visual idea: A beam of light from the sky turns a ragged crowd into a joyful procession, a miracle shown as a spotlight.
1119_miracle-in-milan.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Italian fable, retro storybook illustration.

1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.People: One glamorous woman in a tight white dress, full body, large, at left; six small inset portraits at right of singers and a group, each in a colored strip.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Composition: Two columns: a big cutout figure on a yellow rectangle at left and a stack of six alternating blue and pink strips at right, under a huge two-line title across the top.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photo cut-outs pasted on flat spot-color blocks, with a printed paper texture, like a mid-century screenprint or collage.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Typography: The title is giant magenta bold sans-serif capitals in two lines spanning the poster width, about 20 percent of its height. Singer names are in black hand-lettered script inside the strips with star bursts; cast names in a thin condensed black font above.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink, cyan blue, canary yellow and cream; flat, bright, no real lighting.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman is the draw of a lively show with many music acts.
1120_the-girl-can-t-help-it.jpg.Visual idea: A pin-up and a parade of acts presented like a record-catalog or jukebox list, with color bands as slots.

1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.People: Many tiny silhouetted figures in a dense city scene, small and scattered (people on balconies, sitting, walking, on a roof), around a giant black head-shaped void in the center whose title text fills it.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Composition: A massive black head profile (hair and face) fills the center, with the title written inside; around it a collage of buildings, bus, umbrellas and utility lines in layered patches in a vertical stack.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Medium: Hand-cut paper collage and rough ink or marker drawing, with chalky dry-brush texture and flat color patches.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Typography: The title is in off-white hand-lettered chalky script, in two parts: the foreign word 'eyimofe' large at the upper part and 'this is my desire' in smaller lines below, inside the black head shape; the credit in small orange italic at the top.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Color and light: Black and cream with orange, pink, blue, magenta and green accents; flat, no light source.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Story it suggests: A person's dreams and thoughts are crowded by the busy city around them.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Visual idea: The head silhouette holds the title as inner thought while the street scene pours over it, making the city and the mind one.
1121_eyimofe-this-is-my-desire.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary African urban art, collage and street poster style.

1122_round-midnight.jpg.People: A saxophonist in glasses and hat in close-up at the top, his face cropped, with a microphone; below, a small dark figure in a hat walks away down a narrow street.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Composition: Split horizontally in two: top is the purple close-up of the player, bottom a deep blue street scene with strong one-point perspective, with the walking figure in the center. The title sits on the dividing line.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Medium: Duotone color-cast photographic stills with grain, as in two tinted film frames.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Typography: The title is bold white condensed capitals, large, at the center right, right-aligned over the blue panel; credits in white and magenta thin condensed capitals on the dividing line, and a small 'Stereo' label in blue at left.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Color and light: Magenta-purple on top, saturated cobalt blue below; night, smoky stage light and street shadow.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Story it suggests: A musician plays in a club and later walks alone into the night streets.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Visual idea: Two tints divide the poster into the stage and the street, the performance and the loneliness after it.
1122_round-midnight.jpg.Feels like: 1980s jazz film, Blue Note album-cover inspired.

1123_mr-klein.jpg.People: One large man's face at the bottom center, intense and wary, with the same face repeated smaller: a figure in a window at left, a hatted figure in the right middle and another face at lower right. All appear to look at the central man.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Composition: The man's head sits at the bottom with a house perched on top of it like a hat, and stacked city blocks leaning in on both sides in a canyon; the title is at the top.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Medium: Pastel or chalk and gouache drawing with rough textured grain and visible pencil strokes.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Typography: The title is large, rough gray-white block capitals with a small 'Mr.' tilted, in the upper center, about 15 percent of the poster's height, drawn like cut paper with uneven edges, over buildings; star name above in smaller bold capitals and the credit in italics.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Color and light: Deep indigo, violet, slate and sage green with orange street; murky, dusk-like light.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is watched from every window as the city closes in on him with suspicion.
1123_mr-klein.jpg.Visual idea: A building sits on his head like a hat, so the town literally weighs on him, with faces hidden in windows spying.

1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.People: One large man in a patterned jacket at the bottom, cropped at the neck with his face replaced by a collage; inside the collage are several small photos of men, a figure in a light jacket in a Polaroid-like frame, a crowd of tiny figures in a street scene, and a hand holding cash. The big figure is a halftone image, the others are pasted fragments.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Composition: Vertical stack: a big torso rising from the bottom left, with the head area replaced by overlapping pasted rectangles (newspaper clipping, instant photo, crowd photo, taxi). A black and white torn-edge field splits the poster diagonally, with open white area on the left.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Medium: Black and white photocopy and halftone stipple, torn paper edges, a newspaper clipping with typewriter text, an aged instant-photo frame, ink-blot shapes.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Typography: Title is hand-lettered in white brush or marker script, medium-large, slanted upward at the top right with an underline stroke; small vertical typeset credit text on the left and a vertical Chinese character cut into the white area.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Color and light: Strictly black, white and warm paper grey, high contrast with no real light source.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone has vanished and the evidence is scattered clippings, snapshots and street scenes that never quite assemble into a face.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Visual idea: The head is literally replaced by a collage of clues, so the missing person is a hole filled with fragments.
1124_chan-is-missing.jpg.Feels like: Gritty 1980s independent city drama, zine and photocopy punk collage.

1125_the-funeral.jpg.People: A crowd of about ten seated and standing people around a long banquet table, mostly in half body view, drawn as illustrations; a woman in a blue kimono stands on a stage in the background, a framed portrait of a man sits on an altar, and a cat sits at the lower right.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Composition: Dense scene on a torn-edge rectangle with cream border: foreground diners at the bottom, a yellow altar in the center, a mountain peak with red and blue striped curtains behind, and clouds across the top. The long red table makes a perspective diagonal into the middle.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Medium: Layered flat colour print with rough textured edges, like risograph or gouache with visible misregistration; torn paper silhouette and speckled texture.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Typography: Title is white-cream wide-spaced capitals on two black torn banner strips at the top, stepping down to the right, partly hung on ropes; director credit in typewriter-like capitals on small cream label strips at the bottom left, in stacked lines.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, sky blue, yellow and black on cream, flat even daylight.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Story it suggests: A formal mourning ceremony turns into a lively meal where the mood among the guests is awkwardly relaxed.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Visual idea: Funeral and festival are blended, with the altar, striped curtains and mountain staged like a cheerful stage set.
1125_the-funeral.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary editorial illustration for a satirical family comedy, with a retro Japanese print feel.

1126_double-indemnity.jpg.People: Two figures: a woman in a pale gown reclined in an armchair, close to half body, lower right, smoking; a man in a dark coat seen in shadow at the top right behind window blinds, half body and turned toward her. They are separated by space and by light.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Composition: Diagonal layering: the huge title fills the upper left and center, the man sits high at the right, and the woman is lower right. The cast list is stacked at the top left and credits at the lower left, with a lot of dark space around.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Medium: Black and white photographic stills with film grain and soft glow, blended into a dark composite; smoke curls drawn over the image.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Typography: Title in huge white condensed block capitals, in two stacked lines taking about half the poster width, with a grey extruded 3D shadow offset down-left. The cast list is right-aligned condensed capitals; small credit text in the lower left uses mixed sizes.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome with deep blacks, high contrast, venetian-blind slats of light and a spotlit face.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Story it suggests: A shadowy man watches from above while a calm, smoking woman holds the center of attention, suggesting a scheme between them.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Visual idea: Surveillance and seduction share one frame, with the title dropping like heavy block letters between them.
1126_double-indemnity.jpg.Feels like: 1940s black and white crime melodrama, classic studio noir.

1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.People: A couple embracing in the center, in a close half body shot with the man hugging the woman from behind; around them are five or six more individual cutout portraits (a woman at left, a man holding a flower, two men in patterned shirts) plus a small painted deity figure and a statue of liberty figure with a mask and a bindi.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Composition: A dense, centered collage mass with a cream border around it: the couple at the center, with the title across the lower middle and motel sign, plane, car and cotton bolls arranged around them in a rough circle.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Medium: Cut-paper collage with photographic cutouts, paper texture, red petal shapes, soft drop shadows, and cotton bolls and flowers as real objects.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Typography: Title is made of mismatched ripped letters in white, teal, orange and yellow, tilted and varied in size (the word MASALA is big and jumbled, MISSISSIPPI smaller and above); the director credit is red bold capitals in the lower right.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Color and light: Warm cream ground with strong reds, pinks, teal and mustard, soft even light.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Story it suggests: A romance between two people from different communities, with their families and surroundings crowding in around them.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Visual idea: A mixed-up collage that literally mixes cultures, objects and faces, like the title mixes two words.
1127_mississippi-masala.jpg.Feels like: Early 1990s romantic drama, handmade scrapbook collage in a modern re-issue.

1128_farewell-amor.jpg.People: Three faces in double exposure: a woman in left profile-ish close-up (face turned and cropped at the lips), a bald bearded man looking down in the center, and a young woman in right profile looking upward behind. All are large, head-and-shoulders, overlapping in one big head-shaped mass.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetrical-ish oval silhouette of a large round afro-shaped hair mass filled with the faces, with a small city skyline along the bottom edge. The title sits across the upper middle, over the hair.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Medium: Digital photographic double exposure with smooth gradient overlays, soft misty glow and slight blur; no grain.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Typography: Title in large white high-contrast serif lowercase, two stacked lines, centered in the upper half with a small sans credit line above; bold rounded letterforms sit on top of the image with no distortion.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome magenta, violet and lilac gradients with pale blue accents, soft misty glow.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Story it suggests: Three people linked by memory and a city, each lost in thought and separated by distance or time.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Visual idea: The faces share one head-shaped silhouette with a skyline at its base, as if the city is their shared memory.
1128_farewell-amor.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary intimate drama, 2020s stylish poster with dreamy gradient.

1129_rouge.jpg.People: A man and a woman in close profile, heads almost touching, half body; the woman at the left has a bob and bright red lips, the man at the right wears a high-collar dark jacket and holds a small green object up to her mouth. The woman's figure ends in a cut-off neck, so it looks like a floating cutout.
1129_rouge.jpg.Composition: Two profiles face each other in a diagonal at the lower two thirds, with the title in a pink rectangle across the top center. Butterflies fill the black background all around, with the pair's hands and faces at the center.
1129_rouge.jpg.Medium: Smooth digitally painted illustration with airbrushed skin and fine hair strokes, hyper-realistic, over a flat black patterned ground.
1129_rouge.jpg.Typography: Title in huge black Art Deco-style serif capitals inside a pink gradient box, taking about 60% of the poster width, near the top; small spaced sans director credit above it.
1129_rouge.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with hot pink, orange and yellow butterflies and a vivid red mouth, with soft studio-like light on the skin.
1129_rouge.jpg.Story it suggests: A tender, intimate moment between two lovers, edged with something unreal.
