1129_rouge.jpg.Visual idea: Butterflies and the red lips make desire into pattern, with the lovers cut out of a decorative black fabric.
1129_rouge.jpg.Feels like: Glamorous 1930s romantic period melodrama, modern luxury illustration.

1130_shaft.jpg.People: Many figures at various scales: a large man in a coat with a raised gun in profile at the top right, a pink silhouette copy of him behind, several faces stacked at the right (including a man with a moustache), a kicking fight silhouette in the center, a white running figure at the lower left, and two men in hats at the bottom right. The relation is a crowd of heroes and enemies in a montage.
1130_shaft.jpg.Composition: Collage of rectangular blocks: the top is a purple field with a diagonal gun arm; the left middle is a night street scene, the right is a stacked tower of faces, and the title sits in a white band at the bottom left. The gun arm points left and anchors the layout.
1130_shaft.jpg.Medium: Posterized screenprint look with colour-shifted halftone and painted texture, glowing blobs and bubbles, visible paint and brush marks, misaligned colour layers.
1130_shaft.jpg.Typography: Title is big, bold, chunky 3D block capitals in dark blue with a pale lavender extruded shadow and white outline, about half the poster width at the bottom left; small credit line below.
1130_shaft.jpg.Color and light: Vibrant purple, hot pink, orange, cyan and white with neon-like glow, as from city lights.
1130_shaft.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone tough man moves through a night city of fights and pursuit.
1130_shaft.jpg.Visual idea: A psychedelic action montage in which a hero is repeated in different colour versions like pop art.
1130_shaft.jpg.Feels like: 1970s urban action film, pop-art street poster.

1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.People: No people. A line drawing of a flamingo stands next to a pedestal with a ball on top.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Composition: Everything is on a single crumpled sheet of kraft paper; the title and drawing are in the upper middle, tilted diagonally, with a typed address label stuck at the lower right. The lower left is empty.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Medium: Photographed brown paper bag with creases and folds; the print is printed as dull brown ink with a hand-drawn illustration look, and the label is typed on white tape.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Typography: Title in dark-brown chunky script, stacked in two lines and tilted about 25 degrees up-right, at roughly 40% of the width; small boxed 'IN COLOR' and a serif tagline sit below. Typed address label in a monospace typewriter face at the bottom.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Color and light: Tan kraft brown and dark brown ink; flat, soft daylight on wrinkled paper.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Story it suggests: A package arrives with a gaudy lawn ornament on it, and a stranger's address.
1131_pink-flamingos.jpg.Visual idea: Packaging as the poster: a cheap, brown-wrapped mailer that mocks its own good taste.

1132_the-worst-person-in-the-world.jpg.People: Three simplified drawn figures: a tall nude woman standing in the center holding a bleeding heart, a small man sitting at the lower left, and a man lying down at the lower right with a smoke or heart-shaped cloud. She is full body and much bigger than the men, who sit at her feet.
1132_the-worst-person-in-the-world.jpg.Composition: Centered figure on a vertical axis against a huge empty black field, with the title in the upper third and the figures on a red rug in the lower third; the two small men balance left and right.

1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.People: Six cutout figures: a man's face floating on crossed bones at the center bottom; two older women at the upper left and right (one holds a tray with a decanter, one holds a book); a man in a pith helmet blowing a bugle and sitting on the bottle cork at the top; and two men in suits standing on gravestones at the lower left and right (one with a shovel). They are stylized cutouts that do not look at each other, apart from the two women glancing toward the center.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Composition: Strict bilateral symmetry around a huge central black bottle: the cork rider at the top, women either side at mid-height, gravestones with men below, and bats scattered in the sky. The title is on the bottle.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Medium: Halftone-patterned black and white photo cutouts pasted on a purple textured ground with drop shadows, like paper collage.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Typography: Title in tall, thin cream art-deco serif capitals ('ARSENIC and OLD LACE') in the center of the black bottle, about 40% of the width, with cursive credit above and sans credit below; fitted into the bottle shape like a label.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Color and light: Purple ground, black bottle, cream and gray photo tones; flat theatrical lighting with cast shadows.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Story it suggests: A respectable family is secretly morbid, with poison and graves behind the polite faces.
1153_arsenic-and-old-lace.jpg.Visual idea: The poison bottle becomes the stage, with the hero's face on a skull-and-crossbones as its label.

1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.People: One woman's face seen in profile, from nose down, lips pressed to a white-gloved finger in a hushing gesture, blended into the landscape; two tiny figures hold hands at the lower right, as silhouettes by the water. A house stands in the mist at the upper left.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Composition: Layered double exposure: a mansion and tall bare trees in the upper half, the giant mouth and hushing finger at the center, and a flooded swamp with small figures at the bottom. Trees frame the left and right.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Medium: Photographic double exposure with soft misty blending, atmospheric haze, silhouettes of trees and water reflection.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Typography: Title in big, hand-brushed black cursive on two lines, slanted, over the house in the upper middle, with the cast names in small pale capitals along the top and a handwritten credit below.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber and peach haze in the top, cold teal-green water at the bottom; foggy diffuse light.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Story it suggests: A secret held in a Southern house by a girl who is asked to keep quiet.
1154_eve-s-bayou.jpg.Visual idea: The hushing finger and the mouth merge with the swamp and house, as if the landscape itself keeps the secret.

1155_cure.jpg.People: One person, a blurred dark silhouette of a head and shoulders, with the face hidden by a tall candle flame in the center. The person's identity is ambiguous: only the outline of hair and shoulders is visible.
1155_cure.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetrical vertical flame in front of a head-shaped shadow, set inside a slightly rough-edged gray rectangle on a black border; the title is at the bottom right of center.
1155_cure.jpg.Medium: Photographic, soft-focus, with dust specks and an uneven film-edge border, like a projected frame.
1155_cure.jpg.Typography: Title in tiny, very widely letter-spaced bronze capitals (C U R E) near the bottom, a quarter of the width with large gaps between letters; credit below in dim, spaced small capitals, partly fading into black.
1155_cure.jpg.Color and light: Black and gray with a single glowing orange-white flame; a single warm light source in darkness.
1155_cure.jpg.Story it suggests: A person whose mind is burned away or hypnotised by a small flame.
1155_cure.jpg.Visual idea: A flame replaces the face, an eerie hypnotic image where the self is erased.
1155_cure.jpg.Feels like: Quiet 1990s Japanese psychological thriller, minimalist horror.

1156_la-llorona.jpg.People: Two armored, helmeted riot figures with opaque face shields at left and right, and between them a woman with very long black hair, seen from behind, in a pale dress; a frog sits on her shoulder; the faces are hidden, giving a ghostly quality.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Composition: Symmetric triptych: guards flanking at the sides, a central pale figure lower down; a dark horizontal band in the lower part holds the title.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with soft, smoky grey airbrushed textures and torn-paper edges at the top.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Typography: Tall slim sans capitals 'LA LLORONA' in cream, stacked in two lines at the lower left with a small 'A film by' credit to the right; typeset, quiet and sparse, sitting on a dark ground.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Color and light: Cold greys and charcoal with a pale cream dress and a hint of red; foggy, dim, dusky light.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Story it suggests: Armed, faceless men stand around a ghostly long-haired woman, haunted by threat and mourning.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Visual idea: Armor and faceless masks contrasted with a single spectral figure and a small frog.
1156_la-llorona.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary political horror, art-house ghost story, 2010s.

1157_daisies.jpg.People: Two young women, each a large cut-out close-up: one at left with a flower crown and a sidelong smile, one at right in grainy black and white licking a spoon with wide eyes. They sit on opposite sides of the central lettering, and are cut-out photographs inside a collage rather than a single scene.
1157_daisies.jpg.Composition: Vertical strip of stacked lettering runs down the center, with a face on each side forming a rough left-right symmetry. Torn paper scraps overlap everywhere, so the layout is dense with almost no empty space.
1157_daisies.jpg.Medium: Paper collage of torn and cut photographs with visible halftone grain, scrawled blue ink handwriting, rough edges and paper texture. Colors look slightly misregistered and photocopied.
1157_daisies.jpg.Typography: The title is cut into tall black-and-white ransom-note letters running vertically down the middle, almost the full height of the poster, each letter on a separate paper strip and cut off at top and bottom. The credit is handwritten in white chalky letters on a black strip at lower right.
1157_daisies.jpg.Color and light: Warm orange, olive and rust floral tones with black, white and flashes of red; flat printed light with no single source.
1157_daisies.jpg.Story it suggests: Two mischievous girls treat the world as something to cut up and consume, playfully and a little menacingly.
1157_daisies.jpg.Visual idea: The poster is itself cut up and pasted back together, so the collage form stands for the film's destructive appetite.
1157_daisies.jpg.Feels like: 1960s avant-garde art-house, Dada-style collage and fanzine cut-and-paste.

1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.People: One man shown from the knees up, large, facing the viewer; his hat shades his eyes. He holds a small bunch of flowers in both hands at chest height.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Composition: Strict central, symmetric, frontal composition with the figure centered against a bright window that acts as a frame within the frame. The flowers sit at the exact middle as the focal point.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Medium: Soft grainy monochrome with a drawn, charcoal or pencil-like quality in the figure and fur chaps; the flowers are the only color, looking like a pasted-on paper craft. The surface is hazy, like a photo mixed with illustration.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Typography: Title in a classical serif at the bottom, spread across most of the width, with 'of the' in italic and small caps for the director line above. It is white, quiet, and sits over the dark chaps without distortion.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Color and light: Sepia and charcoal tones with a glowing window behind; only small blue, orange and pink flowers break the monochrome.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard, shadowed man carries an unexpectedly delicate offering, hinting at hidden tenderness or a trap.
1158_the-power-of-the-dog.jpg.Visual idea: Color is withheld until the fragile flowers in a hardened silhouette, a contrast of toughness and softness.

1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.People: Two men, small and full body, on a rooftop edge in the lower third. One at right in a leather jacket points a gun at the other's head; the other, in a dark suit with hands behind his back, looks back at him.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Huge empty sky fills the upper two thirds, with the two figures tiny on a horizontal ledge near the bottom. The gun arm forms a horizontal line linking them; the mountains and skyline layer behind.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism, clean and slightly graded, like a film still.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Small white wide-tracked sans-serif capitals, right-aligned in the middle of the sky, with the title in more widely spaced letters and 'THE' much smaller. It sits calmly in open sky without overlapping the figures.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue sky and white clouds, green-blue mountains, with bright daylight and dark figures.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet standoff in open daylight, with one man holding the other at gunpoint high above a city.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: The tension of a lethal moment is set against a vast, serene sky, so the scale makes the confrontation feel isolated.
1159_the-infernal-affairs-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: 2000s Hong Kong crime thriller, polished and modern.

1160_malcolm-x.jpg.People: One man in profile, a very large close-up from the chest up, in a fedora and browline glasses, looking sideways into the distance. A faint second hatted figure is blurred at the bottom edge.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Composition: The face fills the lower two thirds, angled diagonally from lower left to right, with a blurred marquee behind. Red graphic bars and a row of triangles at the bottom right frame it.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Medium: Photographic film-still with a slightly soft focus and a grainy 1990s look, overlaid with flat solid red graphic ink.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Typography: Big red sans-serif 'MALCOLM X' across the top third with an underline and a large cross-shaped X that touches the hat; credits in smaller red type with vertical bars. The red letters sit over the photo and echo the lettering of the marquee behind.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige and gray photo with strong red type and a red-white flag; soft daylight.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Story it suggests: A determined man pauses on a busy street, watchful and resolute.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Visual idea: The title's red X and the red marquee letters tie the man's name to his surroundings and to a flag.
1160_malcolm-x.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s biopic with a modernist, protest-poster graphic treatment.

1161_wall-e.jpg.People: No humans. A character is assembled from junk: binoculars as eyes, a box as a body, a trash can as a head, and a pincer arm, so it reads as a small robot built out of objects. A small cockroach sits at lower left.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Composition: A dense pile of objects fills the frame edge to edge, built like a heap with a central figure: the binocular eyes at upper center, the cardboard box below, and a tilted diagonal spatula and glittery strip pointing downwards. Ruined skyscrapers fade into the haze at the top.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Medium: Detailed painterly illustration or digital painting with a grainy, textured, matte finish, with each object rendered like a tactile still life; the shiny rhinestone strip adds a glittery texture.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Typography: Wide, extended white geometric capitals WALL and a dot followed by a red circle with a white E, set along the bottom over the debris. A smaller white-and-gray 'DIRECTED BY' credit sits beneath, typeset and clean, overlapping the clutter.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Color and light: Dusty beige, rust, gray and tan, with accents of blue and red; hazy, dirty, warm light.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Story it suggests: A lonely little machine is made of the world's leftovers, watching from within a mountain of trash.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Visual idea: A face assembled from discarded objects, a figure made of junk, with each item a piece of character, like a still-life portrait.
1161_wall-e.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary animated adventure, retro-futuristic, with a hand-crafted collage and poster-painting feel.

1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.People: A woman's face in a black and white photo cropped to a torn shard at the top right, and a headless white marble torso statue at the center, which is ambiguous as a sculpture rather than a person.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Composition: The torso runs diagonally down the center, flanked by two rotated lines of huge vertical lettering at left and right. The torn photo wedge points diagonally into the torso.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Medium: Paper-collage look, a photographic marble cutout, a halftone-like gray photo, flat yellow ink and a hand-drawn red crayon scribble over the torso.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Typography: Heavy condensed black titles are rotated 90 degrees, stacked in separate vertical lines on both sides, cropped at the edges and partly hidden behind the torso. A handwritten red signature runs along the bottom and italic white text runs vertically at upper right.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow ground with black type, white marble, red-orange crayon and gray; flat, graphic light.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman's body is scrutinized and defaced, with a gaze looking back at the viewer.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Visual idea: A classical female nude is scratched out by a red scribble, so the poster itself marks over the idealized body.
1162_three-films-by-mai-zetterling.jpg.Feels like: 1960s feminist art-house collage, with a contemporary editorial design.

1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.People: One tiny figure, a young man playing table tennis in a small film frame at the left; the other frames show a beach and a bedroom without people.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Asymmetric Swiss-style layout with a mostly empty gray ground, a name at the top right, a band of three stills in the middle left and one word at the bottom right. The still strip acts as a horizontal band cutting across the page.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Flat solid ink on matte gray paper-like field, with small photographic stills that look like video or low-resolution film.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Very large black Helvetica-like sans-serif name at the top right, filling about half the width, and ': Trilogy' at the bottom right, so the gap between them is huge. Three small film titles run in a vertical line of tiny type beside the stills.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Neutral warm gray, with black type and muted blue-gray and sand tones in the stills; flat and cool.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: Cold domestic observation, with ordinary rooms and games watched at a distance.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: The title is stretched apart by emptiness, a detached, clinical presentation.
1163_michael-haneke-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: Austere European modernist graphic design, like an art-book cover from the 2020s.

1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.People: Three musicians, small and full body, in a rectangular photo in the lower half; two seated with guitars and one standing playing guitar, all inverted into light negative tones.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetric vertical stack: top rule, credit, title, photo, names, bottom rule. A wooden-looking frame runs around the border, framing a frame.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Medium: Mirror-reversed cyanotype-like print with a negative image, scratched and stained edges, uneven ink and visible creases, as if photographed through the back of a screenprint.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Typography: All lettering is mirror-reversed. The title is huge, with 'VELVET' in thin multi-line outline letters and 'UNDERGROUND' in solid heavy letters, below a small 'THE'; names are in small caps at the bottom. Text is cream on blue, centered, overprinted on the image.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Color and light: Saturated cobalt blue with cream and pale-blue highlights, edged with pink and teal stains; flat, backlit like a negative.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Story it suggests: A band appears as a reversed, underexposed memory from an underground scene.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Visual idea: The image is flipped as if seen from behind the print, an 'underground' reading of the poster.
1164_the-velvet-underground.jpg.Feels like: 1960s psychedelic and experimental-film print, reimagined as a rough silkscreen.

1165_cooley-high.jpg.People: Two young men, large half-body figures, side by side. One at left wears glasses and a flat cap with a coat and tie; the other at right turns his head over his shoulder in a letterman jacket, both looking at the viewer with a playful, sidelong air.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Composition: The two heads sit in the upper middle and overlap; a red brick wall fills the background and a white strip on the left holds the logo. The jacket's back at lower right is the focus.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Medium: Detailed colored-pencil or painted illustration with smooth, photoreal shading and a visible hand-drawn texture, with an artist's signature at the bottom left.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Typography: The title appears as the orange letters of a varsity jacket, 'COOLEY' curved on top and 'HIGH' at the bottom around a basketball patch holding the director credit. The lettering is stitched felt-like, part of the image and partly cut by the edge.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Color and light: Navy, orange and cream with warm brick red; soft, even daylight.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Story it suggests: Two close friends in a mid-century city neighborhood, playful and a bit mischievous.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Visual idea: The title is built into the jacket, so costume becomes the lettering.
1165_cooley-high.jpg.Feels like: 1970s high-school coming-of-age film, as a modern illustrated tribute.

1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..People: A large central man in a powdered wig and red military coat looks out with a smile, half body; two smaller sculpted-looking heads flank him at the bottom, and a tiny nude woman stands in a shell at the center.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Composition: Symmetric and centered, like a stage: a proscenium with red curtains frames the scene (frame within frame), and the tricorn hat at the top fills the top quarter. A balloon at left and a sea monster at right balance each other.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Medium: Hand-painted gouache or acrylic illustration with chalky brushstrokes and a decorative, flat storybook finish.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Typography: The title is set in ornate gold Victorian wood-type letters on the black hat, with a tiny curved line above and a ribbon banner holding the director credit at the bottom in a hand-lettered script. The lettering is part of the picture.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Color and light: Rich red curtains, gold, blue night sky and sea-green, lit like stage footlights.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Story it suggests: A grand storyteller presides over a fantastical show of balloons, monsters and theatrical wonders.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Visual idea: The poster is a toy-theater stage in which the hero's hat carries the title.
1166_the-adventures-of-baron-munchausen..Feels like: Late-1980s fantasy adventure, baroque and playfully theatrical.

1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.People: Two women in close half-body, facing each other: one at left in profile with a hand to her mouth, the other at right in a hat and fur collar looking up at her.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Composition: The two sit in the lower half in a diagonal, close exchange of looks, while the upper half holds stacked title text over a plain gradient wall. A thick underline separates text from the faces.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Medium: Classic black and white studio photograph with soft glow and smooth grain, combined with a typeset layer.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Typography: Big white condensed capitals fill the width for the title, with a script 'of' and script first names above the surnames. The type sits in the empty wall area and does not touch the faces; underline and a small director line follow below.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome from black to white with a gray gradient background; soft glamour lighting.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A moment of emotional intimacy or confession between two women of different standing.
1167_imitation-of-life.jpg.Visual idea: The two faces are the poster, with the lettering like a billboard above them.

1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Composition: Blurred, abstract image of light and dark; a bright warm glow left of center and a dark teal upper half. Title block sits right of the center, mid-height, with a hand-drawn network map of rail lines and cities in the lower right.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Photographic blur with heavy texture, scratches, dust and film-damage marks, overlaid with a scanned or printed map with ink-stamp quality.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Title in condensed distressed white sans capitals, about 45 percent of the width, one line, with a smaller three-line list of films in the same style to the left, and a small credit above; texture has chips like worn print. City names on the map are tiny, handwritten stamped letters.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Dark teal and black on top, glowing yellow, orange and white below; smeared, blown-out light.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A feverish train journey through a ruined Europe, glimpsed through a hazy window.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: A blurred train-window view laid over a railway map, as if memory and geography are mixed.
1168_lars-von-triers-europe-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: Late 1980s and early 1990s European art cinema, with a grungy, hazy mood.

1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.People: One person, small, in a dark hooded shawl, seen from above and kneeling on a metal bedspring frame at the right; around her are about a dozen sheep.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Composition: High-angle view with a dense crowd of sheep filling the frame edge to edge; the woman sits off-center right and the bedspring runs diagonally. The title text runs in a vertical column down the center, over the animals.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Medium: Photographic, grainy film-like image with saturated, slightly crushed color and soft wool texture.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Typography: The title is split into small widely spaced pale serif capitals stacked one word per line down the middle, ending in a larger italic 'RESURRECTION' spread across the width near the bottom. Delicate, light-colored text laid directly over the sheep and the person, not boxed.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Color and light: Deep indigo blue ground with creamy gray-green wool, dim and cold with a soft glow.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Story it suggests: A solitary figure keeps a vigil, surrounded by animals, in a bleak and sacred rural place.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Visual idea: The stacked words fall like a poem, a quiet incantation over a pastoral scene with an odd bedframe as a kind of altar.
1169_this-is-not-a-burial-it-s-a-resurre.Feels like: Contemporary slow-cinema art-house, rural and spiritual.

1170_bergman-island.jpg.People: Two people, close half-body, a woman with curly hair in an orange top and an older man behind her, both looking in profile toward the left; the frames repeat the same pair above and below, blurred.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Composition: Layout is a filmstrip: three vertically stacked frames of the same shot, shifting out of register, with the center frame in focus. A vertical strip of sea fills the left fifth.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Medium: Soft, grainy film with a slight blur and light leaks, and the repeated frames suggest motion blur or a sliding film reel; the sea strip looks like a long-exposure photo.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Typography: Names and title are rotated 90 degrees in a black sans-serif line running up the left edge of the image, separated with slashes and repeating, cropped at the top and bottom. It is small and mechanical, like a film leader.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Color and light: Pale cream and green with orange and navy accents, with blue sea at the left, in soft overcast daylight.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people gaze together at something out of view, with their shared view stuttering like a memory.
1170_bergman-island.jpg.Visual idea: A strip of film slipping in the projector, with the island sea as a blue band beside it.

1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.People: Two young people, large heads in profile, a young man at left lying down and a young woman at right leaning over, facing each other, with eyes lowered and a faint smile.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Composition: Strictly symmetric about a vertical white sword that hangs from the top center and splits the poster in two. The faces sit at mid-height on either side, and the title is at the bottom left.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Medium: Flat two-color screenprint look: photographs reduced to dark brown and red tones with a solid cream sword shape.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Typography: Black blackletter 'Romeo and Juliet' stacked at the bottom left, large (about a third of the poster's height), with swashy ornamental capitals, a smaller serif credit at right. The sword's blade passes between the words.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red-orange throughout with black, deep brown and cream; flat, warm tones.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers gaze at each other in bed while a blade hangs between them, so love and danger share one frame.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Visual idea: The sword is a divider between the two lovers, a symbol of violence cutting the intimacy in two.
1171_romeo-and-juliet.jpg.Feels like: 1960s romantic costume drama, in a bold, modern graphic style.

1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.People: One person, seen as a large blurred dark silhouette of a long-haired figure, with a glowing red-orange smaller figure at the center, which is ambiguous (reflection, another body or a bottle shape).
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Composition: Centered, symmetric portrait with the figure filling the frame; a white border frames the image, and the text sits in the lower center. The small glowing shape is on the central axis.
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Medium: Heavily out-of-focus photograph with soft bokeh, film grain and a smooth gradient; almost no hard edges.
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Typography: Small, widely letter-spaced white serif capitals centered at the bottom in three lines, the last in italics. Quiet and modest, it sits over the dark blur.
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Color and light: Murky olive, brown and black with a glowing ember-red center, lit from within like a lamp.
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Story it suggests: A presence barely seen, a memory or a person dissolving into darkness.
1172_two-films-by-marguerite-duras.jpg.Visual idea: Blur as a stand-in for memory and absence, where nothing can be pinned down.

1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.People: Four men sitting in a row on chairs, full body, each holding or resting with sheets of paper, and looking nervous, bored or thoughtful; they are drawn and not photographed. More faces appear inside the wall posters (drawn within the drawing).
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Composition: A horizontal line of seated figures across the bottom half, with a wall of framed posters behind them (frames within the frame). The title sits at upper right over a poster.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration with flat colors and pencil-like shading, imitating screenprinted posters on the wall.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Typography: Big white chunky outlined block letters with a metallic gradient, stacked in two lines at upper right and running into the poster, with a script line above; the lettering in the faux posters is distinct and busy.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Color and light: Peach beige wall with green, brown and mustard clothes and orange-red posters; flat, even light.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Story it suggests: Several actors wait their turn at an audition, anxious, with scripts in hand.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Visual idea: A waiting-room line-up where the cheesy posters on the wall comment on the roles on offer.
1173_hollywood-shuffle.jpg.Feels like: 1980s satirical comedy, in a retro illustrated style.

1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.People: Two men, large half-body, one above and behind the other, both in old-style hair and robes, each gripping a sword and looking sideways with a hard expression.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Composition: The two figures form a diagonal cluster in the center on a wide white field, with swords crossing at lower left and a seal-like label in the center. The title sits below and the poster has ample empty space.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Medium: Ink-wash and watercolor painting look, with loose brushstrokes, splatters, bleeding washes and paper-white gaps.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Typography: Title in red condensed serif capitals stacked in three lines at the bottom with a small 'for', and a gray serif director line below; a vertical Chinese label in a red-bordered stamp sits mid-poster. Clean typeset text, separate from the painting.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Color and light: White paper with black and gray ink, vivid red splashes and a little green; even and matte.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Story it suggests: Two sword-wielding men, bloodied and wary, stand together in a fight.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Visual idea: The red wash bleeds across the swords and bodies, reading as spilled blood and brush paint in one.
1174_last-hurrah-for-chivalry.jpg.Feels like: Swordsman and martial-arts film of the 1970s, with a traditional ink-painting feel.

1175_inland-empire.jpg.People: One person, barely visible as a blurred gray face in the middle, partly hidden behind the letters; ambiguous and out of focus.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Composition: A black field with a rectangle of gray image in the center, covered by huge title letters that run off the left and right edges. A large empty black area sits at the bottom.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Medium: Dark, low-resolution video-like blur with soft glow, with the letters cut out like holes with a bright halo.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Typography: Huge black condensed capitals 'INLAND EMPIRE' in two lines, about the full width of the poster and cut off at left and right, with a glowing white edge, so they read as black cutouts. Smaller white widely spaced lines for the name above and a quoted tagline below.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Color and light: Almost pure black and white with gray mid-tones; ghostly backlight.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Story it suggests: Someone is lost in a dark, dreamlike space, and their face is blotted out by the title.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Visual idea: The words are voids that swallow the image, a threat in the dark.
1175_inland-empire.jpg.Feels like: Early-2000s experimental digital-video horror, mysterious and unsettling.

1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, large, three-quarter body, standing in falling snow and facing a house; a faint figure stands in a window of the house (a small, ambiguous silhouette).
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Composition: The man fills the right side and the A-frame house the upper left, with a small orange car at lower left; the diagonal roof line points to his head. Large empty snow-white space at the bottom holds the title.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with soft gouache or oil brushwork, visible canvas texture and a hazy vignette that fades to white at the edges.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Typography: Title in a pale blue-gray serif at lower center-left, in two lines, about a quarter of the poster's width, with a smaller credit line below. Calm, low-contrast and set in the snow.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Color and light: Icy white, pale blue and gray with a single orange car and bits of red-orange wrappers; flat overcast winter light.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Story it suggests: A man stands in the snow outside a house, watching, unable to go in.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Visual idea: Whiteness itself conveys the cold and emptiness, with the car's warm color as the only heat.
1176_chilly-scenes-of-winter.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American indie drama, gentle and melancholy.

1177_small-axe.jpg.People: Many faces, about a dozen, in close-up and half-body crops (a boy with glasses, protesters with fists and megaphones, smiling friends, a man in a suit); they are sliced into the arms of an X.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Composition: A Union Jack-like cross and diagonals divide the poster into four quadrants, each with portrait photos cut into diagonal bands, and a red cityscape runs along the central cross. Strongly symmetric, with the title at the exact center.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Medium: Photographic stills tinted in red and blue, cut into geometric shards, and a duotone aerial photo of a city in the center cross.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Typography: Bold white sans-serif title 'SMALL AXE' with a small round emblem between the words, plus 'FIVE FILMS BY STEVE MCQUEEN' in smaller bold type to the right. Placed at the center crossing, clean and legible over the dark red.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, white and blue, with natural warm color in the photo patches; flat graphic light.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Story it suggests: Several lives and a community's struggles, in joy and protest, are woven together in one city.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Visual idea: The flag's cross is rebuilt from portraits of Black Britons, so the national symbol is filled with its people.
1177_small-axe.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary anthology series cover, 1970s British social drama.

1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Composition: A single golden hand grenade tilts diagonally from the upper left to the lower right in the center, with its pin and ring floating at upper right. A splash of liquid follows the same diagonal, and the title sits at the bottom.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Medium: Glossy, photographic rendering of gold metal with liquid splash droplets, a high-contrast studio look.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Typography: Title in cream serif capitals stacked in two lines at the bottom, about two thirds of the width, with some letters (A, S) in italic, plus a small director line above. Elegant, classical type over the dark splashing droplets.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with metallic gold and cream highlights; dramatic spot lighting and sparkle.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Story it suggests: Luxury and violence collide in one explosive object, a pin pulled and the blast pending.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Visual idea: A grenade made of gold, a symbol of wealth as a weapon, with champagne-like splash.
1178_triangle-of-sadness.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary satirical drama, decadent and glossy.

1179_targets.jpg.People: One older man's face, a large close-up cropped in a circle, and a smaller second face and a hand at the right; the images are cut into quadrants and reassembled, so they are fragments of faces.
1179_targets.jpg.Composition: A large circle divided by crosshair lines into four quadrants fills the lower two thirds: an old man's face at left, a newspaper at upper right, a bullseye at lower right. The title above is repeated and layered.
1179_targets.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black and white halftone photos cut as paper collage, on flat red solid ink.
1179_targets.jpg.Typography: Title 'TARGETS' set in huge cream display capitals with sliced, stencil-like angular cuts, repeated in three overlapping rows across the top third and spanning the whole width. A small bold sans-serif credit line at the top and bottom.
1179_targets.jpg.Color and light: Brick red with cream, black and white; stark, flat contrast.
1179_targets.jpg.Story it suggests: An aging man is caught in the sights of a rifle-like scope, where news of violence and a shooting range blur together.
1179_targets.jpg.Visual idea: A rifle scope's crosshair slices the image into pieces, with the bullseye replacing the face.
1179_targets.jpg.Feels like: 1960s American thriller, bold modernist graphic design.

1180_thelma-louise.jpg.People: Two women, large, close half-body, in an open convertible; one in front in sunglasses and a sleeveless top with wind-blown hair, the other behind her in a denim vest, also in sunglasses; a mirror shows a reflection of the road.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Composition: A diagonal car frame sweeps from the upper left and the large side mirror anchors the bottom center; the two heads are overlapping at the upper middle. A cream band at the bottom holds the text.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with visible oil or gouache brush strokes, with glossy highlights on the chrome.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Typography: Title in a bold orange-red sans-serif in capitals at the bottom right, about half the width, with smaller black cast names above in a clean sans. It sits on a flat cream band, separate from the picture.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Color and light: Turquoise car, orange-red hair, sunny desert yellow and blue sky; hot, bright sun.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Story it suggests: Two friends on a carefree drive that feels like an escape.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Visual idea: The mirror reflects the open road behind, with the women's wind-blown hair as a sign of speed and freedom.
1180_thelma-louise.jpg.Feels like: Early-1990s road movie, a sunny retro illustration.

1181_petite-maman.jpg.People: Two tiny children, in blue and red sweaters, walking hand in hand into the dark forest at the center; they look like two small figures, almost mirror-like.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Composition: A deep arch of tree trunks frames a dark tunnel with the pair at its mouth, the center of a vertical, near-symmetric view. A white snow-like shape at the bottom holds the title.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Medium: Watercolor and gouache illustration with soft washes, visible brush marks, layered leaves and a paper-like white.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Typography: Title in red-orange serif capitals, in two lines at the lower left, about a third of the width, and a smaller italic credit at the lower right. Quiet and classical, on a plain cream shape.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal, green and navy forest with cream, with two spots of red and blue; dim, cool woodland light.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Story it suggests: Two children enter a mysterious forest together and are small in the dark.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Visual idea: The woods as a doorway, with the two kids dressed in mirrored colors as a sign of doubling.
1181_petite-maman.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary children's-book fairy tale, gentle and uncanny.

1182_the-servant.jpg.People: Two men: a large one at the bottom in a flat cap, looking upward with his mouth slightly open, shown from the chest up, and a smaller man in a dark suit standing above in a round mirror, with a gloved hand on a railing; a dark figurine sits in the mirror, too.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Composition: A large round gilt mirror is in the upper half as a frame within a frame, with the servant's face below it overlapping its edge. The title sits at the bottom center.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Medium: Painterly digital or gouache illustration with smooth blended strokes and a glowing, glossy sheen on the gold frame.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Typography: Title in teal slab-serif capitals, 'SERVANT' very large at the bottom center with a small 'THE' above, and smaller cream credit lines at the very bottom. The teal stands out clearly against the brown and gold.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Color and light: Warm amber, gold and brown with a teal title and a patch of blue; dim, theatrical light from above.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in a lower position looks up while another man watches him from a reflection, with power and suspicion between them.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Visual idea: The mirror shows the master above the servant, who is seen in reverse, a hierarchy shown through reflection.
1182_the-servant.jpg.Feels like: 1960s British psychological drama, moody and claustrophobic.

1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.People: Two figures, small to medium, loosely painted standing beside a bicycle; one wears a backpack. They are abstract sketches with almost no faces.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Composition: A white field with huge title lettering filling the top half and a compact painted cluster of figures and bike in the lower half, leaving wide margins. Bicycle wheels anchor the bottom center.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Medium: Loose watercolor washes with black crayon or charcoal line, visible smears and uneven edges on white paper.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Typography: Very large black high-contrast serif title in three stacked lines, with 'for' in italic, spanning most of the width and the top half of the poster. A small blue serif director line at the bottom. The lettering is elegant, fashion-magazine-like and does not touch the painting.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Color and light: Pale cyan and teal washes with black lines on off-white; soft, airy and cool.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people moving through a city together, quiet and a little wistful.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Visual idea: Sketchy blue figures stand for fleeting, half-remembered connection, with the oversize title as a counterweight.
1183_medicine-for-melancholy.jpg.Feels like: Indie romance of the 2000s, hand-drawn and breezy.

1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.People: One woman's face large and partly hidden behind a small black-and-white photo that a hand holds up; the photo shows another face with wide eyes and a headscarf. Two hands pinch the photo's edges (a portrait within a portrait).
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Composition: Centered vertical layout: the title stacks across the top half, the face sits behind, the held photograph fills the lower left, and the director's name stacks at the lower right. A photo-in-photo frame is the focal point.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Medium: Photograph with a flat saturated pink background, and an engraving-like, high-contrast halftone print for the small photo.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered mint-green brush capitals, large, in four lines across the top and again at lower right, slightly tilted and uneven, like handwriting. The letters overlap the head and are the same size as the face.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Color and light: Hot magenta pink with mint green lettering, black and white photo and dark skin; flat, vivid, studio-like light.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks for someone from the past and holds up an old picture to the camera.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Visual idea: An old image is held up against a living face, so the past and present overlap.
1184_the-watermelon-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1990s independent queer cinema, a zine-like pop poster.

1185_after-hours.jpg.People: One man, large, with his face tilted up and a worried look, from the chest up, and about a dozen small faces and figures in the collage behind him.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Composition: The big face sits at the center and fills most of the frame, with a wall of small collaged photos, a clock and signs surrounding it in a ring. The title curves up at the bottom right.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Medium: Coarse halftone and stipple screenprint look, made with two or three flat inks, with a visible dot pattern.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Typography: Pink neon-tube-like script title, 'After Hours', in glowing loops that run diagonally up from the lower center, partly overlapping the man's collar, plus a small teal credit. It is a bright, hand-drawn glowing line.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Color and light: Teal, hot pink and peach on cream, with black stippled shadows; flat and poster-like with a neon feel.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Story it suggests: A frightened man is caught in a night of strange encounters, with the clock ticking.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Visual idea: A face swimming in a collage of the night's clues: signs, a clock, strangers.
1185_after-hours.jpg.Feels like: 1980s New York cult comedy-thriller, in a retro risograph look.

1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.People: Five cowboys, medium-sized half and full body, rotated around the page so that three or four are upside-down or sideways; the one at lower right is upright. They look like repeated cut-outs of the same man in different poses with rifles.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Composition: A radial or kaleidoscope arrangement of figures rotated around an empty central white area, where the title sits. Orange and red rock formations frame the corners.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Medium: Photographic cut-outs reduced to red-orange duotone halftone with a grainy screenprint texture; the upright figure is in natural color.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Typography: Title in chunky red wood-type Western letters, slightly distressed and textured, stacked in the center, taking up about half the width. A tan and red serif credit sits below it.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Color and light: Vivid red, orange and cream with a dark gray-brown for the one upright man; sunbaked, flat light.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Story it suggests: Gunmen close in from every side on a lone center, a standoff in a desert.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Visual idea: The rotated figures make the desert feel like a circle of duelists, upside down, around the title.
1186_the-ranown-westerns-five-films-dire.Feels like: 1950s Western, remade as a bold modern graphic.

1187_one-false-move.jpg.People: One woman's face, very large and cropped at the top, in three-quarter view, with curly hair. Below, a dark police car with a headlight beam and a tiny body lying on the road (small and ambiguous), and a faint second person in the shadow at right.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Composition: The big face is in the upper left, the text column runs down the right, and a small night scene sits along the bottom edge; a tower-like pylon is drawn faintly behind. A bright beam crosses to the body.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Medium: Painterly illustration with soft oil-paint blending, visible brush marks and fog or grain in the bottom landscape.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Typography: Cast names in small tan sans-serif capitals stacked at the right, then the large cream condensed serif title in three lines, about one third of the width, aligned left. Typeset, simple and without distortion.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Color and light: Dark brown and black with a warm glow on the face and a cold white headlight beam; night, dramatic chiaroscuro.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman looks away, thoughtful or guilty, while police lights find a body on the road.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Visual idea: The woman's face looms over the scene like a memory or conscience, with the crime scene shrunk beneath her.
1187_one-false-move.jpg.Feels like: 1990s Southern crime noir, a moody thriller.

1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.People: None; a pile of about a dozen pairs of shoes drawn near a doorway implies people unseen.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Composition: A flat red field with the title in the upper third and a small line-drawn pile of shoes in the lower center, with a step and a doorframe in thin lines; wide empty space between. Centered and simple.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Medium: Flat solid red ink with thin black pen or marker line drawing, wobbly and childlike; the shoes are drawn in a red-on-red outline.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Typography: Lowercase hand-lettered title in mustard yellow, in two sizes, centered, with 'dim sum' large at the upper middle and subtitle and director line small. Simple, rounded and friendly.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red with mustard yellow and black lines; flat, no light.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Story it suggests: A household full of guests, a home where many people have just arrived.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Visual idea: The shoes at the door stand for the family inside, with absence implying presence.
1188_dim-sum-a-little-bit-of-heart.jpg.Feels like: 1980s small-scale family drama, a minimal hand-drawn design.

1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.People: A large cropped figure lying sideways on grass fills the left two-thirds: closed-eyed face, white lace-cuffed sleeve and clasped hands, shown rotated 90 degrees. Three small black-and-white stills on the right show a woman's face behind a wet car mirror, a young man leaning on a desk, and a column of marching men with a red banner.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Composition: Vertical split: a big color image on the left, a cream column of text on the right bracketed by stacked small stills above and below. The sleeping figure runs diagonally from top left to bottom center, with the title straddling the seam.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Medium: Grainy color film still on the left with soft focus and slightly faded tones; the right-hand stills are high-contrast black-and-white photographs with visible grain, and the center is flat cream paper with solid ink.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Typography: The title is split in two: 'BO WIDERBERG'S' in a condensed white sans across the image, and 'NEW SWEDISH CINEMA' in tall, heavy dark-green condensed capitals stacked in three lines on the cream panel. Four film titles in small orange-red caps sit beneath. All typeset, upright, and large.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Color and light: Spring greens, pale cream and white, with orange-red and yellow accents; soft natural daylight on the left, harsh grayscale on the right.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Story it suggests: A quiet, dreamy rest outdoors set against glimpses of private worry, longing and collective march, as if one pastoral moment sits among several stories.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Visual idea: A collection poster as contact sheet: one oversized, rotated intimate frame against smaller stills of other moods, so the sideways sleeper reads as a dream or a fall.
1189_bo-widerbergs-new-swedish-cinema.jp.Feels like: Art-house film retrospective box set, 1960s-70s European new-wave feel in a contemporary editorial layout.

1190_drylongso.jpg.People: About seven people cut out and pasted: three small Polaroid portraits at the top, a person hiding their face behind a red instant camera at the center, a man on a bicycle at right, a woman in a bandana and sunglasses at left, and two women at the bottom (one crouched in a floral dress, one standing and smiling in denim). Mostly half-body to full-body, arranged as separate cutouts rather than interacting.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Composition: Dense collage centered on the camera, with figures orbiting it in a rough ring. A generous cream margin frames the whole collage; torn paper edges and scattered flowers fill gaps, and the title sits alone in the bottom margin.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Medium: Hand-made paper collage: torn paper edges, visible glue bottles, patterned carpet scraps, music-sheet staves, embossed gold foil flowers and dark red fabric roses, with Polaroid borders. Photographic cutouts have a slightly faded print look.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Typography: The title 'DRYLONGSO' is set in widely letterspaced italic serif capitals in deep maroon at the bottom center, relatively small. 'A film by CAULEEN SMITH' is a tiny maroon italic line placed on a torn paper strip at upper left. Both are typeset and sit calmly outside the collage.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Color and light: Warm maroon, tan, gold and teal blue with cream; flat, even, scrapbook-like lighting.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Story it suggests: A circle of friends and neighbors documents each other's days, with a camera turned toward the viewer.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Visual idea: The poster as a scrapbook or photo album with a camera at the center, implying memory, looking and being looked at.
1190_drylongso.jpg.Feels like: Handmade zine or scrapbook collage, 1990s nostalgia with Black American portrait photography feel.

1191_the-trial.jpg.People: A man in a dark suit seen from behind stands at the center walking on a hallway floor; three other suited figures appear tiny, one far away at the top in a doorway, one rotated sideways on a wall at left, one on a door at top right. A large reclining figure with a rounded sleeve lies sideways at the bottom, cropped. The orientations make some of them ambiguous in position.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Composition: Fractured, rotated planes in black and white: a long corridor in steep perspective runs from center to bottom, while a door and a wall are turned on their sides. The giant title letters cut a perspective funnel down the center, with the main figure standing on its edge.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic collage with heavy film grain and high contrast, combining several rotated frames and a flat white cutout lettering shape.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Typography: The title 'THE TRIAL' is in enormous solid white block capitals, stacked and sheared into a vanishing-point funnel, with 'THE' on top and 'TRIAL' below, partly cut by the figures and floor. Smaller bold italic credits sit at left and bottom, and a thin line of credits runs along the top. Typeset, but warped into the architecture.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and mid-grays only; dim, hard-edged studio light with deep shadows.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man is lost in an endless, impossible building where walls and floors do not agree and nothing leads out.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Visual idea: The lettering is the corridor: letters turn into the floor's perspective, and the world is rotated so up and down are unreliable.
1191_the-trial.jpg.Feels like: 1960s black-and-white art-house paranoia thriller, bureaucratic nightmare with modern graphic collage treatment.

1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.People: A single figure shown from chest up, centered and viewed from below, with spiky red-pink hair and a face tinted pink. The torso is turned into a flat hot-pink shape with concentric line patterns across the body and sleeves. Looking straight out at the viewer, alone.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Composition: Strict central symmetry: the figure rises from the bottom edge to just above center against a starry sky, shoulders spreading in a wide triangle, striped curves mirrored on each side. The top-down line pattern radiates around the hourglass-shaped chest.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Medium: A photographic face posterized into flat pink ink, with outlined stripes that look like screen-print layers, set over a photographic night sky with stars and a purple galaxy band.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Typography: The title runs vertically along the right edge, reading top to bottom, in condensed bold capitals alternating pink and white, with small 'A FILM BY' stacked between words. It is narrow, about a third of the poster height, rotated 90 degrees, and typeset, sitting in the empty sky beside the figure.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Color and light: Neon magenta and hot pink against deep navy and violet; cool star glow and a flat, shadowless pop color.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous alien-like figure stands calmly in front of the universe, as if arrived from somewhere else.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Visual idea: Pop-art screenprint of a person fused with outer space, with the striped bodysuit as a cosmic emblem.
1192_moonage-daydream.jpg.Feels like: 1970s glam-rock and space-age pop-art, with contemporary neon color.

1193_la-bamba.jpg.People: One large central man in a leather jacket playing an electric guitar, shown three-quarter body with a grin and a radiating burst behind him. Four smaller cut-out heads with names, two women and one man on the left and two women at right, ring him like portraits. They do not interact, but orbit him.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical arched layout: a yellow arch frames the central figure, with portraits placed in a loose circle and decorative flowers filling the four corners. The title sits at the bottom on a green blob, while the main subject sits slightly above center.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Medium: Risograph or letterpress-style print on cream paper texture, with halftone-dot black-and-white photos, flat pink, green and yellow spot inks, and slight misregistration offsets.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Typography: 'LA BAMBA' is huge at the bottom, in chunky hand-lettered, slanted pink capitals with black and green drop shadows, partly wrapped by quote marks. Cast names are tiny black caps under each portrait, and the star's credit curves along the arch top in a rough black script. Hand-drawn feel, integrated with the image.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow, pink and mint green with black and cream; flat, printed color without real light.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Story it suggests: A rising young guitar star, surrounded by family and loves, is celebrated like a saint.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Visual idea: A devotional prayer-card or votive altar format, with a halo, sacred heart, flowers, snake and winged guitar to turn a rock singer into a folk saint.
1193_la-bamba.jpg.Feels like: Mexican-American folk-art and vintage rock-and-roll handbill, 1950s nostalgia in modern risograph style.

1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.People: Three vintage sepia portraits: a man in a wide hat dabbing his face with a handkerchief in a yellow oval at left, a woman in a nun's habit in a blue oval at right, and a smiling person in a patterned dress holding a card and wand in a red diamond at center. All are half-body or bust portraits, framed separately, not interacting.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Composition: Symmetric centered layout: a red diamond holds the central portrait, flanked by two ovals, with giant title across the top and two smaller titles at the bottom left and right. A thin ornate rectangular border frames it all.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Medium: Worn, distressed print: speckled ink, scratched and cracked surfaces, and chipped paint on a charcoal board, with sepia-toned vintage photos and flat red, yellow and blue ink like old carnival signage.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Typography: 'FREAKS' dominates the top in huge, hand-cut, wobbly Victorian capitals alternating red and yellow with cream outlines. Below are many small taglines in stencil-like and hand-drawn letters in cream, plus two secondary titles in curly yellow and blue lettering at the bottom. Nearly every line differs in style, like a sideshow bill.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Color and light: Red, mustard yellow and sky blue on blackened gray, with aged paper-like flat light.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Story it suggests: A traveling sideshow invites us to gawk at strange performers and sentimental romance.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Visual idea: A fake antique carnival banner built from mismatched type and frames, so the poster itself feels like a show.
1194_freaks-the-unknown-the-mystic-tod-b.Feels like: Early 20th century circus and sideshow broadsides, with vintage horror and a nostalgic-gothic mood.

1195_the-others.jpg.People: A single woman shown in profile from the head to the chest, looking left with wide eyes, parted lips and a tear on her cheek. She is lone and large, filling the upper two-thirds of the poster. A thin necklace runs down her neck.
1195_the-others.jpg.Composition: Central subject emerging from a large black void: head in the upper center, neck and shoulders tapering toward the bottom center. The text block sits in the bottom third, centered, leaving much empty black on both sides.
1195_the-others.jpg.Medium: Photographic, painterly retouching: smooth skin, soft blurred edges, and a flat black background with no texture, giving a studio-portrait or oil-painting finish.
1195_the-others.jpg.Typography: The title 'THE OTHERS' sits at the bottom center in widely spaced serif capitals in warm gray-gold, medium-large, with the O blurred and enlarged so the letters seem to go out of focus. Smaller actor and director credits in thin spaced capitals above and below. All typeset and horizontal.
1195_the-others.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with muted gold and pale skin tones; low-key light from the left like a single candle.
1195_the-others.jpg.Story it suggests: A frightened woman in darkness hears or sees something unseen, and holds back her fear.
1195_the-others.jpg.Visual idea: Face as the only visible thing in the darkness, with the out-of-focus lettering suggesting unclear sight or presences.
1195_the-others.jpg.Feels like: Gothic ghost story, period melodrama of the 1940s-50s portrait, early 2000s thriller restraint.

1196_nanny.jpg.People: One woman standing waist-deep in dark water, facing the viewer with her chin raised, in a long braid and open shirt over a tank top. Large and full figure from head to thighs, centered. Beneath the surface a hand grabs at her leg, ambiguous whether it's a person or something else.
1196_nanny.jpg.Composition: Strongly central and vertical: her body forms a column in the middle, with the horizontal title crossing her chest and the water line near the bottom edge. Empty hazy darkness surrounds her on both sides.
1196_nanny.jpg.Medium: Painterly digital illustration with visible brushstrokes and grainy, smoky texture, looking like a painted photograph; gold paint streaks sit on the shirt and the hand.
1196_nanny.jpg.Typography: 'NANNY' is spaced out across the width in large gold serif capitals with sharp angular cuts, and the Y has a drip-like vertical stroke ending in a point that falls down her body. The lettering overlaps her torso. Small gold credit text at the bottom in italic serif.
1196_nanny.jpg.Color and light: Deep indigo, violet and ink-blue with mustard-gold accents; cold, glowing moonlight or underwater light.
1196_nanny.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman rises from dark water as something from below pulls at her, haunted and defiant.
1196_nanny.jpg.Visual idea: Her body is a monument rising out of the dark, while the gold drip links the lettering to the hand as if the title is leaking.
1196_nanny.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary folk-horror and ghost story, with a spiritual painted-portrait mood.

1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.People: Six images of the same young man with feathered dark hair, cut out and flying through the air in kung-fu poses: kicking, falling, leaping with a pole, crouching with claws. Mostly full body or half body, often upside down, all in mid-action; the repetition suggests different moments rather than a crowd.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Composition: A swirling whirl of overlapping figures, thrown props, a stool, bowls, a vase, a chicken and eggs, all on white. The figures form diagonals and a loose spiral around the center, with the big title letters scattered behind.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Medium: Loose gouache, ink and pencil illustration with visible brush marks and watery washes, highlights in white, and faded unpainted areas; the red lettering has a rough, felt-like flat texture.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Typography: 'JACKIE CHAN' is enormous, in rough red block capitals scattered and tilted, each letter placed separately (J, A, C, K, I, E, then C, H, A, N) and overlapped by the figures. A smaller red wide-spaced 'EMERGENCE OF A SUPERSTAR' sits below with film titles in small black caps. Typeset, but arranged as flying pieces.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Color and light: Bright white background with red, black, olive green and white clothing, plus flesh tones; flat, bright, shadowless.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Story it suggests: A brawl turns into acrobatic slapstick, with objects flying and the same fighter everywhere at once.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Visual idea: Letters, props and bodies are all tossed by the same kick, so the typography itself becomes part of the fight.
1197_jackie-chan-emergence-of-a-supersta.Feels like: 1970s-80s martial arts movie art, hand-painted comedic action, in a playful contemporary re-draw.

1198_mean-streets.jpg.People: A young man's face cut out large at center, torn in half down the middle with two different expressions (grinning on one side, calm on the other), his arm stretched toward the viewer holding a revolver. Two small full-body men in overcoats walk at the bottom left, and a statue of a robed figure stands at the right. Crucifix figures appear as objects.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Composition: Layered cut-and-paste collage around a central torso and face; the torn seam runs vertically through the face to the crucifix below. Neon signs, a street storefront, a mailbox and a car cluster around the figure, with the big title above and tagline below.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Medium: Photographic cutouts with warm film color, ripped paper edges and a visible match flame, printed on speckled cream paper; the title is flat ink with a rough, grainy texture.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Typography: 'MEAN STREETS' is huge, in chunky, rounded, slightly bent red capitals with the letters locked tightly together in two lines across the top half; texture is distressed. Small black credit above and a red tagline in condensed capitals below. Typeset, and the figure overlaps its lower edge.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Color and light: Brick red, rust brown and cream with neon red-orange glows; warm night-street light and a flame highlight.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Story it suggests: A man is split between faith and violence on the same street, gun raised, in a world of churches and bars.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Visual idea: The torn face as a divided soul, with sacred objects and sin signs stacked in the same cut-out space.
1198_mean-streets.jpg.Feels like: 1970s New York crime drama, gritty seventies exploitation-style collage with a modern retro treatment.

1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.People: Two women's faces in extreme close-up, cropped so the left face shows half (one eye, nose tip, lips) and the right face shows eye, nose and mouth, their heads pressed side by side. Both look out, with the faces filling almost the entire poster.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Composition: Vertical split along a diagonal seam; the left face dominates, the right one sits upper right, leaving a wedge of red background between them. The text block sits bottom right, below the faces.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Medium: Coarse film grain, soft focus and visible noise, like an enlarged blown-up video still; skin looks sandy, with slightly blurred edges.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Typography: 'LA CEREMONIE' is a medium-large, hand-written, slanted yellow script in the bottom right. Cast names above are in thin cream handwritten caps, with the director's line underneath. They overlap the dark red background and the cheek of the right face. Hand-drawn feel.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Color and light: Flesh tones, brick red and dark brown with a lone yellow title; harsh warm, flat light.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women, intimately close and yet cut off from each other, share a charged unease.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Visual idea: The two cropped faces are fitted together like halves of one portrait, merging two people into a pair.
1199_la-ceremonie.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1990s European psychological thriller, intimate and slightly grimy.

1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.People: A small boy in a gray sweater looking up, shown from the shoulders up in color at the bottom, holding a string. Above on the balloon stand a black-and-white boy riding a white horse, a foal, and a winged angel-like figure in white gliding at the upper left; a tiny hot-air balloon with a basket floats at the top right. The color boy is a photograph, the others are cutouts.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Composition: Vertical stack along a central axis: boy at the bottom, string rising to a huge red sphere in the middle, a tower of animals and figures balanced on top. Wide empty pale sky on both sides; the scene reads as a tall balancing totem.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Medium: Photo collage with smooth sky gradient and mixed photographic cutouts, some in black and white and some in muted color; the balloon is glossy, with a reflection of a city skyline.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Typography: 'THE RED BALLOON' is set inside the balloon in white, chunky, flared capitals with a wide RED, medium size; 'and Other Stories' is in blue flowing script to the lower right, and the director line is in small plain serif text. Typeset, partly integrated into the object.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Color and light: Pale powder blue and cream sky with a saturated glossy red and orange accents; soft, bright daylight.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Story it suggests: A child and his floating balloon carry a stack of dreamlike creatures into the sky.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Visual idea: The balloon is the platform for all the stories, stacking the five films as one floating monument.
1200_the-red-balloon-and-other-stories-f.Feels like: Mid-century children's storybook and French poetic fantasy, in a gentle modern collage style.

1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.People: Several characters: a wooden puppet boy at the center-front with an upraised arm, an old bearded man behind him with a hand on his shoulder, a tall pale winged being with white eyes behind both, a small monkey crouching at lower left, a dangling devil-like puppet at the upper right, and tiny masked soldiers at lower right. Dolls and a bomb hang from strings at the edges.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Composition: A tall framed rectangle in the middle of cream margins with a pyramid arrangement: wings spread behind, figures stacked down to a decorative ornamental base with a cricket face. Strings and aircraft suggest a stage.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Medium: Highly detailed digital illustration in the style of an engraved or screen-printed poster, with grainy cloudy sky texture and a faded duotone feel; hatching and tonal gradients.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Typography: Top line 'GUILLERMO DEL TORO'S' in medium red serif capitals; 'PINOCCHIO' is huge, in tall thin elegant red-orange capitals with outlines, spanning the top of the frame and overlapped by the wings. Credits are small and upright at both bottom corners in navy. Typeset in a decorative style.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Color and light: Muted olive, teal, sepia and gold with purple shadow and orange fire at the horizon; hazy, stormy light.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Story it suggests: A father and his puppet boy stand together under a watching angel while war and trouble gather behind them.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Visual idea: A theatre of puppets and strings: every figure is hung, held or watched, and the proscenium frame turns it into a marionette stage.
1201_guillermo-del-toro-s-pinocchio.jpg.Feels like: Dark fairy tale and storybook fantasy, in the manner of a collectible screen-print gig poster.

1202_lone-star.jpg.People: No living figures; a car viewed head-on at the horizon top right, and a huge animal-like skull half-buried in the ground at lower left. A small sheriff's star badge lies on the ground at lower right.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Composition: Split horizon about one-quarter down: sky and a distant car on top, then a wide band of earth. The skull dominates the lower left diagonally, with the badge at the opposite corner and the title centered across the middle.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Medium: Gouache or acrylic painting with dry-brush strokes and thick flat patches, visible paint scrape marks and flecked texture on the sky.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Typography: 'LONE STAR' sits at mid-height across nearly the full width, in heavy cream slab-serif capitals with a distressed, chipped texture, like a worn wooden sign. Small italic director credit beneath in the same cream. Typeset, sits on the ground like a billboard.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Color and light: Dusty ochre, tan and brown against a turquoise sky; flat, strong desert sun with little shadow.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Story it suggests: A law car arrives at a barren landscape where old bones and a lost badge point to something buried.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Visual idea: The star badge next to the skull sets law and death together in the dirt, an unearthed secret.
1202_lone-star.jpg.Feels like: Southwestern neo-western, painted 1970s paperback or western pulp with a mystery mood.

1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.People: One woman's face in black-and-white close-up, short dark hair, looking straight at us with a slight smile, on the top card of a stack; behind are other film frames with a couple kissing, a blonde woman leaning over, and a back view. Several people, all as photos.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Composition: Four overlapping photo cards, staggered up and to the right, on a flat red field; the big face is lower centre-right and the title block overlaps its top. A grid of eight small film titles runs along the bottom in four columns.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Medium: Photographic stills with film grain, printed as collaged flat rectangles on a solid red ground; the portrait is monochrome, the others have colour.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Typography: Heavy, extra-bold condensed off-white capitals in three left-aligned lines at upper left, large at about 75% width, overlapping the first card and the top of the face; below is small regular grotesque in four columns.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Color and light: Coral red, cream, with black-and-white and teal-blue photos; flat, even light.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Story it suggests: A woman looks us in the eye, surrounded by scenes from different films.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Visual idea: A stack of film frames fanned like a deck of cards: one body of work seen in layers.
1203_chantal-akerman-masterpieces-196819.Feels like: Contemporary boxed-set design with a 1970s European art-film mood.

1204_trainspotting.jpg.People: Five full-body figures in black and white, laid out in a vertical stack and numbered 1 to 5 with names: a thin man in a T-shirt, a man in a splashed suit, a woman in a glittery dress, a man in a tweed suit, and a man in glasses and a leather jacket. They are rotated 90 degrees, as if lying sideways, each posing or looking out, not interacting.
