1204_trainspotting.jpg.Composition: The whole composition is rotated sideways: the title column sits left of center, and the people stack in a vertical lineup on the right over white chevrons; the big left side is empty cream.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Medium: Flat, solid orange ink and clean vector shapes, with high-contrast halftone-like black-and-white cutouts; looks like signage or a printed form on matte paper.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Typography: 'Trainspotting' is large, in bold white Helvetica-like lowercase on an orange panel with a visible grid and margins, rotated to read bottom to top, ending in a diagonal arrow. Character labels are small orange sans text beside numbered dots. Entirely typeset and systematic.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Color and light: Cream, bright orange and black and white; flat, even, studio-like light.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Story it suggests: A cast of five is lined up like items on a station board, each a character in the same system.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Visual idea: A transit-signage or lineup chart: the people are sorted like train platforms with an arrow telling you where to go.
1204_trainspotting.jpg.Feels like: 1990s British graphic design in the Swiss-style, with a rail-station information feel and a dry, cool pop tone.

1205_mudbound.jpg.People: Eight or so faces and busts in sepia drawing, cut by the geometry: a boy in a hat at upper left, a figure in sunglasses and a hat at top, a bearded man in profile, an older man in a hat at middle left, a profile at right edge, and a woman with bangs and a man with a mustache at the bottom. Mostly heads and shoulders in profile or three-quarter; they do not interact.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Composition: Black triangular shapes and right-angle blocks create a quilt-like pattern across the whole poster; faces appear in the gaps around the edges and the central text block sits in the middle on black.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Medium: Pencil and charcoal drawings on aged, tan paper with visible shading and stains, combined with flat black ink shapes.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Typography: 'MUDBOUND' is medium-large, in tan, rough, stencil-like condensed capitals set lower center on a black block, with a stacked column of cast names above it in small tan caps (surnames bolder). Left-aligned, horizontal, typeset with a worn texture.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Color and light: Warm tan and gold with black and gray; flat, dim, archival light.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Story it suggests: A community of people tied together by land and history, seen as separate portraits.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Visual idea: A patchwork quilt of faces: the triangles divide and join them like a pieced fabric, suggesting separate lives sewn into one pattern.
1205_mudbound.jpg.Feels like: Depression-era and Southern American folk-art feel, in a contemporary period-drama style.

1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.People: Four small photo scenes of people: two young people walking on grass in front of a flowering bush, a woman holding a toddler's hand in a park, a man and a woman face to face on a beach, and a woman seen from behind in a window. Mostly full body or half body, small within the poster, in pairs or alone.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Composition: A diagonal cluster of tilted, torn-edged photos and paint swatches runs from upper left to lower right across the lower middle, leaving wide empty beige margin around. The title lines sit centered above and the film titles below.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Medium: Thick acrylic or gouache paint swatches with visible bristle texture and rough edges, mixed with film stills cropped in ragged brush-edge shapes, on smooth matte paper.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Typography: Title in small, widely letterspaced black serif capitals centered at the top in two lines; four film titles in black serif mixed case at the bottom, staggered. Quiet, typeset, small relative to the poster, with no interaction with the image.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Color and light: Pale pinkish beige with pink, red, orange, yellow and blue paint swatches, and soft natural daylight in the photos.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Story it suggests: Ordinary lives pass through changing seasons with small encounters, walks and glances.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Visual idea: A painter's palette becomes a calendar: each swatch pairs with a photo like a season's color.
1206_eric-rohmers-tales-of-the-four-seas.Feels like: Gentle French art-house romance with a modern, designed, painter's-studio look.

1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.People: Three women in a triangle: one at the top turned away with a gloved raised hand and looking up, one at lower left in goggles on her head glancing sideways, and one at lower right with long wavy hair gripping a staff with bloody hands. All shown from the chest up, large and dramatic, looking in different directions.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Composition: Pyramid arrangement with a central triangle of faces, diagonal staves and red streaks cutting across, and the title block anchored at the bottom right. Figures fill the entire frame, with no empty space.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Medium: Loose, expressive digital painting with thick brushstrokes, drips and splattered paint, with chromatic edge glitches; looks like oil on canvas.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Typography: Cast names are stacked at the upper right in tall, narrow cream capitals; the title 'THE HEROIC TRIO / EXECUTIONERS' is huge at the bottom right in condensed cream block capitals in two lines divided by a thick rule. Small credits sit at the left of the title. Typeset, flat, upright, and overlapping the painting's lower edge.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Color and light: Teal and cyan against blood red, orange and magenta; dramatic neon-like glow with dark shadows.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Story it suggests: Three fierce women prepared for battle stand side by side, already bloodied.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Visual idea: The three faces are set as a trinity with swords and drips, uniting them like pieces of one weapon.
1207_the-heroic-trio-executioners.jpg.Feels like: 1990s Hong Kong action film, in a contemporary neon-painting style.

1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.People: Two men in fedoras and suits at the center left: one in the front with a stern look, a pinstripe jacket and a pocket square, one behind in a double-breasted suit holding a pistol. At the lower right a singing woman in a white dress and headpiece, and at top right a tiny soldier with a rifle. Half to three-quarter body, large.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal frame: a dark slanted panel holds the men, while a collage column at the right stacks a newspaper headline, bottles, banknotes and a stage singer. The huge title runs down the lower left to the right.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white illustration with a drawn, airbrushed and inked look: precise contour lines, halftone grain and smooth shading, like a painted still.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Typography: 'THE ROARING TWENTIES' is gigantic, in white 3D block capitals with gray extrusion shadows, stacked on two lines and filling the lower half, overlapping the men's coats. 'THE' is small on top. Credit is in a hand-script and sans capitals at the bottom right. Typeset, with a dimensional, chiseled look.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and graded grays only; hard noir lighting with strong highlights on faces.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard-faced man rises through crime and booze, with armed men at his shoulder and a stage performer nearby.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Visual idea: The right-hand column acts like a montage of the era: headlines, liquor, cash, a singer and a soldier tell the whole story.
1208_the-roaring-twenties.jpg.Feels like: 1930s gangster film poster, Prohibition-era crime melodrama, retold in a graphic-novel style.

1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.People: One man in profile, looking downward with a thoughtful, tired expression, cropped from the head to the shoulders and large across the poster. Wears a light jacket with the collar up. Alone.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Composition: The photo fills the upper three-quarters at a slight diagonal, face lower left and the head's crown at the top center; a flat off-white bar with all text runs across the bottom quarter.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with fine film grain and soft shadows; the text panel is flat matte paper.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Typography: 'NOTHING BUT A MAN' is very large in heavy black condensed grotesque capitals, filling the width of the bottom panel in one line. Cast names in small black caps above, credits in small serif italics below, one inside a thin outlined box. Typeset, horizontal, tight to the image's edge.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and gray with off-white; soft side light on his face.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet man weighs a burden, looking down in private thought.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Visual idea: A blunt, plain statement: the title sits as a heavy bar beneath the bowed head, as if it were his weight.
1209_nothing-but-a-man.jpg.Feels like: 1960s American independent drama, in a stripped Swiss-style modern design.

1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.People: A woman in the back seat of a car, shown from the chest up and turned toward the camera with half-closed eyes and a dreamy expression. She has teased hair with pins and bows, dark red eye makeup and a huge fuzzy magenta coat. Alone, large.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Composition: A horizontal photo fills the top 60%, the coat sweeping diagonally from left to right, with the face to the right of center; a solid dark band holds the stacked title in the bottom 40%.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Medium: A photographic film still with slightly faded, grainy color and soft focus, as in a snapshot; the title panel is matte flat ink.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Typography: 'ALL THE BEAUTY AND THE BLOODSHED' is huge in pale blue-gray high-contrast serif capitals (a Didone style), stacked on four lines, centered and filling most of the dark panel. A thin rule and small italic credits left and right below. Elegant, typeset, upright.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Color and light: Electric magenta against cool gray daylight through the car windows and a near-black brown panel; flat overcast light.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Story it suggests: A glamorous, tired night traveler rides through a city, decorated but distant.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Visual idea: The fur coat is the explosion of color in a gray, drab ride, a splash of beauty against bleakness.
1210_all-the-beauty-and-the-bloodshed.jp.Feels like: 1980s downtown New York snapshot photography with a fashion-magazine elegance.

1211_the-runner.jpg.People: A young boy with wet, tousled hair and a dark T-shirt, standing in front of a large airliner, shouting with both fists raised. Shown from the waist up, centered and large at the bottom; the plane behind him is a blurred giant.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Composition: Strongly symmetrical and vertical: the boy at the bottom center, the jet's front facing us right behind him with its wings spread across the width. A large empty hazy sky holds the lettering at the top.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Medium: Soft-focus film photograph with fine grain and a hazy, muted print texture; the plane is blurred like a heat mirage.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Typography: 'The Runner' is large, in a thin, hand-written white brush script at the top center, with an Arabic title above it in a smaller white script. Beneath, widely spaced white sans capitals for the credits. Hand-drawn and delicate, in the empty sky.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Color and light: Pale sea green and gray haze with warm brown skin tones; bright, diffused, hot hazy daylight.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Story it suggests: A kid stands defiantly under a roaring plane, screaming, as if declaring himself to the sky.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Visual idea: Scale contrast: the tiny shouting boy versus the huge machine, with the boy's fists mimicking the plane's wings.
1211_the-runner.jpg.Feels like: 1980s Iranian neorealist child drama, with a dreamy sun-bleached feel.

1212_saint-omer.jpg.People: One woman seated at the bottom right corner, shown from the shoulders up, in a brown sweater against wood paneling, glancing to the left with a stern, guarded expression and a bruise-like mark under one eye. Small relative to the poster.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Composition: A huge empty wood-paneled wall dominates, bordered by a molded frame; the figure is tucked in the bottom right corner and the title floats centered at mid-height, creating a lot of negative space.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with a smooth, natural look, slightly painterly grain; the wood grain is visible as warm streaks.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Typography: 'SAINT OMER' is small, set at the center in a medium-weight gold-yellow sans capitals with a gradient from pale to deep, with a tiny dark spaced-capitals credit under it. Horizontal, typeset, and modest, floating on the panel.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Color and light: Honey amber, brown and gold, nearly monochrome; warm, even interior light.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman sits exposed and watched in a formal room, under the weight of the wall above her.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Visual idea: Scale: the huge wooden wall as a courtroom's authority pressing on one small person.
1212_saint-omer.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European legal drama, a restrained, austere portrait of a courtroom.

1213_to-die-for.jpg.People: One woman in extreme close-up, cropped at the forehead and chin and running off the right edge, with a bright blue eye, a large smile and bangs. Her face fills nearly the whole poster, alone, looking directly out.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Composition: The face is enlarged and pushed to the right so the hair falls in a dark mass on the left; the title sits in the center, over her cheek and hair, in a small column.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Medium: Glossy photographic portrait with very smooth skin, shallow focus and soft film grain, like a magazine close-up.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Typography: 'TO DIE FOR' is stacked in three lines in large, thin, geometric white sans capitals, positioned at the middle left of the poster over the dark hair and cheek. Small cast and director credits above and below in the same light sans. Typeset, with the letter strokes thin enough to let the face show through.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Color and light: Warm skin tones, auburn hair, pink lips, a pale blue eye and black shadows; soft, flattering beauty light.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful, camera-ready smile that seems a little too bright, hiding something.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Visual idea: A close-up smile as a mask: the friendly face is the entire attraction, with the title placed next to the eye as a warning.
1213_to-die-for.jpg.Feels like: Mid-1990s glossy satire and thriller, fashion-magazine glamour.

1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.People: A group of silhouetted figures against a red field at the top: a woman carrying something at the left, then an adult and two children holding hands and walking. At the bottom left, a woman's face looking sharply at the viewer with a cross necklace; at the bottom right, a dense crowd of men with raised arms and fists, in teal.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Composition: Three horizontal torn-paper layers: red sky on top, a black band with the title across the middle, and a split bottom row of a portrait and a crowd. Grayscale edges with a skyscraper and a palm tree peek in at the top corners.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Medium: Torn-paper collage with duotone and spot-color printing, rough edges and ink texture; grainy black-and-white film frames recolored in flat pink-red, gold and teal.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Typography: 'I AM CUBA' is large in a single line across the black band, in rough, stenciled tan-gold block capitals with uneven edges, 'CUBA' bigger. A tiny handwritten white credit sits below it at right. Typeset-looking but worn, flat, and horizontal.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Color and light: Hot coral-red, teal, mustard gold and black, with gray; flat color blocks and high-contrast light.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Story it suggests: Ordinary families, a defiant woman and an angry crowd are layered together as a country's different lives and the march toward revolt.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Visual idea: Layered strips like torn strata of a nation: a fragile family above, authority in the dark middle, and a united crowd beneath.
1214_i-am-cuba.jpg.Feels like: 1960s revolutionary agitprop poster, in a contemporary silkscreen and collage style.

1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.People: A man's face in profile at the left, looking right with stubble and tousled hair, shown from the neck up. At the right, a huge close-up of an animal eye with a bright reflection, much larger than the man. The two face each other.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Composition: Two large forms in a dark void: the human face at left of center and the huge eye at right, positioned at a similar height and facing each other with a gap between; the title sits centered in the lower third.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic frames with strong film grain and deep, crushed blacks; the eye has wet specular highlights.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Typography: 'Werckmeister Harmonies' is medium in size, two stacked lines in gray, graceful old-style serif mixed case, centered in the lower part with a small flourish on the 's'. Credits in small, widely spaced white sans capitals underneath. Typeset, quiet, horizontal.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Color and light: Black, charcoal and silvery white; a single hard side light, with the rest swallowed by darkness.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Story it suggests: A man and a giant animal stare at each other in silence, as if something vast is quietly looking back.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Visual idea: Scale confrontation: the eye is bigger than the face, with a glance exchanged across a black gap.
1215_werckmeister-harmonies.jpg.Feels like: Austere European art-house cinema, like a black-and-white woodcut or night photograph.

1216_dogfight.jpg.People: Two young people in a black-and-white photo at the top: a man at left in a jacket with short hair, looking toward the woman, and a woman at right with bangs in a chunky cardigan, arms crossed, leaning against a brick wall and smiling at him. Half to three-quarter body, facing each other.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Composition: A wide photo band across the top 55%, separated by a dark bar, over a large empty off-white area; the text block is placed in the lower right quarter, asymmetric, with the title right-aligned.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Medium: Grainy, high-contrast black-and-white photograph, a bit washed out like a photocopy, on a flat off-white print background with solid inks.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Typography: 'DOGFIGHT' is big in heavy orange-red sans capitals at the lower right, with cast names above in gray bold caps and a tagline in gray sans text lines below next to a small hornet-like emblem and 'A LOVE STORY'. Typeset, horizontal, plain.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Color and light: Gray, black and off-white with one orange-red accent; flat, overcast-looking light.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Story it suggests: A boy and a girl face each other with wary curiosity, one smiling while the other's guard stays up.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Visual idea: A simple still stands for a small, awkward relationship; the red title is the single hot spot.
1216_dogfight.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American indie romance, a Swiss-style plain layout with a 1960s snapshot look.

1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.People: One man's portrait, bust-length, facing us with a pipe in his mouth and a hand at his chin, drawn in black and white with blocky faceted highlights. He is centered on a cut-out map shape.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Composition: A concentric layout: a patterned border frames a rectangular gold panel, in which the portrait sits in the center on a silhouette of Africa, flanked by four diamond-star shapes; the title is split into two big words above and below.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Medium: Mixed-media collage: etched or linocut-like black ink portrait, cut printed-fabric pieces for the continent, painted gold ground, and an outer border of photographed batik or mud-cloth print.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Typography: 'OUSMANE' above and 'SEMBENE' below the portrait in huge, tall, high-contrast stencil-like navy capitals that nearly span the panel width; small navy serif lines on top and bottom for the series and film titles. Typeset, symmetrical, upright.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Color and light: Mustard gold, purple, indigo and brown against black and cream; flat, even light.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Story it suggests: A thinker and storyteller is presented as the center of a whole continent.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Visual idea: The person's face is placed inside the map of Africa, made out of fabric patterns, like a portrait stitched from textile.
1217_three-revolutionary-films-by-ousman.Feels like: Pan-African political art and textile-inspired folk collage, with a revolutionary cinema tone.

1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.People: One woman's face, large, turned in three-quarter view and looking to the left of the viewer with a serious, guarded expression, hair parted over the forehead. Cropped at the neck, filling most of the poster. Alone.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Composition: The face is slightly right of center on a pale ground, and the huge stacked title runs down the middle of the face from top to bottom, in a block that is taller than it is wide.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Medium: A painterly, soft-focus portrait with pencil-like hair strokes and a misty white vignette, looking like a photograph overpainted with watercolor; the red marks are speckled like paint spatter.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Typography: 'ANATOMY OF A FALL' is gigantic, in tall, narrow white condensed sans capitals stacked on four lines and staggered to run diagonally down the center, partially covering her face. The white letters are spotted with small red stains. Small credit at the top. Typeset, with the stains tying the letters to the image.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Color and light: Pale gray, ivory and ash blond with tiny scarlet red spots; flat, soft, overcast daylight.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stays calm and unreadable while the words over her face suggest violence and suspicion.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Visual idea: The blank letters sit over the face like a barrier, and the red specks suggest evidence staining the text.
1218_anatomy-of-a-fall.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary European courtroom drama, a restrained, minimalist art-house thriller.

1219_girlfight.jpg.People: One young woman's face, split down the middle: the left half in saturated red-magenta watercolor and the right half in black-and-white charcoal grain. Close-up, cropped at the forehead, with a furrowed brow and a hard stare. She is alone and fills the whole poster.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Composition: A vertical split along the nose line, with two profiles of the same face interlocking; paint blots of pink, blue and violet at the corners, and a small title in the center-left over the red half.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Medium: A mix of watercolor and ink bleed on paper with pigment blooms, and stippled, grainy charcoal or toner dots, with visible paper texture.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Typography: 'girlfight' is small in lowercase, in rough white brush-like, hand-cut letters with a scratchy underline, placed at the center-left over the red cheek. Smaller credit text under it in a thin white sans, partly lowercase. Hand-made look, integrated with the paint.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink, crimson and magenta with cobalt and violet splashes against gray charcoal and cream; flat, high-contrast, expressive light.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman is ready for a fight, with fury and hurt at the same time.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Visual idea: One face divided into two media, red paint of anger against gray grain of control, as if two selves meet at the nose.
1219_girlfight.jpg.Feels like: Punk zine and expressive modern poster art, with a raw sports-drama feel.

1220_bound.jpg.People: Two figures in extreme close-up, cropped to just noses, lips and chins, almost touching face to face. Both are mostly black silhouettes with faint rim light on skin.
1220_bound.jpg.Composition: Two profile faces fill the upper half and meet at the center; the lower half is a diagonal burst of splatter rising from the bottom left. A red framed title box sits at the midline, separating face from splatter, with a lot of empty black around it.
1220_bound.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism in the faces, with deep shadow; the bottom is a high-contrast photo of white paint or liquid splashing with red stains, cut out against flat black.
1220_bound.jpg.Typography: Title in blocky heavy red capitals inside a thin red outline box, medium size, centered slightly below middle; small red cast names across the top in bold sans. Flat solid ink, no distortion, it floats in the dark rather than touching the image.
1220_bound.jpg.Color and light: Near-black with a few skin highlights, saturated red, and stark white splatter. Low-key, dramatic spotlight on lips and noses.
1220_bound.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people lean in toward a kiss while something violent or messy has already spilled below.
1220_bound.jpg.Visual idea: Intimacy set against a stain: a kiss on top, a spatter of blood and paint on the bottom, tied together by red.

1221_querelle.jpg.People: One muscular man in a sailor cap and white tank top and trousers, three-quarter body, leaning on a post with a hand near his hip and an arm hanging. His gaze goes straight at the viewer.
1221_querelle.jpg.Composition: Figure runs diagonally from top center to bottom right, in front of a backdrop of bare tree, poles and a large sun on the right. The title spans the whole top width; credits sit in the right-hand empty space beside the head.
1221_querelle.jpg.Medium: Painted-looking photo with a saturated, hazy, almost stage-set backdrop; oiled skin with glossy highlights and a fine canvas or linen grain across the surface.
1221_querelle.jpg.Typography: Huge thin art-deco capitals in yellow gradient across the top, with the Q looping around a small circle and its tail curling into the poster. Large pale cream capitals for the director names at right; small italic script lines for credits. Typeset, and the figure's cap overlaps the title letters.
1221_querelle.jpg.Color and light: Amber, mustard yellow and gold, with creamy white clothes. A sunset glow with warm artificial light.
1221_querelle.jpg.Story it suggests: A swaggering sailor poses against a sunset, inviting and confident.
1221_querelle.jpg.Visual idea: Pin-up glamour in a stylized golden-hour set, mixing vintage deco lettering with a staged body.
1221_querelle.jpg.Feels like: Retro erotic art-film, stylized 1980s with an old physique-magazine look.

1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.People: Three figures, all drawn: a tall full-body woman in a yellow ruffled costume at left, a man with hat and cigarette at lower right holding a gun, and a tiny crouched figure at the bottom center. Woman and man are far apart in scale and mood.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Composition: Tall S-curve figure down the left; man's head anchors the lower right; title stacked at upper right in an open black area. Lower right to upper left diagonal ties them together, with a tiny figure in the gap.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Medium: Loose gouache and ink brushwork with thick black brush strokes, dry-brush edges, flat patches of pink, red and yellow and visible paper white.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Typography: Hand-brushed pink title in tall slanted capitals, stacked on three lines (VICTIMS / OF / SIN) at upper right, with a script subtitle below. Name at top in red, small credits in white. Rough painted look that matches the illustration.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Color and light: Hot yellow, magenta, red and orange against black and white paper. Flat, graphic color with no real light source.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous showgirl and a menacing gunman occupy the same world while a small child watches from the edge.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Visual idea: Expressive brush illustration pulls the figures out of the black like a sketched fashion plate.
1222_victims-of-sin.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century melodrama, nightclub noir, hand-painted poster revival.

1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.People: One seated woman painted in half body, head bowed, hands cupped together at the center holding a small glowing object. She sits in a dark cloak or dress.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure with a halo of dark hair shape; the title is cut into three huge rows (top, middle, bottom) that frame her face and hands. Hands at lower center act as the focal point.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Medium: Thick oil or gouache painting with visible dabs, scraped textures and gold flecks across dark teal; light shines from the hands.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy bronze-gold serif capitals filling nearly the full width, split THE UNDER / GROUND / RAILROAD with GROUND widely letterspaced. The top line touches the circle logo and the bottom row is cut by the bottom edge; the figure sits behind the letters. A small italic director line lies in between.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal, navy and black with ochre gold; a small cool light glows in the hands.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman alone in darkness guards something small and precious.
1223_the-underground-railroad.jpg.Visual idea: Title letters stack like layers or a tunnel above and below, and the glow in her hands is the only way out.

1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.People: Many faces: a giant half-face in a hat on the left, several smiling and serious faces in panels at lower right, small gunmen and horsemen. Men appear in close-up, groups and distant riders.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Composition: The whole poster is fractured by cracked-glass lines radiating from a bullet hole at lower left. A torn paper shard at upper right holds the title; photo fragments fill the rest.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Medium: Orange and brown duotone halftone photos, bold dot screens and torn paper collage with cardboard texture and glass cracks printed over.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Typography: Large heavy rust-orange slab capitals in three lines (PAT / GARRETT / and BILLY / THE KID) on the cream torn shard, cut off at the shard edge; a small curly 'and' and smaller credits. Letterpress-like ink color with the photos.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Color and light: Burnt orange, mustard, dark brown and cream; flat, warm and dusty.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Story it suggests: A shattering confrontation between men in a dusty land, where a bullet has already been fired.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Visual idea: A bullet hole cracking the image into shards, so the story breaks into faces and fragments.
1224_pat-garrett-and-billy-the-kid.jpg.Feels like: 1970s western, grindhouse collage, vintage print revival.

1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.People: One man in a wide-brimmed hat decorated with coins, long curly hair, holding a large knife upright in front of his face, shown at half body. His face is split by the blade.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Composition: Strong central circular composition: a spinning sunburst of curved yellow and pink blades radiates around the figure's white disc. Title at top right with credits at left.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Medium: Flat screen-print inks with black-and-white halftone photo placed over red; the body below the disc turns into red overprint, so it looks like a printed silkscreen with overprint of translucent colors.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Typography: Lowercase heavy sans title in two lines, black over cream, top right, medium size; small yellow lowercase credit at left. Clean typeset, with no overlap on the image.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, hot pink, yellow and cream; flat, bright and poster-like.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Story it suggests: A rough, armed man stands like a sun-god or bandit at the center of a blazing world.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Visual idea: The sun becomes a halo or pinwheel around the figure, and the blade splits the face in two, like the title's black and white.
1225_black-god-white-devil.jpg.Feels like: 1960s political poster, pop and Latin American graphic design.

1226_perfect-days.jpg.People: One small figure, a man in blue work clothes crouched at a sink, cleaning, tucked at lower right and half hidden behind a curved wall. He is tiny relative to the frame and engaged in a quiet task.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Composition: A frame-within-frame: a curved pale concrete wall at left and a tall rounded tile-covered column at right make a vertical corridor of tree foliage above and a cleaning scene below. The title is placed at the middle of the left wall; the person sits low in the lower right.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Medium: A sharp, natural photograph with fine detail of concrete texture and tiny round metal tiles; a clean, soft, documentary look.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Typography: Bold white condensed sans PERFECT DAYS in the middle of the poster, crossing over the wall and the edge of the column, with a small spaced credit line above. The letters are clean and typeset and overlap the architecture; a tiny curl or mustache-like mark sits under the T and D gap.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Color and light: Cool gray-white concrete, dark silver and brown tiles, and green leaves; soft diffuse daylight.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Story it suggests: A worker quietly tends a small space, hidden in a corner of the city, in an ordinary routine of care.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Visual idea: The curved walls shelter the man and make a small ordinary act feel monumental and calm.
1226_perfect-days.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary quiet arthouse drama; clean, architectural, observational.

1227_risky-business.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, full body, wearing only an oversized pink shirt and white socks, head bowed, standing legs apart. Nobody else is in the frame.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Composition: Figure at center in front of a staircase whose diagonal rail rises to the upper left; empty frame and door fill the right. Title at lower center, cast names at top.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Medium: Painterly photo-realism with soft brush texture on surfaces and a smooth glossy floor.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Typography: Pink flowing cursive title across the lower third in large size with neon-like brightness, and small spaced capitals for names at top and director at bottom. Typeset, sitting on the floor rather than overlapping the figure.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige and brown interior with pink shirt and pink title as the accent; low sun streaming through blinds onto the floor.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man alone in an empty house, slouched and unsure, as if after something he should not have done.
1227_risky-business.jpg.Visual idea: The pink shirt makes the figure pop against the muted house, and its color is repeated in the title.

1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.People: One performer in a tight, large close-up at left, wearing an elaborate pearl-and-jewel headdress and stage makeup, eyes cast downward, with a hand raised to the mouth and lips. Ambiguous in presentation, with a theatrical, painted face.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Composition: A strong diagonal splits the poster from lower left to upper right: the photo on the upper left, a flat red triangle on the lower right. The title runs vertically along the right edge and then turns horizontally along the bottom of the red area.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Medium: A warm, saturated film-like photograph with a slight grain next to a perfectly flat solid red ink field.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Typography: Large yellow thin high-contrast serif capitals, FAREWELL running vertically top to bottom at the right edge, then MY CONCUBINE running horizontally at the bottom, so the words turn a corner and rotate 90 degrees. A small yellow italic 'Directed by' credit sits to the left. The lettering sits on the flat red, tight against the diagonal.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Color and light: Bold red and yellow with turquoise and cream accents; warm, theatrical, stage-lit.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Story it suggests: A performer in full costume and makeup gazes down in private moment, caught between the stage persona and the person beneath.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Visual idea: The diagonal cut divides picture and color field like a stage curtain or a mask, with the title bending around the corner.
1228_farewell-my-concubine.jpg.Feels like: 1990s epic period drama, with a lavish theatrical look redone as modern graphic design.

1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.People: Many people in fragments: faces in profile, a woman in a woven hat at center, a figure running at right, a child, men at the edges. They are cut apart so no one relationship is clear.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Composition: All-over collage of torn photo scraps overlapping at angles, with two white torn-paper patches holding the title at top and credit at bottom. The central profile in the hat is the largest piece.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Medium: Blue-grey monochrome photocopy or halftone images, ripped paper edges with white fibers, strips of yellowed masking tape and white painted patches.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Typography: Hand-lettered pencil or charcoal scrawl in dark grey, two lines at upper center, uneven and quick, sitting on a white torn cloud; a smaller handwritten credit with an underlined name at the bottom. Looks like a handwritten label stuck to the collage.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Color and light: Cool grey-blue and white with cream tape; flat, diffuse, no strong light.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Story it suggests: Glimpses of scattered lives and partings, remembered in pieces.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Visual idea: The poster is a scrapbook of memory: torn, taped and relabeled by hand, like a farewell assembled from pieces.
1229_brief-encounters-the-long-farewell-.Feels like: Art-house scrapbook, 1960s to 70s Eastern European black-and-white film, contemporary DIY collage.

1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.People: Two young women sit on a mattress in the large photo, one tenderly touching the other's head; three smaller color frames below show a young woman alone, a woman with a man, and a woman in a red shirt. Mostly young women, half to full body.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Composition: Cream border frames a large rectangular black-and-white photo, with a strip of three equal color photos below. Title stacked on three lines overlaps the photo's lower left and the strip.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with a sepia or warm tint on textured cream paper; the lower strip is saturated color film stills.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Typography: Big round chunky retro letters in cream with dark outline and shadow, stacked 'not / a / Pretty / Picture' on a tilt-free left column; some letters are mixed upper and lowercase. It overlays the photo edge and goes into the strip; small typeset credit at right.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Color and light: Warm gray, cream and sepia, with red, green and plaid pops in the color strip. Soft indoor daylight.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Story it suggests: Young women comfort one another in a bare room and face something painful and awkward.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Visual idea: A cold documentary photo above and warm color frames below suggest a memory or a staged reenactment.
1230_not-a-pretty-picture.jpg.Feels like: 1970s indie drama, verite and Seventies design.

1231_real-life.jpg.People: A big family around a table in a painting, with a smiling man and woman carrying a turkey; two figures with giant helmet-like devices instead of heads; and one curly-haired man in the front, cut out and standing outside the frame, arm out. About ten people.
1231_real-life.jpg.Composition: Large gold ornate picture frame centered on a flat green field, with the title above. The man at the lower right breaks out of the frame's corner, overlapping it.
1231_real-life.jpg.Medium: Realist illustrated or painted scene in glossy magazine-cover style, with a photographic cutout glued in; thick gilded frame and flat green paper.
1231_real-life.jpg.Typography: Heavy cream-yellow sans capitals 'REAL LIFE' in medium size at top center, a smaller white sans subtitle below, tiny credit line above; a gold plaque at the bottom of the frame reads in small caps. Simple, typeset, symmetrical.
1231_real-life.jpg.Color and light: Deep emerald green, gold and warm cream; flat even lighting.
1231_real-life.jpg.Story it suggests: A cozy holiday dinner that is being filmed, with the man in front acting like its host.
1231_real-life.jpg.Visual idea: A painting of the perfect family is invaded by helmeted camera-like figures and a modern man pasted over the frame, so image and reality clash.

1232_mother.jpg.People: Two people in a tight close-up: a dark-haired man kissing the forehead of an older woman with light hair, while his hands hold her face. She looks sideways at us with a wry smile.
1232_mother.jpg.Composition: Diagonal from top-left head down to the woman's face at lower center; both faces fill most of the frame and the white background leaves space at top right for names.
1232_mother.jpg.Medium: Crisp black-and-white studio portrait photo on clean white, smooth with fine tone.
1232_mother.jpg.Typography: Serif capitals: names stacked at top right in black, large 'MOTHER' at the bottom center, small italic red tagline in the middle left. Classic typeset, restrained, with the title below the image.
1232_mother.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and grays with a single red tagline; bright even studio light.
1232_mother.jpg.Story it suggests: A grown son kisses his mother, who seems amused and slightly trapped.
1232_mother.jpg.Visual idea: The mother's sideways glance and the son's kiss turn affection into a joke at his expense.
1232_mother.jpg.Feels like: 1990s comedy, portrait poster, studio publicity style.

1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.People: Four young people in photo fragments: a giant face with sunglasses cropped at nose and lips on top, a teen in a yellow shirt at left, a shirtless blond youth lying down in blue, and a boy standing small beside a bench at the bottom.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Composition: Stack of horizontal color bands: red on top, yellow and blue side by side in the middle, green at the bottom. The huge stacked title crosses the bands diagonally-looking with italic slant, centered.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Medium: Saturated color-tinted film stills with heavy grain and blown-out, oversaturated tones, like color-filtered video frames; each band has a single dominant hue.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Typography: Very large condensed italic sans capitals in black and white, stacked on five lines, tightly leaded with different weights per line (black for the top two, white below). The title covers most of the poster and crosses band boundaries with no shadow.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Color and light: Primary and secondary colors: red, yellow, blue, green, each a flat tint; harsh, flash-like light.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Story it suggests: Restless teens drift through a lurid, over-bright world, each one alone in his or her own color.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Visual idea: A color-coded triptych of three stories: stacked bands like a test pattern make the three parts into one title block.
1233_gregg-arakis-teen-apocalypse-trilog.Feels like: 1990s queer-punk indie, MTV-era grunge graphic design.

1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.People: One man's face, tightly cropped and partially visible through the mosaic: eyes, nose, mouth and chin appear as separate glimpses. Orange tones at the bottom suggest a shoulder or collar.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Composition: The whole poster is a grid of square tiles with white grout lines; the huge white title is stacked in four rows over the center and the face shows through gaps. Credit blocks sit on white rectangles at the top and bottom.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Medium: Printed look of a bathroom or mosaic tile pattern with scratches, dust and white crease lines on a glossy surface, as if a photo is cut into small squares and reassembled.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Typography: Giant thin white geometric sans capitals, stacked 'ALL / OF US / STRAN / GERS' with the last word broken in two, filling the full height and width. Heavy letterspacing pushes letters into the edges, and the letters cover most of the face. Names are in smaller capitals on white boxes.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Color and light: Cool blue and navy tiles with orange and skin tones of the face; soft, dim and slightly sad.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Story it suggests: A man looks out in solitude, his face and memory broken into pieces he can't quite put together.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Visual idea: The tile grid fragments a portrait like a broken memory, and the title letters break apart too, so 'strangers' splits into STRAN and GERS.
1234_all-of-us-strangers.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary arthouse melancholy, 2020s, pastiche of 1980s tile and photo textures.

1235_happiness.jpg.People: A crowd of about ten cartoon adults crammed into the bottom edge, shoulders and heads only, with one big sweating man with glasses at front-left and a wide-eyed woman at right. Others stare sideways with wary or hostile looks.
1235_happiness.jpg.Composition: Giant empty yellow field above; the title sits in the upper middle and the crowd in a band across the bottom. Large negative space is the main feature, and the faces look away from each other.
1235_happiness.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-like comic illustration with thick black outlines, hatching on clothing, and solid color fills; no texture on the background.
1235_happiness.jpg.Typography: Huge white rough-edged capitals 'HAPPINESS' spanning nearly the full width at the upper-middle, slightly hand-cut, with a small orange line above it. Flat typeset-lettering style that is high but not touching the illustration.
1235_happiness.jpg.Color and light: Bright lemon yellow, with pink, red, blue, brown and lilac for clothes; flat, cheerful, without real shadows.
1235_happiness.jpg.Story it suggests: A group of uneasy ordinary people look away from each other under a cheerful banner, hiding something.
1235_happiness.jpg.Visual idea: Irony: a sunny, empty yellow word over a row of anxious faces.

1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.People: Left panel: a huge black silhouette of a standing man, seen from behind or front as a flat shape, with two small women in white gowns (one repeated as a double or ghost) at the bottom; right panel: a woman's face and long dark hair in profile, eyes closed, large close-up. The silhouette is a flat shape with no face.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Composition: Poster divided vertically into two panels by a thin line, each a separate poster: left a tall figure with branches behind and tiny women below, right a head-and-hair filling the lower two thirds under a patterned wall; black band across the top for the producer credit.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Medium: Digital painting with flat shapes, marbled or ink-swirl texture in the hair, and patterned wallpaper.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Typography: Left: orange hand-lettered caps for the title in quotes, stacked, with 'ZOMBIE' in outlined italic; right: elegant flourished serif 'The Seventh Victim' stacked and angled. Credits in matching colors, smaller; producer line across the top in sage green caps. The left title sits over the silhouette's chest.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Color and light: Black, olive, sage and salmon orange on the left; gray, taupe and cream on the right; moody, low-key.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Story it suggests: Two eerie tales, one of a dark figure in the jungle and one of a woman haunted in a city room.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Visual idea: A double bill shown as two posters side by side, linked by the shared black.
1236_i-walked-with-a-zombie-the-seventh-.Feels like: 1940s B-horror double feature, with a modern illustrated reissue look.

1237_demon-pond.jpg.People: A woman in an ornate red kimono with long black hair, eyes closed and head tilted back, arms outstretched, floating up in a half-body to full-body pose. Two large fish below, and a tiny shoal in the background.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Composition: Central vertical figure with sleeves spread wide in a V shape, two koi curling in a loose circle around the title block at the bottom center. The red title panel anchors the lower middle.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Medium: Woodblock-print or screen-print look with rough ink edges, visible paper texture, patterned fabric, and speckled bubble dots; fish drawn in translucent blue-grey line.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Typography: Rough brush-cut cream capitals 'DEMON / POND' stacked at center-bottom, large, on a red rectangle; small credits in the same panel. Hand-brushed and slightly broken, set on top of the image and fish.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Color and light: Black-blue night water, vivid red and gold on the kimono, and ghostly grey-blue fish; bubbles glitter like snow, with a cold underwater light.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman rises or drifts through dark water, with spirit fish circling her.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Visual idea: The kimono wings echo a bird or a dragon; fish and bubbles turn the dark into a pond, and the title is placed like a sign.
1237_demon-pond.jpg.Feels like: Japanese ukiyo-e and kabuki-inspired fantasy, 1970s horror-fable.

1238_gummo.jpg.People: One figure sitting in the center, shirtless, wearing a rabbit-ear hat, holding an accordion on the lap; the face is lost in a solid blue shape, so it reads as a mask or blank face.
1238_gummo.jpg.Composition: Central seated figure with long ears rising to the top edge, in a narrow stained room whose walls frame him; the title sits across the bottom.
1238_gummo.jpg.Medium: Heavily processed and color-inverted photograph with grain, scratches and smeared paint-like textures, like a damaged video or negative.
1238_gummo.jpg.Typography: Gothic blackletter 'Gummo' in white filling the lower part, large and heavy, with a handwritten white 'Harmony Korine's' across the figure's chest; one rough and hand-drawn, one old-English style, both overlay the picture.
1238_gummo.jpg.Color and light: Electric violet, magenta and cyan blues; unnatural glowing light, like a negative or blacklight.
1238_gummo.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange rabbit-eared boy plays an accordion alone in a decayed room.
1238_gummo.jpg.Visual idea: A distorted, inverted image that makes a familiar child's costume feel eerie and ghostlike.
1238_gummo.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American indie, lo-fi, trashy, a punk zine look.

1239_scarface.jpg.People: One man in a fedora and dark suit, half body, face split by a vertical machine-gun barrel covering the left half of his face. A tic-tac-toe or cross scar mark is drawn on his cheek in orange.
1239_scarface.jpg.Composition: Strong vertical axis: the gun runs top to bottom through the center, with the face on the right and the gun's magazine on the left. Cracked bullet-hole glass at left and upper right adds radiating lines. Title at the bottom left.
1239_scarface.jpg.Medium: Graphic halftone dots in gray with flat black and white shapes, rough brush edges, and a single spot orange for the scar and lettering; looks like a printed screen-print.
1239_scarface.jpg.Typography: Very large rough orange capitals 'ScarFace' mixing upper and lowercase, sloped and jagged, across the lower left; stacked cast names above and below in blocky orange sans, small credits at right. The title overlaps the suit and gun.
1239_scarface.jpg.Color and light: Gray, black and white with one punchy orange; flat graphic contrast and no soft light.
1239_scarface.jpg.Story it suggests: A hard man hides behind a gun with a mark on his face, with bullets already breaking the glass.
1239_scarface.jpg.Visual idea: The weapon cuts the face in half and the orange cross scar reads as both wound and target.
1239_scarface.jpg.Feels like: 1930s gangster film, retold with pop-art halftone, noir.

1240_funny-girl.jpg.People: One figure drawn as an abstract upside-down woman: two kicking legs at the top, an arm with a flower at right, a pink head with white smile at the bottom, beaded hair swirling below. Her body is replaced by the title letters.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Composition: The whole figure tilts at an angle and runs diagonally across the black field, with the title serving as her torso. Large black empty space around it.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink cut-paper or screen-print shapes in vivid colors on black, with dotted beads in line; completely flat, no gradients.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Typography: Big chunky yellow and gold hand-drawn capitals 'FUNNY / GIRL' set upside-down along the diagonal and becoming the body; narrow credits in small capitals below and at left, plus a tiny signature.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Color and light: Jet black with yellow, gold, orange, pink and violet; flat saturated color, no real lighting.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Story it suggests: A playful woman is mid-tumble or cartwheel, upside down and all limbs.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Visual idea: Letters as a body: the title is the torso and the dancer is built from it.
1240_funny-girl.jpg.Feels like: 1960s musical comedy and mid-century graphic poster, Broadway.

1241_paper-moon.jpg.People: Two figures face each other in profile: a tall man in a light fedora and striped suit bending down, and a small child in a knit cap and overalls looking up. Their hands meet over a suitcase at the bottom; both are half body.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical face-off with the man on the left and child on the right, a long straight road receding into the distance in the middle bottom. The title floats centered between them.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photograph with coarse film grain, high contrast, and a light sepia-gray cast; cutouts of two images over a road.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Typography: Chunky geometric white capitals 'PAPER / MOON' with moon-like round cutouts, centered at the middle and fairly large; small italic serif and light sans credits below. Clean typeset, sitting in the gap between faces.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Color and light: Grays and black and white; flat overcast daylight.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Story it suggests: A grown man and a child meet as equals at a roadside, a deal being shaken on.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Visual idea: Two profiles facing off over the title, as if the title were the space between them; the handshake is the pact.
1241_paper-moon.jpg.Feels like: 1970s road comedy, Depression-era Americana, black-and-white photography.

1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.People: Two figures: a dark-haired woman on the left in profile, and a green-scaled humanoid creature at right in profile, almost nose to nose across a glass pane. Their hands press at the glass at the bottom, large in the foreground.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Composition: A vertical pane of glass splits the poster in the middle; the two heads meet at its edge, and the hands rise from the bottom as reflections. The title is centered over the glass.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Medium: Painterly photo with soft grain, bubbles, and hazy glowing edges like water; skin and scales are slightly blurry and oversaturated.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Typography: Thin light sans capitals stacked in three lines ('THE / SHAPE / OF WATER') with small 'THE' and 'OF', centered in pale mint on the glass; small credit at the top. Delicate, clear and floating over the image with no distortion.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Color and light: Teal and sea-green with warm amber on the woman's skin, a glowing underwater light.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman and a creature reach for each other through a barrier of glass and water.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Visual idea: The pane of glass is a barrier and a mirror, and the warm human side meets the cool aquatic side.
1242_the-shape-of-water.jpg.Feels like: Romantic fairy-tale monster movie, 2010s, aquatic fantasy.

1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.People: One man seen from behind, full body, standing in the middle of an empty motel lot holding a tank and a long tool; his head turns slightly to look sideways. He is small against the landscape.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Composition: Figure placed right of center with a long shadow to the lower left; the motel sign at the left and a row of motel doors at the right lead toward a vanishing point on the horizon. Huge sky fills the top half and the title sits at the bottom.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Medium: Screen-print illustration limited to a few flat inks with rough brush-like edges and speckle, like a limited-palette print on cream paper with a border.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Typography: Condensed bold sans capitals 'NO COUNTRY FOR OLD MEN' in cream on one line at the lower center, medium size, with a small credit below; the motel sign has its own painted lettering. Straight, typeset, no interaction with the figure.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Color and light: Dusty maroon, tan and cream with dark brown shadows; low sun at the horizon making long shadows.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man in an empty motel lot carries a strange tool, and menace hangs in the quiet.
1243_no-country-for-old-men.jpg.Visual idea: Emptiness as threat: the wide sky and bare lot shrink the man to an ominous silhouette.

1244_eastern-condors.jpg.People: About eighteen people: a large central man in a headband with fists up, rows of fighters and soldiers with rifles below, two figures in a kick fight at the center, and tiny soldiers on a boat. Mostly half-body and faces, crowded in a pyramid.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Composition: Pyramid composition with the biggest face at the top center, cast fanning out below in a flame-colored mass, a green river and jungle at the bottom, helicopters at upper right. Title in the lower center on top of the green.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with loose oil or gouache brushwork, fiery gradients and speckled edges fading into white paper.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Typography: Heavy white stencil capitals 'EASTERN / CONDORS' in two lines, large, at lower center with cut-out bridges, over green rockets or jungle; yellow credit at the bottom. Typeset, military stencil feel, slightly overlapping the jungle shapes.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Color and light: Fiery red-orange fading to cream at top and deep green and teal at bottom; hot, explosive glow.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Story it suggests: A band of fighters and soldiers pushes forward through flames and jungle.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Visual idea: A mountain of faces rising from the flames and the river becomes one battle-poster crest.
1244_eastern-condors.jpg.Feels like: 1980s action ensemble, war and kung-fu, retro hand-painted blockbuster poster.

1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.People: Three people seated close together, half body: a dark-haired man at left speaking and gesturing, a woman in black at center looking down with a cigarette, and a woman at right kissing her cheek. Their glances don't meet.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Composition: A tall rectangular photo sits off-center on a white page with a thick white margin; the title wraps around its upper right corner, with 'AND' offset left. Heavy margins and white space leave the photo isolated.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still, fine grain and soft contrast, printed on stark white.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy black sans capitals in four staggered lines ('THE / MOTHER / AND / THE / WHORE') that cut across the photo's top edge and jump to the left for 'AND'; small bold credit below. Typeset, stacked and offset, overlapping the photo's edge.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with mid grays; soft flat interior daylight.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Story it suggests: One man between two women, one of whom looks away while the other presses close.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Visual idea: The title is split so 'AND' stands alone away from the others, a love triangle in typographic layout.
1245_the-mother-and-the-whore.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave-era art film, 1970s arthouse drama, minimal Swiss-style layout.

1246_the-grifters.jpg.People: No people; three pairs of sunglasses stacked vertically stand in for three characters.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Composition: Strict vertical column of three centered glasses with equal spacing, plus names across the top and the title bottom right. Large flat yellow space around them.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Medium: Flat spot-color screen print with coarse halftone texture in the red tortoiseshell frames, black lenses, and paper-grain on yellow.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Typography: Heavy black condensed italic capitals 'THE / GRIFTERS' large at the lower center-right, slanting; names in narrow caps across the top just above the first glasses, each aligned above a pair. Credit lines in narrow black type.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, black and red; flat, bright, no real shadows.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Story it suggests: Three people who hide behind dark lenses, none of whom can be read.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Visual idea: Three characters reduced to their sunglasses, which hide the eyes where the con happens.
1246_the-grifters.jpg.Feels like: 1990s neo-noir, con-artist crime film, pop graphic poster.

1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.People: One man's face and shoulders in a frontal portrait, large and filling the frame, with an afro-style hair mass and direct gaze. The figure is made from pieces, so it is a depicted face rather than a photo.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Composition: Dead-center symmetrical head-and-shoulders portrait inside a black border; faceted triangular shards of pale metal radiate out from the head like a halo. Title runs in a single strip below.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Medium: Real physical collage or mosaic of cut metal, tin cans, rusted sheet and printed packaging scraps, with visible rust, creases and bits of packaging text, photographed under flat light.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Typography: A single line of bold condensed capitals in orange ('JO JO DANCER, YOUR LIFE IS CALLING') and cream ('A RICHARD PRYOR FILM') under the image, small relative to the poster, flat typeset on black. Does not touch the portrait.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Color and light: Rusty browns, oranges, and reds in the face against grays and whites; bright flat even lighting, with black frame.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Story it suggests: A man looks out at us with a tired, searching face, assembled from broken pieces.
1247_jo-jo-dancer-your-life-is-calling.j.Visual idea: A life reassembled from scrap: the face is a mosaic of discarded metal and trash.

1248_winchester-73.jpg.People: One man in a wide-brimmed hat, half body, face turned up and to the left, holding a long gun upright with one hand at left. The face is lit and sharply looking away.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from lower right to upper left, with the hat brim sweeping across the top and the rifle barrel vertical on the left edge. Title across the lower third, large.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Medium: Monochrome painted illustration in thick oil brushstrokes, with visible dry-brush streaks and canvas showing through at edges; some spots of ochre.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Typography: Huge ornate western wood-type capitals 'WINCHESTER '73' in white with black outline and drop shadow, in two lines across the bottom, plus a smaller bold sans for the star's name above and an italic credit. Typeset in Victorian display faces, overlapping the figure.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and silver-gray with small amber patches; dramatic contrast with a spotlight on the face.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Story it suggests: A watchful man grips a rifle, looking out of frame for danger.
1248_winchester-73.jpg.Visual idea: The rifle and face form a single tilted slash, like a gunfighter's pose, with the title as a saloon sign.

1249_king-lear.jpg.People: One man lying on grass in a close-up, wearing sunglasses and a long brown wig, with cables and wires coiled around his head and a hand at right; the image is repeated twice. He is lying on his side with his head turned sideways.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Composition: Poster is two stacked film-frame panels showing nearly the same shot, rounded like film cells with black gaps; title text runs across both, and the image is rotated 90 degrees. Radiation warning triangle at left in the second panel.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Medium: Color film frames with grain, shown as strips of film with black separators and rounded corners; photographic realism with saturated colors.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Typography: Very large yellow sans capitals 'JEAN-LUC GODARD' cut off at the top, 'KING / LEAR' underlined and stacked at right, and 'JEAN-LUC' again cut off at the bottom. Repeated and cropped, typeset, set over the picture and across the frame gap.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Color and light: Bright grass green, orange-red cables and flowers, and mustard-yellow type on black; flat daylight.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Story it suggests: A strange figure lies tangled in wires on the ground, a ruined king or a man plugged into a machine.
1249_king-lear.jpg.Visual idea: A repeated film strip treats the poster as a strip of film, and the warning sign marks the image as hazardous.

1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.People: Two people face to face in profile at half body: a woman at left in a brown bowler hat with curly red-brown hair, and a man at right with dark hair and a plaid jacket. They look at each other with a small gap between them.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Composition: Face-off composition, symmetrical around the title block in the middle, with a shop window and pickle barrels behind them. Barrels at the bottom center and a shop sign at the top.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Medium: Loose ink line and watercolor wash with bleeding pigment and visible paper white; hand-drawn lettering.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered navy blue capitals 'CROSSING / DELANCEY' stacked at center, medium size, plus a small italic script credit below; the shop signs 'Pickles Kraut' and 'Fusner' are drawn in the scene. The title is placed like another shop sign.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Color and light: Muted blues, brown and soft green on cream; gentle daylight.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people look at each other across a pickle shop in a neighborhood scene, with a hint of matchmaking.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Visual idea: The title is painted like a shop sign between the two faces, so the setting and romance share one picture.
1250_crossing-delancey.jpg.Feels like: Warm romantic comedy, 1980s New York neighborhood, sketchbook illustration.

1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.People: One huge face in profile at left, cropped at brow and chin, eyes looking down and sideways. A few small black silhouettes (a falling figure, a cyclist) float in the sky at right.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Composition: Giant face occupies the left half, with a scattering of floating objects (pills, spoon, syringe, cowboy hat, dog, cow, house, plane) falling across the sky at right as if in zero gravity. Title block at upper right.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Medium: Collage: the face is a coarse halftone color print with visible dots, set against a grainy photographic sky and cut-out vintage object images.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Typography: Chunky dark condensed lowercase sans 'drugstore / cowboy' in two lines at right of center, medium-large, with a small credit above in a lighter weight. Flat typeset, sitting in the sky among the floating objects.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue and cloud white with a pinkish face, and pops of red, orange, blue and mint; soft daylight.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man gazes away as a dream of pills, needles and Western icons drifts through the sky.
1251_drugstore-cowboy.jpg.Visual idea: The sky becomes the contents of his head, a cluster of obsessions floating off his face.

1252_performance.jpg.People: One woman's face, extreme close-up, split into overlapping translucent shards so that two or three versions of eyes, nose and mouth seem to blend. Open red lips and wide eyes.
1252_performance.jpg.Composition: Face fills the upper two-thirds in a rounded spotlight shape over black, cut by overlapping triangular shards; title at lower right and credits below on the dark empty area.
1252_performance.jpg.Medium: Photographic color film still with grain, broken up by glassy fragments and layered semi-transparent shapes; a blurry, double-exposed look.
1252_performance.jpg.Typography: Chunky lowercase sans 'performance' in gradient green to blue with a doubled offset ghost, medium-large at lower right, and small light lowercase credits below. Looks glitchy or vibrating, since letters repeat as echoes behind.
1252_performance.jpg.Color and light: Black ground, hot pink, purple, orange and red in the face; theatrical spotlight with a glowing, hallucinatory look.
1252_performance.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman's identity splits and fractures into several faces.
1252_performance.jpg.Visual idea: The mirror-shard fracture turns a portrait into a double or triple, and the title echoes in the same way.
1252_performance.jpg.Feels like: 1970s psychedelic art film, late-sixties countercultural thriller.

1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.People: One woman, half body, looking back over her shoulder at the viewer with a sly smile, in a huge black feather hat and fur wrap, raising one hand with long pearl strands. A tiny sketch of Paris skyline behind.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Composition: Round orange-yellow moon centered behind her head, framing the feathered hat; the Eiffel Tower silhouette at the left and rooftops at the bottom. Title large at the bottom over black.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Medium: Pen-and-ink stipple and hatching illustration with flat spot colors and a grainy gradient on the moon, like a vintage screen print.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Typography: Large cream serif capitals 'A WOMAN / of PARIS' in two lines at the lower center, with ornamental swash on the lowercase 'of'; orange and cream credits below in smaller serif and italic type. Classic typeset, partly overlapped by the pearl strand.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Color and light: Deep midnight blue with stars, glowing orange-yellow moon, black hat and city silhouette; a warm theatrical glow.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Story it suggests: A glamorous woman in the night of Paris glances back with knowing confidence.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Visual idea: The moon becomes a halo behind her feathered hat, so she is the moon of the city.
1253_a-woman-of-paris.jpg.Feels like: Silent-film glamour, 1920s Paris, art deco revival.

1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.People: None. Two giant monsters instead: a gray-green upright dinosaur-like creature at the center and a huge plant-like beast with several toothed mouths and tentacles behind.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Composition: Dynamic cluster: the central monster rears up with arms stretched out, grasping green vines pulled toward the corners in a radial pattern; the plant beast looms above with open jaws, and the title fills the lower quarter.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Medium: Painted illustration with detailed airbrush and oil-like rendering, wet glossy highlights, yellow rim outline, and a mottled organic backdrop.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Typography: Large blocky, slanted comic-style capitals with a green-to-yellow gradient and black outline with a drop shadow, two lines stacked with a small orange connector word between, about 80 percent of the width. A small artist signature at the bottom right. The title hits the bottom edge, in the manner of a B-movie logo.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Color and light: Fiery red and orange background, acid green, teal; hot, glowing, lurid light.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Story it suggests: Two monstrous creatures lock in a savage fight, tendrils tearing through the air.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Visual idea: An explosion of vines radiating from the hero's fists, with a gory, living backdrop.
1254_godzilla-vs-biollante.jpg.Feels like: Kaiju monster-movie poster painting, with a horror-fantasy feel in the late 1980s.

1255_night-moves.jpg.People: One man, half body, seen through murky blue water or glass; a dark hand with splayed fingers presses up at the right and a second pale arm reaches in from the lower left. Rendered as a painting, he is partly dissolved and half-submerged, so he reads as both figure and smudge.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Composition: Lettering stacked in the top half, painted figure sunk into the bottom third, with the figure's bulk offset slightly left and the raised hand balancing on the right. Large empty blue field between title and figure; bubbles scatter up the sides.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Medium: Loose oil or gouache painting with visible brushstrokes, dabbed pale-blue bubble shapes and soft blended edges; no photographic grain.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Typography: Very large heavy condensed sans-serif title stacked in two lines, mustard-gold, spanning nearly the full width; an off-white bold name line above and a small spaced credit line below. Clean typeset letters sit flat on top of the painting with no distortion.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Color and light: Teal and steel blue throughout with muddy brown flesh tones and one mustard accent; dim, diffuse underwater-like light.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Story it suggests: A man struggles or drifts beneath a surface, reaching for something while bubbles rise, suggesting drowning or being trapped.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Visual idea: Submersion as metaphor: the figure is literally dissolved into paint like something sinking out of clarity, while the solid gold title stays above the surface.
1255_night-moves.jpg.Feels like: 1970s paranoid thriller, painted American paperback or poster art, revived in modern editorial style.

1256_choose-me.jpg.People: A woman shown only as lips, chin, and two hands; no eyes. A fingertip touches her mouth while the other hand grips a phone receiver. Extreme close-up, fragmentary, with the face cropped at the nose.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Composition: Square illustration inside a thin red frame, set above a black band that holds the credits and title in the lower area. Diagonal flow from the lips at top center down to the phone and pearls at lower right; nails are repeated as red accents around the frame.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Medium: Airbrushed, hyperreal illustration with smooth gradients and glossy highlights on lips, nails, pearls and plastic; slick 1980s commercial-art finish.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Typography: Title in a red brush-script, large, in the lower right, slanted upward with a rough brushed underline stroke; cast names in small white sans stacked left; a small credit line right. The script feels hand-painted and contrasts with the plain white type.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Color and light: Saturated red, flesh pink and cream against pure black; warm, glossy, studio-lit highlights.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Story it suggests: A seductive voice on the phone, intimacy conducted at a distance with the face withheld.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Visual idea: The mouth, nails and phone stand in for the whole person: desire reduced to red details, with the face deliberately cropped away.
1256_choose-me.jpg.Feels like: 1980s erotic drama or romance poster, airbrush pulp glamour.

1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.People: Seven figures: three large heads across the top (a man, a mustached older man in a straw hat, a blond man looking up), a young blonde woman with blue eyes in the center right, and three smaller figures lower right (a man, a woman, a child in a straw hat). Mostly head-and-shoulders portraits clustered like a collage; a rabbit also appears bottom left.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Composition: Faces cluster in a descending cascade from top to right, with a big cream circle at left holding the title; a landscape with a stone farmhouse fills the lower half. Layered vertical tiers: faces above, hills and house below, tilted gaze lines pointing upward and sideways.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Medium: Painted illustration with visible brushwork, textured like gouache or oil, with a slight vintage-print softness.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Typography: Large, tall, ornamental serif with swashes and stacked words in dark green, set in a pale circle on the left; a small spaced credit line sits inside. The title runs in a column that follows the circle edge, with small words in between like 'de' and 'of the'.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Color and light: Sunlit pastel teal sky, golden yellow-green hills and warm skin tones; soft, warm daylight.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Story it suggests: Several people tied together by a rural property, with watchful, wary looks hinting at rivalry and longing over the land.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Visual idea: Characters floating above the landscape like the thoughts or fate hanging over the farm; the circle holds the title as a sun or medallion.
1257_jean-de-florette-manon-of-the-sprin.Feels like: Classic European rural drama, hand-painted cinema poster of the 1980s revived as nostalgia.

1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.People: A man in a cap and jacket carrying a baby, seen at half body on a printed insert, cropped and slightly tilted. The figures are inside a photographed DVD case, so the people are an image inside a photograph of an object.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Composition: Photographed from above at an angle: a DVD case sits on a blue tarp among other cases at the edges, with one partially cropped. The case runs diagonally, with the main figure in the lower right of its insert and the title below him.
