1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Medium: Photographic realism of a cheap bootleg-style printed cover, with soft low-resolution printing, faded color, and glossy plastic edges, on top of a woven plastic tarp and concrete.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Typography: Title in a bejeweled bling pendant script, silver and gold chain letters hanging on the jacket, stacked in two lines; a small white credit line below. Small printed text on neighboring cases is cut off at the edges; the vertical year and collection text sits on the dark pavement at left.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Color and light: Washed-out pale sky tones over a saturated blue tarp, with gray pavement; flat daylight.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Story it suggests: A young father with a child out on the street, in the world of street-market goods and hustling.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Visual idea: The cover is staged as a street-vendor bootleg DVD, so the poster acts as an object in the world it depicts.
1258_prince-of-broadway.jpg.Feels like: Street-level urban indie, 2000s DIY, a playful take on counterfeit DVD sellers.

1259_anora.jpg.People: One woman, nearly full body, seated and facing the viewer with legs wide apart in tall black boots; wearing only a red scarf. She is centered and frontal.
1259_anora.jpg.Composition: Strongly symmetrical and centered: a big neon script arches across the top, the figure forms a triangle below it, and her boots make a V shape that leads down. Dark empty space around, with the credit centered at the bottom.
1259_anora.jpg.Medium: Glossy, photographic with heavy bloom and glow; the neon looks luminous, with subtle scratchy dark texture in the background.
1259_anora.jpg.Typography: Huge neon-sign script title in glowing red with white-hot cores, slanting upward across most of the width, set behind the figure's head so the head overlaps it. Small spaced caps above the red cursive credit at the bottom.
1259_anora.jpg.Color and light: Black and saturated red with glowing neon light spilling onto skin and scarf; high-contrast, nocturnal, a single color family.
1259_anora.jpg.Story it suggests: A confident woman presents herself in a nightlife setting, in control of her own display.
1259_anora.jpg.Visual idea: The woman and the neon sign merge into a single glowing emblem, with the neon title serving as her halo.
1259_anora.jpg.Feels like: Neon-lit nightlife pop, contemporary erotic drama with a retro sign-painting touch.

1260_basquiat.jpg.People: One man at half body, looking down, in a dark jacket with spiky hair, holding a cloth and a hand-painted yellow bird-like toy under one arm. His head sits right of center, with blurred buildings behind him.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Composition: Black-and-white photo filling the frame, with the man in the lower right and a hand-drawn crown, oval title and cast list filling the upper left and center. A diagonal run of scribbled names leads down toward the yellow toy.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white photograph with heavy film grain; red crayon or paint scrawl and thick yellow-orange daubs painted over it.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered red capital letters scrawled and uneven, some crossed out, in a looped oval with radiating tick marks; crowns and a credit line drawn at top with a ruled line underneath. The names are small and column-like, left-aligned, overlapping the man's jacket.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Color and light: Gray monochrome with bright red lettering and yellow-orange patches; flat overcast city light.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Story it suggests: A young man walks through the city while his own name and fame are being scribbled over the image.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Visual idea: The cover is defaced by the subject's own graffiti hand, as though the artwork is annotating the photograph.
1260_basquiat.jpg.Feels like: 1980s-90s downtown art-scene biography, graffiti and expressionist street art.

1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.People: One man, full body, small relative to the landscape, standing in profile and looking down at something in his hand. He is centered right of middle.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Composition: Wide landscape of hills and mountains behind, with the man in the center; two thin diagonal lines slice the image from top right to bottom left. Big title letters run down the image and some are cropped off the edges.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still, soft and faded with a slight haze; the type is flat and crisp over it.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Typography: Very large white italic serif capitals, stacked in four lines and moving down the page in a staggered diagonal. 'THE' is cut off at the top and left, 'CARRY' bleeds off the right edge, and letters overlap the man; thin white lines cross the letters.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Color and light: Pale sage-yellow sky and sand-colored hills with blue-gray mountains and a green and blue plaid shirt; hazy, washed daylight.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Story it suggests: A man alone on a dry hillside, waiting or searching, as if listening to the wind.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Visual idea: The title is blown across the image like wind, cutting through the scene and pushing past the edges.
1261_the-wind-will-carry-us.jpg.Feels like: Slow, contemplative arthouse cinema with a modern editorial design treatment.

1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.People: One person, small and blurred, mid-leap or falling in the centre of a pale doorway, limbs flung out; no face visible. It is ambiguous whether it is a jump or a tumble, and whether it is a child.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Composition: Tall narrow white strip like a doorway or a hall runs vertically in the centre between dark walls on both sides; the figure floats in the middle, with a thin diagonal line crossing behind. The title is placed above and the credit stacked below.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white film still with coarse grain and strong blur; high contrast.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Typography: Typewriter-like, slightly irregular black capitals, small, set in short stacked lines (KILLER / OF / SHEEP; A FILM / BY / CHARLES / BURNETT), staggered left to right and spaced widely; sits on the white strip, so letters appear to hang in the same space as the figure.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Color and light: Black, grey and white; harsh, overexposed daylight.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Story it suggests: A person leaps through an empty bright space between dark walls.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Visual idea: The doorway as a stage with the leap in the middle, floating, with type placed as if falling with it.
1262_killer-of-sheep.jpg.Feels like: 1970s independent black-and-white realism, spare and lyrical.

1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.People: Four tiny cartoon swordsmen in period costume, full body, perched or leaping around the edges of the giant lettering. They are small, drawn in profile or three-quarter poses, and do not interact with each other.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Composition: Giant title block fills the center in a stacked column, with a long extruded shadow dropping down and to the right; the little figures cling to its corners at top, left, lower right and bottom left. A cast list runs down the right edge and plenty of cream space frames the block.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Medium: Flat solid color with ink-line cartoon figures that have light watercolor fills, on a cream paper-like background with a soft yellowed vignette at the edges.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Typography: Huge condensed Victorian-style serif, stacked in four rows with swashy terminals, in dusty pink-brown and olive-gold, each with a deep dark-brown extruded shadow. The type is the main image; the figures stand on and cling to it. Cast names are small, right-aligned, first names in lowercase and surnames in caps.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Color and light: Cream background with dusty rose, olive gold and chocolate brown; flat, matte and evenly lit.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Story it suggests: A swashbuckling romp where sword fights happen on the very letters of the title.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Visual idea: The title as a building or cliff that the swordsmen climb and duel on.
1263_the-three-musketeers-the-four-muske.Feels like: 1970s comic costume adventure, whimsical vintage illustration.

1264_the-wiz.jpg.People: Eight or so figures in painted portrait: a smiling woman in pink with a small dog, a metallic man in a straw hat, a scarecrow-like figure in striped sleeves, a bejeweled queen at left, a roaring lion head at bottom left, a woman in a starry blue gown at bottom right, and a giant metallic blue face looming at the top. Mostly half-body and head-and-shoulders, packed together like a crowd.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Composition: Densely packed collage with a pyramid arrangement: the huge blue head at top center with two beams of light going out, a city skyline and a rollercoaster behind, and a yellow taxi at the bottom center. Faces overlap and fill nearly every inch, with the title near the lower center.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Medium: Detailed painted illustration, like acrylic or gouache, with crisp edges, glossy highlights and richly textured costumes.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Typography: Chunky gold block capitals with black outline, glossy highlights and sparkles, stacked in two lines at center and overlapping the figures, with a small black credit box beneath. The metallic lettering looks like a lit marquee.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Color and light: Saturated teal-blue sky, golden yellow, magenta and pink, with metallic silver; theatrical light with beams from the top face.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Story it suggests: A band of odd companions travels through a fantastical city toward a looming, powerful being.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Visual idea: A city turned into a fairytale realm, with a huge face as the all-seeing presence and the group converging toward the center.
1264_the-wiz.jpg.Feels like: 1970s musical fantasy, celebratory contemporary mural-style painting.

1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..People: One man seen in profile as a solid black silhouette, wearing a hat and a beard, large and facing right. The face is blindfolded or wrapped by filmstrips across the eyes.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Composition: A cyan block across the top holds the title, with the cream lower area filled by the huge silhouette cutting in from the left edge. Three wavy filmstrips pass through the head diagonally toward the right; a vertical tagline and an arrow on the right edge point up.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Medium: Flat solid ink in screenprint style with a speckled, stippled edge on the silhouette; the filmstrip has white sprocket dots and thin outlines.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Typography: Huge black slab-serif 'MONK' in wide letter-spaced capitals filling the top band and bleeding to the right edge, with a smaller spaced first name and credit line above; a rotated tagline in black and blue runs down the right side, with the last words in blue, ending in an arrow.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Color and light: Cyan blue, cream and black; flat, graphic, no visible light source.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Story it suggests: A musician whose face is bound or blindfolded by film, implying how a film has captured or covered him.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Visual idea: The filmstrip as a blindfold or headband, so the documentary medium wraps around the subject.
1265_thelonious-monk-straight-no-chaser..Feels like: Mid-century jazz record sleeve, bold modernist graphic design.

1266_midnight.jpg.People: A cast of about nine: a man in a chauffeur's cap at upper right, a mustached man in a tuxedo at left, a woman with curly hair and puffed sleeves resting her cheek on her hand at center, and a row of party guests behind them. Mostly half body, drawn in a collage of two scenes; the woman looks sidelong at the viewer.
1266_midnight.jpg.Composition: Split into two zones by a sweeping curved line: a nighttime city street with the driver at the top, and a ballroom crowd below with the central woman. Title runs diagonally down the left over a curtain edge; the main couple in the lower left sits on a diagonal toward the crowd.
1266_midnight.jpg.Medium: Gouache or ink drawing in grayscale with visible brush marks, pencil shading and hand-inked contours; looks hand-painted on paper.
1266_midnight.jpg.Typography: Big white brush-script title with black drop shadow, slanted upward at the left and stretched tall, with star dots over the 'i'; names set in a delicate serif at top; the director credit is bottom right in serif bold.
1266_midnight.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray, black and white with a warm beige tint in the lower scene; soft, flat, evening-like.
1266_midnight.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman caught between a formal society man and a cabbie, with the night city sliding into a glamorous party.
1266_midnight.jpg.Visual idea: The two worlds, street and ballroom, are held in one frame by the curve, as if one scene transforms into the other.
1266_midnight.jpg.Feels like: 1930s screwball comedy, black-and-white vintage poster art.

1267_sorcerer.jpg.People: None. A weathered red-painted emblem on dark metal occupies the center; the emblem's circles and shapes may read as a crude face or truck front, which is ambiguous.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Composition: Big red graphic at the center, tilted slightly, with a hand-painted title below it. Out-of-focus green leaves frame the left, top right, bottom and right edges like a vignette, as though seen through foliage.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Medium: Photographic close-up of a chipped, peeling red paint stencil on dark rusty metal, with shallow depth of field and soft-focus leaves in the foreground.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Typography: Title in rough hand-painted red brush capitals along the lower left to right, tilted upward and spattered like paint on metal, with the umlaut-like dots over the O; a small clean white serif credit at the bottom center.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Color and light: Blood red against near-black and deep jungle green; moody, dim, dappled light.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Story it suggests: Something dangerous and machine-like is hidden in dense foliage, a marked vehicle abandoned or hunted in the wild.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Visual idea: The emblem acts like a totem or ritual mask, so a truck or machine feels like a sorcerous idol.
1267_sorcerer.jpg.Feels like: 1970s gritty jungle thriller, rendered in a modern textured style.

1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.People: None. The letters themselves are built from piano parts, so the only human trace is implied through the instrument.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Composition: Entirely centered and symmetrical: six stacked lines of the title fill the page, with a black field around, and a small credit centered at the bottom.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Medium: Photographic collage of disassembled piano parts (hammers, keys, strings and felts) cut into letter shapes, photographed against pure black with a glossy, dimensional finish.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Typography: The title is the entire image: very large Victorian-style serif capitals, stacked in six lines, each letter made of piano innards in wood, ivory and copper; the letters are slightly irregular in size. A small spaced serif credit in light gray sits at the bottom.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Color and light: Warm tan, ivory, copper and wood tones with a few red felts against deep black; spotlit, dramatic.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Story it suggests: A portrait of a musician told through his instrument, taken apart into fragments, much like the film's many short pieces.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Visual idea: Letters made of piano pieces, so the title is both text and the dismantled instrument, a puzzle of parts.
1268_thirty-two-short-films-about-glenn-.Feels like: Classical music, arthouse biography, 1990s experimental graphic design.

1269_the-big-heat.jpg.People: A man in a fedora and overcoat at half body, in profile, at left; behind him a huge ghostly face in profile, a woman's, dissolves into the dark. A hand holding a gun is at the bottom, and a coffeepot sits near the title.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Composition: Black field with the man left of center and the giant faint face on the right in a diagonal, rising to the upper right. Title runs diagonally across the lower half, with cast names beside it. Light slashes run diagonally over the whole mass.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Medium: Charcoal or airbrush-like drawing with soft smoky gradients, grainy blacks and glowing whites, mimicking black-and-white film; the lettering looks hand-drawn.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Typography: Title in large white slanted hand-lettered capitals with rough edges and a glow, leaning forward, set across the lower middle and overlapping the man's coat. Cast names in smaller condensed white type with script first names at left; a small script credit at right.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white with gray smoke; high-contrast noir light with venetian-blind stripes.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man with a gun is haunted by the face of a woman looming over him in a violent underworld.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Visual idea: The ghost face looms like a memory or threat made of shadow, with the blinds' stripes cutting across both faces.
1269_the-big-heat.jpg.Feels like: 1950s film noir, crime poster in charcoal.

1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.People: Four people shown as tight close-up faces, two men on top and two women on the bottom, each facing the viewer in a square photo. They do not look at each other, and each gazes in a different direction.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Composition: Grid of four equal square photos with the title running as a wide band across the middle, forming a cross-like layout; a lot of cream margin with the credit at bottom right. Symmetry is near-perfect.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Medium: Color film-still photographs with fine grain, printed on a flat beige paper-textured background.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Typography: Enormous black condensed sans-serif title set in a single line across the full width between the photos, tight tracking, with a small credit line in bold black below at the right. The block letters are straight, flat and heavy.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Color and light: Warm beige background with orange and brown skin tones and a bit of orange from the spine and logo; soft interior light.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Story it suggests: Two men and two women, each facing out alone, suggesting a quartet of relationships that never quite meet.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Visual idea: A grid of faces separated by a stark title, as if the couples are divided and compared like specimens.
1270_carnal-knowledge.jpg.Feels like: Early-1970s American drama, clean modernist design.

1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.People: Two people, full body, seated on a bench at a roadside; a woman in white at left and a man in a brown jacket at right. Both look off to the side in different directions, and are small within the frame.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Composition: Photographic scene with the pair centered in the lower half, green foliage filling the upper half and a house barely visible in the middle. The sidewalk and road at the bottom make horizontal bands. The title floats in the upper center among the leaves.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with natural grain and soft color; a quiet, naturalistic photograph.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Typography: Title in lowercase typewriter-style slab letters, cream colored, stacked in three lines in the upper center and centered; the director credit at the bottom is in the same typewriter face in black, with a small italic 'a film by'. Casual and understated.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Color and light: Deep leafy greens, with white and brown accents and gray pavement; soft natural overcast daylight.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people wait side by side without looking at each other, hinting at siblings or a pair who are close but not saying much.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Visual idea: The two figures sit within a green bubble of calm, a pause before a journey, with the bag at their feet.
1271_you-can-count-on-me.jpg.Feels like: Quiet American indie drama of the 2000s, small-town naturalism.

1272_shoeshine.jpg.People: Two boys in tight close-up, one at left and one right behind and higher at right, seen through vertical prison-like bars. Both gaze at the viewer with wary, sad expressions; the second is half-lit and blurred.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Composition: Three thick dark vertical bars run the full height, crossing both faces. Faces occupy the middle, the director name runs across the top and a huge title across the bottom.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Medium: Grainy black-and-white film photograph with soft focus and dim light, with flat gold lettering on top.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Typography: Enormous mustard-gold condensed capitals filling the bottom third edge to edge, flat and tall; the director name spans the top in widely spaced thin white capitals, with a small gold 'A film by' above. The bars overlap the top lettering.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Color and light: Black, gray and white with a single ochre-gold accent; dim, low-key light with soft shadows.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young friends are shut behind bars, afraid and watching, their bond tested by confinement.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Visual idea: The bars slice the faces, turning the image into a cell, and the gold title is a weighty, rigid block below.
1272_shoeshine.jpg.Feels like: Postwar Italian neorealism, restored classic with a modern two-color design.

1273_cairo-station.jpg.People: A smiling woman in a striped dress and large earrings, shown nearly full body in three-quarter turn, holding a bucket of soda bottles; behind her, a huge close-up of a man's eyes and nose fills the background, glaring. The big face is a background painting, not a second figure in the scene.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Composition: Woman centered on the vertical axis with the huge pair of eyes spread at her shoulder height behind her; title stacked in the center overlapping her body, bottles at the bottom.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Medium: Digital painting in a gouache style, with soft brushwork and grain.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Typography: Large cream thin-weight elegant serif caps in two lines, about 75% of the width, placed over her torso; the credit in italic serif is smaller, below. Typeset and layered over the figure.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Color and light: Deep maroon red background with golden-yellow, olive green and cream; warm, theatrical light.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Story it suggests: A cheerful vendor is watched by a man with menacing eyes.
1273_cairo-station.jpg.Visual idea: Huge eyes behind the woman turn her bright smile into a stage of obsession and danger.

1274_compensation.jpg.People: Four people in two scenes: a man and a woman dancing or gesturing on a dune at the top, and a man in a bowler hat bending toward a woman in a wide hat in shallow water at the bottom. They are small to medium, full body, facing each other.
1274_compensation.jpg.Composition: Poster is split in two photographs stacked vertically with the title band in the middle: top scene has the pair centered on a light dune, bottom scene has them left and right on the water with a tilted horizon. A line of sign-language hand drawings sits above the title.
1274_compensation.jpg.Medium: Faded black-and-white film stills with heavy grain, printed in warm-gray, overexposed tones; the hands are old engraved illustrations.
1274_compensation.jpg.Typography: Title in ornate Victorian serif capitals with swirling decorative interiors, dark brown, centered, with a row of engraved hands spelling out letters above it; small spaced credit below. Fine, antique and decorative.
1274_compensation.jpg.Color and light: Cream, warm gray and dark brown; bright, hazy, high-key light that washes out the highlights.
1274_compensation.jpg.Story it suggests: Two pairs of lovers from different times play and approach each other by the water.
1274_compensation.jpg.Visual idea: Two eras are stacked and mirrored, with silent hand-language linking them through the title.
1274_compensation.jpg.Feels like: Silent-era-style early 20th-century romance, antique and archival.

1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.People: About twenty-four people in a loose crowd, full body, walking and standing in diverse modern clothes, seen from slightly above. Most face different directions and look away from each other; one holds a phone to his ear.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Composition: The crowd forms a tall, tapering cluster in the center of a white field, slanted slightly from the top to the lower right, with wide empty margins. Titles run vertically in a narrow column at right in two blocks, top and bottom.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Medium: Clean black ink line drawing with flat black fills and red halftone-dot fills on some clothing; crisp, printed-looking illustration on white.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Typography: Two title blocks at the right: a bold black condensed sans stacked title with tall black Chinese characters below at top, and a red condensed sans title with red Chinese characters at the bottom; a red rotated credit runs vertically between them. Small relative to the image, aligned to the right margin.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Color and light: White, black and a single pinkish red in halftone dots; flat and shadowless.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Story it suggests: A crowd of city dwellers moving through the same space without meeting, each in their own world.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Visual idea: The crowd as a mass with red-dot figures scattered through it, like pieces on a board or highlighted connections inside an anonymous group.
1275_a-confucian-confusion-mahjong-two-f.Feels like: 1990s urban ensemble comedy, contemporary minimalist print illustration.

1276_saving-face.jpg.People: Three women: one large frontal face wearing a white sheet mask, filling the center, flanked by a smaller figure with arms crossed at left and another with a hand in her hair at right. The center woman looks straight at the viewer with a skeptical expression; the side figures look away.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical triptych feel with the big face dead center and the two figures in the upper left and right; the face runs from top to bottom. Title letters wrap around the head, one word above and one word below the face.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Medium: Gouache or painted-paper look with flat opaque color, visible dry-brush texture and loose edges; hand-painted illustration.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Typography: Title in coral-red hand-painted brush capitals, stacked with 'SAVING' arcing over the top of the head and 'FACE' slanting below the chin, large and loose with wobbly strokes; a small white hand-lettered credit at the bottom. The letters wrap the face like a frame.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Color and light: Saturated greens in many tones with coral red letters, a white face and a bit of peach; flat, painterly, no cast light.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman in a face mask is watched and judged by the women around her, caught between family expectation and her own private moment.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Visual idea: A literal face mask that also stands for hiding and saving face, set in a sea of green.
1276_saving-face.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary indie comedy-drama, modern hand-painted editorial illustration.

1277_born-in-flames.jpg.People: One woman's face in extreme close-up, cropped at the left so only one eye, nose and lips show, with a headscarf or band at the top. Her eye stares sideways out at the viewer.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Composition: Face fills the left and center; title in huge slanting letters sits across the center, each word on its own black bar, stepping down to the right. Credit sits at the lower right.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Medium: High-contrast, grainy black-and-white photocopy look with white specks and scratches; red crayon or marker scribbles and rough red-textured lettering over the top.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Typography: Title in huge hand-scrawled red capitals, rough and grainy like crayon, slanted forward and stacked in three lines, each set on a black bar; the letters overlap and are crisscrossed with red scratch lines. The credit is in rough white hand-lettering with small caps above.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with fiery red; harsh, high-contrast, flash-like light.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Story it suggests: A defiant gaze under a scratched-over image, a woman looking back at the viewer in a charged, rebellious moment.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Visual idea: The image looks scratched out and marked up like a protest flyer, so the title burns through the face like a flame.
1277_born-in-flames.jpg.Feels like: Early-1980s punk, protest zine, guerrilla photocopy art.

1278_flow.jpg.People: No humans. One black cat leaping or floating in mid-air at the center, with wide amber eyes, surrounded by many small colorful fish. The cat is large, nearly full body, and seen from a low angle.
1278_flow.jpg.Composition: Cat is central and upright with the legs pulled up, and the title sits below at the bottom center. Fish scatter across the whole frame and shrink toward the bottom, giving a sense of depth; a glowing bright patch at the upper left pulls the eye up.
1278_flow.jpg.Medium: Digital 3D-style animation rendering with soft painterly textures, shallow depth of field and a slightly blurry bokeh; looks like a still from a computer-animated film.
1278_flow.jpg.Typography: Title in huge white hand-brushed lowercase-style letters with a rough round stroke, centered near the bottom and large; a small white sans credit below. The brush look softens the digital image.
1278_flow.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal and aqua with luminous white-blue light from above, dark cat, small bright orange, yellow and pink fish; dreamy, underwater glow.
1278_flow.jpg.Story it suggests: A small cat is suddenly afloat among fish, surprised and alone in a flooded world.
1278_flow.jpg.Visual idea: A land animal dropped into a water world, with the big wide-eyed cat as the astonished viewer.
1278_flow.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary animated adventure, wordless fable, painterly CG.

1279_read-my-lips.jpg.People: Two people shown in extreme close-up fragments of faces: a man's bleeding cheek and eye on the top row and left, and a woman's face and hand over her nose at right and bottom. They never appear together in one frame.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Composition: Strict 3x3 grid of image tiles divided by thin red lines, with the center tile a solid red block carrying the title. Top row repeats a sliding crop of the same eye and cheek; bottom row shows fingers over the nose, repeated at an offset, like a pan across a frame.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Medium: Color film still photographs with fine grain and soft focus, cropped and tiled; flat red ink for the center block.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Typography: Title in black condensed sans-serif capitals in the red center block, spread out with large word gaps so 'READ' and 'MY' sit at the edges; small names above and credit below are widely letter-spaced across the width. The text is justified and mechanical.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Color and light: Red grid lines and block, with skin tones and a muted green background; flat, even interior light.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Story it suggests: A violent, intimate encounter between two people shown only in pieces, with hands hiding a mouth.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Visual idea: A face is cut into a grid and repeated like frames on a filmstrip, so the viewer has to read lips from fragments.
1279_read-my-lips.jpg.Feels like: 2000s French crime thriller, modern graphic grid design.

1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.People: Fragments of a few people in tiles: a man's eye, nose and chin across several squares, a woman's profile in a car at right, a hand with a wound at the bottom right and a hand on sheet music at top left. Never a whole figure.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Composition: 3x3 grid of square photographs in the center of a dark brown field, with text blocks above and below. The man's face is chopped across the central column, and a few tiles show blurred lights or objects.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Medium: Color film-still photographs with warm grain and shallow focus, tiled with thin dark gaps; flat red type on brown.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Typography: Red condensed sans-serif capitals, evenly spread so each word sits in a three-column grid: the title in two lines above the grid, the director credit in two lines below. The wide spacing makes the lines read as a table; no distortion.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Color and light: Near-black brown ground with red type and warm amber, green and skin tones in the photos; dim night-lit, glowing city lights.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Story it suggests: A man torn between rough hands and music, pieces of his life that don't fit together, moving through the night.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Visual idea: The man's face is dissected into tiles beside objects of his two lives, a puzzle that hasn't been assembled.
1280_the-beat-that-my-heart-skipped.jpg.Feels like: Mid-2000s French drama, moody arthouse grid design.

1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.People: A large dog painted in the framed picture, with a trail of tiny people and dogs arranged along its body like a procession. They are figures inside a painting inside a photograph of a room; a small girl pictogram is on a door at right.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Composition: A photographed scene: a wooden framed painting on an easel at left center, with a brown door at right and a stool at the bottom, all set against a mustard-yellow wall. Title in a box at the top; the dog curls diagonally through the frame, head top left, tail bottom center.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Medium: Photographic image of a diorama-like set, with a detailed painted illustration in the frame that looks like gouache or ink with wood-grain; miniature handcrafted feel.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Typography: Title in black rectangular label boxes with yellow bold italic serif letters at the top, outlined in a gold bar like a signboard; huge red brush-painted Japanese characters inside the painting; a small label plate under the frame and a yellow italic credit at the bottom right.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Color and light: Mustard yellow, warm wood brown and strong red accents; flat, even, soft interior light.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Story it suggests: A single dog stands in for an entire crowd of characters, set in a staged display, a story told as a school-play poster.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Visual idea: A poster-within-a-poster, where the dog's body becomes a map of the cast.
1281_isle-of-dogs.jpg.Feels like: Quirky hand-crafted stop-motion fable with Japanese-inspired set design.

1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.People: A dense crowd of roughly 80 caricatured figures, mostly head-and-shoulders or half body, packed in tiers from foreground to windows and rooftops. Some are big in the foreground (a bearded painter with a palette, a young man with a cigarette and a pink booklet, a chef); many look out of windows or stand on stairs; a few act (a guitarist, a climber, police with guns).
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Composition: Layered, pyramidal crowd with large figures at the bottom and tiny ones above, set in front of a street of Paris-style buildings. Title in the sky across the top; the crowd fills the whole lower two thirds in a busy, many-pocket 'Where's Waldo' layout.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Medium: Flat-color ink illustration with thick black outlines and loose hatching; looks like a hand-drawn, printed comic or newspaper cartoon.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Typography: Title as a large marquee-style sign in black dotted-bulb capitals, stacked in two lines in the top half, with a small subtitle below; sign-like text appears throughout (shop names, placards). The marquee letters sit in the sky and feel like architecture.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Color and light: Sky blue with warm yellow, red and orange, muted pastel building tones; flat, even daylight, with yellow glowing windows.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Story it suggests: A whole city's cast of eccentrics crams into one frame, each with a story, as if every window holds an article.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Visual idea: The poster is a magazine-cartoon panorama where every window and face is its own little vignette.
1282_the-french-dispatch-of-the-liberty-.Feels like: Whimsical French-magazine cartoon, ensemble comedy with mid-century Parisian flavor.

1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.People: One man, head and shoulders, facing the viewer calmly, his skin entirely tinted red. A small white house sits in the background at the right, with no one else visible.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical and centered: the red face stands in front of a horizon line at the middle, with sky and clouds above and rolling farmland below. A winding road leads from the lower left toward the house at right; the title sits at the top.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Medium: Painted or digital illustration with soft airbrush-like clouds, flat stylized fields and a finely drawn, hatched face; mixes a naive landscape with detailed portraiture.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Typography: Title in a chunky white soft serif with curvy, friendly letterforms, set in two lines at the top over the clouds, with the 'A' tucked beside the logo; a small white italic credit near the bottom. The warm, rounded letters contrast with the dark subject.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue and pastel pink clouds, bright greens, and a saturated red face; flat, sunny, storybook light.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Story it suggests: A calm man in a peaceful countryside carries something dangerous beneath the surface, a violent side hidden behind a tidy home.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Visual idea: A red-washed face in a pastoral dream, as if blood or anger is spilling over an idyllic scene.
1283_a-history-of-violence.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary thriller reimagined in a retro children's-book or folk-art style.

1284_altered-states.jpg.People: One man's face at the center, half human and half skull, inside a dark circle, with a crown of eyes around his head and wires attached at the sides. Large and frontal, eyes closed.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Composition: Circular mandala-like arrangement: a big disc at the upper center holds the head, surrounded by radiating starbursts, cells and spirals. Title in big letters across the bottom, running off the right edge.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Medium: Intricately hatched ink or scratchboard-like illustration with dense line work, colored in glowing neon gradients; looks like an etching lit from within.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Typography: Title in huge pale cream geometric sans-serif capitals in two lines at the bottom, with a diagonal 'A' and a slashing 'A' in STATES, the second line cropped off the right edge; credit in a smaller cream sans. The type is plain and clean compared to the dense image.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Color and light: Magenta, crimson, teal green and violet on black, with glowing star highlights; psychedelic, electric, glowing from inside.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Story it suggests: A man's mind is breaking apart or transforming, a scientific experiment pushing him into a hallucination between life and death.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Visual idea: The face splits into skull and flesh inside a cosmic eye-wreath, a literal image of consciousness unraveling.
1284_altered-states.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s and 1980s psychedelic sci-fi horror, midnight-movie poster art.

1285_deep-crimson.jpg.People: Two people, half body: a woman in a red off-the-shoulder dress at left and a man in a fedora and tan suit at right, facing each other close, his arm around her neck while he grips her arm. She holds a knife behind her back with the other hand, hidden from him.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Composition: Couple fills the center and left, pressed against a brown wall on the left; a window to a desert and cloudy blue sky opens at the right. The red dress is the visual anchor, and the knife blade points diagonally down at lower center.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushwork, glazed skin tones and heavy realistic shading, a slightly caricatured naive-realist style.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Typography: Title in tall thin cream serif capitals, widely spaced across the middle of the poster, overlapping the couple; small cream italic credit at upper right. The letters are crisp, elegant and even.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Color and light: Deep red, tan and brown with a blue evening sky; warm, theatrical side light.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Story it suggests: An embrace that is also a trap: she hides a knife while he holds her close.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Visual idea: Seduction and murder in one gesture, with the hidden knife as the secret in the middle of an embrace.
1285_deep-crimson.jpg.Feels like: 1940s-50s pulp crime romance in the manner of a regional realist painting.

1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.People: One figure in a silhouette wearing a fedora and holding a cane, standing in the lower left, black against a bright disc. A huge eye ringed by many small eyes looms at right, a creature or symbol, ambiguous.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Composition: Black field with a big circular swirl behind the figure, echoing a spiral or tunnel; the silhouette sits left of center and the many-eyed shape sits on the right. Title in large letters angled diagonally from the upper left down toward the right, overlapping the top of the circle.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Medium: Scratchboard or pen-and-ink with dense white hatching on black, rough and hand-drawn.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Typography: Title in chunky, wobbly white outlined capitals with hatched fill, in two lines, slanting up toward the right and large across the top; a tiny credit line above it. The jagged outlines look hand-cut or carnival-sign-like.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Color and light: Black and off-white only; stark, high-contrast, like moonlight on a dark carnival.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Story it suggests: A lone man stands in front of a staring, many-eyed horror, caught in a sinister carnival setting.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Visual idea: The disc is both moon and hypnotist's wheel, with the swarm of eyes as the thing watching him.
1286_nightmare-alley.jpg.Feels like: Gothic carnival horror and noir, woodcut or engraving style.

1287_house-party.jpg.People: A crowd of about a dozen painted figures in a loose ring; two large dancers in the foreground, one in a white shirt and jeans on the left, one in a purple hoodie with a high flat-top on the right, both mid-step, with a woman in a green top between them. Mostly three-quarter and full-body views, all looking toward the center dance space.
1287_house-party.jpg.Composition: The dancers frame an open circle of floor at the center, with the crowd stacked in rows behind and the heads forming a band across the middle. A yellow banner with a house-shaped outline occupies the top third, cutting the painting off with a straight horizontal edge.
1287_house-party.jpg.Medium: Visible thick brushstrokes in gouache or acrylic, with chunky blocky patches of color and faceted shading; it reads as a hand-painted canvas rather than a photograph. Flat solid yellow fills the top banner.
1287_house-party.jpg.Typography: Huge, bold condensed title across the upper half, with HOUSE in teal and PARTY in red, each letter outlined in purple with a hard offset drop shadow. It sits on the flat yellow banner above the painting and is tilted slightly up to the right; a small italic serif credit line sits at top right.
1287_house-party.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow, cobalt blue, purple, teal and coral red; lit evenly with no single light source, colors do the shading.
1287_house-party.jpg.Story it suggests: A dance-off at a packed party, with onlookers circling two rivals showing off.
1287_house-party.jpg.Visual idea: A mural-style painting of a communal dance circle under a cartoon house sign, making the poster itself feel like a party flyer.
1287_house-party.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s to early-1990s teen comedy, retouched with a contemporary fine-art painting look.

1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.People: One woman in the upper left, shown from the chest up, blonde with a curled bob, a fur wrap and a beaded strap dress, glancing sideways with a faint smile; she is large, taking about a third of the poster. Small biplanes appear as tiny shapes in the sky.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Composition: A diagonal runs from her face down through the smoke plume to a burning airship at the bottom right, with the woman and the airship at opposite corners. Biplanes are scattered around the edges, and the title sits at upper right, balancing her.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Medium: Airbrushed or oil-painted illustration with soft blended gradients and visible painterly strokes in the clouds and flames; looks like a classic hand-painted movie poster.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Typography: Large italic slab-like title, HELL'S ANGELS stacked in two lines at upper right, tilted upward, with a yellow-to-orange gradient fill and a dark offset shadow. Small credits in a cream serif and script at the bottom, in two groups.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Color and light: Deep blues and purples for the sky against hot orange and yellow flames; strong warm glow from the fire lighting the cloud edges.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Story it suggests: An aerial battle with a burning airship goes down while a glamorous woman watches from above the scene.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Visual idea: The woman is merged into the cloud and smoke, as if she hovers over the war, linking glamour with destruction.
1288_hell-s-angels.jpg.Feels like: Revival of a 1930s aviation adventure poster in a painted style.

1289_el.jpg.People: Two figures in the lower half, both seen from below: a woman on the left with short hair, looking up with a slight smile and one gloved hand pressed to her chest, and a man at right turned away, mostly a dark hulking coat and the back of his head. They stand very close, facing each other.
1289_el.jpg.Composition: Low-angle view with the two figures at the bottom, a huge bell hanging down from the top right and a dark vertical wall at left. A giant white letter shape fills the middle and slants across the frame, giving a diagonal tilt; lots of bright empty space in the center.
1289_el.jpg.Medium: Black and white film photograph with visible grain, high contrast and soft gray mid-tones, with the lettering printed as flat white and gray shapes over it.
1289_el.jpg.Typography: Enormous letters, E and L, stacked or run together diagonally, filling most of the poster; the top is cropped off by the edge. Colored white and mid gray with slightly rough, jagged edges, and the people are layered in front of them. Small serif credit line at the bottom center.
1289_el.jpg.Color and light: Strict black, white and gray; bright backlit white sky with the figures in deep shadow.
1289_el.jpg.Story it suggests: A man looms over a woman who looks up at him with unease or devotion, under a threatening bell.
1289_el.jpg.Visual idea: The title letters are built as a monumental structure that the couple stand beneath, and the bell is a looming weight over them.
1289_el.jpg.Feels like: Mid-century black-and-white art-house drama, rethought in modern graphic design.

1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.People: Two faces, both large and in profile, rendered as hollow masks with empty eye holes, a man at left and a woman at right, nose to nose. They are masks or painted casts rather than living faces, and the eyes show the red background through them.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Composition: A red rectangle with fuzzy edges floats on a black field, and the two masks face each other symmetrically in its upper two-thirds. Text stacks below the masks inside the red, with the title beneath the red rectangle on black.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Medium: Painted or airbrushed look with a fine crackle texture like cracked glaze on the masks; the red panel has soft grainy edges, like a printed or glowing slide.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Typography: Three-line orange bold sans (names) centered in the lower red area, and the blue title in bold sans on a single line below the red frame, both fairly large. Both are flat and typeset with no distortion.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Color and light: Intense red and black with pale icy blue-white masks and orange and sky blue lettering; the masks are lit flat and cool.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people face each other, empty and masked, with desire and secrecy between them.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Visual idea: Eyeless masks make the idea of the title literal: looking without seeing.
1290_eyes-wide-shut.jpg.Feels like: Late-1990s erotic psychological thriller, with an art-poster feel.

1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.People: No full person; a single jointed wooden mannequin hand fills the right and center, cupping two dice in its palm. It is an artificial hand (a mannequin or doll), not a living one, shown large and cropped by the right edge.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Composition: The hand reaches in diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, and the dice sit near the center. All the lettering is rotated to follow the same steep diagonal, so the whole poster tilts. Large black empty space surrounds the hand at the top left.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Medium: Grainy black and white film still with soft contrast and visible grain, with the lettering added in flat ink.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Typography: The title RETURN TO REASON is huge, in bright cyan, set at a steep upward angle across the lower right and cropped off at the bottom left edge by the poster boundary. Smaller film titles are in white italic type running along the same diagonal, and a cyan and white credit line sits at upper left, also rotated, so text and hand are parallel.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Color and light: Black, silvery gray and white with one vivid cyan accent; harsh single-source light on the hand against deep dark.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Story it suggests: A chance gamble: something artificial is rolling dice, and fate is being handed over.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Visual idea: Text tilted along the line of the hand so the title appears to be thrown like the dice, putting chance and rotation into the layout.
1291_return-to-reason-four-films-by-man-.Feels like: 1920s avant-garde and surrealist cinema, reworked as a modern graphic poster.

1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.People: Two people, a woman standing at left in an orange blouse and red patterned skirt, looking down while holding a glass, and a young boy crouched at the lower middle, looking straight at the viewer. Full-body to three-quarter framing; the woman is tall and the boy small beneath her.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Composition: The photo takes the left two-thirds and a yellow vertical panel with the title takes the right third, split by a thin green stripe. The woman and the boy form a descending diagonal inside a dark doorway.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Medium: Color photograph, slightly grainy, in warm saturated film tones; the title panel is flat yellow ink with a distressed, speckled, worn texture.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Typography: Very large red letters with white offset outlines, rotated 90 degrees to read bottom-to-top along the yellow panel and filling its entire height. The letters are chunky and hand-cut looking, with a scratchy, rubbed print texture, and a small white squiggle sits below. Small credit text in dark blue near the bottom.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Color and light: Warm oranges, reds and yellow with deep teal and shadowed black; soft indoor light from the side.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Story it suggests: A child sits at the feet of an adult who is lost in her own thoughts, in a cramped, dim space.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Visual idea: The vertical title strip acts like a hand-painted street sign beside a candid photo, bringing together documentary realism and a bright signboard.
1292_salaam-bombay.jpg.Feels like: 1980s social-realist drama, with a hand-painted South Asian street-sign look.

1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.People: Many painted figures and creatures: a bow-tied man in a gray suit at lower right in a large close-up with a smirk, a girl in a pink dress with hands up, a woman in a red gown, a bearded man holding a bone, a screaming man in a car at upper left, and several others, all over the picture. Also a green dinosaur, a red devil, a hairy monster, a cat and dogs. Faces are cartoon-like.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Composition: Crowded and busy with a diagonal road running from lower left to upper right; the big dinosaur and the bicycle sit in the middle and bottom, and a yellow lightning-like beam from the top leads to the title. A purple archway frames a distant scene at right.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Medium: Gouache or acrylic painting with obvious brushstrokes, flat saturated fills and wobbly outlines; naive, folk-art illustration.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Typography: Hand-lettered black brushy title in two lines, set on a yellow spike shape at the top, tilted upward to the right with irregular letter widths. Credit text in dark purple is hand-drawn on the purple arch, also tilted.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Color and light: Very bright primary colors, with sky blue, yellow, green, red and purple; flat, cheerful, no real light source.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Story it suggests: A man on a runaway adventure is chased through a bizarre landscape of monsters and oddities.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Visual idea: A crowd of absurd encounters packed into one picture, like a dream map of the trip.
1293_pee-wee-s-big-adventure.jpg.Feels like: 1980s zany comedy in the style of contemporary outsider-art illustration.

1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.People: No photographed people; tiny drawn figures appear on some cards, including a running figure, a pair of legs and a baby. Gray suit drawings stand in for bodies, and a drawn brain and foot also appear.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Composition: A grid of index cards and paper scraps pinned on a tan corkboard, in rows, with the big title block in the middle left splitting the grid into two bands. Cards are slightly tilted at different angles, with red arrows pointing in various directions.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Medium: Collage of pencil and colored-pencil drawings, cut-out vintage illustrations, ruled grid paper and torn paper pinned to a cardboard-colored board; it looks like handmade scrapbook work.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy condensed sans: DAVID BYRNE'S in red, AMERICAN in off-white, and UTOPIA in red flipped upside down, mirrored under AMERICAN. It is large, filling the left half of the middle band; small handwritten and typed labels appear on the cards, plus a cut-out label reading A SPIKE LEE JOINT.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Color and light: Muted tan, gray and cream with red accents and a few dots of blue, green and orange; flat, even lighting.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Story it suggests: A person's notes and plans for a show laid out as a puzzling set of ideas about the body, mind and uniformity.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Visual idea: A mind-map pinboard of the show's ideas, with the upside-down word showing a flipped, odd view.
1294_david-byrne-s-american-utopia.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary art-school notebook and concert-film poster.

1295_the-dead.jpg.People: No clear people; a dark vertical silhouette-like shape may be hidden in the middle, a faint standing figure formed by the dark ink blotches, but it is ambiguous.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Composition: Centered, with a vertical stack of text over an all-over pattern of pale round blots. A darker column in the center suggests a figure, and the blots are scattered evenly with the dark mass gathering toward the lower right.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Medium: Ink-and-water wash or watercolor on paper, with bleeding edges, pooled pigment and bloom spots; the texture is wet, granular and uneven.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Typography: Cream-white hand-lettered capitals with ragged, torn-looking edges. THE DEAD is big and centered across the lower middle, stacked in two lines, with a smaller JOHN HUSTON'S above. The letters look cut from paper and laid on the wash.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Color and light: Charcoal black, navy and slate gray with pale blue-gray spots and cream text; dim, cold, wintry.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Story it suggests: A quiet, cold, snowfall-like night in which the dead drift among the living.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Visual idea: The pale spots work as falling snow and as ghosts at once, and the dark central shape makes a hidden figure.
1295_the-dead.jpg.Feels like: Hand-made, literary period drama with a ghostly, wintry feel.

1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.People: Several small photo panels show people: a figure in a yellow shirt wearing a horse mask, a long line of robed people facing each other across a dry stream, a close-up of a man's face in red light, and two tiny figures in a barren orange landscape. The people in the panels range from close-up face to crowd to tiny figures.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Composition: A collage-like layout of four film-still rectangles on a cream page: stills stack down the left side with different widths, and the title and a film list occupy the right and lower right. A large circular seal sits at bottom right, balancing the photos at upper left.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Medium: Color film stills in warm, grainy film tones set on flat cream paper; the seal and type are flat yellow and black ink.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Typography: Title in a tall, thin condensed yellow sans at right, stacked on four lines, roughly a quarter of the poster height. Below, a list of four films in black condensed sans with small yellow bullets, and a circular yellow badge with text running around a globe and a big number 5. All typeset, orderly and straight.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Color and light: Cream background with yellow-orange type, teal-green logo and strip, blue sky and rust-orange photographic tones.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Story it suggests: A curated program of four films from different places, with scenes of ritual, desert and landscape.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Visual idea: A catalog page of stills and a stamp-like emblem, suggesting an archive or museum program.
1296_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Feels like: Modern museum or festival program in an international-archive style.

1297_captain-blood.jpg.People: One swashbuckler in a feathered hat and dark coat, shown full figure and large, standing with one boot raised on a ship's rail, sword out in his right hand and the left hand open; smiling and looking at the viewer.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Composition: A strong low-angle diagonal: the ship's mast on the left, rigging lines slanting up, and the man in the center and right. The title is stacked at upper right, aligned with the sky and clouds, with credits running down along the right edge.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Medium: Gouache or oil painting with smooth blended color and visible brush texture, like a vintage illustrated poster.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Typography: Big red hand-drawn, tall outline capitals for CAPTAIN BLOOD stacked on two lines at upper right, slightly overlapping the hat and hand. Smaller red lettering below in a mix of script and capitals, right-aligned and set around the figure.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Color and light: Sky blue and cream clouds against olive green, brown and gray costume tones, with red type; bright, warm daylight.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Story it suggests: A confident pirate captain poses mid-swagger, ready for a duel on deck.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Visual idea: The figure stands on the ship's rail like a monument, with the red title working as a flag against the sky.
1297_captain-blood.jpg.Feels like: 1930s Hollywood swashbuckler poster, in a painted adventure style.

1298_birth.jpg.People: One woman's face in an extreme close-up, filling the whole poster from forehead to lips, staring directly at the viewer with pale blue eyes and a neutral, unsettled expression.
1298_birth.jpg.Composition: Dead-center, symmetrical, with the eyes at the upper third, the nose in the middle and the lips cropped at the bottom edge by the title. The face is cut by the frame on every side.
1298_birth.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with fine film grain, soft skin texture and shallow depth of field; realistic, slightly desaturated.
1298_birth.jpg.Typography: Big white elegant flowing script title set over the lips at the lower middle, roughly a fifth of the poster width, with thin small capital credit lines centered below. The title sits directly on the mouth, so the words seem to come from it.
1298_birth.jpg.Color and light: Warm muted skin tones, soft pinks and browns with pale blue eyes; soft, dim, low-key light.
1298_birth.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman stares, silent and shaken, as if she has just seen or heard something impossible.
1298_birth.jpg.Visual idea: Face as landscape: the eyes confront the viewer while the title appears over her mouth.
1298_birth.jpg.Feels like: 2000s quiet psychological drama, intimate and uneasy.

1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.People: Two men in a prison cell: one in a pale blue shirt and jeans sitting on a bed edge, bearded, looking down at a plate of food; the other lying on his side in a flowery shirt, head on his arm, looking toward the viewer. Both are full to three-quarter figures in the lower half, side by side.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Composition: A low wall and bed run across the lower middle, with the two men in a stepped arrangement and a tall gray wall above. The title sits in the upper wall area over a drawn spider web, and a beam of light comes from the upper left.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Medium: A digitally painted, composited scene mixing photographic realism with painted shading; the web and wall are rough gray plaster, and the colors are partly desaturated except for the floral shirt.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Typography: White art-deco-style script and capitals, with the title in two lines, tilted slightly up to the right and inside quotation marks, drawn over a spider web. Smaller credits are plain white capitals with a script lead-in, and a bit of the web passes behind the letters.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Color and light: Smoky grays and browns with a pop of floral orange and teal on one shirt; a dusty shaft of light from the upper left and a tiny candle flame.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: Two cellmates sharing a cramped space, one withdrawn and eating while the other watches him.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Visual idea: A spider web on the cell wall behind them hints at entrapment and the pair caught together.
1299_kiss-of-the-spider-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1980s prison drama, with an old-movie-title look.

1300_network.jpg.People: One black silhouette of a figure with arms and legs spread wide in the middle of a cracked television screen, ambiguous and faceless. A dollar bill's portrait face is visible behind the cracks.
1300_network.jpg.Composition: Symmetrical and centered: a stack of repeating title words in perspective rises above a retro TV set in the bottom half. The TV is a frame-within-frame, with the figure at its middle, and its side panel holds credits and dials.
1300_network.jpg.Medium: Flat solid-ink screenprint look with coarse stipple grain and spray-like noise fading the lower title lines; the dollar image is a greenish engraving texture inside the screen.
1300_network.jpg.Typography: A huge black condensed NETWORK repeated five times, stacked and in perspective, the top rows cropped at the edges and the lower rows dissolving into speckled gradient fade, like a signal receding. Small black and yellow credit text sits next to the TV in a compact condensed face. It is typeset and graphic.
1300_network.jpg.Color and light: Saturated mustard yellow with black, cream and muted money green; flat, graphic, with no real light source.
1300_network.jpg.Story it suggests: A figure is trapped or shattered inside a TV screen over a banknote, so media and money crack someone apart.
1300_network.jpg.Visual idea: Money seen through broken glass, with the repeated title as broadcast echo, merges television, cash and a fractured person into one image.
1300_network.jpg.Feels like: 1970s satirical drama, in the look of a bold retro screenprint poster.

1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.People: One man in a suit and tie sits on a patterned sofa, facing the viewer with a stern, flat expression, shown as a full torso and legs. He is centered and fairly large, while the top of his head nearly touches the title text.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Composition: A strict centered, symmetrical arrangement: title at the top on a blank cream field, the man in the middle, and a low coffee table with an ashtray and magazines across the bottom. Large empty space is above his head, and the lines of the sofa run horizontally.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Medium: A monochrome illustration made with pencil, charcoal or airbrush shading and a photographic feel; soft gradients, textured fabrics and slightly rough edges on a creamy paper tone.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Typography: Huge condensed gray sans capitals stacked on three lines at the top, filling about a third of the height and centered. The letters are flat, solid and a bit worn; a small white bold line of credit sits at the bottom center.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Color and light: Gray and cream, a nearly monochrome tonal range; flat, even, subdued light with a darker side on the right.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Story it suggests: A man sits still and alone in a living room, present but somehow absent.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Visual idea: The title and the empty space above his head make him look small and unnoticed, a pun on absence.
1301_the-man-who-wasn-t-there.jpg.Feels like: Late-1940s noir and magazine illustration, in a restrained retro style.

1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.People: No living people; the bones are animal bones and skulls (cattle-like), so a human presence is only implied through the arrangement.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Composition: A symmetrical, rectangular, ornamental layout seen from above: two rows of skulls at top and bottom, spine columns down each side, bone patterns in two bands and a central crescent made of jaws and ribs with four cross-shaped vertebrae around it. It reads like a woven rug or a ritual pattern.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Medium: A photograph of real bones on cracked dry earth, tinted in blue and violet; fine grain and a dark vignette.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Typography: A small credit at the top and a title in grey-white heavy condensed capitals at the bottom, left-aligned on a single line, slightly condensed with some letters overlapping. Moderately small, with the layout leaving the pattern dominant.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Color and light: Deep indigo, violet and black with pale blue-white bones; cold, dim, moonlit feel.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Story it suggests: A buried history of death arranged with care, like a grave offering.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Visual idea: Bones arranged as a textile pattern and a crescent moon, turning remains into ornament.
1302_killers-of-the-flower-moon.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary prestige-drama poster, with folk-craft and forensic overtones.

1303_testament.jpg.People: None visible; a vague, very faint hint of vertical shapes near the top might be figures or trees, but nothing is clear.
1303_testament.jpg.Composition: A white page with a thin gray rectangular border, a framed panel inside, and a vertical gradient from near white at the top to dark gray at the bottom. The title is packed at the bottom of the panel, and a credit line sits below the frame, with an enormous empty field above.
1303_testament.jpg.Medium: A smooth gradient with fine film grain or noise and no visible detail; printed flat with a slight photographic fog.
1303_testament.jpg.Typography: Wide-tracked white serif capitals TESTAMENT spread across the full width at the bottom of the gray panel, about a tenth of the height. A small gray serif credit line sits below the frame; everything is typeset and straight.
1303_testament.jpg.Color and light: White, light gray and charcoal only; a hazy, foggy light that darkens toward the bottom.
1303_testament.jpg.Story it suggests: Something fades out, like a fog or ash cloud, leaving a blank, silent stillness.
1303_testament.jpg.Visual idea: An almost blank gradient frame stands for erasure or fading, with the title sitting where the darkness is heaviest.
1303_testament.jpg.Feels like: 1980s quiet, bleak drama, in a minimal modern layout.

1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.People: One large square close-up of two faces pressed cheek to cheek, a woman's face in the foreground with eyes closed and a man's nose and partial face at lower left. Two small strips at the bottom show a man in profile (left) and a woman smiling behind a fur collar and a gloved hand (right).
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Composition: A muted red field with a large centered square photo, the title below it and a split two-panel strip of stills along the bottom edge. A handwritten signature line crosses the lower-left corner of the photo, so photo, title and strip stack vertically.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Medium: The big photo is a grainy sepia-toned film still with soft contrast; the lower strip is color and cool-toned film frames; the field is flat matte ink.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Typography: Names in small black bold sans capitals at the top; a title in cream bold geometric sans capitals on one line below the photo, about a third of the poster width; and a black handwritten script credit overlapping the photo's lower-left edge. All typeset except the script.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Color and light: Brick red with warm sepia, cream, and cold blue-black and green in the bottom panels; soft, diffused natural light.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Story it suggests: A tender, quiet closeness between two people, with other moments showing each alone.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Visual idea: The two faces merge into one image in the middle while the bottom strip shows them apart, a before-and-after of togetherness.
1304_a-man-and-a-woman.jpg.Feels like: 1960s French romance, in a modern minimalist layout.

1305_the-blade.jpg.People: One male fighter, large, taking up most of the poster, in a wide crouching lunge with a scarred face looking out, holding a cleaver-like blade up with a chain trailing; long dark robes whip around him. Full-body figure, shown in action.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Composition: A strong central figure with a diagonal sweep: the arm and blade rise to upper right and the robe flares to the left and right, forming a pinwheel. Red slashes radiate outward from the center, and the white space around them keeps the pose in contrast.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration with rough ink and gouache-like brush marks, flat shapes and dry-brush red splatter; the figure has a slightly cel-shaded, painted look on a white ground.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Typography: A big red single Chinese character (the title in glyph form) sits at the center on his torso, with the English title THE BLADE in widely spaced white capitals across it, partly overlapping the character and the robe. The credit at the bottom is small bold black capitals, centered.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Color and light: Stark white, black and brown with vivid red slashes; flat graphic light with no soft shadows.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Story it suggests: A scarred swordsman mid-strike, with the air itself slashed open.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Visual idea: The red character acts as a cut through the figure, with red slashes echoing the blade's motion.
1305_the-blade.jpg.Feels like: 1990s martial-arts action, in a modern ink-brush comic style.

1306_point-blank.jpg.People: One older man, large at right, head thrown back and face tilted up with a grimace, wearing dark clothes and a white collar, cut out against the cream background. To the left, four tall vertical strips repeat his face in green, yellow, blue and red, showing him gripping his hair and shouting.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Composition: Left and right halves: four rounded-edge vertical bars in a stepped fan on the left, and the cutout figure and the stacked title at the lower right. The strips overlap like a color-separation sequence and step toward the figure.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Medium: Halftone or posterized photographic cutouts with flat spot-color tints, in a screenprint-like look; the right figure is a high-contrast black-and-white photo with a pinkish skin tint.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Typography: Name and title in huge heavy sans capitals stacked in four lines at lower right: LEE MARVIN in peach, POINT BLANK in red, with a small black-on-peach credit line. The text runs along the figure's coat, on the same vertical axis as the strips.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Color and light: Cream background with red, yellow, blue and green tinted strips and black; flat graphic color, harsh contrast.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Story it suggests: A man in violent anguish, his rage and pain repeated over and over.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Visual idea: Color-separation strips repeat his scream like an echo or a stuttering film frame, shifting from one tint to the next.
1306_point-blank.jpg.Feels like: 1960s crime thriller, with a mod pop-art graphic style.

1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.People: Two figures in a painted street mural scene: a large mural-style face of a man in a dark cap and round glasses at the left, and a standing man in a cap, glasses and a dark T-shirt at the right, looking off to the side. Both are painted; the face is cropped from the chest up and the standing man is three-quarter length.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Composition: A street scene with a red stop sign tilted in the lower left foreground, a gray wall with the mural in the middle, and a car across the bottom, in front of a red-brick wall. The sky fills the top third, and the title block is right-aligned in the sky.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Medium: Digital painting with visible brushwork and a painterly, semi-realistic style, with dripping, textured sky and a gritty street finish.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Typography: Title block in cream typewriter-style capitals right-aligned at the top, with a fancy blackletter-style line over a thin rule and three film names below, spaced widely; the type sits in the sky. One small black bar-over sign on the cap is part of the picture.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Color and light: Blazing orange-red sunset sky, warm browns, a silvery car and a red stop sign; low, glowing evening light.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Story it suggests: A neighborhood at dusk, with young men watched over by a giant portrait on the wall.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Visual idea: A mural of the characters on a street wall, so the neighborhood itself holds the portrait, with the stop sign at the edge.
1307_john-singletons-hood-trilogy.jpg.Feels like: Early 1990s urban drama, repainted as a contemporary street scene.

1308_body-heat.jpg.People: Two figures in an embrace, a man leaning over a woman who is reclined backward, with her hand touching his shoulder and his hand holding a revolver pointing down; both are half to three-quarter body and tilted, with the man's head near the center top.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Composition: A big glowing disc (sun or moon) sits behind the pair, with their bodies forming a diagonal. Diagonal horizontal bands of red and black like venetian-blind shadows cross the whole image, and the title sits at the bottom.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Medium: Heavily color-processed photograph with a gradient-map look: grainy, posterized, with fluorescent tones and striped light.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Typography: A widely spaced, thin yellow sans title across the bottom, about a tenth of the height, with the letters separated by large gaps; a small credit line in pale lavender at the top center. All typeset, quiet beside the strong image.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Color and light: Hot orange, magenta and red against deep blue and black; hard stripes of light as if through blinds.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Story it suggests: Two lovers in a hot, sticky affair, with a gun between them.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Visual idea: The thermal color palette and blind-stripe shadows make heat and secrecy visible, and the gun hangs low in the frame.
1308_body-heat.jpg.Feels like: Early 1980s erotic neo-noir, redone in a neon, synthwave-like palette.

1309_the-delta.jpg.People: Two young men walking through a field in the lower third, one in a white V-neck shirt looking down at his hands and one in a dark sweater looking sideways; small in the frame, three-quarter figures.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Composition: The image is split horizontally: a cream textured top with the title, a hazy mountain ridge, a wide empty hazy middle and the two men with green plants at the bottom. The torn-paper mountain edge cuts across behind the title.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Medium: Grainy, washed-out film photograph with soft focus and heavy noise, paired with a flat pastel pink title on a plaster-like textured cream paper at the top.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Typography: Lowercase chunky rounded sans title in salmon pink, stacked in two lines, large at the upper middle and overlapping the mountain edge; a small monospace credit line in brown at its right. Typeset, soft and friendly, with no distortion.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Color and light: Pale greens, yellow-greens, cream and salmon pink; hazy, overexposed morning light.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Story it suggests: Two young men wander through crops in a quiet, hazy countryside, each in his own thoughts.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Visual idea: The faded photo and torn-paper edge give a sense of memory, and the empty haze makes the two men small and slightly lost.
1309_the-delta.jpg.Feels like: 1990s low-budget indie drama, with a soft zine-like layout.
