1310_fresh-kill.jpg.People: Two women, filling the upper half in large close-ups: one at left in profile with reddish-brown hair, the other at right facing forward in a dark hat with green eye makeup and curly hair. They are close but not touching, and the profile one looks toward the other.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Composition: The two faces fill the top half side by side; a neon-green lip-shaped outline holds the title in the lower middle. Orange fish are strewn around the corners and edges, and a small credit sits between the faces and the lips.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Medium: A digital collage with video-scanline and glitch effects, a green-tinted screen texture, photographic cutouts of fish and faces, and a neon glow effect for the lips.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Typography: The title is hand-drawn like neon tubing in glowing lime green inside a big outlined lip shape, tilted slightly, with a dollar-sign-like S in 'Fresh'. A small white stacked credit sits above it in a heavy block sans, with 'A film by' in tiny type.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Color and light: Acid green and black with orange-red fish and skin tones; a glowing neon and a flickering screen light.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women stare out in a toxic, glowing city, with something fishy and dangerous around them.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Visual idea: A neon mouth with the title in it, surrounded by fish, ties together a body, a sign and the film's sea creatures in one pop-collage.
1310_fresh-kill.jpg.Feels like: 1990s queer indie and punk zine, in a glitch and neon style.

1311_sentimental-value.jpg.People: Two small figures shown only from behind in two screen-like insets at the right: a woman with a bun and a headset-like wire in a blue dress (upper right) and an older gray-haired man's head and shoulders (lower right). Both are drawn from the back, faceless, and cropped in boxes. Tiny silhouettes also appear in a window of the house.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Composition: A large, flat two-story wooden house fills the left half in side view, with a bare tree and a snowy yard on the right. The two rectangular insets overlap the tree trunk at upper and lower right, and the title crosses the middle right between them.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Medium: Flat vector-like illustration with clean ink outlines, flat color fills and grain-textured gradients for the fog; a modern editorial, children's-book-like style.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Typography: Thin, tall hand-drawn lowercase letters in white, with the title 'sentimental value' on one line across the right middle, slightly overlapping the tree and the inset boxes. Small handwritten credit lines in white below it. Delicate and low-key, the title about a third of the poster width.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Color and light: Cool pale blue-gray sky with maroon and rust-red house, a green fence and white snow; soft, overcast winter light.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Story it suggests: A family house in winter holds memories, while two people look away from each other, seen from behind.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Visual idea: The house is a central character, and the two back-turned figures in windows suggest a screen or a stage for family distance.
1311_sentimental-value.jpg.Feels like: Contemporary Scandinavian art-house family drama, in an illustrated, quiet style.

1312_lenny.jpg.People: One man in profile, shown as a black silhouette, holding a microphone in his hand and standing in a cone of spotlight; full figure, mid-size, with an empty mic stand behind.
1312_lenny.jpg.Composition: A diagonal beam of white light sweeps from the top right to bottom left, with the figure at the center-right; the poster has a thin white border frame and the title at the upper left.
1312_lenny.jpg.Medium: Very high-contrast grainy black-and-white photograph, nearly pure white and black.
1312_lenny.jpg.Typography: Bold serif title lines, 'Dustin Hoffman' and 'Lenny' in quotation marks and 'A Bob Fosse Film' in white, tight and centered at the upper left, in the dark area; typeset and classic.
1312_lenny.jpg.Color and light: Pure black and white; hard spotlight, glare with grain.
1312_lenny.jpg.Story it suggests: A performer stands alone on a stage in a hot spotlight, mic in hand.
1312_lenny.jpg.Visual idea: The performer reduced to a silhouette, the spotlight as the true shape of the image.
1312_lenny.jpg.Feels like: 1970s nightclub, a documentary-style black-and-white stage photo.

1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.People: A large crowd of painted figures: a boy in a red coat and turban with a tear on his cheek at the bottom center; a crowned king in a leopard-print robe holding a book on a throne at the center top, with a man in a suit behind him; a skeleton-faced figure with arms outstretched and a candle on her head in the middle; and many protestors with raised fists, signs and ribbons on both sides. Mostly full and half-body figures.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Composition: Symmetrical, with a one-point perspective runway of stairs or rails leading up to the throne under a gate-like frame, and the crowd streaming in from both sides along the diagonals. The boy's face is at the bottom center, the skeleton is at mid-center and the king at the top center, a strong vertical axis.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Medium: Hand-drawn ink and gouache illustration, with bold black outlines, hatching and flat color fills with a rough, woodcut or screenprint quality; a thick orange frame with a scribbled texture surrounds it.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Typography: Hand-lettered title in wavy outlined capitals at the top: WEST INDIES in teal and yellow with a red outline and shadow, set slightly tilted, and a smaller subtitle on the gate's crossbeam in dark red caps. A small credit line is at the very top; all of it is part of the drawing.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Color and light: Hot orange-red, yellow and cream with black and teal accents; flat theatrical light and a warm glow like firelight.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Story it suggests: A festival or revolt in which a crowd marches against a throne ruled by a king and a ghostly figure of death.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Visual idea: The poster is staged like a grand carnival procession or stage set, with royalty on high, death in the middle and the weeping boy as the witness in front.
1313_west-indies-the-fugitive-slaves-of-.Feels like: 1970s political musical and Caribbean carnival, in a comic-book and protest-poster style.

1314_high-art.jpg.People: Two women lying close in bed, in a snapshot-like photo: a dark-haired woman behind with her face pressed to the other's neck, and a blonde woman in front with green eyes looking at the viewer. Both are bare-shouldered, half-body, and tangled together.
1314_high-art.jpg.Composition: A tilted white-bordered photo print, rotated clockwise, sits across the lower two-thirds on a pale blue-gray background; the title brushes across the top and runs off the page. The two faces are in the middle, and the diagonal of the tilted print gives a loose, casual feel.
1314_high-art.jpg.Medium: A color snapshot photo with soft, slightly faded tones and a white instant-print border, laid over a smooth, pale gradient background; the title is done in dry ink brush.
1314_high-art.jpg.Typography: Giant black hand-painted brush letters spelling 'High Art', stretching across the top and cut off at the right edge, with rough, dry strokes and uneven spacing. A smaller handwritten credit line at lower right, also black marker, tilted slightly.
1314_high-art.jpg.Color and light: Pale blues and creams with warm skin tones, a dark hair accent and small red flowers; soft, diffuse daylight from a window.
1314_high-art.jpg.Story it suggests: Two women share an intimate, wary moment in a bedroom, one drawn close and the other looking out cautiously.
1314_high-art.jpg.Visual idea: A personal photograph stuck onto the page with a hurried handwritten title, as if the film were a keepsake from someone's private life.
1314_high-art.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American indie drama, in a diary or zine style.

1315_hairspray.jpg.People: Nine cut-out head shots scattered around the poster: a smiling girl with a big dark bouffant and a white bow at upper left, a drag-style face with a red beehive at upper right, and a row of seven more at the bottom including a mustached man, a woman with a white bouffant, a blonde woman with a big beehive, an older mustached man and a blonde girl. All are heads only, no bodies, pasted like cut-outs.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Composition: A bright yellow ground fills the space, with the giant title across the middle, the two big heads above and a row of smaller heads below. Cream star shapes, pink and blue asterisks and pink rays fill the gaps, and name banners are attached to each face.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Medium: Flat graphic collage with halftone-printed photo cutouts, flat spot-color banners and a mid-century sticker style, like an old magazine ad or a record sleeve.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Typography: A huge title in tall, rounded, slightly uneven teal-blue letters across the middle with a dotted 'i', plus a smaller magenta script credit above it. Names on pink and blue banners in cream and dark bold sans, each set at a slight tilt and attached to a head, about eight separate lettering pieces.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow with pink, cornflower blue and cream; flat, cheery, no real light.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Story it suggests: A big, loud ensemble in hairdos and costumes, all celebrating in a teen dance party.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Visual idea: The hairdos are the stars: each head is cut out like a sticker so the hair volume reads as the hero.
1315_hairspray.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s teen pop and dance show, remade as a camp, retro sticker-sheet collage.

1316_desperate-living.jpg.People: None. A dead rat served on a dinner plate stands in for a figure.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Composition: Top-down view of a formal place setting on black: plate with the rat in the lower center, forks at the left, knife and spoon at the right, two wine glasses and a small dish above, with a roses bouquet cropped at the upper left. Title at the upper right balances the flowers.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Medium: Glossy studio photograph with sharp detail, with the figure cut out against a flat black background, in a staged still life.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Typography: Elegant white calligraphic script title, two lines, slanted with long swashes, filling about 45 percent of the width at the upper right; a small bold serif possessive credit above. Typeset like a wedding invitation, which contrasts with the rat.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Color and light: Black, cream plate with gold rim, red roses, yellow lemon; bright, even studio light.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Story it suggests: A fancy dinner is served with something horrible, a grotesque joke on refinement.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Visual idea: A formal table setting as the frame for a dead rodent, as polite surface and filth.
1316_desperate-living.jpg.Feels like: 1970s trash comedy dressed up in luxurious stationery.

1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.People: Five people pushing a white van from behind, seen from above: a woman in a white wedding dress and veil among four men, all small in the middle of the poster and bent forward in a line. Other people appear as tiny parts of cars and a motorbike rider at the left edge.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Composition: A high, overhead view of an asphalt road with a white van heading toward the upper left, and the pushers in a diagonal row at its back. Lane markings run diagonally across, and the title stacks in the rest of the space on three lines, wrapping around the van from upper right to lower left. A thin yellow-green frame borders the poster.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Medium: A color photographic frame from above with a soft, slightly muted, natural look; the type is flat, matte ink in a single chartreuse color.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Typography: Very large, tall, condensed high-contrast serif letters in mustard-chartreuse that stack across the whole poster and almost touch the figures; 'IT WAS JUST' at upper right, 'AN' at left and 'ACCIDENT' across the bottom, with parts of letters over the van and road. A small credit in the same color at lower left. The title surrounds the action.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Color and light: Gray asphalt, white vehicles and chartreuse type with a mustard frame, with a touch of green leaves; flat, overcast daylight.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Story it suggests: An everyday breakdown in traffic where a bride and some men push a stalled van together.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Visual idea: The letters frame the small, heroic push, and the same chartreuse for border and type ties the whole poster together.
1317_it-was-just-an-accident.jpg.Feels like: 2020s Iranian social-realist drama, in a clean, modern typographic style.

1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.People: A diner scene with about six people: a woman in a pink uniform with a white headband leaning on the counter at the right and looking sideways, a waitress in pink standing behind the counter, a man in a cream cowboy hat and glasses eating at left, and a few more diners in the background and at the left edge. They are mostly half-body, with the counter as a long line.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Composition: A long diner counter runs on a strong diagonal from the lower right to the upper left, with condiments, plates and cake stands lined along it and the two waitresses at the far end. The photo fills the upper two-thirds, and a plain cream band holds the title text at the bottom.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Medium: A color film still with natural grain and slightly faded 1970s film tones; the lower band is a flat cream field.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy dark-brown italic sans capitals stacked on four lines at the lower right, quite large; the cast names are in thin golden-yellow capitals at the left, with a small 'in' in between. Small credits sit below in two lines. Typeset and aligned across the band.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Color and light: Cream, mustard yellow, soft pink and brown with red ketchup accents; warm daylight through windows.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Story it suggests: A tired waitress leans on the counter at work, lost in thought while the diners eat.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Visual idea: The counter leads the eye to the woman at the end, the quiet center of a busy room.
1318_alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American slice-of-life road drama, in a faded-film look.

1319_hud.jpg.People: Three men in black and white: a blurred large man in the right foreground, cropped to a hat brim, his lowered face and a shirt, a cowboy in a straw hat standing in the middle looking toward the viewer with a hand in his pocket, and a small young man walking at left in the distance. Different scales, near to far, in a diagonal line.
1319_hud.jpg.Composition: A staggered stack of three figures, from big and blurred at right to small and sharp at left, plus a giant title stacked on the left and top. The white lettering at the top is cut off by the poster edge, and the foreground man's hat is cut off at the top right.
1319_hud.jpg.Medium: High-contrast black-and-white photograph with film grain and bleached highlights; the sky and ground are blown out to near white.
1319_hud.jpg.Typography: Very large, bold condensed white sans capitals reading 'PAUL NEWMAN' across the top, stacked on two lines and cut off by the top edge; a small italic 'is' and the title in quotation marks, 'HUD', in a heavy dark gray at the left middle. Small credit lines in white at upper left, all overlapping the sky and the figures.
1319_hud.jpg.Color and light: Pure black, white and gray; harsh, bright sunlight with bleached sky.
1319_hud.jpg.Story it suggests: A swaggering cowboy faces a hard, grim older man while a younger one watches from afar.
1319_hud.jpg.Visual idea: Three generations or attitudes set in depth, with the nearest man blurred and the star letters towering over the scene.
1319_hud.jpg.Feels like: Early 1960s modern Western drama, in a classic black-and-white star-poster look.

1320_the-crying-game.jpg.People: Two figures, drawn large at half-body scale: a woman in profile bowed forward at left and a man facing the viewer at right, heads close together. Both are ink-wash drawings, not photographs; a pale hat or coat hanging on a hook at upper right is a ghostly white shape.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Composition: Faces cluster in the lower-middle of the upper two-thirds, with the woman's head overlapping the man's shoulder in a diagonal lean. A loose scribble of gold and sketched lines fills the top left, and a large empty cream area at the bottom carries the title on the right.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Medium: Watercolor and ink wash on cream paper, with blotchy bleeds, drips (one runs down from the woman's dark garment) and fine pen outline. Gold mottled texture suggests wallpaper or dappled foil.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Typography: Title in gold, hand-brushed, stacked on three lines with large capitals, slanted and set at lower right at roughly a quarter of the poster height. A small italic serif credit line sits at lower left in gray-blue; the lettering sits in the empty cream space beside the figures.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Color and light: Muted slate blue-gray and ochre gold on warm cream; soft diffuse light like a gray daylight interior.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Story it suggests: Two people lean close in quiet intimacy, with something unspoken between them.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Visual idea: Faces rendered as watery smudges so the characters feel half-dissolved, as if seen through tears; the title is written like a handwritten note.
1320_the-crying-game.jpg.Feels like: Literary art-house drama, 1990s memory, hand-illustrated Criterion style of the 2020s.

1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.People: Two figures in the lower third: a bare-backed man seated and turned over his shoulder, and a woman reclining in a white wrap who looks out at the viewer. Both are painted, at roughly half-body scale, and are intertwined in a languid pose.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Composition: Huge stacked title fills the upper two-thirds while the couple sits low on a diagonal shoreline strip that rises to the right. The man's head overlaps the bottom of the word YOUTH, tying figures to letters.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Medium: Flat digital gouache or painted illustration with speckled spatter texture on the yellow field, soft brush edges on the skin and cloth.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Typography: Enormous red-orange serif capitals, stacked CRUEL / STORY / YOUTH with a tiny italic 'of' tucked inside the O of YOU, filling nearly the whole width. The man's head and shoulders overlap and cut the word, so the title appears behind the figures. Small credit in yellow-orange at bottom right.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Color and light: Saturated yellow-orange sky with a faint sun at top left, brick red type, violet and navy ground, a pink stripe of fence or pier.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Story it suggests: A young couple lies together on a dark shore beneath a blazing sky, seemingly relaxed but with an uneasy edge in her sidelong look.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Visual idea: Title as a monumental wall that dwarfs the lovers, with the sun-yellow field suggesting heat and impulse.
1321_cruel-story-of-youth.jpg.Feels like: Japanese New Wave romance and youth drama, reimagined with a 1960s-meets-contemporary illustrated look.

1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.People: Many people across about a dozen photo cutouts: a woman smoking, a dancing woman on yellow, a man and child with a boom mic, two men dancing, a woman in pink in a crowd, a child, a couple in a corridor, and a dog. Mostly half-body or medium shots, with a few non-human objects (red shoes, camera, burning car).
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Composition: Collage grid of irregular rectangles and torn blob-shaped cutouts on light gray, no single center. Text runs along top, bottom, and vertically on both sides, framing the images.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Medium: Photographic film stills, color and black-and-white, some with torn paper edges, cut out against a flat pale gray ground like a scrapbook.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Typography: Thin white sans-serif capitals; a headline across the top, a film list across the bottom, and vertical repeated lines of 'THE FILMS OF MIKE MILLS' running up and down the left and right sides, overlapping the photos. Soft rainbow glow halos blur behind some letters; the white type is hard to read against light areas.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Color and light: Pale gray ground with pops of red, mustard yellow, blue and pink; natural everyday light, with a fiery orange car as a hot accent.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Story it suggests: A set of ordinary lives and small tender moments, with a burning car hinting at disruption.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Visual idea: A personal scrapbook or contact sheet of memories, with the title lines wrapping around the images like a frame.
1322_ill-remind-you-of-everything-the-fi.Feels like: Indie film retrospective box set, 2020s, zine-like collage.

1323_little-odessa.jpg.People: Four to five silhouetted figures at the bottom: two larger men standing in the foreground (one at left holding something low in his hand) and smaller heads clustered between them. All are shown as full-body or half-body dark shapes seen from behind or the side.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Composition: Figures sit in the bottom third, under a large empty dark wall; the title spans the center in two widely spaced lines, with a row of five names above. A bare thin tree rises beside the left figure.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with film grain and heavy shadow, the wall surface streaked and stained. Title type is chipped and worn.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Typography: Red blocky, stencil-like capitals; LITTLE on one line and ODESSA stretched wide across the full width with big gaps between letters. Lettering has a scuffed texture and sits in the middle, above the figures. Five cast names in small pale blue-gray spaced capitals above, credit at the bottom.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Color and light: Deep teal-blue night with near-black shadows, dull red title; cold moonlit or industrial light, backlit figures.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Story it suggests: A small group stands in the dark outside a looming wall, facing something unseen and waiting.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Visual idea: Title in Cyrillic-like block capitals evoking the Russian-immigrant theme; the figures dwarfed by the wall.
1323_little-odessa.jpg.Feels like: 1990s American crime drama, moody and bleak, gritty neo-noir.

1324_american-dream.jpg.People: Dozens of people in about a dozen film-frame panels: protesters with signs, a woman handing out meat, a speaker at a podium, police pulling a woman, masked figures in parkas. Mostly medium shots and close-ups of ordinary working people, crowds, shouts.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Composition: Top half is a mosaic of rectangular frames of varied sizes separated by black gutters, with a few large central frames. The bottom half is solid black with huge stacked title and credit.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Medium: Photographic stills from film, grainy 16mm-like with faded color, each framed by dark borders with rounded corners like film cells.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Typography: Giant condensed sans-serif title in coral red, stacked AMERICAN / DREAM and filling the full width and about a third of the height, flush left. Credit 'A FILM BY BARBARA KOPPLE' in the same red at lower right, bold and stacked, placed in the gap beside the second word.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Color and light: Black ground with coral-red type; the frames show warm faded 1980s color, winter daylight, harsh night, flat news-footage light.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Story it suggests: Workers on a picket line clash with authority, rallying under signs in cold weather.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Visual idea: A contact-sheet mosaic of struggle, with the slogan-like title standing over it as protest placard.
1324_american-dream.jpg.Feels like: Documentary about labor protest, 1980s newsreel energy, political poster.

1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.People: One large head and shoulders of a bearded man, looking down at an angle, fills the center; smaller figures appear in fragments within his body: a man with red clothing, a face lower right, a woman at lower left. The big figure is made of torn paper and photographic scraps.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Composition: Large central figure, with its head near the middle and the body spreading down; a torn corner at top left with a yellow-ringed logo, a cassette tape at lower right, and title block in the upper right. Dense layering with overlapping collage.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Medium: Torn-paper collage with newspaper clippings, handwritten ID forms, halftone dots in the face, paper grain and ripped edges; a brownish aged-print feel.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Typography: Title in gold-yellow heavy italic serif with a dark drop shadow, stacked two lines at upper right at about a fifth of the poster's width, with director names in small serif capitals inside thin boxes above and below. Vertical black stencil lettering 'PERNAMBUCO' runs up along the left. Text on the collage itself is cropped and layered.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Color and light: Dark brown and sepia with cream newsprint, spots of orange-red and mustard yellow; warm, aged, muted light.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Story it suggests: A man hides in or is built from the records and press about him: a surveillance or identity-file feel of someone being tracked.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Visual idea: The man's body is literally assembled from documents and news, as if he is a dossier.
1325_the-secret-agent.jpg.Feels like: 1970s political thriller, archival collage, dictatorship-era files, modern craft poster.

1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.People: No people apart from an abstract eye shape: a yellow cut-paper eye with black lids at lower right looks outward from the white strokes. Possibly a face or a hand reading, but ambiguous.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Composition: Big red blob top, white brush strokes below, dark navy ground; the title list is stacked at left over the red, and the yellow eye sits low right with a green ribbon and yellow dot streaking in from the top right like a comet. Diagonal from upper right to lower left.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Medium: Gouache or ink on paper with brushed edges, cut-paper collage elements, visible paper grain. Flat opaque ink.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Typography: Three film titles stacked in yellow serif capitals at left, each about a tenth of the height, tightly set and overlapping the red and white shapes. Last line 'THE LOVERS ON THE BRIDGE' sits over the white and blurs into it. Small 'THREE FILMS BY LEOS CARAX' at bottom left.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Color and light: Strong red, white, and yellow on deep navy, with a green accent; flat, high-contrast, no real light source.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Story it suggests: A comet of green and yellow streaks toward a watching eye, hinting at love, danger, and being seen.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Visual idea: Abstract painted shapes standing in for a tricolor flag and a single eye, a poetic rather than literal summary.
1326_three-films-by-leos-carax.jpg.Feels like: French art-house, 1980s romantic and avant-garde, painterly modern collage.

1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.People: One man in half-body, in profile, head bowed and cigarette at his lips, wearing dark glasses and a tweed jacket; behind him a wall of pinned portrait photographs of women and men, including one clearer woman looking sideways at lower right.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Composition: Photo fills the top two-thirds with the man left-of-center, the photo wall to the right; below, a cream block holds a staggered title. The green vertical band at left carries the Criterion label.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic still with film grain and shallow focus, with flat printed color blocks for the title.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Typography: Large stacked title Nouvelle / Vague in a high-contrast serif, with the initials N and V as big capitals in magenta and yellow squares, the rest in cream and black. Placed at lower right, about a third of the width and overlapping the photo's bottom edge. Credit lines in small colored caps at the bottom.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Color and light: Black and white with bold magenta, yellow and green blocks on warm off-white; soft diffuse indoor light.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Story it suggests: A smoker pauses in thought in a room full of faces, as if choosing or remembering.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Visual idea: Mid-century graphic blocks of color pull the black-and-white image into the 1960s, echoing New Wave title cards.
1327_nouvelle-vague.jpg.Feels like: French New Wave homage, 1960s magazine layout, cinephile cool.

1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.People: Four men, each in his own close-up face shot, shown in car interiors; two in the top row (one laughing in profile with dark glasses, one pursing lips) and two below looking at or near the viewer, one with thick glasses. They appear to be friends traveling together.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Composition: Four equal quadrants meet in the center, where a white circle with one half striped in black vertical lines sits at the intersection. Faces are placed to the outer corners, with the white title area beneath.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white photographic film stills with moderate grain, plus flat graphic white circle and vertical-line texture.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Typography: Green serif capitals, two lines, centered below the grid, about a quarter of the width in height, and a small gray italic credit beneath. Typeset, quiet, with generous white margin; it doesn't touch the image.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Color and light: Monochrome gray tones with white, single green title; bright daylight through car windows.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Story it suggests: Four companions ride together, each in a different mood, cooped up together on a trip.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Visual idea: Four-panel grid joined by a central circle, like the four men sharing a single orbit; the striped half suggests a film strip or light through slats.
1328_days-and-nights-in-the-forest.jpg.Feels like: Indian art-house, 1970s black-and-white, elegant modern grid design.

1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.People: One woman, large, seen from the chest up and knee, kneeling or crouching and looking upward, one hand holding a gun upright near her chest. Single figure, painted, roughly filling the right two-thirds.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Composition: Diagonal from upper left to lower right; metal grating and frame lines slant at left, and the figure sits right of center with her face near the top. Text stacked at the bottom-left, title across the bottom.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Medium: Digital painting with thick, visible brushstrokes like oil paint, glossy highlights on skin, neon-lit reflections.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Typography: Title in bright yellow, two lines: WELCOME II THE in a thin serif above a thin rule, and TERRORDOME in wide geometric sans below, spanning the full width at the bottom. Director name in white serif above, stacked and left-aligned.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Color and light: Hot magenta and red with deep violet and electric blue; neon, nighttime city light with some orange fire in the left window.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Story it suggests: A woman crouches in a neon-lit hideout, gun in hand, looking up at something coming.
1329_welcome-ii-the-terrordome.jpg.Visual idea: Painted portrait lit as if by police lights, mixing the title's two typefaces to suggest old and new.

1330_christiane-f.jpg.People: A young girl with long red hair, shown large at half-body on the right, bent over looking at her inner forearm with a tourniquet strip in her mouth. Two small inset photos at lower left show a singer at a microphone in a red jacket and a group of five young people walking down a street.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Composition: Vertical torn-paper edge divides the poster: a dark green left column with title and credits, and the large photo on the right, with the two small stills stacked at lower left. The girl's face sits at upper right and her arm sweeps diagonally down to the lower right.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Medium: Grainy color photograph with a warm cast, torn white paper edges separating the panels; a flat printed red title bar.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Typography: Title 'Christiane F.' in heavy cream condensed serif on a red rectangular bar at left, about a third of the width, crossing the torn edge into the photo. Credits in cream sans-serif below. Typeset, neatly placed in the dark column and not over the face.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Color and light: Sickly yellow-olive wall, dark green and black, red hair and red jacket as hot accents; harsh flat flash-like light.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Story it suggests: A girl alone in a grimy room prepares to inject herself, with the rest of her circle shown at the margin.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Visual idea: Torn paper splits the girl's private moment from the glamorous singer and the street group, as if layers of a life are ripped apart.
1330_christiane-f.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s Berlin youth drama, gritty documentary-style photo cover, punk and zine collage.

1331_the-shout.jpg.People: A giant face at the bottom, shown in extreme close-up, mouth wide open in a scream, in high-contrast grain; in the arcs above are small figures: a person lying on a bed, a man with outspread arms on a hill, plus a musical score and a window. All are photographic cut-outs.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Composition: Concentric arcs radiate upward from the screaming mouth like a sound wave, each arc filled with a different photo strip; the face is cropped at the bottom, split across the poster at mid-height by a hard horizontal cut. The title sits in the second arc.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Medium: Photocopy-grainy halftone and threshold collage on off-white paper, with torn-edge strips and cut-and-paste layers.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Typography: Title in bold black wide grotesque capitals, tilted about 15 degrees, set into the second arc at about 40% of width; the director's name in a black serif italic follows the curve at a different angle, and the cast list is smaller and curved too. The lettering rides the arcs.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Color and light: Black, white and warm grey-pink, no accent colour; flat, stark.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Story it suggests: A scream sends out waves that reach strange scenes.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Visual idea: A sound wave drawn as rainbow-like arcs, each containing a fragment of the story the shout touches.
1331_the-shout.jpg.Feels like: Late-1970s experimental British horror, handmade collage.

1332_frankenstein.jpg.People: Two figures: a living man in a green and red cloak, eyes closed, cradling a pale, bandaged, wounded body that arches backward with one arm outstretched. Both are large, filling most of the poster, in a pieta-like embrace; the creature's hands are chained.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Composition: Strong diagonal from the upper left (raised bandaged hand) to the lower left; the cloaked man at right leans in, and long chains swoop down both sides to the bottom. The pair sits in front of heavy dark drapery.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible canvas weave, classical glazing, dramatic chiaroscuro and drips of blood, in an old-master style.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Typography: Title in cream handwritten cursive script, about the width of the lower half, set at the bottom and slightly curving, with a wide-spaced small-capital credit 'GUILLERMO DEL TORO' above in cream serif. The script is thin and overlaps the cloak and chain.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Color and light: Dark brown, teal green, crimson, and chalky white flesh; warm theatrical candlelit glow against shadow.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Story it suggests: A creator holds his bloodied, chained creation as if mourning, or being clutched by it.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Visual idea: A Renaissance pieta transformed: the monster as a fallen Christ, the creator as grieving bearer.
1332_frankenstein.jpg.Feels like: Romantic gothic horror, 19th-century painting, baroque, modern gothic prestige film.

1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.People: Three young women drawn in dynamic action poses, one at upper left with long red hair, one in the middle with a long lavender braid and yellow jacket, one at lower right grinning with a dark bun, all wielding glowing blades and flying or leaping. A huge blue cat-like monster with orange eyes and fangs fills the left background; a small bird and tiny winged creatures appear near the lower girl.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Composition: A swirling diagonal composition running from upper left to lower right, with the three girls staggered along it and the monster's giant face behind them. The title sits at the lower left in the pale clear area with the lowest figure's legs cutting in.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Medium: Digital illustration with loose painterly and ink-sketch linework, soft gradients, glittery star sparkles and speckled cosmic textures; pastel marbled patterns fill the background.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Typography: Large pastel pink-lilac gradient capitals, K-POP DEMON HUNTERS, stacked on three lines at the lower left, with sparkle shapes serving as stars in the letters. It is stylized and sharp, with the lowest letters overlapped by the figure's leg; small credit text at the right.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Color and light: Candy pink, lavender and cyan with blue, yellow and orange accents; luminous, glowing, magical light.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Story it suggests: Three fierce, cheerful fighters leap at a giant snarling monster with glowing weapons, mid battle.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Visual idea: A fusion of pop-idol glamour and monster-fighting action, with sparkle effects in the air like stage lighting.
1333_kpop-demon-hunters.jpg.Feels like: 2020s animated fantasy action, anime-influenced, bright and glittery pop style.

1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.People: A man and a woman, tightly embracing, shown from the waist or thigh up and filling the whole poster. She has blonde curls, a star earring and pink dress, looking sidelong at the camera; he wears a black T-shirt and gold watch, staring straight out. Hands grip her waist.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Composition: A vertical diagonal pairing, the two faces stacked at top center-right and the bodies filling the lower half, the pink title banner cutting across the middle at a slight tilt. Orange and yellow speed streaks cross in at the sides.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Medium: Studio photograph cut out on a flat white background, with slightly high-contrast, glossy 1980s print quality and a rough grain; torn pink paper strip.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Typography: Title in black heavy italic capitals with white offset outline, about 80% of the width, tilted slightly upward to the right and placed over a torn pink paper band at the center. Small spaced 'DAVID LYNCH'S' above in black italic. The band overlaps the bodies, running across both.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Color and light: Hot pink and black with blonde yellow on white; flat, bright flash studio light.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Story it suggests: A couple on the run cling to each other, defiant and a bit dangerous.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Visual idea: The torn-pink-paper title and orange slashes give a ransom-note, punk edge to a romantic embrace.
1334_wild-at-heart.jpg.Feels like: Late-1980s pop-romance and road-movie poster, punk, MTV-era.

1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.People: One young woman with a tall feathered, powdered pale-blond updo, seated with chin on hand, large at half-body to near full; background shows blurry figures in period dress in a gilded room, some faces smudged.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Composition: Central figure leans from the right toward the viewer, and her bent knees and gown fill the lower half; the pink title tilts diagonally across the middle, with other figures soft in the upper background.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Medium: Photographic still with soft focus, film grain and a dreamy glow, with printed pink paper-cut title pieces.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Typography: Title in white hand-cut lettering, slanted capitals on two torn pink paper strips, across the middle at roughly 80% of the width, rising to the right. A script credit curves beneath in white cursive and a name in script above her hair. Handmade, collage-like, overlapping the dress and shoulder.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Color and light: Warm peach, cream, pink, gold, with deep violet shadow; soft candle-like diffused glow.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Story it suggests: A young woman in a lavish court lounges with a knowing look, bored or amused amid the glitter.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Visual idea: Pastel-pink torn paper, like a teen-magazine cutout or scrapbook, set on an opulent period still.
1335_marie-antoinette.jpg.Feels like: Pop-baroque period costume film, mid-2000s, girly teen-zine.

1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.People: One figure in a rotated film still, a man's head and shoulders lying sideways against a bright sky; the image is turned 90 degrees so he seems to lie on his side. A face is partially hidden by a cloth or rough fabric, and the figure's expression is blurred.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Composition: Centered rounded-rectangle photo on a large cream field, with decorative cross ornaments at top and bottom and a circular seal overlapping the photo's right edge. Symmetrical, centered, with generous margins.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Medium: Faded, slightly overexposed color film still with grain; flat cream paper background with tan line-art stamp and ornaments.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Typography: Title in black tall condensed sans-serif capitals, two lines at the bottom, about 70% of the width and overlapping the lower edge of the photo; small italic and capital credit at the top. The seal ring has a circular tan text running around a globe.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Color and light: Pale sky blue and white with cream background, tan and brown accents; washed daylight.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Story it suggests: A person lies in a sky-like space, as if falling or dreaming, apart from the ordinary world.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Visual idea: The photo turned sideways makes ground and sky swap, the way a dream or vision unsettles the body; the stamp suggests an archival seal.
1336_shadows-of-forgotten-ancestors.jpg.Feels like: Restoration-era archive release, folk-ornament design, 1960s Eastern European art cinema.

1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.People: Seven men in silver space suits and helmets walking toward the viewer in a tight cluster, half to full body, large at the bottom; they share a purposeful forward march.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Composition: Title block of huge stacked letters at top, a red-white-blue bar with a star below it, and the group of astronauts filling the bottom half, fading into white at the top.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Medium: Oil painting with visible brushstrokes for the men, white background with a smooth fade, flat vector for the title.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Typography: Huge heavy slab-serif caps in royal blue, stacked three lines and nearly filling the width across the top half; a red double bar with a blue star acts as an underline; small condensed credit line below. Typeset, like a patriotic emblem.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Color and light: Royal blue, red and white, with metallic silver-gray suits; bright, even, white-gray light.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Story it suggests: A team of heroes marches forward together, proud and unshakable.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Visual idea: The flag-colored title bars and the walking line of suits create a national-heroes emblem.
1337_the-right-stuff.jpg.Feels like: 1980s American epic, patriotic, painted heroic-group poster.

1338_the-english-patient.jpg.People: A small, indistinct reclining figure at the lower right in painterly strokes, partly lost in blue-green and a glow; the figure is ambiguous, suggesting a person lying in a bed, plus two tiny biplanes above.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Composition: Large desert dunes fill the upper portion with a biplane at the upper right and its shadow below; a cast list row and the centered title, a faint pattern of embroidered flowers overlapping the sand, and the figure at the bottom.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Medium: Soft painted illustration with blended brushwork, like watercolor and gouache, with a faint textile pattern layered over the dunes.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Typography: Large thin elegant high-contrast capitals 'THE ENGLISH PATIENT' in white, centered and stacked, with small condensed cast names above and credits below; typeset, delicate, floating over the sand.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Color and light: Warm apricot orange and peach with green-teal at the bottom; soft golden, hazy light.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Story it suggests: A flight over the desert and a person lying in a green bed, the two blending into a memory.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Visual idea: Dunes that double as bedsheets, landscape and body, with an embroidered pattern linking them.
1338_the-english-patient.jpg.Feels like: Epic romantic drama, 1990s, dreamy and painterly.

1339_grizzly-man.jpg.People: No people; a bear's face (animal) fills the whole frame in extreme close-up, with only one eye visible at lower left, looking toward the viewer.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Composition: Extreme crop of the head, the eye low on the left and the muzzle at lower right, with a dark rounded label box placed dead center in the fur. Asymmetric and full-bleed.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Medium: Photographic macro image with sharp individual hairs and slight film grain; flat solid dark label.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Typography: Title in cream serif capitals on a dark brown rounded rectangle at the center, about 60% of the width, with a small sans-serif credit below inside the same box. Typeset and neat, sitting on top of the fur like a name tag, with no interaction with the image.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Color and light: Golden tan fur against deep brown, a gray-white patch at lower right; soft overcast daylight.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Story it suggests: A wild animal looks back at us from so near that it feels like an intrusion or a confrontation.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Visual idea: Labeling the bear's fur with a neat tag, as if the animal were a museum specimen or a person introduced by name.
1339_grizzly-man.jpg.Feels like: Nature documentary of the 2000s, arthouse minimalism.

1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.People: Two people at half-body: a smiling woman with curled hair at left, holding a tall stack of white boxes, and a man in a dark double-breasted suit at right, looking at her; his open hand extends toward the boxes. Gentle flirtation, face to face.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Composition: Faces meet at the center, with the woman lower left and the man taller at right, the box stack forming a vertical block between; the swirling title zig-zags diagonally down from upper left to the middle right. A decorated tree and shelves of boxes fill the background.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Medium: Black-and-white studio photograph, with silvery contrast and sharp 1940s Hollywood finish; the title is rendered as shiny folded ribbon.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Typography: Title in ribbon-like silver script, huge, three lines (The Shop / Around the / Corner) zigzagging from the top left across the middle right at about half the poster's height, overlapping the man's shoulder. Star names in white spaced capitals at the top; director credit stacked vertically on the white box at lower right.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Color and light: Black, white, and silver gray; bright, soft studio light.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Story it suggests: Two shop colleagues meet over a stack of gift boxes at Christmastime, with a spark between them.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Visual idea: The title as gift ribbon, unfurling over the pair and tying together the shop's wrapping and their romance.
1340_the-shop-around-the-corner.jpg.Feels like: Classic 1940s Hollywood romantic comedy, holiday film, old studio glamour.

1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.People: A line of people walking through tall grass at top left (a group of soldiers or travelers in single file), a masked woman in a headscarf holding a stick in red, a man with open arms in orange, and a couple in a car in green. Mostly small to medium shots, each different.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Composition: Collage grid of four rectangular stills tinted in different colors, staggered around a central text block; the large round seal at top right balances the left photos, and the credits list sits at right. Lots of cream space.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Medium: Photographic film stills, three duotoned in red, orange and teal-green, one in natural color; printed on flat cream with flat seal graphics.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Typography: Title in tall thin coral-red condensed capitals stacked on four lines at center-left, about a quarter of the poster's width; film list at right in black condensed capitals with small serif names and country and year captions. All typeset, in a column, sitting in the cream space. A round stamp reading 'Dedicated to preserving and restoring films from around the world' with a large number 6.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Color and light: Cream background with coral red, orange yellow, teal, and sun-gold grass; warm even daylight.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Story it suggests: Four films from different countries seem to share a single shelf, each shown in a single revealing glimpse of people on the move.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Visual idea: A catalog or stamp-card of world cinema: each film color-coded and pinned to a page like specimens.
1341_martin-scorseses-world-cinema-proje.Feels like: Archive restoration box set, mid-century travel poster and film-festival program.

1342_deliverance.jpg.People: Two groups of men: four men sitting in a posed sepia group photo at top, and below, four men in a rocky cave in distress, one wounded and being cradled by a shirtless man with a worried face, another pressing a hand on the rock. Half-body to close-ups.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Composition: Frame within a frame: an orange-brown rectangular border encloses a small sepia photo at the top, a tagline, and a large dark photo below. The title block sits outside the frame at bottom.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Medium: Photographic stills with film grain: the top is sepia and faded like an old snapshot, the bottom is deep green-brown color film.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Typography: Title in heavy rounded sans-serif with a gold-brown gradient, filling the full width at the bottom, about a tenth of the height, with a smaller black bold credit line below. Bold black tagline 'This is the weekend they didn't play golf.' set in the white space between the photos. Typeset, 1970s.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Color and light: Off-white page with rust-orange border, sepia and brown tones above, dark green and black cave tones below; harsh dim light.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Story it suggests: A friendly group outing turns into a violent ordeal in rough country.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Visual idea: Before and after: a smiling snapshot above, a bloody scene below, with the tagline connecting them as an ironic caption.
1342_deliverance.jpg.Feels like: 1970s American thriller, vintage poster layout, retro adventure.

1343_career-girls.jpg.People: Two women sitting close on a sofa at the bottom, full-length: one with brown hair in jeans and sneakers, one with short red hair in black; both look in different directions, hands touching around a cigarette. A table of cigarette packs and clutter is in the foreground.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Composition: Title fills the top two-thirds and the women are in the bottom third on a wide sofa; horizontal bands (wall, sofa back, figures, table). Mostly empty beige wall space above them.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Medium: Photographic film still with soft grain, matte, slightly washed 1990s film color.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Typography: Gigantic dark olive-brown condensed rounded sans-serif capitals stacked CAREER / GIRLS across nearly the full width, about 55% of the height; small spaced capitals credit at the top right. Typeset, flat, sitting on the wall as if painted on it, above the figures without touching them.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Color and light: Beige wall, orange floral sofa, blue jeans, black tops; flat, dim indoor daylight.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Story it suggests: Two old friends sit together in a messy room, close but each lost in her own thoughts.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Visual idea: The title as a giant wall slogan looming over small lives and their cluttered table.
1343_career-girls.jpg.Feels like: 1990s British kitchen-sink drama, social realism, understated indie.

1344_chocolat.jpg.People: Two people: a young blond girl in a pink shirt shielding her eyes with her hand, sitting on the shoulders of a Black man in a light blue shirt who stares ahead. Large, half-body to close-up, stacked vertically with her above and him lower right; his arm holds her leg.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Composition: The girl's head sits upper left and the man's face lower right, forming a diagonal; behind them is empty sky. A white strip at the bottom holds the credit and title.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Medium: Photographic color portrait with a crisp, slightly grainy film look, as if low-angle 35mm.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Typography: Title CHOCOLAT in heavy dark brown wide capitals at the bottom right, small relative to the poster (about a quarter of the width), on a white strip below the photo. A thin credit 'A FILM BY CLAIRE DENIS' sits to the left in sans-serif. Typeset and kept out of the picture.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Color and light: Pale clear blue sky, soft pink and baby blue clothes, dark brown skin; strong afternoon sun with sharp shadows.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Story it suggests: A child looks into the distance from a man's shoulders while he stares just as far but with a graver expression, as if they see different futures.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Visual idea: The girl rides high looking at the horizon while the man below is contained in a quieter gaze, a picture of unequal vantage points.
1344_chocolat.jpg.Feels like: 1980s French art-house, colonial-era memory drama, sun-washed fashion photograph.
